title: Computer Assistant II (Part-time)
description:
Position Details
  • Title: Computer Assistant II
  • Location: InfoZone
  • Hours: Part-time, 20 hours per week
  • Schedule: May vary, but will be a combination of day, evening, and weekend hours; including Sundays, and holidays. Weekend shifts are not extra hours.
  • Starting Hourly Rate: $18.30
  • FLSA Status: Non-Exempt
  • Submission Deadline: October 1st at 11:59 pm. Candidates will be updated on application status via email.

A successful candidate will…

  • Six-months/one year of advanced study or training past high school or equivalency
  • Have intermediate to advanced knowledge of computer functions (Microsoft Office applications, Google applications, and iOS or Android devices and apps, printing, copy machines, etc.).
  • Have previous experience working with customers face to face.
  • Have previous experience assisting others with basic computer and/ or software problems.
  • Be available to work day, evening, and weekend hours - including occasional mandatory Sundays.
  • Be bilingual (preferred but not required).
  • Previous experience working in a customer service position and/or working with adult instruction is preferred.

What does the job look like?

  • Develops, assists with, and/or presents technology-themed programming and digital literacy classes across multiple skill levels. Develops and delivers computer and technical skill training, for the local community and community groups.
  • Supports library patrons on workforce-related projects to assist with job searches, writing resumes and cover letters, and other computer and workforce related activities, including assisting patrons with internet use in relation to navigating job search engines, government workforce websites and other job-related websites.
  • Monitor the Computer Lab. Troubleshoot basic computer technical problems.
  • Handle patron’s questions and offer computer assistance.
  • Order supplies as needed and maintain printer/equipment readiness.
  • Process and shelve holds.
  • Assist patrons with questions regarding library policies and services, analyze and make decisions regarding patron problems, using good and appropriate judgment.
  • Accept and process all outgoing and incoming materials from patrons in a timely manner.
  • Assist patrons with library card applications.
  • Prepare cash drawer, including preparation of bank deposit. Accept payments for overdue, lost and damaged materials.
  • Physical requirements include frequent standing, lifting/ carrying, hearing/ talking, and fine dexterity. Job also includes pushing and pulling up to 20 pounds. May occasionally lift more than 20 pounds.

What’s In It for You?

We offer our employees a robust compensation package! Our comprehensive benefits include: medical, dental and vision insurance coverage; 100% company-paid long term disability, employer paid basic group life insurance, generous amounts of PTO, 11 paid holidays per year, and a Library paid pension plan. The Library proudly promotes from within as part of a strong commitment to providing career growth opportunities for employees of all levels.

We are proud to be an EEO/AA employer M/F/D/V.

title: Forretningsudvikler til Modeldata
description:
Vil du være med til at forme datagrundlaget bag Jyske Banks kreditmodeller?

Har du erfaring med kreditrisiko, IRB, analyse eller data, og motiveres du af at løse komplekse problemstillinger i samarbejde med dygtige kolleger?

Vi søger en forretningsudvikler til vores Modeldata-team, hvor du får en central rolle i udviklingen af de data, der understøtter bankens kreditmodeller og risikostyring. Du bliver en del af et spændende felt, hvor forretning, data, modeller og regulatoriske krav mødes, og hvor du er med til at skabe konkrete løsninger til bankens kreditmodeller.

Skab værdi dér, hvor data omsættes til indsigt

Bag enhver god analyse og velunderbygget beslutning ligger der data af høj kvalitet. I Modeldata teamet arbejder vi med at skabe og videreudvikle det datagrundlag, som understøtter centrale processer inden for risikostyring og kreditområdet i Jyske Bank.

Du bliver en vigtig del af et team, der fungerer som bindeled mellem forretningen, modeludviklerne og de øvrige teams i Data Warehouse. Sammen arbejder vi for at sikre et solidt, veldokumenteret og anvendeligt datagrundlag til bankens analyse- og risikoområder.

Du kommer til at arbejde med nogle af bankens mest centrale dataområder og får mulighed for at præge både løsninger, processer og fremtidige initiativer.

Dine opgaver

Som forretningsudvikler vil du blandt andet:

  • Afdække og analysere forretningsmæssige krav til modeldata.
  • Omsætte forretningsbehov og regulatoriske krav til konkrete dataløsninger.
  • Agere bindeled mellem forretningen, modeludviklere og dataudviklere.
  • Bidrage til høj datakvalitet og tydeligt dataejerskab.
  • Dokumentere data, regler og data flows.
  • Være med til at sikre et robust og fremtidssikret datagrundlag til kreditmodellerne.

Hvem er du?

Du behøver ikke kunne sætte flueben ved alt. Det vigtigste er, at du er nysgerrig, analytisk og trives med at skabe sammenhæng mellem forretning og data.

Vi forestiller os, at du:

  • Har erfaring fra den finansielle sektor.
  • Har indsigt i kreditområdet, kreditrisiko eller IRB-området.
  • Har interesse for data, analyse og komplekse forretningsmæssige sammenhænge.
  • Kan skabe struktur og overblik i komplekse problemstillinger.
  • Tager ansvar og bidrager til fremdrift.

Vi ser gerne, at du har erfaring med SQL, dataanalyse eller datamodellering, herunder opbygning og vedligeholdelse af historiske dataserier. Derudover er kendskab til data governance en fordel, men vi vægter din nysgerrighed og læringsvilje mindst lige så højt.

Derfor skal du vælge os

Hos os får du:

  • En vigtig rolle med stor synlighed og høj forretningsmæssig betydning.
  • En central rolle i arbejdet med det datagrundlag, der understøtter bankens kreditmodeller og risikostyring.
  • Dygtige og engagerede kolleger med forskellige faglige profiler.
  • Et solidt fagligt miljø med gode udviklingsmuligheder.
  • Fleksible arbejdsforhold og mulighed for hjemmearbejde.
  • En kultur præget af tillid, hjælpsomhed, humor og ansvar.

En hverdag med åbenhed og tillid

I vores Modeldata team tror vi på, at de bedste løsninger skabes i fællesskab. Vi udfordrer hinanden fagligt, hjælper hinanden i mål og værdsætter forskellige perspektiver.

Vi har stor frihed til at påvirke vores egen hverdag og vores løsninger, og vi lægger vægt på, at det både skal være fagligt spændende og sjovt at gå på arbejde.

Om afdelingen

Modeldata er en del af Datawarehouse og Systemstyring i Jyske Bank. Vi arbejder i krydsfeltet mellem forretning, data og teknologi og har en vigtig rolle i udviklingen af de data, som understøtter bankens strategiske beslutninger.

Du bliver en del af et team med kolleger i både Silkeborg og København. Du kan have din daglige base enten i Glaskuben i København eller i Silkeborg, og vi arbejder i et fleksibelt hybrid setup, hvor faglig udvikling, godt samarbejde og en god balance mellem arbejde og privatliv er en naturlig del af hverdagen.

Er du klar til næste skridt?

Måske arbejder du allerede med kreditrisiko, IRB, modeller eller data. Måske sidder du i en rolle, hvor du savner større indflydelse på løsningerne. Eller måske er du blot nysgerrig på, hvordan du kan bringe din faglighed i spil i et af bankens mest spændende dataområder.

Vi oplever mangfoldighed som en ressource i vores opgaveløsning og i vores fællesskab. Derfor opfordrer vi alle til at søge – vi ser frem til at modtage din ansøgning, hvor du beskriver netop dine evner i forhold til jobbet.

title: Power Quality Customer Training Team Leader
description:
The opportunity

Do you want to be part of executing our People strategy of Lifelong learning & Groiwth and directly impacting our customers sucess? GPQSS Technical Training center and Power Quality in Västerås, Sweden is looking for a Team Leader to take on the challenge to coordinate our Global Customer Training team. Our customer training is a key part in the customer focused approach, and we need you who enjoy building and developing teams. Our project portfolio is bigger than ever, and the demand for training is growing. If you enjoy interacting with people and thrive to be the spider in the web, the role as Global Customer Training Team Leader offers you exactly this.

In this role, you will be responsible for organizing, coordinating, and leading the daily operations for an expanding global team. The team today consists of 2 employees + the team leader. Power Quality Customer training is part of the GPQSS Technical Training Center and we welcome you into a global training team with people from many cultures and locations. This is an opportunity to work in a very dynamic and growing organization where you will have the chance to be involved in developing people according to our strategy and work with continious improvement initiatives.

  • Act as an operational team leader of the Global Customer Training Team as well as lead and organize their daily activities.
  • Work with technical experts to create a training plan in accordance with the customers’ technical specification and represent Customer Training in tenders and projects.
  • Manage technical training in our delivery projects and tenders according to contracts, deadlines, and within budget, collect feedback from customers and trainers and transform it into concrete actions to further develop the trainings.
  • Ensure that training related documentation and any special equipment or customized devices are accurately prepared and available for training sessions.
  • Create and coordinate training agendas.
  • Participate in meetings with customers when required.
  • This role is part of the technical training center team but will work very closely with the engineering and planning teams and interact cross functionally in the organization.

Your background

  • Excellent coordination, communication, networking and leadership skills
  • Strong project management skills
  • Candidate should be driven, well organized, communicative and have passion for training and developing people and have good negotiation skills.
  • Experience in a leading position and/or experience within the field of technical training is preferable.
  • Technical interest and a curios and innovative mindset are required. Degree in technical area is beneficial but not a requirement.
  • Strong team-player with the ability to engage with different stakeholders and all levels of the organization, organized and accurate with a problem-solving mindset.
  • Solid experience of using MS Office. Knowledge of other administrative tools and systems is a plus.
  • Fluency in English, both written and spoken, is required.

title: Purchasing Specialist
description:
Job Summary

The Purchasing Specialist will be capable of performing tasks in multiple areas of the Purchasing discipline but will be a Subject Matter Expert in one or more areas. The Purchasing Specialist will ensure the availability of raw materials in a manner that allows our facilities to be responsive to our customers in each industry segment we serve while minimizing the company’s working capital investment.

Summary of Essential Job Functions:

· Manage the purchasing process for raw materials in assigned commodities and facilities.

· Ensure continuity of raw material supply for designated U.S., Mexico and Canada facilities per the Transactional Purchasing Process.

· Identify purchasing requirements and execute the Purchase Order Process at designated U.S., Mexico and Canada facilities.

· Identify barriers to strategic business goals and proactively put counter-measures and process improvement initiatives in place to enable business growth.

· Oversee and execute the Inventory Level Corrective Action Process for the designated facilities, which includes ensuring facility ordering decisions meet TGC stocking criteria.

· Execute the Vendor Lead Time Change Management and Vendor Price Change Management Processes and maintain accurate and timely Part Maintenance Cost Field determination for the assigned commodities and facilities.

· Daily tasks include answering raw material part ID requests, sourcing requests, inventory stocking requests, material shortages, new vendor requests and expedite requests.

· Assist the Strategic Sourcing team as required for sourcing/quote requests

· Analyze industry and demand trends and support senior management with the development and implementation of sourcing strategies

· Maintain process documentation and provide training materials that allow others to administer process with limited direction.

· Lead/facilitate process improvement activities utilizing lean tools and techniques.

· Document supplier interactions using iCRM.

title: Senior internal lead auditor
description:
The opportunity

Power Transformers is a business unit within Hitachi Energy that manufactures power transformers and reactors up to the highest possible power and voltage levels. The unit in Ludvika has unique global expertise in ultra-high voltage technology and is an important hub for the development of new transformer technology. Power Transformers is currently in a strong growth phase and we are therefore looking for an audit manager for our quality department. In this role, you will have a central position in the organization and be an important part of the development of both our production and our processes. This position is located at Hitachi Energy – Power Transformers in Ludvika, Sweden. We believe in a hybrid model when it comes to remote and on-site work, knowing that both physical contact and individual time for focus are needed.

  • You will be responsible for leading, running and improving our internal audit activities regarding standards ISO 9001, 14001, 45001, 50001.

title: Systems Administrator - FT
description:
This is a hybrid position that requires the individual to work 2 days a week from a location in Central Iowa, North East Iowa or Omaha, NE

WANT TO BE A PART OF AN AWARD WINNING TEAM, APPLY TODAY!!

Take a look at all our great benefits here!

Application deadline: September 30th, 2026

Location: Cedar Falls – IA / Johnston – IA / Omaha, NE

Hybrid eligible

Status: Full-time exempt

Summary

The Systems Administrator manages, maintains, and monitors IT systems and provides tier 2 support to end users. The position’s responsibilities include administration of Windows Active Directory, Microsoft Exchange, VMware, SAN/NAS, patch management, and backup software. The Systems Administrator also maintains regular helpdesk status updates for support and project cases.

Essential Functions

  • Create excellent service experiences that promote the Veridian brand.
  • Assist with the administration and maintenance of Windows Active Directory and related services, including user and group management, Group Policy administration, and identity-related troubleshooting.
  • Assist with the administration and maintenance of Microsoft 365 services, including Exchange Online, Entra ID, Teams, OneDrive, and SharePoint Online. Support user provisioning, licensing, permissions, and basic tenant administration.
  • Assist with the administration and maintenance of server infrastructure, including Active Directory Domain Controllers, DNS, DHCP, file servers, print services, and business applications.
  • Monitor backup jobs, verify successful completion, assist with restore requests, and help ensure recovery objectives are met.
  • Assist with the administration and maintenance of file storage systems, including capacity monitoring and routine storage management activities.
  • Assist with the administration of VMware or other virtualization platforms, including server provisioning, resource management, monitoring, and routine maintenance.
  • Deploy operating system and application updates, assist with vulnerability remediation efforts, monitor compliance reporting, and work with IT Security to address identified risks.
  • Provide application and infrastructure support to end users and IT staff. Troubleshoot server, workstation, and application issues, coordinate with vendors as needed, and assist with software and hardware installations and upgrades.
  • Document systems, procedures, configurations, and support processes. Maintain accurate and up-to-date technical documentation.
  • Collaborate with senior IT staff on infrastructure projects, system upgrades, business continuity initiatives, and disaster recovery testing activities.
  • Collaborate with the IT Security department to support security best practices and ensure adherence to PCI and other regulatory requirements.
  • Monitor system health, performance, and capacity using established tools and processes, escalating issues when appropriate.
  • Contribute positively to team efforts by consistently achieving established goals and expectations.
  • On call availability required for system support as needed (includes nights and weekends).

Key Attributes

  • Oral and written communication skills.
  • Member service focus.
  • Attention to detail and accuracy.
  • Positive attitude that supports a team environment.
  • Dependable and punctual; flexible during peak times.
  • High level of confidentiality.
  • Organizational skills.
  • Self-motivated; ability to work without close supervision.
  • Problem solving; analysis.

Physical Demands

The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job:

  • Occasionally lift and/or move items over 50 pounds.
  • Remain sedentary (seated) for extended periods of time.

Working Conditions

This job operates in a professional office environment and routinely uses standard office equipment.

Travel

Limited travel expected.

Required Education and Experience

  • Associate's Degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Management Information Systems, or a related technical field or equivalent combination of education, training, and experience of 4+ years.
  • 2+ years of experience in an IT support, systems administration, or related technical role with direct experience in the following:
    • Microsoft Active Directory
    • DNS
    • DHCP
    • Group Policy
    • Microsoft 365 Administration
    • PowerShell or other command-line tools
  • Experience troubleshooting operating systems, user access, applications, and infrastructure-related issues.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Windows operating systems and business productivity applications.

Preferred Education and Experience

  • Experience with the following:
    • Microsoft 365 services, including Exchange Online, Entra ID, Teams, OneDrive, and SharePoint Online
    • Microsoft Power Platform, including Power Automate, Power Apps, and Copilot Studio
    • VMware or other virtualization platforms
    • Backup and recovery technologies
    • Patch management and vulnerability remediation
    • PowerShell scripting and automation
    • Linux administration
    • Microsoft Azure, AWS, or other cloud platforms
    • PCI compliance requirements and cybersecurity best practices

Other Duties

Veridian Credit Union is a PCI compliant financial institution to ensure the security of member information. As such, all employees are expected to ensure security measures are in place and adhered to regarding PCI and other highly secure data compliance requirements.

Please note this job description is not designed to cover or contain a comprehensive listing of activities, duties, or responsibilities that are required of the employee for this job. Duties, responsibilities, and activities may change at any time with or without notice.

title: Design Engineering 12 Month Placement Scheme
description:
Career Area:

Students and Graduates

Job Description:

Your Work Shapes the World at Caterpillar Inc.

When you join Caterpillar, you're joining a global team who cares not just about the work we do – but also about each other. We are the makers, problem solvers, and future world builders who are creating stronger, more sustainable communities. We don't just talk about progress and innovation here – we make it happen, with our customers, where we work and live. Together, we are building a better world, so we can all enjoy living in it.

12-Month Industrial Placement Scheme

Discipline: Design Engineering – Caterpillar Marine

Location: Wimborne

Salary: £26,000 Share Scheme, Pension and 25 days annual leave (plus bank holidays).

We currently have some exciting opportunities for industrial placement students to join Caterpillar across several of our sites. You will have the opportunity to work with others across our organisation and you will be directly involved, and at the heart of our business, participating on strategic projects.

*Please note that to be eligible to complete a 12-Month Industrial Placement commencing July 2027, you must be in your penultimate year of study unless enrolled in an integrated master’s program.

What do we do?

Caterpillar Inc. is the world’s leading manufacturer of construction and mining equipment, diesel and natural gas engines, industrial gas turbines, and diesel-electric locomotives. Since 1925, we’ve been driving sustainable progress and helping customers build a better world through innovative products and services. Throughout the product life cycle, we offer services built on cutting-edge technology and decades of product expertise. These products and services, backed by our global dealer network, provide exceptional value to help our customers succeed.

We have a clear vision to be the global leader in providing customer value in the markets in which we operate. Our core values (Integrity, Excellence, Teamwork, Commitment and Sustainability) are key to our success.

Caterpillar, Wimborne

The facility boasts a wealth of hugely experienced designers, engineers and technicians used to providing solutions for commercial, professional and military customers in the marine product range. From design, testing and production, each engine is proven before leaving the premises to ensure the best performance for the end-user. The production products range up to 500 bhp for marine propulsion engines and 200 ekW for our gensets. In addition to the factory the Wimborne location is home for roles across sales, marketing, product support and engineering for the entire range of Caterpillar marine products.

Diversity at Caterpillar

When we leverage our people's experiences, backgrounds, and cultures in an inclusive environment, we enable every individual to achieve their full potential, which drives business success. We are proud to be active partners with both the Society of Women Engineers (SWE) & Women's Engineering Society (WES). We also have numerous well supported employee resource groups. Caterpillar is an equal opportunity employer, and we welcome applicants from diverse backgrounds.

What experiences can we offer you?

As an equal opportunity employer, we value diversity at Caterpillar and believe the more experience you can gain early in your career the further you can go. That’s why during our yearlong scheme we place an emphasis on multiple diverse projects. You will have the opportunity to work and collaborate with people in Caterpillar facilities worldwide and we are looking for you to bring fresh, innovative ideas to solve complex technical problems. You will be a fully involved team member with responsibility and accountability for key project deliverables. That said, you will be given all the support you require to be successful.

Our placement roles have the additional benefit of a workplace mentor; this could be your manager or a technical expert who will support you throughout your time at Caterpillar and help you gain the professional development and skills you need to be set up for success! Our placement students can expect to return to university with further developed technical skills and experience of how University learning is applied to the workplace.

We also operate a conditional offer process; our highest performing placement students are fast tracked to our graduate development scheme. This includes a financial incentive and the potential of a summer work placement. Offers will be made based on the condition that a graduate role is available at the time of your graduation and that you achieve a min of 2:1.

The role

With the team growing we are looking for a design engineering placement student at Caterpillar Marine, located in Wimborne, Dorset within the Caterpillar Oil, Gas & Marine division. The team has responsibility for all areas of marine engine & genset design for products from 10kW to over 750kW. This role will focus on design of mechanical systems for this wide range of marine products.

Design engineering design placements offer placement students real life product design experience in a customer focused environment.

Job duties and responsibilities may include, but are not limited to:

  • Design of marine engine systems and components.

  • System schematics & layout.

  • Technical calculations.

  • Component / sub-systems supplier review.

  • Liaison with shop floor personnel on the assembly / manufacture of product.

  • Carry out all work in accordance with company policies and procedures.

Who are we looking for?

We’re looking for people who can show us a highly participative working style, and who thrive in a team of committed professionals. At the same time, we need people who are self-motivated and can drive change through persuasion and influence. Communication and presentational skills are essential.

As the type of roles within our business are becoming more diverse, we are looking for people who are open minded, excellent problem solvers and who have an ability to learn quickly. You will be motivated, hard-working, and will embrace change. In return for your dedication and hard work, you will be provided with excellent career opportunities and strong support for your personal and career development to pursue a career within Caterpillar.

Applicants will be on target to achieve a minimum of 2:1 honours degree level in a relevant discipline:

  • Mechanical / Automotive Engineering

Recruitment Process Guide

We're excited that you're considering a career with Caterpillar. Below is an overview of our Early Careers recruitment process and what you can expect at each stage.

Step 1: Online Application

To apply, simply complete our online application form and upload your CV before the advertised closing date.

Our team will review all submissions & we'll keep you updated and let you know as soon as possible if you've been selected to progress to the next stage.

Step 2: Online Assessments & Video Interview

If you are selected to move forward in the process, you'll be invited to complete some online assessments, followed by a user-friendly video interview. Your responses will be reviewed by the hiring team, and successful candidates will then be invited to attend an in-person Assessment Centre / Interview, which we anticipate will take place on Wednesday 2nd December 2026 at our Wimborne facility. If possible, we recommend keeping this date available.

To ensure you don't miss any communications from us, please regularly check your text, email inbox (including your spam/junk folder) and your Workday account for updates.

Step 3: In Person Assessment Centre

Our Assessment Centre is designed to help you showcase your potential through a range of interactive activities focused on competencies such as teamwork, communication, problem-solving, and decision-making.

We aim to make the experience engaging, inclusive, and relaxed, giving you the best opportunity to demonstrate your strengths and learn more about Caterpillar.

Step 4: Offer

Following the Assessment Centre, the Caterpillar team will review all feedback and make hiring decisions. We aim to communicate outcomes and extend offers to successful candidates as quickly as possible.

title: Talehørekonsulent til PPR og Familieindsatser
description:
PPR og Familieindsatser - Familie og Rådgivning i Gladsaxe Kommune søger en talehørekonsulent 30-37 timer om ugen med ansættelse 1. december 2026 eller hurtigst muligt. Har du lyst til at være en del af et stærkt tværfagligt fællesskab og være med til at gøre en forskel for Gladsaxe Kommunes børn og unge fra et PPR-perspektiv?

Om os
I PPR Gladsaxe bliver du en del af en stor og velfungerende talehøregruppe. Vi tilbyder en stilling, hvor du får rig mulighed for både direkte intervention med børn og unge og konsultativ vejledning til barnets omgivelser herunder forældre, pædagoger og lærere. .Vi gør os umage for at tage godt imod nye medarbejdere, og tilbyder dig blandt andet mentorforløb, sidemandsoplæring og let adgang til sparring og vidensdeling.

PPR Gladsaxe er opdelt i 10 tværfaglige teams, bestående af psykologer, talehørekonsulenter, ergoterapeuter og PPR-konsulenter samt familiekonsulenter. Hvert team har en teamleder og en koordinator. PPR’s primære opgave er at kvalificere, motivere og understøtte professionelle såvel som forældre med henblik på at fremme et optimalt lærings- og udviklingsmiljø for børn og unge i kommunens skoler og dagtilbud.

I Gladsaxe arbejder vi i og med ”Deltagelsesmuligheder for alle”, hvor børne -ungerådgiver, familiekonsulenter og PPR tværprofessionelt er til stede i børnenes læringsmiljøer. Du vil blive tilknyttet et fast tværprofessionelt team og et område. Vi arbejder med at forstærke de almene miljøer, så flere børn og unge får deltagelsesmuligheder i de lokale fællesskaber i børnehus og skole.

Dine arbejdsopgaver vil være at bidrage til stærke sprogmiljøer i både dagtilbud og skoler igennem bl.a.
  • logopædisk undervisning, testning og vurdering/udredning
  • praksisnær sparring til pædagoger og lærere med udgangspunkt i børn med sproglige vanskeligheder
  • fysisk tilstedeværelse i børnegrupperne og klasserne med fokus på det alment forebyggende arbejde og udvikling af de voksnes pædagogiske kompetencer, hvor din faglighed skal supplere lærernes og pædagogernes didaktiske og pædagogiske faglighed. Herunder børn med tale-, sprog og hørevanskeligheder
  • specialpædagogisk rådgivning om børn i vanskeligheder, samt vejledning til deres familier.
  • samarbejde med forældre, lærere og andre fagpersoner for at skabe de bedste rammer for børns udvikling.
  • pædagogisk og psykologisk rådgivning til ledelser og ressourcepersoner
  • være en del af handleplaner med det fagprofessionelle personale i skoler og børnehuse samt pædagogiske-psykologiske vurderinger i et tværfagligt samarbejde med de øvrige faggrupper

Vi ønsker en kollega, der
  • har gå på mod og brænder for det logopædiske arbejde
  • har et stærkt fokus på at udvikle de sproglige miljøer i børnehuse og skoler og udvikle deltagelsesformer for børn
  • har en stærk monofaglighed og er gavmild med at dele og formidle viden
  • er villig til at udfordre praksis
  • vil være med til udvikle vores fag og metoder i talehøregruppen
  • gerne har erfaring fra PPR eller anden relevant kendskab til området
  • har en uddannelse som logopæd/audiologopæd, lærer eller pædagog med PD- eller speciallæreruddannelse eller lignende kvalifikationer

Vi tilbyder dig
  • at blive forankret i en fagligt stærk og hyggelig faggruppe på 15 talehørekonsulenter
  • en mentor i opstartsperioden
  • at få ansvaret for primært en folkeskole og tre børnehuse i et af vores 10 tværfaglige PPR-teams
  • at få mulighed for at arbejde med flersprogede børn og familier
  • at få mulighed for at være med til at opbygge vores DLD-indsatser på skoleområdet. Du vil i dette skoleår (26-27), sammen med faggruppen, få et kompetenceforløb i DLD i skolen
  • en inddragende og løsningsfokuseret arbejdsplads, hvor du kan sætte dit aftryk og bidrage til udvikling og ny praksis
  • spændende og varierede arbejdsopgaver med høj grad af frihed og ansvar.
  • høj grad af fleksibilitet og mulighed for at tilrettelægge arbejdet hensigtsmæssigt
  • en kollegagruppe, hvor der er højt til loftet og en uhøjtidelig omgangsform
  • en ledelse, der har tillid til, at alle gør sig umage og yder det bedste i forhold til opgaven
  • et særligt tilrettelagt introduktionsforløb

For yderligere oplysninger
Kontakt PPR-teamleder Semail Wanscher på mail SEWANS@gladsaxe.dk / telefon 51 15 67 73 eller til Talehørekonsulent Mette Søe Hastrup på telefon 20 15 60 60.

Ansøgningsfrist
15. oktober 2026 kl. 12.00.
Samtalerne vil blive afholdt den 26. oktober 2026 fra 10.00-15.00.

I Gladsaxe tager vi udgangspunkt i borgernes og virksomhedernes behov og trivsel i alt, hvad vi gør. Bæredygtig velfærd og udvikling er en mærkesag for os og vi arbejder for både social, miljømæssig og økonomisk bæredygtighed. Med FN’s verdensmål som ramme ser vi en bæredygtig fremtid som noget, vi skaber sammen – med borgere, virksomheder, foreninger og lokalsamfundet. Du kan læse mere om vores mål i Gladsaxestrategien.

Ingen ansatte i Gladsaxe Kommune må ryge eller bruge tobaksrelaterede produkter i arbejdstiden, som for eksempel snus og vapes.

Vi opfordrer alle interesserede uanset alder, køn/identitet, seksualitet, handicap, religion eller etnisk tilhørsforhold til at søge stillingen.

title: Staff Backend Engineer - Grafana Second Horizon | UK | Remote
description:
Grafana Labs is the company behind Grafana Cloud, the fully managed observability platform trusted by more than 10,000 organizations to ensure reliability, resolve incidents faster, and optimize telemetry at scale. Built on open source and open standards and designed for interoperability across any stack, Grafana Cloud brings AI to observability and observability to AI, giving teams (and their agents) unified visibility so they can see, understand, and act on all their disparate data, wherever it lives, and move at the speed of their ambitions. Customers, including Anthropic, Bloomberg, NVIDIA, Microsoft, and Salesforce, rely on Grafana Labs. We are a 100% remote company with team members across 40+ countries, backed by leading investors including Lightspeed Venture Partners, Sequoia Capital, GIC, Coatue, J.P. Morgan, CapitalG, and Lead Edge Capital. Learn more at and follow us on LinkedIn and X.

We’re scaling fast and staying true to what makes us different: an open-source legacy, a global collaborative culture, and a passion for meaningful work. Our team thrives in an innovation-driven environment where transparency, autonomy, and trust fuel everything we do.

You may not meet every requirement, and that’s okay. If this role excites you, we’d love you to raise your hand for what could be a truly career-defining opportunity.

This is a remote opportunity, and we would be interested in applicants located in Spain, Sweden, UK, Ireland or Germany.

The Opportunity:

At Grafana Labs, we build observability tools that help users understand, respond to, and improve their systems – regardless of scale, complexity, or tech stack. We recently started a skunkworks initiative with a mission to bring observability to the rest of the business. Our goal is to make Grafana the single best place where humans and AI agents understand and act on real-time data from across the enterprise. As part of this initiative, we are building an AI-native data intelligence system that gives agents reliable, governed access to enterprise context. This system helps agents retrieve the right data, metadata, definitions, lineage, quality signals, and institutional knowledge without every agent builder having to maintain their own brittle context files. The principle is simple: the context system retrieves, agents decide, and data teams maintain the intelligence.

The new team is a mix of seasoned Grafanistas and new hires. We operate with a high degree of autonomy and ownership, both as individuals and as a team. Engineers are empowered to make decisions, move quickly, and validate ideas early – while being supported by a deeply collaborative culture that values curiosity, feedback, and cross-functional partnership.

We’re looking for a Staff-level Backend Engineer to help build the first production services for this context layer management system. You will design and ship the core backend architecture that powers ingestion, context storage, retrieval APIs, and agent-facing integrations. This is an early-stage role on a high-autonomy team, so you should be comfortable working through ambiguity, making pragmatic architectural decisions, and building systems that can evolve from internal dogfooding to production-grade SaaS. As the team matures, there’s a broad opportunity to expand or redefine this role based on impact and initiative.

What You'll Be Doing:

  • Build the core backend services: Design, implement, test, and operate the first services for context ingestion, context indexing, retrieval orchestration, API access, source configuration, and system administration.
  • Create a scalable SaaS foundation: Help define and build the architecture for a multi-tenant service, including tenant isolation, usage tracking, quotas, audit logs, background jobs, and reliable service boundaries.
  • Power agent-facing retrieval workflows: Build APIs and service interfaces that allow AI agents, MCP tools, CLIs, and internal applications to retrieve relevant context, provenance, confidence signals, and warnings.
  • Work across product and infrastructure: Partner with the team to make practical tradeoffs between fast experimentation and long-term reliability, especially as the project moves from prototype to production.
  • Operate what you build: Instrument services with metrics, logs, traces, alerts, and dashboards. Use observability tools to understand system behavior and improve reliability.
  • Contribute to technical direction: Help shape the architecture, service boundaries, storage choices, API contracts, deployment patterns, and engineering practices for a new product area.
  • Effective communication: You’ll be working in a highly dynamic and collaborative environment, so we need someone who can communicate effectively and contribute across teams.
  • Ownership and impact: Take full ownership of the AI solutions you develop, ensuring they are not only innovative but also scalable, maintainable, and aligned with real user workflows.

What Makes You a Great Fit:

  • Strong engineering skills: Solid experience building production-grade, user-facing software systems. You’re a self-starter, capable of tackling complex engineering problems and making UI design decisions with minimal supervision.
  • AI experience with a practical mindset: You’re familiar with AI technologies and frameworks, and you focus on delivering high-quality solutions that work in the real world, not just in theory.
  • Quick iteration and experimentation: You’re comfortable releasing prototypes, collecting feedback, and iterating with a pragmatic mindset.
  • Proven initiative: You take ownership and drive projects forward, pushing boundaries to find the most impactful solutions. You can deal with ambiguity and are able to define scope where things are loosely defined.
  • Collaborative attitude: You communicate effectively with your peers. You’re open to feedback, and you bring a solutions-oriented mindset to the table.
  • Experience with LLMs, prompt engineering, and building applications powered by GenAI.
  • Proven track record of delivering software that made it into production and is actively used by users.
  • Exposure to working in cloud-native environments (e.g., AWS, GCP, Azure).
  • Experience using observability tools to understand and troubleshoot system behavior.

Bonus Points for:

  • Experience building or working with agent frameworks or multi‑agent workflows.
  • Experience as a data analyst or work with data platforms (e.g., Looker, Tableau, PowerBI, Snowflake, DataBricks)
  • Experience building tools for data engineering.

How we work:

We are a remote-first team that meets regularly over video and does most of our work asynchronously, in writing. We value creativity, diverse perspectives, and clear communication. Tempo is relied upon by prominent global organizations to monitor critical applications and infrastructure, and we expect everyone on the team, including our Staff engineers, to contribute ideas that make it a more reliable, more useful, and more loved product.

Compensation & Rewards:

In the United Kingdom, the Base compensation range for this role is GBP 103,958 - GBP 124,750. Actual compensation may vary based on level, experience, and skillset as assessed in the interview process. Benefits include equity, bonus (if applicable) and other benefits listed here.

*Compensation ranges are country specific. If you are applying for this role from a different location than listed above, your recruiter will discuss your specific market’s defined pay range & benefits at the beginning of the process

*Compensation ranges are country specific. If you are applying for this role from a different location than listed above, your recruiter will discuss your specific market’s defined pay range & benefits at the beginning of the process.

Why You’ll Thrive at Grafana Labs:

  • 100% Remote, Global Culture - As a remote-only company, we bring together talent from around the world, united by a culture of collaboration and shared purpose.
  • Scaling Organization – Tackle meaningful work in a high-growth, ever-evolving environment.
  • Transparent Communication – Expect open decision-making and regular company-wide updates.
  • Innovation-Driven – Autonomy and support to ship great work and try new things.
  • Open Source Roots – Built on community-driven values that shape how we work.
  • Empowered Teams – High trust, low ego culture that values outcomes over optics.
  • Career Growth Pathways – Defined opportunities to grow and develop your career.
  • Approachable Leadership – Transparent execs who are involved, visible, and human.
  • Passionate People – Join a team of smart, supportive folks who care deeply about what they do.
  • In-Person onboarding - We want you to thrive from day 1 with your fellow new ‘Grafanistas’ to learn all about what we do and how we do it.
  • Balance is Key - We operate a global annual leave policy of 30 days per annum. 3 days of your annual leave entitlement are reserved for Grafana Shutdown Days to allow the team to really disconnect. *We will comply with local legislation where applicable.

Equal Opportunity Employer: Grafana Labs is an equal opportunities employer. We welcome applications from everyone regardless of race, colour, nationality, origin, caste, sex, gender reassignment identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, religion or belief, disability, veteran status, genetic information, pregnancy, maternity, marital, family or carer status, or any other characteristic which is protected by local law. We believe that equality and diversity build a strong organisation, and we work hard to ensure that is the foundation of our organisation as we grow.

Grafana Labs may utilize AI tools in its recruitment process to assist in matching information provided in CVs to job postings. The recruitment team will continue to review inbound CVs manually to identify alignment with current openings.

title: Afdelingsleder til udskolingen på Kongehøjskolen
description:
Vil du være med til at gå forrest for elevernes læring, trivsel og udvikling?
Har du lyst til at være tæt på elever og medarbejdere? Motiveres du af at skabe gode rammer for både faglig udvikling og stærke fællesskaber? Og har du lyst til at blive en del af en skole, der har ambitioner og ønsker at udvikle sig endnu mere?
Så er det måske dig, vi søger som vores nye afdelingsleder til udskolingen.

Om Kongehøjskolen
Kongehøjskolen er Aabenraa Kommunes største folkeskole med ca. 700 elever fordelt på fem afdelinger og omkring 120 medarbejdere. Vi har mange forskellige fagligheder og tror på, at det tætte samarbejde på tværs skaber den bedste skole for eleverne.
Vi er en skole med en tydelig retning og en ambition om at være fagligt og didaktisk på forkant. Vi har et godt fundament og et stærkt ønske om hele tiden at udvikle vores praksis og gøre det, der allerede fungerer godt, endnu bedre.
På Kongehøjskolen fungerer vores fire kernefortællinger som et fælles afsæt for vores arbejde og som centrale pejlemærker for vores pædagogiske praksis, samarbejde og udvikling af skolen:
  • Elevsyn
  • Professionalisme
  • Mangfoldighed er en styrke
  • Dannelse
Vi tror på, at eleverne i konteksten gør det rigtige, når de kan. Vi arbejder for stærke faglige og pædagogiske fællesskaber og har fokus på sammenhæng i elevernes skoleforløb.

Om jobbet
Som vores nye afdelingsleder får du det pædagogiske og personalemæssige ansvar for udskolingen med ca. 200 elever og 17 medarbejdere.
De seneste tre år har vores skoleleder fungeret som afdelingsleder i udskolingen. Nu søger vi en leder til at videreføre arbejdet i afdelingen. Du træder ind i en udskoling, hvor der allerede er et godt arbejde i gang, og hvor du får mulighed for at bygge videre på det eksisterende fundament
I udskolingen er medarbejderne fagligt stærke og ambitiøse. De tager ansvar, engagerer sig i skolens udvikling og sætter stor pris på medinddragelse.
Som leder bliver du tæt på hverdagen, medarbejderne og eleverne. Du skal kunne fastholde det, der fungerer godt, og samtidig sammen med medarbejderne og de øvrige ledere have blik for, hvordan vi kan blive endnu bedre.

Dit ledelsesteam
Du bliver en del af et stærkt og mangfoldigt ledelsesteam på fem. Teamet består af både meget erfarne ledere og nyere ledere og rummer forskellige faglige baggrunde.
Vi arbejder tæt sammen om skolens samlede drift, udvikling og retning og bruger hinandens forskellige perspektiver og kompetencer aktivt.
Du bliver samtidig en del af vores administrationsteam, som ud over ledelsen rummer tre administrative medarbejdere. Sammen skaber vi en velfungerende hverdag, hvor samarbejde, hjælpsomhed og fælles ansvar er en naturlig del af arbejdet.

Vi tilbyder dig
Hos os får du
  • en spændende lederopgave med pædagogisk og personalemæssigt ansvar for en velfungerende udskoling
  • en fagligt stærk og engageret medarbejdergruppe med lyst til udvikling
  • et stærkt og samarbejdende ledelsesteam, hvor vi hjælper hinanden og løfter i fællesskab
  • en skole, hvor elevernes læring, trivsel og dannelse samt professionalisme og gode relationer er centrale omdrejningspunkter
  • mulighed for at sætte dit præg på en skole, der er i en positiv udvikling
  • store muligheder for at gøre en forskel og sætte spor i mange børns liv

Om dig
Vi søger en leder, der kan skabe rammerne for stærke klassefællesskaber, hvor eleverne trives og lykkes. Du har lyst til at være tæt på udskolingens hverdag og vil sammen med medarbejderne være med til at udvikle en professionel, fagligt stærk og attraktiv udskoling.
Fagligt forventer vi, at du
  • har stor pædagogisk indsigt og forståelse for skolens praksis
  • har lyst til og gerne erfaring med udskolingen og arbejdet med unge mennesker
  • har blik for, hvad der kendetegner en professionel skole og et stærkt professionelt samarbejde
  • har lyst til at indgå aktivt i et tæt samarbejde med både medarbejdere, ledelse og administration
Personligt forventer vi, at du
  • er optimistisk og ser muligheder samt møder andre med energi og engagement
  • er teamdrivende, nærværende og tydelig i din ledelse og kan sætte retning og skabe følgeskab
  • er delegerende og har tillid til medarbejdernes kompetencer
  • er styrende, når situationen kalder på det, og kan træffe beslutninger
  • er strategisk og analytisk
  • er organiserende og kan skabe overblik, prioritere og sikre fremdrift
Læs mere om de faglige og personlige kvalifikationer samt stillingen i vores job- og kompetenceprofil.
Det er en fordel, hvis du har ledelseserfaring, men det er ikke et krav. Vi er et erfarent og fagligt stærkt ledelsesteam, og vi kan hjælpe dig godt i gang.

Læs mere i Job- og Kompetenceprofil

Løn- og ansættelsesvilkår
Ansættelse sker efter en forhåndsaftale på skolelederområdet.
Vi gør opmærksom på, at der forud for ansættelsen vil blive indhentet børne- og straffeattest, og at ansættelse er betinget af, at disse er tilfredsstillende.

Vil du vide mere?
Har du spørgsmål til stillingen, er du velkommen til at kontakte skoleleder Søren Ernst Lüdeking på telefon 73 76 84 01 eller e-mail selu@aabenraa.dk.
Inden du sender din ansøgning, vil vi meget gerne vise dig rundt på skolen, så du kan møde os og få et indtryk af Kongehøjskolen og hverdagen i udskolingen.
Kontakt sekretær Sanne Klemensø Matthiasen på telefon 73 76 83 50 eller e-mail skma@aabenraa.dk for at aftale et besøg.

Ansøgning
Send din ansøgning, CV og relevante bilag via linket senest den 20. oktober 2026.
Første samtalerunde bliver afholdt den 27. oktober 2026, og anden samtalerunde den 12. november 2026.
Mellem første og anden samtalerunde vil der blive udarbejdet en personprofil ved en ledelseskonsulent fra Aabenraa Kommune.

Vi ser glæder os til at høre fra dig!

Kommunens mission er, at vi sammen skaber Det Gode Liv.
Er du tilflytter, vil vi gerne, at du falder hurtigt og godt til. Derfor har vi en række tilbud til dig - og dem der eventuelt flytter med.

title: Purchasing Clerk I
description:
About the job

The Role

This position will report to: Purchasing Supervisor

Travel Requirements: Based on Business needs 7-10%

FLSA Status: Non- Exempt

Shift:1

Employment Category: Temporary

Pay Range: $20.40/HR to $27.68/HR

Onsite Position


Bronco Wine Company founded in 1973, our family-owned company strives to continue and improve upon being vertically integrated, from the vineyard to the table, focusing on crafting quality wines for every table. Our family’s resilience and sustained growth will continue to be fostered through stewardship of family, valued employees, respected partners, and future generations.


JOB STATEMENT: The Purchasing Clerk I is responsible for purchasing parts, supplies and services necessary for daily operations.

Essential Duties:

  • Convert all requisitions for all sites into a PO
  • Create PO’s directly without requisitions if requested by ownership
  • For Ceres, bid and get competitive pricing if needed
  • For Ceres, call in and place orders for vendors
  • For Ceres, follow up on all expected delivery dates
  • For Ceres, manages coffee/water, water coolers, and portable toilet services
  • Create in IFS all suppliers for all entities
  • Using document management, attach all necessary applications to the supplier
  • Attach all and maintain all equipment leases in IFS via document manager, with expiration dates to notify Purchasing Supervisor 6 months to expiration
  • For Ceres, place all food orders as necessary
  • For Ceres, assist with managing the closet for office supplies
  • Reserve all hotel reservations for all personnel
  • Assist AP and receiving with any issues they have with suppliers’ invoices or BOL
  • Research and ensure all PO’s are properly closed if not closed automatically by IFS system
  • Understand and comply with all ISO9001, HACCP and GMP requirements and processes
  • Assist or lead special projects as requested
  • All other requirements will be assigned by the Purchasing Supervisor


JOB REQUIREMENTS:

Education/Experience:

  • Purchasing policies and procedures
  • Telephone experience

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities:

  • Computers and office equipment
  • Maintain multiple projects
  • Communicate effectively
  • Work with minimal supervision

PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS:

  • Sit for an extensive period of time
  • Perform tasks using standard computer equipment

title: Client Service Monitor
description:
Hope Mission Statement

The mission of Hope the Mission is to prevent, reduce and eliminate poverty, hunger, and homelessness by offering immediate assistance and long-term solutions.

Position Purpose and Summary

The Client Services Monitor (CSM) works directly on-site and is responsible for keeping participants safe, supporting daily operations, community standards and helping Hope the Mission's Interim Housing programs run smoothly. The CSM plays an important role in creating an environment that is safe, structured, and respectful — one where every participant is treated with dignity and fairness.

This position requires someone who shows up consistently, uses good judgment, and genuinely cares about serving people experiencing homelessness. Many participants in our programs have been through long periods of instability, crisis, and trauma. When a CSM shows up with calm, care, and compassion, it creates a sense of safety and routine that participants can count on as they work toward stable housing.

The CSM reports to the Program Manager or Assistant Program Manager and works alongside site staff to make sure the program runs well, meets contract requirements, and reflects Hope the Mission's values in every interaction.


Primary Duties and Responsibilities

Facility Maintenance and Sanitation

  • Assists with and facilitates routine cleaning of all facility areas to maintain cleanliness, safety, and operational readiness

  • Cleans and disinfects restrooms and shower areas after each use, without exception. Maintains sanitary and safe restroom and sink conditions at all times. Completes deep cleaning of restrooms and common areas.

  • Monitors and maintains hygiene areas and community areas; ensures resources are fully stocked, replenishing as needed.

  • Washes, dries, and prepares towels used for restroom and shower services

  • Monitors laundry rooms, restrooms, and common areas to ensure cleanliness and appropriate use

  • Maintains accurate shower and restroom usage logs

Participant Safety and Monitoring

  • Conducts required wellness checks each shift to ensure participant safety and well-being

  • Monitors participant movement, common areas, and site activity to promote safety and program compliance

  • Conducts routine site walk-throughs and safety checks during assigned shifts

  • Supports contraband control and safety procedures in accordance with agency policy

  • Responds to incidents and emergencies using trauma-informed de-escalation techniques and follows all incident reporting protocols

  • Supports emergency responses — including medical emergencies, overdoses, and evacuations — until leadership or first responders arrive

Participant Services and Engagement

  • Provides direct, respectful assistance to participants, including answering questions, responding to requests, and connecting participants to appropriate staff or resources

  • Assists with participant intake, orientation, and explanation of site guidelines as directed by management

  • Distributes hygiene supplies including soap, shampoo, towels, and related items to participants as needed

  • Supports meal service, supply distribution, and general operational duties as assigned

Documentation and Reporting

  • Completes Daily Activity Reports (DARs) accurately, objectively, and in a timely manner

  • Conducts intake, exit, and case notes in HMIS where applicable

  • Assists with documentation related to participant movements, wellness concerns, or incidents as required

  • Observes and reports safety concerns, maintenance issues, guideline violations, and unusual occurrences to site leadership promptly

Shift Operations

  • Provides support during shift pass-downs and communicates relevant updates between shifts

  • Provides overnight, evening, weekend, or holiday coverage as scheduled

  • Performs other duties as assigned

Transportation (Site Specific)

  • Transports participants to and from established routes and as directed by a supervisor

  • Maintains vehicle cleanliness inside and out at all times

  • Ensures the vehicle has sufficient fuel before and during each shift

  • Completes daily vehicle maintenance checks and reports any issues to the supervisors

  • Logs all mileage accurately and in accordance with departmental procedures

Skills

  • Strong observation and situational awareness skills

  • Trauma-informed communication and de-escalation techniques

  • Ability to maintain professional boundaries with participants

  • Clear, objective, and professional written documentation skills

  • Ability to follow policies, procedures, and chain of command

  • Strong teamwork and communication skills

  • Basic computer and email proficiency

  • Ability to lead with integrity and uphold organizational mission, values, and service philosophy.

  • Ability to cultivate and maintain collaborative relationships with community-based organizations and external service providers. Strong Interpersonal Skills.

  • Maintains professionalism, empathy, and sound decision-making when working in complex or emotionally challenging environments.


Qualifications

  • High school diploma or GED required

  • Previous experience in homeless services, shelter operations or social service preferred

  • Knowledge of trauma-informed care and harm reduction principles preferred

  • Ability to work flexible schedules including nights, weekends, and holidays


Mandatory Requirements

  • Background Screening – Employment is contingent upon the successful completion of background checks as required per worksite.

  • Drug and Alcohol Testing – Candidates must pass pre-employment and ongoing drug and alcohol screenings in accordance with company policy.

  • Motor Vehicle Record (MVR) Check – For roles requiring driving, employment is contingent upon an acceptable driving record.

  • Legal Eligibility to Work – Candidates must provide proof of legal authorization to work in the US.

  • Compliance with Company Policies and HIPAA standards – All employees must comply with company policies, including safety, confidentiality, and conduct standards.


Physical, Demands, Environmental Conditions, Equipment

The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of the job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential job functions. The employee is required to: walk and climb stairs; stand, bend, squat, climb, kneel, and twist on an intermittent or sometimes continuous basis; grasp, push, pull objects such as files, file cabinet drawers, and reach overhead; handle, finger, grasp and feel objects and equipment; reach with hands and arms; be mobile by moving oneself from place to place quickly and easily; repeat various motions with the wrists, hands, and fingers; be able to perform visual activities for (including, but not limited to) administrative and clerical tasks; ability to lift up to 25 lbs.; communicate, receive and exchange ideas, information by means of the spoken and written word; drive vehicles in and around Los Angeles County; be able to enter various buildings that may require climbing stairs; be periodically subjected to outside environmental conditions. The employee may work in proximity to service animals and emotional support animals; use a desktop and/or laptop computer; various office machines. Complete all required forms in personal writing.


Work Environment

The employee may be in contact with individuals and families in crisis who may be ill, using alcohol and drugs, and who may not be attentive to basic personal hygiene, health and safety practices. The employee may experience a number of unpleasant sensory demands associated with the participants’ use of alcohol and drugs, and lack of personal hygiene. The employee must be ready to respond quickly and effectively to many types of situations, including crisis situations and potentially hostile situations. The noise level in the work environment is usually moderate in an office setting. Sometimes work may become stressful when working under pressure or in crisis intervention. .


EEO: HTM (Hope the Mission) provides equal employment opportunities (EEO) to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability or genetics. In addition to federal law requirements, HTM complies with applicable state and local laws governing nondiscrimination in employment in every location in which the company has facilities. This policy applies to all terms and conditions of employment, including recruiting, placement, promotion, recall, transfer, leaves of absence, compensation and training.

HTM will consider qualified applicants with a criminal history pursuant to the California Fair Chance Act. You do not need to disclose your criminal history or participate in a background check until a conditional job offer is made to you. After making a conditional offer and running a background check, if HTM is concerned about a conviction that is directly related to the job, you will be given the chance to explain the circumstances surrounding the conviction, provide mitigating evidence, or challenge the accuracy of the background report. Find out more about the Fair Chance Act by visiting the California Department of Fair Employment and Housing’s Fair Chance Act webpage.

title: Connectivity Director
description:
Connectivity Director I Viator

About Tripadvisor

The Tripadvisor Group connects people to experiences worth sharing, and aims to be the world’s most trusted source for travel and experiences. We leverage our brands, technology, and capabilities to connect our global audience with partners through rich content, travel guidance, and two-sided marketplaces for experiences, accommodations, restaurants, and other travel categories. The subsidiaries of Tripadvisor, Inc. (Nasdaq: TRIP), include a portfolio of travel brands and businesses, including Tripadvisor, Viator, and TheFork.

Tripadvisor is looking for a Connectivity Director to own the technical and commercial relationship between our platform and the reservation systems (restechs) our supplier partners rely on. This is a hands-on leadership role: you'll set the connectivity strategy, build C-suite relationships with restech partners, and roll up your sleeves alongside engineers when a hard integration problem needs solving.

You'll lead the team responsible for supplier and restech connectivity – the APIs, integration technologies, and configuration processes that let millions of travellers book experiences seamlessly. You'll work closely with Product, Engineering, and commercial teams to make sure our connectivity capability scales with the business.

Job Location: UK, offices in London and Oxford.

This role is a remote position in the United Kingdom. Occasional travel to company offices as necessary.

Key Responsibilities

  • Define and own the Connectivity strategy – a clear point of view on where supplier and restech integrations need to go, aligned to our broader technical direction (faster releases, better observability, simplification, AI driven efficiencies).

  • Build and maintain C-suite level relationships with restech and supplier partners, acting as the senior technical face of Tripadvisor in those conversations.

  • Stay genuinely hands-on: dig into API design, integration architecture, and connectivity issues directly, not just from a distance.

  • Lead, grow and mentor a team of tech leads and engineers – with experience building teams from scratch or reinvigorating existing ones globally.

  • Partner closely with Product to shape the connectivity roadmap; this is a product-oriented team and role.

  • Instigate change: bring new technologies and approaches to the team, and create space for technical creativity.

  • Own escalation and resolution of complex operational and connectivity issues, keeping transactions and integrations running smoothly at scale.

  • Oversee configuration, monitoring and testing of supplier integrations, and drive continuous improvement of the tools and processes behind them.

  • Respond quickly and positively as remit, priorities or team structure evolve.

About You

  • Deep, hands-on knowledge of APIs and restech integration technologies, and a genuine understanding of how connectivity platforms work end to end.

  • A proven track record of building senior (C-suite level) relationships with restech and supplier partners.

  • Experience building a technical or connectivity strategy and also getting hands-on to deliver against it.

  • Genuine hands-on technical experience

  • Comfortable working alongside Product as a true partner, ideally having done so before on a customer-facing site or app.

  • An inclusive, non-hierarchical leadership style

  • Energised by fast-moving environments and comfortable adapting quickly to changes in remit, priorities or structure.

  • Excellent communication and management skills, with the technical credibility to match.

  • Data/analytical mindset, ability to design and build relevant reports

Practicalities

  • This role is remote in the UK, ideally someone based in or around London

  • You'll want to build real relationships with the team, which means coming into the office from time to time.

  • Reports to the Senior Director, Destination Management.

Personal Qualities

  • Strategic Vision: A visionary thinker capable of translating complex technical challenges into clear, long-term strategic roadmaps.

  • Executive Presence: Exceptional ability to communicate and influence at the C-suite and executive levels, both internally and with external partners.

  • Adaptive Leadership: A resilient and inclusive leader, comfortable navigating and driving change in fast-paced, high-growth environments.

  • Collaborative Catalyst: A natural partner who excels at breaking down silos and fostering cross-functional alignment between Engineering, Product, and Commercial teams.

Skills and Experience Guide

  • Leadership Experience: 10+ years of experience in technical leadership, connectivity strategy, or product engineering, ideally within the travel technology or B2B SaaS space.

  • Relationship Management: Proven track record of building and managing high-stakes C-suite partnerships, including technical advocacy and commercial negotiation.

  • Technical Strategy: Demonstrated experience defining and delivering technical roadmaps, API strategies, and scaling connectivity platforms in high-traffic environments.

  • Integration Expertise: Deep knowledge of integration architecture, API design, and observability, with the credibility to engage hands-on with engineering teams.

  • Team Development: Proven ability to build, mentor, and lead high-performing global engineering and technical teams from the ground up or through significant transformation.

  • Strategic Execution: Analytical mindset with the ability to design and leverage data to drive technical decision-making and operational improvements.

What We Offer

  • Competitive compensation packages (routinely benchmarked against the latest industry data), including base salary and annual bonuses
  • “Work your way” with flexibility to suit your lifestyle. Tripadvisor Group takes a remote-friendly approach to collaboration across a worldwide team, with the option to join on-site as often as you’d like or as required by your team.
  • Flexible schedule. Work-life balance is ingrained in our culture by design. Trust and accountability make it work.
  • Donation matching. Give back? Give more! We match qualifying charitable donations annually.
  • Tuition assistance. Want to level up your career? We love to hear it! Receive annual support for qualified programs.
  • Lifestyle benefit. An annual benefit to spend on yourself. Use it on travel, wellness, or whatever suits you.
  • Travel perks. We believe that travel is employee development, so we provide discounts and more.
  • Employee assistance program. We’re here for you with resources and programs to help you through life’s challenges.
  • Health benefits. We offer great coverage and competitive premiums.
  • Generous referral scheme. Help us grow and be rewarded with generous awards for referring successful candidates.

Our Cultural Pillars:

Traveler first

We exist to create value for our customer, the traveler. We enable our suppliers and partners to unlock this value. Their collective behaviors and insights are what drives us.

Execution is our edge

We act fast, experiment, learn from failure, iterate, and improve the solutions of tomorrow across every aspect of our business. Our execution is agile, data-driven, prioritised, and built to scale. We assume no problem is someone else’s problem and finish what can be done today, knowing tomorrow will bring fresh challenges.

We succeed together

The best outcomes are driven by empathic, humble, and diverse subject matter experts working toward shared goals. We collaborate relentlessly, challenge assumptions, give actionable feedback, and set each other up for success through empowered teams with a clear charter. We transparently take ownership of our growth, individually and as a team. We celebrate the quality of our effort, our learnings, and our collective achievements.

We strive to create an accessible and inclusive experience for all candidates. If you need a reasonable accommodation during the application or the recruiting process, please make sure to reach out to your individual recruiter or our team at AccessibleRecruiting@tripadvisor.com.

If you have any additional questions about careers at Tripadvisor you can email us at recruitment@tripadvisor.com. We have all the answers!

title: Erfaren og selvstændig servicemontør til vores afdeling i Rødovre
description:
Hos SH Group søger vi en erfaren og selvstændig servicemontør til vores afdeling i Rødovre.

Vi står blandt andet for service på mange kraftvarmeværker, færgelejer og drift og vedligehold af flere af Københavns ikoniske oplukkelige broer. Samtidig udfører vi service- og vedligeholdelsesopgaver på hydrauliske anlæg og tekniske installationer inden for andre områder af energi- og industrisektoren.


Om jobbet

Som servicemontør bliver du en del af et erfarent team, der arbejder med service, vedligehold og fejlfinding på hydrauliske og mekaniske anlæg.

Du får en varieret hverdag med både planlagte serviceopgaver og akut fejlfinding, hvor du ofte arbejder selvstændigt ude hos kunderne.

Dine primære arbejdsopgaver bliver:

  • Service og fejlfinding på hydrauliske anlæg.
  • Udekørende serviceopgaver, primært på kraftværker.
  • Drift og vedligehold af andre teknisk komplekse anlæg og Københavns oplukkelige broer.
  • Tæt dialog med kunder, maskinchefer og teknisk personale.
  • Udarbejdelse og opfølgning på serviceskemaer og dokumentation.
  • Fokus på kvalitet, sikkerhed og rettidig levering.
  • Identifikation af forbedrings- og mersalgsmuligheder i forbindelse med servicebesøg.


Din profil

Du behøver ikke nødvendigvis at have erfaring med kraftværker men vil naturligvis være en fordel.

Der er vigtigt at du har en solid teknisk forståelse og erfaring med hydraulik.


Vi forestiller os, at du:

  • Har erfaring med hydrauliske systemer, service og fejlfinding.
  • Har kørekort kategori B og er en rutineret chauffør.
  • Taler, skriver og forstår dansk.
  • Kan arbejde både selvstændigt og som en del af et team.
  • Er struktureret, ansvarsbevidst og mødestabil.
  • Trives med kundekontakt og repræsenterer SH Group professionelt.
  • Er fleksibel i forhold til arbejdstider, da arbejdsplanen kan omfatte aften- og weekendarbejde.
  • Gerne har kendskab til mekanik, elinstallationer eller styringsteknik.


Vi sørger for resten

Du bliver oplært i vores arbejdsmetoder og specialopgaver. Det vigtigste er, at du har den rette tekniske forståelse, lyst til at lære og tager ansvar for dine opgaver. Samtidig bliver du en del af:

  • Et stærkt fagligt miljø med dygtige og hjælpsomme kolleger.
  • Et uformelt arbejdsmiljø med højt til loftet og god humor.
  • En afdeling med stor frihed under ansvar.
  • En virksomhed med spændende opgaver inden for energi, infrastruktur, marine og forsvar.


Vi tilbyder

  • Attraktiv løn efter kvalifikationer.
  • Gode indtjeningsmuligheder.
  • Udstyret servicebil.
  • Alsidige og spændende arbejdsopgaver.
  • Gode arbejdsforhold og et stærkt kollegialt fællesskab.


Ansøgning – CV er ikke et krav

Klik på "Søg stillingen" og fortæl os lidt om dig selv. Du er velkommen til at vedhæfte CV og ansøgning, men det er ikke et krav. En kort beskrivelse af din baggrund og motivation er rigeligt til at starte dialogen.

Du er også meget velkommen til at ringe til os for en uforpligtende snak.


Ansøgningsfrist

Vi afholder samtaler løbende og ansætter, så snart vi har fundet den rette kandidat. Derfor anbefaler vi, at du sender din ansøgning hurtigst muligt.

Alle henvendelser behandles naturligvis fortroligt.


Kontakt

Har du spørgsmål til stillingen, er du velkommen til at kontakte Værkstedsleder Martin Meister på +45 27 60 02 85.

title: Sagsbehandlende terapeut til Visitation og Myndighed – Hjælpemidler
description:
Sagsbehandlende terapeut til Visitation og Myndighed – Hjælpemidler

Tidsbegrænset stilling – måske er det lige dig, vi mangler på holdet?

Har du lyst til at gøre en forskel for mennesker – og samtidig have en arbejdsdag, hvor der både er faglige udfordringer, selvstændighed og plads til et godt grin?
Så læs endelig videre.

Vi har forrygende travlt og søger derfor en ekstra kollega i en tidsbegrænset stilling på 37 timer om ugen i ét år fra 1. december 2026 – gerne tidligere, hvis du er klar på at springe til.

Vi leder efter en ergo- eller fysioterapeut, der har lyst til at arbejde med sagsbehandling af hjælpemidler, forbrugsgoder og mindre boligændringer efter Servicelovens §§ 112, 113 og 116.

Hvad skal du lave?

Din primære opgave bliver at hjælpe os med at få arbejdet os igennem vores venteliste – og her kommer du ikke til at sidde alene bag en skærm hele dagen.

Du kommer blandt andet til at:
  • tage på hjemmebesøg hos borgere
  • vurdere personkreds og behov
  • afdække borgerens situation og hverdagsliv
  • dokumentere løbende
  • træffe myndighedsafgørelser
  • finde den rigtige løsning sammen med borgeren
  • vælge, afprøve og tilpasse hjælpemidler og løsninger.

Kort sagt: Du skal bruge både din terapeutiske faglighed, din myndighedshat (udleveres ved ansættelse) og din sunde fornuft.

Hvem er vi?

Vi er en flok på 8 terapeuter og 3 administrative medarbejdere, som arbejder med hjælpemidler, forbrugsgoder, boligændringer og handicapbiler.

Vi holder til på Rådhuset i Middelfart, hvor vi sidder sammen i et storrumskontor. Det betyder, at du sjældent behøver gå langt for at få sparring – der er altid en kollega i nærheden, som enten kan hjælpe dig med en faglig problemstilling eller lige høre, om du også synes, sagen er lidt kringlet.

Vi arbejder tæt sammen med vores kolleger på Hjælpemiddeldepotet, og vi dokumenterer i KMD Nexus.

Vi har to indgange til vores område:

Den ene er på Rådhuset, hvor borgerne kan kontakte os telefonisk eller møde personligt op.

Den anden er vores straks service på Hjælpemiddeldepotet, hvor borgere kan møde op og få behandlet ansøgninger om en række hjælpemidler med det samme.

Så ja – der sker lidt hos os. Og det er netop noget af det, vi godt kan lide.

Hvad får du hos os?

Vi kan tilbyde:
  • Dygtige og engagerede kolleger, som både tager deres faglighed seriøst og kan grine sammen.
  • Et selvstændigt job med ansvar og kompetence, hvor du selv er med til at planlægge din arbejdsdag inden for vores åbningstider og opgaver.
  • Masser af sparring og samarbejde – både mono- og tværfagligt og på tværs af organisationen.
  • Et godt introduktionsprogram og en mentor, så du ikke bliver sendt ud i verden med en computer, en madpakke og et „held og lykke“.
  • Bil, cykel eller elcykel, når du skal på hjemmebesøg.
  • Et kollegialt fællesskab, hvor vi faktisk synes, det er ret vigtigt, at vi har det godt, mens vi går på arbejde. Her er plads til læring og det er okay at begå fejl i ny og næ – bare vi bliver klogere sammen.
  • En arbejdsplads, hvor hverdagen godt kan være travl – men hvor der også er plads til humor, grin og en snak over kaffen.

Hvem er du?

Vi forestiller os, at du:
  • Er uddannet ergo- eller fysioterapeut.
  • Har erhvervserfaring – gerne fra myndighedsområdet, men det er bestemt ikke et krav.
  • Kan møde borgere og samarbejdspartnere i øjenhøjde.
  • Kan arbejde selvstændigt, men også ved, hvornår det er smart at spørge en kollega.
  • Har flair for IT på brugerniveau.
  • Har erfaring med KMD Nexus – eller er klar på at lære det.
  • Trives i en hverdag, hvor forandring ikke er en gæst, men en fast del af inventaret.
  • Kan bevare overblikket, også når der er travlt.
  • Bidrager positivt til arbejdsmiljøet.
  • Har kørekort B.

Og måske vigtigst af alt: Du skal have lyst til at være en del af et team, hvor vi hjælper hinanden og ikke er bange for at sige:

„Den her skal vi lige være to om at finde ud af.“

Praktiske oplysninger

Stillingen er på 37 timer om ugen og er tidsbegrænset i ét år fra 1. december 2026 – gerne tidligere, hvis det kan lade sig gøre.

Løn- og ansættelsesvilkår fastsættes efter gældende overenskomst.

Har du spørgsmål eller lyst til at høre lidt mere om, hvem vi er, og hvad jobbet går ud på, er du meget velkommen til at kontakte:

Myndighedschef Pia Schjøtt (træffes ikke i uge 41+42)
20 52 05 17

eller

Faglig leder Hanne Egeris Hansen
24 24 03 41

Skal det være dig?

Så send din ansøgning, CV og relevante bilag via vores rekrutteringssystem. Du bliver guidet gennem processen, når du trykker på „Send ansøgning“.

Ansøgningsfrist: 21. oktober kl. 23.59

Vi holder løbende ansættelsessamtaler, så stillingen kan blive besat inden ansøgningsfristen.

Vi håber, du har lyst til at søge –
vi glæder os til at høre fra dig!

Løn- og ansættelsesvilkår

Arbejdssted: Myndighed – Hjælpemidler, Middelfart Kommune – med arbejdsplads på Rådhuset.
Timetal: 37 timer
Ansættelsesdato: 1. december 2026 evt. tidligere.
