title: Ernæringsassistent til et barselsvikariat til cafeteria i aktivitetshus på Olivenhaven
description:
Bliv en del af et bæredygtigt, engageret og ansvarligt køkken.

Arbejdssted: Køkkenet Olivenhaven - Munkevænget 10, 6000 Kolding.

Arbejdstid: Fuldtid eller efter aftale, fordelt på hverdage. Helligdage og weekendarbejde kan forekomme. Arbejdstiden er mellem kl. 7.00 - 15.30.

Ansættelsestidspunkt: Barselsvikariat med opstart hurtigst muligt og ca. et år frem, evt. med mulighed for fastansættelse efterfølgende.

Kvalifikationer:

  • Du er uddannet ernæringsassistent eller har en tilsvarende relevant uddannelse

  • Du er fleksibel, stabil, engageret og ansvarlig. Du er desuden god til at arbejde selvstændig og tør at tage en chance. Du besidder humoristisk sans og bidrager til et stærkt samarbejde i temaet.

  • Du har erfaring med alle opgaver i et køkken og har kendskab til gængse IT-systemer.

  • Du er god til at udnytte ingredienserne for at minimere spild og optimere ressourceforbruget og bidrager til at reducere vores klimaaftryk og arbejder i tråd med Kolding Kommunes klimahandleplan.

  • Vi arbejder med SELVVÆRD og SAMMENHÆNG i Kolding Kommune og møder borgerne, kollega, plejepersonalet, aktivitetspersonale m.fl. med fokus på den enkeltes behov. Det er borgerens centrum vi tager udgangspunkt i.

Hvem er vi?

  • I køkkenet på Olivenhaven er p.t. 5 ernæringsassistenter og 3 flexjobber.

  • Vi er et engageret og samarbejdsorienteret team, hvor vi vægter tillid, ansvar og gensidig respekt, højt

  • Vores målgruppe er pensionister, efterlønner og borger der bor på plejehjem

  • Vi tilbereder mad til ca 80-100 mennesker dagligt i form af morgenmad, varm og kold frokost og kage. Desuden tilbereder vi mad til møder og diverse arrangementer ud af huset

  • Vi har et tæt samarbejde med vores andre køkkener på Koldings plejehjemmene og ser os som et stort team hvor vi hjælper hinanden ved behov

  • Vi arbejder aktivt med bæredygtighed og arbejder målrettet hen imod Kolding Kommunes madprofil.

  • Vores arbejdsmiljø er en vigtig del af vores hverdag. Vi har hæve- sænke borde og andre hjælpemidler til at gøre det daglige arbejde letter.

Nærmere oplysninger fås ved henvendelse til:

Ledende økonoma Lucia Korn 20189115 og mail Lmbko@kolding.dk

Ansættelsestidspunkt: Hurtigst muligt

Ansøgningsfrist: d. 2. oktober 2026. Der afholdes løbende ansættelsessamtaler til den rette kandidat er fundet.

Ansættelsesudvalg sammensættes med TR og en medarbejder fra køkkenet.

Ansøgning og CV samt andre relevante bilag sendes elektronisk via knappen "Søg stillingen".

Løn og ansættelsesvilkår:

Lønnen bliver fastsat efter principperne i ny løn i h.t. stillingens funktioner og ansøgerens kvalifikationer efter overenskomsten.

Der indhentes straffeattest og indhentes referencer ved påtænkt ansættelse.

Alle stillinger er fuldtidsstillinger medmindre andet er angivet. Kolding Kommune opfordrer alle interesserede uanset alder, køn, handicap, religion og etnisk tilhørsforhold til at søge stillingen. Forud for ansættelse indhenter Kolding Kommune straffeattest/børneattest, når loven kræver det, eller stillingen i øvrigt berettiger til det.

title: Construction Technician - Baltimore
description:
Construction Technician

Full-Time | Field-Based | $25–$30/hour

About This Role

SpartanX is seeking an experienced, hands-on Construction Technician to support our Construction Operations team.

This is a versatile field position responsible for completing repairs, property restoration, punch-list work, and general construction tasks associated with SpartanX projects. You'll work across multiple trades, including drywall, siding, carpentry, concrete, landscaping, painting, trenching, and general property repairs.

You'll also support our Service and Inspection teams when needed, helping resolve field issues, complete corrective work, address property damage, and ensure every project meets SpartanX quality standards.

We're looking for someone who can walk onto a property, figure out what needs to be done, and take ownership of getting it done correctly.

What You’ll Do

Construction & Property Repairs

  • Perform general construction repairs and corrective work at residential properties
  • Diagnose construction issues and determine appropriate repair methods
  • Complete punch-list items and property restoration work
  • Repair installation-related property damage
  • Perform drywall patching, sanding, texturing, and preparation for paint
  • Repair or replace damaged siding and exterior materials
  • Perform basic to intermediate carpentry, including trim, fascia, framing, doors, gates, and other wood components
  • Complete minor concrete repairs, patching, filling, and finishing
  • Perform trenching and properly restore disturbed areas
  • Repair landscaping affected by construction, including grass, soil, rock, mulch, and irrigation components
  • Perform interior and exterior painting, touch-ups, caulking, priming, and finish work
  • Match existing finishes and leave completed repairs clean and professional

Service & Inspection Support

  • Assist Service Technicians with repairs and corrective work as needed
  • Support Inspection teams with field corrections and property-related issues
  • Identify and resolve construction deficiencies before they become customer escalations
  • Support troubleshooting and corrective work within your skill level
  • Provide required photographs and documentation of completed work
  • Escalate electrical, structural, roofing, or other specialized issues requiring a licensed or qualified professional

Customer & Property Care

  • Represent SpartanX professionally at customer properties
  • Treat customer homes and property with care and respect
  • Communicate professionally with homeowners when interaction is required
  • Protect landscaping, vehicles, personal belongings, and surrounding property while completing work
  • Remove construction debris and leave work areas clean
  • Take ownership of workmanship and correct deficiencies when identified

What We’re Looking For

  • Demonstrated general construction experience
  • Working knowledge of multiple construction trades
  • Experience performing drywall repairs
  • Ability to perform siding and exterior repairs
  • Basic to intermediate carpentry skills
  • Experience with painting and finish work
  • Ability to perform minor concrete repairs
  • Experience with trenching and ground restoration
  • Ability to perform basic landscaping and property restoration
  • Ability to safely operate common hand and power tools
  • Strong attention to detail and pride in quality workmanship
  • Ability to work independently with minimal supervision
  • Valid driver's license and reliable transportation
  • Ability to travel based on business needs
  • Must have and maintain personal tools appropriate for the position

Preferred Qualifications

  • Residential construction experience
  • Solar, roofing, electrical, or home-improvement experience
  • Experience performing service or warranty repairs
  • Experience working from punch lists
  • Experience documenting field work through mobile applications
  • OSHA or other relevant construction safety training

Tools & Equipment

This position requires the Construction Technician to provide and maintain their own professional hand tools and commonly required construction tools. Specialized equipment may be provided by SpartanX when required.

Schedule & Travel

Primarily Monday–Friday, with occasional Saturday availability required.

This position requires local travel between job sites and may include regional travel, occasional overnight travel, or temporary assignments in other SpartanX markets based on operational needs.

What We Offer

  • $25–$30/hour based on experience
  • Full-time position
  • Consistent field-based work
  • Opportunity to work across multiple construction trades
  • Training and professional development
  • Career advancement opportunities within a rapidly growing organization
  • Opportunity to support Construction Operations, Service, and Inspections across multiple markets

Why SpartanX?

Our Construction Technicians are the people who make sure the job is actually finished.

Whether it's repairing drywall, restoring a yard after trenching, fixing siding, completing a punch list, or stepping in to resolve a field issue, you'll help protect the customer experience and ensure our work meets SpartanX standards.

If you're a versatile construction professional who takes pride in your work, solves problems instead of walking past them, and believes the property should look right when you leave, we want to hear from you.

Solar Done Right.

Legal Disclaimer

SpartanX is an Equal Opportunity Employer that values workplace diversity. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, or protected veteran status and will not be discriminated against based on disability. For more information, please visit www.eeoc.gov.

title: [Coupang Pay] Sr. Back-end Engineer (Pay Test Operations)
description:
회사 소개

쿠팡페이의 핀테크 사업은 금융 서비스의 재정의를 통해 쿠팡 고객과 판매자들이 동일한 비용으로 더 많은 가치를 누리도록 지원합니다.
쿠팡페이는 쿠팡 앱 및 홈페이지에서 상품을 구매하는 소비자와 쿠팡 마켓플레이스에서 사업을 영위하는 판매자, 쿠팡이츠에 입점한 음식점주 등에게 혁신적인 결제 및 금융 솔루션을 제공하는 데 최선을 다합니다. 쿠팡페이의 최신 핀테크 혁신 기술은 원터치 결제 서비스가 탑재된 자체 결제 시스템 쿠페이를 기반으로 한국과 대만 소비자들의 니즈에 부응하고 있습니다.
대표적으로 쿠팡페이는 고객 가치 지향 차원에서 업계 최고 수준의 리워드를 제공하는 쿠팡와우카드(쿠팡 전용 제휴 카드)를 빠르게 확장시키고 있습니다. 또 마켓플레이스 판매자들을 위해 BaaS (Banking as a Service) 모델을 접목하고 다양한 유동성 강화 솔루션을 제공함으로써 소상공인들의 사업 성장을 적극 지원합니다.
보유하고 계신 다양한 경험을 핀테크 분야에서 최대한 살리고 싶다면 쿠팡페이와 함께 하세요. 쿠팡페이는 고객들의 결제 시간을 최대한 아껴주고 좋아하는 것을 마음껏 쇼핑할 시간을 벌어드립니다.

업무 내용

  • 비즈니스 도메인팀의 서비스를 위한 기반 플랫폼 서비스 설계, 구축 및 운영
  • Zero downtime 을 달성하기 위한 쿠팡 Fintech 차세대 infrastructure & platform 의 설계 및 구현
  • HA/DR Architecture 설계 (clustering, replication 등)를 주도 및 구현
  • CI/CD DevOps 도구 고도화 및 최적화(considering both cloud and on-premise environments)
  • best practice 를 발굴하고 팀에 전파

자격 요건

  • 팀 플레이어
  • Unix/Linux 기반의 5년 이상의 소프트웨어 엔지니어링 경력
  • 3년 이상의 backend architecture 설계 및 구현 경험
  • Strong coding skill - OOP and scripting language
  • 장애 관리 및 모니터링 기능이 있는 대규모 운영 시스템 경험
  • 조직이 확장되고 시스템이 복잡해지면서 발생하는 문제들을 겪고 구조적으로 해결해 본 경험
  • 컴퓨터 공학 또는 관련 기술 분야의 학사 학위를 소지한 자

우대 사항

  • 빠르게 변화하는 환경에서 여러 경쟁 우선 순위를처리 할 수 있는 능력
  • Cloud background (docker, K8S and AWS/ Google/ Azure)
  • API Gateway, Service Mesh 를 company-wide 적용 경험
  • Strong Java, distributed systems, micro services, messaging services
  • 애자일소프트웨어 방법론이 익숙하신 분
  • 장애 관리 및 모니터링 기능이 있는 대규모 운영 시스템 경험이 있는 분

전형 절차 및 안내 사항

  • 전형절차
    • 서류전형 - 대면(화상)면접 – 최종 합격
    • 전형절차는 직무별로 다르게 운영될 수 있으며, 일정 및 상황에 따라 변동될 수 있습니다.
    • 전형 일정 및 결과는 지원서에 등록하신 이메일로 개별 안내 드립니다.
  • 참고사항
    • 본 공고는 모집 완료 시 조기 마감될 수 있습니다.
    • 지원서 내용 중 허위사실이 있는 경우에는 합격이 취소될 수 있습니다.
    • 취업 보호 대상자(보훈대상자, 장애인 등)는 관련 법률에 따라 채용우대를 받을 수 있습니다.
    • 직급과 담당 업무 범위는 후보자의 전반적인 경력과 경험 등 제반사정을 고려하여 변경될 수 있습니다. 이러한 변경이 필요할 경우, 최종 합격 통지 전 적절한 시기에 후보자와 커뮤니케이션 될 예정입니다.
    • 채용 및 업무 수행과 관련하여 요구되는 법령상 자격이 갖추어지지 않은 경우 채용이 제한될 수 있습니다.
    • 고용형태는 정규직으로 수습기간 12주를 포함합니다. 단, 업무상 필요한 경우에는 상기 수습기간을 적용하지 않거나 단축 또는 연장할 수 있습니다.

개인정보 처리방침

  • 쿠팡 그룹은 입사지원자 개인정보 처리방침(아래 링크)에 따라 귀하의 개인정보를 수집하여 처리합니다.

서류 반환 정책

  1. 본 고지는 『채용절차의공정화에관한법률』 제11조제6항에 따른 것 입니다.
  2. 당사 채용에 응시한 구직자 중 최종 합격이 되지 못한 구직자는 『채용절차의 공정화에 관한 법률』에 따라 제출한 채용서류의 반환을 청구할 수 있음을 알려 드립니다. 다만, 홈페이지 또는 전자우편으로 제출된 경우나 구직자가 당사의 요구 없이 자발적으로 제출한 경우에는 그러하지 아니하며, 천재지변이나 그 밖에 당사에게 책임 없는 사유로 채용서류가 멸실된 경우에는 반환한 것으로 봅니다.
  3. 위2항 본문에 따라 채용 서류 반환 청구를 하는 구직자는 채용 서류 반환 청구서 [채용절차의 공정화에 관한 법률 시행규칙 별지 제 3 호 서식]를 작성하여 이메일 (recruitingops@coupangpay.com) 로 제출하면, 제출이 확인된 날로부터 14 일 이내에 지정한 주소지로 등기우편을 통하여 발송해 드립니다. 이 경우 등기우편요금은 수신자 부담으로 하게 되오니 유념하시기 바랍니다.
  4. 당사는 위2항 본문에 따른 구직자의 반환 청구에 대비하여 채용 여부가 확정된 날로부터 180 일간 구직자가 제출한 채용서류 원본을 보관하게 되며, 그때까지 채용서류의 반환을 청구하지 아니할 경우에는 『개인정보 보호법』에 따라 지체 없이 채용서류 일체를 파기할 예정입니다.
  5. 단, 위 1항 내지 4항의 내용은 대한민국의 노동 관계 법령이 적용되는 경우에만 적용됩니다. 그 이외의 경우에는 적용되지 않습니다.

title: Project Controls Associate
description:
Job Title: Project Controls Associate
Location: On-Site Mobile, AL
Employment Type: Full-Time

Who We Are:
Management Solutions, LLC (MSLLC) is an award-winning management consulting firm delivering solutions for our partners’ most complex challenges. Since 2002, we have supported federal and commercial clients through expertise in project and program strategy, delivery and implementation, engineering and technical advisory services, workforce solutions, and digital solutions.
We are distinguished by our reputation for managing mission-critical projects and helping organizations improve performance through innovative, people-centered solutions. MSLLC has been recognized as Small Business of the Year by the U.S. Small Business Administration, the Department of Energy, and Oak Ridge National Laboratory and has been named one of the Top Employers in the Greater Knoxville area.

Why Join Our Team:
At Management Solutions, we believe our people are the foundation of our success. We are committed to fostering a collaborative and caring culture where employees feel valued, supported, and empowered to grow. We seek professionals who think critically, solve complex problems, and are dedicated to building and sustaining a high-performing, people-centered organization.

Job Summary:
Management Solutions is seeking a Project Controls Associate to support project planning, scheduling, cost control, project data coordination, and reporting across major initiatives. This is a developmental project controls role for a candidate with strong analytical, organizational, communication, and problem-solving skills and the ability to learn scheduling and client project-management systems.

Key Responsibilities:
  • Assist with developing, maintaining, updating, and analyzing integrated project schedules in accordance with project requirements.
  • Collect, validate, and update project progress data from project teams and stakeholders.
  • Assist with monitoring project metrics including schedule dates, physical percent complete, resource needs, subcontractor deliverables, costs, and accruals.
  • Assist with documenting planning objectives, scope, milestones, and other project information for inclusion in scheduling and reporting processes.
  • Track schedule progress and support project setup, closeout, status reporting, and milestone tracking.
  • Support data-quality checks and reconciliation of project information across scheduling, cost, financial, and reporting systems, as applicable.
Required Qualifications:
  • Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and relevant professional experience. Relevant backgrounds may include project controls, scheduling, construction, engineering, project/program coordination, estimating, cost control, operations, data analysis, or related project-delivery functions.
  • 2–5 years of relevant professional experience.
  • Strong analytical, quantitative, problem-solving, and data-quality skills.
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills with the ability to work effectively with project managers, analysts, contractors, client representatives, and other stakeholders.
  • Organized, detail-oriented, proactive, and able to manage multiple priorities.
  • Familiarity with a scheduling tool such as Primavera or MS Project.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Excel and other Microsoft Office applications, including the ability to organize, analyze, and present project data.
  • Ability to successfully complete any required background investigation and pre-employment screening consistent with federal contract requirements.
Preferred Qualifications:
  • Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Construction Management, or a related field.
  • Prior experience with DoD, DOE, USACE, or other federal contracts.
  • Familiarity with project controls tools, scheduling, cost control, reporting, or methodologies in a federal contracting or similar project-delivery environment.
Candidates with transferable experience in construction, engineering, project coordination, project management, estimating, cost control, operations, data analysis, planning, or similar project-delivery environments are encouraged to apply.

Work Authorization
U.S. Citizenship required due to federal contract requirements.

Working Conditions
This position is primarily performed in an office environment. Employees will be required to use a computer and other office equipment for extended periods.

What We Offer
Management Solutions offers a comprehensive benefits package including: Medical, Rx, Dental and Vision Insurance, company paid short-term disability and life insurance, 401k plan with up to a 5% match with immediate vesting, Flexible Spending Accounts, PTO, paid holidays, and more!

Equal Employment Opportunity
Management Solutions is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or veteran status. We encourage applications from individuals of all backgrounds and experiences.

It is the policy of the Company to provide equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws.

title: Lagermedarbejder søges til julesæsonen – måske er du også med bagefter?
description:
Vi søger en engageret og energisk lagermedarbejder til vores travle julesæson.

Stillingen er som udgangspunkt tidsbegrænset hen over julesæsonen, men for den rette kandidat vil der være mulighed for forlængelse.

Arbejdstiden kan variere i takt med travlheden, men du kan forvente minimum 20 timer om ugen.

For os handler et godt lager ikke kun om at arbejde hurtigt – det handler mindst lige så meget om at arbejde klogt. Derfor arbejder vi ud fra tankegangen:

Work smarter, not harder.

Vi leder efter dig, der naturligt tænker: Kan det her gøres nemmere, smartere eller bedre? – og som samtidig ikke er bange for at tage fat, når der er brug for det.

Hvem er du?
Du behøver ikke nødvendigvis at have mange års lagererfaring. Din indstilling og dit mindset betyder mindst lige så meget for os.

Vi forestiller os, at du:

  • har drive og energi og bliver motiveret af at lykkes

  • forstår, at vi lykkes bedst, når vi lykkes sammen

  • ser løsninger frem for begrænsninger

  • tør tage ansvar og selv tage initiativ

  • har øje for detaljen og sætter en ære i, at tingene bliver gjort rigtigt

  • arbejder struktureret og omhyggeligt – også når tempoet er højt

  • forstår vigtigheden af, at den rigtige vare ender hos den rigtige kunde

  • kan bevare overblikket, når der er mange bolde i luften

  • trives i en uformel hverdag, som til tider kan være både hektisk og lidt kaotisk

  • er fysisk robust og ikke er bange for at tage ved

  • har et godt kendskab til IT og nemt ved at lære nye systemer

  • bidrager med en positiv indstilling og god energi til teamet.

Lagerarbejde er også IT

Hos os er lagerarbejde mere end paller, papkasser og palleløftere. IT og systemer er en naturlig og vigtig del af arbejdsdagen.

Vi arbejder i Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central (BC) og NaviPartner WMS. Har du erfaring med disse eller lignende systemer, er det en klar fordel – men ikke et krav.

Det vigtigste er, at du er fortrolig med IT, har lyst til at lære og forstår sammenhængen mellem det fysiske arbejde på lageret og det, der sker i systemerne.


Dine arbejdsopgaver

Din hverdag vil blandt andet bestå af:

  • varemodtagelse og kontrol af varer

  • pluk og pak af kundeordrer

  • kontrol af, at de rigtige varer og antal bliver sendt

  • håndtering af ind- og udgående varer

  • klargøring af forsendelser

  • øvrige praktiske lageropgaver.

Vi har travlt, men hurtigt må aldrig betyde sjusket. Vores kunder skal modtage den rigtige vare første gang, og derfor er kvalitet og øje for detaljen en vigtig del af jobbet.

Samtidig forventer vi, at du bruger hovedet. Ser du noget, der kan gøres smartere, må du gerne sige det. Opstår der et problem, ser vi gerne, at dit første instinkt er at finde en løsning.

Det er en fordel, hvis du

  • har erfaring fra lager, logistik eller lignende

  • har truckcertifikat

  • har erfaring med BC, WMS eller andre lager-/ERP-systemer.

Men dit CV fortæller ikke nødvendigvis hele historien. Mindset, energi, ansvarsfølelse, omhyggelighed og lysten til at være en del af holdet vægter højt hos os.

Hvad kan du forvente af os?

Du bliver en del af en arbejdsplads med en uformel tone, plads til humor og en hverdag, hvor vi hjælper hinanden.

I julesæsonen har vi travlt. Nogle dage går stærkt, planerne kan ændre sig, og der kan opstå situationer, som skal løses her og nu. Derfor skal du kunne arbejde hurtigt uden at miste overblikket eller sansen for detaljen.

Til gengæld får du mulighed for at vise, hvad du kan – og fungerer samarbejdet godt, er der mulighed for, at din tid hos os ikke nødvendigvis slutter sammen med julesæsonen.

Vi går på arbejde for at lykkes – og vi lykkes bedst sammen.

title: Commercial Production Coordinator
description:
As a Commercial Production Coordinator, you'll work with some of the world's most recognised food, nutrition and technology brands, helping them reach the audiences shaping the future of food. From breakthrough food-tech innovations and sustainable ingredients to cutting-edge manufacturing technologies, you'll help deliver commercial content programmes that showcase thought leadership, share expertise and create meaningful engagement with industry audiences.

By coordinating stakeholders, managing content workflows and maintaining high standards throughout the campaign lifecycle, you'll contribute to the successful delivery of commercial content articles, webinars and broadcasts, reports and white papers and multimedia campaigns that deliver value for clients and audiences alike.
  • Coordinating the delivery of commercial content campaigns across multiple brands and content formats, ensuring projects are delivered on time and to a high standard
  • Managing project schedules, approvals, content assets and stakeholder communications throughout the campaign lifecycle
  • Preparing, reviewing and coordinating content for publication, ensuring accuracy, consistency and alignment with brand and client requirements
  • Creating client-facing proposals, presentations, campaign summaries, case studies and other sales enablement materials
  • Partnering with colleagues across commercial, editorial, marketing and operations teams to deliver successful campaigns and content programmes
  • Maintaining project trackers, content calendars and campaign documentation to enable efficient workflow management and reporting
  • Gathering campaign data and performance metrics, delivering insights and recommendations to drive future campaign success and continuous improvement
  • Helping contribute ideas that support the evolution of commercial content products and services
  • Excellent organisational and project management skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines simultaneously
  • Previous exposure to content, media, publishing, marketing or commercial communications
  • Strong written communication skills and a high level of attention to detail
  • Confidence building relationships and working with a range of stakeholders, including clients and internal teams
  • The ability to manage competing demands in a fast-paced environment while maintaining accuracy and quality
  • Commercial awareness of how content supports audience engagement and client objectives
  • Experience using project management, CRM, CMS or reporting tools would be advantageous
  • Generous annual leave –25 days plus standard England and Wales bank holidays for full-time employees
  • Long service holiday reward – Receive an extra day's annual leave for each year of service after six years, up to a maximum of 30 days plus bank holidays for full-time colleagues
  • Christmas office closure – Enjoy additional paid leave between Christmas Day and New Year's Day to cover discretionary office closure days
  • Holiday purchase scheme – Buy up to three additional days' annual leave each year and spread the cost over up to six months
  • MeDay – Take an additional paid day off to celebrate your birthday, a cultural or religious event, or another occasion that is meaningful to you
  • Volunteering day – One paid day each year to support a charity, community group or cause close to your heart
  • Hybrid and agile working – Flexible ways of working to help you balance work and life commitments (role dependent)
  • Enhanced pension contributions – Benefit from employer pension contributions above the statutory minimum
  • Life assurance – Providing financial protection and peace of mind for you and your loved ones
  • Group Income Protection – Financial support if you're unable to work due to long-term illness or injury
  • Family-friendly policies – Enhanced pay entitlements to support you and your family during important life events
  • Health and wellbeing support, including:
    • Healthcare cash plan
    • Employee Assistance Programme (EAP)
    • Virtual GP service
    • Health and wellbeing resources and tools
  • Commitment to Equity, Diversity and Inclusion – Supported by employee-led networks, with a culture where everyone feels welcome and valued. We are proud to be a Disability Confident Committed employer
  • Cycle to Work scheme – Save money and support a healthier commute
  • Electric Car scheme – Access an affordable and sustainable way to drive an electric vehicle

title: Senior Software Engineer – IT Risk & Pricing (m/f/d)
description:
As a Senior Software Engineer (m/f/d) at auxmoney, you’ll join our IT Risk & Pricing team, where we build backend systems and services that support risk decisioning, pricing, and data-driven product logic. The work is backend-heavy, involving complex technical problem-solving and close integration with data/analytics workflows.

In this role, you’ll design and deliver impactful features, help evolve a scalable, resilient architecture, and take end-to-end ownership from concept through production. You’ll work closely with analysts/data scientists, product managers, and business stakeholders to ship high-quality solutions and continuously improve our engineering standards. If you are passionate about writing clean, maintainable code, solving complex technical challenges, and building software that delivers real value, this role offers the opportunity to make a meaningful impact.
  • Architecture & System Design: Identify and address architectural limitations, make pragmatic trade-offs, and help evolve systems toward scalability, reliability, and long-term maintainability.
  • Technical Leadership: Act as a trusted technical expert by promoting engineering best practices, facilitating technical discussions, and helping teams align on high-quality solutions.
  • Engineering Quality: Build solutions that are secure, scalable, extensible, and cost-efficient while maintaining high coding and documentation standards.
  • Execution & Delivery: Break down complex initiatives into manageable workstreams and deliver incremental value through iterative development.
  • Impact & Knowledge Sharing: Champion engineering excellence, share knowledge proactively, and support the professional growth of colleagues.
  • Collaboration & Problem Solving: Work closely with cross-functional stakeholders, actively contribute to design reviews, and address root causes of recurring technical challenges.
  • Ownership & Mentorship: Take responsibility for challenging projects and guide team members through technical mentoring and hands-on support.
  • Strategic Thinking & Growth Mindset: Balance short-term delivery with long-term system sustainability and continuously look for opportunities to improve technology, processes, and team effectiveness.
  • Backend Engineering Expertise: Several years of hands-on backend development experience with preferably strong proficiency in PHP, particularly using the Symfony framework and Python.
  • System & API Development: Proven experience designing, building, and maintaining robust backend systems in production environments, including strong expertise in developing and integrating RESTful APIs.
  • SQL Expertise: Hands-on SQL experience in application development, with strong proficiency in relational data modelling (table design, keys, and constraints) and writing complex, performant queries to support business features.
  • Cloud & DevOps Practices: Experience working with cloud platforms (preferably AWS) and modern DevOps practices such as CI/CD pipelines, containerization, and infrastructure automation. Experience with Docker and Kubernetes is highly valued.
  • Event-Driven Architecture (Bonus): Familiarity with Kafka or similar event-driven messaging systems is considered a strong advantage.
  • Testing & Quality Assurance: Solid understanding of automated testing strategies, including unit and integration testing, with a focus on delivering reliable and high-quality software aligned with overall quality standards.
  • Product-Oriented Mindset: A strong focus on building solutions that deliver measurable value for users and business outcomes.
  • Team & Communication Skills: Strong communication skills and a collaborative approach, with the ability to work effectively in cross-functional teams and contribute to a supportive engineering culture.
  • Security & Compliance Awareness: A proactive approach to implementing security best practices and ensuring compliance throughout the software development lifecycle.
  • Language Skills: Fluent written and spoken English.
  • Flexibility for Your Lifestyle: Enjoy family-friendly working hours and a generous home office policy, allowing you to stay agile and flexible in any situation.
  • Ergonomic Work Environment: For your office days, we provide ergonomic workstations that offer you a comfortable and healthy workspace.
  • Independent Work: With short decision-making paths, we enable you to work autonomously and actively contribute your ideas – we provide space for you to take on responsibility.
  • Grow with Us: Unlock your potential with numerous opportunities for growth and development, along with an annual development budget to help you achieve your professional and personal goals.
  • Team Spirit: Team spirit is important to us – we regularly host events and parties where fun is guaranteed.
  • Mobility Your Way: Whether you prefer a train ticket or parking – we support your choice of preferred mobility.
  • Stay Active: Keep fit with a discounted membership at Fitness First or Urban Sports Club, or use our in-house fitness room to stay active after work and enhance your work-life balance.
  • Secure Your Future: Think about your future – we offer subsidies for company pension plans so you can plan long-term with us.
  • Tailored Benefits: We consider your personal life situation – whether you're a parent or love to travel, we offer customized benefits to suit your lifestyle.

For us as an employer, equal opportunities and diversity are especially important. Therefore, we welcome applications from mothers, fathers, people with disabilities and people from the LGBTQIA+ community. Please feel free to let us know if, for example, you would like us to use a gender-neutral pronoun, if you need barrier-free access to our office, or if you would like us to allow more time for the application process.

title: Senior Software Engineer (.NET/C#) - Logistics team
company: Grupa Allegro Sp. z o. o.
description:
We are part of Allegro Group and we are specialists in providing advanced IT systems for logistics management.

Join the team building the technological foundation of Allegro One logistics! Our systems support the end-to-end parcel flow - from pickup through sorting, depots, and last-mile delivery. Processing millions of logistics events daily, our backend services directly impact stability and efficiency for thousands of couriers, warehouse workers, and drivers.

You will have a chance to build and refine the high-performance infrastructure powering our logistics network. We prioritize high reliability, modern engineering practices, and a supportive team culture. This role offers an excellent opportunity to actively shape our backend architecture while solving high-scale challenges.

Important things for you:

  • Flexible working hours in the hybrid model (4/1) - working hours start between 7:00 a.m. and 10:00 a.m. We also have 30 days of occasional remote work.
  • The salary range for this position depending on the skill set is as follows (contract of employment, tax-deductible cost):
    • PLN 18 850 - 25 900
    • Annual bonus based on your annual performance and company results.
    • Long term discretionary incentive plan based on Allegro.eu shares (restricted stock units).
  • Our team is based in Warsaw.


What’s in it for you:

  • Well-located offices (with e.g. fully equipped kitchens, bicycle parking, terraces full of greenery) and excellent work tools (e.g., raised desks, ergonomic chairs, interactive conference rooms).
  • A Dell Laptop (Windows) and all the necessary accessories.
  • A wide selection of fringe benefits in a cafeteria plan - you choose what you like (e.g., medical, sports or lunch packages, insurance, purchase vouchers).
  • English classes that we pay for related to the specific nature of your job.
  • A training budget, inter-team tourism (see more here), hackathons, and an internal learning platform where you will find multiple trainings.
  • An additional day off for volunteering, which you can use alone, with a team, or with a larger group of people connected by a common goal.
  • Social events for Allegro people - Spin Kilometers, Family Day, Fat Thursday, Advent of Code, and many other occasions we enjoy.

#goodtobehere means that:

  • You will join a team you can count on - we work with top-class specialists who have knowledge- and experience-sharing in their DNA.
  • You will love our level of autonomy in team organization, the space for continuous development, and the opportunity to try new things. You get to choose which technology solves the problem and you are responsible for what you create.
  • You will value our Developer Experience and the full platform of tools and technologies that make creating software easier. We rely on an internal ecosystem based on self-service and widely used tools such as Kubernetes, Docker, Consul, GitHub, and GitHub Actions. Thanks to this, you can contribute to Allegro from your very first days on the job.
  • You will be equipped with modern AI tools to automate repetitive tasks, allowing you to focus on developing new services and refining existing ones (also leveraging AI support).
  • You will create solutions that will be used (and loved!) by your friends, family and millions of our customers.
  • You will meet the Allegro Scale, which starts with over 1000 microservices, an open-source data bus (Hermes) with 300K+ rps, a Service Mesh with 1M+ rps, tens of petabytes of data, and production-used machine learning.
  • You will become part of Allegro Tech - We speak at industry conferences, cooperate with tech communities, run our own blog (it's been over 10 years!), record podcasts, lead guilds, and we organize our own internal conference - the Allegro Tech Meeting. We create solutions we love (and can) to talk about!

Send us your CV and… see you at Allegro!

We are looking for people who have:

  • Core Technical Stack & Architecture: Extensive experience architecting high-throughput, low-latency backend systems using C# and .NET Core / ASP.NET Core; mastery of resilient RESTful APIs, modular monoliths, and microservices; deep expertise in relational database optimization using PostgreSQL and Entity Framework Core under high-concurrency workloads; pragmatic experience with legacy protocols (SOAP/WCF).
  • Infrastructure & Distributed Systems: Hands-on production experience in cloud-native environments using Docker, Kubernetes, and CI/CD; strong background in event-driven architectures and distributed messaging via Azure Service Bus or Kafka; solid grasp of caching and optimization techniques to ensure high availability and eventual consistency.
  • Mobile & Platform Integration: Understanding of backend considerations for mobile integration, including payload optimization, offline synchronization, push notification architectures, and API versioning.
  • Leadership & Delivery: Proven technical leadership in mentoring engineers, driving code quality, and leading architectural reviews; full ownership across the SDLC from design to delivery; fluent in English (at least B2).

title: Har du körkort och vill jobba 1-2 dag i veckan i Uppsala? Kolla här då!
description:
Alma Assistans är det engagerade företaget som i samarbete med kunden skapar den personliga assistansen. Vi jobbar nära kunden och vet att goda relationer är nyckeln till en väl fungerande assistans. Vi är verksamma i hela Sverige med kontor i Uppsala, Jönköping, Ulricehamn, Malmö, Helsingborg och Växjö.

Nu söker vi en trygg assistent till en trevlig kvinna boendes i centrala Uppsala.
Hon bor själv i centrala Uppsala, hon går själv, så inga tunga lyft, hon berättar vad hon behöver hjälp med.

Arbetet innebär sedvanliga arbetsuppgifter så som hjälp med matlagning och städ även att följa med på läkarbesök eller andra aktiviteter, vid dessa tillfällen kör man henne med hennes egna bil (automat).
Vi söker dig som är intresserad utav att arbeta 1-2 dag pass i veckan (enbart vardagar) och är lite flexibel och kan hoppa in ibland extra vid sjukdom/sem. Passen är förlagda 10.00-16.00. Möjligheten finns också att arbeta hos flera kunder i Uppsala, om du vill upp i fler timmar.
Intro kommer påbörjas omgående.

Du som söker passar in på följande beskrivning:

* är en lugn och trygg person med ett eget driv.
* ser och kan ta ansvar för vad som behöver göras.
* har en stor förmåga att sätta dig in i någon annans situation och perspektiv. 
Det är meriterande om du har erfarenhet av arbete inom vården, men inget krav. Att personkemin mellan dig och vår kund stämmer är det viktigaste. Körkort, är ett krav, då kvinnan har en egen bil som man kan få köra ibland.

Ring för frågor, annars välkommen in med din ansökan!

title: Residential Executive Director
description:
With traumatic brain injury, life changes in an instant. For us, there is no greater reward than easing human suffering and helping people put their lives back together. As a Residential Rehabilitation Manager, you will play a critical role in transforming lives and helping individuals regain their independence and quality of life.


At CNS, we are a community of "PATHfinders" who work together to find every path possible for our patients to reach their maximum independence and quality of life. We create a supportive work environment through selflessness, innovation, and hard work. We take work very seriously, but we also enjoy a great atmosphere of fun and professional development, and we are committed to promoting a rich environment for each other to thrive through collaboration and empowerment.

Responsibilities

The Residential Rehabilitation Manager directs and coordinates activities of personnel in the Residential Rehabilitation Program to carry out its objectives in the provision of rehabilitative care. Is on the premises the number of hours necessary to manage and administer the facility in compliance with applicable law and regulation. A high degree of accuracy in documentation and observation, adaptability to a variety of situations, strong organizational and communication skills, decision making and an ability to evaluate situations as they occur is needed for this position.

This is a full-time position on the AM shift in a residential facility that operates 24 hours a day, 7 days a week. Will also include rotation of on-call work. Work is performed at the residential site and clinic and may also include the community.
  • Hires, trains, and supervises residential staff
  • Prepares weekly staffing requirement reports
  • When patients have needs identified in the needs and services plan which cannot be met by the facility but can be met by community programs, the RRM arranges for the patients to attend available community programs
  • Assures that communication between the clinic and residential setting is upheld in a manner to promote quality operations that work for the good of the patients
  • Coordinates patient admissions and discharges including NRS (Direct Care Staff) scheduling concerns
  • Conducts tours of facility for outside sources including potential patients, families, and insurance representatives
  • Maintains awareness of Residential departmental operation and objectives and need for addition, adaption or elimination of any techniques which would result in more effective service to patients
  • Assures that licensing requirements are met
  • Maintains Administrator certification as required by licensing regulations

Qualifications

Successful candidates will have:

Knowledge of the requirements for providing the type of care and supervision needed by patients, including ability to communicate with such patients
  • Knowledge of and ability to comply with applicable laws and regulations
  • Ability to establish and maintain the facility’s policy, program, budget, and financial/other records
  • Ability to recruit, employ, train, and evaluate qualified staff, and to terminate employment of staff, if applicable to the facility

Experience and Education

  • Age Requirement: Must be at least 21 years of age.
  • Educational Background: Must have at least a high school diploma or pass a general educational development test (GED). Bachelor’s degree or higher in a related field is highly preferred.
  • Work Experience: One year of work experience in residential care is required. Experience in which potential administrative and supervisory competence has been demonstrated is required.
  • Specialized Knowledge: Previous experience and/or working knowledge in rehabilitative care is highly preferred.
  • Certification: Must obtain and keep current Assisted Living Manager (ALM) certificate issued by State of Texas; however, a current Assisted Living Manager (ALM) certificate issued by Texas is highly preferred.

Benefits Package Includes:


At CNS, we value our employees and offer a comprehensive benefits package to support your well-being and professional growth. Here are some of the benefits you can enjoy as a full-time staff member:

  • Paid Time Off: Enjoy generous paid time off to relax and recharge.
  • Extended Sick Leave: Take the time you need to recover with extended sick leave.
  • Insurance: Access to PPO medical, dental, life, and vision insurance starting the 1st of the month after hire. Employment includes annual enrollment in One Medical () with telehealth also available through the company health plan.
  • We offer Daily Pay!- access your earning immediatley after you complete your shift!
  • 401(k) Plan: Plan for your future with our company matching 401(k) retirement savings plan.
  • Professional License Reimbursement: Get reimbursed for your professional license fees.
  • Continuing Education Assistance: Pursue further education with our continuing education assistance program.
  • LifeMart Benefits: As a valued member of our team, you have access to exclusive discounts and savings through LifeMart, a proprietary, members-only discount shopping website. LifeMart provides real savings on a wide range of products and services to help you manage everyday needs. Some of the benefits include:
    • Travel: Discounts on flights, hotels, car rentals, and vacation packages.
    • Tickets: Savings on movie tickets, theme parks, and other entertainment options.
    • Electronics: Deals on the latest gadgets, computers, and home electronics.
    • Family Care: Discounts on childcare, eldercare, and pet care services.
    • Wellness: Savings on gym memberships, fitness equipment, and wellness programs.
    • Home & Auto: Discounts on home improvement services, appliances, and auto care.
    • Financial and Legal: Savings on financial planning, tax services, and legal assistance.
    • Apparel: Deals on clothing, shoes, and accessories from top brands.
    • Flowers & Gifts: Discounts on flowers, gift baskets, and other special occasion items.
    • Restaurants and Dining: Savings on dining out at popular restaurants9.

Wisely Financial Services:

As part of our comprehensive benefits package, we are pleased to offer access to Wisely's financial services. These services are designed to provide flexibility and control over your finances, helping you manage your money more effectively and achieve your financial goals. Here are some of the key services offered by Wisely:

  • Early Direct Deposit: Opt-in to receive your paychecks early through direct deposit.
  • Cashback Rewards: Earn cashback rewards on purchases at participating merchants, accessible through the myWisely mobile app.
  • Prepaid Debit Cards: Use Wisely's prepaid debit cards for everyday financial transactions.


Call to Action

Are you passionate about making a difference in people's lives? Join us at CNS and be part of a team that is dedicated to helping individuals with brain injuries find hope and independence. Apply now to become a Residential Rehabilitation Manager and start your journey with us today!

title: Commercial Specialist
description:
JOB TITLE: Commercial Specialist

LOCATION: Jakarta, Indonesia

CONTRACT TYPE: Permanent, full-time

REPORTING TO: Business Development Strategist


PURPOSE OF THE ROLE

The Commercial Specialist will ensure Acorn understands exactly what it is committing to commercially before submitting a proposal. The role will examine scopes in detail, build defensible cost models and identify ambiguity, hidden effort and commercial risk before commitments are made to clients.


Working closely with the Business Development Strategist and teams across Finance, Operations, Project Management and Account Management, the successful candidate will coordinate compliant, on-time submissions and carry approved scopes through to delivery. They will provide clear handovers, support change requests and help build the structured commercial processes and records needed for sustainable agency growth.


KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Read RFPs, tenders and client briefs in full, extracting every deliverable, volume, service level and submission requirement.
  • Build structured and defensible cost models against the agreed rate card, documenting assumptions and the basis for each estimate.
  • Identify gaps between stated budgets and the true cost of delivery, escalating material concerns before the agency makes a commitment.
  • Interrogate vague or ambiguous scopes, raise clarification questions within tender windows and surface hidden effort or delivery risk early.
  • Review client terms, NDAs and contractual requirements for commercial impact, flagging changes to cost, risk or delivery obligations and routing documents for the appropriate approval or signature.
  • Check that proposals, forms and declarations meet all stated client requirements before submission.
  • Coordinate input from senior stakeholders and cross-functional teams, following up professionally to keep concurrent submissions on track.
  • Submit approved proposals, confirm receipt and resolve technical or administrative issues before external deadlines.
  • Maintain a clearly named, accurate and reusable library of proposals, costings, source materials and commercial records.
  • Hand approved scopes over to Account Management with deliverables, assumptions, commitments and commercial boundaries clearly documented.
  • Support Account Managers with change requests and scope variations, re-costing work and highlighting the commercial impact of proposed changes.
  • Use AI tools critically to improve the speed and quality of scope review and proposal work, validating outputs and refining prompts or processes over time.


QUALIFICATIONS

  • Bachelor's degree in Business, Finance, Commercial Management, Project Management or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • 5 years of agency-side experience in a commercial, scoping, bid-management or proposal-management role, ideally across communications, creative, social media or third-party supplier services.
  • Demonstrated ability to interpret complex or poorly structured briefs and translate them into complete, clearly defined scopes of work.
  • Experience building and explaining cost models from a rate card, with clear assumptions and sound commercial judgement.
  • Strong critical-thinking skills, with the confidence to challenge ambiguity, identify hidden effort and explain the commercial consequence of missed requirements.
  • Experience reviewing terms, NDAs and submission requirements for commercial and delivery implications, and routing issues for appropriate approval.
  • Strong AI fluency, including the ability to assess AI-generated outputs critically, distinguish substantive gaps from surface issues and improve prompts or workflows.
  • Confidence using structured costing, CRM and project-management systems; experience with platforms such as HubSpot or ClickUp would be advantageous.
  • Exceptional attention to detail across costings, forms, declarations, records and submission requirements.
  • Strong stakeholder-management and communication skills, including professional persistence when coordinating input from senior colleagues.
  • A methodical and composed approach to managing multiple concurrent deadlines and resolving issues under pressure.
  • High integrity when handling confidential client and commercial information, combined with strong ownership, collaboration and learning agility.


WHY JOIN US?

  • Be part of a global, growing organisation with exposure across multiple markets.
  • Work in a collaborative, multicultural environment.
  • Opportunity for career growth as the organisation expands.
  • Help build a disciplined, scalable commercial process that protects delivery quality and sustainable agency growth.


ABOUT ACORN STRATEGY

Voted Large Agency of the Year and winner of multiple international awards, Acorn Strategy is a full-service communications consultancy with offices in Dubai, Abu Dhabi, Melbourne, Perth, and London, and an ever-expanding client roster. We are an integrated marketing, public relations, and digital consultancy that delivers sharp, agile, and creative strategies to help grow our clients' business.


OUR CULTURE

We understand that our success depends on recruiting and retaining the highest quality individuals. We have created an environment for people to grow and learn through a culture that empowers creativity, innovation, and professionalism. The core values we live by are collaboration, agility, bravery, curiosity, and integrity.


OUR PEOPLE

Over the years we have come to realise that although each of our team members are unique, we each share a series of personal traits that have successfully linked us culturally as a team and as an agency at large.


ACORN STRATEGY is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are dedicated to creating and building a respectful and empowering environment. We aim to create an inclusive workplace that supports our diversity and increases our potential to produce work that better represents and resonates with the world around us.

title: Agent de Comptoir en Location de Véhicules (H/F) - Temps Partiel
description:
ABOUT US

Indie Campers is a global leader in road trip travel, offering thousands of customers the freedom to explore the world in fully equipped campervans and RVs.
As we expand our product offerings, we rely on exceptional frontline professionals who deliver memorable customer experiences while also driving commercial results.

The Rental Service Agent is a dual-focused role:

  • Sales Specialist for RV purchase demos and conversions

This position is crucial to ensuring customers leave satisfied, whether they are beginning a rental journey or purchasing their future RV.

THE ROLE

The Rental Service Agent executes all customer-facing rental operations and performs professional RV sales demonstrations to convert leads into buyers. This is a hands-on, customer-centric role combining service, product presentation, operational execution, and follow-up sales management. Across rentals and sales, this role ensures every vehicle, every interaction, and every customer moment reflects Indie Campers’ high standards.

WHAT WILL YOU WORK ON?

  • Customer Service & Operations: Conduct check-ins/check-outs, briefings, and provide ongoing rental support. Handle service recovery and emergencies with empathy.
  • Sales Demonstrations & Customer Engagement: Prepare and perform RV demos, showcasing features, specs, and customer-specific needs. Ensure smooth handovers and all documentation is in order.
  • Sales Conversion & Lead Management: Track leads, demos, and follow-ups in CRM. Convert rental customers into sales opportunities, and support the RV Sales District and City Lead to meet targets.
  • Product Knowledge & Technical Support: Maintain knowledge of Indie Campers RV models and perform basic system demos (lighting, gas, etc.). Troubleshoot and escalate issues as needed.

WHO ARE WE LOOKING FOR?

  • Must have: 1-3 years in customer service, sales, hospitality, rental, or automotive environments.
  • Must have: Strong communication and customer engagement skills.
  • Must have: Ability to understand and explain technical RV/vehicle systems.
  • Must have: Hands-on, adaptable, solution-oriented under pressure.
  • Proficiency using Nice to have: CRM tools, Must have: rental systems, or nice to have: digital sales software.
  • Must have: Organised, detail-focused, and proactive in managing leads or customers.
  • Must have: Driving License (Category B) required.
  • Must have: English and French proficiency.

PHYSICAL AND OPERATIONAL REQUIREMENTS

  • Must Have: Able to stand, walk, and move around the depot for extended periods throughout the day.
  • Must have: Able to lift or carry light to moderate items (10–15 kg).
  • Must have: Comfortable working outdoors in varying weather conditions.
  • Must have: Flexible to work weekends, holidays, and peak-season schedules.
  • Must have: Ability to interact with customers in different emotional states (excited, stressed, confused) with calmness and professionalism.

THE INDIE COMMITMENT!

  • Competitive compensation and commission opportunities.
  • Training in sales, product knowledge, customer service, and RV technical systems.
  • Career growth across Rental, Sales, Operations, or Servicing.
  • Travel benefits and access to the Indie Campers rental fleet.

Are you Ready to Go Indie?

title: Företagsinköpare till Bilia Outlet
description:
Vill du utvecklas inom bilförsäljning, med inriktning på värdering och inköp av begagnade bilar från företag? Då är det kanske dig vi söker! Vi söker nu en Företagsinköpare till Bilia Outlet med placering i Kista och vi hoppas att just du vill arbeta med oss för att bli branschens bästa servicebolag.

Varför välja Bilia

Bilia är mer än bara en arbetsplats, det är en möjlighet att utvecklas och få erfarenheter för framtiden. Vi är en inkluderande organisation som värdesätter engagemang och vilja att lära. Hos oss blir du en del av ett team där samarbete och service står i fokus. Vi vill att du ska trivas under din tid hos oss och få en positiv arbetsupplevelse i en trygg och stöttande miljö.

Om tjänsten

Som Företagsinköpare kommer du att ingå i vårt inköpsteam som arbetar över hela landet med att säkerställa ett attraktivt inflöde av begagnade bilar till verksamheten. Rollen innebär att du bygger och utvecklar långsiktiga relationer med företag, leasingbolag och andra samarbetspartners för att skapa affärsmöjligheter och genomföra lönsamma fordonsaffärer.

Du arbetar uppsökande via telefon, e-post och digitala möten där du etablerar nya kontakter och vidareutvecklar befintliga relationer. Från första kontakt till avslutad affär ansvarar du för hela processen med behovsanalys, värdering, förhandling och inköp av fordon. Du har ett affärsmässigt förhållningssätt och trivs med att kombinera relationsbyggande med ett tydligt resultatfokus.

För att lyckas i rollen behöver du ha ett genuint intresse för bilmarknaden och god förståelse för olika bilmärken, modeller och utrustningsnivåer.

Vad vi önskar av dig

Vi söker dig som:

  • Har erfarenhet av företagsförsäljning, uppsökande försäljning eller inköp, gärna inom fordonsbranschen
  • Har vana av att bygga och utveckla långsiktiga kundrelationer
  • Är affärsmässig och trivs med att skapa nya affärsmöjligheter
  • Har erfrenhet av arbete i CRM-system.
  • Har B-körkort

Arbetet är provisionsbaserat vilket innebär att du drivs av att skapa lönsamma affärer och nå uppsatta mål. Du är initiativtagande, har ett högt engagemang och tycker om att arbeta i ett högt tempo tillsammans med kollegor samtidigt som du håller en hög servicenivå gentemot kunder och samarbetspartners.

Övrigt

Tjänsten är en tillsvidareanställning på heltid med placering på Bilia Outlet i Kista. Har du frågor om tjänsten är du välkommen att kontakta rekryterande chef.

Urvalsarbetet sker löpande och tjänsten kan komma att tillsättas före sista ansökningsdatum, skicka därför in din ansökan redan idag. Då vi arbetar för en jämnare könsfördelning ser vi gärna kvinnliga sökande till den här tjänsten.

Vi ser fram emot din ansökan

title: Client Service Monitor
description:
Hope Mission Statement

The mission of Hope the Mission is to prevent, reduce and eliminate poverty, hunger, and homelessness by offering immediate assistance and long-term solutions.

Position Purpose and Summary

The Client Services Monitor (CSM) works directly on-site and is responsible for keeping participants safe, supporting daily operations, community standards and helping Hope the Mission's Interim Housing programs run smoothly. The CSM plays an important role in creating an environment that is safe, structured, and respectful — one where every participant is treated with dignity and fairness.

This position requires someone who shows up consistently, uses good judgment, and genuinely cares about serving people experiencing homelessness. Many participants in our programs have been through long periods of instability, crisis, and trauma. When a CSM shows up with calm, care, and compassion, it creates a sense of safety and routine that participants can count on as they work toward stable housing.

The CSM reports to the Program Manager or Assistant Program Manager and works alongside site staff to make sure the program runs well, meets contract requirements, and reflects Hope the Mission's values in every interaction.


Primary Duties and Responsibilities

Facility Maintenance and Sanitation

  • Assists with and facilitates routine cleaning of all facility areas to maintain cleanliness, safety, and operational readiness

  • Cleans and disinfects restrooms and shower areas after each use, without exception. Maintains sanitary and safe restroom and sink conditions at all times. Completes deep cleaning of restrooms and common areas.

  • Monitors and maintains hygiene areas and community areas; ensures resources are fully stocked, replenishing as needed.

  • Washes, dries, and prepares towels used for restroom and shower services

  • Monitors laundry rooms, restrooms, and common areas to ensure cleanliness and appropriate use

  • Maintains accurate shower and restroom usage logs

Participant Safety and Monitoring

  • Conducts required wellness checks each shift to ensure participant safety and well-being

  • Monitors participant movement, common areas, and site activity to promote safety and program compliance

  • Conducts routine site walk-throughs and safety checks during assigned shifts

  • Supports contraband control and safety procedures in accordance with agency policy

  • Responds to incidents and emergencies using trauma-informed de-escalation techniques and follows all incident reporting protocols

  • Supports emergency responses — including medical emergencies, overdoses, and evacuations — until leadership or first responders arrive

Participant Services and Engagement

  • Provides direct, respectful assistance to participants, including answering questions, responding to requests, and connecting participants to appropriate staff or resources

  • Assists with participant intake, orientation, and explanation of site guidelines as directed by management

  • Distributes hygiene supplies including soap, shampoo, towels, and related items to participants as needed

  • Supports meal service, supply distribution, and general operational duties as assigned

Documentation and Reporting

  • Completes Daily Activity Reports (DARs) accurately, objectively, and in a timely manner

  • Conducts intake, exit, and case notes in HMIS where applicable

  • Assists with documentation related to participant movements, wellness concerns, or incidents as required

  • Observes and reports safety concerns, maintenance issues, guideline violations, and unusual occurrences to site leadership promptly

Shift Operations

  • Provides support during shift pass-downs and communicates relevant updates between shifts

  • Provides overnight, evening, weekend, or holiday coverage as scheduled

  • Performs other duties as assigned

Transportation (Site Specific)

  • Transports participants to and from established routes and as directed by a supervisor

  • Maintains vehicle cleanliness inside and out at all times

  • Ensures the vehicle has sufficient fuel before and during each shift

  • Completes daily vehicle maintenance checks and reports any issues to the supervisors

  • Logs all mileage accurately and in accordance with departmental procedures

Skills

  • Strong observation and situational awareness skills

  • Trauma-informed communication and de-escalation techniques

  • Ability to maintain professional boundaries with participants

  • Clear, objective, and professional written documentation skills

  • Ability to follow policies, procedures, and chain of command

  • Strong teamwork and communication skills

  • Basic computer and email proficiency

  • Ability to lead with integrity and uphold organizational mission, values, and service philosophy.

  • Ability to cultivate and maintain collaborative relationships with community-based organizations and external service providers. Strong Interpersonal Skills.

  • Maintains professionalism, empathy, and sound decision-making when working in complex or emotionally challenging environments.


Qualifications

  • High school diploma or GED required

  • Previous experience in homeless services, shelter operations or social service preferred

  • Knowledge of trauma-informed care and harm reduction principles preferred

  • Ability to work flexible schedules including nights, weekends, and holidays


Mandatory Requirements

  • Background Screening – Employment is contingent upon the successful completion of background checks as required per worksite.

  • Drug and Alcohol Testing – Candidates must pass pre-employment and ongoing drug and alcohol screenings in accordance with company policy.

  • Motor Vehicle Record (MVR) Check – For roles requiring driving, employment is contingent upon an acceptable driving record.

  • Legal Eligibility to Work – Candidates must provide proof of legal authorization to work in the US.

  • Compliance with Company Policies and HIPAA standards – All employees must comply with company policies, including safety, confidentiality, and conduct standards.


Physical, Demands, Environmental Conditions, Equipment

The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of the job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential job functions. The employee is required to: walk and climb stairs; stand, bend, squat, climb, kneel, and twist on an intermittent or sometimes continuous basis; grasp, push, pull objects such as files, file cabinet drawers, and reach overhead; handle, finger, grasp and feel objects and equipment; reach with hands and arms; be mobile by moving oneself from place to place quickly and easily; repeat various motions with the wrists, hands, and fingers; be able to perform visual activities for (including, but not limited to) administrative and clerical tasks; ability to lift up to 25 lbs.; communicate, receive and exchange ideas, information by means of the spoken and written word; drive vehicles in and around Los Angeles County; be able to enter various buildings that may require climbing stairs; be periodically subjected to outside environmental conditions. The employee may work in proximity to service animals and emotional support animals; use a desktop and/or laptop computer; various office machines. Complete all required forms in personal writing.


Work Environment

The employee may be in contact with individuals and families in crisis who may be ill, using alcohol and drugs, and who may not be attentive to basic personal hygiene, health and safety practices. The employee may experience a number of unpleasant sensory demands associated with the participants’ use of alcohol and drugs, and lack of personal hygiene. The employee must be ready to respond quickly and effectively to many types of situations, including crisis situations and potentially hostile situations. The noise level in the work environment is usually moderate in an office setting. Sometimes work may become stressful when working under pressure or in crisis intervention. .


EEO: HTM (Hope the Mission) provides equal employment opportunities (EEO) to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability or genetics. In addition to federal law requirements, HTM complies with applicable state and local laws governing nondiscrimination in employment in every location in which the company has facilities. This policy applies to all terms and conditions of employment, including recruiting, placement, promotion, recall, transfer, leaves of absence, compensation and training.

HTM will consider qualified applicants with a criminal history pursuant to the California Fair Chance Act. You do not need to disclose your criminal history or participate in a background check until a conditional job offer is made to you. After making a conditional offer and running a background check, if HTM is concerned about a conviction that is directly related to the job, you will be given the chance to explain the circumstances surrounding the conviction, provide mitigating evidence, or challenge the accuracy of the background report. Find out more about the Fair Chance Act by visiting the California Department of Fair Employment and Housing’s Fair Chance Act webpage.




Full-Time, Exempt position; swing shift: 3:00pm - 11:30pm

title: Servicemedarbejder under 18 år - Kolding
description:
Servicemedarbejder under 18 år

Vil du være en del af stjerneholdet?

I Carl’s Jr. er vores kunder altid i centrum. Vores formål er at servere store, saftige, flammegrillede burgere og skabe en uforglemmelig oplevelse for vores gæster. Kundernes tilfredshed er essentiel for os – og det skal den også være for dig.

Vil du have en plads i et godt team, hvor vi har det sjovt, mens vi arbejder? Så er du måske Carl’s Jr.’s næste stjernemedarbejder under 18 år, så vi sammen kan gøre hver dag bedre.

Hvad tilbyder vi dig?
Som medarbejder hos Carl’s Jr. – uanset niveau – har du mulighed for at udvikle dig både fagligt og menneskeligt samt forfølge dine karriereambitioner. Vi er overbeviste om, at tilfredse og dygtige medarbejdere er væsentlig for, at kunderne vælger at besøge vores restauranter.

Som en del af vores team vil du blive en del af et godt arbejdsmiljø, hvor vi vægter samarbejde og godt humør højt.

Derudover tilbyder vi dig

  • En grundig introduktion og oplæring
  • Mulighed for at udvikle dine færdigheder i en international burgerkæde
  • Diverse medarbejdergoder indenfor Carl’s Jr. og Salling Group

Hvem er du?

description:

MGC Contractors, Inc is looking for a Mechanical/Process Equipment Installer to join our Utah Division in the Provo area.

title: Smed/svejser søges til automotive virksomhed i Gedved
description:
Svejsning · Smedearbejde · Trailere og maskinkonverteringer – Fuldtid, fysisk tilstedeværelse, Gedved, Danmark

Er du typen, der læser en tegning, tænder for svejseapparatet og er stolt af det, der kommer ud i den anden ende? RENTEQ Automotive er en startup i vækst, og vi har brug for en dygtig smed til at svejse de trailere, rammer og dele, der indgår i hver eneste maskine, vi konverterer. Hvis du er praktisk anlagt, nysgerrig og har lyst til at sætte dit præg på noget, der virkelig betyder noget – så læs videre.

Om RENTEQ Automotive

RENTEQ Automotive er en ung dansk virksomhed med en ambition om at reducere CO₂-udledningen ved at elektrificere varebiler og entreprenørmaskiner. Vi holder til i Gedved og tager hele rejsen på os – fra ingeniørarbejde og udvikling helt frem til produktion.

Din rolle

Som vores smed vil du omsætte tegninger til de færdige dele, der går i vores produkter. Fra vores værksted i Gedved svejser og tilpasser du trailere, bærende rammer og de øvrige stålkomponenter, der udgør rygraden i vores maskinkonverteringer. Meget af materialet vil kommer fra egen cnc bukkemaskine og laserskærer.

Det her er ikke kun et samlebånd – der vil være mange forskellige projekter, og du skal kunne tænke selvstændigt. Du arbejder tæt sammen med ingeniør- og produktionsteamet, kan finde ud af bidrage til problemløsninger tidligt, og hjælper os med at bygge klogere fra gang til gang.

Dine opgaver

• Svejse bærende rammer, chassisdele og konstruktioner – MIG og TIG afhængigt af materiale og specifikation

• Bygge, svejse og tilpasse trailere og de øvrige dele, der indgår i konverteringen af maskinerne

• Tilpasse og efterbearbejde svejsninger – opretning, slibning og kontrol af pasform

• Læse og fortolke tekniske tegninger og omsætte dem til færdige dele

• Kvalitetskontrollere eget arbejde – målkontrol, svejsekvalitet og pasform – inden det går til produktion

• Samarbejde med ingeniørteamet om at identificere designproblemer og give praktisk feedback

• Holde værkstedet organiseret, udstyr vedligeholdt og processer dokumenteret

• Understøtte prototypeiterationer – forvent at der er hyppige designændringer og flere projekter kørende på én gang.


Er det dig, vi leder efter?

Har du praktisk erfaring inden for svejs/smedearbejde – det kan være fra en håndværksuddannelse, teknisk skole eller reel værkstedserfaring?

Det vil være en fordel, hvis du kan sætte kryds ved det meste af nedenstående:

• Erfaren svejser – MIG og TIG

• Erfaring med trailer-, chassis- eller konstruktionssvejsning er et stort plus

• Fortrolig med almindeligt smedeværktøj – vinkelsliber, plasma-/gasskærer og opretningsværktøj

• I stand til at læse og arbejde ud fra tekniske tegninger og 3D-modeller

• Øje for detaljen: du måler to gange og er stolt af præcist, pænt arbejde

• Trives i et team, hvor ingen dage er ens

• Proaktiv – du identificerer problemer tidligt frem for at lade dem blive til andres problem

• Dansk på højt niveau og velfungerende engelsk, da vi er et internationalt team.

Vi tilbyder

• En central rolle i en startup i vækst, hvor dit arbejde er synligt i hvert køretøj, der forlader vores værksted

• Et uformelt og rart team i en flad virksomhedsstruktur med variation i arbejdsdagene

• Et sundt og attraktivt arbejdsmiljø med ordentligt svejse- og smedeudstyr

• Reelle muligheder for at vokse med virksomheden, efterhånden som vi skalerer til fuld produktion.

Sådan søger du

Send dit CV og et par linjer om dig selv til Simon Steen Kristensen på email simon@ren-teq.com. Vi behandler ansøgninger løbende og inviterer relevante kandidater til en uformel første samtale – så vent ikke for længe med at tage kontakt.

Har du spørgsmål til stillingen, inden du søger, er du meget velkommen til at skrive til os på samme adresse eller ringe på tlf. +45 21 94 21 43.

title: Kom med på holdet – vi søger en SSH/SSA til vores skærmede enhed på Symfonien NV4
description:
🌟Har du lyst til at gøre en forskel for mennesker med demens – og være med til at skabe tryghed, nærvær og stjernestunder i hverdagen.

Så har vi måske jobbet til dig!

Vi er en skærmet enhed med 24 beboere, og vi søger nu vores nye kollega. Vi søger enten en SSH eller en SSA, som har lyst til at blive en del af en engageret medarbejdergruppe, hvor faglighed, kvalitet og omsorg går hånd i hånd.

Hos os er beboerne altid i centrum. Vi går langt for, at vores beboere trives, føler sig trygge og får mulighed for at have et godt og meningsfuldt hverdagsliv. Vi tror på, at de små øjeblikke ofte er de største – en god snak over kaffen, et grin, en sang, en tur ud i det fri eller bare det at blive mødt med nærvær og respekt.

Hos os får du mulighed for at gøre en forskel

Vi arbejder ud fra den enkelte beboers livshistorie, ønsker, vaner og ressourcer. Vi ser mennesket bag sygdommen og forsøger hver dag at skabe rammer, hvor den enkelte kan bevare mest muligt af sig selv og sit gode liv. Vi lægger stor vægt på, at vores beboere oplever tryghed, genkendelighed og kontinuitet, og vi arbejder derfor målrettet med personcentreret omsorg.

Faglighed er en vigtig del af vores hverdag.

Vi ønsker at være en arbejdsplads, hvor man både kan bruge sin faglighed og udvikle den.

Vi har blandt andet daglig triagering, hvor vi sammen vurderer beboernes aktuelle tilstand og reagerer på ændringer i deres fysiske og psykiske helbred. Vi arbejder systematisk med observationer, dokumentation og opfølgning, så vi hurtigt kan handle, når en beboer ændrer tilstand.

Som SSH/SSA hos os bliver du derfor en vigtig del af det tværfaglige samarbejde omkring beboerne.

Vi arbejder blandt andet med:

  • Daglig triagering og systematiske observationer
  • Tidlig opsporing af ændringer i beboernes tilstand
  • Personcentreret omsorg
  • Dokumentation og faglig opfølgning
  • Ernæring og forebyggelse af vægttab
  • Rehabilitering og vedligeholdelse af beboernes ressourcer
  • Samarbejde med sygeplejersker, terapeuter, læger og pårørende
  • Fokus på demensfaglighed og den enkelte beboers livshistorie
  • At skabe gode hverdage og masser af stjernestunder 🌟

Vi løfter i flok - Vi tror på, at et godt arbejdsmiljø og høj faglighed hænger sammen.

Hos os skal der være plads til at spørge, undre sig, dele sin viden og hjælpe hinanden. Vi ønsker en kultur, hvor vi tager ansvar for både beboerne og hinanden.

Vi forventer ikke, at du kan alt fra første dag. Til gengæld forventer vi, at du har lyst til at lære, tage ansvar og være en aktiv del af vores fællesskab.

Vi leder efter dig, som

  • er uddannet SSH eller SSA
  • har lyst til at arbejde med mennesker med demens
  • har en anerkendende og respektfuld tilgang til beboerne
  • kan arbejde selvstændigt og samtidig indgå aktivt i et team
  • har blik for ændringer i beboernes tilstand
  • er nysgerrig på faglig udvikling
  • kan bevare roen, også når hverdagen bliver udfordrende
  • har humor og lyst til at bidrage til en god arbejdsdag
  • ser muligheder frem for begrænsninger.

Vi håber, du har lyst til at blive en del af os
Hos os får du mulighed for at være med til at gøre en reel forskel for 24 mennesker – hver eneste dag.
Du bliver en del af en arbejdsplads, hvor vi både tager faglighed, kvalitet, omsorg og arbejdsglæde alvorligt. Vi glæder os til at møde dig og høre, hvad du kan bidrage med – og ikke mindst hvad der giver dig arbejdsglæde.

Om Distrikt NordVest
Vi er et af to distrikter under Center for Sundhed og Ældre i Næstved Kommune.
Vores fokus er rehabilitering og at understøtte borgernes mulighed for at mestre eget liv, ud fra deres ønsker, mål og livshistorie.

Løn og ansættelsesvilkår sker i henhold til gældende overenskomst mellem KL og DSR.
