Dina arbetsuppgifter

Som IT-tekniker kommer du att arbeta med drift, underhåll och felavhjälpning i vår utskriftsmiljö. Dina huvudsakliga arbetsuppgifter inkluderar att:

  • Arbeta med drift, tekniskt underhåll och förvaltning

  • Utföra daglig systemadministration i program som PaperCut MF, HP Web Jetadmin och HP Security Manager, samt delta firmware-uppdateringar, konfigurationer och drivrutinshantering.

  • Analysera, felsöka och åtgärda problem i systemmiljöer, inklusive skapande av utskriftsköer.

  • Hantera mer komplexa incidenter och tekniska problem, såsom eskalerade ärenden inom 2nd och 3rd line support. Detta innefattar avancerad felsökning av utskriftsflöden, nätverksrelaterade utskriftsproblem, användarstöd samt hantering av hårdvarufelanmälningar mot externa leverantörer.

  • Delta i genomföranden vid förändringar i IT-miljön enligt etablerade processer.

  • Ta fram, underhålla och proaktivt uppdatera teknisk dokumentation, driftinstruktioner samt guider för både slutanvändare och kollegor.

  • Samverka med kollegor och externa leverantörer vid mer komplexa incidenter eller förändringar för att bidra till utveckling och kvalitetssäkring av våra IT-tjänster.

Din arbetsplats

Vi är kommunens IT-avdelning och tillhör förvaltningen Verksamhetsstöd och service. Här arbetar cirka 120 medarbetare med att leverera stabila, säkra och moderna IT-tjänster till kommunens verksamheter - och i förlängningen till elever, brukare och invånare.

Vi på enheten Kontorsnära IT är ett team på cirka 10 medarbetare som tillsammans ansvarar för kommunens alla skrivare samt tjänster inom Ljud & Bild. Det innebär att vi hanterar allt från utskriftslösningar till videomöten, projektorer och bokningsskärmar.

Vårt uppdrag är att göra arbetsdagen enklare och smidigare för alla anställda genom att se till att den kontorsnära tekniken fungerar sömlöst i vardagen.

För oss är hjälpsamhet och utveckling A och O. Vi delar gärna med oss av vår kunskap, stöttar varandra i vardagen och förbättrar våra arbetssätt tillsammans. Hos oss får du en välkomnande arbetsplats med mycket arbetsglädje och goda möjligheter att växa.

Du som söker

Vi söker dig som vill ha en betydande roll i vår utskriftsmiljö och dela din kunskap med ett team där trivsel och utveckling går hand i hand. För oss är det viktigaste inte bara att skrivaren fungerar, utan att du vill bidra till en välkomnande arbetsplats där vi stöttar varandra i vardagen.

Du som söker har en eftergymnasial utbildning inom IT, systemadministration eller motsvarande kompetens förvärvad genom arbetslivserfarenhet. Du har kunskap inom drift av IT-system, felsökning och analys i komplexa IT-miljöer. Vidare har du dokumenterad erfarenhet av supportarbete i andra och/eller tredje linjen, med vana av att ge stöd både via fjärrstyrning och på plats (onsite). Vi ser att du som söker även har erfarenhet av incidenthantering av skrivare. Om du har erfarenhet av arbete inom IT-miljö i offentlig verksamhet ser vi det som meriterande.

Som IT-tekniker ser vi att du har erfarenhet av att arbeta i Active Directory. Vi ser det som meriterande om du även har erfarenhet av utskriftsplattformen PaperCut MF. Vi ser det även som meriterande om du har tidigare erfarenhet av komplexa skrivarmiljöer och FollowMe-lösningar samt processramverket ITIL.

Vi söker dig som arbetar bra med komplexa frågor, analyserar och bryter ned problem och löser komplexa tekniska problem. Vidare är du en person som planerar och prioriterar ditt arbete på ett effektivt sätt, sätter upp tidsramar och är noggrann i ditt utförande. Du arbetar bra med andra, är lyhörd, har en god kommunikationsförmåga både muntligt och skriftligt samt delar gärna med dig av din kunskap till kollegor. Som IT-tekniker är du lugn och tillmötesgående i ditt bemötande.

För den här tjänsten kommer vi att begära ett utdrag ur belastningsregistret/misstankeregistret inför anställning.

Välkommen med din ansökan.

Övrig information

I denna ansökan bifogar du inget personligt brev.

Du ansöker med e-legitimation. Saknar du e-legitimation? Kontakta ansvarig HR-konsult eller chef, så hjälper vi dig.

Tillträde: Enligt överenskommelse

Anställningsform: Tillsvidareanställning

Sysselsättningsgrad: 100%

Antal lediga befattningar: 1

Ref. nr: 17819

Besök gärna https://www.linkoping.se/arbete-och-lediga-jobb/jobba-hos-oss för att ta del av medarbetarberättelser, förmåner, kollektivavtal och lönestatistik.

Tillsammans formar vi framtidsstaden

Linköping är en av Europas mest innovativa städer och möjligheternas kommun. Med energi, mod och hjärta gör vi vår stad ännu bättre. Vi drivs av nyfikenheten och viljan att hitta nya lösningar. Och av att förgylla vardagen och förbättra livskvaliteten för våra invånare.

title: Køkkenchef søges til Café Englen
description:
Cafe Englen søger ny køkkenchef

Vi er på udkig efter en god kandidat til vores stærke køkkenhold. Vi søger en kok med stor faglighed, engagement og med lyst til at blive en del af en ganske særlig café og arbejdsplads.

Som køkkenchef på Café Englen vil du være en del af en stærk og dedikeret personalegruppe, som er vant til at arbejde selvstændigt og i et højt tempo. Du vil komme til at arbejde et sted hvor der er stolthed i mad, vin og kaffe, og hvor ekspertise indenfor disse områder er værdsat og sættes i spil hver dag.

Cafeen har haft samme ejer siden sin opstart i 1984, hvilket bidrager til en afslappet og hjemlig stemning, som gæsterne ynder at vende tilbage til. Vi har et ambitiøst men uformelt arbejdsmiljø, og lægger stor vægt på at den daglige tone medarbejderne imellem er venlig og respektfuld til enhver tid. Vi søger en kandidat med samme værdigrundlag, med forståelse og respekt for caféens traditioner.

Jobbet omfatter:

· Daglig ledelse af køkkenpersonale

· Udvikling af menu og produkter

· Tilberedning /opbakning

· Service

· Rengøring/egenkontrol

· Varebestilling

Som køkkenchef på Café Englen skal du være selvstændig, kreativ, ambitiøs og have lyst til at være en styrende kraft i et køkken som vil mere end blot at servere ordinær cafémad. Du sætter en ære i det gode håndværk, har øje for detaljen og sætter stor pris på at indgå i et team hvor alle har noget at bidrage med til den daglige arbejdsgang.

Ansættelsesstart: snarest muligt

Ansøgning skal sendes til job@cafe-englen.dk og vil blive behandlet løbende.

Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig!

title: Tre ernæringsassistentelever til Københavns Kommune
description:
Bliv klog på mad i Københavns Kommune – Danmarks største arbejdsplads.

Er du nysgerrig på kostens betydning for forskellige målgrupper?
Har du lyst til at arbejde med økologi og bæredygtighed?
Har du lyst til at planlægge og lave mad og måltider til ældre eller børn?
Så er du måske en af vores nye ernæringsassistentelever. Vi søger elever, som er engagerede i uddannelsen og interesserede i at yde en god service.

Hvis du godt kan lide at arbejde med mad og sundhed, samtidig med at du gør en forskel for din målgruppe, så er ernæringsassistentuddannelsen noget for dig. Her får du kombineret faglig viden om ernæring og fødevarer med praktisk kunnen i et produktionskøkken.

Vi søger elever til ansættelse fra den 1. december 2026. Uddannelsen veksler mellem oplærings- og skoleophold.

Mødetiden i oplæringen planlægges i tidsrummet kl. 06.30-19.00. Der kan forekomme weekend- og helligdagsvagter.

I Københavns Kommune har du mulighed for at din læreplads kan være fx i et køkken på et plejecenter eller i et større eller mindre køkken.

Du er velkommen til evt. at skrive i din ansøgning, hvad du kunne være interesseret i. Vi tager hensyn til dine ønsker og behov i det omfang, vores muligheder tillader det, når vi fordeler elever.

Læs mere om Københavns Kommune her.

Som ernæringsassistentelev lærer du om

  • produktionsmetoder, sansning, tilsmagning og tilberedning af velsmagende mad
  • råvarernes sammensætning og økologi
  • menuplanlægning, herunder valg af råvarer i forhold til sæson og pris
  • næringsberegning og fysiologi for at sikre den rette ernæring til målgruppen
  • fremstilling af vegetarmad og diæter, herunder dysfagikost
  • hygiejne og mikrobiologi i forhold til fødevarebårne sygdomme
Vi tilbyder

  • en alsidig uddannelse i samspil med mennesker, hvor god mad er det centrale, og hvor der er fokus på din læring
  • et struktureret uddannelsesforløb i samarbejde med den uddannelsesansvarlige
  • et køkken i udvikling og med medarbejderinddragelse
  • en personlig uddannelsesplan, der løbende følges op af en praktikvejleder
  • et hold kolleger, som synes, humor er en god del af hverdagen
  • ansættelse med løn under hele uddannelsen
Vi forventer, at du

  • har det adgangsgivende grundforløb for ernæringsassistentelever inden start på hovedforløb – vi ansætter gerne EUX-elever
  • udviser interesse for faget både praktisk og teoretisk
  • sætter faglighed og kvalitet i højt
  • har en god ordenssans
  • er ansvarsbevidst og mødestabil
  • har lyst til at arbejde i teams
Ansættelsesvilkår
Løn- og ansættelsesvilkår er i henhold til gældende overenskomst. Din arbejdstid er 37 timer om ugen. Du kan læse, om du kan få voksenelevløn her.

Mere information
Hvis du har spørgsmål, så ring til konsulent Nana Sandø på 22 68 52 30. Du kan læse mere om at være elev i Københavns Kommune her.

Skriv lidt om hvem du er, og hvorfor du ønsker elevplads som ernæringsassistent i Københavns Kommune. Sammen med din ansøgning beder vi dig uploade eksamensbevis fra dit grundforløb. Hvis du endnu ikke har modtaget dit eksamensbevis, kan du uploade din uddannelsesplan.

Søg via linket senest søndag den 4. oktober 2026
Vi inviterer skriftligt til ansættelsessamtaler umiddelbart efter ansøgningsfristen, og vi holder samtaler mandag den 12. oktober (OBS uge 42).

title: Senior it-projektleder
description:
Senior it-projektleder

til det fælleskommunale it-selskab i Region Sjælland

Vil du projektmæssigt stå i spidsen for en af de største it-transformationer i den kommunale sektor og være med til at samle 16 kommuners it-infrastruktur i én fælles serviceorganisation?

De 16 kommuner i Region Sjælland, tilsammen 833.062 borgere, etablerer et fælles kommunalt it-selskab, der skal konsolidere kommunernes server- og netværksinfrastruktur og drift i én robust serviceorganisation. Initiativet udspringer af Økonomiaftale 2026 mellem regeringen og KL, og selskabet stiftes den 1. januar 2027. Selskabet etableres som et aktieselskab (A/S). Arbejdet er siden januar 2026 organiseret som ét fælles program med syv projektspor.

Konsolideringen af servere, netværk, drift og it-services er et af de største it-projekter i nyere tid i den kommunale sektor. Fem regioner gennemfører den samme øvelse samtidigt, og i denne stilling får du en nøglerolle i at omsætte ambitionerne til konkrete projekter, beslutninger og resultater.

Om stillingen

Som senior it-projektleder får du ansvar for at planlægge, lede og koordinere komplekse it-projekter på tværs af de 16 kommuner. Du bliver bindeled mellem ledelse, styregrupper, teknikere, arkitekter, leverandører og øvrige interessenter, og du sikrer fremdrift, overblik og beslutningskraft i projekterne.

Du kommer til at arbejde i etableringsfasen af en ny organisation, hvor rammer, governance og samarbejdsformer skal bygges op samtidigt med, at de store konsolideringsopgaver skal drives sikkert frem. Rollen kræver derfor både solid projektfaglighed, politisk og organisatorisk forståelse samt evnen til at skabe ro, retning og fælles ejerskab i komplekse forløb.

Dine opgaver vil blandt andet være at:

  • Planlægge og lede større it-infrastruktur- og konsolideringsprojekter på tværs af kommunerne
  • Udarbejde projektgrundlag, projektplaner, milepæle, beslutningsoplæg og ledelsesrapportering
  • Sikre tydelig governance, rollefordeling, fremdrift og beslutningsveje i projekterne
  • Drive workshops, styregruppemøder, projektfora og tværkommunale afklaringsprocesser
  • Håndtere risici, afhængigheder, økonomi, kvalitet, ændringer og gevinstrealisering
  • Koordinere tæt med arkitekter, driftsspecialister, leverandører, ledelse og kommunale nøglepersoner
  • Understøtte implementering af fælles standarder, processer og driftsmodeller
  • Bidrage til opbygningen af en professionel projektkultur i den nye organisation

Din profil

Du har en relevant videregående uddannelse og solid erfaring med ledelse af komplekse it-projekter, gerne i organisationer med mange interessenter og høj teknisk eller organisatorisk kompleksitet. Du trives med at skabe struktur, fremdrift og samarbejde, og du kan omsætte strategiske mål til konkrete planer, beslutninger og leverancer.

Måske arbejder du allerede som senior projektleder, programleder, it-projektleder eller konsulent. Det vigtigste for os er, at du er erfaren, relationelt stærk og sikker i rollen som den, der skaber overblik, samler trådene og får projekter sikkert i mål.

Det er en fordel, hvis du har erfaring med nogle af følgende områder:

  • Ledelse af større it-infrastruktur-, drifts- eller transformationsprojekter
  • Projekt- og programstyringsmetoder som PRINCE2, MSP, PMI, SAFe eller lignende
  • Styregruppearbejde, ledelsesrapportering og beslutningsoplæg
  • Leverandørstyring, kontraktopfølgning og samarbejde med eksterne parter
  • Governance, risikostyring, økonomiopfølgning og gevinstrealisering
  • Offentlig sektor, kommunal it eller andre komplekse enterprise-miljøer
  • It-drift, infrastruktur, cybersikkerhed eller digital transformation

Vi tilbyder

En sjælden mulighed for at være med fra begyndelsen af en helt ny organisation med stor strategisk betydning for 16 kommuner.

Du får en central rolle i gennemførelsen af nogle af de mest omfattende it-konsolideringer i Danmark og mulighed for at præge både projekterne og den organisation, som skal drive fremtidens kommunale it på Sjælland.

Du bliver en del af et fagligt stærkt miljø med høj grad af samarbejde, ansvar og frihed til at skabe resultater. Vi lægger vægt på pragmatisk problemløsning, tydelig kommunikation og et stærkt fælles fokus på kvalitet, sikkerhed og drift.

Praktisk

Løn- og ansættelsesvilkår sker i henhold til gældende overenskomst og efter kvalifikationer.

Oplysninger om startløn og forventet løninterval
Via linket her kan ses oplysninger om relevant løninterval for den konkrete stilling. I oversigten vælges Næstved Kommune, hvilken stillingskategori (overenskomst) du ansøger til og yderligere hvilken stilling du søger. I tabellen derunder kan ses de relevante oplysninger for den konkrete stilling.

Tiltrædelse: Den 1. december 2026.

Ansættelsessted: Næstved Kommune, indtil selskabet får egen lokation.

Ansøgningsfrist: Onsdag den 21. oktober 2026.

Spørgsmål til stillingen: Kontakt Lars Borg, It- og Digitaliseringschef, Næstved Kommune, tlf. 2115 2674.

Du søger stillingen ved at sende din ansøgning, CV og anden relevant dokumentation og uddannelsesbevis elektronisk via ansøgerknappen ”Ansøg”.

Vi ser frem til at modtage din ansøgning.

title: PSR Recovery Coordinator
description:
Job Title

PSR Recovery Coordinator

Reports to

PSR Sr Manager

FLSA / WAGE

Nonexempt / $21.58 - 22.38 per hour

Original Date:

June 2023

Revised:

July 2026

JOB SUMMARY

The Psychosocial Rehabilitation (PSR) Program at Park Center builds community in East Nashville with adults diagnosed with mental Illnesses. All PSR staff share in assisting members to live vocationally productive and socially satisfying lives. The program participants are perceived as “members” rather than “clients” or “patients”, and they work to maintain an informal setting to reduce the psychological distance between staff and members. Staff encourage members to assume productive roles within our hybrid psychosocial rehabilitation and clubhouse-adjacent programming, and within the broader community. Coordinators provide members support through working to maintain a flexible, varied program of vocational, educational, and recreational activities. Members are actively involved with the development of supported employment pathways and placements in the community and actively involved with their sustainability.

ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS

  1. Work with clients (“members”) to complete vocational activities.

    1. Work in close collaboration with staff team and members to meet goals, promote a positive work environment, and advance the quality of services provided to members of the program utilizing principles of trauma-informed and person-centered care.
    2. Actively engage members, work with and alongside members in the work-ordered day, to identify needs in the unit and the program.
    3. Assist members in planning out a full day’s worth of work and ensure those needs are met.
    4. Plan activities and perform tasks associated with the program units.
    5. Complete work if members are unwilling to assist.
    6. Identify and encourage the skills, talents, and creative ideas and efforts of each member each day.
    7. Participate in social/recreational activities on some weekends, evenings, and holidays.
    8. Serve as an advisor, advocate, and resource for members. Support members’ goals to find meaningful work outside the program through IPS and supported employment.
    9. Participate in outreach activities aimed at engaging members in coming to the program.

  2. Actively engages members in designing and implementing a plan for their recovery.

Develops and leads recovery-based activities and psychoeducational groups.

Maintains a caseload meeting with assigned members, assisting them in identifying recovery goals, and objectives to meet their set goals.

Writes group notes daily and weekly progress notes for assigned caseload.

Records any incidents in accordance with policies and procedures.

Engages and trains members in unit activities including activities of daily living (ADLs) and job readiness skills in work units (Culinary, Environmental, Hospitality, Media and Communications)

Facilitates 1:1 training and small groups to teach and demonstrate tasks in work units.

Provides encouragement and feedback to members in a trauma-informed and

strengths-based approach.

Ensures that all information in the member record is signed as required, of high quality, and clearly understood by members, other staff, and monitoring sources.

Communicates thoroughly with the rest of the team regarding members’ strengths and opportunities for growth. Participates as a member of the team discussing members progress towards set recovery goals.

  1. Other duties

    1. Learns agency policies and follows them accurately.
    2. Attends all necessary staff meetings and trainings.
    3. Participates in member activities as required.
    4. Other duties as assigned.

  2. Value cultural competence and diversity

    1. Collaborate with staff, members, and the community to gain the perspectives of others having diverse opinions, abilities, values, beliefs, perspectives, and ethnic or cultural backgrounds.
    2. Take deliberate steps to increase your own cultural competency by attending trainings, events, discussions, workshops, etc.


SKILLS AND QUALIFICATIONS

Bachelor’s Degree preferred from an accredited college in social work, sociology, or another related field.

One (1) year of experience in a mental health or social service setting. Lived experience of being hospitalized psychiatrically or receiving mental health services preferred.

Demonstrates flexibility and teamwork in the delivery of services.

Possess a strong desire to help others with empathy, patience, understanding, enthusiasm, and dedication.

Demonstrate professionalism in communication, empathy, attendance, attention to accuracy and follow through, teamwork, and punctuality.

Ability to communicate effectively with members and staff.

Eager to learn.

Committed to customer service.

Ability to receive constructive feedback and incorporate feedback into practice.

Demonstrate commitment to org mission and values.

Demonstrates high standards of professional and ethical behavior.

Must have a valid drivers’ license.

Must be able to show proof of personal automobile insurance.

Must be insurable under Park Center's automobile insurance.

WORKING CONDITIONS

Works in an office setting with limited remote work options. Attends community outings with members. This position requires evening, weekend, and holiday work.

Work will also take place in an industrial kitchen, where you'll be exposed to heat, noise, and occasional humidity. Safety gear such as gloves, protective eyewear, or aprons may be necessary depending on the task.

Please note that reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions of this job. It's important to us that our employees work in safe, respectful conditions, and we adhere to all applicable health and safety regulations.


PHYSICAL DEMANDS

The position requires frequent physical activity including standing, walking, bending, and kneeling. You may be required to lift or move heavy objects up to 30 lbs. occasionally.

Manual dexterity is necessary for certain tasks, such as food preparation in the kitchen. Part of the job may be performed in an outdoor setting where exposure to various weather conditions should be expected. This can include tasks such as landscaping or maintenance duties.

Please note that reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions of this job. It's important to us that our employees work in safe, respectful conditions, and we adhere to all applicable health and safety regulations.


DIRECT REPORTS

None

SCHEDULE

This position is a Monday-Friday full time position of 37.5 hours weekly. Occasional nights or weekend events may be required.

There are three (3) available schedules to work: (based on program need)

7:30 am-3:30 pm

8:00 am-4:00 pm

8:30 am-4:30 pm

WORK LOCATION

The PSR Day Program is located at 948 Woodland Street location in Nashville, TN.

DISCLAIMER

This job description is not intended to be all-inclusive, and the employee will be expected to perform other reasonably related duties as assigned. Park Center reserves the right to revise or change job tasks and responsibilities.

title: Product Designer (6/12 months Fixed Term Contract)
description:
About the role

Flo is seeking a contract Product Designer to join our Technology team on a full-time, 6–12 month hybrid basis. We welcome bold, inventive ideas to help us reshape the clean energy landscape and position Flo as the premier renewable electricity retailer across Singapore and Australia.


What you will be doing:

  • Design end-to-end flows and interfaces across both our customer-facing products and Canopy, our internal console that powers energy retail operations—from signups and metering to billing and market interactions.
  • Own your design work from problem framing through to polished, developer-ready handoff—translating PRDs and specs into wireframes, prototypes, and high-fidelity designs.
  • Simplify complex operational workflows into clear, efficient interfaces that help our internal teams work faster and smarter.
  • Work within our design system and UX principles, using existing tokens and components, and flagging gaps where new patterns are needed.
  • Build strong, collaborative relationships with product managers, engineers, and operations teams, clearly articulating design rationale to drive informed product decisions.
  • Take initiative in improving existing workflows, simplifying complex interactions, and enhancing usability through continuous iteration.


You will be a good candidate if you have/can

  • Have 3–5 years of experience as a Product Designer or UI/UX Designer, ideally including B2B, SaaS, or internal tooling.
  • Maintain a portfolio that showcases end-to-end product thinking and shipped product work—real flows, not just visuals.
  • Are confident in owning the full design process—from discovery and ideation to prototyping, usability testing, and final handoff—with minimal hand-holding.
  • Can make dense, data-heavy interfaces feel simple, with strong interaction design and information architecture skills.
  • Use Figma proficiently, including design systems, components, and variables, and are comfortable picking up new tools as needed.
  • Communicate clearly and confidently with cross-functional teams, articulating design decisions and facilitating collaboration.
  • Work well in fast-paced environments and adapt to shifting priorities while maintaining attention to detail.

title: Therapy Services Therapist
description:
Job Title

Therapist – Therapy Services

Reports to:

Director of Clinical Services

FLSA / WAGE

Non-Exempt / $26.88 - $29.02 per hour

Original Date:

October 2025

Revised:

Job Summary

This position provides quality, person-centered, trauma informed, recovery focused therapeutic services to those enrolled in Therapy Services, including the co-occurring out-patient and intensive out-patient programs.

ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS

  1. Value cultural competence and diversity

    1. Collaborate with staff, members, and the community to gain the perspectives of others having diverse opinions, abilities, values, beliefs, perspectives, and ethnic or cultural backgrounds.
    2. Take deliberate steps to increase their own cultural competency by attending training, events, discussions, workshops, etc.

  1. Member Support Duties:

    1. Engage members utilizing a trauma lens and cultural humility to quickly establish trust and build rapport.
    2. Partner with members to help them achieve goals around improving their mental health and substance use
    3. Provide therapeutic services, including individual sessions, group sessions, family/couples therapy, and assessments to members with mental health challenges, substance use disorders, and physical health issues. Use evidence-based modalities such as Cognitive Behavioral Therapy (CBT), Dialectical Behavior Therapy (DBT), Motivational Interviewing (MI), and harm reduction strategies.
    4. Educate members about the connection between mental health, substance use, and physical health, providing tools to enhance overall wellness.
    5. Empower members by teaching coping strategies, life skills, and relapse prevention skills.
    6. Collaborate with members to develop personalized treatment plans that address mental health, substance use, and physical health needs.
    7. Provide crisis intervention for members in acute distress, ensuring safety and immediate support.
    8. Address mental health and substance use crises with sensitivity and a trauma-informed approach, coordinating with medical and social services teams as necessary.
    9. Assist members with developing interpersonal skills to connect with members of the community and expand their natural support system.
    10. Complete, maintain, and review documentation for agency and funding requirements within all designated timeframes
    11. Develop and provide resources to members based around recovery services.
    12. Demonstrate consistent adherence to the ethical standards and professional conduct guidelines set forth by the American Counseling Association (ACA), National Association of Social Workers (NASW), and the Professional Counselor (PC) Code of Ethics to ensure safe, ethical, and client-centered therapeutic practice.
Page Break

  1. Public/Staff Relations:

    1. Communicate with internal and external partners to coordinate care and advocate for member needs.
    2. Build rapport and connections with community service providers to provide wrap around support and care to members in recovery.
    3. Develop effective working relationships with human services organizations.

  2. Program Development:

    1. Create and update departmental procedures in collaboration with Therapy Services leadership.
    2. Coordinate and meet with other programs and industry leaders for research and development.
    3. Work closely with Park Center staff and other service providers to ensure comprehensive, recovery focused care for members.
    4. Participate in multidisciplinary case conferences to discuss member progress, challenges, and additional needs.

SKILLS AND QUALIFICATIONS

  • Master’s degree in social work (MSW), Counseling, Marriage and Family Therapy (LMFT), or a related field required.
  • Licensure in the state of Tennessee (LCSW, LMFT, LPCC, or similar) preferred, or working towards licensure.
  • At least 2 years of experience providing direct clinical services, preferably with individuals experiencing homelessness, mental health issues, substance use, and/or physical health concerns.
  • Experience working with trauma, substance use recovery, and/or co-occurring disorders is strongly preferred.
  • Knowledge of harm reduction principles and practices is a plus.
  • Able to demonstrate strong recovery support competencies and ethical behaviors.
  • Must have proven written and verbal communication skills and computer literacy.
  • Must have a valid Tennessee Driver’s License.
  • Must be able to show proof of personal automobile insurance.

WORKING CONDITIONS

  • Able to operate with many distractions.
  • Routine office environment with capability to provide virtual sessions as needed.

Physical Demands

  • The ability to communicate effectively in written and oral form.
    • The ability to sit and stand for extended periods is required.
  • The ability to use a vehicle to travel to different sites or transport members as needed.

The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by any employee to perform the essential functions of their job at Park Center. Reasonable accommodation, physical or otherwise, may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform essential functions.


Schedule

  • Monday – Friday 8:30 to 4:30

Work Location

  • Primary work location is 1935 21st Avenue S. Work at other Park Center locations may be required.

Disclaimer

This job description is not intended to be all-inclusive, and the employee will be expected to perform other reasonably related duties as assigned. Park Center reserves the right to revise or change job tasks and responsibilities.

title: Gravermedhjælper søges til Thorsø Høje Menighedsråd (37 t)
description:
Kan du lide at arbejde ude i al slags vejr? Og trives du i et job med stor grad af frihed under ansvar? Så søger vi netop nu en dygtig gravermedhjælper til Thorsø Høje Menighedsråd.

Som gravermedhjælper vedligeholder du kirkegårdene og arealerne omkring sognegården i tæt samarbejde med de øvrige kollegaer – herunder graveren, der har det overordnede ansvar for arealerne.

Stillingen er en fuldtidsstilling med en ugentlig arbejdstid på 37 timer med helårsansættelse.

Dine opgaver:

• Grøn pleje - herunder sæsonbestemte opgaver, såsom udplantning af forårs- og sommerblomster, hækklipning, græsslåning, grandækning og anlæg af gravsteder.

• Indvendigt vedligehold af kirker og øvrige bygninger – herunder også lettere rengøringsopgaver.

• Kirketjeneste dvs. de praktiske opgaver før, under og efter gudstjenesten. Opgaven deles med øvrige kolleger og du kan derfor forvente at du (herunder weekendarbejde og til tider aftenarbejde)

Vi forestiller os, at du har følgende kvalifikationer:

• Trives med at arbejde ude i al slags vejr og med en god blanding af varierende- og rutineopgaver.

• Som person er du god til at samarbejde, tager ansvar for dine opgaver og kan samtidig lide at løse opgaver selvstændigt.

• Som kirkens ansigt udadtil skal du være serviceminded og udvise hensynsfuld adfærd overfor pårørende og besøgende på kirkegården.

• Vi vægter det sociale liv højt i menighedsrådet, så det er vigtigt, at du har lyst til at engagere dig i samarbejdet med menighedsråd og kolleger.

• Ordenssans og omhyggelighed i udførelsen af opgaver

• Kørekort B og egen bil er et krav, da vi har 4 kirker og kirkegårde som du skal arbejde ved. Befordringsgodtgørelse ydes.

Til gengæld tilbyder vi:

• Et spændende arbejde med høj grad af frihed under ansvar

• En alsidig hverdag med variation i opgaverne

• Et stærkt kollegialt fællesskab og godt arbejdsmiljø med et menighedsråd der engagerer sig i sine medarbejdere.

Ansættelsesvilkår:

Ansættelse sker ved Thorsø Høje Menighedsråd Dolmervej 4 8500 Grenå, arbejdssted er Thorsø Høje Menighedsråds 4 kirker og kirkegårde i sognene Veggerslev, Villersø, Karlby og Voldby samt sognehuset i Voldby

Ansættelse og aflønning sker efter Overenskomst for gravermedhjælpere på landsbykirkegårde indgået mellem Kirkeministeriet og Fagligt Fælles Forbund (3F). Løn og nærmere vilkår kan ses her: Gældende overenskomster - Folkekirkens Personale

Lyder jobbet som noget for dig?

Så send et CV samt en kort beskrivelse af din motivation for jobbet: 8236fortrolig@sogn.dk.

I emnefeltet bedes du skrive: ”Gravermedhjælper”

Ansøgningsfrist er d. 04/10-2026 kl. 12:00. Vi forventer af afholde samtaler i uge 42 eller 43.

Opstart ønskes hurtigst muligt herefter.

Nærmere oplysninger om stillingen kan fås ved henvendelse til personaleansvarlig Jens Sloth Tlf. 40431176.

Vi ser frem til at modtage din ansøgning.

title: Butiksmedhjælper ca. 7t om ugen

title: Pediatric Dental Associate
description:
🦷 General Dentist – Join a High-Growth, Patient-First Team! | Jefferson Dental and Orthodontics


📍 Location: San Antonio, TX

💼 Employment Type: Full-Time


Jefferson Dental & Orthodontics is looking for a General Dentist with a strong interest in treating children and families to join our growing San Antonio team.

This is an excellent opportunity for a General Dentist who enjoys working with pediatric patients and wants to build a practice that serves children, families, and the broader community. Our high patient volume means you can focus on providing great care without the pressure of building your own patient base.

At Jefferson Dental & Orthodontics, our mission is simple: provide high-quality, affordable dental care to the communities that need it most.

🚀 Why Join Jefferson Dental?

We’re a mission-driven organization committed to expanding access to quality dental care. Our San Antonio clinics provide a steady flow of patients, modern technology, and strong operational and clinical support so our dentists can focus on delivering exceptional care.

If you enjoy working with children, educating parents, and helping young patients develop healthy habits early, this is an opportunity to make a lasting impact.

👧 Pediatric Dentistry Opportunity

  • Treat a strong and growing population of pediatric patients
  • Provide preventive, restorative, and comprehensive dental care for children
  • Build lasting relationships with young patients and their families
  • Educate parents and children on proper oral hygiene and preventative care
  • Work alongside experienced dental assistants, hygienists, and specialists
  • Opportunity to grow your pediatric patient base while continuing to practice comprehensive general dentistry
  • Supportive environment for dentists who want to further develop their skills working with pediatric patients

💰 What You’ll Get

  • Highly competitive compensation with daily guarantee + tiered production
  • Sign-on bonus opportunities
  • Robust patient volume with a schedule that stays full
  • Clinical autonomy with strong operational support
  • Modern, fully equipped offices with digital X-rays and advanced technology
  • Paid CE and mentorship opportunities
  • Full benefits package including Medical, Dental, Vision, 401(k), and PTO

🦷 Your Role

  • Provide comprehensive dental care to children, adolescents, and adults
  • Perform pediatric preventive and restorative procedures
  • Conduct exams, diagnosis, and treatment planning
  • Provide general dentistry procedures including restorative care, extractions, and preventive treatment
  • Educate children and parents on oral health and treatment options
  • Create a positive, comfortable dental experience for young patients
  • Collaborate with hygienists, assistants, and specialists to provide comprehensive care
  • Maintain accurate patient records and uphold clinical standards

🎯 What We’re Looking For

  • DDS or DMD degree from an accredited dental school
  • Active Texas dental license or ability to obtain one
  • Strong interest or experience in pediatric dentistry is highly preferred
  • Comfortable treating children and working with parents and families
  • Strong clinical skills and patient-first mindset
  • Excellent communication and bedside manner
  • Desire to work in a fast-paced, team-oriented environment

🌟 What Makes Jefferson Dental Different?

  • High pediatric and family patient demand—you won’t have to build your own schedule
  • Opportunity to make a meaningful impact on children's oral health
  • Supportive clinical environment with experienced team members
  • Strong earning potential with a steady flow of patients
  • Paid CE, mentorship, and opportunities for professional growth
  • Clear career paths into leadership, mentorship, or specialty-focused roles
  • A mission-driven organization focused on increasing access to affordable dental care

📣 Ready to Make a Difference?

If you’re a General Dentist who loves working with children, wants a full schedule, and is looking for strong earning potential and long-term career growth, we want to hear from you!

Join Jefferson Dental & Orthodontics and help create healthy smiles that last a lifetime—starting with our youngest patients.

👉 Apply today and take the next step in your dental career!

title: Budbilschaufför
description:
Är du en person som värdesätter flexibilitet och ansvarstagande samtidigt som du har en fallenhet för ordning och reda? Är du dessutom en bilentusiast som alltid strävar efter att erbjuda den bästa servicen? Då har vi det perfekta jobbet för dig!


Vilka är Måltidsfabriken?

Måltidsfabriken AB är ett företag som idag erbjuder måltidsservice till offentlig sektor och privata företag. Med verksamhet etablerad i 18 orter runt om i Sverige befinner vi oss i en mycket expansiv fas. Vårt företag utför främst måltidstransporter åt kommuner där vi har regelbundna transporter som kräver en hög grad av självständighet och eget ansvar.

Vi söker nu efter en person som vill vara en del av vårt team och utföra dessa transporter på ett noggrant och effektivt sätt. Du kommer att spela en avgörande roll i att säkerställa högsta kvalitet i våra leveranser och följa ett schema anpassat efter våra kunders behov. Erfarenhet av måltidsleveranser är meriterande men inget krav.


Vi söker en kandidat som uppfyller följande krav:

  • Ansvarstagande och plikttrogen med en stark arbetsmoral och förmåga att utföra uppgifter till högsta standard.
  • Har en förmåga för att hantera flera bollar samtidigt och trivs med att lösa utmaningar.
  • Drivs av att arbeta i högt tempo och trivs med en dynamisk arbetsmiljö.
  • Följer processer och rutiner noggrant och effektivt för att säkerställa en smidig verksamhet.
  • Flexibel för att hantera förändringar och snabbt anpassa sig till nya situationer.
  • Fysiskt kapabel med förmågan att hantera tunga lyft om det behövs.
  • Innehavare av ett giltigt B-körkort för manuell växellåda.


Detta är en deltidstjänst på ca 50%

Vi söker någon som är flexibel, pålitlig och ansvarsfull, och som alltid sätter kunden i första hand. Om du tror att du är rätt person för denna position och vill vara en del av vårt team, tveka inte att skicka in din ansökan!

title: Erfaren forretningspartner til digital udvikling
description:
Kan du bevæge dig sikkert mellem strategisk rådgivning og konkret eksekvering?

Digitalisering spiller en stadig større rolle i udviklingen af HOFORs forretning og evne til at skabe værdi for kunderne, samfundet og organisationen. Vi søger derfor en erfaren og forretningsorienteret digital forretningspartner, der kan arbejde strategisk med vores fagområder og tage medejerskab for den digitale udvikling og transformation.

Understøttelse af udvikling og implementering af digitale initiativer
Som vores nye forretningspartner opbygger du en solid forståelse for fagområdets strategi, mål og udfordringer. Du identificerer digitale muligheder, omsætter behov til konkrete handlingsplaner og følger initiativerne fra idé til implementering og gevinstrealisering. Samtidig sikrer du de rette involveringer, skaber overblik over prioriteringer og hjælper med at sætte retning for løsninger og udviklingsindsatser på tværs af forretning og udviklingsteams.

Dine opgaver bliver at:

  • Rådgive ledere og nøglepersoner om digitale muligheder og omsætte strategi, mål og udfordringer til klare prioriteringer
  • Udfordre og kvalificere behov, løsninger og arbejdsgange med fokus på effekt, forretningsværdi og gennemførlighed
  • Udarbejde beslutningsgrundlag, business cases og anbefalinger, der gør det tydeligt, hvad der skal prioriteres og hvorfor
  • Drive digitale handlingsplaner og udviklingsforløb fra idé og behov til implementeret løsning og realiseret værdi
  • Skabe overblik og fremdrift i fagområdets digitale pipeline og sikre sammenhæng med strategi, arkitektur, sikkerhed og governance
  • Lede tværgående processer og projekter med mange interessenter, herunder facilitere workshops, prioritere backlog og følge op på fremdrift, risici og gevinster

Erfaring med strategisk rådgivning
Du har erfaring fra et konsulenthus, en strategifunktion eller som forretningsudvikler i en større organisation med komplekse udviklings- og digitaliseringsopgaver. Det vigtigste er dog, at du kan dokumentere, hvordan du har skabt retning, fremdrift og resultater i praksis.

Du tager tydeligt ansvar for fremdrift og kan skabe retning i situationer, hvor behov, roller og løsninger endnu ikke er fuldt afklarede. Du kan udfordre ledelsen konstruktivt og samtidig opbygge den tillid og opbakning, der er nødvendig for at gennemføre forandringer.

Derudover forestiller vi os, at du:

  • Har solid erfaring med strategisk rådgivning, digitalisering, management consulting eller forretningsudvikling
  • Har erfaring med at rådgive ledere og udarbejde beslutningsgrundlag på strategisk og taktisk niveau
  • Har forståelse for IT, data og digitale løsninger uden nødvendigvis at være teknisk specialist
  • Har projektlederegenskaber og kan sikre fremdrift i tværgående initiativer med mange interessenter og afhængigheder
  • Kan vurdere initiativer ud fra forretningsværdi, økonomi, risici og organisatoriske konsekvenser
  • Skaber gode relationer, følgeskab og resultater uden nødvendigvis at have formelt ledelsesansvar

Dine dygtige kolleger er klar til at byde dig velkommen
Du bliver en del af teamet Partnere & LCM, som består af dygtige specialister, der hjælper forretningen på den digitale rejse, med bred viden inden for Lifecycle Management, forandringsledelse og procesudvikling. Derudover bliver du også en del af et større Digitaliseringsområde med mere end 180 medarbejdere, der spænder bredt fra IT-sikkerhed og arkitektur til SRO og datamanagement.

Vi har et fleksibelt arbejdsmiljø og giver plads og mulighed for hjemmearbejde efter aftale med nærmeste leder. Hos os er der plads til dig, og til at du har et bæredygtigt arbejdsliv.

Du kan læse mere om vores medarbejdergoder her.

Sådan bliver du vores kollega
Er du klar til nye muligheder, så ser vi frem til at høre fra dig senest den 2. oktober. Vi vil gerne gøre det nemt for dig at søge vores stilling, du skal derfor ikke skrive en ansøgning, men blot sende dit CV, hvor du sætter nogle ord på din motivation for at søge stillingen**.** Du kan finde inspiration til at skrive et motiveret CV her.

Vi afholder 1. samtale i uge 43 og 2. samtale i uge 44.

Har du spørgsmål til jobbet, er du velkommen til at kontakte ansættende leder Fatima Højby Kvist Nedergaard på tlf. 3445 8410.

Søg stillingen ved at klikke på ”Søg stillingen”.

Hos os får du plads

title: Academic Partnerships & Research Lead
description:
Qube Research & Technologies (QRT) is a global quantitative and systematic investment manager, operating in all liquid asset classes across the world. We are a technology and data driven group implementing a scientific approach to investing. Combining data, research, technology, and trading expertise has shaped QRT’s collaborative mindset which enables us to solve the most complex challenges. QRT’s culture of innovation continuously drives our ambition to deliver high quality returns for our investors.

Join QRT Academy as an Academic Partnerships & Research Lead in Hong Kong, working at the interface between academia and industry. QRT Academy connects leading research communities and talent with QRT through academic collaborations and research engagement initiatives. In this role, you will lead the development of QRT’s academic collaborations, working directly with leading institutions and research groups globally to shape and contribute to research projects and collaboration opportunities.

Your future role at QRT:

  • Lead the design and delivery of engagement programmes with academic partner institutions, including research collaborations, visiting practitioner initiatives, and student programmes
  • Collaborate directly with academic partners on research projects, including contributing to research direction, publications, and conference engagement
  • Build and develop long-term partnerships with leading academics, departments, and research groups across priority institutions
  • Act as a primary point of contact for partner institutions, collaborating closely with academics and researchers to shape collaboration opportunities
  • Identify and engage high-potential students and early-career researchers through academic programmes and networks
  • Develop and scale the model for academic partnerships across institutions and regions
  • Ensure alignment between academic engagement activities and broader research and talent objectives
  • Work closely with internal teams to connect academic collaborations with QRT’s research priorities
  • Partner with the operations function to support effective delivery of programmes, maintaining focus on academic content and relationships

Your present skillset:

  • PhD in a quantitative discipline (mathematics, statistics, computer science, engineering or related field) with a strong research background
  • Experience managing or contributing to academic collaborations, research programmes, or university partnerships
  • Strong stakeholder management skills, with the ability to engage effectively with senior academics and researchers
  • Strong understanding of how leading research institutions structure external collaborations
  • Ability to shape and manage complex academic partnerships across institutions and regions
  • Strong organisational and problem-solving skills, with the ability to operate in evolving or ambiguous environments
  • Experience working in globally distributed or research-intensive environments is advantageous
  • Strong engagement with research and the academic ecosystem

QRT is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome diversity as essential to our success. QRT empowers employees to work openly and respectfully to achieve collective success. In addition to professional achievement, we are offering initiatives and programs to enable employees achieve a healthy work-life balance.

title: Reservations Agent - Remote (German & English Speaking) (m/f/d)
description:
ABOUT NUMA

Hey there! We’re Numa, a forward-thinking hospitality brand redefining how people discover cities. We create spaces where simplicity meets innovation, offering thoughtfully designed rooms, studios, and apartments in the heart of Europe’s most vibrant neighbourhoods.
We’re not just transforming the guest experience—we’re revolutionizing the hospitality industry from the inside out. Our cutting-edge technology streamlines operations, delivering unparalleled value with no hidden fees—just real, quality experiences.
At Numa, we believe that travel should be curious and authentic, and we bring those same values to our work culture. As part of our team, you’ll experience a dynamic and supportive environment where creativity thrives, and your contributions make a real impact. About the Role

As a Reservations Agent, you will be part of our team supporting corporate clients, group bookings, and individual requests. You’ll handle enquiries primarily via email and phone, ensuring a smooth and professional booking process. Your key responsibilities:
● Handle incoming corporate and group enquiries via email and phone in a timely and professional manner
● Create and send tailored offers using our online quotation tools

● Liaise closely with Guest Support, Operations, Revenue Management, and Finance to ensure consistent and accurate information flow

Our ideal candidate has:

ABOUT OUR OFFER

Numa values the diversity of the people it hires and serves. For more information on the processing of your personal data, please see our Privacy Notice.

title: Member Service Representative
description:
Join the Mountainside Fitness Team

About the Role


We’re looking for a friendly, energetic, and motivated individual to join our team as a Member Service Representative at Mountainside Fitness— an upscale health club where members and employees feel welcomed, valued, and supported. As a Member Service Representative, you’ll be one of the first faces our members and guests see, creating a welcoming atmosphere while providing outstanding customer service. You’ll assist with member needs, answer questions, give tours, promote memberships and club services, and confidently identify sales opportunities. If you’re personable, goal-driven, and enjoy connecting with people while helping them reach their fitness goals,


Why Mountainside Fitness? It's more than just a job in Fitness.

We invest in our people. Here's what you can expect as part of the Mountainside family:

  • Complimentary gym membership plus deep personal training discounts
  • Onsite childcare — bring your own kids to work with you
  • Consistent schedules that stay the same week to week — no surprises
  • Flexible pay for hourly employees — access your earnings when you need them
  • Real growth opportunities — 100% of our General Managers were promoted from within


RESPONSIBILITIES & DUTIES — SALES SPECIFIC


Data & Prospect Management

  • Enter data accurately and effectively into the computer system.
  • Tour, contact, and enter every prospect into the system. Maintain communication with prospects until the sale is complete.
  • Document all customer communication in Hub Spot and record follow-ups to verify contact. MSRs will use the company phone for all outreach.


Sales Performance Standards

  • The MSR role at Mountainside Fitness is competitive. Schedules, goals, and performance metrics change monthly — MSRs must consistently meet sales criteria. Performance is measured across:
  • Number of sales per pay period.
  • Prospect-to-sales closing ratios.
  • Training Package sales.
  • Meeting or exceeding monthly sales goals: BE, Income, Personal Training, and other stated goals.
  • Performance during Secret Shopper visits.
  • Number of self-generated prospects — employee's ability to drive traffic into the club.
  • Availability, dependability, and ability to improve the sales team at their specific location.


Closing Ratio Requirement: MSRs are expected to maintain a 70% or higher closing ratio. Example — if you tour 10 prospects, 7 should be sold. Ratios are calculated on a monthly basis only. Example: In August, Johnny Membership sold 20 memberships and had 30 outstanding prospects — a closing ratio of 67%. Four consecutive pay periods below the 70% minimum will result in progressive discipline, which may include suspension, loss of sales shifts, or termination.

  • Sales goals are set monthly by the club manager or District Manager. Total sales per period compared to the sales goal is the primary measure of sales performance.
  • MSRs are expected to sell Personal Training at a rate of 15% of their sole BEs.


Secret Shopper & Professionalism

  • Clubs and MSRs will be visited sporadically by corporate Secret Shopper personnel. MSRs are expected to perform professionally, remain service-minded, and express the desire to start the guest on a membership that same day.
  • MSRs are expected to work honestly and fairly with the sales staff and be available to pick up additional shifts when needed.


Training & Development

  • MSRs are expected to attend MSF-sponsored continuing education and sales technique improvement sessions at least once per quarter.
  • MSRs are expected to initiate a monthly tour with their GM or DM. The tour will include role play, closing techniques, and sales methods such as "Discovering the Prospect."

title: Consultant, Policy and Market Reform
description:
About Baringa

Baringa is a global consulting firm that partners with leaders to drive change and create value. With deep industry expertise, and enabled by advanced technology, the firm helps clients to deliver with greater confidence and certainty. With over 2,000 people across the UK, Europe, North America, Asia and Australia, the firm combines global insight with local understanding.

The firm works across energy and resources, financial services, government and public sector, consumer products and retail, pharmaceuticals and life sciences, manufacturing, and technology, media and telecoms, with capabilities spanning strategy, transformation and operational excellence – all powered by advanced technology, data, AI and digital innovation.

Clients value Baringa’s collaborative approach and the way its teams integrate seamlessly – all working with a shared understanding of what matters most. The firm is known for its kind, curious experts who listen closely and care deeply about client success as they help clients transform energy markets, modernise financial platforms, expand telecoms and digital networks through advanced data analytics, enable digital services in government, and unlock growth in consumer sectors.

Certified as a Great Place to Work around the world, Baringa has been recognised by the Financial Times in 22 categories of its UK Leading Management Consultants rankings, and by Forbes for four consecutive years as one of the World’s Best Management Consulting Firms.

Our Policy and Economics practice is looking for an experienced Consultant or Senior Consultant to join the team.

We support clients from policy development to delivery and capital deployment, from regulatory strategies to business case submissions, and from competition cases to expert opinion. Our economists, policy specialists, regulatory experts and techno-economic modellers work alongside governments, regulators, investors and corporates — shaping regulatory and policy frameworks, as well as decisions, which underpin multi-billion-pound investment across energy, utilities and wider infrastructure.

What you will be doing

  • Apply economic reasoning and quantitative analysis to assess the impact of policy and regulatory changes on energy markets, investors, consumers and other market participants.
  • Develop robust analytical models and evidence-based insights to inform client decision-making on complex policy and market issues.
  • Translate technical analysis into clear, compelling and commercially relevant recommendations for clients.
  • Produce high-quality written outputs, including reports, presentations and briefing materials for senior client stakeholders.
  • Contribute to business development activities, including proposal writing, discussions on client propositions, and the development of new service offerings.
  • Build trusted relationships with clients and support the delivery of projects from inception through to final recommendations.
  • Contribute to internal initiatives that strengthen the team's capabilities, analytical tools, intellectual property and market profile.
  • Stay abreast of emerging policy, regulatory and market developments, identifying implications for clients and opportunities for new work.


Your skills and experience

  • You will have 3-7 years' experience in consulting, government, industry or a similar analytical role, with a focus on energy markets, policy or economics.
  • You've conducted policy, regulatory or economic analysis and can demonstrate how your work has influenced business, investment or policy decisions.
  • You will have experience using quantitative analysis, economic modelling or data analysis techniques to evaluate market or policy outcomes.
  • You've produced high-quality written reports, presentations or consultation responses, translating complex analysis into clear and persuasive recommendations.
  • You have a good understanding of energy markets and structures, underpinning policy and emerging trends.
  • You've worked with clients or senior stakeholders to scope problems, communicate findings and deliver analytical projects to deadlines.

What a career at Baringa will give you


Putting People First.

Baringa is a People First company and wellbeing is at the forefront of our culture. We recognise the importance of work-life balance and flexible working and provide our staff amazing benefits. Some of these benefits include:

  • Generous Annual Leave Policy: We recognise everyone needs a well-deserved break. We provide our employees with 5 weeks of annual leave, fully available at the start of each year. In addition to this, we have introduced our 5-Year Recharge benefit which allows all employees an additional 2 weeks of paid leave after 5 years continuous service.
  • Flexible Working: We know that the ‘ideal’ work-life balance will vary from person to person and change at different stages of our working lives. To accommodate this, we have implemented a hybrid working policy and introduced more flexibility around taking unpaid leave.
  • Corporate Responsibility Days: Our world is important to us, so all our employees get 3 every year to help social and environmental causes and increase our impact on the communities that mean the most to us.
  • Wellbeing Fund: We want to encourage all employees to take charge and prioritise their own wellbeing. We’ve introduced our annual People Fund to support this by offering every individual a fund to support and manage their wellbeing through an activity of their choice.
  • Profit Share Scheme: All employees participate in the Baringa Group Profit Share Scheme so everyone has a stake in the company’s success.

Diversity and Inclusion

We are proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We believe that creating an environment where everyone feels a sense of belonging is central to our culture and that diversity is paramount to driving creativity, innovation, and value for our clients and for our people.

An award-winning workplace

You can be a part of our ‘Great Place to Work’ – with our commitment to women and well-being in the workplace for all. Click here to see some of our recent awards and how we’ve achieved this.

Using business as a force for good.

We maintain high standards of environmental performance and transparency, which can be seen through our commitment to Net Zero with our SBTI-verified Scope 1, 2 and 3 emissions reduction targets and our support of the Better Business Act. We report our progress publicly and ensure that we are also externally assessed and scored through organisations like CDP and EcoVadis - helping us to continually identify where we can improve.

We have a long legacy of supporting the communities in which we work, and offer a variety of ways to contribute, by putting people first and creating impact that lasts. Our Corporate Social Responsibility (CSR) agenda is about giving back to the communities in which we live and work by sharing our skills, talent and time. In essence, we aim to empower and encourage everyone in the firm to contribute to the things we care about, and support registered charities and organisations with a clear social or environmental purpose to increase the positive impact they can have.

Join us

All applications received will be reviewed by a member of our Talent Acquisition team. We never rely solely on automated screening or AI tools to make hiring decisions. Your application will be considered for employment without regard to race, ethnicity, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, nationality, disability, age, faith or social background. We do not filter applications by university background and encourage those who have taken alternative educational and career paths to apply. We would like to actively encourage applications from those who identify with less represented and minority groups. We operate an inclusive recruitment process, ensuring reasonable adjustments where needed. Please contact a member of our Recruitment Team to discuss further.

Baringa Privacy Notices

For UK & EU

Your personal data will be retained by Baringa for up to two years, in accordance with our UK Recruitment Privacy Notice / EU Recruitment Privacy Notice, to evaluate your application and meet our legal and reporting obligations. In line with the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR), you have the right to request access to, rectification, or erasure (subject to legal limitations) of your personal data. For more information, please contact us at privacy@baringa.com

For the USA

Your personal data may be retained by Baringa for up to two years, as outlined in our Recruitment Privacy Notice (AMER & APAC), to support the recruitment process and internal reporting requirements. Where applicable, and in accordance with relevant federal and state laws, you may have the right to request access to or correction of your personal information. For further details, please contact privacy@baringa.com

For Australia & Singapore

Your personal data will be retained by Baringa for up to two years, in accordance with our Recruitment Privacy Notice (AMER & APAC), to assess your application and meet applicable reporting and legal obligations. In line with the Australian Privacy Act and Singapore’s Personal Data Protection Act (PDPA), you may have rights to access, correct, or request limited deletion of your personal data. For more information, please contact us at privacy@baringa.com

title: Principal Engineer, Growth Mega Alliance (all genders)
description:
The Role

The Growth Mega Alliance (GMA) builds the platforms that power how HelloFresh acquires, converts, and retains customers across 18 markets and multiple brands, across five pillars: AdTech, Conversions, Payments, Communications, and Customer Value Optimization (CVO).

As Principal Engineer, you are the technical visionary for these platforms. You define architectural direction across all five pillars, lead the most consequential cross-cutting initiatives, and raise the technical bar for the entire organization. This is a hands-on leadership role - you code, review, and design alongside the senior and staff engineers who look to you as the technical lead.

What You'll Do

GenAI & Agentic Engineering Leadership

  • Own GMA's GenAI strategy: identify the highest-leverage opportunities across all five pillars where AI/ML unlocks step-change outcomes, for both engineering productivity and customer-facing capabilities.
  • Establish agentic development workflows — where specs drive AI-assisted code generation — and scale them from early adopters to standard practice. Build the guardrails and reference architectures that enable squads to work AI-natively.
  • Develop and articulate a clear point of view on how engineering teams need to evolve in skills, process, and culture to realize the gains that agentic tools make possible.

Growth Platform Architecture

  • Own the long-term technical architecture across GMA's five pillars: real-time personalization, experimentation at scale, AI/ML-driven automation, and cross-pillar data integrity.
  • Lead the most complex architectural decisions (shared identity schemas, experiment assignment, AdTech-to-Conversions signal loops, payment authorization flows) and drive migrations with large impact.
  • Ensure GMA platforms integrate cleanly with internal infrastructure and meet reliability, latency, and observability requirements at a global scale.

Experimentation & Personalization

  • Define GMA's experimentation strategy and execution framework to optimize experimentation-based decision-making at scale.
  • Own the data path from customer event to business decision: instrumentation standards, identity resolution, attribution windows, and signal quality.

Technical Strategy & Cross-Alliance Collaboration

  • Define GMA's multi-year technical vision and communicate it with the precision engineers need and the clarity executives can act on. Represent GMA in company-wide programs.
  • Partner with Intelligent Platforms, Consumer, and Operations Mega Alliances to drive shared architectural standards and prevent fragmentation.

Mentorship & Engineering Culture

  • Coach and grow Staff and Senior Engineers across all five pillars. Foster engineering excellence through rigorous design review, strong observability practice, and honest post-incident learning.
  • Champion AI-native development workflows, TDD, DDD, and DevSecOps. Set the written communication standard through your design docs and architectural decision records.

What You'll Bring

GenAI & Agentic Engineering

  • Practical, hands-on experience with AI coding agents (e.g., Claude Code, Cursor, GitHub Copilot, OpenCode) in production or near-production environments — not just experimentation.
  • Experience integrating GenAI into customer-facing products or internal business processes at scale, with a clear point of view on the team and cultural changes required to realize the productivity gains.

Growth Domain Expertise

  • Deep familiarity with at least two of: AdTech / paid media infrastructure, funnel optimization, payment orchestration, CRM and lifecycle communications, or pricing and incentive optimization.
  • Fluent in growth domain constraints: PSP behavior, consent and privacy requirements across markets, deliverability limits, attribution windows, and incrementality measurement. Experience in a multi-market subscription or e-commerce business preferred.

Technical Depth

  • ~10+ years in software engineering, with ~5+ years at principal level in a high-growth, cloud-native environment.
  • Expert in distributed systems, microservices, and event-driven patterns (Kafka). Deep AWS experience. Strong proficiency in Go, Kotlin, Python, or TypeScript.
  • Track record of designing and operating large-scale, multi-region systems. Comfortable doing hands-on architectural reviews and solving critical bottlenecks directly.
  • Working knowledge of experimentation design and analysis; able to work directly with data (SQL, BI tooling) and trace the full signal chain from instrumentation to business metric.

Ways of Working

  • Exceptional written communication — your documents make complexity smaller, not larger.
  • Able to influence without authority; direct, low-ego, and comfortable disagreeing with senior stakeholders while keeping the relationship intact.
  • Fluent English. German is a bonus.

What Success Looks Like

3 months — You have mapped GMA's critical architectural dependencies and GenAI opportunities, conducted design reviews across multiple pillars, and established a point of view on the highest-leverage technical bets for the year.

6 months — Your architectural direction is reflected in roadmaps. GMA's first AI-native workflows are in production. At least one cross-pillar initiative is running under your technical ownership with clear instrumentation.

12 months — GMA's platforms are measurably more scalable, observable, and AI-capable. Engineering standards are set and followed. You are the person leaders across HelloTech bring their hardest growth-engineering problems to.

Why Work With Us

  • Make an Impact: GMA's platforms touch every customer HelloFresh acquires and every euro it collects. Your decisions move top-line numbers at a company that has changed the way millions of people eat.
  • Real Scope: You own technical direction, make consequential architectural calls, and ship things that matter — at a scale that makes the problems genuinely hard.
  • AI at the Frontier: You will have the mandate, resources, and organizational support to lead AI-native engineering transformation — not advocate for it from the sidelines.
  • Direct Access: You work daily with engineering, product, and business leadership, with the visibility and accountability that implies.
  • Learn & Grow: Annual learning budget, HelloFresh Academy, and internal mobility across a large, technically ambitious engineering organization.

title: Peruskoulun päätoiminen tuntiopettaja luokanopetukseen, Kantokasken koulu
description:
Kantokasken koulu on metsän siimeksessä sijaitseva espoolainen alakoulu, jossa kasvaa ja oppii 309 lasta. Etsimme iloiseen joukkoomme luokanopettajan sijaista ajalle 19.10.2026-14.3.2027. Tehtävä jatkuu tästä mahdollisesti kevään loppuun. Opetettavana on 4.luokka.

Koulumme kasvatusajatus pohjautuu positiiviseen ihmiskäsitykseen ja aitoon vuorovaikutukseen ja kohtaamiseen.

Koulun nimi ja osoite: Kantokasken koulu, Kaskisavu 4, 02340 Espoo
Työaika: OVTES:in mukainen.
Haettava tehtävä on määräaikainen.
Palvelussuhde alkaa 19.10.2026
Tämä työpaikka on esteetön.
Palkka: OVTES:in mukainen. Hinnoittelutunnuksen mukainen peruspalkka määräytyy henkilön koulutuksen perusteella.
Tehtäväänsä kelpoiselle luokanopettajalle (vain luokanopettajan kelpoisuus) maksetaan hinnoittelutunnuksen mukaisen peruspalkan lisäksi työn vaativuuteen perustuvaa lisää. Hinnoittelutunnuksen mukaiset peruspalkat https://www.kt.fi/sopimukset/ovtes/palkat-palkkiot

Kelpoisuusvaatimus: Peruskoulun luokanopettajan kelpoisuus.

Opettajan kelpoisuudet määräytyvät opetustoimen henkilöstön kelpoisuusvaatimuksista annetun asetuksen no 986/98 mukaisesti. Asetuksen 9 §:n mukaisesti perusopetusta antavalla opettajalla tulee olla suomen kielen erinomainen suullinen ja kirjallinen taito.

Määräaikaisissa tehtävissä huomioimme myös ei-kelpoiset hakijat.

Tehtävässä edellytetään hyvää ryhmänhallintakykyä ja positiivista mieltä.

Tehtävään valittavan on esitettävä nähtäväksi rikosrekisterilain 6.2 §:n tarkoittama rikosrekisteriote.

Arvostamme kokemusta opettajan tehtävästä.

Edelläkävijöiden Espoo - rohkeus uudistaa, taito kehittää

Espoo on edelläkävijöiden kaupunki. Työnantajalupauksemme - rohkeus uudistaa, taito kehittää - näkyy arjessamme sujuvana työnä, osaamisen pitkäjänteisenä kehittämisenä ja fiksuna johtamisena. Rakennamme yhdessä kaupunkia, jossa työn merkitys on selkeä ja asiantuntijuutta arvostetaan.

Tuemme ammatillista oppimistasi ja kehittymistäsi sekä työn ja muun elämän yhteensovittamista joustavilla käytännöillä.

title: Maskinfører til maskindrift og GPS i Holmegaard
description:
Er du maskinfører og vil du arbejde med maskindrift og GPS?

Vi mangler en erfaren maskinfører i Holmegaard til fast arbejde.

Du lander i en virksomhed, hvor skiltning, folie, print og visuelle løsninger fylder hverdagen. Kunderne er især erhverv, så præcision og aftaler betyder noget hele vejen igennem. Arbejdet ligger i Holmegaard og omegn, og du bliver en del af et større setup med flere funktioner omkring produktionen. Der er brug for en maskinfører, der kan tage ansvar, når maskinen skal køre rigtigt første gang.

Det særlige her er kombinationen af maskindrift og GPS. Du skal kunne læse opgaven, styre maskinen sikkert og sige til, hvis noget ikke stemmer. Der er ikke pyntet på kravene - vi leder efter en erfaren maskinfører, der har prøvet mere end de nemme dage.

Det får du

Løn: 150-200 kr. i timen

Arbejdsområde: Holmegaard og omegn

Overenskomst: Ansat under gældende overenskomst

Ansættelse: Fastansættelse - vi søger folk, vi kan arbejde med i mange år. Ingen korte forløb.

Hverdag: Maskindrift, GPS og præcision

Din hverdag

Hverdagen handler om maskindrift, GPS og at holde opgaverne i gang uden slinger. Du arbejder med de oplysninger du får på opgaven, kontrollerer at maskinen og GPS'en spiller, og melder hurtigt tilbage hvis noget ikke stemmer.

Du kommer blandt andet til at arbejde med:

  • Arbejder med maskindrift og GPS
  • Betjener maskiner sikkert og stabilt gennem dagen
  • Kontrollerer indstillinger, retning og præcision under arbejdet
  • Siger til, hvis maskinen, GPS'en eller opgaven ikke stemmer
  • Holder tempo uden at gå på kompromis med sikkerheden

Når noget ændrer sig undervejs, er det dig der reagerer i tide. Aftaler og deadlines betyder noget her, så du skal kunne holde hovedet koldt og få meldt tingene videre.

Vi leder efter dig, der kan sætte kryds ved det meste

Du skal ikke være ekspert i hvert eneste hjørne af faget. Men du skal kunne stå inde for det du afleverer.

Vi forestiller os, at du:

  • Har mindst 5 års erfaring som maskinfører
  • Har kørekort
  • Kan arbejde sikkert med maskindrift og GPS
  • Møder stabilt og holder dine aftaler
  • Siger til, hvis noget ikke stemmer

Det er en fordel, hvis du har arbejdet med GPS-styring før. Men det vigtigste er, at du kan tage ansvar for maskinen og arbejde sikkert.

Allerede i job?

Så skal det selvfølgelig give mening at skifte.

Derfor starter vi med en uforpligtende snak. Du kan høre mere om opgaverne, virksomheden, lønnen og hverdagen, før du beslutter noget. Og ja, det foregår diskret.

Hvis det her lyder som noget for dig, kan du starte Hurtigst muligt.

Du behøver ikke sende en lang ansøgning. Tryk på Ansøg job, så ringer vi dig op og tager den derfra.

Om PowerMatch

Hos PowerMatch matcher vi dig kun med job, der lever op til dine krav på løn, opgaver, kultur, firmabil og hvad der ellers betyder noget for dig.

Du starter direkte ude i virksomheden. Vi arbejder kun med forløb, hvor målet er fastansættelse. Ikke korte vikariater.

Hvis jobbet ikke viser sig at være det rigtige match, hjælper vi dig videre til noget, der passer bedre.

PowerMatch har 5 stjerner på Trustpilot baseret på 500+ anmeldelser fra håndværkere og fagfolk som dig.

Du optjener point hos PowerMatch, som du kan bruge på 1000+ forskellige gavekort som f.eks Circle K, Elgiganten og oplevelser.

Du får gratis Wolt+, WashWorld og Tv2Play abonnementer.

Du får ét ugentlig spin på vores app, hvor du kan vinde alt fra rejser til elektronik.

Søg uden lang ansøgning

Du behøver ikke skrive en roman.

Tryk Ansøg job, så ringer vi dig op til en kort og uforpligtende snak.

Passer jobbet til dig, går vi videre. Passer det ikke, prøver vi at finde et bedre match.

title: Hygiene Assistant (Nguru)
description:
Company Overview
Action Against Hunger is an international humanitarian organization committed to ending world hunger. For almost 45 years, across countries, we have been working to fight undernutrition and support communities affected by crisis across the globe.

We carry out innovative, lifesaving programs in Health, Nutrition, Water, Sanitation and Hygiene, Mental Health and Psychosocial Support, Food Security and Livelihoods, and Social Protection.

Action Against Hunger began operations in Nigeria in 2010 in response to the high rate of chronic malnutrition in Northern Nigeria, focusing on integrated programming. Action Against Hunger currently implements multi-sectoral humanitarian and development interventions in Northeast and Northwest Nigeria, funded by AFD, EU/ECHO, French Government, GAC, SIDA, US Government, and GIZ.

Action Against Hunger Nigeria (ACF Nigeria) Ltd/Gte is currently recruiting a Hygiene Assistant based in Yobe. The successful candidate will support the implementation of hygiene promotion activities and the distribution of non-food items (NFIs) to affected populations.


Position Details

Reporting to: Hygiene Officer

Proposed start date: October 2026

Work location: Nguru, Yobe State



KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Mission 1: Assist in context assessment and developing materials for hygiene promotion.

  • Conduct initial rapid needs assessment for affected communities and Health facilities
  • Assist in conducting home visits and visits to the community (schools, Health facilities, etc.) to identify gaps in terms of hygiene, sanitation and use of water.
  • Assist in preparing training modules for the promotion of hygiene practices at the household and community levels.
  • Assist in developing training tools adapted to different audiences using different approaches; songs, role games, meetings, training courses.
  • Assist in identifying targeted partners within the communities: schools, hospitals, clinics, etc.
  • Conduct household census to determine beneficiary population.

Mission 2: Carry out emergency safe hygiene promotion and mobilize members of the beneficiary communities and health facilities

  • Organize emergency hygiene promotion awareness raising sessions.
  • Mobilize communities and health facilities to adopt safe hygiene practices as promoted by the project (latrine construction, hand washing facilities, environmental cleanliness)
  • Assist in conducting training sessions for the community workers and/or targeted populations.
  • Conduct focus group discussion for Women and Girls to identify a location for the construction of WASH facilities
  • Write a weekly activity report.
  • Propose possible improvements.

Mission 3: Assist in carrying out shelter, hygiene and NFI kits distribution.

  • Assist in the process of beneficiary’s selection to receive NFI assistance.
  • Assist in beneficiary registration.
  • Assist in distributing shelter, Hygiene and NFI kits to registered beneficiaries.

Additional Responsibilities
  • This job description is not intended to be all inclusive and the employee will also perform other related tasks as required and responsible for reporting and communication of progress and achievement of the specific assigned task
  • Maintenance of high technical standards
  • Conduct all duties in a professional manner following ACF Nigeria mission staff regulations, ACF mandate and charter including promotion of gender equality

Position Requirements:
  • Minimum of National Diploma in Public Health or Health related field.
  • Experience in hygiene promotion or community mobilization an advantage.
  • Motivated, open, creative, mature, responsible, flexible, and culturally sensitive
  • Willing and able to be based and travel regularly within remote areas, where services are limited.
  • Fluency in Hausa and English.
  • Commitment to Action Against Hunger Nigeria’s mission, values, and policy
  • Good knowledge of the intervention area/s and local economy

At Action Against Hunger, we foster a work culture that champions diversity, equity and inclusion. We are committed to creating an environment where every employee feels valued, respected, and empowered to thrive

Application Deadline:
Thursday, 24 September, 2026 at 05:00 pm (Nigerian Time)

Important Notice:
Action Against Hunger does not charge any fee at any stage of the recruitment process – this includes application, interview, or processing fees.

Our Commitment:
We are dedicated to preventing all forms of unwanted behaviour in the workplace, including sexual harassment, exploitation and abuse, lack of integrity, and financial misconduct. We are equally committed to safeguarding the welfare of children, young people and adults. We prioritize hiring individuals who embody and uphold our core values.

En dag som Säljare i vår 3Butik

Det är starten på en ny dag. Du ser till att göra butiken i ordning för dagen, ser till att butiken är städad och fin, kollar försäljningsresultat och sätter därefter mål för dagen.
