Under dagen kommer du och din chef att gå igenom försäljning, kundnöjdhet, daglig drift och du kommer att få regelbunden coachning. Vem är du?

Vi tror att du är serviceinriktad och intresserad av försäljning. Som person är du relationsskapande och kommunikativ, och drivs av att arbeta mot mål. Vi ser också att du är ansvarstagande och en riktig buddy! Välkommen med din ansökan!

Att söka jobbet är enkelt och går snabbt, du behöver bara besvara några urvalsfrågor direkt i annonsen. Vi tar inte emot CV eller personligt brev, eftersom vi är mer intresserade av vem du är och vad du kan bidra med, än vad du gjort tidigare.

Vi drivs av att hela tiden försöka göra saker bättre, på nya och annorlunda sätt. Vi ser oss själva som en avgörande del av Sveriges samhällsstruktur, eftersom vi vet att pålitlig uppkoppling är en viktig grundsten i dagens digitala värld.

title: Pædagog der ønsker gode vilkår
description:
Pædagog til Jægersborg Børnehus, afd. Solsiden – med fokus på relationer, leg og faglig udvikling

Vil du være med til at skabe en tryg og legende start på livet for fremtidens børn?

Vi søger en uddannet pædagog til vores vuggestue og børnehave, hvis fokus er, at skabe høj pædagogisk kvalitet gennem nærværende relationer, leg og stærke børnefællesskaber.

I vores børnehus arbejder vi med afsæt i Gentofte Kommunes vision for dagtilbud: "En tryg og legende start på livet – sammen skaber vi et godt børneliv med fællesskab og fordybelse." Vi ser pædagogisk omsorg og nærvær som fundamentet for børns trivsel, udvikling og læring.

Vi arbejder målrettet med udvikling af vores pædagogiske praksis med afsæt i KIDS. Det betyder, at vi sammen reflekterer over vores læringsmiljøer med fokus på relationer, børneperspektiver, leg, deltagelsesmuligheder og fællesskaber. Vi tror på, at faglig udvikling sker gennem nysgerrighed, sparring og et stærkt kollegialt samarbejde.

Jægersborg Børnehus består af 3 afdelinger og du bliver en del af Solsiden, der er et engageret børnehus med ca. 20 medarbejdere og en nærværende ledelse. Hos os hjælper vi hinanden, deler viden og skaber en hverdag præget af tillid, humor, arbejdsglæde og fælles ansvar.

Vi søger dig, der

  • er uddannet pædagog eller tilsvarende - og har lyst til at skabe en forskel
  • skaber trygge relationer og møder børn med omsorg, nærvær og faglig nysgerrighed.
  • har blik for børnenes perspektiver og understøtter deres deltagelse i fællesskaberne.
  • bidrager aktivt til faglig refleksion og udvikling af den pædagogiske praksis.
  • vægter et tæt og anerkendende samarbejde med forældrene.
  • trives i et fællesskab, hvor vi løfter i flok.

Hos os får du

  • Et fagligt stærkt og omsorgsfuldt arbejdsfællesskab.
  • Nærværende ledelse og engagerede kolleger.
  • Gode muligheder for efteruddannelse, kurser og kompetenceudvikling.
  • En dagtilbudsforvaltning der sikre gode arbejdsvilkår og vilkår
  • Mulighed for at udvikle praksis gennem faglig sparring og refleksion.
  • Inspirerende rammer, hvor naturen er en aktiv del af børnenes hverdag.

Har du lyst til at blive en del af vores vuggestueteam, glæder vi os til at høre fra dig. Du er også meget velkommen til at kontakte os for en rundvisning og en uforpligtende snak - bare giv mig et kald

title: SQA Engineer
description:
Who are we and why should you join us?

ConcertAI is building the future of precision medicine. We use advanced artificial intelligence and real-world data to transform how healthcare and life sciences generate evidence, make decisions, and improve patient outcomes—starting in oncology and rapidly expanding across therapeutic areas. Our teams partner with the world’s leading pharmaceutical companies, providers, and research organizations to solve some of healthcare’s most complex challenges.

At the core of our innovation is Cara, our next-generation AI platform that unlocks powerful insights from complex clinical, imaging, and molecular data. Combined with our Precision Suite—which unifies real-world data, advanced analytics, and scalable evidence generation—these solutions are transforming how clinical development, regulatory, and commercialization decisions are made.

ConcertAI brings together a portfolio of purpose-built solutions, including TeraRecon, an industry leader in advanced imaging and AI-driven visualization, and CancerLinQ, the ASCO-originated oncology platform advancing care quality and large-scale discovery.

Joining ConcertAI means working alongside bold thinkers, builders, and healthcare experts on innovative, high-impact products that directly improve patient lives. You’ll be part of a fast-growing, mission-driven organization at the forefront of AI-enabled healthcare, with meaningful opportunities for growth and leadership.

Position Overview

We are seeking a highly technical Software Quality Assurance Engineer with strong scripting skills and a solid software development background to support testing across a modern full-stack medical imaging ecosystem built on .NET, Blazor, SignalR, REST APIs, distributed microservices, and cloud-hosted backend systems.

This role is responsible for validating the reliability, performance, scalability, security, and data integrity of backend imaging workflows and UI-driven clinical applications. The ideal candidate has hands-on experience validating distributed systems, asynchronous workflows, real-time communication features, and high-volume data processing systems, with a strong automation-first mindset.

The ideal profile is a software developer who has transitioned into Software Quality Assurance or is interested in continuing a career in quality engineering with a strong technical and backend-oriented focus.

Key Responsibilities

  • Develop and maintain automated test suites for UI, APIs, backend services, asynchronous workflows, and distributed microservices using scripting languages or C#-based frameworks
  • Design and execute test plans covering full-stack workflows, including Blazor UI, REST APIs, SignalR real-time communication, and backend imaging services
  • Validate real-time features such as:
  • Study/series loading updates
  • Viewer synchronization
  • Notifications and workflow events
  • Validate asynchronous processing, concurrency handling, race conditions, and distributed transaction behaviors
  • Test backend business logic supporting study, series, and image metadata management
  • Validate database operations, schema changes, relational integrity, and backend data consistency across SQL Server, Postgres, and related storage systems
  • Test authentication and authorization flows including role-based access, JWT authentication, and identity systems
  • Evaluate system performance, scalability, concurrency behavior, and reliability under high-volume imaging workloads
  • Test cloud-hosted services, containerized applications, and distributed microservice interactions (AWS preferred)
  • Build and maintain test harnesses, mocks, utilities, and automation tools supporting backend and distributed system testing
  • Analyze backend logs, API traces, service interactions, and monitoring data to isolate defects and support troubleshooting
  • Validate logging, audit trails, monitoring behavior, and observability mechanisms in regulated healthcare environments
  • Integrate automated tests into CI/CD pipelines and monitor automated quality gates
  • Investigate, document, and track defects; verify fixes and perform regression testing across the full application stack
  • Validate deployments, perform smoke testing, and support production issue investigation
  • Ensure testing practices align with healthcare security, privacy, compliance, and data protection requirements
  • Collaborate closely with software developers, architects, and DevOps teams to improve product quality and testability

Required Qualifications

  • 5–8 years of professional experience in software QA, test automation, software development, or Software Development Engineer in Test (SDET) roles
  • Strong development or automation background may compensate for years of experience
  • Strong scripting and automation skills using Python, PowerShell, JavaScript, or similar languages
  • Solid understanding of C#/.NET and modern backend development principles
  • Experience testing RESTful APIs, backend services, distributed systems, and asynchronous workflows
  • Hands-on experience validating real-time communication systems such as SignalR or equivalent technologies
  • Strong understanding of concurrency, asynchronous processing, and race condition validation
  • Familiarity with SQL Server, Postgres, relational data modeling, and backend data validation
  • Experience testing cloud-hosted applications, microservices, or distributed systems (AWS preferred)
  • Understanding of secure application development and testing practices
  • Experience with Git and modern team-based development workflows
  • Ability to write clear and maintainable test cases, test plans, automation scripts, and defect reports
  • Strong analytical, debugging, and troubleshooting skills across backend and distributed systems

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience testing Blazor applications (Server or WebAssembly)
  • Experience with automated UI testing frameworks such as Playwright, Selenium, or Cypress
  • Familiarity with MudBlazor or FluentUI component libraries
  • Experience with performance and load testing tools such as JMeter or k6
  • Experience testing containerized applications and Docker-based deployments
  • Familiarity with ORM-based backend systems such as Entity Framework
  • Knowledge of logging, monitoring, observability, and audit trail validation in regulated environments
  • Experience with AWS-based healthcare systems or cloud-native architectures
  • Experience in medical imaging or healthcare applications
  • Familiarity with DICOM concepts including Study, Series, and SOP Instances
  • Experience validating integrations with PACS or imaging storage systems

Desired Attributes

  • Strong attention to reliability, scalability, workflow correctness, and data integrity
  • Ability to validate complex distributed systems and compliance-sensitive applications
  • Strong technical mindset with software development and automation-oriented thinking
  • Ability to troubleshoot across UI, backend services, databases, cloud systems, and distributed workflows
  • Comfortable working in regulated healthcare environments
  • Effective communication and collaboration skills
  • Commitment to maintainable, repeatable, automation-driven testing practices
  • Ability to work independently while collaborating closely with development and DevOps teams

Learn More About ConcertAI

Our team at ConcertAI is dedicated to transforming healthcare decision-making through the application of RWE and AI to improve patient outcomes. We work in a fast-paced, dynamic, high-performing culture where diversity, collaboration, and innovation are valued. Join us on our quest to create a world free of disease. Learn more about ConcertAI at www.concertai.com , or follow us on LinkedIn. Serving 1,300 clinical sites globally, TeraRecon - a ConcertAI company - is a Best in KLAS solution provider for AI-empowered radiology, oncology, cardiology, neurology, and vascular surgery. In the future, the combination with ConcertAI could bring a single, advanced AI-augmented diagnosis and interpretation capability from clinical trials to patient care.

This policy applies to all terms and conditions of employment, including recruiting, hiring, placement, promotion, termination, layoff, recall, transfer, leaves of absence, compensation and training. Requests for accommodation will be handled confidentially and in accordance with applicable law.

title: Junior Software Developer
description:
Want to work with sustainability and software? Looking to be part of an innovative, fast-growing Danish greentech company with global reach? Then Explicit might be the place for you.

We are looking for a software developer to join us to develop and maintain our digital platforms as we scale.

We do drone-based emissions monitoring across oil & gas, maritime, waste management, and other industries. By helping operators safely identify methane leaks and quantify emissions, we're proud to be supporting industry efforts to improve environmental performance while enhancing operational efficiency and asset integrity. We measure greenhouse gas emissions data from various sources and combining them with atmospheric data. Based on scientific methods we then quantify emissions and visualize the data to provide emissions intelligence to operations enabling actions on emissions.

We have a strong focus on R&D, and we are exploring new cutting-edge technologies and ideas to innovate what we can do within emissions monitoring.

The job

You will be part of a small, talented tech developer team, responsible for designing, building and maintaining our digital platforms, which are the core of the products we deliver to customers.

As a Software Developer your responsibilities will include:

  • Co-development of our main applications Microsoft Azure, Blazor Server Application (C#)

  • Co-development of our calculation engine, Microsoft Azure Function (Python)

  • Develop new, more appealing user experiences aimed at different user groups to view products and services.

  • Maintain databases, application services and reporting landscape specific to the European maritime emission monitoring set-up.

  • Improve analysis tools and the user experience for the customers, the drone pilot and the internal project manager in collaboration with the project manager running the campaigns.

About you

We are looking for a candidate who meets the following criteria:

  • A bachelor's degree or master’s degree in engineering, data science, software design, computer engineering, mathematics, physics or similar

  • Experience with code development in C# and Python and preferable Rust

  • Experience with database design (SQL)

  • Familiar with software development processes in Azure DevOps

  • Experience with development of user interfaces and UX design is an advantage, but not a requirement

  • Fluent in English. Danish is an advantage, but not a requirement

  • Genuine interest in technology and IT infrastructure

  • Structured and focused on delivering quality work and being a good team player.

What we offer

  • A permanent, full-time position in a fast-growing greentech company with real-world impact on cutting industrial emissions

  • Competitive benefits including paid pension, health insurance, parental leave and 6 weeks' holiday allowance

  • Software ownership early on, with senior developers to learn from

  • A flat hierarchy where ideas are heard, initiative is encouraged, and responsibility comes early

  • A supportive team that values collaboration, trust and learning

  • Job location is just north of Copenhagen in Virum, Denmark.

Application and information

We encourage you to apply as soon as possible, as we will be evaluating applications on an ongoing basis. Application deadline is 18 October 2026. Expected start date is 1 November 2026.

Please send your application, including your motivation and what a competence you bring, together with your CV to jobs@explicit.dk. Write “Software developer” in the subject field.

If you have any questions about the job, you are welcome to contact Rasmus Ebdrup, Chief Digital Officer at reb@explicit.dk

___________________________________________________________________________________

About Explicit

Explicit ApS is a pioneering Danish green tech company specialising in drone-based emissions monitoring across the energy, maritime, waste management, and other industries. We deliver reliable, transparent and actionable emissions data to some of the largest energy companies all over the world using our patented drone-based methodology.

We are headquartered in Virum, Denmark, with offices in Norway, Germany and Australia. Our international team of around 30 colleagues brings together engineering, data and environmental expertise, united by a shared mission to make a difference in emissions monitoring. title: Optometristi 37,5h/vko, Nissen Iso Omena ja Nissen Kamppi
description:
Optikko tai optometristi, näytä vahvuutesi!

Mikäli nautit ammattitaitosi jatkuvasta kehittämisestä, haluat työskennellä alan uusin teknologia apunasi ja arvostat laajaa työnkuvaa, voit olla tiimimme uusin jäsen. Meillä pääset tarjoamaan asiakkaille parhaat näkemisen ratkaisut yhdessä alan osaavimpien työkavereiden kanssa. Jatkuvasti kehittyvään palveluvalikoimaamme kuuluvat esimerkiksi All Inclusive, Kuivasilmäklinikat sekä etänäöntarkastukset.

Instru Optiikalla saat tehdä merkityksellistä työtä yhteisössä, jossa optometristien ammattitaitoa aidosti arvostetaan. Työnkuvasi on monipuolinen ja näöntarkastusten lisäksi pääset esimerkiksi tulkitsemaan silmänpohjakuvia sekä tekemään yhteistyötä silmälääkäreiden kanssa. Myös myynti on tärkeä osa arkeasi ja autat yhteistyössä myyjien kanssa asiakkaitamme kehys- ja linssivalinnoissa.

Olemme iso talo ja tarjoamme työntekijöillemme mahdollisuuden kouluttautua, erikoistua tai edetä omien kiinnostuksen kohteiden mukaan. Meille on tärkeää tutkia asiakkaan näköä kokonaisvaltaisesti ja siksi panostamme henkilökuntamme osaamisen kehittämiseen, laadukkaisiin laitteisiin ja alan viimeisimpään teknologiaan. Esimerkiksi useimmista myymälöistämme löytyvän silmänpohjakameran avulla saamme tavanomaista laajemman ja paremman näkymän silmänpohjaan.

Miksi valita meidät?

- Meillä optometristin työ on erittäin monipuolista - myymälämme ovat keskenään hyvin erilaisia ja eri kokoisia, joten jokaiselle löytyy varmasti mieluisa myymälä

- Tarjoamme laajat etenemis- ja erikoistumismahdollisuudet kiinnostuksen kohteidesi mukaan: voit esimerkiksi suuntautua esihenkilötyöhön, perehtyä kuivasilmäisyyden hoitoon tai kouluttaa kollegojasi

- Meillä pysyt aina ajan hermolla - tarjoamme säännöllisesti ajankohtaisia koulutuksia sekä paikallisesti että kansainvälisesti

- Olet mukana optisen alan kehityksessä - saat käyttöösi tehokkaat työvälineet ja esim. silmänpohjakamera ja OCT ovat kattavasti saatavillasi

- Meillä on hyvät henkilökuntaedut - myös läheisesi nauttivat eduistamme, kuten edullisista ja laadukkaista silmälaseista

Olemme osa EssilorLuxotticaa

EssilorLuxottica on maailmanlaajuinen edelläkävijä silmälasilinssien, kehysten ja aurinkolasien suunnittelussa, valmistuksessa ja jakelussa. Toimimme yli 150 maassa ja tarjoamme näönhuollon ammattilaisille pääsyn laadukkaisiin tuotteisiin ja palveluihin – aina Essilorin tunnetuista linssibrändeistä (Varilux, Crizal, Eyezen, Stellest ja Transitions) kuluttajien rakastamiin ikonisiin kehysmerkkeihin (Ray-Ban, Oakley, Persol, Oliver Peoples, Vogue Eyewear ja Costa). Lisäksi konserniin kuuluu laaja jälleenmyynti- ja palveluverkosto (kuten Sunglass Hut, LensCrafters, Salmoiraghi & Viganò ja GrandVision), sekä useita johtavia verkkokauppa-alustoja.

Liity osaksi maailmanlaajuista, yli 190 000 työntekijän yhteisöämme ja ole mukana muovaamassa näönhuollon tulevaisuutta.

Monimuotoisuus, tasa-arvo ja osallisuus

Olemme sitoutuneet luomaan osallistavan ympäristön kaikille työntekijöille. Juhlistamme monimuotoisuutta ja tarjoamme yhtäläiset mahdollisuudet kaikille – riippumatta sukupuolesta, etnisyydestä, uskonnosta, vammasta, seksuaalisesta suuntautumisesta tai mistä tahansa muusta ominaisuudesta, joka tekee meistä ainutlaatuisia.



Aloitus: Joustavasti sopimuksen mukaan. Vuoroja on Nissen Iso Omenan ja Nissen Kampin myymälöissä.

Työaika: Sovittavissa 37,5 h/vko

Työsuhteen tyyppi: Tehtävä on vakituinen

Kiinnostuitko? Näytä vahvuutesi ja täytä hakemus jo tänään!


Instru Optiikka Oy

Me Instru Optiikka Oy:ssä tarjoamme sinulle mahtavan työyhteisön, joka toivottaa uudet työntekijät lämpimästi tervetulleiksi. Olemme vakaa, jo 130 vuotta alalla toiminut, ihmiskeskeinen työnantaja. Toimintaamme ohjaa halu toimia markkinoiden johtavana näönhuollon ammattilaisena ja asiakkaiden ykkösvalintana. Instrumentarium, Nissen ja Keops ovat Instru Optiikan ketjuja, joten uramahdollisuudet ovat meillä erinomaiset. Lisäksi olemme osa maailmanlaajuista EssilorLuxottica-konsernia, mikä mahdollistaa myös kansainvälisen yhteistyön ja mielenkiintoiset urapolut.

Meille on sydämen asia löytää asiakkaan jokaiseen elämäntilanteeseen sopivat näkemisen ratkaisut.

See More – Be More!

title: Sjuksköterska - Avancerad sjukvård i hemmet
description:
Om oss

Vill du jobba i framkant och söker ett arbete där du kan utvecklas och växa i din roll som sjuksköterska?

Vi på ASIH är specialiserade på att ge vård i hemmet till patienter med behov av avancerade sjukvårdsinsatser. Vi finns tillgängliga dygnets alla timmar för att tillgodose både planerade och akuta behov. Vi har ett öppet och positivt arbetsklimat med möjlighet till personlig utveckling och hög delaktighet. Vår ambition är att tillvarata samtliga medarbetares kompetens och att tillsammans på ett professionellt och engagerat sätt ge våra patienter den bästa vården.

Din roll

I din roll som sjuksköterska kommer du att träffa patienter från olika patientgrupper, t.ex. patienter med avancerad cancerbehandling, palliativa patienter samt patienter med kroniska sjukdomar, i deras hemmiljö. Vi strävar efter att skapa förutsättningar för patienter att kunna bo kvar i sitt hem under hela vårdprocessen, i den mån det är möjligt.

I dina arbetsuppgifter ingår t.ex. symtomlindring, provtagning, hantering av in- och utfarter, läkemedelsadministrering samt råd och stöd i vardagen för patienter och närstående. Du kommer att ingå i ett tvärprofessionellt team där du deltar aktivt och leder planeringen runt patientens dagliga vård tillsammans med det övriga teamet.

Vi erbjuder dig

  • Garanterad lönenivå efter 12 månaders anställning

  • Kvarstannandebonus: 1 arbetsveckas komptimmar per år

  • Kollektivavtal

  • Närvarande chef

  • Kompetensutveckling, både internt och externt

  • Friskvårdsbidrag

  • Frukost varje fredag

  • En inkluderande arbetsplats där vi lär av varandra

Anställningsform: Tidsbegränsad anställning. Dag-, kväll-, och helgtjänstgöring.

Heltidsmått 37 h/vecka.

Lön enl. överenskommelse.

Om dig

Vi söker dig som är legitimerad sjuksköterska. Personlig lämplighet väger tungt vid rekrytering. Vi erbjuder en trygg och personcentrerad introduktion. Vi ser gärna att du har erfarenhet från ASIH, onkologi eller hemsjukvård. Vi använder oss av systemen TakeCare och Medoma m.m.

Vi söker en lyhörd och kreativ person som har ett intresse för att bli en del av vårt team som strävar efter utveckling och nytänkande.

Giltigt B-körkort är ett krav för tjänsten. Goda kunskaper i svenska språket.

Ansökan

Intervjuer sker löpande och tjänsten kan komma att tillsättas innan sista ansökningsdag. Annonsen kan därför tas bort tidigare än planerat, så vänta inte - skicka in din ansökan redan idag.

I samband med anställning kan bakgrundskontroll och utdrag ur belastningsregistret komma att begäras.

Vi ser fram emot att höra från dig!

Publicerat: 2026-09-18

Sista ansökningsdag: 2026-10-31

Vi undanber oss vänligt men bestämt all direktkontakt med bemannings- och rekryteringsföretag samt försäljare av jobbannonser.

title: Associate I– Reg CMC Strategy (LEC Team)
description:
JOB SUMMARY

Functions as a Strategist for Brands-LEC team, working with Global Regulatory Strategist (GRS-CMC) and Cross Functional Teams to prepare and submit the variations for entity name change across global markets including US, EU & ROW as per defined timelines.

JOB RESPONSIBILITIES

· Manages day-to-day regulatory activities associated with assigned LEC variations within agreed upon timelines.

· Evaluate change controls for completeness, accuracy and required supporting documents. Initiate change controls when needed.

· Performs Market Impact Assessment (MIA) for the specific entity name change.

· Runs the RegAtlas to determine the filing action and impacted sections specific for entity name change and to obtain confirmation from the Regional Regulatory Lead.

· Search Regulatory databases for Common Technical Document components or request them from appropriate market contacts, when not available.

· Familiarity with global guidelines for filing Legal Entity Changes (LEC) and run corresponding reports in the regulatory requirements database.

· Should be familiar with submission grouping practices.

· Interpret and apply global/regional CMC regulatory policies.

· Request documents from the sites/markets/center functions as needed.

· Request Ancillary documents from Ancillary documents team.

· Communicate with markets if clarification/prioritization is needed.

· Follow up with all responsible disciplines to be able to meet timelines.

· Authoring of the impacted CMC sections i.e. Module 3 under the guidance from the product strategists as appropriate and within agreed timelines.

· Responsible for obtaining approval in Reg-459 form from GRS CMCs on the completion of authoring the sections.

· Works under the supervision of line manager

title: Sygeplejerske søges til Lungemedicinsk Sengeafsnit, Næstved Sygehus, Medicinsk Afdeling, SUH Roskilde
description:
Vi søger fagligt stærkt, imødekommende og positiv sygeplejerske til fuldtidsstilling i skiftende vagter.

På lungemedicinsk sengeafsnit i Næstved, arbejder en flok dedikerede og meget dygtige og engagerede sygeplejersker og social- og sundhedsassistenter. De er enige om at det er den bedste medicinske afdeling at arbejde på! Hvor der bliver taget hensyn til Work/Life balancen, med en fantastisk vagtplanlægger, et spændende speciale, gode kollegaer, en nærværende leder og en fællesskabsånd, hvor vi konstant har fokus på det gode arbejdsmiljø.

Når du starter hos os, vil du hurtigt opdage, at alle er på fornavn med alle, og at den nyeste unge sygeplejerske får luftet sine gode idéer, på lige fod med professoren eller oversygeplejersken. Vores målsætning er nemlig at vi skal være gode for hinanden, trivslen og det tværfaglige samarbejde.

Tid til høj faglighed og det gode samarbejde

Når du starter i Lungemedicinsk afsnit, tager vi rigtig godt imod dig og sørger for en god start med vores introduktions- og oplæringsprogram, som tager dig igennem din første tid i afsnittet. Samtidig får du tilknyttet din egen mentor, som understøtter dig i alt det nye.

Vores sygeplejestrategi bygger på Fundamentals of Care. Vi har stort fokus på udvikling, vi har to sygeplejersker med specialistfunktion, to erhvervskandidatstuderende sygeplejerske og en hel afdeling fuld af dygtige sygeplejersker, som har hånd i hanke med sygeplejen og vores faglighed.

Du kan se frem til en begivenhedsrig hverdag på vores sygehus. En spændende arbejdsplads, hvor dagene aldrig er ens, og hvor vi har en bred og forskelligartet patientkontakt.

På sengeafsnittet modtager vi patienter med KOL, patienter til NIV-behandling, patienter til hjemme-NIV og efterfølgende telemedicinsk opfølgning, lungecancerpatienter, infektionsmedicinsk- og internmedicinske patienter.

Udover sengeafdelingen med 22 senge, består lungemedicinsk afdeling af en stor ambulant lungecancerudredning, et lungemedicinsk ambulatorie og en aktiv forskningsenhed.

Attraktive arbejdsforhold med tid til både arbejde og fritid

Hvis du bliver vores nye kollega, kan du se frem til et arbejdsliv, hvor der er tid til både arbejde og fritid. Vi ved, at tid er vores medarbejderes dyrebareste og mest værdifulde ressource. Når tiden er knap, går det ud over vores arbejdsglæde, det gode arbejdsliv og de gode patientforløb. Derfor går vi på arbejde i hverdage og weekender med et smil på læben i både dag-, aften- og nattevagter som vi gør vores bedste for at tilrettelægge i samarbejde med dig.

Du skal søge, hvis du:

  • er sygeplejerske, erfaren eller nyuddannet
  • gerne vil dygtiggøre dig i det lungemedicinske speciale og den medicinsk sygepleje
  • vil være en aktiv del af et godt fællesskab
  • vil bidrage med dit gode humør

Kan du nikke ja til ovenstående, er lungemedicinsk afsnit på Næstved Sygehus det rette sted for dig. Vi er ca. 40 engagerede medarbejdere, og vi glæder os til at byde dig ind i vores afdeling, til spændende, faglige udfordringer og gode udviklingsmuligheder, inden for det lungemedicinske speciale.

Hør mere om Lungemedicinsk afsnit

Er du blevet nysgerrig og gerne vil høre mere om os og vores afsnit, så vil vi med glæde tage en snak med dig, og du kan kontakte oversygeplejerske Emina Laursen, eblu@regionsjaelland.dk tlf. 9357 6964.

Din ansættelse sker på overenskomstmæssige vilkår, efter aftale med forhandlingsberettiget organisation. Stillingerne ønskes besat fra 1.december 2026 eller efter aftale.

Ansøgningsfrist 18.oktober 2026

Ansættelsessamtaler forventes at blive afholdt løbende

Om Medicinsk Afdeling

Medicinsk afdeling, SUH Roskilde har regionsfunktion inden for lungemedicin, infektionsmedicin og nefrologi. Det betyder, at afdelingen modtager patienter fra hele regionen med sjældne og komplicerede forløb inden for de tre specialer. Afdelingen varetager herudover diagnostik og behandling af akutte og kroniske lidelser på hovedfunktionsniveau inden for alle tre specialer.

Der sker en løbende udvikling indenfor specialerne både fagligt, forsknings- og aktivitetsmæssigt. For at sikre et højt fagligt og udviklende miljø med høj grad af patientinddragelse arbejder vi målrettet og kontinuerligt med forbedringsarbejde, kvalitet, uddannelse, udvikling og forskning.

Ansættelsesområde

Region Sjælland og Region Hovedstaden bliver den 1. januar 2027 til Region Østdanmark som følge af sundhedsreformen. Dit ansættelsesområde vil være Region Østdanmark med alle tilhørende organisatoriske enheder.
Læs mere om betydningen af ansættelsesområdet på Region Østdanmarks hjemmeside.

Startløn for overenskomstansatte

Regionen er forpligtet til at oplyse dig om startlønnen for stillingen. Du får oplyst grundløn, centralt fastsatte tillæg og pension i den relevante overenskomst. Udover startlønnen, kan lønnen indeholde eventuelt forhandlede tillæg afhængigt af stillingen, dine erfaringer og kvalifikationer.
Se startlønnen på regionens hjemmeside

Om Sjællands Universitetshospital

Sjællands Universitetshospital er Danmarks nyeste universitetshospital med aktiviteter i Køge, Roskilde og Nykøbing F. Vi er et modigt og udadvendt universitetshospital, hvor vi hver dag arbejder for at skabe et sammenhængende sundhedsvæsen og større lighed i sundhed for borgerne i regionen.

Vores optageområde er præget af flere borgere med kronisk sygdom og sociale udfordringer end landsgennemsnittet. Derfor arbejder vi målrettet med innovation, nye samarbejdsformer og løsninger, der bringer behandling tættere på borgerne.

Hos os bliver du en del af en ambitiøs arbejdsplads, hvor samarbejde på tværs, høj faglighed og løbende forbedringer er en naturlig del af hverdagen. Vores ledelsesværdier er nytænkning, følgeskab, ordentlighed og fællesskab, og de sætter retning for, hvordan vi arbejder, udvikler os og skaber gode resultater – for både borgere og medarbejdere.

title: Myyntineuvottelija, Helsinki
description:
Mitä, jos unohtaisit perinteiset myyntityön mielikuvat? Tule meille töihin!

Nuorekas ja innovatiivinen Nordic C-Management etsii Helsingin toimipisteeseen uutta myynti- ja asiakashankinnan osaajaa. Olemme kansainvälisesti toimiva taloushallinnon yritys, jossa pääset kasvattamaan myynnin taitojasi modernissa ja rennossa työympäristössä. Meillä työyhteisö on tunnettu huonoista vitseistä, matalasta hierarkiasta ja siitä, että töihin on oikeasti kiva tulla. Työ ja vapaa-aika pidetään erillään, eikä meillä tunneta ylipitkiä työpäiviä – viikonloput ja lomat ovat oikeasti vapaita.

Pääkonttorimme sijaitsee Kampin Autotalossa. Lisäksi meillä on toimistoja Espoossa, Vantaalla, Tampereella, Turussa, Lohjalla, Jyväskylässä, Tallinnassa ja Tukholmassa. Työskentelemme pääsääntöisesti toimistolta, joten ihmislähtöinen rekrytointi ja hyvä työilmapiiri ovat meille avainasemassa.

Haemme myyntineuvottelijaa:

Toivomme, että sinulla on jonkin verran kokemusta B2B-myynnistä, asiakashankinnasta tai asiakastyöstä – tai vahva motivaatio kehittyä myynnin roolissa. Tärkeintä on rohkeus tarttua puhelimeen, kyky kohdata asiakkaita ja halu oppia. Voit olla urasi alkuvaiheessa tai jo kokeneempi osaaja, meille sopii molemmat!

Tarvittaessa koulutamme sinut taloushallinnon palveluiden myyntiin, ja tuemme sinua urapolullasi aina asiantuntijamyyjäksi asti.

Tarjoamme sinulle:

- Nuorekkaan, rennon ja huumorintajuisen työyhteisön

- Selkeän myyntiroolin ilman turhaa byrokratiaa

- Kilpailukykyisen palkan sekä mahdollisuuden tulospohjaisiin bonuksiin

- Mahdollisuuden kasvaa myynnin ammattilaiseksi ja edetä yrityksen sisällä

- Modernit työtilat ja hyvät kulkuyhteydet Helsingin toimipisteeseen

- Tukea, sparrausta ja jatkuvaa oppimista

- Mielenkiintoisia asiakkaita eri toimialoilta.

Kiinnostaako myyntineuvottelijan pesti? Aloitamme haastattelut jo hakuaikana, joten hae tehtävään mahdollisimman pian lähettämällä hakemuskirje, CV ja palkkatoiveesi.

Voit myös halutessasi laittaa meille avoimen hakemuksen, sillä hyviä tyyppejä etsitään aina! Muistathan kertoa hakemuksessasi, mihin toimipisteeseen ja tehtävään haet. :)

KMRG, LLC (KMRG) is a federal services company that hires talented professionals to support Government agencies and the communities they serve. title: Client Service Monitor - PT & FT
description:
Hope Mission Statement

The mission of Hope the Mission is to prevent, reduce and eliminate poverty, hunger, and homelessness by offering immediate assistance and long-term solutions.

Position Purpose and Summary

The Client Services Monitor (CSM) works directly on-site and is responsible for keeping participants safe, supporting daily operations, community standards and helping Hope the Mission's Interim Housing programs run smoothly. The CSM plays an important role in creating an environment that is safe, structured, and respectful — one where every participant is treated with dignity and fairness.

This position requires someone who shows up consistently, uses good judgment, and genuinely cares about serving people experiencing homelessness. Many participants in our programs have been through long periods of instability, crisis, and trauma. When a CSM shows up with calm, care, and compassion, it creates a sense of safety and routine that participants can count on as they work toward stable housing.

The CSM reports to the Program Manager or Assistant Program Manager and works alongside site staff to make sure the program runs well, meets contract requirements, and reflects Hope the Mission's values in every interaction.


Primary Duties and Responsibilities

Facility Maintenance and Sanitation

  • Assists with and facilitates routine cleaning of all facility areas to maintain cleanliness, safety, and operational readiness

  • Cleans and disinfects restrooms and shower areas after each use, without exception. Maintains sanitary and safe restroom and sink conditions at all times. Completes deep cleaning of restrooms and common areas.

  • Monitors and maintains hygiene areas and community areas; ensures resources are fully stocked, replenishing as needed.

  • Washes, dries, and prepares towels used for restroom and shower services

  • Monitors laundry rooms, restrooms, and common areas to ensure cleanliness and appropriate use

  • Maintains accurate shower and restroom usage logs

Participant Safety and Monitoring

  • Conducts required wellness checks each shift to ensure participant safety and well-being

  • Monitors participant movement, common areas, and site activity to promote safety and program compliance

  • Conducts routine site walk-throughs and safety checks during assigned shifts

  • Supports contraband control and safety procedures in accordance with agency policy

  • Responds to incidents and emergencies using trauma-informed de-escalation techniques and follows all incident reporting protocols

  • Supports emergency responses — including medical emergencies, overdoses, and evacuations — until leadership or first responders arrive

Participant Services and Engagement

  • Provides direct, respectful assistance to participants, including answering questions, responding to requests, and connecting participants to appropriate staff or resources

  • Assists with participant intake, orientation, and explanation of site guidelines as directed by management

  • Distributes hygiene supplies including soap, shampoo, towels, and related items to participants as needed

  • Supports meal service, supply distribution, and general operational duties as assigned

Documentation and Reporting

  • Completes Daily Activity Reports (DARs) accurately, objectively, and in a timely manner

  • Conducts intake, exit, and case notes in HMIS where applicable

  • Assists with documentation related to participant movements, wellness concerns, or incidents as required

  • Observes and reports safety concerns, maintenance issues, guideline violations, and unusual occurrences to site leadership promptly

Shift Operations

  • Provides support during shift pass-downs and communicates relevant updates between shifts

  • Provides overnight, evening, weekend, or holiday coverage as scheduled

  • Performs other duties as assigned

Transportation (Site Specific)

  • Transports participants to and from established routes and as directed by a supervisor

  • Maintains vehicle cleanliness inside and out at all times

  • Ensures the vehicle has sufficient fuel before and during each shift

  • Completes daily vehicle maintenance checks and reports any issues to the supervisors

  • Logs all mileage accurately and in accordance with departmental procedures

Skills

  • Strong observation and situational awareness skills

  • Trauma-informed communication and de-escalation techniques

  • Ability to maintain professional boundaries with participants

  • Clear, objective, and professional written documentation skills

  • Ability to follow policies, procedures, and chain of command

  • Strong teamwork and communication skills

  • Basic computer and email proficiency

  • Ability to lead with integrity and uphold organizational mission, values, and service philosophy.

  • Ability to cultivate and maintain collaborative relationships with community-based organizations and external service providers. Strong Interpersonal Skills.

  • Maintains professionalism, empathy, and sound decision-making when working in complex or emotionally challenging environments.


Qualifications

  • High school diploma or GED required

  • Previous experience in homeless services, shelter operations or social service preferred

  • Knowledge of trauma-informed care and harm reduction principles preferred

  • Ability to work flexible schedules including nights, weekends, and holidays


Mandatory Requirements

  • Background Screening – Employment is contingent upon the successful completion of background checks as required per worksite.

  • Drug and Alcohol Testing – Candidates must pass pre-employment and ongoing drug and alcohol screenings in accordance with company policy.

  • Motor Vehicle Record (MVR) Check – For roles requiring driving, employment is contingent upon an acceptable driving record.

  • Legal Eligibility to Work – Candidates must provide proof of legal authorization to work in the US.

  • Compliance with Company Policies and HIPAA standards – All employees must comply with company policies, including safety, confidentiality, and conduct standards.


Physical, Demands, Environmental Conditions, Equipment

The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of the job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential job functions. The employee is required to: walk and climb stairs; stand, bend, squat, climb, kneel, and twist on an intermittent or sometimes continuous basis; grasp, push, pull objects such as files, file cabinet drawers, and reach overhead; handle, finger, grasp and feel objects and equipment; reach with hands and arms; be mobile by moving oneself from place to place quickly and easily; repeat various motions with the wrists, hands, and fingers; be able to perform visual activities for (including, but not limited to) administrative and clerical tasks; ability to lift up to 25 lbs.; communicate, receive and exchange ideas, information by means of the spoken and written word; drive vehicles in and around Los Angeles County; be able to enter various buildings that may require climbing stairs; be periodically subjected to outside environmental conditions. The employee may work in proximity to service animals and emotional support animals; use a desktop and/or laptop computer; various office machines. Complete all required forms in personal writing.


Work Environment

The employee may be in contact with individuals and families in crisis who may be ill, using alcohol and drugs, and who may not be attentive to basic personal hygiene, health and safety practices. title: PhD scholarships in Economics at the Department of Economics, University of Southern Denmark
description:
Applications are invited for one or more fully funded PhD scholarships at the Department of Economics, University of Southern Denmark, Odense.

Depending on academic qualifications, applicants may be enrolled in either the 4+4 or the 5+3 PhD programme. Both programmes include a research stay abroad, typically of six months’ duration, and offer a competitive full-time salary.

We aim to appoint the successful candidate as soon as possible, ideally with a start date of 15 January 2027, while remaining flexible regarding the exact timing.

About the Department and Research Environment

The Department of Economics is an international department with a strong tradition of excellence in research and teaching across a wide range of fields within economics. Research, teaching, and outreach activities are organized within four research groups: Econometrics and Data Science; Economic History; Macroeconomics; and Microeconomics. Further information about the department and its research groups is available on the department website.

The PhD student will be affiliated with the Historical Economics and Development Group (HEDG), which focuses on Economic History with a strong emphasis on applied microeconomics and causal inference. HEDG is internationally acknowledged as a leading research group and attracts substantial grants and media coverage, as well as publishing books and articles with top outlets.

The position

The successful candidate will become part of an international research environment and work closely with Associate Professor Anthony Wray on Private Foundations, a Carlsberg Foundation-funded project on the roles of private investment and medical education in shaping innovation and inequality in the United States during the early twentieth century. For further information about the project, please see this link.

These are applied microeconomic questions in health, labour, education, and demographic economics, approached with historical data. We are interested in strong applied microeconomists broadly, not only in candidates who already identify as economic historians, and there is scope for the PhD student to develop their own questions within the project.

The successful candidate is expected to contribute to high-quality research within the scope of the project, including independent, single-authored work. In addition, the candidate will be involved in teaching and supervision within economics at both undergraduate and graduate levels.

The PhD student will be supervised by Associate Professor Anthony Wray and will join a research group that includes two postdoctoral researchers and scientific research assistants, with access to an international network of collaborators.

The project has its own GPU environment — university hardware, reserved for this project and its research team. It runs open-weight models locally for large-scale digitisation and data extraction from historical sources, alongside frontier models. We are also building an autonomous workflow for agentic-supported academic research, and the PhD student will have the chance to help develop that workflow.

Applicants’ profile

Applicants should have completed a relevant master’s degree in Economics, Mathematics and Economics, or related disciplines. Qualified candidates currently enrolled in a relevant master’s programme are also welcome to apply. Furthermore, we expect applicants to:

  • Have solid knowledge of econometrics and applied quantitative methods, with experience using Python, R, Stata, or similar tools, and be eager to learn and apply new methods.

  • Be dedicated, capable of working independently and in cooperation with a PhD supervisor.

  • Have strong English skills, both spoken and written.

  • Have good interpersonal skills, be interested in engaging with national and international researchers.

The following qualifications are an advantage

  • Have an interest in, or potentially experience with, machine learning, large language models, and natural language processing.

  • Experience working with large datasets and conducting empirical research.

  • Demonstrated interest in economic history or cultural economics.

We are an international department, and the working language is English.

Further information about the position can be obtained from Head of Administration Astrid Holm Nielsen, e-mail: astni@sam.sdu.dk. For general questions regarding relocation, housing, taxes etc., contact the SDU’s International Staff Office.

How to apply for this position

Employment as a paid PhD fellow takes place in accordance with the circular of 20 December 2021 on the collective agreement for academics in the state – appendix 5, protocol on PhD fellowships.

For more information on the department guidelines for qualification and recruitment please see our Appointment Guidelines.

The application must include (all attachments must be in Adobe PDF format):

  • Detailed CV - the education and work history must be month and year specific.

  • A certified copy of your master’s degree certificate, including transcripts of all examination results. Foreign diplomas that are not in Norwegian, Swedish or English must be accompanied by a translation into Danish or English, as well as a translation of the official description of the marking scale used. If your degree has not yet been completed, please state your expected date of completion.

  • A motivational letter describing why you are a good match for analyzing the topic and how your skills provide a solid foundation to do so (max. 5 pages incl. reference list).

  • A project description (max 5 pages of 2400 characters each, including spaces, notes, appendices, bibliography etc.).

When applying for a PhD scholarship, please fill in the application form available on our web page.

On the webpage of the PhD-school, you can find the guidelines for preparing your project proposal.

All non-Danish documents must be translated into English.

Applications will be assessed by an assessment committee. The committee may request additional information, and if so, it is the responsibility of the applicant to provide the necessary material.

Once the assessment committee has submitted its report, the applicant will receive the portion of the evaluation that pertains to them.

Applications that are incomplete regarding the above requirements will not be assessed by the committee.

Shortlisting and tests may be used in the assessment process.

As part of the overall assessment of the applicant’s qualifications, an interview may be applied.

Documents should not contain a CPR number (civil registration number) – in this case, the CPR number must be crossed out.

The application and CV must not exceed 10 MB.

The application deadline is November 1, 2026, 23.59 CET/CEST.

Applications must be submitted electronically using the link "Apply now" on our website. Uploaded files must be in Adobe PDF (unlocked) or Word format.

We recommend that you read the guideline for applicants. If you experience technical problems, you must contact hcm-support@sdu.dk before the application deadline.

The University of Southern Denmark wishes to reflect the surrounding community and therefore encourages everyone, regardless of personal background, to apply for the position.

Salary and employment terms
Salary is determined in accordance with the applicable collective agreement and based on objective and gender-neutral criteria, including the content of the position, responsibilities, and qualification requirements.

As an applicant, you are entitled to information about the starting salary and salary range for the position. This information will be provided during the recruitment process.

SDU does not collect information on applicants’ previous salary.

title: Lager- og logistikmedarbejder til pluk og pak i Næstved
description:
Er du lager- og logistikmedarbejder og vil du have fast arbejde?

Vi mangler en erfaren profil til pluk, pak og forsendelse i Næstved.

Du lander i et lager- og produktionsmiljø, hvor grafiske varer skal ud af døren i ordentlig stand. Kunderne bestiller alt fra skilte og print til folier, labels og andet visuelt materiale. Der er både lagervarer og specialtilpassede emner, så pluk, optælling og forsendelse skal sidde lige i skabet.

Rollen passer til dig, der har prøvet lager før og ikke skal lære de grundlæggende ting fra bunden. Du får ansvar for at holde styr på varerne, følge sikkerheden og fange fejl, før de bliver sendt videre. Det er et job for en erfaren lagerperson, der trives bedst når tingene spiller.

Det får du

Løn: 170-190 kr. i timen

Arbejdsområde: Næstved og omegn

Kolleger: Cirka 10 ansatte

Overenskomst: Ansat under gældende overenskomst

Ansættelse: Fastansættelse - vi søger folk, vi kan arbejde med i mange år. Ingen korte forløb.

Hverdag: Pluk, pak og lagerstyring

Din hverdag

Dagen starter med overblik over ordrer, varer og forsendelser. Du plukker og pakker efter det der skal videre, tæller op når lageret skal stemme, og retter til hvis noget ikke passer. Når en vare kræver ekstra kontrol, stopper du op og får det afklaret før den forlader lageret.

Du kommer blandt andet til at arbejde med:

  • Plukker og pakker varer til forsendelse
  • Styrer lagerbeholdning og hjælper med optælling
  • Holder kvalitet, sikkerhed og orden i hverdagen
  • Gør forsendelser klar, så de kan komme rigtigt afsted

Det vigtigste er, at du har ro i hovedet når der er flere ordrer i gang. Hvis noget ikke stemmer, siger du til i tide, så resten af huset kan arbejde videre på et ordentligt grundlag.

Vi leder efter dig, der kan sætte kryds ved det meste

Du skal ikke være ekspert i hvert eneste hjørne af faget. Men du skal kunne stå inde for det du afleverer.

Vi forestiller os, at du:

  • Har mindst 10 års erfaring med lager og logistik
  • Har kørekort
  • Kan holde styr på pluk, pak, optælling og forsendelse
  • Arbejder sikkert og holder orden omkring dig
  • Møder stabilt og siger til, hvis noget ikke stemmer

Det er en fordel, hvis du har arbejdet med lager i en produktion eller en webshop før. Men det vigtigste er, at du kan holde hovedet koldt og få varerne rigtigt videre.

Allerede i job?

Så skal det selvfølgelig give mening at skifte.

Derfor starter vi med en uforpligtende snak. Du kan høre mere om opgaverne, virksomheden, lønnen og hverdagen, før du beslutter noget. Og ja, det foregår diskret.

Hvis det her lyder som noget for dig, kan du starte hurtigst muligt.

Du behøver ikke sende en lang ansøgning. Tryk på Ansøg job, så ringer vi dig op og tager den derfra.

Om PowerMatch

Hos PowerMatch matcher vi dig kun med job, der lever op til dine krav på løn, opgaver, kultur, firmabil og hvad der ellers betyder noget for dig.

Du starter direkte ude i virksomheden. Vi arbejder kun med forløb, hvor målet er fastansættelse. Ikke korte vikariater.

Hvis jobbet ikke viser sig at være det rigtige match, hjælper vi dig videre til noget, der passer bedre.

PowerMatch har 5 stjerner på Trustpilot baseret på 500+ anmeldelser fra håndværkere og fagfolk som dig.

Du optjener point hos PowerMatch, som du kan bruge på 1000+ forskellige gavekort som f.eks Circle K, Elgiganten og oplevelser.

title: WASH Officer (Nguru)
description:
Company Overview
Action Against Hunger is an international humanitarian organization committed to ending world hunger. For almost 45 years, across countries, we have been working to fight undernutrition and support communities affected by crisis across the globe.

We carry out innovative, lifesaving programs in Health, Nutrition, Water, Sanitation and Hygiene, Mental Health and Psychosocial Support, Food Security and Livelihoods, and Social Protection.

Action Against Hunger began operations in Nigeria in 2010 in response to the high rate of chronic malnutrition in Northern Nigeria, focusing on integrated programming. Action Against Hunger currently implements multi-sectoral humanitarian and development interventions in Northeast and Northwest Nigeria, funded by AFD, EU/ECHO, French Government, GAC, SIDA, US Government, and GIZ.

Action Against Hunger Nigeria (ACF Nigeria) Ltd/Gte is currently recruiting a Wash Officer based in Yobe. The successful candidate will support the implementation of public health promotion activities and the distribution of non-food items (NFIs) to affected populations.


Position Details

Reporting to: Programme Manager

Proposed start date: October 2026

Work location: Nguru, Yobe State



KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Mission 01: Overall supervision of hygiene Promotion and Non-food items distribution activities following Action Against Hunger local strategy and International Guidelines
  • Ensure that a joint multi sectoral rapid needs assessment is carried out, analysis done and hygiene promotion strategy is designed on the basis of the findings;
  • Ensure the implementation of WASH EM approach and collect the relevant data for context specific hygiene promotion interventions
  • Promote the implementation of Baby Wash approach and collect the relevant data to improve context specific Baby Wash hygiene promotion interventions
  • In coordination with the WASH Program Manager, revising and adapting hygiene promotion training and IEC materials in line with the local context (should be drawn up as a communication plan) and in line with target groups to be trained;
  • Ensure that all monitoring mechanisms are in line with the agreed monitoring format;
  • Continually assessing emergency needs, as requested, especially taking in the broader perspective of public health;
  • Plan beneficiary selection and registration, and lead the distribution of NFI kits with the Field Assistant team;
  • Work closely with MEAL team to ensure post distribution monitoring (PDM) is conducted for all nonfood items (NFIs) distributed
  • Ensure that work meets with SPHERE minimum standards;
  • Assist the WASH Program Manager with, and where required participate in, community
  • mobilization;
  • Ensure that all technical work reflects the needs and preferences of different target groups and are devoid of public health hazards.

Mission 02: Train and build the capacity of staffs and partners
  • Ensure that the PHP team members are fully aware of the hygiene promotion strategy and all activities are in line with strategy activities.
  • Prepare training tools on relevant technical topics and conduct trainings for both internal staff and external stakeholders
  • Assist the WASH Program Manager in the development of technical guidelines and tools for hygiene promotion services
  • Conduct WASH FIT assessment for all implementing health facilities
  • Assess areas for improvement and recording lessons learnt for future activities
Mission 3: Coordinate with internal staffs, and local stakeholders to ensure smooth project implementation
  • Working closely with the WASH Program Manager throughout the planning, design and implementation stages of WASH public health promotion activities.
  • Representing the organization at local level WASH meetings and technical working groups relating to public health promotion and NFI distribution as required by your line manager.
  • Work closely with Nutrition and health team in integrating activities towards improving service delivery to target population.

Mission 4: Supervise and manage staffs under your responsibility
  • Providing day-to-day management of staff directly under your responsibility;
  • Setting performance missions with staff under your direct management conducting performance appraisal in line with ACTION AGAINST HUNGER performance management policies as well as identifying areas where support and capacity building is required;
  • Ensure team coordination and integration with other WASH technical team members.

Additional Responsibilities
  • This job description is not intended to be all inclusive and the employee will also perform other related tasks as required and responsible for reporting and communication of progress and achievement of the specific assigned task

title: SSA i dagvagt i somatisk enhed
description:
🌿 Social- og sundhedsassistent til dagvagt søges til Sophienborg Plejehjem 🌿
– vær med til at skabe et trygt og meningsfuldt hverdagsliv for vores beboere
Vil du gøre en forskel hver dag? Og ønsker du at arbejde et sted, hvor faglighed, fællesskab og omsorg går hånd i hånd?
Så er det måske dig, vi søger til vores somatiske enhed på Sophienborg Plejehjem.

🏡 Om os
Sophienborg Plejehjem er et moderne plejehjem beliggende i naturskønne omgivelser i Hillerød Vest. Vi er opdelt i mindre, overskuelige bofællesskaber med 7–9 boliger, hvor vi skaber trygge rammer og hjemlige omgivelser.
Hos os arbejder vi ud fra Leve-Bo-principperne, hvor det gode hverdagsliv er i centrum. Vi har fokus på det enkelte menneske og støtter beboerne i at leve et liv med størst mulig selvbestemmelse, tryghed og livskvalitet.
Vi arbejder bl.a. med:
  • Personcentreret omsorg og socialpædagogiske metoder
  • Rehabiliterende tilgang og tidlig opsporing
  • Pædagogiske handleplaner som aktivt redskab
Vi er stolte af at være en arbejdsplads med et godt arbejdsmiljø og et stærkt kollegialt sammenhold.

💙 Om stillingen
Vi søger en social- og sundhedsassistent til dagvagt i vores somatiske enhed med opstart 1. november 2026 eller efter aftale.
Hos os får du mulighed for at:
  • Skabe nærvær og livskvalitet i beboernes hverdag
  • Tage ansvar og bruge dine faglige kompetencer
  • Være en del af et team, hvor vi hjælper og støtter hinanden
  • Arbejde med inddragelse af både beboere og pårørende

🌱 Vi lægger vægt på, at du:
  • Har et godt overblik – også i en travl hverdag
  • Har høj faglighed og lyst til udvikling
  • Er fleksibel, positiv og samarbejdsorienteret
  • Arbejder selvstændigt – men også trives i et team
  • Har flair for dokumentation
  • Møder beboere og kollegaer med en anerkendende tilgang

🤝 Derfor skal du vælge os
Hos os bliver du en del af et plejehjem, hvor:
  • Vi prioriterer trivsel og arbejdsglæde
  • Vi støtter hinanden – både fagligt og menneskeligt
  • Vi har fokus på udvikling og refleksion
  • Vi sammen skaber de bedste rammer for beboernes liv

📞 Vil du vide mere?
Du er meget velkommen til at kontakte:
Souschef Annika Skovsgaard på telefon 72 32 69 82 eller administrationen på telefon 72 32 69 00.
Vi tilbyder også gerne et besøg efter aftale.

📅 Ansøgningsfrist
Ansøgningsfrist er den 28. september 2026 - Vi afholder samtaler løbende – så send din ansøgning hurtigst muligt.

Ansøgningen sendes elektronisk via linket

Hos os er det ikke kun arbejdet, der tæller, men også menneskene bag.

I fællesskab gør vi hver dag en forskel for kommunens mere end 54.000 borgere, og vi sætter pris på det helt særlige bidrag, som du kommer med. Vi er stolte af at gå nye veje og sammen finde løsninger på de udfordringer, som møder os. Hillerød Kommune er en fleksibel arbejdsplads, hvor vi tror på værdien af både forskellighed og sammenhold. Det er vigtigt, at alle føler sig anerkendt og respekteret, for hos os er arbejdsglæde en forudsætning for den gode kvalitet og tilfredse borgere.

title: Executive Recruiting Coordinator
description:
About Nebius:

Nebius is leading a new era in cloud infrastructure for the global AI economy. We are building a full-stack AI cloud platform that supports developers and enterprises from data and model training through to production deployment, without the cost and complexity of building large in-house AI/ML infrastructure.

Built by engineers, for engineers. From large-scale GPU orchestration to inference optimization, we own the hard problems across compute, storage, networking and applied AI.

Listed on Nasdaq (NBIS) and headquartered in Amsterdam, we have a global footprint with R&D hubs across Europe, the UK, North America and Israel. Our team of 1,500+ includes hundreds of engineers with deep expertise across hardware, software and AI R&D.

Considering candidates living in East Coast timezone only.

We are looking for an Executive Recruiting Coordinator to join our US-based Talent Acquisition team and work exclusively on Executive and senior leadership hiring at Nebius.

This is not a traditional Recruiting Coordinator role. You will be the operational partner to our Executive Recruiters, supporting some of the most critical and high-profile searches across the company, including C-suite, VP and senior leadership roles within technology, AI and other strategic functions.

You will be responsible for ensuring that executive searches move seamlessly from initial engagement through interview, decision and offer.

Executive hiring at Nebius moves quickly and often involves multiple senior stakeholders, complex calendars, international time zones, confidential information, last minute changes and candidates who expect an exceptional level of service.

We are looking for someone who thrives in this environment, someone who is naturally proactive, exceptionally organised, calm under pressure and capable of operating several steps ahead of everyone else.

You won't simply be coordinating interviews. You will anticipate what the Executive Recruiter, candidate and hiring team will need next, identify risks before they become issues, and ensure every detail of the search is executed to an exceptionally high standard.

What You'll Do

  • Manage multi-stage interview processes, aligning calendars across multiple time zones and senior stakeholders.
  • Coordinate interviews, candidate preparation calls, debriefs, feedback sessions and decision meetings.
  • Manage scheduling conflicts, last minute changes and search dependencies to keep processes moving.
  • Ensure interviewers and candidates have the information, interview plans and necessary materials required for each interaction.
  • Proficiency in Greenhouse, including managing interview stages and ensuring each search is configured and tracked according to its role-specific interview plan.
  • Proactively keep Executive Recruiters informed of coordination progress, outstanding actions and potential blockers.
  • Act as a trusted and highly responsive point of contact for senior and executive level candidates throughout the process.
  • Deliver a white glove polished, personalised and discreet candidate experience aligned with Nebius's executive hiring standards.
  • Coordinate candidate travel, accommodation and onsite experiences (as required.)
  • Partner with Executive Assistants and other support teams to ensure a seamless experience for candidates and senior stakeholders.
  • Act as a trusted operational partner to Executive Recruiters, enabling them to focus on search strategy, assessment and closing.
  • Build collaborative and trusted relationships with senior executives, hiring managers, Executive Assistants and other key stakeholders.
  • Take ownership of issues and drive solutions quickly with minimal disruption.
  • Handle sensitive executive searches with a high level of discretion, professionalism and attention to detail.

What We're Looking For

  • 4+ years of experience in recruiting coordination in a high touch, high volume recruiting environment including at least 2 years of specialized experience supporting C-suite, VP or senior leadership hiring.
  • Experience working in an executive search firm, high-growth technology company or similarly fast-paced environment is highly desirable.
  • Experience coordinating multi-stage interview processes across multiple time zones.
  • Exceptional organisational skills and the ability to manage competing priorities without losing attention to detail.
  • Experience working directly with senior executives, Executive Assistants and/or senior hiring stakeholders.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with strong professionalism and discretion.
  • Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to remain calm and effective under pressure.
  • Comfortable operating with urgency and ambiguity in a rapidly changing environment.
  • Ability to build strong relationships and establish credibility with senior stakeholders.
  • Experience with ATS and recruiting operations platforms such as Greenhouse, Lever, Ashby, or Workday Recruiting.

Pay Transparency

We offer competitive compensation and benefits packages. Actual compensation will be determined based on job-related factors, including experience, skills, qualifications, the level at which the candidate is hired, and geographic location, consistent with applicable law.

Base Compensation Range
$72,000—$91,000 USD

Benefits & Perks:

  • Competitive compensation
  • Career growth and learning opportunities
  • Flexibility and ownership
  • Collaborative and innovative culture
  • Opportunity to work on impactful AI projects
  • International environment and talented teams

What's it like to work at Nebius:

Fast moving - Bold thinking - Constant growth - Meaningful impact - Trust and real ownership - Opportunity to shape the future of AI

title: Cost Analyst
description:
Company Overview

Qarbon Aerospace is a world class manufacturer of cutting-edge composite components and assemblies for the Aerospace and Space industry’s most advanced commercial and military aircraft. Qarbon Aerospace has the capabilities and resources to solve the market’s toughest challenges On-Time with Quality Assured. As a US-based company with more than 100 years of experience and 1.6 million square feet of state-of-the-art facilities, we assure quality into every fiber, letting our customer’s ideas and our employee’s passion take flight.

About the role

An aerospace/defense manufacturer is seeking a Program Cost Analyst to support program and manufacturing costs, contribute to fiscal forecasts, and help connect production-floor cost data to program-level financial reporting. This is an individual contributor position with no direct reports and a clear path to greater ownership. The person in this seat works closely with program, operations, and finance leadership to help them understand what a program costs and why it moved.

What you'll own

  • Administer assigned program cost; prepare fiscal forecasts from historical cost and current production data
  • Compile and review program spend using actual performance, prior figures, estimated revenue, and expense data; prepare comparative evaluations of actual costs against prior EAC/forecast and investigate variances
  • Analyze manufacturing cost data — standard cost, burden/overhead rate application, BOM and scrap variance, work-in-process — and reconcile job cost data between the ERP/MRP system and the general ledger
  • Prepare Estimate at Completion (EAC) inputs and supporting analysis; perform monthly variance analysis and support earned value reporting where applicable
  • Support labor, overhead, and burden cost rate maintenance; contribute to personnel and headcount forecasts by program
  • Apply and help interpret EAC cost; maintain historical cost records; prepare regular management reports
  • Serve as a point of contact on assigned contracts and projects, coordinating with program management, contracts, operations, and finance colleagues

What you bring

  • Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, Business Administration, or a closely related field, or equivalent experience
  • 3–7 years of progressively responsible cost accounting, analysis, or financial analysis experience; aerospace, defense, or other regulated manufacturing exposure preferred
  • Working knowledge of cost accounting and EAC principles and practices
  • Ability to work under general supervision and to solve moderately complex problems using established precedent
  • U.S. Person status required (ITAR/EAR). Not eligible for visa sponsorship

Preferred

  • Exposure to Deltek Costpoint, SAP, Oracle, IFS, or a similar ERP/MRP system, including a cost or production module
  • Progress toward CMA, CPA, or CDFM; some EAC or earned value management exposure
  • Experience in an AS9100- or NADCAP-certified manufacturing environment
  • Strong Excel skills; familiarity with Power BI or Tableau

  • 12 Paid Holidays

  • Critical Illness Insurance / Hospital Indemnity Insurance / Accident Insurance
  • Life Insurance and AD&D Insurance
  • Savings and Spending Accounts
  • Health Flexible Spending Account (FSA)
  • Dependent Care FSA
  • Health Savings Account (HSA)
  • Immediate vesting on 401(k) Plans

title: Functional Automation Tester
description:
Salary: AUD 120 - 150 per hour

Seeking a Functional Automation Tester with a ISTQB Automation Certification or similar certification.

The Functional Automation Tester is responsible for delivering manual and automated testing activities to support digital transformation initiatives. Working within Testing Practice, the role focuses on testing Microsoft Dynamics 365 and Power Platform applications — including Power Pages, Power Apps, and Dataverse-based solutions — and their associated business processes, to ensure the quality, reliability, and usability of business solutions.

Key duties and responsibilities

The role requires the ability to quickly understand new business processes, applications, and technologies, while effectively managing testing activities across multiple concurrent projects and competing priorities. The successful candidate will be expected to become productive within a short onboarding period, work independently with minimal supervision, and contribute to a high-performing testing team.

A key aspect of the role is the design, development, execution, and maintenance of automated regression tests — spanning both UI and API/integration layers — alongside manual testing activities, and ensuring these tests run as part of CI/CD delivery pipelines rather than purely on demand. The position requires strong UI and API testing experience and a solid working knowledge of modern testing and development tools to support the delivery of high-quality business outcomes.

About the project

The successful developers will join an inflight portal project program, supports organisational strategy by delivering a digital-first approach to maritime regulation, improving customer experience, streamlining business processes, enhancing data capability and enabling more efficient regulatory service delivery. The portal has been developed in-house and will continue to be expanded to support additional services

Essential criteria
  • Demonstrated experience testing Microsoft Dynamics 365 and/or Power Platform applications (Power Pages, Power Apps, Dataverse) and their associated business processes, including the ability to analyse requirements, design test scenarios, execute tests, manage defects, and support end-to-end business process validation.
  • Demonstrated experience performing UI, functional, integration, system, regression, and user acceptance testing across web-based and enterprise applications, with a strong understanding of testing methodologies and best practices.
  • Strong experience in test automation and modern testing tools, covering both: * UI regression testing — design, development, execution, and maintenance of automated UI test suites for enterprise applications, particularly Dynamics 365/Power Platform, using Playwright, Selenium, EasyRepro, or similar automation frameworks; and * API/integration testing — automating validation of backend services and integrations (e.g., API Management-fronted APIs, Dataverse plugins/custom APIs, authentication flows) using tools such as Postman/Newman, REST Assured, or Playwright's API testing capabilities.
  • Demonstrated experience integrating automated test suites into CI/CD pipelines (Azure DevOps), so tests execute automatically as part of build and release processes rather than solely on manual trigger.
  • Demonstrated proficiency with Visual Studio Code (VS Code), Azure DevOps, source control, defect management, and test management and reporting practices. Demonstrated understanding of Software Development Lifecycle (SDLC) principles and Agile delivery methodologies, including experience working collaboratively within multidisciplinary project teams.
  • Demonstrated adaptability and flexibility, with the ability to move between projects, technologies, testing phases, teams, and business domains as organisational priorities change.
Desirable criteria
  • ISTQB Automation Certification or similar certification.
  • Experience testing or supporting Microsoft Dynamics 365, Dataverse, Power Platform, and Power BI solutions in depth (e.g., server-side/plugin logic, environment variable and secret configuration, API Management policy validation).
  • Experience using Jira or similar tools for test management and defect management, alongside Azure DevOps.
Contract: 12 Month Contract with 2 x 12 months extension option

Security Required: Baseline Security Clearance required

Location - Canberra

How to Apply - Please upload your resume to apply. Candidates will need to be willing to undergo pre-employment screening checks which may include, ID and work rights, security clearance verification and any other client requested checks
