title: Senior Data Engineer (Databricks)
description:
Job Description

Job Title: Sr Databricks Engineer

Location: Remote (Mandatory to work onsite at Bengaluru office for 1-2 week in November and March/April)

Hire Type: Fulltime

Summary:

We are looking for a seasoned Senior Data Engineer with strong Databricks expertise to contribute to the expansion of our enterprise Databricks data platform. The selected candidate will focus on integrating additional datasets, engineering scalable data pipelines, and building new business dimensions and measures within the existing Databricks ecosystem.

Key Responsibilities:

Data Engineering & Development

  • Architect and build scalable data pipelines leveraging Databricks and PySpark
  • Connect and incorporate additional data sources into the existing Databricks Lakehouse environment
  • Create and refine dimensional models, business dimensions, measures, and curated datasets for analytical use
  • Prepare, transform, and optimize data to support reporting, analytics, and downstream applications
  • Contribute to data quality initiatives, validation activities, monitoring, and performance tuning
  • Investigate and resolve platform-related issues throughout the project.

Platform & Data Management

  • Apply Databricks development, deployment, security, and governance best practices across solutions
  • Use Unity Catalog to address data governance and access control requirements
  • Build, package, and deploy solutions through Databricks Asset Bundles
  • Work closely with the project team to convert business and technical requirements into scalable data solutions.

DevOps & Automation

  • Establish and manage CI/CD workflows for data engineering components
  • Use GitHub and/or GitLab to manage source code, branching approaches, and peer code reviews
  • Contribute to automated deployment workflows and release management activities.

Required Skills:

  • 8+ years of professional experience in Data Engineering
  • 4+ years of practical, hands-on experience with Databricks (required)
  • Strong proficiency with:

-Databricks

-PySpark

-Python

-SQL

-Delta Lake

-Unity Catalog

-Databricks Asset Bundles

-Databricks Security & Access Management

  • Proven experience designing and supporting enterprise-level ETL/ELT solutions
  • Extensive experience developing dimensional models, business dimensions, measures, KPIs, and analytical datasets
  • Hands-on experience developing and maintaining CI/CD pipelines
  • Strong background in source code management using GitHub and/or GitLab
  • Experience delivering solutions within cloud-based data environments
  • Strong verbal and written communication abilities.

Preferred Skills:

  • Exposure to Fivetran or comparable cloud-based data ingestion solutions
  • Working knowledge of REST APIs and integrations with enterprise applications
  • Experience with Power BI or comparable enterprise business intelligence and reporting platforms
  • Background supporting AI, machine learning, or advanced analytics projects
  • Experience working with HR, Finance, or other enterprise business data domains.

title: Støberiteknikerlærling
description:
Bliv støberiteknikerlærling hos BIRN - og vær med til at forme fremtidens industri!

Ønsker du en spændende, håndværksmæssig uddannelse, og vil du være en del af en stor virksomhed med dygtige kollegaer og et netværk af andre elever? Så er det måske dig, vi søger som vores nye støberiteknikerelev

Som støberiteknikerlærling bliver du oplært i både traditionelle håndværksteknikker og moderne teknologi. Fra stålskrot til flydende smelte og fra traditionelle sandstøbeforme til 3D-scanning og robotteknologi. Du vil få indsigt i hele fremstillingsprocessen: modelfremstilling, jernsmeltning, støbning, efterbearbejdning og slutkontrol. Kort sagt, en kombination af praktisk arbejde og teori

Kort om uddannelsen:

  • Uddannelsen tager 3,5 år og består af et grundforløb samt i alt 22 ugers skoleophold fordelt på 3 hovedforløb som afholdes på Uddannelsescenter Holstebro (UCH).
  • En praktikplads hos BIRN - én af Nordeuropas største støberikoncerner
  • Mulighed for at tilpasse uddannelsen efter dine egne interesser

Læs meget mere om uddannelsens spændende muligheder på

Hvad kan BIRN tilbyde:

  • En læreplads i en stor virksomhed med fokus på godt arbejdsmiljø
  • En spændende og tempofyldt hverdag med faglige udfordringer
  • Mulighed for udvekslingsophold med andre spændende virksomheder
  • Et stort team af dygtige kollegaer som på tværs af anciennitet og faglighed hjælper hinanden - rummelighed og ordentlighed.
  • En uddannelse, der giver dig en stærk faglig håndværksbaggrund og viden om hele produktionskæden
  • En læreplads som er bevidst om, at udviklingen går stærkt og som arbejder målrettet på, at uddanne faglærte og specialiserede medarbejdere, som kan varetage processer og materiel
  • En god kantineordning, pension gennem Industriens Pension, og PFA sundhedsforsikring

Din profil:

  • Du har gåpåmod og lyst til at lære nyt
  • Du er mødestabil og klar på at tage initiativ
  • Du er passioneret omkring praktisk arbejde og sætter en ære i det gode håndværk

Ansøgning:

  • Vi læser ansøgninger og holder samtaler løbende, så ansøg hurtigst muligt.
  • Ved spørgsmål kontakt gerne uddannelsesansvarlig Morten Larsen på tlf. 81 88 97 54 eller mail ml@birn.dk
  • Vigtigt: Af hensyn til GDPR-behandling besvarer vi kun ansøgninger, der er modtaget via vores rekrutteringssystem. Ansøgninger sendt pr. mail vil ikke blive besvaret

VIRKSOMHEDEN

BIRN i Holstebro er hovedsæde for en af Nordeuropas største støberikoncerner med selskaber i Danmark, Sverige, Tyskland og Italien. Vi tilbyder komplette løsninger i støbejern - fra støbning til bearbejdning og overfladebehandling. Vores kunder tæller bl.a. Grundfos, Scania og Volvo.

Vi er ca. 750 medarbejdere - heraf ca. 470 i Holstebro - og størstedelen af vores produktion eksporteres til det europæiske marked.

Vi tager ansvar - for kvalitet, miljø og hinanden. Vores støbejern består af 93 % genanvendt materiale, og den cirkulære tankegang er en integreret del af vores hverdag. Vores styrke er vores engagerede medarbejdere og samarbejdet på tværs af hele koncernen.

title: Självgående säkerhetstekniker sökes till BIAB Lås & Larm
description:
OBS! Vi tar endast emot ansökningar via ansökningslänken och kan inte garantera att vi läser din ansökan om du skickar den på mejl. BIAB Lås & Larm är ett tryggt och väletablerat säkerhetsföretag som arbetar med installationer och service av moderna säkerhetslösningar till både företag och offentlig verksamhet. Vi erbjuder allt från passersystem, larm och kameraövervakning till brandlarm och porttelefoner och vi är med från planering till färdig lösning.

Just nu växer vi och söker dig som vill ta ett steg in i säkerhetsbranschen som montör. Hos oss får du arbeta praktiskt, lära dig av erfarna kollegor och utvecklas tillsammans med ett engagerat team.

I rollen som montör får du lära dig yrket genom att assistera våra erfarna tekniker vid installation och service av säkerhetssystem. Du kommer att vara en viktig del i teamet och utvecklas i takt med att du får mer erfarenhet och ansvar.

Dina arbetsuppgifter kommer bland annat att vara:

  • Lära sig kring kabelinfrastruktur och uppbyggnaden av olika system.

  • Assistera vid installation av larm, passersystem, CCTV och brandlarm

  • Hjälpa till med felsökning och enklare service

  • Lära dig arbeta med system från leverantörer som Vanderbilt, RCO, ASSA ARX och UTC

  • Förbereda material och verktyg inför uppdrag

  • Sköta dokumentation av utfört arbete i system och app.

Vi söker dig som:

Har minst ett års erfarenhet och har ett genuint tekniskt intresse. Kanske har du gått el eller teknikprogram på gymnasiet, jobbat praktiskt inom bygg eller el, eller kanske skruvat mycket på egen hand. Det är viktigt att du vill lära dig och har rätt inställning!

Eftersom du kommer att arbeta hos våra kunder ser vi gärna att du är:

Nyfiken och lärande: Du är inte rädd att ställa frågor eller testa nytt.

Noggrann: Säkerhet handlar om detaljer, du förstår vikten av att göra rätt.

Serviceinriktad: Du gillar att ge ett bra intryck och bemöta kunder professionellt.

Punktlig och ansvarstagande: Vi litar på att du dyker upp i tid och tar ansvar.

Krav:

B-körkort- du kommer behöva ta dig mellan olika kunduppdrag.

El eller teleteknisk utbildning.

God svenska i tal och skrift – eftersom du kommunicerar med både kunder och kollegor.

Goda tekniska färdigheter – antingen genom utbildning eller praktisk erfarenhet.

Meriterande:

Tidigare erfarenhet av montering, el eller lås.

Säkerhetsrelaterade utbildningar (ex. brand, larm, CCTV).

Övrigt:

Start: Efter överenskommelse.

Arbetstider: 7 - 16.

Placering: Vi har kontor i Tullinge, och genomför jobb i hela Stockholmsområdet.

Lön: Fast månadslön.

Anställningsform: Heltid tillsvidare, vi tillämpar 6 månaders provanställning. Rekryteringen görs i samarbete med Tillväxt Botkyrka. Urvalet sker löpande och dina svar på ansökningsfrågorna ligger till grund för bedömning av din ansökan. På grund av hur annonsplattformen är uppbyggd kan Tillväxt Botkyrka stå som avsändare, men tjänsten är hos BIAB Lås & Larm.

title: Introduktionsstilling i intern medicin ved Medicinske Sygdomme, Sygehus Sønderjylland, Sønderborg i specialerne endokrinologi, nefrologi, hæmatologi og lungemedicin
description:
Tiltrædelse 1. december 2026 eller efter aftale.

Arbejdssted: Medicinske Sygdomme, Sygehus Sønderjylland, Sønderborg

Medicinske sygdomme, Sygehus Sønderjylland er en stor intern medicinsk afdeling fordelt på 3 matrikler; Sønderborg, Aabenraa og Tønder. Introduktionsstilling på Sønderborg matriklen giver mulighed for fordybelse i et eller flere af vores intern medicinske specialer i endokrinologi, nefrologi, lungemedicin og hæmatologi. Såfremt du har interesse i et af specialerne på afdelingens matrikel i Aabenraa, geriatri og gastroenterologi, er kombination også en mulighed.

Vi arbejder målrettet på at skabe et dynamisk og innovativt fagligt miljø, hvor patienten er i centrum. Vi tror på, at et højt niveau af engagement, faglighed og professionalisme er til gavn for vores patienter og deres pårørende. Det understøtter vi blandt andet ved at prioritere det tværfaglige uddannelsesmiljø og forskning højt i afdelingen. Samtidig sætter vi fokus på sammenhængende patientforløb, patient- og pårørendeinddragelse.

Medicinske Sygdomme arbejder efter visionen ”Vi er sammen om din sundhed”.

Vi ser det som vores kerneopgave at have fokus på hele den sønderjyske population. Vi har derfor fokus på forebyggelse, men også på at behandle patienter tæt på, og ofte i eget hjem i samarbejde med patient, pårørende, øvrige intern medicinske specialer og kommune.

Medicinske sygdomme, Sygehus Sønderjylland, Sønderborg varetager følgende funktioner:

  • Endokrinologi
  • Nefrologi inkl. hæmodialyse
  • Lungemedicin
  • Hæmatologi
  • Onkologi
  • Palliation (med selvstændigt sengeafsnit)
  • Medicinsk Modtagelse med døgndækket akutfunktion, daghospital og diagnostisk center.
Du indgår som forvagt i døgndækket tilstedeværelsesvagt i Medicinsk Modtagelse, der er dobbeltbemandet til klokken 23.30, samt efter individuel vurdering som bagvagt 2 i dagtiden. Der er bagvagt i tilstedeværelsesvagt hele døgnet.

Derudover vil du have funktion i ambulatorie og eventuelt i hæmodialysen samt gå stuegang på sengeafsnit.

Vores tilbud:

  • Bred intern medicinsk uddannelse
  • Du tilknyttes op til to forskellige afsnit, med 6 måneder i hvert – så vidt muligt efter eget ønske.
  • Rig lejlighed til at afprøve dine interesser inden for de intern medicinske grenspecialer. Afdelingen har i øjeblikket hoveduddannelsesforløb i nefrologi, lungemedicin, endokrinologi, geriatri, almen medicin samt dele af hoveduddannelsen i reumatologi og kardiologi
  • Mulighed for at udvikle organisatoriske og administrative kompetencer
  • Mulighed for at blive oplært i procedurer som ascitespunktur og pleurapunktur
  • Alle uddannelseslæger tilbydes kursus i fokuseret lungeultralyd under deres ansættelse.
Vi forventer, at du:

  • Er energisk, engageret og fleksibel
  • Har gode samarbejdsevner og lyst til at indgå i et tværfagligt samarbejde, der har fokus på høj faglighed og sammenhængende patientforløb
  • Deltager i kvalitetssikring af behandlingen
Der foreligger godkendt uddannelsesprogram til stillingen. I tillæg til gennemførelse af individuelle uddannelsesplaner til opnåelse af de generelle intern medicinske kompetencer, vil der som følge af grenspecialetilknytning være mulighed for supplerende uddannelse, blandt andet med henblik på kvalificering til senere hoveduddannelsesforløb.

Der vil være mulighed for at deltage i forskningsaktivitet, såfremt det har din interesse.



Løn og overenskomst:

Regionen er forpligtet til at oplyse dig om startlønnen for stillingen. Du får oplyst grundløn, centralt fastsatte tillæg og pension i Underordnede læger - overenskomst 33.06.1 - løn pr. 1.4.2026. Udover startlønnen, kan lønnen indeholde eventuelt forhandlede tillæg afhængigt af stillingen, dine erfaringer og kvalifikationer.

Se startløn for stillinger i Region Syddanmark . Ansættelsesvilkår efter gældende overenskomst.

Ansøgningsfrist den 02.10.2026

Ansættelsessamtaler forventes afholdt i uge 41

Yderligere oplysninger fås hos:

  • Cheflæge, klinisk lektor, Frans Brandt Kristensen, tlf. 7997 3010, FBK@rsyd.dk
  • Uddannelsesansvarlig overlæge Thomas Raffnsøe Hoeg, tlf. 79971763, Thomas.Raffnsoe.Hoeg@rsyd.dk

title: Hammaslääkäri, Länsimäen terveysaseman hammashoitola
description:
Terveydenhuollon palvelujen toimiala, Suun terveydenhuollon palvelut
Länsimäen terveysaseman hammashoitola
Keilakuja 1, 01280 Vantaa

Me VAKEssa rakennamme yhdessä rohkeasti hyvinvointialuetta, johon asukkaamme voivat luottaa. Haluamme olla vakaa edelläkävijä, joka uudistaa toimintaa avoimesti ja ihmislähtöisesti. Arvomme oikeudenmukaisuus, vastuullisuus ja rohkeus ohjaavat arjen työtämme. Tunnistatko näistä myös omat arvosi?

Tule sinäkin Hyvantekijät-joukkueeseemme!

Haemme hammaslääkäriä määräaikaiseen sijaisuuteen Länsimäen terveysaseman hammashoitolaan.

Hammaslääkärin tehtävässä yhdistyvät kliininen asiantuntijuus, potilaslähtöinen työote ja tiivis yhteistyö muun hoitohenkilökunnan kanssa. Työ painottuu suun terveyden kokonaisvaltaiseen hoitoon, hoitosuunnitelmien laatimiseen sekä kiireellisten vastaanottotilanteiden hallintaan.

Keskeiset tehtävät:

- Potilaiden kokonaisvaltainen hoito ja hoitosuunnitelmien laatiminen
- Hammaslääkärin vastaanottotyö
- Kiireellisen vastaanoton työtehtävät
- Yhteistyö muun hoitohenkilökunnan kanssa

Tehtävässä menestyminen edellyttää Suomessa laillistettua hammaslääkärin pätevyyttä, vahvaa ammatillista osaamista sekä hyviä vuorovaikutustaitoja. Työssä korostuu asiakaslähtöinen työote ja kyky toimia osana moniammatillista tiimiä. Arvostamme oma-aloitteisuutta ja halua kehittää sekä omaa osaamista että työyhteisön toimintaa. Työkielenä on suomen kieli.

Länsimäen terveysaseman hammashoitola on osa Vantaan ja Keravan hyvinvointialueen suun terveydenhuollon palveluja. Olemme siirtyneet omatiimi- ja omahammaslääkärimalliin, jossa jokaisella alueella on oma väestövastuu. Länsimäen yksikössä työskentelet osana itäisen Vantaan omatiimiä.

Yksikössämme on 15 hoitohuonetta, ja tiimiin kuuluu moneen erikoisalaan perehtyneitä hammaslääkäreitä, kokeneita suuhygienistejä ja hoitajia. Työyhteisömme on osaava, yhteistyöhön kannustava ja kehittämismyönteinen. Tavoitteenamme on tarjota laadukasta ja asiakaslähtöistä hoitoa sekä kehittää palveluita yhdessä henkilöstön kanssa.

Miksi Vantaan ja Keravan hyvinvointialue?

Meillä hyvinvointi ja arjen sujuvuus ovat aidosti tärkeitä. Tarjoamme lounasedun sekä 400 euron Epassi-edun liikuntaan, kulttuuriin, hyvinvointiin tai työmatkoihin. Lisäksi hyvinvointiasi tukevat lakisääteiset työterveyspalvelumme.

Olemme ihmisläheinen organisaatio, jossa kehitämme toimintaa rohkeasti ja yhdessä. Meillä johtaminen on lupaus selkeistä tavoitteista, arvostavasta kohtaamisesta ja rohkeasta yhdessä uudistamisesta.

Saat selkeän näkymän omaan työhösi sekä mahdollisuuksia kokeilla ja kehittää uusia tapoja tehdä työtä. Tarjoamme mahdollisuuksia myös oman osaamisesi vahvistamiseen ja urasi kehittämiseen. Teemme merkityksellistä työtä joka päivä: autamme, hoidamme ja pelastamme.

title: Research Grants and Contracts Specialist
description:
ABOUT VITALIEF
Vitalief is a clinical research consulting firm focused exclusively on the clinical research industry, providing consulting, staffing, and technology-enabled services to academic medical centers, health systems, sponsors, CROs, and site networks. By combining deep subject matter expertise with the experience of senior research practitioners, we help organizations accelerate study activation, optimize operations, improve financial performance, and build scalable workforce solutions that reduce costs, increase efficiency, and advance clinical breakthroughs for patients.

Position Overview
Vitalief is seeking an experienced Pre and Post-Award Research Grants & Contracts Specialist to support a major statewide clinical research initiative for a leading academic medical center in New Jersey.

The Specialist will manage and coordinate a portfolio of research, engineering, and education-related grants across the full pre- and post-award lifecycle. This role will work closely with Principal Investigators, institutional leadership, and cross-functional teams including Research Administration, Finance, Sponsored Programs, Contracts, Regulatory/IRB, Data, Operations, and external collaborators.

WHY VITALIEF?
  • People-First Culture: Join a collaborative environment focused on professional growth, innovation, and teamwork.
  • Comprehensive Benefits: Enjoy 20 PTO days, 9 paid holidays, company-paid life insurance, short- and long-term disability coverage, a 401(k) retirement plan, and comprehensive healthcare benefits.
  • Work Location: This is a 100% remote position (EST Zone work hours).
  • Salary Range: $80,000 – $110,000 annually, depending on experience level.

RESPONSIBILITIES:
Pre-Award Grant Administration
  • Review and coordinate grant and contract proposals for completeness, accuracy, and compliance with sponsor and institutional requirements.
  • Assist Principal Investigators and research teams with proposal development, budgets, justifications, required forms, and supporting documentation.
  • Coordinate multi-investigator and multi-institutional proposals and ensure submissions meet internal and sponsor deadlines.
  • Submit proposals through institutional systems and sponsor portals and maintain accurate submission records.
  • Serve as a liaison between sponsors and Principal Investigators regarding questions and requirements before award issuance.

Post-Award Administration
  • Coordinate award setup, budget management, financial monitoring, reporting, subawards, and closeout activities.
  • Monitor budgets and expenditures, assist with forecasting, and identify and resolve financial or compliance issues.
  • Prepare and submit Research Performance Progress Reports (RPPRs) and other required progress reports.
  • Coordinate sponsor prior-approval requests, including no-cost extensions, budget changes, changes in scope or PI, and carryforward requests.
  • Ensure compliance with sponsor terms, institutional policies, and applicable federal and state requirements.

Project Coordination & Stakeholder Management
  • Serve as a central point of contact for assigned grant portfolios and coordinate activities across faculty, research administration, Finance, Contracts, Regulatory/IRB, Data, Operations, and external collaborators.
  • Track project deliverables, milestones, deadlines, dependencies, and sponsor requirements.
  • Identify and proactively address risks, gaps, issues, and potential delays.
  • Coordinate meetings, action items, communications, and follow-up across multiple workstreams.
  • Provide regular project and portfolio status updates to leadership.
  • Maintain comprehensive and organized project documentation to support continuity and knowledge transfer.

Systems & Process Management
  • Maintain accurate grant, award, personnel, budget, and milestone information within institutional research administration systems.
  • Support system enhancements, user acceptance testing, and process improvement initiatives.


Required Qualifications:
  • Bachelor's degree in life sciences, public health, healthcare administration, business, or a related field.
  • 5+ years of experience in grants administration, sponsored research, research administration, clinical research, or project management.
  • Experience managing complex pre- and post-award grants, preferably within an academic medical center, university, healthcare system, or research consortium.
  • Strong understanding of the full research grant lifecycle, including proposal development, submission, award setup, budgeting, compliance, reporting, subawards, and closeout.
  • Experience working with federal, state, nonprofit, and/or for-profit funding agencies, including NIH, DARPA, and other federal research sponsors.
  • Experience with grant submission and research administration platforms such as Grants.gov, NIH eRA Commons/ASSIST, Research.gov, DARPA submission systems, NSPIRES (NASA), NJ SAGE, and/or ProposalCentral.
  • Experience working closely with Principal Investigators and multidisciplinary research teams.
  • Strong knowledge of grant budgeting, financial monitoring, forecasting, and sponsored research compliance.
  • Experience coordinating multiple stakeholders, workstreams, deadlines, and deliverables in a matrixed environment.
  • Excellent communication, organization, problem-solving, and relationship-management skills.
  • Ability to influence and drive accountability across teams without direct authority.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office, particularly Excel, Word, and PowerPoint.
  • Experience with multi-institutional research, subrecipients, or external collaborators is preferred.
  • Certified Research Administrator (CRA) certification is a plus.

PHYSICAL DEMANDS: Prolonged periods of sitting at a desk and working at a computer. Standing, walking, visual perception, talking and hearing. Lifting up to 20lbs.

title: Technical Program Manager, Business Development (Mandarin Speaking)
description:
Founded with the vision to electrify everything, Group14 is the leading commercial manufacturer of advanced silicon battery materials. Our breakthrough technology, SCC55®, is unlocking transformational performance for rechargeable batteries that power the world’s most critical innovations, from electric vehicles and AI-enabled electronics to eVTOLs and grid-scale energy storage. By enabling higher-density, faster-charging batteries, we are helping accelerate the global transition to an electrified future.

Over the past year, Group14 reached major milestones that underscore our momentum. We closed a $463 million Series D round, bringing our total equity raised to more than $1 billion, and acquired full ownership of a battery materials factory in South Korea, strengthening global supply chains and scaling production to meet surging demand. Headquartered in Washington state with manufacturing operations worldwide, Group14 is backed by world-class investors and customers, including Porsche, ATL, Microsoft, and SK Inc. As we continue to grow, we are building a team united by passion for shaping the future of energy.

Group14 Technologies is looking for a Technical Program Manager (TPM) to join our Business Development organization to drive customer adoption and technical qualification of our silicon-carbon composite anode material, SCC55®. Functioning as the key technical bridge between commercial partners, including top-tier automotive OEMs, consumer electronics leaders, and global cell manufacturers, and internal engineering teams, you will oversee joint development agreements, sampling pipelines, and customer validation milestones from initial engagement through commercial program delivery.

WHAT YOU’LL BE DOING:

  • Customer Technical Lead: Serve as the primary technical program interface for commercial partners, facilitating technical deep-dives, specifications matching, and Joint Development Agreements (JDAs).

  • Qualification Management: Drive customer sampling programs and cell qualification cycles to meet customer gating requirements.

  • Cross-Functional Alignment: Partner closely with program managers, business development managers, R&D, Quality, and Manufacturing Operations to translate customer specifications into internal product roadmaps and technical deliverables.

  • Risk & Timeline Execution: Establish project scopes, timelines, and risk mitigation strategies to ensure key program milestones are delivered on schedule.

  • Technical Advocacy: Synthesize OEM testing feedback and battery testing data to refine application guidelines and present technical progress to external and internal executive stakeholders.

WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR:

  • Language Requirement: Fluency in Mandarin (native or professional full-working proficiency, written and spoken) is required to interface directly with major Asian cell manufacturing partners and supply chain stakeholders.

  • Education: B.S. or M.S. in Materials Science, Chemical Engineering, Chemistry, Electrochemical Engineering, or a related technical discipline.

  • Experience: 4+ years of technical program management, application engineering, or technical customer success experience in the lithium-ion battery, advanced materials, or automotive/EV sectors.

  • Domain Knowledge: Hands-on familiarity with lithium-ion cell chemistry, silicon-anode development, electrode formulation, and battery testing standards.

  • Communication & Execution: Proven ability to manage multi-stakeholder technical projects, translate complex data for commercial teams, and navigate high-stakes OEM engagements.

OTHER QUALITIES WE’D LOVE FOR YOU TO HAVE:

  • Direct experience with silicon-carbon composite materials or advanced battery chemistry scaling.

  • Prior exposure to automotive OEM cell qualification standards (e.g., APQP, PPAP) or tier-1 cell manufacturing processes.

  • Ability to travel up to 25% for partner meetings and facility visits.
Base Pay Range
$110,000—$150,000 USD

GROUP14 OFFERS COMPELLING BENEFITS

  • Medical, Dental, and Vision: 100% paid for by the company for employees (80% for dependents) with an HSA-eligible plan option for Medical
  • Employee Assistance Program
  • Long-Term and Short-Term Disability Insurance
  • Life Insurance and AD and D Insurance (100% Employer Paid)
  • Option to purchase additional Life and AD and D Insurance (with guaranteed issue) and Accident, Critical Illness, and Hospital Insurance coverages for you and dependents at affordable rates
  • Discounted rates on Pet Insurance
  • 401(k) with Pre-Tax and Roth options and Company Match
  • Paid Time Off and Floating Holidays
  • Stock Options

GROUP14 IS AN EQUAL OPPORTUNITY EMPLOYER

We love creating opportunities for others by connecting people from widely diverse backgrounds, perspectives, and geographies. Being a diverse and inclusive company isn’t just something we strive for, it's who we are and part of what we do each and every single day. We want to ensure that as an employee, you belong and that Group14 is the kind of workplace where you feel safe, included, and that you have the opportunity to thrive in your career.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, marital status, protected veteran status, disability status or any other characteristic protected by applicable local laws, regulations and ordinances.

If you need any assistance or an accommodation due to a disability, please email: careers@group14.technology. This information will be treated as confidential and used only for the purpose of determining an appropriate accommodation for the application and/or interview process.

Group14 is committed to a safe and productive work environment. As part of our hiring process, we conduct pre-employment drug screenings for substances in accordance with state and federal regulations. Please note that our pre-employment drug screening process does not include testing for THC.

Please note: We are not able to accommodate candidates in need of work sponsorship at this time.

NOTICE TO STAFFING AGENCIES AND SEARCH FIRMS

Group14 does not accept unsolicited resumes or candidate submittals from staffing agencies and search firms. Any resumes or candidate submittals sent to our careers site (directly or via job boards) or directly to Group14 employees will not be eligible for any placement fee, and the resume/candidate will be added to our database for direct recruitment.

Group14 only assigns positions to staffing agencies and search firms who are pre-approved by HR and that we have a current agreement with. Not all positions are eligible for a placement fee.

title: Global Operations Associate
location: København, Capital Region of Denmark, Denmark
description:
About Flexport:

At Flexport, we believe global trade can move the human race forward. That’s why it’s our mission to make global commerce so easy there will be more of it. We’re shaping the future of a $10T industry with solutions powered by innovative technology and exceptional people. Today, companies of all sizes—from emerging brands to Fortune 500s—use Flexport technology to move more than $19B of merchandise across 112 countries a year.

The recent global supply chain crisis has put Flexport center stage as we continue to play a pivotal role in how goods move around the world. We are proud to have the support of the best investors in the game who believe in our mission, solutions and people. Ready to tackle global challenges that impact business, society, and the environment? Come join us.

Your responsibilities as a Global Operations Associate include, but are not limited to the following:

  • Be the 'front line' in ensuring the highest standard of Flexport quality: shipments move on-time, exceptions are handled proactively, and clients receive a first-class experience through timely, clear communication.
  • Be responsible for ensuring your work satisfies internal KPIs and SLAs that demonstrate quality delivery, independently managing your priorities and commitments.
  • Follow standard operating procedures (SOP) and proactively flag opportunities for improvement.
  • Solve client issues quickly and ensure smooth operations at origin and destination, developing solutions independently and escalating to senior team members as needed
  • Act in the best interest of the company by avoiding leakages and ensuring cost conscious behavior.
  • Seamlessly coordinate day-to-day operations with the relevant internal and external partners for your team's scope (e.g. carriers, vendors, customs, regional trade lane management, cross-functional stakeholders, etc)
  • Execute the end-to-end movement of freight shipments within a regional network (both imports and exports), including intermodal movements.
  • Assist the shipments managed by partners as we drive partner autonomy and parity with insourced operations (if applicable in a given region).
  • Use data and operational tools to inform decisions, identify patterns in your work, and contribute to efficiency improvements.

Requirements:

  • BA/BS Degree or completed professional training as forwarding agent ([local degree/certification if applicable]).
  • 2+ years of experience in operations, logistics or freight forwarding
  • Able to adapt to new technology and can thrive in a fast paced environment.
  • Effective time management. Be able to properly prioritize and manage a large volume of tasks.
  • Attention to detail.
  • Ability to effectively seek and receive feedback.
  • Effective communication both verbally and in writing.
  • Teamwork and relationship building.
  • Orientation towards working smarter and adopting best practices and standardization.
  • Problem-solving capabilities.
  • A “compliance first” attitude to keep our regulators happy and enthusiastic about Flexport since we operate in a heavily regulated industry.
  • A client service mindset; you are obsessed with client satisfaction, and strive to investigate and troubleshoot the client’s problem.
  • Language requirement: Mandatory Danish and fluency in English.

What's in there for you:

  • An opportunity to contribute to one of the fastest-growing companies, where you’ll have the chance to create a global impact while being a part of a thriving multinational environment
  • Daily catered lunch including vegetarian options, additionally the office is stocked with breakfast items, healthy snacks, and drinks.
  • Pension scheme
  • Medical Insurance which is covered under the pension scheme mentioned above.
  • Flexport employees in Denmark are insured and covered under the rules and regulations set up between Employer and Employee.
  • 30 vacation days a year
  • Equity program: every team member becomes a shareholder, aligning our success with yours. As a private company in a multi-trillion dollar industry, you have a direct stake in our collective growth and success.
  • Employee Assistance Program through Aetna Resources for Living: Flexport provides an employer-sponsored program at no cost to you and your household members
  • Parental leave benefit: Flexport is here to support you and your families in one of the most important times in life – the birth of a child! Our parental leave program allows both mothers and partners to take time off from work for pregnancy, childbirth, and to bond with your new child.



Commitment to Equal Opportunity

At Flexport, our ability to fulfill our mission of making global commerce easy and accessible relies on having a diverse, dedicated and engaged workforce. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment regardless of race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, physical and mental disability, health status, marital and family status, sexual orientation, gender identity and expression, military and veteran status, and any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

Global Data Privacy Notice for Job Candidates and Applicants

Depending on your location, the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) and California Consumer Privacy Act (CCPA) may regulate the way we manage the data of job applicants. By submitting your application, you are agreeing to our use and processing of your data as required. Please see our Privacy Notice available at for additional information.

title: Specialistläkare/BÖL/ÖL, Barn- och Ungdomsmedicin, Södertälje sjukhus
company: Södertälje sjukhus, Verksamhetsområden, VO Kvinnor-Barn, Läkare Barn
description:
Verksamhetsområde Kvinnor-Barn omfattar BB Södertälje, Barn- och ungdomsmedicinsk mottagning (BUMM) samt Gynekologi och kvinnosjukvård. Vi är ett familjärt verksamhetsområde med ca 200 medarbetare som arbetar nära varandra oavsett profession. Hos oss är patienten och familjen alltid i fokus. Med hög delaktighet och korta beslutsvägar finns en stor möjlighet att göra skillnad som medarbetare. Centralt i vår verksamhet är en inkluderande atmosfär som drivs av hög kompetens, god stämning, starkt engagemang och en öppenhet för förändring.

Specialistläkare/BÖL/ÖL till Barn-och ungdomsmedicinska mottagningen, Södertälje sjukhus

Välkommen till en arbetsplats som präglas av hög patient- och föräldranöjdhet, god stämning, stort engagemang och goda utvecklingsmöjligheter. En stor del av vården bedrivs tillsammans med våra kompetenta sjuksköterskor och undersköterskor i team (astma/allergi, uroterapi, obesitas, gastroenterologi, ADHD och allmänpediatrik). På mottagningen arbetar även uroterapeut, psykologer och dietister.

Vi söker dig som är specialist i barn- och ungdomsmedicin som är intresserad av att behålla och utveckla en bred kompetens, men samtidigt ingå i ett team med stora möjligheter att utveckla spetskompetens, samt att påverka arbetssätt och utformning av vården.

Arbetsuppgifterna är huvudsakligen mottagningsarbete där du har eller utvecklar din specialinriktning samt handlägger patientfall med stor variation av olika sjukdomstillstånd. I tjänsten ingår även arbete och jourarbete på vår integrerade BB/förlossning, där det föds omkring 2000 barn per år. BB Södertälje är en lågriskenhet med förlossningar från graviditetsvecka 36 och har en verksamhet med medarbetardrivna, kontinuerliga förbättringsarbeten som genererat goda kvalitetsresultat för våra födande och nyfödda.

I tjänsten ingår möjlighet till visst distansarbete med telefontider, videobesök och administration.

Vi värnar om att arbete hos oss ska gå att kombinera med privatliv och är därför flexibla och utgår i största mån efter medarbetarnas önskemål vid schemaläggning.

Dina personliga egenskaper:

Du är en engagerad, noggrann och omdömesgill person med god förmåga att samarbeta i team. Du är flexibel, har gott omdöme och goda specialistkunskaper. Du sätter patienten i centrum och gör ditt bästa för att ge en god, evidensbaserad och omsorgsfull vård.

Stor vikt läggs vid personliga egenskaper.

Dina kvalifikationer:

Krav:

- Specialist inom Barn- och ungdomsmedicin.

- Goda kunskaper i svenska i såväl tal som skrift.

Meriterande:

- Inriktning mot eller intresse för barngastroenterologi, barnallergologi, barnobesitas eller neonatologi.

title: Produktionsmedarbetare!
description:
Om företaget

NearYou är ett rekryterings- och bemanningsföretag med kontor i 17 städer. Vi har gått från att vara ett bolag bland andra i branschen till att också bli en samhällsaktör. Med oss som partner och arbetsgivare lovar vi att ge mer av det vi är bäst på. Vi är bäst på att vara nära, mänskliga och en motpol till stress, människor som statistik och en alltför opersonlig digitalisering. Vi är hos dig, ett handslag, ett löfte. För dig som kandidat innebär det en aktör som backar dig, oavsett var i karriären du är och vill vara. Vi vill vara tryggheten i en snabb värld. Vi stöttar, utmanar och frågar hur det går. Helt naturligt, tycker vi. Läs gärna mer om oss på www.nearyou.se

Tjänstebeskrivning

Vi söker dig till arbete inom industriell produktion där du blir en viktig del av ett team som arbetar med avancerade material inom metallindustrin. Arbetet sker i en modern produktionsmiljö med kontinuerlig drift där fokus ligger på kvalitet, precision och effektivt produktionsflöde. Du arbetar med processer som kräver noggrannhet och förståelse för industriella tillverkningsmetoder. I rollen ingår att övervaka och stödja produktionsprocesser, arbeta med hantering av material samt bidra till att produktionen håller hög och jämn kvalitet. Arbetet kan även innebära kontroll, justering och enklare underhåll i produktionen.

Kvalifikationer

Vi söker dig som: *Har erfarenhet från industri eller tillverkningsarbete *Har god arbetsmoral och en positiv inställning *Trivs i en produktionsmiljö med högt tempo och kontinuerlig drift *Är noggrann och ansvarstagande *Har god samarbetsförmåga men kan även arbeta självständigt *Har erfarenhet av maskiner eller produktionsutrustning (meriterande) *Har truckkort (meriterande) *Kan arbeta skift *Har B-körkort och tillgång till bil (krav) *Behärskar svenska i tal och skrift Vi lägger stor vikt vid personliga egenskaper och rätt inställning till arbetet.

Låter detta intressant?

Din ansökan skickar du in via NearYous hemsida, www.nearyou.se snarast. Vi jobbar med löpande urval, så skicka gärna din ansökan idag. Vänligen notera att vi inte behandlar ansökningar som skickas via mejl. Med anledning av nya dataskyddsförordningen GDPR, ber vi dig att utesluta de sista fyra siffrorna i ditt personnummer samt eventuella referenskontakter i din ansökan/CV. Välkommen med din ansökan!

Om NearYou

Som konsult hos NearYou är du anställd hos oss och arbetar ute hos någon av våra kunder. För oss är det viktigt att erbjuda en trygg och hållbar anställning för alla våra anställda. Du har samma fördelar och trygghet som hos en traditionell arbetsgivare och du omfattas av kollektivavtalens villkor för till exempel lön, försäkringar, pension och semester. Som konsult hos oss får du en konsultchef som hjälper dig i ditt val av uppdrag och ger dig tips och råd hur du kan utvecklas i arbetslivet. Du får även möta olika företagskulturer och får erfarenhet från olika branscher, vilket gör att du utvecklar din kompetens och ditt nätverk och gör dig till en mer attraktiv medarbetare.

title: Senior Java Developer – London – Fintech
description:
WE ARE:


At Adaptive, we are a financial consulting firm that partners with capital, commodity, and digital market participants. We value differentiation through technology. Our experienced teams design and deliver complex front-office technology solutions using our proven accelerators to create long-term competitive advantage.

Our clients include the world’s leading investment banks, investment managers, fintechs and capital market service providers. With a global reach with offices in London, New York, Barcelona, Montreal and Manila, we have a proven track record delivering powerful, elegant and intuitive trading technology solutions.

We are expanding our product capability and looking for talented individuals to help build transformational capital markets products including:

  • Aeron - our flagship high-performance messaging infrastructure.
  • Hydra - our developer framework for accelerating the development and delivery of trading systems.
  • Artio - our market-leading open-source FIX engine.
  • Aeron Sequencer - replicated state machines at scale.

YOU ARE:

  • A JVM lover who really enjoys working with the latest technologies and design patterns
  • Eager to solve complex technical challenges, especially in cloud-based environments and event driven architecture patterns
  • Someone looking to work in a collaborative environment, sharing knowledge and helping each other
  • Experienced within the Fintech industry

YOU HAVE:

  • Significant, professional server-side software development experience
  • Solid experience programming using Core Java. Exposure to Java 25+ is a plus
  • General familiarity with data structures such as sets, hashes, caches etc
  • Experience developing Front Office financial systems, E-Trading and FIX
  • Experience in delivering OMS/EMS/Exchange systems
  • Exposure to equities trading & brokerage
  • General knowledge of data injection/inversion of control
  • Experience working in an Agile environment (Scrum, Kanban)
  • Exposure to WebSocket

WHY US:

  • To be immersed in high-standard engineering culture. Our fantastic team takes pride in crafting complex technical solutions but also loves sharing their knowledge and helping you grow professionally (we have extraordinary minds at Adaptive, you can learn from anyone here, which is the beauty of it)
  • To take part in the growth and development of a great company
  • Our teams feel free to speak up, make suggestions and raise concerns
  • Collaborative team environment: we all work together, respect each other, and pitch in
  • Great consideration for work/life balance (highly-flexible, hybrid working model, well-being benefits…). The balance between professional and personal life is massively important to us
  • We work hard to provide a positive, collaborative and inclusive culture and to positively impact our staff and local communities through different well-being, diversity and inclusion programmes

WHAT PEOPLE THINK OF US
You can check our Glassdoor page

BENEFITS (What we offer in return // what you’ll get )

For permanent employees:

We create benefits with YOU in mind.

  • 25 days holiday
  • Family medical and dental
  • Pension plan
  • Season ticket loan
  • Gym subsidy
  • Life insurance
  • Long-term disability insurance
  • Employee Assistance Plan

For contractors:

All our contracts are outside IR35

THE PROCESS

Long interview processes are stressful and boring and that is not us

We want to make sure that everything runs smoothly.

So here you will have three stage interviews:
1- A chat with one of our great recruiters.
2- A zoom chat with one of our Java colleagues where they will ask you detailed questions about your experience
3- A Face to Face interview (either in our office or via Zoom). ​​During this interview, we will dig even deeper and you will have a pair programming task to do. You will also have a chat with our local director.

But don’t worry; everything will be explained to you step by step by your recruiter.


A little tip for you during those stages:

Collaboration is massively important to us, so don't hesitate to share your thoughts, ask questions, ask for help if needed, etc

DIVERSITY & INCLUSION:

Diversity and inclusion are key to a great workplace, and Adaptive is better when it’s more representative of the world around us. We want everyone to feel comfortable bringing their whole selves to work without any fear of judgment or negativity.

All we ask is that our colleagues are respectful, collaborative, passionate about what they do, and have the skills needed to be successful in their roles.

title: Erityisluokanopettaja
description:
Porvoo on kasvava ja monikulttuurinen kaupunki. Koulujemme toiminta perustuu yhdessä tekemiseen, oppimisen ja työn iloon sekä laadukaaseen pedagogiikkaan.

Kaupunki toimii vastuullisena ja vakaana työnantajana, joka tarjoaa henkilöstölle hyvät mahdollisuudet kehittyä ja vahvistaa osaamistaan. Modernit ja uudistetut koulumme tukevat sekä oppimista että opettamista, ja niissä korostuvat yhteisöllisyys, osallisuus ja kulttuurinen monimuotoisuus - arvot, jotka näkyvät arjessa sekä oppijoiden että opetushenkilöstön työssä.

Albert Edelfeltin koulu on noin 620 oppilaan yhtenäiskoulu, jossa toimivat vuosiluokat 1-9. Koulu sijaitsee 17 vuotta vanhassa rakennuksessa Näsin alueella keskustassa. Kiinteistö on saneerattu viimeisen kahden vuoden aikana, ja talossa on erinomaiset tilat opiskeluun ja harrastamiseen. Yhteisöllisyys ja turvallisuus ovat koulumme peruskivi: oppilaalle luodaan tuttu ja turvallinen yhdeksänvuotinen oppimispolku saman katon alla. Meille lapsi ja nuori on tärkeä ja koemme, että opetuksen laatu muodostuu arjen pienistä kohtaamisista.

Albert Edelfeltin koulussa työskentelee päivittäin yli 90 henkilökunnan jäsentä. Koulussa on hyvä yhteishenki: koulun arki muodostuu yhteisestä tekemisestä huumorilla täydennettynä. Koulun erityispiirteitä ovat ruotsinkielinen kielikylpyopetus vuosiluokilla 1-9 sekä kahdeksan erityisluokkaa, joista seitsemässä opiskelee vaativan erityisen tuen oppilaita. Koulun johtoryhmän muodostaa rehtori, virka-apulaisrehtori ja kolme apulaisjohtajaa.

Albert Edelfeltin koulun vaativan tuen erityisluokilla toimivat luokka-asteet E - 9. Oppilaat ovat eriasteisesti kehitysvammaisia ja/tai autismin kirjolla. Lisäksi oppilaille tarjotaan aamu- ja iltapäivätoimintaa sekä koulun lomien aikaista toimintaa. Yhteisöllisyys ja turvallisuus ovat koulun peruskivi: oppilaalle luodaan tuttu ja turvallinen yhdeksänvuotinen oppimispolku saman katon alla.

Erityisluokanopettajan tehtävänä on suunnitella ja toteuttaa vaativan erityisen tuen oppilaiden yksilöllisiä opiskelusisältöjä ja -tavoitteita sekä ohjeistaa ohjaajia työssään.

Toivomme hakijoiden kuvaavan seuraavia valintaan vaikuttavia edellytyksiä työhakemuksessa. Haastatteluun kutsuttavat valitaan työhakemusten perusteella.

Eduksi luetaan:
kokemusta vaativan erityisen tuen opetuksen suunnittelusta, toteutuksesta ja arvioinnista
hyviä yhteistyö- ja vuorovaikutustaitoja sekä ratkaisukeskeistä työotetta
kokemusta moniammatillisesta tiimityöskentelystä ja verkostoyhteistyöstä

Kelpoisuusehdot määräytyvät opetustoimen henkilöstön kelpoisuusvaatimuksista annetun asetuksen (986/1998) mukaisesti. Valitulla tulee olla erityisluokanopettajan kelpoisuus. Alkuperäiset kelpoisuuden osoittavat tutkintotodistukset tulee esittää mahdollisen haastattelun yhteydessä.

Palkkaus määräytyy kunnallisen opetusalan virka- ja työehtosopimuksen mukaan.

Virkaan valitun on esitettävä nähtäväksi lasten kanssa työskentelevien rikostaustan selvittämisestä annetun lain (504/2002) 3 §:n mukainen rikosrekisteriote.

Koeaika on puolet palvelussuhteen kestosta.

Tule mukaan tekemään tulevaisuuden työtä!

Lähetä hakemuksesi 5.10.2026 klo 15 mennessä Hae työpaikkaa -linkin kautta.

Lisätietoja antavat vaativan tuen erityisluokkien apulaisjohtaja Leena Laivaara puh. 040 154 7819, rehtori Janne Salmela puh. 040 152 4197 ja virka-apulaisrehtori Teemu Pohjola Korhonen puh. 040 194 1565.

title: Restaurangmedarbetare till Malmö & Lund- Majola öppnar i Skåne
description:
Tycker du om att arbeta med service, mat och människor? Majola Restaurangkonsult öppnar nu i Skåne och söker restaurangmedarbetare till uppdrag i Malmö, Lund och närliggande områden.

Som restaurangmedarbetare hos oss får du möjlighet att arbeta på olika restauranger, hotell, konferensanläggningar och andra verksamheter inom hotell- och restaurangbranschen. Arbetsuppgifterna varierar beroende på uppdrag och kan exempelvis innebära servering, bar, frukostservice, konferensservice, caféarbete, kassa, disk och enklare köksuppgifter.

Vi söker dig som trivs i en social och omväxlande arbetsmiljö och som alltid vill ge gästerna ett professionellt och trevligt bemötande. Du är flexibel, ansvarstagande och har lätt för att samarbeta med olika team. Oavsett om du har lång erfarenhet eller är i början av din karriär inom restaurang ser vi gärna att du hör av dig.

Vi vill att du:

  • har erfarenhet från restaurang, hotell, café, konferens eller annan serviceverksamhet

  • är serviceinriktad, positiv och tycker om att möta olika typer av gäster

  • är självgående, noggrann och tar ansvar för dina arbetsuppgifter

  • trivs med varierande arbetstempo och kan behålla lugnet när det är mycket att göra

  • har lätt för att samarbeta och snabbt sätta dig in i nya arbetsmiljöer och rutiner

  • kan arbeta dagtid, kvällar och helger beroende på uppdrag

  • talar och förstår svenska eller engelska.

Meriterande:

  • erfarenhet av à la carte-servering, konferens eller hotellfrukost

  • erfarenhet av bararbete, kassa eller enklare köksarbete

  • utbildning inom restaurang, hotell eller service

  • körkort och tillgång till bil.

Om Majola Restaurangkonsult

Majola är ett av Sveriges största bemanningsföretag inom hotell- och restaurangbranschen. Vi erbjuder varierande uppdrag hos välkända och uppskattade kunder och ger dig möjlighet att påverka när och var du vill arbeta. Nu etablerar vi oss i Skåne och bygger ett starkt nätverk av restaurangmedarbetare i Malmö, Lund och närområdet.

Du blir anställd av Majola och arbetar på uppdrag hos våra kunder. För dig som uppskattar variation, möten med människor och möjligheten att utvecklas inom restaurang och service är detta en spännande chans att bli en del av vår satsning i Skåne.

Känns detta som något för dig? Skicka in din ansökan redan idag. Vi ser fram emot att höra från dig!

title: Wardens Supervisor søges til OPARKO – med fokus på optimering af pladser og team
description:
Vil du stå i front for vores p-vagter og sikre, at vores kunder får den bedst mulige oplevelse?

Trives du med at være ude i felten, tage ansvar for et team og samtidig se de større linjer i optimering og samarbejde? Så er du måske vores nye Wardens Supervisor.

Om rollen

Som Wardens Supervisor hos OPARKO får du det daglige operationelle ansvar for vores team af p-vagter – og du er ude på pladserne sammen med dem. Rollen er placeret under Customer Success, og du bliver en central spiller i forhold til optimering af både interne arbejdsgange og samarbejdet med vores kunder.

Du sikrer, at pladserne drives optimalt, at vagtplaner og ruter giver mening, og at teamet af p-vagter er klædt på til at levere en professionel indsats hver dag. Samtidig er du med til at identificere, hvor vi og vores kunder kan få mere værdi ud af samarbejdet – og omsætte det til konkrete forbedringer i driften.

Dine arbejdsopgaver

  • Daglig ledelse og tilstedeværelse ude på pladserne sammen med teamet af p-vagter

  • Planlægning af vagtplaner, ruter og kontrolrunder, så pladserne drives optimalt

  • Løbende optimering af arbejdsgange for p-vagterne i felten

  • Oplæring af nye p-vagter og sparring om korrekt sagsbehandling

  • Tæt samarbejde med Customer Success om at optimere pladser og styrke samarbejdet

  • Identificere forbedringsmuligheder – både internt i teamet og i dialogen med kunderne

  • Opfølgning på performance og trivsel i teamet, samt afholdelse af 1:1-samtaler

Din profil

Vi søger en kandidat, der:

  • Har erfaring med ledelse af et team i en operativ rolle, gerne med meget tid i felten

  • Trives med at være ude på pladserne og ikke bag et skrivebord

  • Er stærk til at se og gribe optimeringsmuligheder – både for medarbejdere og kunder

  • Er struktureret og god til planlægning, fx af vagtplaner og ruter

  • Har en naturlig autoritet og evner at skabe tillid og sammenhold i teamet

  • Er løsningsorienteret og god til at træffe beslutninger

  • Er nysgerrig og motiveret for at udvikle sig fagligt

Erfaring med parkeringsbranchen eller lignende operativt arbejde er en fordel, men ikke et krav.

Vi tilbyder

  • En rolle med reelt ansvar og direkte indflydelse på både team og kundesamarbejde

  • Et teamorienteret og inkluderende arbejdsmiljø

  • Fleksibilitet i arbejdstider

  • Konkurrencedygtig løn, pension og sundhedsforsikring

  • Et sted, hvor dine idéer og input betyder noget

Om OPARKO:
OPARKO er en mindre, men hurtigt voksende tech-virksomhed, der arbejder med parkerings- og mobilitetsløsninger i ejendomsbranchen. Vi har et ungt miljø med korte beslutningsveje og højt tempo, og vi leder efter folk, der tør tage ansvar, lære nyt og være med, når det virkelig gælder.

Ansøgning:
Er du klar til at tage næste skridt i din karriere og blive en del af OPARKO? Send din ansøgning og CV til service@oparko.com. Vi behandler ansøgninger løbende, så send din ansøgning hurtigst muligt.

Vi ser frem til at høre fra dig!

title: Pladesmed
description:

Vi har travlt på vores pladeværksted. Derfor søger vi en karosseritekniker på fuld tid med tiltrædelse snarest muligt.

Vi er autoriseret SKODA og SEAT forhandler i Hjørring. Vi servicerer, reparerer og udbedrer også skader på andre bilmærker. Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig.

title: Cyber Threat Analyst
description:
Now is an amazing time to join Nozomi Networks as we build the future of OT and IoT cybersecurity.

We defend some of the world’s largest organizations and critical infrastructure in more than 68 countries and we’re just getting started. Our AI-powered cybersecurity platform secures operational technology (OT) and Internet of Things (IoT) infrastructures for enterprises and government entities across energy, manufacturing, transportation, resources, and critical infrastructure.

As we expand our product portfolio and global presence, our Security Research department is hiring a Cyber Threat Analyst to perform threat intelligence research and reverse-engineer samples providing better protection to the customers and sharing the findings with the public.

You could be the next "Nozomier"! If this sounds like you, read on.

In this role, you will:

• Perform hands-on static and dynamic analysis of malicious samples to understand their behaviour, capabilities, and intent
• Perform threat intelligence operations to collect and vet all the required knowledge to respond efficiently to advanced threats
• Contribute to the signature creation activities and help us shape the TI infrastructure
• Contribute to the technical material shared with the public and be actively engaged with the marketing team
• Be an active team player, independently proposing and driving new ideas
• Present our findings at technical conferences
• Embody the Nozomi Networks Cultural Pillars and our mission to protect what matters most with transparency and trust

To be successful in this opportunity, you will have:

• Proven hands-on experience with both static and dynamic malware analysis, including working in isolated/sandboxed environments
• Demonstrated experience analysing Windows malware, including a solid understanding of the Windows executable format (PE) and common execution, persistence, and evasion techniques
• Experience analysing malware in Linux environments, including familiarity with the ELF format and Linux-specific persistence and execution techniques, is a strong advantage
• A proven record of previous presentations at conferences
• Proven experience in reverse engineering using analysis tools such as IDA Pro, Ghidra, OllyDBG, x64dbg, radare2, or similar
• A solid understanding of binary file attributes such as executable structures and packers
• Familiarity with the MITRE ATT&CK framework and cyber kill chains
• Understanding of the OSI model and an ability to use Wireshark
• The attitude to operate in environments including data covered by non-disclosure agreements and a high level of confidentiality
These qualifications would be a strong plus:
• Previous professional experience as a Security Researcher, Detection Engineer, SOC Analyst, or Threat Hunter

Who we are and what we stand for:

Nozomi Networks is the leader in OT and IoT Cybersecurity. We protect the world's critical infrastructure, industrial and government organizations from cyber threats by providing exceptional network visibility, threat detection and operational insight. We’re always innovating and we hire the best at what they do to ensure our customers always have access to fast product enhancements, exceptional engineering support and rapid deployment across continents. If you like a challenge, and value integrity and customer success, we invite you to help Nozomi Networks build the future of OT and IoT cybersecurity.

Diversity, Inclusion and Belonging are part of our core beliefs, at Nozomi Networks. Diversity of thought, background and culture broadens our knowledge of the world and helps us learn, grow, and gain new perspectives. What makes us all different is what makes us powerful.

Our Global Benefits

All of our benefits are customized to the country you are based in, naturally we want to get the best out of our Nozomiers, so we provide the best benefits packages, such as:

  • Health & Wellness
  • Financial
  • Work-Life Balance
  • Unparalleled Flexible Time-Off

Need to know information

Successful candidates will be subjected to background verification checks.

Be cautious of unsolicited messages, fake email addresses, requests for money and unclear job descriptions. Report suspicious activity to authorities. Our open job opportunities and descriptions are posted on Nozomi Networks' career page. If in any doubt please apply for opportunities on our careers website here.

If you would like to know more about our Privacy Policy, please click here. Any questions about how we process personal information, or if you would like help exercising your privacy rights please contact us using the email provided within the Privacy Policy.

title: Teardown Technician
description:
About M&D


For the past 80+ years, M&D has led the aftermarket in remanufacturing innovation to address technological advancements and changing customer needs. In the past few decades, we have expanded beyond our remanufacturing roots to develop close (and sometimes exclusive) partnerships with the world’s leading OEMs and manufacturers.


Those partnerships with key suppliers like Bosch, Garrett, Federal Mogul, Cummins, Stanadyne, Holset, BorgWarner, Delphi, Yanmar, Mitsubishi, Denso and others have been critical in honing our remanufacturing capabilities and expanding our parts offering to include new, no core options in fuel injectors and fuel pumps, diesel engine cylinder heads, blocks, crankshafts and connecting rods. M&D also stocks a complete assortment of turbos (new and remanufactured), inframe overhaul kits, filtration and aftertreatment parts including DPFs, DOCs, EGRs, sensors and other engine parts.


Our strong remanufacturing roots combined with our 48 branch locations, a nationwide outside sales team of 25 and our close OEM & Manufacturer partnerships make us unique in the industry – no one understands diesel engine failure analysis and parts better than M&D. WE FUEL UPTIME.


Position Summary:


The Teardown Technician disassembles diesel engines in preparation for repair and remanufacture. We provide all tools & training. We offer Competitive pay + competitive benefits.


Essential Duties and Responsibilities

  • We provide all tools& training!
  • Intake diesel engines
  • Disassemble diesel engine components
  • Cleaning and prepping of parts
  • Forklift operation
  • General shop responsibilities
  • Performs other duties as assigned by supervisor


Minimum Qualifications:

  • 1-2 years of experience in related field preferred (We will train)
  • Experience in forklift operation; ability to become forklift certified
  • High school diploma or equivalent
  • Ability to follow written and verbal instructions
  • Mechanical aptitude
  • Ability to repeat motions
  • Follow all safety policies
  • Successful completion of pre-employment background and drug screening
  • Fosters good coworker citizenship and contributes to a positive work environment


Physical Demands and Work Environment:


The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this position. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the functions.

  • Shop environment that can include exposure to loud noises, dirt, and dust
  • Ability to squat, kneel, and bend over
  • Ability to lift objects to shoulder level
  • Ability to lift, move, and carry objects to 50 lbs.



This job description in no way states or implies that these are the only duties to be performed by the employee(s) of this position. Employees will be required to follow any other job-related instructions and to perform any other job-related duties requested by any person authorized to give instructions or assignments.



M&D provides equal employment opportunity to all qualified applicants and employees without regard to race, color, sex, religion, national origin, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, familial status, disability, military status, and genetic information.

title: System Engineer
description:
합류하게 될 팀에 대해 알려드려요

  • 토스인슈어런스의 System Engineer는 Security & IT Infra Team에 속해 있어요.
  • 보험설계사 및 내부 고객 전반에 대한 시스템을 구축 및 지원하고, IDC를 관리하고 있어요. 금융이나 커머스, 포털, 게임사 등 여러 분야에서 모인 인프라, 개발 영역의 우수한 팀원들과 협업하고 있어요.
  • '제품에만 집중할 수 있도록 모든 것을 지원한다'라는 목표를 두고, 보험 설계 업 에서 가장 높은 수준의 인프라 구축을 위해 노력하고 있어요. 더욱 빠른 제품 출시를 위해 자동화도 추진하고 있어요.

합류하면 함께 할 업무예요

  • 토스인슈어런스의 서버, OS, SAN, Storage, Back up 등을 담당하며, 보험 설계사 시스템 전반에 대한 인프라 구축 및 지원 업무를 하고 있어요.
  • 신규 서비스가 출시될 때 필요한 서버 장비를 할당하고, 장비들과 결합하여 서비스도 함께 연계시키는 일을 수행하고 있어요.
  • IDC 인프라를 운영·관리하고 있어요 .
  • ITO(IT Operation) 업무를 함께 수행하며, 장애 대응, 모니터링 등을 담당합니다.
  • 향후 IDC 인프라의 AWS로 마이그레이션을 계획하고 있어요.

이런 분과 함께하고 싶어요

  • 5년 이상 Linux OS 기반의 시스템 엔지니어링 구축 및 운영 경험이 필요해요.
  • 개발자와 협업이 많기 때문에 스크립트 언어(Shell, Python, Perl, Ruby 등)를 사용하여 인프라를 운영하실 수 있는 분이 필요해요.
  • 퍼블릭 클라우드(AWS) 아키텍쳐 설계 및 운영 경험이 있는 분이 필요해요.
  • 토스인슈어런스는 서비스 애플리케이션이 리눅스 OS 위에서 구동되고 있으므로, 리눅스를 잘 핸들링 할 수 있는 분, 서비스에 대한 비즈니스 이해도가 높은 분이면 좋아요.
  • 시스템 자동화 배포 솔루션 구축 및 운영 경험이 있다면 좋아요.

이력서는 이렇게 작성하시는 걸 추천해요

  • 기술적인 문제 개선 (최적화, 오류 수정 등) 사례 중 가장 기억에 남는 것, 두 가지를 상세히 기술해 주세요.
  • 본인이 기여한 프로젝트를 사례 중심으로 상세히 기술해 주세요. (프로젝트 기간, 수행한 역할, 사용했던 기술 스택, 프로젝트 전후 개선된 점 등)
  • 다루셨던 OS와 주요 솔루션의 버전을 상세히 기술해주세요.

토스인슈어런스으로의 합류 여정

  • 서류접수 > 직무 인터뷰 > 문화적합성 인터뷰 > 레퍼런스 체크 > 처우 협의 > 최종합격 및 입사

꼭 확인해 주세요

  • 근무지는 서울특별시 구로구 경인로 662 (신도림동, 디큐브시티 타워동) 37층이에요.
  • 장애인 및 국가보훈대상자는 지원 시 관련법에 따라 우대하고 있어요.
  • 이력서 및 제출 서류에 허위 사실이 발견되거나 근무 이력 중 징계 사항이 확인될 경우, 채용이 취소될 수 있어요.
  • 토스인슈어런스 내규에 따라 채용금지자 또는 결격사유 해당자는 채용이 취소될 수 있어요.

함께할 동료를 위한 한마디

"System Engineer로서의 모든 것을 경험할 수 있어요"

  • 토스인슈어런스에서는 인프라 내 다양한 부서와 긴밀하게 협업합니다. System Engineer로서 전체적인 아키텍처에 대해 이해하고, 여러 기술들을 배움으로써 비로소 인프라 시스템의 원리를 깨우칠 수 있던 것 같아요.
  • 배움을 게을리하지 않으며, 일을 좋아하고, 엔지니어를 위한 최고의 환경에서 커리어의 Quantum Jump를 하고 싶은 System Engineer분들에게 토스인슈어런스를 적극 추천합니다!

title: Senior Produktionstekniker
description:
Om företaget

Hos Avaron får du tryggheten i en fast anställning kombinerat med variationen av att arbeta ute hos olika kunder. Vi tillsätter specialister inom allt från teknik, IT och industri till projektledning och affärsstöd – och oavsett uppdrag har du en konsultchef som finns där för dig och din utveckling.

Om rollen

Du kliver in i en central roll i en avancerad produktionsmiljö där fokus ligger på att utveckla maskiner och arbetssätt med säkerhet, produktivitet och kvalitet i centrum. Du blir en del av ett team som ansvarar för maskinparken och som stöttar produktionslinjerna med både linjespecifika verktyg och tydliga instruktioner.

Rollen spänner över fyra tydliga fokusområden: HSE, drift, förbättringar samt utveckling. Du arbetar nära produktionen och andra funktioner i organisationen, med stort utrymme att påverka hur maskiner, processer och arbetssätt utvecklas över tid. Du bidrar också i utvecklingsprojekt och driver mindre investeringsinitiativ. Det här är en spännande möjlighet för dig som vill kombinera teknisk bredd med konkret påverkan i en verksamhetsnära miljö.

Arbetsuppgifter
  • Du driver förebyggande HSE-arbete och bidrar med innovation inom maskinsäkerhet.
  • Du utvecklar maskiner och arbetssätt med fokus på säkerhet, kvalitet och produktivitet.
  • Du arbetar med kvalitetsförbättringar och optimering av tillgänglighet i produktionen.
  • Du förbereder drift och stöttar produktionslinjerna i det dagliga förbättringsarbetet.
  • Du deltar i utvecklingsprojekt och ansvarar för mindre investeringsprojekt.
  • Du tar fram dokumentation, ekonomiska kalkyler och arbetar med offertförfarande.
  • Du genomför riskbedömningar och bidrar till att förebygga och minimera risker i produktionen.
Krav
  • Du har utbildning inom produktionsteknik eller maskinteknik, alternativt civilingenjörsutbildning inom maskinteknik.
  • Du har erfarenhet och/eller utbildning inom maskinsäkerhet.
  • Du har kunskaper inom CAD, SolidWorks eller liknande.
  • Du talar och skriver flytande svenska samt engelska.
  • Du är van att arbeta strukturerat och kreativt för att lösa tekniska uppgifter.
  • Du trivs med att hantera flera parallella arbetsuppgifter i en miljö med högt tempo och höga kvalitetskrav.
  • Du arbetar väl tillsammans med andra och bidrar till ett gott samarbete både inom teamet och med övriga organisationen.
Vi erbjuder
  • Fast anställning hos Avaron AB
  • Tjänstepension
  • Friskvårdsbidrag på 5 000 kr per år
Ansökan

Vi tillsätter löpande – sök gärna så snart du kan.

title: Progettista Elettrico
description:
Progettista Elettrico – Ufficio Tecnico
📍 Bresseo di Teolo (PD)

Ritmo progetta e costruisce macchine per la saldatura delle materie plastiche, che vanno in cantiere in tutto il mondo. Cerchiamo una persona che entri nel team tecnico e si occupi della parte elettrica delle nostre macchine, dal disegno dello schema fino al collaudo.

🟧 Cosa farai

⚡ Progetterai e aggiornerai gli schemi elettrici delle macchine
📐 Curerai la documentazione tecnica elettrica
🔧 Seguirai la parte elettrica dei nuovi prodotti insieme a chi li sviluppa
🧪 Affiancherai il collaudo e la verifica funzionale delle macchine
🔍 Analizzerai e risolverai i problemi elettrici che emergono in produzione e sul campo
🤝 Lavorerai a stretto contatto con Produzione, Service e Ricerca & Sviluppo

Non è un ruolo chiuso in ufficio: si disegna al PC, ma si scende anche in reparto a vedere la macchina.

🟧 Cosa cerchiamo

✅ Sai leggere e interpretare uno schema elettrico, monofase e trifase
✅ Hai esperienza concreta di cablaggio
✅ Riconosci i componenti e sai a cosa servono
✅ Conosci le principali apparecchiature elettriche industriali
✅ Usi multimetro, pinza amperometrica e strumenti di verifica
✅ Hai almeno 3 anni di esperienza in ambito elettrico industriale, impiantistico o di quadristica
✅ Hai voglia di capire come funziona la macchina: è la qualità che conta di più per noi

⭐ Laurea in Ingegneria Elettrica o dell'Automazione — valutiamo molto volentieri anche periti con esperienza sul campo
⭐ Esperienza di progettazione elettrica industriale
⭐ CAD elettrici, in particolare SPAC Automazione
⭐ CAD 3D, in particolare CATIA
⭐ Conoscenza delle normative di sicurezza applicate alle macchine industriali
⭐ Inglese

Le nostre macchine non le conosce nessuno prima di entrare: l'architettura elettrica dei nostri prodotti, l'applicazione delle norme al nostro specifico, i software che usiamo. Ti affianchiamo, con calma e con un percorso strutturato. Non ci aspettiamo che tu sappia già tutto il primo giorno.

🟧 Cosa offriamo

📄 Assunzione con CCNL Metalmeccanico Industria
🕐 Orario giornaliero 08:00 – 17:00, dal lunedì al venerdì, pausa pranzo 13:00 – 14:00
🍽️ Mensa aziendale a costo agevolato: €1,55 per un pasto completo
👥 Affiancamento strutturato con il progettista attualmente in carico
🏭 Un'azienda di 170 persone, dove il prodotto lo vedi nascere e partire

🟧 Come si svolge la selezione

Un primo colloquio conoscitivo, un colloquio tecnico con il responsabile e una prova pratica. Vogliamo capire come ragioni, non quante sigle conosci.

title: Commercial Roofing Foreman
description:
Commercial Roofing Service Foreman


Eskola, LLC - Lexington, Kentucky | Full-Time | $26.00 - $34.00 / hour (Based on Qualifications & Experience)


Eskola, LLC has been installing commercial and industrial roofing and waterproofing systems throughout the North and Southeastern U.S. since 1972.

We are looking for a looking for an experienced, motivated Service Foreman to lead field crews in our Lexington, Kentucky market. This is a hands-on leadership role with a clear path toward Superintendent and Service Manager opportunities.




What You Will Do

  • Lead and support daily commercial roofing service operations, including repairs, maintenance, inspections, and leak investigations
  • Coordinate jobsite manpower, materials, tools, and equipment
  • Perform field troubleshooting and assessments of roofing and waterproofing systems
  • Train and mentor technicians, promoting strong workmanship, safety, and accountability
  • Communicate professionally with customers, property managers, and vendors
  • Work closely with Superintendents, Service Managers, and Regional Leadership to keep crews productive and on schedule



What We Are Looking For

  • 3+ years of Foreman/Supervisory experience in commercial roofing service, repair, or maintenance
  • Strong knowledge of TPO, PVC, EPDM, Modified Bitumen, metal roofing, and roof coatings/waterproofing
  • Ability to read blueprints and technical specifications
  • Proven leadership, communication, and customer management skills
  • Comfortable working outdoors, at heights, and in physically demanding conditions
  • Valid driver's license and clean driving record
  • Must pass a pre-employment background check and drug screening



Preferred Skills & Certifications

  • Experience with commercial roofing software (e.g., DataForma)
  • OSHA 10 or 30 Hour Card
  • Aerial lift and/or forklift certification
  • First Aid, CPR & AED certification
  • Bilingual in English and Spanish



Why Join Eskola?

  • Trade-specific training & room to grow within the company
  • Medical Insurance (2 plans, including HDHP with HSA & company match)
  • 401(K) with Company Matching
  • Company-provided technology / equipment as needed
  • Dental, Vision, Life, & Disability Insurance
  • Paid Time Off

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or protected veteran status, and are invited to voluntarily self-identify as an individual with a disability or protected veteran during the application process. Eskola, LLC will not discriminate against applicants or employees for discussing their compensation (41 CFR 60-1.35(c)).

title: Digital Business Analyst
description:
Summary

At Avanade, we blend strategy, creativity, and technology to reimagine how organizations grow and operate in the age of AI. We help leaders turn complex business challenges into clear narratives and actionable roadmaps then make them real.

You’ll work with some of the world’s leading brands and public sector organizations, shaping how AI and human insight come together to create value. Here, ideas don’t just get discussed they get built.

Key Responsibilities

  • Shape transformation stories translate business challenges into structured strategies, clear recommendations, and compelling narratives.

  • Lead client conversations facilitate workshops, capture insights, and turn discussions into visual storylines and decision-ready decks.

  • Design the future state map current journeys, identify friction points, and build new blueprints for new digital or AI-powered services.

  • Collaborate to deliver partner with designers, engineers, and change leads to bring ideas to life through prototypes and pilots.

.

title: Senior Controls HW/SW Engineering Lead
description:
About the Company

At Avaron, you get the security of permanent employment combined with the variety of working at different customers. We place specialists across everything from tech, IT and industry to project management and business support – and whatever the assignment, you have a consultant manager who is there for you and your development.

About the Role

You will step into a senior role in a global product engineering environment where control systems are key to building and improving advanced intralogistics solutions. The assignment focuses on strengthening ways of working across product lines and locations, while raising technical quality in both PLC software and electrical hardware.

You will be a key technical voice in the organization, connecting product development with project realization and helping turn operational feedback into long-term engineering improvements. This is a strong opportunity if you want to influence standards, toolchains, and engineering direction in an international setting.

Job Description
  • You will act as a subject matter expert in control systems, with focus on PLC software and electrical hardware.
  • You will drive harmonization and improvement of product engineering processes and workflows across product lines and locations.
  • You will help define and maintain standards and best practices to support consistency, quality, and efficiency.
  • You will ensure compliance with quality standards and technical specifications.
  • You will define requirements for product development and contribute to the continued development of the engineering toolchain.
  • You will mentor colleagues, support knowledge sharing, and help strengthen capabilities within controls product engineering.
  • You will initiate and lead global projects and standardization initiatives within controls engineering.
  • You will collaborate closely with cross-functional teams, including product development and controls software, and secure a strong feedback flow from project realization into product development.

Requirements
  • You have a relevant degree, for example in electrical engineering or automation engineering.
  • You have professional experience from similar roles.
  • You have strong knowledge of control systems, including PLC software and electrical hardware.
  • You are comfortable driving improvements in engineering processes, workflows, and technical standards.
  • You have the ability to define requirements for product development and engineering tools.
  • You work well across cross-functional and international teams.
  • You have solid project and time management skills and can handle several parallel activities.
  • You have a solution-oriented and proactive way of working, combined with a strategic perspective.
  • You are willing to travel occasionally between different locations.
Nice to have
  • Experience from the logistics automation industry.
What We Offer
