Application

Selections are made on an ongoing basis – apply as soon as you can.

title: Varhaiskasvatuksen opettaja
description:
Parhaan arjen Mäntsälä!

Mäntsälän varhaiskasvatuksessa painopisteinä ovat leikin kehittäminen sekä pienten lasten kielenkehityksen ja lukivalmiuksien tukeminen. Ketterät kokeilut mahdollistavat toiminnan joustavan kehittämisen. Mäntsälän varhaiskasvatuksessa työskentelet osana kuuden päiväkodin johtajan päiväkotikokonaisuutta, noin 800 lapsen varhaiskasvatuksessa.

Tervetuloa joukkoomme, sinä varhaiskasvatuksen ja leikin ammattilainen. Etsimme joukkoomme varhaiskasvatuksen opettajaa perhevapaan sijaisuuteen ajalle 19.10.2026-31.5.2027. Tehtävän ensisijainen sijoituspaikka työsuhteen alkaessa on Kaunismäen päiväkoti. Huomioimme myös valmistumassa olevat hakijat.

Varhaiskasvatuksen opettajana olet tiimisi vetäjä ja vastaat ryhmäsi pedagogisesta suunnittelusta ja toiminnasta toteuttaen sitä yhdessä muun meidän osaavan henkilöstön kanssa. Odotamme hyvään tiimiimme sinua, joka tuet lasten osallisuutta ja kehität leikkiä lapsen parhaaksi. Työsi lähtökohtana on vasun hengen mukaisesti ymmärrys lapsen arjen kokonaisvaltaisuudesta. Olet varhaiskasvatuksen opettajana ammatillisesti taitava yhteistyöntekijä ja myönteinen vuorovaikuttaja niin lasten, työkavereiden kuin huoltajienkin kanssa.

Lyhyet kuvaukset päiväkodeista ja niiden sijainnit löydät Tarinakartasta [Päiväkodit - Mäntsälän kunta (mantsala.fi)](https://www.mantsala.fi/kasvatus-ja-opetus/varhaiskasvatus-ja-esiopetus/kunnallinen-varhaiskasvatus/paivakodit/). Mäntsälän päiväkodeissa työskentelee yksi tai kaksi päiväkotiapulaista päiväkodin koon mukaisesti. Varhaiskasvatuksen apulaisjohtajat vahvistavat päiväkotien pedagogista työtä. Lisäksi nimetty kveo käy säännöllisesti konsultoimassa ja mallintamassa toimintaa päiväkodeissa ja kiertävä lastenhoitaja sijaistaa henkilöstön poissaoloja.

Tehtävän kelpoisuusvaatimukset määräytyvät varhaiskasvatuslain (540/2018) 26 § tai 75 § mukaan. Varhaiskasvatuksen opettajan kelpoisuusvaatimuksena on vähintään kasvatustieteen kandidaatin tutkinto, johon sisältyy lastentarhanopettajan koulutus, tai sosiaali- ja terveysalan ammattikorkeakoulututkinto, johon sisältyvät varhaiskasvatuksen ja sosiaalipedagogiikan opinnot, 60 opintopistettä tai sosionomin tutkinto, jota on täydennetty em. opinnoilla.

Palkkaus ja palvelussuhteen ehdot määräytyvät kunnallisen virka- ja työehtosopimuksen mukaan. Tehtäväkohtainen palkka: 3087,31€/kk. Lisäksi voidaan maksaa työkokemukseen perustuvaa lisää aiemman työkokemuksen perusteella. Tehtävän ollessa määräaikainen koeaika on enintään puolet määräaikaisuuden kestosta.

Mäntsälä on koulutus- ja kehitysmyönteinen kunta. Tuemme työssä jaksamista liikunta-, kulttuuri- ja hyvinvointiedun avulla. Tarjoamme sinulle mielenkiintoisen ja monipuolisen työn moniammatillisessa työyhteisössä. Tukenasi ovat osaavat ja motivoituneet työkaverit.

Tehtävään valitun on esitettävä nähtäväksi rikosrekisterilain 6 §:n 2 momentissa tarkoitettu hyväksyttävä rikosrekisteriote (laki lasten kanssa työskentelevien rikostaustan selvittämiseksi, 504/2002) ja pyydettäessä todistus terveydentilastaan. Alle kouluikäisten lasten kanssa työskentelevien valittujen henkilöiden hengityselinten tuberkuloosia koskeva selvitys tarkastetaan (tartuntatautilaki § 55) ennen työsuhteen alkamista.

Lisätietoja antaa päiväkodin johtaja Mervi Kärkkäinen, puh. 040 314 5676 tai sp. mervi.karkkainen@mantsala.fi.

Jätä hakemuksesi sähköisesti 2.10.2026 mennessä osoitteessa: [Avoimet työpaikat - Mäntsälän kunta (mantsala.fi)](https://mantsala.rekrytointi.com/paikat/?o=A_LOJ&list=1) Liitä hakemukseen hakukirje ja ansioluettelosi ja tutkintotodistus. Haastattelukutsussa ilmoitetaan haastattelun aika ja paikka. Toivomme hakemuksia eri ikää, sukupuolta, taustaa ja erilaisia vähemmistöjä edustavilta henkilöiltä.

Mäntsälä on koulutus- ja kehitysmyönteinen, vireä ja vehmas kunta, jossa eletään turvallista, ihmisenkokoista arkea sujuvien palveluiden, monipuolisten vapaa-ajan mahdollisuuksien ja kätevien liikenneyhteyksien äärellä. Kunnan keskeiset arvot turvallisuus, osallistava yhteisöllisyys ja vastuullinen, kehittävä vire ohjaavat toimintaamme. Haluamme olla parhaan arjen paikkakunta, jossa on hyvä elää, työskennellä ja yrittää.

title: Buschauffør til Esbjerg/Billund regionalkørsel
description:
Er du på udkig efter et job med frihed, ansvar og kundekontakt? Drømmer du om et hjørnekontor med 180 graders udsigt? Så er jobbet som buschauffør hos Tide Bus måske noget for dig.

Vi søger både chauffører til fuldtidsstilling og timelønnede afløsere. Vi har anlæg i Esbjerg, Grindsted, Varde og Vejen.

Derfor elsker vi at køre bus

Vi kan godt afsløre, at det her job ikke bare handler om at køre fra A til B. Det handler om frihed, ansvar og mennesker. Her er nogle af de ting, vores chauffører sætter allermest pris på:

  • Frihed på fire hjul - Du har dit "kontor" med panoramavindue og kan nyde landskabet, mens du arbejder.
  • Stabilt job og fast struktur - Vagter, du kan regne med, og løn til tiden.
  • Daglig kontakt med mennesker - Du møder nye ansigter hver dag og bliver en del af mange menneskers hverdag.
  • Ordentlige forhold - Hos Tide får du styr på tingene - både når det gælder udstyr, arbejdsmiljø og kollegaer.
  • Godt fællesskab - Vi hjælper hinanden, griner sammen og løfter i flok.

Vi forventer, at du har følgende kvalifikationer:

  • Erhvervskørekort til personbefordring
  • EU-efteruddannelsesbevis
  • Billettering og kundeservice
  • Kan tale og læse dansk

Vi leder efter chauffører, som deler vores værdier, som er, og kan beskrives som:

  • Stolte. Vores chauffører sætter en ære i, at alle vores passagerer får en god rejseoplevelse, hver gang de kører med vores busser.
  • Miljøbevidste. Vores chauffører er dygtige og kører busserne, så de bruger mindst muligt brændstof.
  • Ansvarlige. Vores chauffører kommer til tiden i en præsentabel uniform, er udhvilede, undgår skader, og passer på busserne så de altid er rene og pæne.
  • Respektfulde. Vores chauffører behandler kolleger, passagerer og samarbejdspartnere med respekt. Herved sikrer vi vores kvalitet og serviceniveau.

Praktisk information

Løn og ansættelsesvilkår i henhold til AKT overenskomsten.

Hvis du har spørgsmål til jobbet, er du meget velkommen til at kontakte:

Driftsleder i Esbjerg Regional, Bjarke Fyhn: Bjarke.Fyhn@tidebus.dk eller tlf.

Vi ansætter løbende, så send søg gerne med det samme.

Du søger jobbet ved at klikke på "Ansøg" nederst på siden.

Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig.

title: Crating Clerk - 2nd Shift
description:
Job Title: Crating Clerk
Department: Operations
Reports To: Logistics Manager
FLSA Status: Non-Exempt

Position Summary

The Crating Clerk is responsible for preparing finished products, components, and materials for shipment by constructing, assembling, and preparing crates, pallets, and protective packaging in accordance with customer requirements, company standards, and shipping specifications. This position plays a critical role in ensuring products are packaged securely, accurately, and efficiently to prevent damage during transit while supporting on-time delivery objectives.

Working closely with Production, Shipping, Warehouse, Quality, and Customer Service teams, the Crating Clerk ensures shipments are properly packaged, labeled, documented, and staged for domestic and international transportation while maintaining a safe and organized work environment. Must have prior experience operating a circular saw, table saw, impact driver, nail guns, and other carpentry tools.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

  • Construct, assemble, and modify wooden crates, skids, pallets, and other protective packaging for finished products and materials in accordance with customer specifications and shipping requirements.
  • Prepare products for shipment by measuring, packaging, bracing, banding, labeling, and verifying materials to ensure safe and damage-free transportation.
  • Review work orders, packing lists, shipping documents, and product specifications to ensure shipment accuracy and completeness.
  • Inspect completed crates and packaged products for quality, accuracy, and compliance with shipping standards.
  • Stage, load, and secure shipments for domestic and international transportation as required.
  • Maintain inventory accuracy through proper material identification, handling, documentation, and participation in cycle counts and annual physical inventories.
  • Safely operate hand tools, power tools, stretch-wrap machines, banding equipment, forklifts, pallet jacks, and other material handling equipment as authorized.
  • Identify opportunities to improve packaging methods, reduce waste, increase efficiency, and support continuous improvement initiatives.
  • Report damaged materials, packaging concerns, inventory discrepancies, or shipment issues to supervision and assist in resolving problems.
  • Maintain a clean, organized, and safe work environment while adhering to all company safety policies and procedures.
  • Collaborate with Shipping, Production, Warehouse, Quality, and Customer Service teams to support operational goals and on-time customer deliveries.
  • Provide support for additional warehouse, shipping, inventory, and manufacturing activities as business needs require, including overtime when necessary.

Qualifications

Education

  • High School Diploma or GED required.
  • Vocational training or related carpentry experience preferred.

Experience

  • Experience with a circular saw, table saw, impact driver, nail guns and other carpentry tools, required.
  • 1-3 years of experience in carpentry preferred.
  • Experience operating forklifts and material handling equipment preferred.
  • Experience reading work orders, packing lists, and shipping documentation preferred.

Knowledge, Skills & Abilities

  • Ability to safely use hand tools, measuring devices, and packaging equipment.
  • Basic mathematical skills, including measuring and calculating dimensions.
  • Strong attention to detail and commitment to accuracy.
  • Ability to follow written and verbal instructions.
  • Strong organizational and time management skills.
  • Ability to work independently and as part of a team.
  • Good communication and problem-solving abilities.
  • Basic computer skills and familiarity with shipping or ERP systems preferred.

Physical Requirements

  • Ability to lift, push, pull, and carry up to 50 pounds regularly and up to 75 pounds with assistance.
  • Ability to stand, walk, bend, kneel, stoop, and reach throughout the workday.
  • Ability to use hand and power tools frequently.
  • Ability to work in a manufacturing and warehouse environment with varying temperatures, noise levels, and conditions.
  • Ability to safely operate material handling equipment when authorized.

Core Competencies

  • Safety Awareness
  • Attention to Detail
  • Accountability
  • Reliability
  • Teamwork & Collaboration
  • Customer Focus
  • Quality Orientation
  • Organization & Planning
  • Problem Solving
  • Adaptability
  • Communication
  • Continuous Improvement

Equal Employment Opportunity Statement: The Company is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or veteran status.

title: Quality Technician
description:
POSITION SUMMARY:

Responsible for effective support of the development, implementation, and maintenance of Product and Processes through participation in Advanced Product Quality Planning; participation in and surveillance of Incoming, Set-up, In-Process, Final, Containment, and Dock Audit Inspection Processes; participation in Corrective, Preventive and Continual Improvement Actions. Also responsible for the support and maintenance of the TS-16949 Quality Management System. Maintains assigned reporting for the communication and assessment of Process and Product performance.


CORPORATE GOALS:

Sanko Gosei Technologies Incorporated is a custom injection molding company that strives to:

  1. Provide defect-free, cost efficient products to our customers in a timely manner.
  2. Operate as a world class supplier for the mutual benefit of both our customers and our employees.
  3. Operate in a team-based environment, where all employees are involved in continuously improving company performance.
  4. Develop suppliers who will provide products and services of superior quality and treat them in a manner to maintain good relations.
  5. Maintain a union-free organization.
  6. Provide shareholders with a long term return on investment superior to other opportunities of equal risk.
  7. Fulfill our responsibilities in the community in which we operate.
  8. Promote safe work practices and be conscious of environmental responsibilities.


PRINCIPAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES: Employees will be trained to all applicable company standards as identified on the company training matrix TR-401

  1. Participates in Product Launch and Change Activities, including fulfillment of Customer Specific Requirements and Sanko Gosei APQP system requirements.
  2. Participates in compiling and maintaining APQP related documents (Flow Chart, PFMEA, Control Plan)
  3. Participates in compilation, timely submission, and maintenance of PPAP requirements.
  4. Responsible for creating and maintaining Standardized Operator Work Instructions, Quality Standards, Appearance Criteria, and Quality Samples.
  5. Responsible for maintaining high standards of quality and reliability; and providing effective communication of Quality related issues.
  6. Participates in Corrective, Preventive, and Continual Improvement Activities.
  7. Supports TS16949 & ISO 14001 Management Systems
  8. Participates in Measurement System Activities including GR&R studies, Development of Gage Instructions, Training of Inspectors, and calibration.
  9. Participates in the development, implementation, monitor, and reaction to Product and Process Verification.
  10. Supports and participates in company efforts to resolve customer driven quality issues.
  11. Supports and participates in the compilation of company performance metric reports
  12. Supports continuous improvement efforts in product and process performance.
  13. Other assignments as designated by the Quality Manager or Operations Management Team.




SPECIFICATIONS:

  1. Strong leadership ability and a high degree of ethical and professional standards. Must be trusted by subordinates, peers, and superiors, and must be willing to accept responsibility for their performance.
  2. Experience with Plastic Injection Molding Processes and Product.
  3. Minimum of an Associate degree or 2 years experience.
  4. Requires a commitment to continuous improvement in order to meet ever increasing demands for improved quality, cost, and delivery performance.
  5. Ability to communicate effectively with the Manufacturing Operations Team
  6. Strong problem solving skills of both the interpersonal, and the technical side of the operation.
  7. Organized and structured approach to the work environment, with strong attention to details.
  8. Ability to Train Operators and Inspectors in processes related instructions.
  9. Ability to use Microsoft Office Applications and Plex manufacturing software.
  10. Strong mechanical aptitude and the ability to quickly learn new technologies.
  11. Ability to handle stressful employee situations, and to treat people with respect.
  12. Ability to excel in a team-based environment.
  13. Ability to perform in a proactive mode, and to plan and respond accordingly.
  14. Must be willing to travel on a limited basis.



REPORTING RELATIONSHIPS:

The Quality Technician reports to the Quality Manager.

title: Vi søger betonchauffør til Unicon i Trekantsområdet
description:
Vil du køre nogle af Danmarks mest ikoniske lastbiler og være med til at levere fundamentet for fremtidens byggeri?

Hos Unicon søger vi en betonchauffør til vores fabrikker i Trekantsområdet. Som betonchauffør hos os er du meget mere end chauffør. Du er en vigtig del af støbningen og den, der sikrer, at betonen kommer sikkert frem, i den rette kvalitet og på det rigtige tidspunkt.

Du trives naturligvis bag rattet i en stor bil, men mindst lige så vigtigt er det, at du kan samarbejde med kollegerne på fabrikken og med kunderne på byggepladserne. Alle dage afsluttes på fabrikken, så du slipper for overnatninger i bilen.


Du bliver en vigtig del af byggepladsen

Som betonchauffør hos Unicon kører du betonen fra fabrikken til byggepladsen, hvor du samarbejder med både kunden, pumpechaufføren og kollegerne om at få støbningen til at forløbe som planlagt.

Du leverer ikke bare et produkt – du er med til at sikre, at byggeriet kan fortsætte.

Nogle leverancer losses direkte fra bilens bånd, mens andre overføres til en betonpumpe. Derfor er det vigtigt, at du kan samarbejde med de mennesker, der modtager betonen, og bidrage til, at arbejdet udføres sikkert og effektivt.

Du kommer til at navigere på byggepladser, hvor pladsen ofte er trang, og hvor præcision og overblik er afgørende. Det kræver gode køreevner, sikkerhedsfokus og evnen til at holde hovedet koldt, når forholdene er udfordrende.


Mere byggeplads end landevej

Hvis du drømmer om lange ture gennem Europa, er dette nok ikke det rette job.

Som betonchauffør hos Unicon kører du typisk mange korte ture mellem fabrikken og lokale byggepladser. Til gengæld bliver du en del af byggeprojekterne og får en hverdag med tæt kontakt til kunder, kolleger og samarbejdspartnere.

Det er et job for dig, der kan lide variation, ansvar og en arbejdsdag, hvor du gør en synlig forskel.


Hvem er du?

Vi forestiller os, at du:

  • Har stort kørekort inkl. hænger/trailer (CE)

  • Har EU-bevis

  • Har fokus på din egen og andres sikkerhed

  • Trives med at køre og manøvrere store køretøjer under krævende forhold

  • Er serviceminded og professionel i mødet med kunderne

  • Kan arbejde selvstændigt og tage ansvar for dine leverancer

  • Har fysik til rengøring og vedligeholdelse af bilen

  • Holder orden omkring dig og dit materiel

Det er en fordel, hvis du har krancertifikat eller erfaring fra bygge-, entreprenør- eller transportbranchen, men det er ikke et krav.


Derfor skal du vælge Unicon

Hos Unicon bliver du en del af Danmarks førende betonproducent og et stærkt fagligt fællesskab, hvor sikkerhed, kvalitet og samarbejde går hånd i hånd.

Vi tilbyder:

  • Branchens bedste ansættelsesforhold

  • Grundig oplæring og introduktion til jobbet

  • Moderne materiel og gode arbejdsforhold

  • Betalt arbejdstøjsordning inklusive vask

  • Gode udviklingsmuligheder – både fagligt og personligt

  • En unik holdånd og stærkt kollegialt fællesskab

  • Overenskomst gennem Dansk Industri og 3F

  • En hverdag med selvstændighed og ansvar

En arbejdsdag, hvor kunderne er med til at sætte dagsordenen

Som betonchauffør er din arbejdsdag styret af byggepladsernes behov og dagens leverancer.

Du får typisk besked om mødetid den følgende dag om eftermiddagen, når næste dags produktion og leverancer er planlagt. Arbejdsdagen slutter, når den sidste tur er kørt og bilen er vasket. Du kommer derfor hjem hver dag og slipper for overnatninger i bilen. Derfor er det ikke et traditionelt 7-15-job, og nogle dage kan blive kortere end forventet, mens andre dage bliver længere. Overarbejde forekommer jævnligt, men bliver naturligvis honoreret, og vi har gode muligheder for både udbetaling og opsparing af afspadsering, som mange af vores chauffører bruger til hele fridage.

Hvis du trives med variation, ansvar og en hverdag, hvor opgaven bliver gjort færdig, vil du passe godt ind hos os.


Sådan bliver du en del af holdet

Med udgangspunkt fra en eller flere af vores fabrikker i Trekantsområdet bliver du en del af et stærkt team af chauffører og kolleger, som hver dag arbejder sammen om at levere beton til nogle af områdets vigtigste byggeprojekter.

Du refererer til fabrikkens daglige leder.

Kan du se dig selv i rollen, hører vi gerne fra dig.

Send din ansøgning og dit CV hurtigst muligt. Har du spørgsmål til stillingen, er du velkommen til at kontakte fabriksleder Tobias Meier Jørgensen på telefon 2871 4678 eller områdechef Kent Florczak på telefon 29254481.

Vi afholder samtaler løbende og ansætter, når vi finder den rette kandidat.

Om Unicon

Unicon Danmark tilbyder lige muligheder for alle og har aktivt fokus på at fremme et arbejdsmiljø, der er fri for diskrimination, og hvor medarbejdere behandles med værdighed og respekt. I vores virksomhed er ansættelse baseret på den enkeltes fortjenester og kvalifikationer, som er direkte relateret til kompetencekrav i jobbet. Vi diskriminerer ikke nogen medarbejder eller jobansøger baseret på race, etnicitet, nationalitet, herkomst, genetiske oplysninger, statsborgerskab, religion, alder, køn, kønsidentitet/udtryk, seksuel orientering, graviditet, civilstand, handicap eller andre beskyttede karakteristika efter gældende love eller regler. Vi overholder disse principper i alle aspekter af ansættelse, herunder rekruttering, ansættelse, uddannelse, kompensation, forfremmelse og fordele.

title: Sähkösuunnittelija
location: Tampere, Espoo, Pori, Jyväskylä, Kuopio, Oulu, Tornio, Finland
description:
Tervetuloa töihin ennakkoluulottomaan rakentamisen ja rakennetun ympäristön suunnittelu- ja konsulttitoimistoon! A-Insinööreissä luomme kulttuuria, jossa asiantuntijamme ja asiakkaamme voivat onnistua yhdessä. Tarjoamme ison yrityksen edut, mutta pienen talon mutkattomuuden innostavassa, palkitussa työyhteisössä.



Haussa nyt
Sähkösuunnittelija vaativiin ja monipuolisiin hankkeisiin

Tule rakentamaan kanssamme rohkeasti parempaa!
Etsimme kokenutta sähkösuunnittelijaa vahvistamaan teollisuuden ja talotekniikan asiantuntijajoukkoamme. Pääset mukaan monipuolisiin ja teknisesti kiinnostaviin hankkeisiin, joissa suunnittelemme toimivia, turvallisia ja energiatehokkaita ratkaisuja asiakkaidemme tarpeisiin.

Voit työskennellä Tampereella, Espoossa, Porissa, Jyväskylässä, Kuopiossa, Oulussa tai Torniossa. Työskentelemme joustavasti ja teemme yhteistyötä yli toimipaikka- ja osaamisrajojen.



Sähkösuunnittelijana vastaat rakennusten sähköjärjestelmien suunnittelusta osana moniammatillisia projektiryhmiämme. Hankkeemme vaihtelevat datakeskuksista ja teollisuuskohteista sairaaloihin, kouluihin, päiväkoteihin, liikerakennuksiin ja muihin julkisiin rakennuksiin.

Työssäsi:

* suunnittelet toimivia, turvallisia ja kustannustehokkaita sähköjärjestelmiä

* osallistut hankkeiden eri suunnitteluvaiheisiin

* työskentelet tiiviissä yhteistyössä asiakkaiden, projektiryhmien ja muiden suunnittelualojen asiantuntijoiden kanssa

* sovitat yhteen teknisiä ratkaisuja rakennuksen käyttötarkoituksen ja hankkeen tavoitteiden kanssa

* pääset kehittämään osaamistasi erilaisten hankkeiden, teknologioiden ja toimintatapojen parissa.

Tehtävän tarkempaa sisältöä ja vastuualueita voidaan painottaa kokemuksesi, osaamisesi ja kiinnostuksesi perusteella.



Toivomme sinulta:

* soveltuvaa teknistä koulutusta, esimerkiksi sähkötekniikan insinöörin AMK- tai DI-tutkintoa

* vähintään 3–5 vuoden kokemusta sähkösuunnittelusta

* MagiCAD- ja/tai Revit-osaamista

* itsenäistä ja huolellista työotetta

* hyviä yhteistyö- ja vuorovaikutustaitoja

* halua kehittää omaa osaamistasi ja jakaa asiantuntemustasi myös muille.

Arvostamme kokemusta esimerkiksi teollisuus-, datakeskus-, sairaala- tai julkisen rakentamisen hankkeista. Kaikkea ei kuitenkaan tarvitse osata valmiiksi. Meille tärkeää on vahvan ammatillisen osaamisen lisäksi utelias mieli ja kiinnostus kehittyä työssäsi.



Satsaamme sinuun ja työyhteisöösi
Haluamme, että ihmisemme voivat kehittyä osaajina omannäköisellään tavalla. Saat ympärillesi osaavan ja kannustavan työyhteisön sekä laajan asiantuntijaverkoston, jonka kanssa pääset ratkaisemaan vaativia suunnitteluhaasteita.

title: Hæmatologi med hjerte og faglighed - vi søger en stedfortræder for oversygeplejerskerne i sengeafsnittene
description:
Hæmatologi med hjerte og faglighed Vi søger en stedfortræder for oversygeplejerskerne i sengeafsnittene Har du blik for både mennesker, faglighed og det gode overblik?
Trives du tæt på patienterne – men får du også energi af at skabe struktur, koordinere og få hverdagen til at hænge sammen?

Så er det måske dig, vi leder efter!

I Hæmatologisk Afdeling X søger vi en stedfortræder for oversygeplejerskerne i vores sengeafsnit – en rolle, hvor du får mulighed for at kombinere det bedste fra to verdener: klinisk sygepleje og ledelse.

Vi leder efter dig, der holder af den kliniske del af sygeplejen, men som samtidig har lyst til at arbejde med organisering, strategi, koordinering og struktur. Måske har du allerede ledererfaring – eller måske er du nysgerrig på ledelse og har lyst til at prøve kræfter med det.

Hvis det sidste er tilfældet, så tør vi godt sige: Her er et rigtig godt sted at begynde!

Hos os står du aldrig alene

I Hæmatologisk Afdeling X tror vi på, at vi lykkes bedst sammen. Det gælder både i klinikken og i ledelsen.

Alle vores ledere arbejder i makkerpar – og det kommer du også til. I bliver nemlig to tværgående stedfortrædere for oversygeplejerskerne, som sammen understøtter sengeafsnittene og bidrager til den daglige drift, udvikling og koordinering.

Det betyder, at der altid er nogen at sparre med, dele idéer med og finde løsninger sammen med.

60 % klinik – 40 % ledelse og koordinering

Stillingen er som udgangspunkt fordelt med:

60 % klinisk arbejde
40 % administrativt, koordinerende og ledelsesmæssigt arbejde

Fordelingen planlægges ud fra afdelingens behov og kan derfor variere. Det giver en hverdag med både nærhed til patienterne, faglige udfordringer og mulighed for at få indflydelse på, hvordan vi organiserer og udvikler vores afdeling. Du arbejder hver 4.weekend, deltager i vagtarbejde og arbejder også på helligdage. Du refererer til oversygeplejerske Charlotte Bang Pedersen, X Nord.

Vi sørger for, at du kommer godt fra start

Du får naturligvis en grundig og tryg introduktion til både afdelingen, arbejdsopgaverne og din nye rolle.

Nedenfor kan du læse meget mere om os, vores afdeling og det arbejde, du bliver en vigtig del af.

Ansættelse snarest muligt eller pr. 1. november 2026.

Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig – og måske byde vores nye kollega og stedfortræder velkommen til Hæmatologisk Afdeling X.



Du er aldrig alene
Som ny sygeplejerske på Hæmatologisk afdeling er du aldrig alene. Uanset om du er erfaren eller nyuddannet, følges du med en mentor fra vores Onboarding team i alle vagtlag, og du får et skræddersyet oplæringsprogram for de 12 første uger udarbejdet af vores introduktionsansvarlige sygeplejerske, så du bliver klædt godt på til opgaven. Som ny sygeplejerske på afdelingen har du løbende refleksion med fokus på trivsel og faglighed med den introduktionsansvarlige sygeplejerske. Efter de 12 uger bliver du mødt af vores uddannelsesansvarlige sygeplejerske, som i samarbejde med dig vil sikre din videre mulighed for læring og udvikling.

Du får også
Blandede vagter med indflydelse på vagtplan via ønsker i Hosinfo

Mulighed for efter- og videreuddannelse

Weekendvagt hver 3. weekend, mulighed for 12 timers vagter hver 4. weekend.

Vores værdier
Vores afdeling er bundet sammen af et særligt værdifællesskab. Vi har defineret de fire mest fremtrædende værdier – passer de til dig?

Vi arbejder sammen
På Hæmatologisk afdeling har vi et helt unikt sammenhold, der går på tværs af faggrænser og afsnit. Sygeplejersker, læger, social- og sundhedsassistenter, fysio- og ergoterapeuter, tandplejere, diætister, socialrådgiver, husassistenter, sekretærer og hospitalspræst arbejder sammen som en enhed for patienternes bedste. Vi har faste tværfaglige konferencer, hvor vi sammen planlægger den bedste pleje og behandling for de enkelte patienter. Vi har forskellige tværfaglige arbejdsgrupper, der arbejder målrettet med alt fra ernæring til seksualitet og socialt udsatte. Afdelingen er præget af en flad struktur, hvor alle kan byde ind med nye input. Vi arbejder tæt sammen med patienter og pårørende – alle er en del af vores arbejdsgrupper og deltager også i ansættelsesudvalg.

Supervision er en naturlig del af vores hverdag.

Vi tager ansvar
Vi arbejder hele tiden på at blive bedre, og det er dybt indgroet i vores kultur, at vi handler hurtigt for at løse problemer. Samtidig arbejder vi på at lære af vores fejl. Afdelingen er præget af ordentlighed og af en fællesskabsfølelse, som betyder, at vi tager ansvar for patienter og pårørende, men også for at vi alle lever op til afdelingens værdier.

Vi arbejder tæt sammen på kryds og tværs af både afsnit og faggrænser.

Vi tænker nyt
Vi er hele tiden på vej nye steder hen, og det kan du se, når du kommer ind i afdelingen. Vi har en meget aktiv forskningsenhed og et tæt samarbejde med afdelingens projektsygeplejersker.

Vores Hjemmeenhed arbejder løbende med patient empowerment – fx i form af hjemmekemo med CADD-pumper.

Vi har masser af idéer, og du vil blive mødt af mange undervisnings- og uddannelsestilbud.

Vi skaber stemning
Det kollegiale sammenhold er i særklasse hos os. Når du starter, vil du møde en personalegruppe, der tager imod dig med åbne arme. Hos os tager vi hånd om hinanden, og den gode stemning bemærkes af patienter og pårørende. Vi har en stor årlig personalefest, i januar holder vi nytårskur, og vi har to fælles årlige temadage. Vi synger morgensang med patienterne året rundt, og vi har et korps af frivillige, som hygger om patienterne. Mange af os laver også ting sammen i fritiden – vi har lige startet et håndboldhold, og vi mødes også til fredagsbar J

Løn- og ansættelsesforhold
Løn- og ansættelsesforhold sker i henhold til overenskomst mellem DSR og Regionernes lønnings- og takstnævn og er omfattet af lokal løndannelse.

Vil du vide mere?
Så kontakt meget gerne en af vores to oversygeplejersker på sengeafsnittene:

Marianne Bjerg Appel oversygeplejerske, tlf. 2337 8119 afsnit X-syd eller oversygeplejerske Charlotte Bang Pedersen, afsnit X-Nord, tlf. 2034 2502

Ansøgningsfrist
Ansøgningsfrist d. 19.10. Samtaler d.23.10.OUH er Patientens Universitetshospital i Region Syddanmark.
Vi varetager både behandling af borgere med fysiske og psykiske sygdomme i hospitalnær- og regionsområde og modtager patienter fra hele landet med behov for højt specialiseret behandling inden for en række områder.

OUH er et f landets største sygehuse og har ca. 13.000 medarbejdOUH er Patientens Universitetshospital i Region Syddanm

title: Logistics Officer
description:
Company Overview
Action Against Hunger is an international humanitarian organization committed to ending world hunger. For almost 45 years, across countries, we have been working to fight undernutrition and support communities affected by crisis across the globe.

We carry out innovative, lifesaving programs in Health, Nutrition, Water, Sanitation and Hygiene, Mental Health and Psychosocial Support, Food Security and Livelihoods, and Social Protection.

Action Against Hunger began operations in Nigeria in 2010 in response to the high rate of chronic malnutrition in Northern Nigeria, focusing on integrated programming. Action Against Hunger currently implements multi-sectoral humanitarian and development interventions in Northeast and Northwest Nigeria, funded by AFD, EU/ECHO, French Government, GAC, SIDA, US Government, and GIZ.

Action Against Hunger Nigeria (ACF Nigeria) Ltd/Gte is currently recruiting a Logistics Officer based in Sokoto. The Logistics Officer will provide logistics support to the programmes and oversee the day to day logistics activities of the base. Key areas of responsibility include the fleet management, maintenance, facilities management and other logistics operations to ensure effective and efficient programme delivery.


Position Details

Reporting to: Logistics and Supply Chain Manager

Proposed start date: October 2026

Work location: Katsina, Katsina State



KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Mission 1: Provide logistics support to the base programs
  • Support requesters in the development of their purchase requests and stock release orders;
  • Provide technical support to Programme Managers (PMs) in the development of the terms of reference;
  • Prepare and supervise construction/rehabilitation work in the field;
  • Monitor requests with the supply team;
  • Support programs during the distributions;
  • Supervise the production of kits;
  • Support programs in their various technical logistics activities, as needed.

Mission 2: Ensure the proper functioning of the base's fleet
  • Develop vehicle schedules based on program needs;
  • Prepare the planning of the drivers under his responsibility according to the number of vehicles to be covered, and update this planning according to the evolution of the requests or the constraints;
  • Prepare (administrative documents and loading) the vehicle's movements off base;
  • Ensure communication with the base staff on planned maintenance and inherent malfunctions.

Mission 3: Ensure the maintenance and follow-up of the facilities
  • Ensure that the condition of the facilities is checked at regular intervals;
  • Supervise small repairs / rehabilitations;
  • Report on the need for major rehabilitation;
  • Report the needs for furniture/small equipment;
  • Ensure the supply of water and energy to all facilities required for the operation of the base and the living environment;
  • Monitor the contract's management of facilities.


Mission 4: Manage the ICT resources of the base (in case there is no ICT Officer in the Base Office)
  • Solve common user problems;
  • Ensure compliance with ICT standards on computers;
  • Supervise the data backup system (backup policy).

Mission 5: Supervise the logistics team of the base
  • Organize the work of the base logistics department;
  • Manage the recruitment for the base logistics department;
  • Contribute to the development of the training plan;
  • Conducting the yearly evaluation interviews;
  • Provide technical support to the team as needed.

Mission 6: Reporting
  • Produce a complete monthly logistics report
  • Contract Follow-up
  • Equipment List
  • Fleet Management Report
  • Stock Follow-up

Additional Responsibilities
  • This job description is not intended to be all inclusive and the employee will also perform other related tasks as required and responsible for reporting and communication of progress and achievement of the specific assigned task
  • Maintenance of high technical standards
  • Conduct all duties in a professional manner following ACF Nigeria mission staff regulations, ACF mandate and charter including promotion of gender equality

Position Requirements:
  • Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Logistics, Supply Chain Management, Purchasing and Supply, or a related field. A Master’s degree is an advantage.
  • Relevant professional certification, such as CIPS or CILT, is an added advantage.
  • Minimum of 2 years’ experience in logistics management, preferably in a humanitarian, development, or I/NGO setting.
  • Strong leadership, team management, training, and capacity-building skills.
  • Excellent organizational, analytical, reporting, communication, interpersonal, and negotiation skills, with strong attention to detail.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office, particularly Word, Excel, and PowerPoint.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities, work independently, and perform effectively under pressure, including in challenging or insecure environments.
  • High level of integrity, accountability, flexibility, resilience, and transparency.
  • Good command of English and Hausa, with the ability to engage effectively with diverse stakeholders.

At Action Against Hunger, we foster a work culture that champions diversity, equity and inclusion. We are committed to creating an environment where every employee feels valued, respected, and empowered to thrive

Application Deadline:
Thursday, 24 September, 2026 at 05:00 pm (Nigerian Time)

Important Notice:
Action Against Hunger does not charge any fee at any stage of the recruitment process – this includes application, interview, or processing fees.

Our Commitment:
We are dedicated to preventing all forms of unwanted behaviour in the workplace, including sexual harassment, exploitation and abuse, lack of integrity, and financial misconduct. We are equally committed to safeguarding the welfare of children, young people and adults. We prioritize hiring individuals who embody and uphold our core values.

Equal Opportunity Employer:
Action Against Hunger is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We do not discriminate based on race, colour, religion, gender, national origin, age, disability or genetic information.
Qualified women are strongly encouraged to apply.

Recruitment Process:
All shortlisted candidates will undergo thorough reference and background checks, and are expected to adhere to organizational standards and principles.

Employee Benefits Include (bot are not limited to):
  • 100% health care coverage
  • Free and direct access to Talent Soft e-learning platform
  • Maternity or Paternity leave
  • Compassionate leave for a hospitalized child
  • Creche facilities for babies

Application Instructions:
All applicants MUST answer every question in the application form. Incomplete applications will not be considered.

title: Hardware Regulatory Engineer
description:
Hardware Regulatory Engineer

Description -

Job Summary

We are looking for a Regulatory Engineer to join our Hardware Test Team within LaserJet Hardware R&D organization. The position supports regulatory readiness, product compliance, and qualification testing across both new product development (NPI) and post-launch (CPE) programs.

Responsibilities include collaborating with Regulatory Engineers, R&D teams, CPE teams, packaging partners, and subject matter experts to drive regulatory compliance and product qualification activities. The position encompasses planning and executing compliance, reliability, and regulatory testing, evaluating results against worldwide regulatory requirements, and supporting the delivery of safe, compliant, and high-quality products. The successful candidate will also investigate and resolve compliance-related issues, support sustainability initiatives, and ensure continued product quality and regulatory compliance throughout the product lifecycle.

In addition, the position contributes to the digital transformation of engineering workflows through the development of AI-enabled and data-driven solutions that enhance test automation, reporting, and analytics.

This position provides an excellent opportunity to build expertise across regulatory compliance, product qualification, reliability testing, sustainability initiatives, and data-driven engineering solutions while working at the intersection of R&D, product quality, and regulatory engineering.



Responsibilities

Collaborate early in the design cycle to identify product quality and non-compliance risks, and recommend design improvements that enhance compliance, robustness, and regulatory readiness.

title: Sairaanhoitaja, Päihdepalvelut, Korvaushoito, Turku
description:
Korvaushoidon sairaanhoitajana työskentelet osana korvaushoidon moniammatillista tiimiä. Vastaat korvaushoidon kokonaisvaltaisesta toteuttamisesta, johon kuuluu lääkehoidon lisäksi erilaisten psykososiaalisten tukimuotojen tarjoaminen. Saat tehtävään myös koulutusta, joka tukee osaamisesi kehittämistä.

Työssäsi kohtaat täysi-ikäisiä potilaita ja toimit tiiviissä yhteistyössä koko yksikön henkilöstön kanssa. Pääset osallistumaan yksikön toiminnan kehittämiseen sekä kehittämään samalla omaa ammattitaitoasi osana osaavaa työyhteisöä.

Työ on päivätyötä, ja siihen sisältyy myös viikonloppuvuoroja. Työsuhteessa noudatetaan 6 kk koeaikaa.

Mitä tarjoamme sinulle

Tarjoamme mahdollisuuden tehdä monipuolista ja vaikuttavaa työtä, jossa yhdistyvät lääkehoidollinen osaaminen ja psykososiaalinen tuki. Saat tehtävääsi koulutusta ja pääset työskentelemään moniammatillisessa ympäristössä yhdessä kokeneiden ammattilaisten kanssa. Työssäsi pääset kehittämään osaamistasi sekä osallistumaan yksikön toiminnan jatkuvaan kehittämiseen.

Mitä odotamme sinulta

Etsimme sairaanhoitajaa, jolla on kokemusta mielenterveys- ja päihdetyöstä sekä valmius työskennellä kokonaisvaltaisesti korvaushoidon asiakkaiden kanssa.

Eduksi luemme:
- kokemuksen korvaushoidosta
- mielenterveys- ja päihdetyön lisäkoulutukset
- ruotsin kielen osaamisen.

Tehtävässä edellytetään suomen kielen taitoa.

Kelpoisuusvaatimuksena on terveydenhuollon ammattihenkilöistä annetun lain (559/1994) mukainen sairaanhoitajan laillistus.

Jos haluat tehdä merkityksellistä työtä osana korvaushoidon moniammatillista tiimiä, jätä hakemuksesi ja tule mukaan rakentamaan laadukasta ja vaikuttavaa hoitoa.

title: Donor Recruitment Coordinator
description:
BioIVT is a leading global provider of research models and value-added research services for drug discovery and development. We specialize in control and disease-state biospecimens, including human and animal tissues, cell products, blood and other biofluids. Our unmatched portfolio of clinical specimens directly supports precision medicine research, aiming to improve patient outcomes by coupling comprehensive clinical data with donor samples. As the premier supplier of hepatic products, including hepatocytes and subcellular fractions, BioIVT enables scientists to better understand the pharmacokinetics and drug metabolism of newly discovered compounds and their effects on disease processes. By combining our technical expertise, exceptional customer service and unparalleled access to biological specimens, BioIVT serves the research community as a trusted partner in elevating science

Our global team is made up of a diverse group of professionals committed to serving the needs of our 30,000 clients around the globe. Our culture’s core values consist of respect, integrity, accountability, communication, and quality. We operate in a fast-paced environment that, while in operation for over 30 years, maintains an entrepreneurial spirit and a “can do” attitude.

Job Purpose

The Donor Recruitment Coordinator is responsible for supporting diverse duties that relate to the donor program.

Duties and responsibilities

  • Plan, develop, implement, and evaluate programs designed to attract and retain donors for the company’s donor center programs, including community involvement, hospital involvement, on-site recruitment, conversion donors, education, etc.
  • If applicable, follow up with all accepted prescreens regarding the program and preparedness for first donation. Follow up with deferred or rejected prescreens regarding potential referrals to the program.
  • Maintain donor retention and recognition programs.
  • Maintain records and reports of donor recruiter activities in assigned area to assure continuity of recruitment programs.
  • Ensure and maintain an adequate supply of donor recruitment materials for use in assigned area.
  • Compile monthly statistics to measure and track prescreen results and demographics.
  • Develop and maintain a positive rapport with client hospitals’ public relations offices, as well as local media.
  • Establish tracking system to monitor efficacy of various recruitment approaches.
  • Actively participate in the development of advertising and promotional products.
  • If applicable, follow-up with donors who have become inactive. Investigate cause and encourage them to return to the program.
  • If applicable, assure donor satisfaction through regular follow-up with donors to ensure their donation was as pleasant an experience as possible and to collect feedback toward increasing our level of service.
  • Provide accurate information to potential donors regarding procedures to be performed including safety/hazards of the procedures.
  • Participate in community organizations and activities such as Chamber of Commerce and service clubs to stimulate interest in the donor programs and establish potential donor referral sources. Participate in outreach programs such as health fairs and expos.
  • Constantly develop new donor sources. Maintain an ongoing public and media relations program in assigned area.
  • Exposure to bloodborne pathogens and need to follow SOPs and CGMPs for protection.
  • Knows and follows safety rules relative to area(s) or responsibility. Follows Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) and Current Good Manufacturing Practices (cGMPs) and external regulations regarding the products and procedures.

Qualifications

  • Follow all Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), current Good Manufacturing Practices (cGMPs), FDA and AABB regulations as set forth by the Company.
  • Consistently demonstrates excellent interpersonal skills and professionalism to company management, all levels of staff and donors.
  • Maintain clean and organized work area.
  • Adhere to company policies and procedures and sets a positive example for others within the organization. Meets department quality standards.
  • Be available to work a flexible schedule including evenings and weekends.
  • Excellent customer service skills, self-motivated, self-starter, well organized and detail-oriented approach to tasks.
  • Must have a pleasant phone voice and etiquette and project a professional demeanor, both in person and on the phone.
  • High school diploma or comparable education, required.
  • 2 years customer service experience and/or 1-year general office work preferred. Customer service background strongly preferred.
  • Proficient use of Microsoft Office products including Word, Excel, Outlook and PowerPoint.
  • Ability to quickly learn new software programs as needed.
  • You are a team player. You take your work very seriously, but not always yourself.
  • You are dedicated and reliable
  • You are looking for an organization that values mission-driven, loyal individuals focused on achieving goals those in need of our services.
  • You get things done

We offer a comprehensive benefit package for eligible team members, including medical, dental, vision, short-term/long-term disability, life insurance, hospital indemnity and accident insurance. We also provide a generous retirement plan with a company match. Eligible employees enjoy competitive time-off policies and a collaborative environment that promotes growth from within. Enjoy company-sponsored events for the entire team!

Join Us!

We can’t wait to work with you! At BioIVT, we believe that diversity and inclusion are key drivers of innovation and success. We are committed to creating a workplace where everyone feels valued, respected and empowered to bring their unique perspectives to the table. We seek to build a diverse team and encourage applications from people of all backgrounds, experiences and identities.

To Learn more about our mission and team culture, click here!

BioIVT is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are dedicated to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability status, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

title: Product Owner – Mobile & Web Platforms
description:
Join our dynamic team at IC as a Product Owner – Mobile & Web Platforms and help shape the future of FinTech innovation. This full-time, on-site opportunity based in Limassol offers you the chance to make a real impact in a fast-paced and forward-thinking environment. Apply now and take the next step in your career with us!

Who We Are:


IC is a global leader in trading with over 15 years of success, a strong international presence, and a team of skilled professionals, remains at the forefront of financial technology innovation. As an agile company that values growth and collaboration, we offer an exciting opportunity to be part of a dynamic industry where innovation meets excellence.

What You’ll Do:


We are seeking an experienced Product Owner – Mobile & Web Platforms to own and drive the development, enhancement, and continuous improvement of IC Markets' trader-facing mobile and web platforms. This role has a strong focus on the trading experience, therefore a solid background in Forex, CFDs, and online trading platforms is essential. The Product Owner will be responsible for translating product strategy and business objectives into a clear roadmap, prioritised backlog, and well-defined requirements for Engineering and QA teams. The successful candidate should have a strong understanding of trader behaviour, trading workflows, and the end-to-end trading lifecycle, as well as how trading platforms integrate with the broader brokerage ecosystem.





What We’re Looking For:


  • Own and manage the product roadmap and backlog for the mobile application and web trading platform.
  • Translate product strategy, trading requirements, and client needs into clear epics, user stories, acceptance criteria, and functional requirements.
  • Work closely with Product Management to convert strategic priorities into executable initiatives for Engineering teams.
  • Drive the development and continuous improvement of core trading capabilities across mobile and web, including:

-> Market watch and instruments

-> Charts and technical indicators

-> Order placement and execution

-> Open positions and pending orders

-> Stop Loss and Take Profit functionality

-> Trading history and account activity

-> Pricing and market data

-> Account and portfolio information

-> Trading notifications and alerts


  • Ensure a consistent and high-quality trading experience across mobile and web platforms.
  • Understand trader behaviour and identify opportunities to improve trading workflows, usability, platform performance, and client engagement.
  • Work closely with Trading and technical teams on requirements related to order execution, pricing, instruments, trading conditions, and platform behaviour.
  • Collaborate with Engineering, QA, Business Analysts, UX/UI, Compliance, and other Product teams throughout the full product development lifecycle.
  • Lead backlog refinement and prioritisation, ensuring requirements are clear, complete, and ready for development.
  • Manage product dependencies and integrations with other systems, including Trading Platform Infrastructure, Client Area, CRM, Back Office, Payments, KYC/onboarding, and reporting systems.
  • Understand and support integrations with trading technologies such as MT4/MT5, DxTrade, cTrader, ICTrade, and proprietary trading services.
  • Partner with UX/UI and Product Design teams to continuously improve the trader experience across mobile and web.
  • Conduct market and competitor analysis across leading Forex, CFD, and multi-asset trading platforms.
  • Analyze platform usage, trading behaviour, feature adoption, and client feedback to support prioritisation and product decisions.
  • Define and track product KPIs covering engagement, trading activity, feature adoption, platform stability, and customer experience.
  • Participate in UAT, release readiness, and production validation of new features.
  • Ensure regulatory and entity-specific requirements are incorporated into product functionality where applicable.
  • Maintain clear and structured product documentation in Jira and Confluence.
  • Proactively identify product risks, dependencies, delivery blockers, and customer experience issues.
  • Use AI and LLM-based tools where appropriate to support product research, requirements analysis, documentation, and delivery while complying with company confidentiality and data-handling requirements.

Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree in Business, Finance, Economics, Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related field.
  • 3+ years of experience as a Product Owner, Product Manager, or similar product role within Forex, CFDs, online trading, or fintech.
  • Strong practical understanding of Forex and CFD trading is essential.
  • Strong understanding of financial markets, trading instruments, and trader behaviour.
  • Strong understanding of the end-to-end trading lifecycle, including:

->Order types and order management

->Market and limit orders

->Stop Loss and Take Profit

->Positions, exposure, and trading history

->Pricing and market data

->Spreads, leverage, and margin

->Order execution and trading platform behaviour

  • Experience working with mobile and web trading platforms.
  • Hands-on knowledge of trading platforms such as MT4/MT5, DxTrade, cTrader, ICTrade, or other proprietary platforms.
  • Experience defining product requirements, user stories, acceptance criteria, and managing complex product backlogs.
  • Experience working with APIs, system integrations, and interconnected platforms.
  • Good understanding of the broader Forex/CFD brokerage ecosystem, including Client Area, CRM, Back Office, KYC, payments, and trading infrastructure.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to use product data and trader feedback to support prioritisation.
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
  • Ability to work effectively with both technical teams and trading/business stakeholders.
  • Experience working in Agile environments using Jira and Confluence.
  • Awareness of regulatory frameworks relevant to Forex/CFD brokers, including FSA, ASIC, CySEC, and MiFID II.
  • Strong attention to detail with a focus on product quality, platform reliability, and trader experience.

title: Karrieremuligheder: Studentermedhjælper til Kultur & Kollegaer (15624)
description:
“Som studentermedhjælper i Kultur & Kollegaer tør vi godt love et sjovt og lærerigt studiejob. Du får en bred rolle og understøtter vores daglige arbejde med bl.a. læring og udvikling. Du bliver også en del af arbejdet med at understøtte PFA’s digitale transformation og bidrager til adoptionen af forskellige AI- og Microsoft-værktøjer,” siger Karina Spiermann, chef for Kultur & Kollegaer.

Så hvad er det egentlig, du skal?

Du kommer til at understøtte udviklingskonsulenterne i deres opgaver. Samtidig får du ansvar for dine egne opgaver og projekter, som i begyndelsen primært vil have administrativ karakter. Dit ansvar vil løbende blive udvidet, i takt med at du bliver onboardet i PFA og opbygger mere viden gennem dit studie.

Som studentermedhjælper bliver du ansvarlig for at:

  • Supportere HR-årshjulsaktiviteter administrativt.
  • Planlægge / understøtte kurser og træning bl.a. inden for digital kompetenceudvikling - fra booking af deltagere og klargøring til afvikling og opdatering af materialer.
  • Udarbejde surveys og sammenfatte dataindsigter, som danner grundlag for beslutningstagen.
  • Udarbejde og opdatere indhold til PFA’s intranet.
  • Bidrage til vores udviklingsprojekter med ad hoc-opgaver og projektstyring af mindre projekter.

Stillingen er på ca. 15 timer om ugen. Vi planlægger arbejdstiden, så den passer med dit studie.

Hvem er du?

Vi søger dig, der:

  • Er i gang med en relevant bacheloruddannelse inden for HR, organisation, læring eller digital udvikling.
  • Er nysgerrig på mennesker, organisationer og udvikling og har lyst til at lære mere om, hvordan man skaber gode rammer for læring og kompetenceudvikling.
  • Arbejder struktureret og analytisk og kan skabe overblik over nye opgaver og problemstillinger.
  • Du tager ansvar - er ikke bange for at løbe med bolden og følge dine opgaver til dørs.
  • Har flair for AI og bruger det dagligt.
  • Er nysgerrig på, hvordan vi kan hjælpe andre med at styrke deres digitale kompetencer og skabe mere værdi med AI.

Din nye hverdag i PFA

I afdelingen Kultur & Kollegaer er vi 25 kollegaer. Du bliver en del af udviklingsteamet, som består af otte kollegaer, herunder to studenter. I teamet arbejder vi med kultur og kompetenceudvikling, og det betyder blandt andet, at vi har opgaver inden for employer branding, talentudvikling, digitale kompetencer samt diversitet og inklusion. I hverdagen har vi et tæt samarbejde på tværs af afdelingen, og vi hjælper altid hinanden ved behov.

Hvad er det helt særlige, vi kan i PFA?

I PFA er hverdagen noget, vi glæder os til. Du bliver en del af et inkluderende fællesskab og har mulighed for at deltage i en bred vifte af aktiviteter – fra boksning og løbeklub til fredagscaféer. På tværs af PFA er der mere end 60 studentermedhjælpere, og gennem foreningen PFA Students får du gode muligheder for både faglig og social sparring samt deltagelse i forskellige events. Du kan se frem til gode arbejdsforhold. Fx byder køkkenet på frokost til alle kostpræferencer, og du kan købe takeaway med hjem. Vi er placeret i PFA’s nyrenoverede lokaler i Nordhavn i København, hvor du har let adgang til både metro og S-tog.

Lyder det som noget for dig?
Du behøver ikke at skrive en lang ansøgning, men blot nogle få linjer om din motivation for at søge stillingen. Vi afholder samtaler i uge 42 og 43, men vi indkalder løbende til indledende dialoger, så vi opfordrer dig til at sende dit CV hurtigst muligt og senest den 4. oktober 2026. Vil du vide mere om stillingen, er du velkommen til at kontakte Emil Seider, Kultur- & Udviklingskonsulent – Graduate, på tlf. 26 12 47 89.

title: Projektiasiantuntija, CreaTech Growth Lab -hanke
description:
Tavoitteena kasvun kierre - rakennamme Helsingistä kilpailukykyisen alustan luoville aloille.

Helsingin kaupunki hakee projektiasiantuntijaa uuteen Crea+Tech Growth Lab -hankkeeseen. Helsingin kaupunki toimii kaksivuotisen hankkeen päätoteuttajana yhteistyössä Metropolia Ammattikorkeakoulun ja Taideyliopiston kanssa. Hankkeen tavoitteena on rakentaa pääkaupunkiseudulle uusi luovien alojen ja teknologiasektorin yritysten yhteinen tutkimus-, kehitys- ja innovaatiotoiminnan yhteistyömalli, joka vahvistaa yritysten kasvua, osaamisen uudistumista ja poikkialaista yhteistyötä.

Projektiasiantuntijana toimit osana kolmen henkilön hanketiimiä ja vastaat hankkeen sisällöllisen kehittämistyön valmistelusta ja toteutuksen tukemisesta. Työskentelet tiiviissä yhteistyössä projektipäällikön, hankekumppaneiden, yritysten ja muiden sidosryhmien kanssa. Keskeinen tehtäväsi on varmistaa, että hankkeessa kehitettävät toimintamallit, palvelut ja yhteistyörakenteet vastaavat yritysten tarpeisiin ja tukevat hankkeen tavoitteiden saavuttamista.

Tehtäviisi kuuluu:
- luovien alojen ja teknologiasektorin yritysten tuotekehitystarpeiden kartoittaminen
- kansallisen ja kansainvälisen vertailutiedon kokoaminen, analysointi ja hyödyntäminen hankkeen kehittämistyössä
- yritysten yhteisten kehitysprojektien ja uusien palveluiden suunnittelun, valmistelun ja seurannan tukeminen
- työpajojen, yhteiskehittämisen ja muiden osallistavien toimintojen sisällöllinen valmistelu ja toteutus
- hankkeen aikana syntyvän palautteen, kokemustiedon ja kehittämisaineiston analysointi sekä jatkovalmistelu
- yritys-, korkeakoulu- ja sidosryhmäverkostojen kehittäminen ja yhteistyön koordinointi
- hankkeen tulosten dokumentointi sekä raportointia tukevien aineistojen ja sisältöjen tuottaminen.

Tarjoamme sinulle ainutlaatuisen mahdollisuuden olla rakentamassa Helsinkiin ja pääkaupunkiseudulle uutta kasvua ja innovaatioita luovien alojen ja teknologia-alan rajapinnassa. Tehtävä tarjoaa näköalapaikan Helsingin elinkeino- ja innovaatiokehitykseen sekä luovien alojen edistämiseen sekä Helsingissä että Suomessa. Sinulla on mahdollisuus työskennellä laajassa yritys-, korkeakoulu- ja julkisen sektorin verkostossa sekä osallistua uudenlaisten palvelujen, toimintamallien ja yhteistyörakenteiden kehittämiseen. Tuet kaupunkistrategian sekä kaupungin pitkän aikavälin kasvun, osaamisen ja elinvoiman tavoitteiden toteutumista. Tehtäväsi sijoittuu elinkeino-osastolle (Business Helsinki), jonka työn ytimessä on kaupungin kilpailukyvyn, yrittäjyyden ja työllisyyden edistäminen sekä matkailun kehitys ja maahanmuutto.

Tehtävän kelpoisuusehtona on soveltuva korkeakoulututkinto tai muu tehtävään soveltuva koulutus.

Lisäksi tehtävässä edellytetään kokemusta luovien alojen kehittämis-, innovaatio- tai projektitehtävistä, kykyä analysoida ja jäsentää laajoja kokonaisuuksia, vahvoja vuorovaikutus- ja yhteistyötaitoja sekä erinomaista suomen kielen ja hyvää englannin kielen taitoa.

Eduksi luetaan tutkimus-, kehitys- ja innovaatiotoiminnan tuntemus, kokemus yritys- ja sidosryhmäyhteistyöstä, luovien alojen ja teknologiatoimialan toimintaympäristön tuntemus sekä kokemus julkisesti rahoitetuista kehittämishankkeista.

title: Juniorredaktør til GDF.dk
description:
Vil du være med til at designe og producere opgaver og andre undervisningsmaterialer af høj kvalitet til grundskolen? Vi søger netop nu en medarbejder til Forlaget GDF. Vores mål er at udbyde undervisningsmaterialer, som fremmer lysten til læring, og som kan bruges direkte i undervisningen. Alle vores materialer udgives digitalt på .

Stillingen er en projektansættelse, og den præcise længde såvel som det ugentlige timetal kan tilpasses dine planer. Stillingen er derfor f.eks. oplagt, hvis du holder sabbatår, hvis du er mellem to job eller uddannelser, eller hvis du har lyst til at arbejde med et afgrænset projekt.

Om stillingen

Dine arbejdsopgaver vil primært være at producere opgaver til indskolingen og mellemtrinnet i en række fag. De konkrete fag afhænger af dine kompetencer men kan f.eks. inkludere dansk, engelsk, matematik, natur/teknologi og billedkunst.

Du vil komme til at arbejde tæt sammen med den øvrige redaktion.

Din profil

Vi søger en medarbejder, der er fagligt velfunderet i en bred vifte af fag, og som formår at sætte sig ind i niveauet og læringsmulighederne hos elever på forskellige klassetrin og med forskellige forudsætninger. Du skal trives med computerarbejde, da hovedparten af din arbejdstid vil gå med det.

For at komme i betragtning til stillingen skal du som minimum have et fagligt niveau svarende til en gymnasial uddannelse med gode resultater.

Det er en fordel hvis du har erfaring med målgruppen, f.eks. fra arbejde som lærervikar eller lærer, men det er ikke et krav.

Praktiske forhold

Projektansættelsen kan være på fuld- eller deltid, og længden på ansættelsen kan tilpasses dine ønsker. Vi tilbyder desuden en høj grad af fleksibilitet i placeringen af den ugentlige arbejdstid. Arbejdet foregår på vores kontor i Aarhus centrum, hvor vi p.t. er seks medarbejdere.

Lønnen afhænger af din erfaring og er naturligvis konkurrencedygtig. Vi tilbyder desuden frokostordning, økologisk frugt og sociale arrangementer.

Hos os er omgangstonen uformel og ambitionerne høje. Vi vil være en attraktiv arbejdsplads med et godt arbejdsmiljø og et højt niveau af kollegial sparring.

Ansøgning

Hvis opslaget har vakt din interesse, så send os en ansøgning via denne formular:

Til ansøgningen skal du som minimum vedlægge:

  • CV

  • Relevante karakterudskrifter eller eksamensbeviser. Overstreg venligst dit CPR-nummer.

Ansøgningsfristen er d. 9. oktober 2026.

Har du spørgsmål til stillingen, så kontakt redaktionschef Kaare Østergaard på kno@gdf.dk

title: Customer Relations Specialist, Gulf
description:
L-Acino is part of Arcera, a global life sciences company headquartered in Abu Dhabi, United Arab Emirates. Our purpose is to enable longer and healthier lives while creating sustainable growth. We develop, manufacture, and commercialize a broad range of high-quality innovative and proven medicines in key international markets. With an operational footprint spanning over 90 countries across four continents, and manufacturing sites in eight countries, we offer more than 2,000 medicines across various therapeutic areas worldwide.


The position is based in Cairo, Egypt and will report directly to the Commercial Head, Gulf. The role will be responsible for ensuring the smooth and efficient management of customer-related commercial activities across the Gulf Region. The role coordinates closely with KAMs, customers, distributors, Finance, Supply, and other stakeholders to ensure accurate data, timely payments, effective expiry management, proper contract and documentation management, and adherence to internal processes. The role provides reliable operational and analytical support to the commercial team, contributing to strong customer relationships, accurate financial and commercial management, and effective business performance monitoring.


Your Responsibilities will be:


  • Own the end-to-end process for quarterly credit notes, including preparing calculations, coordinating validation with KAMs and Finance, issuing payment instructions to distributors, and following up on completion.
  • Ensure copies of credit notes are shared with the KAMs and maintain accurate records to support any required adjustments in subsequent quarters.
  • Coordinate with accounts, distributors, and internal Arcera stakeholders to ensure all customer-related payments (e.g., TMA, data sharing, enlisting and other commercial agreements) are supported by the required documentation, processed accurately and on time, and properly archived.
  • Manage multiple payment cycles throughout the year and ensure readiness to support increased activity as CHC expands into new chains.
  • Coordinate the expiry management process between KAMs, accounts, distributors, Finance, and Supply to ensure the correct products are collected, validated, and processed in line with internal policies and procedures.
  • Follow-up on the required customer compensation, ensuring amounts are validated and approved by Finance and that the process is completed accurately and within agreed timelines.
  • Collect, consolidate, validate, and maintain customer stock and sell-out data received from KAMs and ensure data is cleaned, aligned, and shared with relevant stakeholders, including SFE, to support performance monitoring, forecasting, and effective order planning with accounts.
  • Own the annual archiving and consolidation of agreements and customer contracts and maintain an accurate overview of fixed and variable discounts and commercial terms to support monitoring of net revenue, accruals, customer performance, and achievement against commercial targets.
  • Prepare and share quarterly performance reports with Tier 3 accounts, providing visibility on purchases versus agreed targets and highlighting any additional rebates earned or missed.
  • Maintain accurate and up-to-date Gulf pricing and availability databases, including competitor pricing benchmarks, public/private availability matrices, insurance coverage matrices, and other relevant market information to support commercial decision-making.
  • Maintain a consolidated Gulf-wide enlisting tracker and coordinate follow-up on outstanding actions, ensuring timely updates and visibility of progress across relevant stakeholders.
  • Maintain accurate records, trackers, and supporting documentation for customer-related processes, ensuring information is readily accessible for monitoring, reconciliation, reporting, and audit purposes.
  • Act as a central coordination point between KAMs, Accounts/Finance, Supply, distributors, SFE, and other relevant stakeholders to facilitate smooth execution of customer-related activities and ensure timely resolution of operational issues.


    Your Profile:


    • Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Finance, Commerce, or a related field.
    • 3+ years of relevant experience in customer relations, commercial operations, sales operations, order-to-cash, finance coordination, or a similar role.
    • Experience working in Pharma, Healthcare, FMCG, or another distributor/customer-driven environment is preferred.
    • Good understanding of customer and commercial operations processes.
    • Strong Excel skills, including data consolidation, validation, reconciliation, and reporting.
    • Ability to work with customer sales, stock, sell-out, pricing, discount, and target data.
    • Good understanding of commercial terms, rebates, discounts, credit notes, accruals, and revenue-related processes.
    • Understands customer needs and ensures timely, accurate, and professional execution of customer-related activities.
    • Maintains a high level of accuracy when handling financial, commercial, and customer data.
    • Effectively manages multiple recurring activities, deadlines, and stakeholders.
    • Works effectively across KAMs, Finance, Supply, Accounts, distributors, and other functions.
    • Takes ownership of assigned processes and follows through until completion.
    • Identifies discrepancies, follows up on outstanding issues, and coordinates appropriate resolutions.
    • Communicates clearly and effectively with internal and external stakeholders.
    • Uses data accurately to support monitoring, reporting, forecasting, and commercial decision-making.
    • Follows established policies and processes while identifying opportunities for simplification and improvement.


    This is the opportunity to join a very dynamic organization, where decisions are taken fast and where you can actively participate in shaping our future. If this sounds exciting, we would love to hear more about you!


    Data Privacy Note


    In connection with your application, Arcera will collect, process and store personal data about you. Our Data Privacy Notice, provides an overview of the personal data that Arcera processes during the application process.


    Note: This Privacy Notice may be updated by Arcera, we therefore invite you to consult the latest versions via the above links. In the event of any conflict between the English and German versions of this Privacy Notice, the English version shall prevail.

title: Director, Analytics, GCS
description:
About WPP Media

WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. With exceptional talent, trusted data and intelligence, and world-class partnerships – all united by our pioneering agentic marketing platform, WPP Open – we help clients navigate change, capture opportunity, and deliver transformational growth.

WPP Media is WPP's AI-driven media operating unit, bringing together media, data, and partnerships to deliver creative personalisation at scale. Connected through WPP Open and powered by Open Intelligence, clients see exactly where, how, and why their media investment is working.

For more information, visit wppmedia.com.

Role Summary and Impact

The Data, Tech & Analytics capability is on a mission to transform marketing by building the fastest, most connected data platform that bridges marketing strategy to scaled activation.

We work with agencies and clients to transform the value of data by bringing together technology, data and analytics capabilities. We deliver this through the Open Media Studio, an AI-enabled media and data platform for the next era of advertising.

We’re endlessly curious. Our team of thinkers, builders, creators and problem solvers are over 1,000 strong, across 20 markets around the world.

Director, Analytics

  • The core purpose of DTA is to support global and multi-market clients. In turn, the Analytics team has a sharp focus and dedication to developing client relationships through data solutions, and by understanding how data and technology combine to inform analytics and insights to drive better decisions.
  • The Analytics team are committed to building and delivering regular reporting and insight solutions for our clients, and to identify ways of utilizing emerging technologies and analytical techniques to drive growth.
  • The Analytics Director will work closely with the Head of Analytics, the Analytics team and wider client teams to manage and develop the ongoing delivery of relevant Reporting, Analytics, and Optimization solutions across WPP Media client requirements for Colgate Palmolive (CP).
  • Key to success will be the appropriate use of technology and identification of new opportunities and potential solutions – particularly focusing on how media effectiveness contributes to an overall measurement framework for CP.
  • The role will also require the ongoing management and development of Analytics team members where relevant – and the Analytics Director will help ensure the agency and our clients understand and appreciate the breadth of solutions the Analytics team can offer and the value we can add.

Skills and Experience

  • Work with CP to identify analytical requirements, solve challenges, and define and implement analysis roadmaps, acting as the primary analytics liaison for the agency and the client, providing CP stakeholders with actionable insights and recommendations through storytelling and visualization
  • Become an expert in CPs business, systems and ways of working. Be the point of contact for CPs GIT and GDO teams for new workstreams and data pipelines and proactively identify future solutions where necessary
  • Ensure Coordination and Collaboration across functions, markets and with the CP Client, working with Local Market Planning teams to develop, pilot, maintain and enhance a range of Business Intelligence projects ensuring outputs support measurement goals and drive business decisions
  • Lead digital transformation initiatives to modernize data collection, processing, and analytics infrastructure, ensuring data accuracy through clear processes, data governance principles and appropriate technology, and foster collaboration across internal teams (activation, channel teams, and account management), to integrate analytics into all aspects of client engagement
  • Develop templates, frameworks and automation processes for (primarily) Digital Data to enable a relevant, valuable and consistent understanding of media performance for CP. Drive forward pilot projects, testing and case studies and share learnings and best practice across all markets

Other Responsibilities

  • Become familiar with the existing Analytics toolset to utilize on client business, including data visualisation technologies (Power BI, Tableau, Datorama), reporting tools (Microsoft Excel, Looker Studio), data warehouse tools (Google BigQuery), measurement platforms (Google Campaign Manager and Google Analytics) and Effectiveness partners (both within WPP and externally)
  • Develop effective partnerships with key stakeholders within clients, WPP Media, WPP and other specialist companies to know exactly who to call on when required, and when to gain buy-in
  • Help evolve the Analytics offering in areas including Forecasting, Attribution, Machine learning and use of AI to improve processes and solve problems
  • Help develop an open, collaborative, progressive day to day culture within Analytics, WPP Media clients – sharing best practice, and teaching and empowering agency and client end users to leverage BI tools and reach actionable insights
  • Ensure your direct reports are clear and confident on their goals & deliverables and are nurtured to fulfil their potential with regular development conversations, formal reviews and associated training plans, mentoring them to enhance technical expertise, analytical thinking, and client communication

Required skills / experience:

  • Experience of working within a communications agency and/or client organisation – ideally International/multi market
  • A problem solver with excellent senior client / stakeholder management & communication skills and attention to detail
  • The ability to get stuck in and make things happen, and the desire to define and implement creative new solutions to client problems - driving improvement and positive change

Life at WPP Media & Benefits

Our passion for shaping the next era of media is powered by our commitment to Be Extraordinary, investing in our employees to inspire transformational creativity. We also Lead Optimistically, firmly believing in and Championing Growth and Development for every individual. This commitment allows WPP Media employees to leverage the extensive global WPP Media & WPP networks to pursue their passions, build vital professional connections, and learn at the cutting edge of marketing and advertising.

We Create an Open environment built on trust and respect, where everyone feels they belong and has opportunities to progress. This inclusive culture is fostered through a variety of employee resource groups and frequent in-office events showcasing team wins, sharing thought leadership, and celebrating holidays and milestone events. Our comprehensive benefits package reflects this commitment, including competitive medical, group retirement plans, vision, and dental insurance, significant paid time off, preferential partner discounts, and employee mental health awareness days.

WPP Media is an equal opportunity employer and considers applicants for all positions without discrimination or regard to characteristics. We believe the best work happens when we're together, fostering creativity, collaboration, and connection in this open and supportive environment. That's why we’ve adopted a hybrid approach, with teams in the office around four days a week. If you require accommodations or flexibility, please discuss this with the hiring team during the interview process. Please note that while our philosophy is the same across WPP, benefits may vary by office/country.

Please note this is a UK based role and requires individuals to have the right to work in this location

While we appreciate all applications received, only those candidates selected for an interview will be contacted.
