title: Senior Human Data Operations Partner, AI
description:
Senior Human Data Operations Partner, AI

Team: Human Data

Prolific

Prolific is not just another player in the AI space – we are the architects of the human data infrastructure that's reshaping the landscape of AI development. In a world where foundational AI technologies are increasingly commoditized, it's the quality and diversity of human-generated data that truly differentiates products and models.

The role

As a Senior Human Data Operations Partner, you will play a pivotal role in ensuring the smooth execution of end-to-end operational processes that power Prolific's specialised participant pools. You’ll act as a key enabler for client-specific projects, working closely with delivery teams to align participant-related processes with strategic AI customer needs. You’ll also work to transform these processes and workflows into scalable solutions, partnering closely with our product and tech teams to do this. This role demands a hands-on approach to participant onboarding, verification, and quality management, as well as cross-functional collaboration to meet the demands of both internal stakeholders and external clients

What you’ll be doing in the role

  • Develop detailed project plans, workflows, and enablement materials to support efficient delivery.
  • Maintain Prolific’s participant pools as high-quality, diverse, and optimised to meet customer demands.
  • Implement and manage verification processes for domain experts and AI taskers, ensuring their skills and qualifications meet client-specific requirements.
  • Continuously optimise participant onboarding and activation funnels to enhance retention and task performance.
  • Monitor participant engagement and quality metrics, using insights to drive improvements.
  • Contribute to upskilling programmes and certification processes for participants involved in complex AI tasks
  • Work closely with product, data, science, and customer success teams to align operational priorities with strategic objectives.
  • Collaborate with product managers to transform manual processes into scalable, technology-driven solutions.
  • Act as a conduit between delivery teams and operational functions to ensure seamless project execution.
  • Document and communicate operational changes to stakeholders across the business, ensuring smooth adoption.

What you’ll bring to the role

  • Proven experience in human data operations, ideally in marketplace or platform environments.
  • Demonstrated ability to manage multiple projects and meet deadlines in a fast-paced environment.
  • Strong project management skills, with attention to detail and operational execution.
  • Experience in implementing and optimising processes to improve efficiency and scalability.
  • Proficiency in operational tools and systems such as, Zapier,, and HubSpot.
  • Exceptional communication and documentation skills, with a track record of stakeholder enablement.
  • Confidence with data analysis and operational metrics to support decision-making and continuous improvement
  • Familiarity with human data operations, product or data operations, participant recruitment, or managing global crowdsourcing/gig-economy platforms.
  • Experience supporting AI/ML lifecycle projects, such as data labelling, annotation, or domain-specific task curation.
  • Understanding of Prolific’s platform and its role in delivering high-quality human data for AI research.

Why Prolific is a great place to work

We've built a unique platform that connects researchers and companies with a global pool of participants, enabling the collection of high-quality, ethically sourced human behavioral data and feedback. This data is the cornerstone of developing more accurate, nuanced, and aligned AI systems.

We believe that the next leap in AI capabilities won't come solely from scaling existing models but from integrating diverse human perspectives and behaviors into AI development. By providing this crucial human data infrastructure, Prolific is positioning itself at the forefront of the next wave of AI innovation—one that reflects the breadth and the best of humanity.

Working for us will place you at the forefront of AI innovation, providing access to our unique human data platform and opportunities for groundbreaking research. Join us to enjoy a competitive salary, benefits, and remote working within our impactful, mission-driven culture.

title: EMA-Projektleder til Lægemiddelstyrelsen
description:
Kan du se dig selv koordinere centrale godkendelsessager igennem europæiske processer? Kunne du tænke dig at have en faciliterende rolle i godkendelsesprocesser for blandt andet nye banebrydende og avancerede terapier? Ønsker du at gøre brug af din viden til gavn for patienter og dyr i Europa? Og vil du bringe din erfaring med europæiske regulatoriske processer i spil? Så er stillingen som EMA-Projektleder i Lægemiddelstyrelsen måske noget for dig.

Om EMA Projektledelse
Du bliver en del af sektion på 14 engagerede medarbejdere i EMA Projektledelse. Vores sektion er forankret i enheden RKE, Regulatorisk og Klinisk Evaluering, der projektleder de regulatoriske processer og samler de lægemiddelfaglige opgaver i relation til lægemiddelgodkendelse, kliniske forsøg og overvågning af lægemidler både til mennesker og dyr.

Enheden består af ca. 100 medarbejdere, der er en stærk tværgående sammenhængskraft mellem de lægemiddelfaglige enheder i en matrixorganisation. I EMA Projektledelse arbejder vi med koordination af de regulatoriske og proceduremæssige opgaver omkring lægemidler ansøgt via den centrale procedure i EU.

Din hverdag hos os
Som EMA-Projektleder er du med til at projektstyre den fælles europæiske godkendelse og vedligeholdelse af lægemidler til mennesker og dyr via den centrale procedure i samarbejde med det Europæiske Lægemiddelagentur (EMA) og de øvrige EU landes lægemiddelagenturer. I denne stilling arbejdes der både med de humane og veterinære lægemidler

Du skal vejlede kollegaer i regulatoriske emner, sikre at processerne overholder strenge fastsatte tidslinjer samt arrangere og lede relevante projektmøder. Du skal desuden arrangere og undertiden lede videokonferencer med samarbejdspartnere fra myndigheder og lægemiddelindustrien.

Eftersom vi arbejder tværfagligt i en matrixorganisation, vil dine nærmeste kolleger være farmaceuter, læger, dyrlæger, toksikologer, biostatistikere og sprogkonsulenter. Du vil imidlertid også komme i kontakt med mange andre medarbejdere, eksterne eksperter og andre lægemiddelagenturer. Derudover vil du også løbende skulle besvare spørgsmål fra blandt andet borger, læger, lægemiddelindustrien m.m.

Der vil forekomme rejseaktivitet hovedsageligt til EMA, som er beliggende i Amsterdam.

Din uddannelse, erfaring og personlige kvalifikationer
Du har en relevant akademisk uddannelse, eksempelvis farmaceut eller anden naturvidenskabelig uddannelse med kendskab til lægemidler. Derudover vil erfaring inden for lægemiddelgodkendelse være en stor fordel.

Desuden forventer vi, at du:

  • besidder gode samarbejdsevner og en god situationsfornemmelse
  • har erfaring med regulatorisk arbejde g og/eller projektledelse
  • kan arbejde målrettet og er god til at bevare overblikket – også på de dage, hvor du har gang i mange forskelligartede arbejdsopgaver samtidig
  • er god til at formulere dig på skrift og behersker engelsk på højt niveau, både mundtligt og skriftligt
  • er fortrolig med at håndtere store dokumenter/filer
  • kan overholde stramme tidsfrister
  • er motiveret for at arbejde tværfagligt i et internationalt miljø
  • er en god kollega med godt humør og at du har lyst til at lære noget nyt.

Vi tilbyder
En internationalt orienteret arbejdsplads med samarbejdspartnere i hele Europa gennem Det Europæiske Lægemiddelagentur (EMA). Stor kontaktflade til andre myndigheder og lægemiddelindustrien.

Et yderst meningsfuldt arbejde, hvor du bliver en del af et aktivt fagligt miljø med dygtige og engagerede kollegaer.

Et spændende og selvstændigt job med afvekslende arbejdsopgaver i en sektion med et uformelt miljø og gode kollegaer

Arbejdspladsen er centralt beliggende på Islands Brygge tæt på både metro, tog og bus.

Læs mere om os og vores arbejde på Lægemiddelstyrelsen.dk.

Om ansættelsen
Du bliver ansat efter gældende overenskomst mellem Finansministeriet og Akademikernes Centralorganisation eller anden gældende overenskomst.

I Lægemiddelstyrelsen træffer vi afgørelser i myndighedssager, og det er vigtigt for os, at man ikke kan stille spørgsmål ved vores habilitet. Derfor er det en forudsætning, at du ikke ejer aktier, anparter, andele eller lignende i en lægemiddel- og/eller medicovirksomhed. Du har dog en vis periode til at sælge dem, hvis du i dag ejer såkaldte medarbejderaktier i en lægemiddel- og/eller medicovirksomhed.

Kontakt os gerne
Få mere at vide om stillingen ved at ringe til Ella K. Schmidt på tlf 55558472

Du kan læse mere om os og vores opgaver på Lægemiddelstyrelsen.dk.

Er du interesseret?
Klik på "søg stillingen" og send os din ansøgning med CV og eksamensbevis.

title: Komponentansvarig - Produktionstekniker
description:
En ögonblicksbild av din dag

Bli en del av vårt Additive Manufacturing team som tillverkar 3D-printade komponenter till Siemens Energys olika gasturbiner!

Du kommer att bli en viktig kugge i våra kvalificeringar av nya komponenter.

Samtidigt har vi en ökande volym i serieproduktion där du tillsammans med oss andra får ett stort ansvar och möjligheter att reducera kostnader, tider och kvalitetsproblem där ditt fokus är på efterbearbetning av de printade komponenterna.

Vi är en relativt ny verksamhet som just nu är i en tillväxtfas där du får möjlighet att påverka beslut och nya processer!

Hur du kommer att påverka

  • Deltagare i utvecklingsprojekt och kvalificeringar av nya komponenter.
  • Produktionsgranskning av nya underlag.
  • Skapa och underhålla beredningar i SAP i samarbete med produktion.
  • Hantera och implementera ändringar.
  • Driva förbättringsarbete inom kvalitet, tid och kostnad inom ditt komponentansvar.
  • Processförbättringar.

Vad du medför

  • Minst fem års erfarenhet i liknande roller i produktionsmiljö och/eller relevant utbildning på högskolenivå.
  • Flytande svenska och bekväm med att hålla möten på engeska.
  • SAP-erfarenhet är meriterande.
  • Drivande och nyfiken attitude.
  • Bra samarbetsförmåga med olika stakeholders och team.

Om Teamet Lokalt i Finspång är Additive Manufacturing en liten verksamhet som dagligen hjälper varandra att komma framåt, både med kunskap, tid och omtanke. På din avdelning finns projektledare, planerare, säljare och produktionstekniker. Vi arbetar självklart hela tiden nära produktionen men har också mycket kontakt med vår globala AM-organisation samt med R&D, inköp, kunder och andra produktionssiter.

Vårt globala team är engagerat i att göra hållbar, pålitlig och prisvärd energi till verklighet genom att tänja på gränserna för vad som är möjligt. Vi upprätthåller ett 150-årigt arv av innovation som uppmuntrar vår sökning efter personer som kan stödja vårt fokus på avkarbonisering, nya teknologier och energiomvandling.

title: Technical Lead
description:
Why Valtech? We’re the experience innovation company - a trusted partner to the world’s most recognized brands. To our people we offer growth opportunities, a values-driven culture, international careers and the chance to shape the future of experience.

The opportunity

At Valtech, you’ll find an environment designed for continuous learning, meaningful impact, and professional growth. Whether you're pioneering new digital solutions, challenging conventional thinking or building the next generation of customer experiences, your work will help transform industries.

We are proud of:

  • The work we do and the innovation we drive
  • Our values of share, care and dare
  • A workplace culture that fosters creativity, diversity and autonomy
  • Our borderless, global framework, which enables seamless collaboration

The role

As a Technical Lead, you are passionate about experience innovation and eager to push the boundaries of what’s possible. You bring 8+ YEARS of experience, a growth mindset and a drive to make a lasting impact.

You will thrive in this role if you are:

  • A curious problem solver who challenges the status quo
  • A collaborator who values teamwork and knowledge-sharing
  • Excited by the intersection of technology, creativity and data
  • Experienced in Agile methodologies and consulting (a plus)

Role responsibilities

  • Working with Architecture in discussing and elaborating Fraud initiatives and solutions.
  • Working with the Technical Leads/Analysts in solution design ensuring initiative alignment to the fraud strategic technical roadmap.
  • Contributing to the Technical Lead/Analyst Guild including making recommendations on architecture best practices, standards and patterns where necessary.
  • Maintaining the existing Fraud technology view recommending improvements and migrations to improve efficiency and alignment to architecture recommendations.
  • Leading the implementation of software by being involved throughout the SDLC
  • Analysing possible project challenges and constraints (Risks, Time, Resources and Scope), identifying options and mitigating actions.
  • Reviewing functional & non-functional requirements with the Business Analysts, Product Owners, Functional & Technical Architectures to define, document & deliver the best solution.
  • Supporting the core team’s working practices, managing dependencies and commitment from multiple contributing teams
  • Supporting Fraud applications in Production, prioritization of incidents and escalations
  • Supporting the coordination and execution of technical testing, destructive or high availability test and performance test.
  • You’re a problem solver — you can identify and unblock distractions to ensure the team stay focused on the things that deliver value

Must have qualifications

To be considered for this role, you must meet the following essential qualifications:

  • Open to work with UK Business Time - 9:00 AM UK Time to 17:00 UK Time (2:30 PM IST to 10:30 PM IST)
  • Strong communication skills
  • Solid technical background with an ability to unpick complex problems
  • Strong experience with API development, Microservice architecture and pipelines
  • Knowledge of Open API, OAuth2, Docker, Jenkins, Gitlab, Github & Kubernetes
  • Experience with Agile methodologies, Jira and Confluence tools
  • Experience with continuous delivery practices
  • Scoping project requirements, considerations, and dependencies
  • Experience in building new proposals E2E based on high level requirements
  • Ability to Lead multiple workstreams in parallel
  • Excellent understanding of Java 8+
  • Excellent knowledge of OOP and design patterns, including benefits and limitations
  • Excellent understanding of data structures and algorithms, Big O notation and performance analysis
  • Excellent knowledge of Spring and Spring Boot
  • Excellent knowledge of architectural patterns.
  • Experience in designing architecture, including choosing the right tech stack
  • Excellent knowledge of git or similar version control
  • Solid experience in building RESTful APIs
  • Solid experience with both relational and non-relational databases, database architecture and distributed transaction management
  • Experience with distributed architecture principles and solutions for performance, scale and reliability
  • Experience building and packaging components and services, cloud/on-premises deployments, CI/CD, monitoring and observability
  • Experience working with containers (Docker) and orchestration (Kubernetes)
  • Experience with Maven/Gradle/Ant
  • Experience working in Agile/Scrum
  • Good communication and analytical skills

Nice to have qualifications

  • Experience in delivering Fraud related initiatives
  • Experience working within AWS, AWS certification
  • Experience in working with Agile methodologies, Scrum and Kanban leveraging JIRA and Confluence tools
  • Solution architecture capabilities
  • Fraud functional knowledge

If you do not meet all the listed qualifications or have gaps in your experience, we still encourage you to apply. At Valtech, we recognize that talent comes in many forms, and we value diverse perspectives and a willingness to learn.

Commitment to reaching all kinds of people

We design experiences that work for all kinds of people - and that starts with our own teams. At Valtech, we’re intentional about building an inclusive culture where everyone feels supported to grow, thrive and achieve their goals. No matter your background, you belong here. Explore our Diversity & Inclusion site to see how we’re creating a more equitable Valtech for all.

The benefits

This is a Full time position based in Bengaluru.

Beyond a competitive compensation package, we offer:

  • Flexibility, with remote and hybrid work options (country-dependent)
  • Career advancement, with international mobility and professional development programs
  • Learning and development, with access to cutting-edge tools, training and industry experts

Our benefits are tailored to each location. Your Talent Partner will provide full details during the hiring process.

Your application process

Once you apply, our Talent Acquisition team will review your application. Your CV should cover key information on relevant experiences and expertise. We do not require information such as age, gender, marital status, or a headshot in your application. We review all candidates based on skills, experience, and potential.

⚠️ Beware of recruitment fraud! Only engage with official Valtech email addresses ending in @valtech.com.

We are committed to inclusion and accessibility. If you need reasonable accommodations during the interview process, please either indicate it in your application or let your Talent Partner know.

About Valtech

Valtech is the experience innovation company that exists to unlock a better way to experience the world. By blending crafts, categories, and cultures, we help brands unlock new value in an increasingly digital world.

At the intersection of data, AI, creativity, and technology, we drive transformation for leading organizations, including L’Oréal, Mars, Audi, P&G, Volkswagen Dolby, and more.

At Valtech, we don’t just talk about transformation. We make it happen. Our people are the heart of our success, and we foster a workplace where everyone has the support to thrive, grow and innovate.

Are you ready to create what’s next? Join us.

title: Senior Projektledare inom AAM/APM
description:
Om företaget

Hos Avaron får du tryggheten i en fast anställning kombinerat med variationen av att arbeta ute hos olika kunder. Vi tillsätter specialister inom allt från teknik, IT och industri till projektledning och affärsstöd – och oavsett uppdrag har du en konsultchef som finns där för dig och din utveckling.

Om rollen

Du kliver in i ett strategiskt projekt där målet är att skapa bättre kontroll över applikationslandskapet i en komplex kommunkoncern. I dag finns flera applikationslistor i Excel, i olika versioner och utan en gemensam master. En förstudie har redan identifierat behov och krav samt tagit fram en informationsmodell, och en genomlysning av möjliga leverantörer har påbörjats.

Nu behövs en senior projektledare som kan ta nästa steg: kvalitetssäkra förstudien, konkretisera projektets inriktning och leda det fortsatta arbetet mot en hållbar lösning. Du arbetar nära verksamhet och IT, med fokus på struktur, samordning och tydliga beslutsunderlag. Rollen passar dig som trivs när du får kombinera operativ framdrift med strategiska vägval i en miljö där informationssäkerhet, regelefterlevnad och gemensamma arbetssätt är viktiga delar av helheten. Det här är en möjlighet att sätta riktning för ett viktigt systemstöd i en organisation där dina rekommendationer får stor påverkan framåt.

Arbetsuppgifter
  • Du sätter dig in i genomförd förstudie, informationsmodell, målbildsarbete, påbörjad leverantörsgenomlysning och övriga relevanta underlag.
  • Du etablerar och leder projektets inledande fas enligt en XLPM-baserad projektmetodik, inklusive organisation, styrning, mandat, roller, ansvar och beslutsvägar.
  • Du identifierar och involverar berörda verksamheter, intressenter och specialistfunktioner.
  • Du tar över och koordinerar den påbörjade leverantörsgenomlysningen samt säkerställer en strukturerad och jämförbar bedömning utifrån behov, krav och utvärderingskriterier.
  • Du planerar, samordnar och utvärderar en begränsad POC i utvalda system utifrån förankrade testscenarier och utvärderingskriterier.
  • Du tar fram förslag till införandestrategi och en övergripande införandeordning som del av projektplanen.
  • Du sammanställer resultat och rekommendationer samt förbereder vägval och beslut för projektsponsor och styrande forum.
  • Du rapporterar löpande status, ekonomi, risker och beroenden och lyfter hinder i tid för att säkra projektets framdrift.
Krav
  • Du har dokumenterad erfarenhet av att planera införande eller större förändring av systemstöd.
  • Du har dokumenterad erfarenhet av att vara huvudansvarig för införande av Application Portfolio Management (APM), Application Asset Management (AAM), CMDB eller liknande område.
  • Du har erfarenhet av att leda krav- och behovsarbete i nära samverkan mellan verksamhet och IT.
  • Du har erfarenhet av att koordinera leverantörsdialoger och systemutvärderingar och eller POC, pilot eller motsvarande verifiering av systemstöd.
  • Du har erfarenhet av att ta fram projektplaner och beslutsunderlag utifrån verksamhetsbehov och relevanta underlag.
  • Du har mycket god kommunikativ förmåga på svenska i tal och skrift.
  • Du har förmåga att snabbt sätta dig in i befintliga underlag och ta över ett påbörjat arbete.
Meriterande
  • Du har erfarenhet av projekt i offentlig verksamhet, kommunkoncern eller annan organisation med flera verksamheter.
  • Du har förståelse för informationssäkerhet och regulatoriska krav i samband med system- och informationshantering.
  • Du har erfarenhet av projekt där informationsmodeller, integrationer, masterdata eller behörigheter har varit relevanta beroenden.
  • Du har erfarenhet av förändringsledning.
  • Du har erfarenhet av XLPM eller annan etablerad projektmetodik.
Vi erbjuder
  • Fast anställning hos Avaron AB
  • Tjänstepension
  • Friskvårdsbidrag på 5 000 kr per år
Ansökan

Vi tillsätter löpande – sök gärna så snart du kan.

title: Electrical Engineering - 12 Month Placement Scheme
description:
Career Area:

Students and Graduates

Job Description:

Your Work Shapes the World at Caterpillar Inc.

When you join Caterpillar, you're joining a global team who cares not just about the work we do – but also about each other. We are the makers, problem solvers, and future world builders who are creating stronger, more sustainable communities. We don't just talk about progress and innovation here – we make it happen, with our customers, where we work and live. Together, we are building a better world, so we can all enjoy living in it.

12-Month Industrial Placement Scheme

Discipline: Electrical Engineering – Caterpillar Marine

Location: Wimborne

Salary: £26,000 Share Scheme, Pension and 25 days annual leave (plus bank holidays).

We currently have some exciting opportunities for industrial placement students to join Caterpillar across several of our sites. You will have the opportunity to work with others across our organisation and you will be directly involved, and at the heart of our business, participating on strategic projects.

*Please note that to be eligible to complete a 12-Month Industrial Placement commencing July 2027, you must be in your penultimate year of study unless enrolled in an integrated master’s program.

What do we do?

Caterpillar Inc. is the world’s leading manufacturer of construction and mining equipment, diesel and natural gas engines, industrial gas turbines, and diesel-electric locomotives. Since 1925, we’ve been driving sustainable progress and helping customers build a better world through innovative products and services. Throughout the product life cycle, we offer services built on cutting-edge technology and decades of product expertise. These products and services, backed by our global dealer network, provide exceptional value to help our customers succeed.

We have a clear vision to be the global leader in providing customer value in the markets in which we operate. Our core values (Integrity, Excellence, Teamwork, Commitment and Sustainability) are key to our success.

Caterpillar, Wimborne

The facility boasts a wealth of hugely experienced designers, engineers and technicians used to providing solutions for commercial, professional and military customers in the marine product range. From design, testing and production, each engine is proven before leaving the premises to ensure the best performance for the end-user. The production products range up to 500 bhp for marine propulsion engines and 200 ekW for our gensets. In addition to the factory the Wimborne location is home for roles across sales, marketing, product support and engineering for the entire range of Caterpillar marine products.

Diversity at Caterpillar

When we leverage our people's experiences, backgrounds, and cultures in an inclusive environment, we enable every individual to achieve their full potential, which drives business success. We are proud to be active partners with both the Society of Women Engineers (SWE) & Women's Engineering Society (WES). We also have numerous well supported employee resource groups. Caterpillar is an equal opportunity employer, and we welcome applicants from diverse backgrounds.

What experiences can we offer you?

As an equal opportunity employer, we value diversity at Caterpillar and believe the more experience you can gain early in your career the further you can go. That’s why during our yearlong scheme we place an emphasis on multiple diverse projects. You will have the opportunity to work and collaborate with people in Caterpillar facilities worldwide and we are looking for you to bring fresh, innovative ideas to solve complex technical problems. You will be a fully involved team member with responsibility and accountability for key project deliverables. That said, you will be given all the support you require to be successful.

Our placement roles have the additional benefit of a workplace mentor; this could be your manager or a technical expert who will support you throughout your time at Caterpillar and help you gain the professional development and skills you need to be set up for success! Our placement students can expect to return to university with further developed technical skills and experience of how University learning is applied to the workplace.

We also operate a conditional offer process; our highest performing placement students are fast tracked to our graduate development scheme. This includes a financial incentive and the potential of a summer work placement. Offers will be made based on the condition that a graduate role is available at the time of your graduation and that you achieve a min of 2:1.

The role

With the team growing we are looking for an electrical engineering placement student at Caterpillar Marine, located in Wimborne, Dorset within the Caterpillar Oil, Gas & Marine division. The team has responsibility for all areas of marine engine & genset design for products from 10kW to over 750kW. This role will focus on electrical system and control systems development for this wide range of marine products.

Electrical engineering design placements offer placement students real life product design experience in a customer focused environment.

Job duties and responsibilities may include, but are not limited to:

  • Design of marine generator control systems and associated equipment.

  • Wiring schematics & harness design.

  • Technical calculations.

  • Component / sub-systems supplier review.

  • Liaison with shop floor personnel on the assembly / manufacture of product.

  • Carry out all work in accordance with company policies and procedures.

Who are we looking for?

We’re looking for people who can show us a highly participative working style, and who thrive in a team of committed professionals. At the same time, we need people who are self-motivated and can drive change through persuasion and influence. Communication and presentational skills are essential.

As the type of roles within our business are becoming more diverse, we are looking for people who are open minded, excellent problem solvers and who have an ability to learn quickly. You will be motivated, hard-working, and will embrace change. In return for your dedication and hard work, you will be provided with excellent career opportunities and strong support for your personal and career development to pursue a career within Caterpillar.

Applicants will be on target to achieve a minimum of 2:1 honours degree level in a relevant discipline:

  • Electrical & Electronics Engineering

Recruitment Process Guide

We're excited that you're considering a career with Caterpillar. Below is an overview of our Early Careers recruitment process and what you can expect at each stage.

Step 1: Online Application

To apply, simply complete our online application form and upload your CV before the advertised closing date.

Our team will review all submissions & we'll keep you updated and let you know as soon as possible if you've been selected to progress to the next stage.

Step 2: Online Assessments & Video Interview

If you are selected to move forward in the process, you'll be invited to complete some online assessments, followed by a user-friendly video interview. Your responses will be reviewed by the hiring team, and successful candidates will then be invited to attend an in-person Assessment Centre / Interview, which we anticipate will take place on Tuesday 8 December 2026 at our Wimborne facility. If possible, we recommend keeping this date available.

To ensure you don't miss any communications from us, please regularly check your text, email inbox (including your spam/junk folder) and your Workday account for updates.

Step 3: In Person Assessment Centre

Our Assessment Centre is designed to help you showcase your potential through a range of interactive activities focused on competencies such as teamwork, communication, problem-solving, and decision-making.

We aim to make the experience engaging, inclusive, and relaxed, giving you the best opportunity to demonstrate your strengths and learn more about Caterpillar.

Step 4: Offer

Following the Assessment Centre, the Caterpillar team will review all feedback and make hiring decisions. We aim to communicate outcomes and extend offers to successful candidates as quickly as possible.

Placement students will begin their placement on 5th July 2027.

We look forward to receiving your application and wish you the very best throughout the recruitment process. Come join us!

How do I apply?

Go to catukgraduates.com for more information.

NOTES:

  • The panel cannot make assumptions when shortlisting therefore please demonstrate your qualifications and experience on your CV relevant to the criteria outlined.

  • Pending the number of applications, the criteria for the position may be enhanced to facilitate shortlisting. This may also include an adjustment to the application deadline date.

Posting Dates:

September 18, 2026 - October 17, 2026

Caterpillar is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Qualified applicants of any age are encouraged to apply

Not ready to apply? Join our Talent Community.

title: Tekniske Sikkerhedsrådgivere
description:
Har du lyst og evner til at være del af et vigtigt rådgivningsteam, der er med til at beskytte Danmarks digitale fremtid? Så kan du nu blive en del af Team Forebyggende Sikkerhed i Statens It, der sikrer og videreudvikler arbejdet med cyber- og informationsikkerhed i staten.

Om stillingen Teamet er en del af Center for Sikkerhed og Compliance og vi har brug for dig, som har erfaring med at omsætte compliance til teknik. Du skal befinde dig godt i rollen som formidler og du er tryg ved at skulle rådgive om centrale aspekter af cyber- og informationsikkerhed. Du vil komme til at samarbejde både internt i Statens It samt med vores kunder og samarbejdspartnere.

Dine primære opgaver vil være at:

  • Rådgive om cyber- og informationssikkerhed på både strategisk og operationelt niveau
  • Følge udviklingen indenfor trusselsbilledet og kunne formidle dette til både direktionen samt til vores kunder og samarbejdspartnere
  • Indgå i større netværk og arbejdsgrupper med fokus på cyber- og informationssikkerhed.
Om dig Du har en teknisk profil og kendskab til cyber- og informationssikkerhedsrammeværk som ISO 27001 og NIST. Du kender statens tekniske minimumskrav og har indsigt i, hvordan de omsættes til tekniske løsninger og implementeres i praksis. Du trives med faglige udfordringer i krydsfeltet mellem myndighedskrav, teknisk sikkerhed og it-drift og arbejder risikobaseret med blik for forskellige interessenters behov. Samtidig interesserer du dig for de tekniske aspekter af god sikkerhed og kan rådgive om dem. Vi forventer ikke, at du kan udføre pentest eller har erfaring med audits, men at du har en solid begrebsforståelse, kan arbejde med eksempelvis sårbarhedsrapporter og formår at omsætte rammeværk og krav til konkrete handlinger.

Vi forventer, at du:

  • har gode mundtlige og skriftlige evner, som du dagligt bringer i spil, hvad enten du skal formidle til Subject Matter Experts, kolleger, it-revisorer eller ledelsen
  • er systematisk og struktureret i din opgaveløsning og forstår at arbejde med milepæle og deadlines
  • prioriterer et godt samarbejde med kolleger og ledere.
Om os Centeret består lige nu af fire teams, som samarbejder om at møde forventningerne fra omgivelserne til bl.a. rådgivning, compliance samt håndtering af cybertrusler i staten.

Team Forebyggende Sikkerhed arbejder med at varsle, om kendte sårbarheder, gennemføre sikkerhedsscanninger og rådgive om softwaresikkerhed. Derudover rådgiver vi om cybersikkerhed. Det er os, der er frontpersoner i arbejdet med at sikre, at vi i Statens It foretager de rigtige prioriteringer af vores sikkerhedsindsatser, og at vi er i stand til at dokumentere og efterleve det. Arbejdet med cyber- og informationssikkerhed er et strategisk fokusområde, som har ledelsens konstante bevågenhed og opbakning.

Intelligente løsninger og aktuelle teknologier er derfor en prioritet for Statens It, og her er sikkerhedsområdet ingen undtagelse.

Statens It har ca. 750 ansatte, som dagligt arbejder med at levere sikker og stabil it-drift til ca. 60.000 brugere på 21 ministerområder. Statens It er i vækst og har løbende fokus på at udvikle fundamentet for den videre digitalisering af staten. Vi har ansvaret for at drive en effektiv it-understøttelse og sikre en høj og ensartet it-service på tværs af staten. Vi lægger vægt på at tilbyde en attraktiv it-arbejdsplads med rigtig gode muligheder for faglig udvikling og specialisering. Vi tilbyder et job i en åben og dynamisk organisation, præget af et meget højt fagligt niveau og med en uformel og fleksibel arbejdsform med kompetente kolleger. Du får mulighed for at være med til at præge udviklingen på it-området på tværs af statens mange institutioner.

Hos os betyder tilstedeværelse sammen med vores kollegaer meget, og vi mener, at samarbejde og videndeling på tværs af styrelsen er afgørende for et godt arbejdsmiljø. Samtidig vil vi gerne sikre fleksibilitet for vores medarbejdere, og hjemmearbejde kan løbende aftales mellem chef og medarbejder, når det er foreneligt med opgavevaretagelsen.

Ansættelsesvilkår Du ansættes efter gældende overenskomst med mulighed for forhandling alt efter kvalifikationer.

Det er en forudsætning for ansættelse, at du kan sikkerhedsgodkendes til HEMMELIGT og efterfølgende kan opretholde sikkerhedsgodkendelsen i hele din ansættelsesperiode. Du vil i forbindelse med ansættelsen blive bedt om at fremsende en privat straffeattest, som du rekvirerer via www.politi.dk eller ved fysisk fremmøde på din lokale politistation. Vi fortæller mere om dette undervejs i ansættelsesforløbet.

Ansættelsesområdet er Finansministeriet med tilhørende institutioner, p.t. Finansministeriets departement, Medarbejder- og Kompetencestyrelsen, Statens Administration, Statens It og Økonomistyrelsen.

title: Truckmedarbejder til aftenhold søges i Ansager
description:
Truckmedarbejder til aftenhold i Ansager – mulighed for fastansættelse

Vi søger en stabil og arbejdsom truckmedarbejder til et længerevarende fuldtidsvikariat hos en fødevareproduktionsvirksomhed i Ansager.

Stillingen er med henblik på fastansættelse, og virksomheden ønsker gennem vikariatet at lære den rette medarbejder godt at kende. For den rette kandidat er der derfor gode muligheder for at blive en fast del af arbejdspladsen.

Du bliver en del af den daglige drift i både produktionen og på lageret. En stor del af arbejdet består af at sørge for, at paller bliver håndteret og kørt fra produktionsområdet til lageret, men du skal også være indstillet på at hjælpe til med andre opgaver, når der er behov for det.

Dine primære arbejdsopgaver vil blandt andet være:

  • Palletering og truckkørsel fra produktionsbånd til lager

  • Truckkørsel og øvrige lageropgaver

  • Hjælp i produktionen samt betjening og pasning af maskiner

  • Andre praktiske og forefaldende opgaver i produktionen og på lageret

Arbejdet består i høj grad af faste og rutineprægede opgaver. Det er derfor vigtigt, at du trives med en struktureret arbejdsdag, hvor mange af opgaverne gentager sig. Du skal kunne bevare fokus gennem hele vagten, arbejde selvstændigt og være god til selv at holde dig i gang.

Vi lægger stor vægt på, at du er stabil og ansvarsbevidst. Du møder til tiden, tager dine arbejdsopgaver seriøst og er ikke bange for at tage fat. Samtidig skal du være fleksibel og klar til at hjælpe til både på lageret og i produktionen.

Vi forventer, at du:

  • Har gyldigt truckcertifikat

  • Kan tale og forstå dansk

  • Er stabil, arbejdsom og møder til tiden

  • Kan arbejde selvstændigt og tage ansvar

  • Trives med faste og rutineprægede arbejdsopgaver

Har du erfaring fra lager, produktion eller fødevareindustrien, er det en fordel, men det er ikke et krav. Det vigtigste er, at du har den rette indstilling og lyst til at arbejde.

Arbejdstid: Mandag til torsdag kl. 13.30–22.45.

Arbejdssted: Ansager.

Opstart: Efter aftale.

Der er tale om et længerevarende fuldtidsvikariat med mulighed for efterfølgende fastansættelse.

Lyder stillingen som noget for dig, hører vi meget gerne fra dig.

Send dit CV til sb@teamly.dk og skriv “ANSAGER AFTEN” i emnefeltet.

Vi behandler ansøgningerne løbende, så send gerne dit CV hurtigst muligt.

title: Senior Busines Program Manager
description:
About Blueprint

Blueprint is a technology solutions firm headquartered in Bellevue, Washington, with teams across the United States. We help organizations turn complex challenges into meaningful outcomes by connecting strategy and execution across AI, cloud, data, product development, and emerging technology.

Our culture is built by people who care deeply about doing exceptional work. We set high standards, take ownership, and continually challenge ourselves and one another to be better. We work hard, support each other, and take genuine pride in what we deliver for our clients, partners, and teams.

At Blueprint, you’ll work alongside talented people with different experiences, expertise, and perspectives. You’ll have opportunities to take on meaningful challenges, expand your skills, and see the impact of what you build.

Bring your perspective. Raise the standard. Build what matters.

In This Role

You will support business operations and strategic planning across a technology-focused organization, with responsibility for budget management, forecasting, executive communications, Rhythm of Business activities, and cross-functional stakeholder coordination. You will help maintain operational visibility through reporting, budget variance tracking, planning, and business metrics while partnering with senior leaders and teams across multiple technology and corporate functions. The role also includes preparing executive and internal communications, supporting town halls and organizational communications, and helping ensure business priorities, processes, and deliverables stay aligned.

Responsibilities

  • Manage and coordinate budgets, forecasting, expenditures, and budget variance reporting across multiple business areas.
  • Support the organization's Rhythm of Business (ROB), including planning, reporting, recurring business reviews, and operational tracking.
  • Partner with senior leaders and stakeholders to coordinate priorities, deliverables, timelines, and business activities.
  • Prepare executive communications, internal communications, presentations, reports, and business updates.
  • Support preparation and coordination of town halls and organizational events.
  • Develop and maintain business processes, project structures, documentation, and operational workflows.
  • Track project and organizational budgets, expenditures, transaction controls, and costs against approved budgets.
  • Identify potential budget overruns or financial risks and communicate potential solutions.
  • Maintain business metrics, project communications, and supporting documentation.
  • Review contracts, cost proposals, and contract-related materials as needed.
  • Establish and maintain communication processes across business units and project teams.
  • Analyze business trends and financial information to support planning and forecasting.
  • Build and maintain strong relationships with cross-functional stakeholders.
  • Support broader business-management and program-management activities above an administrative level.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Business Management, Economics, Finance, Accounting, or a related field.
  • 10+ years of relevant professional experience.
  • 5+ years managing budgets of multiple millions of dollars.
  • 5+ years of executive or corporate communications experience, including the ability to develop clear business storytelling and communications.
  • 5+ years of stakeholder management experience.
  • Strong experience with business management, operations, project management, financial planning, or a related discipline.
  • Experience with business applications such as Microsoft Word and Excel; enterprise application experience is a plus.
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills, attention to detail, interpersonal skills, and ability to work independently.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Prior experience working in a large technology organization in a comparable business management or operations role.
  • Experience in a Business Manager, Chief of Staff, or similar strategic operations role.
  • Experience managing Rhythm of Business (ROB) activities at the VP or executive level.
  • Direct experience supporting a senior executive or corporate vice president-level leader.
  • Strong experience managing multi-million-dollar budgets, forecasting, and variance reporting.
  • Experience creating executive-level storytelling, communications, presentations, and business updates.
  • Demonstrated ability to influence and coordinate stakeholders across multiple business functions.
  • Experience working at the intersection of technology and AI, particularly in areas such as privacy, accessibility, digital safety, human rights, or related responsible-technology domains.
  • Previous experience in a similar role within the client's organization is strongly preferred.

Salary Range

At Blueprint, we strive to offer competitive pay that reflects the value of our team members. Compensation for this role is influenced by a variety of factors, including skills, education, responsibilities, experience, and geographic market. For candidates based in Washington State, the anticipated salary range is $115,000– $120,000 per annum. Please note that we typically do not hire new employees at the top of the posted range. Actual starting pay will be determined based on experience, skills, and internal equity. The final salary and job title may vary depending on the selected candidate’s qualifications and could fall outside the stated range.

title: Sygeplejerske til Ortopædkirurgisk afsnit
description:
Hvidovre Hospital søger en engageret sygeplejerske til Ortopædkirurgiske afsnit - 210. Har du en passion for patientpleje og samarbejde på tværs af faggrupper? Ønsker du at arbejde i et dynamisk arbejdsmiljø, hvor din indsats gør en reel forskel? Så er dette den rette mulighed for dig!

Om jobbet:

Som sygeplejerske på Ortopædkirurgisk afdeling vil du få en central rolle i plejen og behandlingen af vores patienter. Dine primære arbejdsopgaver vil blandt andet omfatte:

  • Grundlæggende sygepleje til den komplekse ort.kit patient med baggrund i det holistiske menneskesyn.
  • Høj prioritering af bl.a. mobilisering, ernæring og sårpleje. Aktuelt implementeres kompetencekort med særlig fokus på sår og ernæring.
  • Ansvar for egne patientforløb herunder medicinadministration, stuegang og sårpleje.
Du vil skabe trygge rammer for patienter og pårørende, hvor de oplever at være vigtige medaktører i samarbejdet og behandlingen. Du forventes at deltage i skiftende vagter og arbejde hver 3. weekend.

Din profil:

Vi ser gerne, at du har en positiv tilgang til et højt arbejdstempo og en lyst til at deltage aktivt i faglig udvikling. Vi forventer, at du:

  • Har interesse for sår og sårpleje samt ortopædkirurgi.
  • Vil bidrage til et sundt og godt arbejdsmiljø og er den kollega, vi ikke kan undvære.
  • Trives i patientforløb, hvor fokus er på det gode samarbejde med patienter og pårørende.
Tre gode grunde til at vælge os:

  1. Individuel oplæring og kompetenceudvikling: Vi tilbyder grundig introduktion til det ortopædkirurgiske speciale, fordi vi ved, at erfaring kommer med tiden. Tilbud om kompetenceudvikling ved deltagelse i diverse kurser.
  2. Engagement og medindflydelse: Vores arbejdsmiljø er præget af engagement, medindflydelse og medansvar. Vi prioriterer faglig kvalitet og udvikling højt.
  3. Stærkt kollegialt sammenhold: Du bliver en del af et team med et meget stærkt socialt fællesskab.
Yderligere information og ansøgning:

title: Giftefoged
description:
Vi søger timelønnede giftefogeder til Christiansfeld ca. 40 timer pr. måned.

Vores mangeårige giftefoged har valgt at trække sig tilbage. Vi søger derfor 2 engagerede og stabile giftefogeder til at forestå vielser i Christiansfeld.

Som giftefoged bliver du bemyndiget af borgmesteren til at foretage borgerlige vielser. Du bliver en af i alt to Giftefogeder i Christiansfeld, som skal supplere hinanden. I 2025 blev der gennemført over 700 vielser i Søstrehuset. Vielserne forgår på alle hverdage og på lørdage. Vielser i Kolding Kommune administreres af Vielsesteamet, som er en del af Borgerservice, som ligger på Nytorv i Kolding. Vielsesteamet sørger for at alt det administrative arbejde.

Dine opgaver som giftefoged:

  • Bidrage til at gøre vielsen til en uforglemmelig og festlig oplevelse for brudeparret.

  • Samarbejde med Vielsesteamet omkring planlægningen af de enkelte vielser.

  • Hente og bringe vielsespapirer til og fra Nytorv i Kolding.

  • Forestå vielsesceremonien på dansk, tysk eller engelsk.

Krav og Kvalifikationer:

Du skal kunne stå til rådighed for vielser 2-3 hverdage i ugen typisk i tidsrummet kl. 10.30-13.30 og ca. hver anden lørdag. Du vil kende dine vielser 2-3 måneder frem i tiden, og vil skulle have en Outlook kalender, hvor du registrerer de tider, hvor du kan bookes også 2-3 måneder frem i tiden.

  • Du skal være præsentabel, venlig, imødekommende og på samme tid udvise myndighed.

  • Du skal kunne tale og læse dansk, engelsk og tysk på et rimeligt niveau, så du kan oplæse vielsesritualet på de tre sprog.

  • Du skal kunne anvende Outlook mail og kalender.

  • Du skal kunne transportere dig selv mellem Kolding og Christiansfeld.

Løn: Du vil blive ansat på en individuel kontrakt. Der aflønnes med det, der svarer til en timeløn for en HK medarbejder i løntrin 22 ved hverdags vielser og løntrin 38 +50 % for lørdagsvielser. Der aflønnes efter antallet af vielser. Der gives kørselsgodtgørelse efter statens takster for kørsel i tjenesten.

title: Informationssikkerhedskonsulent til Frederikssund Kommune
company: Politisk Betjening & Jura i Teknik, Erhverv og IT
description:
Har du lyst til at arbejde med cyber- og informationssikkerhed i en samfundskritisk organisation – og samtidig være med til at understøtte hele Frederikssund Kommunes arbejde med at beskytte borgernes data?

Vi søger en ny kollega, som vil få en central rolle i kommunens efterlevelse af GDPR, den løbende styrkelse af vores cyber- og informationssikkerhedsindsats samt bidrage til implementeringen af NIS2 direktivet.
Stillingen er på fuld tid og ønskes besat pr. 1. januar 2027.

Om jobbet
Frederikssund Kommune har i takt med det generelt stigende fokus på området de sidste par år øget indsatsen på cyber- og informationssikkerhedsområdet. Dette arbejde skal vi fortsat fastholde og forbedre. Derfor søger vi en kollega til holdet.

Som en del af informationssikkerhedsteamet skal du løse opgaver inden for GDPR, men også arbejde med andre områder inden for cyber- og informationssikkerhed. Nogle opgaver løser du selvstændigt, mens andre kræver tæt samarbejde med kolleger på tværs af hele organisationen. Dine opgaver vil blandt andet omfatte:
  • Sikring af efterlevelse af GDPR og understøttelse af databeskyttelsesarbejdet
  • Gennemførelse og opfølgning på risikovurderinger
  • Håndtering, analyse og indberetning af sikkerhedsbrud samt medvirken til forebyggelse
  • Rådgivning og støtte til kolleger i håndteringen af informationssikkerhed
  • Bidrage til udarbejdelsen af skriftlige produkter, herunder politikker og procedurer samt udvikle og gennemføre awareness-aktiviteter inden for cyber- og informationssikkerhed på tværs af organisationen
  • Bidrage til implementering og forankring af NIS2-direktivets krav i organisationen

Om dig
Du har gerne erfaring med eller certificeringer i informationssikkerhed, fx gennem en lignende stilling, konsulentarbejde eller en relevant uddannelse. Erfaring med arbejde i en kommune eller den offentlige sektor er også en fordel.
Du har en akademisk eller administrativ baggrund. Måske kommer du fra en lignende stilling i en anden organisation, men det kan også være, at du er en struktureret generalist eller jurist med interesse for området. Det vigtigste er, at du kan skabe overblik, forstå og formidle komplekse emner og problemstillinger på en enkel måde og har mod på at samarbejde bredt i organisationen. Du har gerne erfaring med kompetenceudvikling af en stor og divers gruppe medarbejdere og kan kommunikere klart, forståeligt og i øjenhøjde – uanset om modtageren er en leder eller en fagspecialist
Du er god til at samarbejde og trives med at arbejde på tværs af organisationen. Du har en systematisk og analytisk tilgang med øje for både detaljer og helhed. Hvis din øvrige profil passer til holdet, tilbyder vi opkvalificering, hvor du eventuelt mangler erfaring.

Om afdelingen
Du bliver en del af afdelingen Politisk Betjening og Jura, forankret i Center for Ejendomme og IT. Afdelingen beskæftiger sig med politisk betjening, jura, køb og salg af kommunens ejendomme, grundejeropgaver og cyber- og informationssikkerhed. Vi er en afdeling med stort engagement, hvor sparring, faglig udvikling og samarbejde er en vigtig del af hverdagen. Du vil derudover helt naturligt have et meget tæt samarbejde med afdelingen IT og Stadsarkiv.

Vi tilbyder
  • En arbejdsplads med trivsel, fællesskab og højt fagligt niveau
  • Vi hjælper hinanden med både humor, faglighed og ansvarlighed
  • Ledere og medarbejdere er nærværende og tør tage ansvar
  • Teamet har fokus på både borgeres og medarbejderes behov
  • En varieret arbejdsdag med fleksibel struktur og meget varierende arbejdsopgaver
  • En spændende mulighed for at arbejde med sikkerhed i den samfundskritiske infrastruktur
  • Fleksibel arbejdstid, mulighed for hjemmearbejde og frihed under ansvar


Løn og ansættelsesvilkår

title: Direct Loan Originator
description:
Triad Financial Services is a leading provider of financial services and solutions, serving clients nationwide. We are seeking a highly motivated and skilled Direct Loan Originator to join our growing team.

Essential Functions:

  • Consult and sell Triad approved applications to borrowers and retailers
  • Develop relationships with approved Triad borrowers and retailers during the home buying process
  • Is the main point of contact: advising borrowers and sellers of the used home buying process, determining solutions, ordering appraisals and gathering/clearing conditions
  • Pipeline Management - will facilitate movement of active loan files to closing in a timely manner
  • Understand Triad’s loan products, rates, guidelines, and loan process
  • Stay up-to-date on changes in market conditions that affect the company’s many loan products
  • Coordinate with other departments to optimize the sales effort
  • Meeting or exceeding Triad "pull-through" goals (percentage of contracts ordered (COF’s) to loans approved)
  • Perform related duties as assigned by supervisor

Minimum Qualifications:

  • One to three years of retail mortgage loan knowledge/experience required
  • Excellent problem-solving skills are essential
  • Ability to work well within a team atmosphere
  • Strong attention to detail
  • Strong customer service skills
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills, including the ability to effectively interact with all retailers, borrowers and internal departments
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office suite of products and ability to quickly gain proficiency in the company’s proprietary mortgage software products
  • Ability to multitask in a fast-paced environment
  • Ability to set goals and divide processes into timelines
  • Applying investor guidelines to specific sales situations and using discretion and judgment to recommend the most appropriate products to customers based on qualifications and needs identified by customer analysis
  • 20-hour Safe Act course*
  • Individual state loan originator license(s) required for specific states in which employee engages in any mortgage loan originator activities*
  • Completing and passing all Continuing Education requirement (annually)*

title: Principal Fire Engineer
description:
Company Overview

Throughout our worldwide network of experts, clients and communities, we are renowned for our leadership in fire protection engineering – a legacy of responsibility we have proudly upheld since 1939. Today, our expertise extends broadly across closely related security and risk-based fields – from accessibility consulting and risk analysis to process safety, forensic investigations, security risk consulting, emergency management, digital innovation and more.

Our engineers and consultants collaborate to solve complex safety and security challenges, ensuring our clients can protect what matters most. For over 80 years, we have helped mitigate risks that threaten lives, property and reputations. Through technology, expertise and industry-leading research, we remain dedicated to our purpose of making our world safe, secure and resilient.

At Jensen Hughes, we believe that creating and sustaining a culture of trust, integrity and professional growth starts with putting our people first. Our employees are our greatest strength, and we value the unique perspectives and talents they bring to our organization.

Our wide range of Global Employee Networks connect people from across the organization, supporting career development and providing forums for individuals to share experiences on topics they’re passionate about. Together, we are cultivating a connected culture where everyone has the opportunity to learn, grow and succeed together.

Job Overview

Jensen Hughes are seeking an experienced and commercially minded Principal Fire Engineer to join our growing team in London. This is a technical leadership role offering the opportunity to deliver complex fire engineering projects across a diverse portfolio of sectors including commercial, residential, healthcare, education, industrial, and infrastructure developments.

As a Principal Fire Engineer, you will play a key role in shaping fire safety strategies, ensuring regulatory compliance, and supporting business growth through strong client relationships and technical innovation. You will not only lead on some of the industry’s most exciting projects but also have a key role in shaping the future talent within our teams through mentorship and development opportunities.

Why join us to grow your career?

  • We are the largest fire consultancy in Europe with offices located in Belgium, Finland, Denmark, Italy, and the UK & Ireland. Our reputation for providing innovative, design-focused solutions has made us the consultant of choice for many of Europe’s leading property clients.
  • As a Principal Engineer you will be an integral part of a dynamic technical team, working with other experienced Engineers, Surveyors and teams including our Forensics division. You will work on the industry's leading technical projects.
  • Working with us offers an exciting range of opportunities to develop your career within a supportive and diverse team that always strives to do the right thing for our people, clients and communities.
  • You will be given early the opportunity to progress rapidly. Jensen Hughes encourages all Engineers to achieve chartered status and offer help and support during the process

Responsibilities

  • Lead and deliver complex fire engineering projects from inception through to completion.
  • Develop fire strategies for a wide range of new-build and existing building projects.
  • Undertake fire safety engineering analyses, including evacuation modelling, smoke control assessments, and performance-based design solutions.
  • Provide expert advice on compliance with UK Building Regulations, Approved Document B, and relevant fire safety legislation.
  • Review and approve technical reports, calculations, and design documentation.
  • Liaise with architects, developers, contractors, approval authorities, and wider project teams.
  • Act as a technical lead and mentor for junior and mid-level engineers.
  • Contribute to business development activities, including client engagement, tender submissions, and project proposals.
  • Maintain awareness of evolving legislation, industry standards, and best practices.
  • Represent the business at client meetings, industry events, and technical forums.

Requirements and Qualifications

  • Degree qualified in Fire Engineering, Mechanical Engineering or related engineering discipline.
  • Ideally be or working towards becoming a Chartered Engineer.

  • Generous pension contribution.
  • Life assurance and income protection.
  • Professional membership subscriptions.
  • Ongoing training and support towards professional development.

Om os

SFO 3 Høje er en integreret del af Langhøjskolen, hvor vi arbejder tæt sammen med lærerne i indskolingen. Vi er organiseret i årgangsteams, og du vil som udgangspunkt følge en årgang i både skole- og fritidsdel.

Vi prioriterer samarbejde, faglig udvikling og refleksion højt. Derfor har vi ugentlige teammøder med lærere, ugentlige pædagogmøder, egen forberedelsestid samt månedlige fællesmøder.

Vi er en SFO i udvikling og arbejder kontinuerligt med at skabe inspirerende lærings- og fritidsmiljøer. Samtidig arbejder vi på at udvikle vores udearealer til spændende og varierede lege- og aktivitetszoner.

Vi søger en pædagog, som

  • Har et ressourceorienteret børnesyn og arbejder ud fra en deltagelsesorienteret tilgang.
  • Kan skabe deltagelsesmuligheder for alle børn og understøtte børnefællesskaber.
  • Er kreativ og brænder for at sætte aktiviteter i gang.

  • Har lyst til at bidrage til både eksisterende traditioner og nye idéer.

  • Kan se dig selv som pædagog i både skole og SFO med samme engagement og faglige nysgerrighed.
  • Trives i samarbejdet med lærere og andre faggrupper.
  • Kan arbejde professionelt i et årgangsteam.

Praktiske oplysninger

Hvis du er en fagligt stærk og kreativ pædagog med lyst til at udvikle børnenes fritidsliv og være en del af et engageret fællesskab, glæder vi os til at høre fra dig.

Hvis du vil vide mere, så kom og besøg os, det vil vi sætte pris på.

title: Senior BI Developer
description:
We are looking for a Senior BI Developer to design, develop and deliver high-quality business intelligence solutions that help colleagues and customers make better decisions. This is a senior role requiring strong Power BI expertise, advanced SQL capability and the confidence to take ownership of complex data and reporting work from requirements through to delivery.

You will work closely with stakeholders across the business to understand reporting needs, translate complex requirements into effective BI solutions and present information in a clear, intuitive and decision-focused way. The role suits someone who combines technical depth with strong judgement, delivery focus and the ability to solve problems independently.
  • Design, build and maintain high-quality Power BI reports, dashboards and semantic models that support operational, commercial and strategic decision-making.
  • Develop robust data models, relationships and DAX measures, ensuring reporting solutions are performant, reliable, secure and scalable.
  • Use SQL to query, investigate, troubleshoot and optimise complex or imperfectly documented data environments.
  • Work with stakeholders to understand business questions, clarify requirements, challenge assumptions where appropriate and translate needs into practical BI solutions.
  • Apply strong data visualisation and storytelling principles so reports clearly highlight trends, exceptions, context and recommended areas of focus.
  • Plan and deliver BI projects or significant work packages independently, managing priorities, dependencies, testing, risks and communication throughout.
  • Take ownership of complex problems from investigation through to resolution, identifying practical options and escalating appropriately when needed.
  • Contribute to development standards, documentation, peer review, knowledge sharing and mentoring across the BI team
You will be an experienced BI professional with a strong track record of delivering Power BI solutions in a complex data environment. You will be comfortable working independently, making sound technical decisions and communicating clearly with both technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Advanced Power BI development experience, including report design, data modelling, DAX, relationships, optimisation and maintaining production reporting solutions.
  • Strong SQL skills, including the ability to write, troubleshoot and optimise complex queries.
  • Experience investigating data quality, data structure and business logic issues in unfamiliar or complex environments.
  • Ability to turn complex data into clear, accessible and decision-focused insight for different audiences.
  • Proven experience planning and delivering BI, analytics or data projects to agreed timescales.
  • Strong stakeholder engagement skills, with the ability to interpret, clarify and challenge requirements.
  • Good judgement, accountability and problem-solving capability, with the confidence to progress work independently.
  • Commitment to high standards in testing, documentation, knowledge sharing and continuous improvement.

Working Style

This role requires someone who can balance technical delivery with collaboration. You will be expected to communicate progress clearly, identify risks early, support colleagues where appropriate and help shape consistent approaches to BI development across the team.

Desired behavioral skills:

The Senior BI Developer should demonstrate the following behavioural skills:
  • Ownership and accountability: Takes responsibility for work from initial investigation through to delivery and handover, without requiring repeated follow-up.
  • Clear and early communication: Provides progress updates and raises risks, blockers and potential delays before delivery is affected.
  • Proactive problem-solving: Investigates issues independently and identifies possible solutions rather than only reporting problems.
  • Appropriate escalation: Recognises when further investigation is unlikely to be productive and seeks support at the right time.
  • Curiosity and analytical thinking: Independently seeks to understand the underlying data, business process and existing logic.
  • Reliability and responsiveness: Will take ownership of agreed priorities, attend scheduled discussions and proactively arrange discussions where required.
  • Collaboration: Works positively with colleagues, participates in team discussions and contributes to shared objectives.
  • Knowledge sharing: Documents findings, explains technical decisions and avoids creating processes that only one person understands.
  • Quality and attention to detail: Tests and validates work thoroughly, performance, usability and maintainability. Understands issues should be addressed before code review, allowing the review process to focus on assurance and improvement.
  • Stakeholder focus: Understands the business outcome behind a request and constructively clarifies or challenges unclear requirements.
  • Adaptability and resilience: Remains constructive when requirements change or unexpected data issues arise.
  • Continual improvement mindset: Acknowledges gaps in knowledge, responds positively to feedback and demonstrates a willingness to learn.

title: PS Climate Data, LCA and Decarbonization Lead
location: Sant Cugat del Valles, Barcelona, Spain
description:
PS Climate Data, LCA and Decarbonization Lead

Description -

Role Purpose

The PS GBU Climate Data and LCA Lead serves as the primary interface between the Climate Team and the Personal Systems (PS) business, ensuring that climate data, life cycle assessments (LCAs), and sustainability insights are translated into meaningful business, product, supply chain, and customer-facing outcomes.

A robust LCA program is the foundation of effective product decarbonization and design for sustainability. However, generating accurate carbon data alone is not sufficient. To drive meaningful environmental improvements and business value, climate insights must be embedded into product development, engineering, sourcing, supplier engagement, marketing claim development, and business planning processes. This role is responsible for ensuring that PS climate data and LCA capabilities are not only technically credible and assurance-ready but also integrated into the way the business makes decisions and communicates sustainability progress. This includes enabling credible, data-driven, and compliance-ready sustainability claims related to product design innovations, lower-carbon materials, packaging innovations, supplier interventions, manufacturing improvements, circularity initiatives, and other sustainability achievements.

The role combines technical expertise in life cycle assessment, carbon accounting, and climate data management with strategic business partnership, decarbonization leadership, stakeholder engagement, and sustainability program influence. The position acts as the steward of how the Personal Systems business measures, manages, communicates, and reduces carbon impacts across the product lifecycle.

The role owns the strategy, governance, and evolution of PS climate models, methodologies, and Life Cycle Inventory (LCI) data, ensuring that carbon measurement systems remain fit for purpose for product design decisions, sustainability innovation, supplier decarbonization programs, customer reporting, product environmental claims, industry benchmarking, and assurance requirements.

The position is accountable for maintaining business continuity across PS climate data, product carbon footprints, NPI support, EPEAT requirements, and sustainability assurance activities while serving as a catalyst for product decarbonization, supplier engagement, sustainability innovation, and industry collaboration.

Key Responsibilities

PS Climate Data, Methodology & LCA Strategy Leadership

  • Own the PS climate data strategy, governance framework, and data quality processes.
  • Serve as the primary methodological authority for product carbon foot printing within the Personal Systems business.
  • Define and maintain the strategy behind PS LCA models, ensuring they remain aligned with business needs, industry developments, customer requirements, and assurance expectations.
  • Own the long-term roadmap for PS carbon modeling capabilities, including model improvements, automation priorities, primary data integration, and methodology enhancements.
  • Govern PS-wide Life Cycle Inventory (LCI) data strategy, including selection of datasets, modeling assumptions, supplier-specific data adoption, and methodological improvements.
  • Ensure consistency of carbon accounting approaches across the PS product portfolio.
  • Partner with climate data, FoLCA, assurance, and sustainability teams to continuously improve model quality, transparency, and scalability.

Business Partnership & Product Decarbonization

  • Serve as the Climate Team focal point within the Personal Systems business.
  • Build strong partnerships with PS Sustainability leadership and key stakeholders.
  • Partner closely with PS engineering, design, product management, and sustainability teams to integrate climate considerations into product decisions.
  • Use LCA insights to identify, quantify, and prioritize product decarbonization hot spots and opportunities.
  • Support engineering teams in evaluating sustainability trade-offs and environmental impacts associated with product design decisions.
  • Support NPI teams to integrate climate and sustainability considerations within product development processes.
  • Act as a trusted sustainability advisor to the PS business, using climate data to inform business strategy and investment decisions.
  • Support the development of credible, data-backed, sustainability claims related to product and packaging innovations, lower-carbon materials, manufacturing improvements, circularity initiatives, and product environmental performance.
  • Provide technical substantiation and evidence supporting customer-facing sustainability communications and product claims.

Supplier Decarbonization & Responsible Sourcing Integration

  • Define Supply-Chain decarbonization requirements and integrate them into Responsible Sourcing programs, supplier engagement activities, and performance expectations.
  • Partner with Responsible Sourcing to influence supplier decarbonization roadmaps.
  • Evaluate supplier decarbonization opportunities and translate findings into actionable recommendations for the business.
  • Drive the integration of supplier RE and climate performance into PS LCAs.

Industry Engagement & External Collaboration

  • Represent HP in relevant industry collaborations, technical working groups, and sustainability consortia, including organizations such as ITCC, SEMI, SCC, and similar initiatives.
  • Influence the development of industry methodologies, standards, and best practices related to product carbon foot printing and product sustainability.
  • Build relationships with external stakeholders and industry peers to advance HP's sustainability objectives.
  • Identify opportunities to improve HP's return on investment from participation in industry associations and collaborative initiatives.
  • Monitor emerging sustainability, decarbonization, and product carbon disclosure trends and assess implications for the PS business.

Governance, Reporting & Assurance

  • Maintain accountability for PS climate data used in SPR, assurance, customer reporting, and product sustainability programs
  • Ensure climate data and supporting documentation remain audit-ready and defensible.
  • Support EPEAT/TCO reporting requirements and associated product carbon footprint documentation.
  • Maintain appropriate governance and controls over PS climate datasets, methodologies, assumptions, and supporting evidence.
  • Partner with assurance teams to ensure ongoing compliance with reporting and verification requirements.

Success Measures

The role is successful when:

  • PS climate data remains accurate, credible, assurance-ready, and fit for purpose.
  • LCA insights are routinely used by engineering, design, and product teams to inform sustainability decisions.
  • Product decarbonization opportunities are identified and translated into measurable business outcomes.
  • Sustainability considerations are integrated into NPI and product development processes.
  • Supplier decarbonization requirements are successfully embedded within Responsible Sourcing programs.
  • Product sustainability innovations are supported by credible and defensible climate data.
  • Sustainability claims and customer-facing communications can be substantiated through robust technical evidence.
  • HP strengthens its influence in industry working groups and sustainability consortia.
  • SPR, assurance, EPEAT, and customer reporting activities are delivered without disruption.

Required Skills & Experience

Technical Expertise

  • Strong experience in Life Cycle Assessment (LCA), carbon accounting, product sustainability, or environmental footprinting.
  • Experience interpreting and applying product carbon footprint methodologies.
