title: Development Director
description:
At EA, we believe games are powerful because they bring together multiple ways people engage: play, watch, create, and connect. And increasingly, the biggest entertainment platforms aren't just places to consume content — they're places where communities build.


Creator-made content is already a proven part of EA's history — from community creation tools in Battlefield to The Gallery in The Sims 4. We believe new creative technologies and tools will expand how players engage with and contribute to our experiences, supported by thoughtful product design, safety systems, and global reach. Our focus is on enabling more players to participate in creative expression by making creation easier, safer, and more rewarding.

We are looking for a Development Director to partner with researchers and engineers shaping the future of AI and interactive entertainment. You will turn technical goals into clear plans and use automation and agentic AI tools to improve how teams plan, coordinate, and deliver work.

You will guide work from research and experimentation through prototypes, integration, and delivery. You will also create systems that give teams clear visibility into priorities, progress, dependencies, risks, and outcomes.

The Development Director will report to the Head of Development Production.

This is a hybrid role, working three days per week in our Stockholm studio.

Responsibilities

  • Translate research and engineering objectives into plans, milestones, and deliverables.
  • Guide projects from early exploration through prototypes, integration, and release.
  • Establish planning, milestone, review, and execution processes for research and engineering teams.
  • Maintain visibility into priorities, progress, dependencies, risks, and outcomes.
  • Coordinate decisions and resources to address project risks and blockers.
  • Turn cross-functional discussions into decisions, actions, owners, and next steps.
  • Build agentic AI workflows that automate scheduling, reporting, coordination, and information synthesis.
  • Improve production tools and processes based on team and project needs.

Qualifications

  • 5+ years managing technical programs or projects in software, research, engineering, or related technical environments.
  • Background managing scope, schedules, dependencies, risks, and delivery across technical programs.
  • Experience applying Agile, Kanban, Lean, or similar development practices.
  • Hands-on work building or operating agentic AI and automation workflows.
  • Familiarity with large language model concepts, including task decomposition, tool use, retrieval, and evaluation.
  • Experience synthesizing technical information for teams and leadership.
  • Proficiency with Jira or similar planning and tracking tools.
  • Track record coordinating work across Research, Engineering, Product, and partner teams.

We are a diverse, goal-driven team that offers real influence and autonomy to every member. Our ideal candidate is curious, open-minded, and thrilled by exploring fresh concepts and tailoring them for game development. If you are a passionate, creative, and communicative individual who is deeply invested in innovating across new domains of gaming, we want you on our team.

title: Senior Product Manager - Platform
description:
Bitwarden empowers enterprises, developers, and individuals to securely store and share sensitive data. With a transparent, open-source approach to password management, secrets management, and passwordless and passkey innovations, Bitwarden makes it easy for users to extend robust security practices across all online activities. Founded in 2016 with headquarters in Santa Barbara, California, Bitwarden is supported by a passionate global community of security experts and enthusiasts.

As Senior Product Manager,Platform at Bitwarden, you will own the strategy and execution for how Bitwarden surfaces actionable security insights to admins, security teams, and executives. You will be meticulous about the data model, reporting experience, and the signals that drive user and organizational security posture improvements. You will partner with Design, Engineering, and GTM to build intelligence features that are clear, trustworthy, and drive meaningful action. You will partner with Sales and Solutions Engineering on how reporting capabilities accelerate enterprise deals and support compliance requirements. You will use qualitative customer feedback, usage analytics, and competitive benchmarking to inform roadmap decisions, thinking deeply about both SMB admin and enterprise security team needs.

This is an all-remote team and we’re looking for someone located in the U.S. with no preference for time zone. We do not offer visa sponsorship at this time.

RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Own the in-product reporting experience, admin dashboards, health score frameworks, anomaly and risk detection surfaces, and data export capabilities
  • Analyze how 1Password, Keeper, Okta, and adjacent IAM/PAM vendors approach access reporting, risk signals, and security posture scoring
  • Model the relationship between reporting feature adoption and expansion ARR, retention, and enterprise deal velocity
  • Define and monitor engagement metrics, report generation frequency, and export/integration usage by cohort and segment
  • Support Sales on how Access Intelligence capabilities map to security buyer pain points, including RFP responses and deal-stage demos
  • Share performance metrics, roadmap updates, and intelligence feature wins with leadership and cross-functional partners
  • Use AI tools to accelerate spec writing, competitive analysis, data modeling, and rapid prototyping

WHAT YOU BRING TO BITWARDEN

  • 4+ years experience in product management
  • Experience with B2B SaaS products
  • Familiarity with data and analytics product patterns including dashboards, alerting, exporting
  • Ability to translate complex security concepts into intuitive admin experiences
  • Ability to have technical discussions with engineering around data pipelines, event schemas, and query performance
  • Extremely organized and able to make highly informed prioritization & trade-off decisions with engineering
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills
  • A growth mindset and a desire to learn from others
  • Excitement and enthusiasm for open source and for better internet security

WHAT TO EXPECT IN THE INTERVIEW PROCESS

Selected candidates will be invited to schedule an introduction call and potentially progress through the following stages:

  • Interview with Senior Director, Product Management
  • Interview with Chief Innovation Officer
  • Interview with Chief Executive Officer
  • Reference calls

A FEW REASONS TO WORK WITH US

  • Our user community loves us and we love them. Come to work each day with a sense of purpose as we bring a more secure internet experience to everyone from our friends and family to the world’s largest organizations.
  • Become an expert. You’ll get immersed in the prominent technology markets of security and open source software.
  • We are dedicated to building a diverse and talented team. Work remotely with motivated and supportive team members across the world.

title: Sygeplejerske søges til de nye Sundheds- og Omsorgsboliger
description:
Vil du være med til at forme fremtidens nære sundhed?

Akutpladserne i Næstved Kommune er på vej ind i en spændende udvikling. Som en del af den nye sundhedsreform bliver Akutpladserne til Sundheds- og Omsorgspladserne – og vi søger derfor engagerede sygeplejersker, som har lyst til at være med på rejsen.

Vi står foran en ny og spændende hverdag, hvor sundhed, rehabilitering, pleje og behandling skal tænkes endnu mere sammen. Her får du mulighed for at bringe dine sygeplejefaglige kompetencer i spil og samtidig være med til at udvikle vores nye tilbud.

Vi søger dig, som

  • er uddannet sygeplejerske og brænder for den borgernære sygepleje
  • trives med komplekse og varierede borgerforløb
  • kan arbejde selvstændigt og samtidig ser værdien i det gode tværfaglige samarbejde
  • har lyst til at udvikle både dig selv og vores fælles praksis
  • kan bevare overblikket, også når dagen ikke går som planlagt
  • møder patienten, pårørende og kolleger med respekt, nærvær og nysgerrighed
  • har lyst til at være en aktiv del af en arbejdsplads i udvikling.

Hos os får du

  • en arbejdsplads i forandring – og mulighed for at gøre en forskel
  • en mulighed for at blive en del af et fagligt stærkt team, hvor vi arbejder sammen om gode og sammenhængende borgerforløb
  • høj sygeplejefaglig kvalitet
  • faglig sparring og læring i hverdagen
  • et tæt tværfagligt samarbejde
  • medindflydelse på udviklingen af de nye Sundheds- og Omsorgspladser
  • et arbejdsmiljø med plads til humor, fællesskab og et godt grin og kolleger, der hjælper hinanden og løfter i flok.

Du får mulighed for at sætte dit faglige aftryk

Når vi går fra Akutpladser til Sundheds- og Omsorgspladser, skal vi sammen finde den bedste måde at løse vores nye opgaver på.
Det betyder, at du ikke bare bliver ansat til en færdig løsning – du bliver en del af udviklingen af den. Vi har brug for sygeplejersker, der tør tænke nyt, stille spørgsmål og komme med idéer.
Måske har du erfaring fra akutsygepleje, medicinsk sygepleje, hjemmepleje, hospital eller et helt andet område. Det vigtigste er, at du har lyst til at bruge din faglighed i en hverdag, hvor ingen dage er ens.

Hvem er vi?

Vi er en arbejdsplads med høj faglighed, mange forskellige kompetencer og et stærkt fokus på patienten. Hos os kommer du tæt på patienterne og får mulighed for at følge deres udvikling. Du vil opleve komplekse problemstillinger, men også de små sejre, der gør sygeplejen meningsfuld.

Vi tror på, at den bedste kvalitet skabes sammen – og derfor har vi brug for dig.

Løn og ansættelsesvilkår sker i henhold til gældende overenskomst mellem KL og DSR.

title: Receptioniste
description:
Ben jij gastvrij, houd je gemakkelijk overzicht en zorg jij ervoor dat bezoekers en collega’s zich direct welkom voelen? Vind je het leuk om telefoon, receptie en ondersteunende werkzaamheden met elkaar te combineren? Dan maken we graag kennis met jou.

Als Receptioniste ben jij het eerste aanspreekpunt van Terberg Benschop. Je ontvangt bezoekers, handelt het telefoonverkeer professioneel, zorgt voor de afhandeling van inkomende e-mail en zorgt dat alles rondom de receptie soepel verloopt. Met jouw vriendelijke en nauwkeurige aanpak draag je iedere dag bij aan een gastvrije ontvangst en een goed georganiseerde werkomgeving. We zoeken iemand voor 24 tot 32 uur per week, het aantal uren en de werkdagen stemmen we af tijdens de procedure.

Wat ga je doen?
Geen dag is precies hetzelfde. Het ene moment heet je een bezoeker welkom, het volgende moment verbind je een telefoongesprek door of zorg je ervoor dat er een lunch besteld wordt. Je werkt zelfstandig binnen duidelijke kaders en krijgt ruimte om initiatief te nemen. Ook wanneer het druk is aan de telefoon of bij de balie, blijf jij rustig, vriendelijk en zorgvuldig. Zo zorg je voor een professionele eerste indruk van Terberg.

Concreet betekent dit dat jij:

  • Ontvangt bezoekers op een gastvrije en professionele manier en helpt hen op weg binnen onze organisatie;
  • Regelt het inkomende en uitgaande telefoonverkeer en zorgt dat vragen bij de juiste collega terechtkomen;
  • Beheert meerdere e-mailboxen;
  • Verzorgt verschillende administratieve en secretariële werkzaamheden, zoals het regelen van vergaderzalen, lunches en overwerkmaaltijden en het bestellen van taxi’s, bloemen en parkeerplaatsen;
  • Houdt de receptie en jouw werkplek netjes en werkt volgens onze kwaliteits-, arbo- en milieuregels.

Wie ben jij en wat breng jij mee?
Je bent representatief, servicegericht en vindt het belangrijk dat mensen zich gezien en welkom voelen. Je schakelt gemakkelijk tussen verschillende werkzaamheden en blijft ook op drukke momenten rustig en vriendelijk. Je werkt nauwkeurig, pakt zaken zelfstandig op en zoekt waar nodig de samenwerking op.

Wat breng je verder mee?

  • Mbo-werk- en -denkniveau;
  • Ervaring in een receptie-, telefonie- of administratieve functie is een mooie basis;
  • Een gastvrije, representatieve en servicegerichte houding;
  • Het vermogen om snel te schakelen en verschillende werkzaamheden goed te organiseren;
  • Je werkt nauwkeurig en gaat zorgvuldig om met vertrouwelijke informatie;
  • Goede communicatieve vaardigheden en een prettige telefoonstem.


Goed om te weten

  • Je hebt een EU-paspoort of een geldige werkvergunning voor Nederland;
  • Je beheerst de Nederlandse taal goed; beheersing van het Engels is belangrijk in onze internationale werkomgeving.

Wat bieden wij jou?
Als collega van Terberg krijg je een mooie functie bij een van de belangrijkste en grootste maakbedrijven van Nederland. De sfeer in ons familiebedrijf is prettig en je gaat aan de slag binnen een gemotiveerd team. Wij houden ervan als je meedenkt en naar je ideeën wordt altijd geluisterd. Vakinhoudelijk bijblijven vinden we van belang, je hebt toegang tot vele opleidings- en doorgroeimogelijkheden via de Terberg Academy. Bij deze baan hoort een goed arbeidsvoorwaardenpakket en we volgen de cao (klein) Metaal en Techniek.

Wat mag je verder van ons verwachten?

  • Een open, informele en no-nonsensecultuur met korte communicatielijnen;
  • 200 vakantie-uren per jaar (op basis van een fulltime dienstverband);
  • Deelname aan een collectieve pensioenregeling;
  • De mogelijkheid om deel te nemen aan onze collectieve zorgverzekering;
  • Belastingvoordeel via onze fietsregeling;
  • Sportieve activiteiten en verschillende sociale evenementen, waaronder mooie bedrijfsfeesten waar collega’s elkaar ook buiten het werk ontmoeten.

Is dit jouw droombaan?
Laat het ons weten en solliciteer via de vacature! Mocht je meer informatie over het bedrijf of functie(inhoud) willen, dan kun je contact opnemen met Ewelina Miller (Recruitment Business Partner) via ons algemene nummer (0348) 45 92 11.

title: Solar Site Surveyor - Pittsburgh
description:
Solar Site Surveyor

Full-Time | Field-Based

About This Role

SpartanX is seeking a dependable and detail-oriented Solar Site Surveyor to support residential solar projects across our active markets.

The Site Surveyor is responsible for collecting the accurate field information our Design, Engineering, Permitting, and Operations teams need to move a project forward. You'll visit customer homes, document roof and structural conditions, collect electrical information, take required measurements and photographs, and identify site conditions that could affect system design or installation.

This is an independent field role for someone who is comfortable on roofs and in attics, communicates professionally with homeowners, and understands that the quality of everything downstream starts with an accurate survey.

What You’ll Do

Site Surveys & Field Documentation

  • Perform residential solar site surveys according to SpartanX standards
  • Collect accurate roof, structural, electrical, attic, and property information
  • Document main service panels, subpanels, meters, breakers, and existing electrical equipment
  • Take complete photographs, measurements, and detailed field notes
  • Document roof dimensions, pitch, material, condition, and potential installation obstacles
  • Evaluate attic access and document applicable structural conditions
  • Identify shading, access limitations, electrical concerns, or other conditions that could affect system design or installation
  • Verify all required information has been collected before leaving the property
  • Submit complete and accurate survey information through company systems within required timelines

Project & Operations Support

  • Provide Design and Engineering with reliable field information needed to develop accurate system plans
  • Communicate unusual site conditions or potential project concerns to the appropriate teams
  • Coordinate with Design, Engineering, Permitting, Installation, and Operations when additional information is required
  • Respond promptly to requests for clarification or additional documentation
  • Help reduce redesigns, return visits, and installation delays through accurate initial surveys
  • Maintain accurate project documentation and survey records

Homeowner & Field Responsibilities

  • Communicate professionally with homeowners during scheduled appointments
  • Arrive prepared and on time for assigned surveys
  • Treat customer homes and property with care and respect
  • Maintain a professional appearance and represent SpartanX appropriately in the field
  • Follow company safety procedures while working on roofs, ladders, in attics, and around electrical equipment
  • Manage assigned appointments and daily routes efficiently

What We’re Looking For

  • Previous experience in solar, construction, roofing, electrical, site surveying, or field operations preferred
  • Strong attention to detail and accuracy
  • Ability to work independently and manage a daily field schedule
  • Professional homeowner communication and customer-service skills
  • Comfortable safely accessing rooftops, ladders, and attics
  • Basic understanding of residential construction
  • Basic understanding of residential electrical systems preferred
  • Comfortable using smartphones, tablets, mobile applications, and web-based systems
  • Ability to take accurate measurements and follow detailed documentation requirements
  • Valid driver's license and clean driving record
  • Ability to travel between scheduled appointments
  • Ability to lift and safely carry equipment required to perform site surveys

Preferred Qualifications

  • Previous residential solar site survey experience
  • Residential solar installation or operations experience
  • Roofing or construction experience
  • Electrical experience or knowledge
  • Familiarity with solar design or site survey software
  • OSHA 10 or other relevant safety training

Schedule

Primarily Monday–Friday, with occasional Saturday availability required.

Pay & Vehicle Compensation

  • $13.75/hour + $55 per completed site survey
  • Vehicle Compensation — Choose One:
    • $400 monthly vehicle allowance + $0.22 per mile, or
    • Use your own vehicle + $0.72 per mile
  • Performance and incentive opportunities for top performers
  • Opportunity to increase earnings through productivity and completed surveys
  • Career growth opportunities within a rapidly expanding solar organization

Legal Disclaimer

SpartanX is an Equal Opportunity Employer that values workplace diversity. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, or protected veteran status and will not be discriminated against based on disability. For more information, please visit www.eeoc.gov.

title: Senior BI Konsult
description:
För kunds räkning söker vi nu en senior BI-konsult som ska stärka kundens BI & Analytics-team och bidra i arbetet med att utveckla och modernisera organisationens dataplattform.

Om tjänsten

I rollen som senior BI-konsult blir du en viktig del av BI & Analytics-teamet. Du kommer att arbeta med att designa, utveckla och förvalta skalbara analyslösningar samt bidra till den fortsatta utvecklingen av kundens BI- och datalandskap.

Rollen innebär ett nära samarbete med verksamheten, där du omsätter affärsbehov och krav till effektiva, användarvänliga och välfungerande analys- och rapportlösningar.

• Arbeta med datamodellering och scriptutveckling

• Optimera prestanda i BI-lösningar i företagsövergripande miljöer

• Bidra till utvecklingen och moderniseringen av BI- och datalandskapet

• Samarbeta nära verksamheten och omsätta affärsbehov och krav till effektiva analys- och rapportlösningar

Din profil

För kunds räkning söker vi dig som är en senior BI-konsult med gedigen erfarenhet av BI och Analytics. Du är van vid att arbeta självständigt, ta stort ansvar och driva ditt arbete framåt i komplexa företagsmiljöer.

Du har ett starkt verksamhetsfokus och förmåga att förstå affärsmässiga behov och omsätta dessa till välfungerande tekniska lösningar. Rollen kräver både djup teknisk kompetens och förmåga att samarbeta med olika delar av verksamheten.

Kvalifikationer

För att vara relevant för uppdraget ser vi att du har:

• Gedigen praktisk erfarenhet av utveckling i Qlik Sense

• Omfattande erfarenhet av datamodellering

• Omfattande erfarenhet av scriptutveckling

• Erfarenhet av prestandaoptimering i företagsövergripande miljöer

• God förmåga att översätta verksamhetskrav till fungerande analyslösningar

• Senior erfarenhetsnivå inom BI och Analytics, 9-12 års relevant erfarenhet

Du arbetar mycket självständigt, tar stort ansvar och har förmåga att vid behov leda större grupper

Meriterande

Det är meriterande om du har:

• Kunskap om Microsoft Fabric, dess koncept och funktionalitet

Ytterligare information

Detta är ett konsultuppdrag för kunds räkning. Kunden befinner sig i en utvecklingsfas där BI- och datalandskapet moderniseras, vilket ger dig möjlighet att bidra med din specialistkompetens och vara med och utveckla framtidens analyslösningar.

Låter detta som ett intressant uppdrag?

Sök redan i dag eller kontakta oss så berättar vi gärna mer. Vi behöver en ansökan inkluderat CV och personligt brev på svenska som matchar vår kunds krav. title: Cloud & Infrastructure Engineer
description:
Exciting Opportunities at Maverick Payments!

Join our fast-paced, growing company and further your career with Maverick Payments, where you can thrive, your ideas are valued, and your colleagues feel more like family than coworkers!

About Us:
Maverick Payments is a family-owned and privately held full-service payment provider. Located in Calabasas, California, Maverick has created innovative technology designed for sales organizations, such as ISO’s and ISV’s, looking to monetize payments by reselling our white-labeled payments stack. Our payment products include merchant acquiring services, a proprietary gateway, ACH processing, fraud & chargeback tools, analytics, and other value-add services. Maverick’s team includes underwriting, risk management, compliance & legal, technology & product development, on-boarding, customer support, information technology, and more.

About the Position:
Reporting to the VP, Information Technology, the Cloud & Infrastructure Engineer to partner with our current engineer to bring complementary depth in cloud and on-premises networking, Azure platform engineering, and infrastructure-as-code. This position will be responsible for the reliability, security, and scalability of our Azure environment, Enterprise M365 capabilities, and our on-premises infrastructure The Cloud Engineer is expected to design and operate infrastructure in a manner that protects cardholder data and supports continuous audit readiness.
  • Design, deploy, and operate Azure platform services: compute, storage, networking, identity, monitoring, and governance (management groups, subscriptions, policy, RBAC).
  • Implement and maintain landing zone patterns, naming and tagging standards, and cost-optimization practices.
  • Build and maintain infrastructure-as-code using Terraform and/or Bicep; implement CI/CD for infrastructure changes.
  • Operate and tune monitoring, alerting, and logging using Azure Monitor, Log Analytics, and related tooling.
  • Own design and operations for cloud and on-premises networking: VNets, subnets, NSGs, route tables, peering, ExpressRoute/VPN, hybrid connectivity, DNS, firewalls, load balancers, and WAN/LAN.
  • Implement and maintain network segmentation appropriate for PCI DSS scope; partner with Information Security on network controls.
  • Troubleshoot complex hybrid networking issues across cloud, hosted private cloud, and on-prem environments.
  • Partner on the design, operations, and lifecycle of our hosted private cloud environment and remaining on-prem infrastructure.
  • Maintain backup, disaster recovery, and business continuity capabilities; participate in DR testing.
  • Manage server, virtualization, and storage platforms in partnership with the existing Cloud & Infrastructure Engineer.
  • Deliver high availability and performance for production and corporate workloads through proactive engineering, capacity planning, and operational excellence.
  • Implement and maintain security baselines, hardening standards, and patching; partner closely with the Security Engineer and Information Security Officer.
  • Provide engineering evidence and remediation for PCI DSS and SOC 2 Type 2 audits.
  • Automate repetitive operational tasks using PowerShell, Python, and CI/CD pipelines (Azure DevOps and/or GitHub Actions).
  • Contribute to runbooks, knowledge articles, and self-service capabilities that standardize execution, improving operations and reducing mean time to recovery.
  • Supporting specialized projects on an as-needed basis as directed by the VP, Information Technology.
  • Support as-hoc tasks and projects as required by departmental and company needs.
  • Other duties as assigned.
Qualifications:
  • 3 - 6 years of hands-on experience in cloud engineering, infrastructure engineering, network engineering, or a closely related role.
  • Strong Azure experience across compute, networking, identity, and monitoring; comfortable building and operating production Azure workloads.
  • Experience managing and operating within a M365 E5 class environment across the services available in the suite.
  • Strong networking fundamentals: TCP/IP, routing, switching, VLANs, DNS, firewalls, VPN, and hybrid connectivity; experience designing and troubleshooting non-trivial network topologies.
  • Strong understanding of privileged access governance and hands-on experience implementing it (PAM/PIM/JIT/JEA).
  • Hands-on experience with infrastructure-as-code (Terraform and/or Bicep) and source-controlled infrastructure workflows.
  • Scripting proficiency in PowerShell and/or Python.
  • Practical understanding of security and compliance constructs in a regulated environment (PCI DSS, SOC 2, HIPAA, or similar).
  • Strong troubleshooting skills, ownership mindset, and ability to operate calmly under incident conditions.
Preferred:
  • Experience in payments, fintech, or another regulated industry.
  • Experience with hosted private cloud, colocation, or hybrid product environments.
  • Experience with virtualization (VMware, Hyper-V), storage platforms, and enterprise backup/DR tooling.
  • Experience with network and security tooling such as Azure Firewall, Palo Alto, Fortinet, SonicWall, Cisco, or comparable.
  • Relevant certifications such as Azure Administrator Associate (AZ-104), Azure Network Engineer Associate (AZ-700), Azure Solutions Architect Expert, CCNA/CCNP, or equivalent.

What We Offer:

  • Competitive Salary, Bonuses and Incentives.
  • Comprehensive employer sponsored health, vision, and dental insurance programs.
  • Paid time off, Paid Sick and Paid Holidays.
  • 401K plan with up to a 3% matching contribution.
  • Commitment to Career Development and Advancement.
  • Employee Recognition Programs
  • Vibrant Office Culture, Team Building, Birthdays, Work Anniversaries, Snacks, and more!
Pay Range: $125K-$140K

This position will report onsite to our offices in Calabasas, CA

Maverick Payments is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

Pay Transparency Notice: At Maverick Payments, we believe in openness, honesty, and empowering our candidates to make informed career choices. As part of our commitment to transparency, we disclose the salary range for our positions. These ranges reflect our dedication to fair compensation practices and recognize the value that each team member brings to our organization. The final salary offer will be based on factors such as your experience, skills, and qualifications.

Non-Solicitation from Third Parties: Do not contact Maverick Payments about this position unless you are a job seeker and potential applicant for this position. Do not contact Maverick Payments about other services, products or commercial interests.

Notice to Agency and Search Firm Representatives: Maverick Payments is not accepting unsolicited resumes from agencies and/or search firms for this or other job postings. Resumes submitted to any Maverick Payments employee by a third-party agency and/or search firm without a valid written and signed search agreement, will become the sole property of Maverick Payments. No fee will be paid if a candidate is hired for this position as a result of an unsolicited agency or search firm referral.

Fair Chance Ordinance: Maverick will consider qualified applicants with criminal histories in a consistent manner with the Los Angeles Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring.

title: CNC Programmer
description:
Ready to make an impact? Join a stable and growing organization where your career can flourish! If you're excited about new opportunities, keep reading!


At Trace-A-Matic, our people are our greatest assets! We offer a friendly, clean, and safe work environment where everyone can thrive. Our mission is to achieve excellence in complex precision machined components and ensure customer satisfaction. Plus, we have a fantastic Gainsharing program: when the company profits, we share 50% with our employees, paid out quarterly!


Trace-A-Matic offers:

  • 10 Paid Holidays
  • Service-Based PTO
  • Gainsharing
  • Medical, Dental, Vision Insurance
  • 401k with company contribution
  • Exciting, fast-paced environment with cutting edge equipment/manufacturing processes
  • On-site Fitness Center & Medical Clinic
  • Weekly Pay
  • Performance Merit Raises

Position Overview:

The manufacturing engineer shall support the business in areas of new product development; process improvement; daily production support; project manage key programs; analyze and interpret technical data (engineering drawings, specifications, purchase orders, etc.) and create shop routings, operations sheets, tools, and other necessary processes and equipment to produce a high-quality product.


Typical processes include milling, lathe operation, honing, plating, CNC programming, assembly, testing, non-destructive testing, dimensional and visual inspection techniques and electro-mechanical assembly experience.


Essential Duties and Responsibilities:

  • Based on requirements from customer orders, plan sequences of operations for machining and assembly of products.

title: Working Student Offshore Risk Management d/f/m
description:
RWE Offshore Wind GmbH
To start as soon as possible, part time, fixed term

Take the opportunity to gain practical experience in Offshore Commodity Risk Management. You will work alongside experienced colleagues to understand how developments in energy and commodity markets affect offshore wind projects; contribute to standardized project risk reporting and help translate complex market information into practical insights for project decision-making. The role offers hands-on exposure to real project challenges while giving you the flexibility to balance professional experience with your studies.

About the Role

  • Analyse market trends that impact commodities, inflation, and offshore wind supply chains
  • Maintain exposure models, assumptions, and supporting data tracking how exposures evolve across lifecycle stages (pre-FID through operations)
  • Assist with analysis of project indexation risks, helping to inform risk management and hedging recommendations
  • Learn to use and apply our in-house modelling and reporting tools, providing analysis and insights to support project decision-making
  • Collaborate with colleagues in Procurement, Controlling and Commercial
  • Assist in preparing and delivering clear presentations and reports for project teams and senior management
  • Build your understanding of energy markets, commodity markets, offshore wind projects and risk management

Job requirements and experience

  • Currently enrolled in a degree programme in Economics, Finance, Engineering, Mathematics, Data Science, or a similar discipline
  • Strong analytical and quantitative skills, combined with an interest in solving complex problems
  • Keen interest in energy markets, offshore wind projects, and the commercial drivers influencing market developments
  • Good verbal and written communication skills with the ability to present information clearly and effectively
  • Collaborative team player who is open to feedback and enjoys working in an international environment
  • Fluent in English, both written and spoken
  • Curious, proactive and motivated to learn in a dynamic project Environment

Advantageous, but not essential

  • Confident user of Microsoft Excel; experience with Python, SQL, VBA, HTML, or Microsoft Azure would be beneficial
  • Experience with financial or cost modelling is beneficial, but not essential

From here, you benefit from many further advantages – Curious? Then click here!

Apply with just a few clicks: ad code 93549.
Any questions? Contact HR: Lena Lefarth (sebastian.emmelot@rwe.com), Contact Business: Amanda Robinson. #LI-SE1

We look forward to meeting you. Of course, you can find us on LinkedIn, Instagram, Facebook, YouTube and Xing, too. #LI-LL2

We value diversity and therefore welcome all applications - regardless of gender, disability, nationality, ethnic and social origin, religion/belief, age, sexual orientation, and identity. #inclusionmatters

As a global leader, RWE Offshore Wind is shaping tomorrow's energy on the high seas. We are active across Europe, U.S., Japan and Korea. We have already 19 wind farms in operation with an installed capacity of over 3 gigawatts. With over 20 years’ experience in developing, building, operating and maintaining offshore wind farms we have established long-term partnerships, working hand in hand with local businesses and communities. Every year, we invest millions of euros in new offshore wind projects and support harbours, educational programmes, local organisations and more. Our passionate workforce is committed to driving technological and sustainable improvements, delivering construction projects on time and within budget to the highest quality and safety standards, and contributing to a clean energy future.

title: Solution Architect | Data Platform
description:
You'll design data platforms and enterprise-scale data solutions on Azure, working across architecture, implementation and client needs. The role combines hands-on architectural work with close collaboration with implementation teams and stakeholders, from shaping the solution to supporting its delivery.


What you'll work with?

Azure | Databricks | Delta Lake | Delta Live Tables | Unity Catalog | Azure Data Factory | SQL | CI/CD | AI / ML

You'll work with Azure infrastructure and identity components, including VNETs and VMs, as well as Cloud Adoption Framework concepts across enterprise and data environments.

You'll probably enjoy working with us if...

  • You like turning complex business and technical requirements into architectures that teams can actually implement.
  • You're interested not only in building data platforms, but also in finding the right place for AI within them.
  • You enjoy exploring how AI can be supported by the underlying data, architecture and governance rather than treating it as a separate layer.
  • You enjoy working at both the strategic level and close to the technical details.
  • You are comfortable bringing different perspectives together and moving architectural decisions forward.
  • You can explain technical trade-offs clearly to business stakeholders, engineers and technology leaders.
  • You like taking ownership of difficult architectural questions rather than waiting for a predefined solution.
  • You keep an eye on how data platform and AI architecture is evolving and enjoy exploring what new capabilities can bring to projects.

This collaboration might not be for you if...

  • You're looking for one predictable project that will stay largely unchanged for the next few years.
  • You want to receive a finished specification, build exactly what's written there and move to the next topic..
  • You'd rather stay away from client conversations and collaboration with different stakeholders.

Elitmind is a consulting company. Projects, clients, industries and technologies change. You'll collaborate with experienced people around you, but you'll also have a lot of freedom and responsibility for figuring out how to move your own area forward.

What collaboration with Elitmind looks like?

Help build Enterprise IQ

Build the Data & AI foundations behind more intelligent organizations, connecting data, analytics, AI and business context to turn technology into better decisions, smarter actions and measurable value.

Close to Microsoft

As one of Microsoft's key partners in Poland, we get early exposure to new technologies and solutions across the Microsoft ecosystem.

Strong Data & AI expertise

Collaborate with experienced Data & AI experts across different areas, technologies and enterprise projects.

Technology that keeps moving

Work across the Microsoft, Databricks and Snowflake ecosystems, with new technologies regularly explored and applied to real business challenges.

Different projects, different challenges

Our projects span different industries, technologies and business contexts, so there's always something new to solve.

Real autonomy

Take ownership of your scope and independently organize how you deliver the agreed outcomes.

Flexibility that works around your life

Choose where you work best and organize your working hours with flexibility. Work remotely or book a desk in our office whenever you want to collaborate or meet the team in person.

What we're looking for?

  • Strong practical knowledge of Azure and its data platform ecosystem.
  • Experience designing and implementing enterprise-scale Data Platforms, Data Warehouses, Data Lakehouses or Delta Lake solutions.
  • Hands-on experience with Databricks, including modern capabilities such as Delta Live Tables and Unity Catalog.
  • Good understanding of Azure infrastructure, networking and identity components.
  • Very good understanding of the Data perspective of the Cloud Adoption Framework and basic understanding of the Enterprise perspective.
  • Experience designing architecture covering connectivity, authentication, authorization, CI/CD, data access, governance, scalability and cost management.
  • Experience working directly with clients and different technical and business stakeholders.
  • Very good command of English.

title: Back-line værkfører søges til vores mekaniske værksted
description:
Tiltrædelse snarest muligt

Har du overblik, teknisk forståelse og blik for effektiv drift?

N. Kjær Bilcentret A/S søger en værkfører til vores back-line på det mekaniske værksted. Du får en vigtig rolle i den daglige koordinering og planlægning af en række værkstedsrelaterede aktiviteter. Du skal sikre, at opgaverne bliver planlagt rigtigt, fulgt til dørs og leveret til tiden – med fokus på kvalitet, effektivitet og god økonomi.

Du kommer til at arbejde tæt sammen med værksted, salg og vores øvrige afdelinger og får en bred kontaktflade i huset. Du får samtidig det daglige koordinerende ansvar for teknikere/mekanikere samt medarbejdere i kosmetisk klargøring.

Dine vigtigste opgaver

  • Planlægge og koordinere teknisk klargøring, udstyrsmontering, syn samt eksterne opbygninger

  • Sikre effektiv kapacitetsudnyttelse, produktivitet og levering til tiden

  • Have ansvar for kosmetisk klargøring og kvalitetskontrol

  • Håndtere garantiarbejde, servicekontrakter og intern afregning

  • Have ansvar for den daglige drift og stand på virksomhedens udlejningsbiler

  • Koordinere mere komplekse tekniske problemsager og sikre, at de bliver fulgt til dørs

  • Fungere som back-up for de kundevendte værkførere

Du får mandat til at prioritere og omfordele opgaver og ressourcer inden for dit område. Vi forventer, at du tager aktivt ejerskab for fremdrift, kvalitet og løsninger.

Hvem er du?

Du har sandsynligvis erfaring fra et værksted eller en anden teknisk driftsorganisation og har god forståelse for arbejdsgange, planlægning og økonomi.

Vi lægger især vægt på, at du:

  • Har teknisk forståelse og godt overblik

  • Arbejder struktureret og følger op

  • Har beslutningskraft og naturlig gennemslagskraft

  • Har sans for kvalitet, dokumentation og korrekt afregning

  • Er samarbejdsorienteret og løsningsorienteret

  • Kan bevare roen, når der er mange opgaver på én gang

Erfaring som værkfører, teamleder, garantiansvarlig eller tekniker er en fordel, men den rette profil og tilgang til opgaven vægter højt.

Du bliver en del af N. Kjær Bilcentret

Hos N. Kjær Bilcentret tror vi på, at gode resultater kommer, når vi tager ansvar, hjælper hinanden og har lyst til at gøre en forskel.

Vi er en familieejet virksomhed med mere end tre generationers historie i Svendborg. For os handler det ikke kun om biler, men om mennesker, relationer og det lokale engagement. Vi kender vores kunder, og vi kender hinanden – og vi står sammen om at skabe en god forretning.

Hos os får du en hverdag med ansvar og mulighed for at påvirke den måde, vi løser opgaverne på. Vi deler viden, hjælper hinanden og tror på, at man bliver dygtigere af at få ansvar.

Vi forventer noget af dig – men vi investerer også i dig.

Vi tilbyder

En central rolle i en veldrevet og familiejet bilforretning med korte beslutningsveje, et stærkt team og en stor kontaktflade.

Du får en varieret hverdag med mulighed for at præge den daglige drift og være med til at udvikle arbejdsgange, kvalitet og effektivitet på værkstedet.

Arbejdssted: N. Kjær Bilcentret A/S, Svendborg

Lyder det som dig?

Send din ansøgning og CV til værkstedschef Ulrich Bjerre, ulbj@nkjaer.dk

Har du spørgsmål til stillingen, er du velkommen til at kontakte Ulrich Bjerre på tlf. +45 62 17 28 08

Vi afholder samtaler løbende.

Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig.

title: Rakennesuunnittelija, Suunnittelutoimisto 7 Oy
description:
Suunnittelutoimisto 7 Oy on vuonna 2021 Kaarinan Piikkiöön perustettu rakennesuunnitteluun suuntautunut yritys. Olemme moderni ja nuorekas suunnittelutoimisto, joka toteuttaa vaativimmatkin rakennesuunnitelmat ammattitaidolla ja vankalla kokemuksella. Toimintamme sekä tiimimme ovat kasvaneet vakaasti perustamisvuodesta lähtien, suunnittelijatiimiimme kuuluu 16 rautaista suunnittelualan ammattilaista. Palvelemme asiakkaitamme kattavasti ympäri Suomen, toimitilamme sijaitsevat Piikkiössä sekä Espoossa.

Lue lisää yrityksestämme https://st7.fi/

Etsimme nyt kasvumme myötä RAKENNESUUNNITTELIJAA vakituiseen työsuhteeseen!

TYÖNKUVASI

Työtehtäviisi kuuluvat rakennesuunnittelijan monipuoliset tehtävät pienissä ja suurissa julkisissa sekä yksityisissä hankkeissa niin uudis- kuin korjausrakentamisen parissa. Vastaat rakennesuunnitelmien, rakennepiirustusten ja tuotantopiirustusten laatimisesta puu-, betoni- ja teräskohteisiin sekä rakenteiden mitoituksesta ja teknisten ratkaisujen suunnittelusta. Pääset osallistumaan myös luonnosvaiheessa olevien hankkeiden kehittämiseen ja suunnitteluun sekä rakenteellisten ratkaisujen ideointiin yhdessä muun suunnittelutiimin kanssa.

ODOTAMME SINULTA

- Rakennesuunnitteluun soveltuvaa korkeakoulututkintoa (esim. DI, RI tai ins.amk)

- Tekla Structures tai muuta 3D-osaamista

- Aikaisempaa työkokemusta suunnittelusta ja vähintään 3 vuoden osaamista rakennesuunnittelusta

- Osaamista rakenteiden mekaniikasta ja rakennusfysiikasta

TARJOAMME SINULLE

Meillä pääset työskentelemään monipuolisten ja vaihtelevien suunnittelukohteiden parissa modernilla suunnitteluohjelmistolla ja huippuluokan työvälineillä. Tarjoamme työntekijöillemme kattavat kulttuuri- ja liikuntaedut sekä lakisääteistä huomattavasti kattavamman työterveyshuollon työntekijöidemme hyvinvoinnin edistämiseksi. Meillä pääset kehittämään ja päivittämään ammatillista osaamistasi jatkuvasti.

title: Juridisk sagsbehandler / advokatsekretær søges!
description:
Har du talent og interesse for juridisk sagsbehandling på højt niveau?

Drømmer du om at udfolde dig i moderne omgivelser med skønne og dygtige kollegaer?

Så er du med stor sandsynlighed den nye holdspiller, som vi er på udkig efter!

Hvad søger vi, og hvad kan du forvente?

Vi søger en dygtig kollega med evnen til – og ønsket om – at arbejde på et både talentfuldt og socialt stærkt hold, som brænder for at skabe gode resultater for vores klienter, og for at skabe og fastholde den bedste arbejdsplads.

Vores filosofi er, at vi får tingene til at gå op i en højere enhed, når vi kombinerer dygtige kollegaer og det bedste arbejdsmiljø. Vi arbejder derfor målrettet på at skabe de bedste rammer for vores dagligdag – det kan du derfor roligt forvente!

Vi tilbyder en individuel og attraktiv lønpakke ud fra kvalifikationer i moderne rammer.

Hvad forventer vi af dig?

Vi lægger vægt på, at du har talent og interesse for juridisk sagsbehandling, og vi prioriterer dette forud for erfaring indenfor særlige sagsområder. Det vil dog være en fordel, hvis du også har erfaring indenfor et eller flere klassiske sagsområder, såsom bobehandling, fast ejendom, erhvervssager, selskabsret, retssager eller inkasso.

Derudover lægger vi vægt på dit engagement og lyst til at lære nyt og løse opgaver – både selvstændigt og i samarbejde med vores øvrige dygtige hold af advokater og juridiske sagsbehandlere.

Kombinationen af talent og engageret deltagelse i at være en del af et særligt og attraktivt arbejdsmiljø er de vigtigste pejlemærker for os. De kompetencer går vi ikke på kompromis med, så det er en vigtig overvejelse inden du søger!

Ansøgningsfrist og kontakt
Ansøgningsfrist: 18. september 2026.

Tiltrædelse: Snarest muligt.
Send din ansøgning til post@ngaf.dk med tilhørende CV. Vi afholder samtaler løbende.

Har du spørgsmål til stillingen, er du velkommen til at kontakte advokat Kathrine Ruhnau på tlf. 22 33 48 60 eller e-mail kr@ngaf.dk.

title: Delivery Operations Director
description:
Job Title: Delivery Operations Director

Compensation: Based on experience

Location: Bountiful, Utah

Status: Full-time

Benefits: Medical insurance, dental insurance, vision insurance, 401(k), health savings account (HSA), employee assistance program (EAP), paid time Off (PTO), paid holidays, employee discount, life insurance

About the Position

As the Delivery Operations Director, you will own WholesomeCo’s end to end delivery system and the outcomes it produces, from last-mile drivers and dispatch to routing, zones, capacity, and the administrative and logistics support behind every order. You will be accountable for on-time delivery, lead time, and delivery speed, matching drivers, vehicles, and route capacity to demand as it shifts throughout the day. This role is built for a leader who makes fast, data-driven decisions, develops strong front-line leaders, and drives full execution of operational change all the way to the driver level.

About WholesomeCo

At WholesomeCo, you’re not just taking a job; you’re joining a team that’s constantly evolving, innovating, and raising the bar. Every new hire is an opportunity for us to level up as a company, and we look for individuals who bring curiosity, a positive attitude, transparency, strong communication, a strong work ethic, and the ability to collaborate respectfully while making their mark. We’re committed to bringing out the best in each team member, and we hope every hire will help us discover bold, creative ways to grow together. Work at WholesomeCo is meaningful, but we also know how to have fun, with team camaraderie, shared experiences, and moments to celebrate built into our culture.

WholesomeCo is at the forefront of normalizing cannabis as a natural path to health and wellness. From medical cannabis services and statewide delivery to 99% of Utah’s population, to retail, drive-thru, and online pick-up through our West Bountiful pharmacy, we combine convenience, care, and cutting-edge technology. Our in-house app, cultivation and processing facilities, and our growing line of WholesomeCo-branded products showcase our innovative, vertically integrated approach. Known for our tech-driven solutions, data focus, and commitment to continuous improvement, we put patients first, guiding them along their unique cannabis journeys and expanding access every step of the way. Join WholesomeCo, where your contributions matter, your ideas are valued, and each day offers the chance to grow, innovate, and make a real difference in people’s lives.

Job Responsibilities

  • This position requires a passion for operational excellence, a drive for results, the ability to quickly and efficiently lead through unforeseen complexity, and the ability to lead, influence, and develop their team.
  • End - to -End Delivery Ownership: Own the strategy, performance, and continuous improvement of WholesomeCo’s Home Delivery operation, including Driver Operations, Dispatch, zoning, routing, delivery capacity and availability, vehicle fleet operations, driver and delivery support and the systems and processes that enable successful delivery execution and a good patient experience.
  • Delivery Strategy & Roadmap: Develop and execute short and long-term strategies to improve delivery speed, convenience, reliability, scalability, and cost efficiency. Identify opportunities to evolve delivery zones, service models, capacity, technology, staffing, and operating processes as patient demand and business needs change.
  • Routing and Capacity Strategy: Own the strategy and performance of delivery zones, routing, delivery availability, and capacity planning. Ensure routing and capacity models effectively match demand with driver, vehicle, and operational resources while continuously identifying opportunities to improve route efficiency, delivery speed, convenience, and cost.
  • Service & Business Performance: Own delivery performance across service, productivity, cost, and quality including on-time delivery, convenience levels, delivery speed, lead times, capacity utilization, route efficiency, cost per delivery, and other key KPIs. Balance patient convenience and service levels with sustainable labor and operating costs.
  • Real-Time Operations: Lead a high-volume operation where staffing, demand, capacity, and operational conditions change throughout the day, making timely decisions and adjusting the plan in real time.
  • Workforce & Capacity Planning: Own workforce planning and staffing strategy across Delivery and Dispatch, ensuring labor plans and schedules align with forecasted demand, seasonality, promotions, delivery availability, and srvice-level expectations. Partner with operational leaders to anticipate staffing needs and maintain appropriate capacity while achieving productivity and labor targets. Oversee recruitment, onboarding, and training to ensure every agent is prepared and understands workplace standards and compliance.
  • Fleet Readiness & Risk Management: Own fleet strategy and readiness, ensuring the appropriate number and mix of vehicles are available to support current and forecasted delivery demand. Oversee vehicle utilization, maintenance strategy, rentals, insurance, accidents and claims, and acquisition/replacement planning in partnership with Finance, Facilities and other stakeholders.
  • Data and KPIs and Operating Cadence: Define and maintain the KPIs, SLAs, dashboards, and operating rhythms used to manage Delivery Operations. Regularly review performance with leaders, identify trends and root causes, surface risks and opportunities, hold yourself and the team accountable to the results,, and communicate results and recommendations to senior leadership on a regular cadence.
  • Leadership & Organizationl Development: Inspire, mentor, and develop Delivery and Dispatch Managers, supervisors and their leadership teams. Establish clear ownership, expectations, decision rights, and accountability across the organization, while building leadership depth and succession capability so day-to-day operations are effectively owned at the appropriate level. Promote a culture of accountability, collaboration, and innovation, and communicate vision and goals so every agent understands how their role connects to company results.
  • Front-Line Execution and Change Management: Translate strategy and operational improvements into consistent frontline execution. Ensure changes are supported by clear ownership, SOPs, communication, training, accountability, and follow-up, and verify through data and frontline observation that changes are understood, adopted, and sustained.
  • Technology and Process Optimization: Oversee the delivery, dispatch, routing, and CRM systems and the internal processes that support drivers, customer support, and partner departments. Drive adoption of new tools and workflows, and continuously streamline processes to expand internal capacity.
  • Cross-Functional Coordination: Ensure effective communication and coordination with fulfillment, inventory, retail, customer support, and other partners so that delivery commitments are supported upstream and downstream.
  • Budget and Resource Allocation: Handle budgets, forecasting, and resource allocation to meet strategic goals.
  • Quality and Safety: Develop, implement, and maintain quality control and safety assurance protocols, including documentation, implementation, and constant refinement of SOPs.
  • Incident Management: Expeditiously handle, communicate, and update the appropriate systems for all potential issues, problems, accidents, or equipment breakdowns, and maintain on-going knowledge of auto insurance policy, coverage, and the claims process.
  • Continuous Improvement: Establish a culture and operating rhythm of continuous improvement across Delivery Operations. Use performance data, frontline feedback, root-cause analysis, and industry best practices to identify operational friction, test solutions, measure results, and scale successful improvements.
  • Compliance: Ensure compliance with all relevant state medical cannabis and delivery regulations, vehicle and driver requirements, and company policies.

Job Qualifications

  • 5+ years of leadership experience in logistics, transportation, last-mile delivery, or another high-volume operational environment, including experience leading managers and frontline teams.
  • Demonstrated experience owning a complex, high-volume operation with accountability for service, labor, cost, productivity, and quality outcomes. Proven success developing managers and frontline leaders and building organizations with clear ownership and accountability.
  • Experience leading real-time operations where staffing, demand, capacity, and conditions change throughout the day and require sound, timely decision-making.
  • Direct last-mile delivery, transportation, dispatch, and fleet management experience is strongly preferred.
  • Demonstrated experience translating strategy and process improvements into sustained frontline execution.
  • Strong analytical and financial acumen, with experience defining KPIs, interpreting operational data, managing budgets, and using data to drive decisions and continuous improvement.
  • Experience with workforce planning, capacity planning, routing/logistics optimization, and technology-enabled operations.
  • Strong cross-functional leadership and executive communication skills.
  • Experience driving technology adoption and workflow optimization across a front-line team.
  • Ability to react well under pressure, handle multiple projects simultaneously, use good judgment in ambiguous situations, and be flexible/adaptable.
  • Skilled in evaluating and revising operations and procedures in response to organizational change and goals.
  • Exceptional organization, prioritization, and time management abilities.
  • Skilled in basic technology (e.g., POS systems, Microsoft Office and/or Google Suites programs).
  • Ability to work a flexible, full-time schedule to include days, evenings, weekends, and holidays.
  • Continuous mobility throughout the operation during shift, including twisting, frequent bending, pulling, pushing, crouching, stooping, and reaching during shifts. Continuous lifting and/or moving up to 25 lbs.

Benefits

  • Unlimited Paid time off (PTO)
  • Annual bonus opportunity
  • Employer paid 80% of the total medical insurance premium
  • Employer paid 75% of the total dental insurance premium
  • Employer paid 75% of the total vision insurance premium
  • HSA with match up to $150 per month
  • 401(k) with 100% employer match up to 3% and 50% match for the following 2%
  • Employee Assistance Program (EAP)
  • Employer paid $25,000 of basic life coverage
  • Optional additional life insurance
  • Optional accident insurance
  • Employees who are active medical cannabis patients are eligible for an employee discount of 35% off of WholesomeCo products and 15% off of 3rd party products

WholesomeCo is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, or veteran status. Employment is contingent on passing a pre-employment/post-offer background check. This employer participates in the E-verify program where legally required.

title: Head of Platform & Product Delivery
description:
Drive Technology Delivery That Makes a Real Difference

We're seeking a strategic and delivery-focused Head of Platform & Product Delivery to lead the successful implementation of critical technology projects, platforms, and products across the business.

This is a high-impact leadership role responsible for overseeing major technology programmes, shaping product roadmaps, and ensuring the delivery of innovative solutions that support both internal operations and client-facing services. From large-scale system implementations to data and AI-enabled products, you will be at the forefront of driving transformation and business value.

About the Role

As Head of Platform & Product Delivery, you will lead the delivery function, ensuring appropriate platform and product roadmaps are in place, projects are delivered on time, within budget, and to the highest quality standards, underpinned by appropriate delivery methodologies. Working closely with business stakeholders, technology teams, and senior leadership, you will translate strategic objectives into successful delivery outcomes.

You will play a key role in developing and evolving the organisation's technology platforms, product portfolio, and programme governance capabilities while fostering a culture of accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement.
  • Lead and develop the technology delivery function, establishing strong PMO governance, reporting, and delivery disciplines.
  • Oversee major technology programmes and implementations, including case management systems, data platforms, HR, finance, and CRM solutions.
  • Own and manage platform and product roadmaps for both internal systems and client-facing products.
  • Partner with senior stakeholders to prioritise features and initiatives based on business needs, customer feedback, and strategic objectives.
  • Drive agile delivery practices across technology teams, proactively identifying and removing delivery risks and roadblocks.
  • Act as the bridge between business and technology teams, ensuring clear communication and alignment throughout project lifecycles.
  • Oversee quality assurance, testing strategies, and release management processes for business-critical platforms.
  • Lead the delivery of client-facing technology solutions, including customer portals, system integrations, automated workflows, and emerging AI-enabled products.
  • Track and report on product, platform and programme performance and business value creation.
Essential Skills & Experience
  • Significant experience delivering large-scale technology programmes, platforms, or products, including leadership experience within a delivery-focused role.
  • Proven success managing complex technology implementations in regulated environments.
  • Strong understanding of both programme management, governance frameworks, and PMO best practice as well as demonstrable experience of establishing a Product Management disciplines within a rapidly growing business.
  • Experience leading high-performing delivery, project management, or product teams.
  • Strong knowledge of agile delivery methodologies, with experience operating within hybrid agile and waterfall environments.
  • Ability to balance strategic planning with hands-on delivery execution.
  • Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills, with the ability to engage and influence at all levels.
  • Experience within, or knowledge of, regulated industries and the factors that define successful technology delivery.
Desirable Skills & Experience
  • Experience delivering highly automated claims or case management platform implementations.
  • Knowledge of data platform, business intelligence, and AI product delivery.
  • Relevant qualifications such as PRINCE2, MSP, Agile, Scrum, SAFe, or equivalent.
  • Experience leading digital transformation programmes across multiple business functions.
  • Familiarity with product management disciplines and customer-centred design approaches.
  • High levels of flexibility and a great work life balance - https://www.dacbeachcroft.com/en/Work-with-us/Whats-in-it-for-you
  • A well-rounded remuneration package (which includes private medical insurance, income protection insurance and discounted gym membership, amongst many other benefits)
  • Opportunities for growth and progression including professional funding
  • In person and remote social events
  • Opportunity to get involved in a range of Environmental, Social and Governance (ESG) activities
We are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive and authentic workplace, which aligns closely to our cultural principles (Determined, Clear, Creative and Supportive). If you are excited about this role and being part of our culture, but your past experience does not align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles!

title: Installed Base Engineer Mechanical Design
description:
Job Description Summary

We are seeking a highly motivated and skilled Mechanical Design Engineer to join our innovative team at Wipro GE Healthcare Private Limited. In this role, you will be responsible for the design, development, and testing of complex mechanical systems and components for cutting-edge medical devices, contributing to advancements in healthcare technology.

Job Description

Responsibilities:

  • * Design and develop mechanical components and assemblies for medical devices, adhering to industry standards, regulatory requirements, and internal specifications.
  • * Conduct detailed engineering analysis, including stress, thermal, and kinematic analysis, using FEA and other simulation tools.
  • * Create 3D CAD models, detailed drawings, and specifications using industry-standard software (e.g., SolidWorks, Creo, CATIA).
  • * Participate in design reviews, providing technical expertise and feedback to ensure design integrity and manufacturability.
  • * Collaborate with cross-functional teams including electrical engineers, software engineers, manufacturing, and quality assurance throughout the product development lifecycle.
  • * Develop and execute test plans, analyze test data, and troubleshoot design issues to optimize product performance and reliability.
  • * Identify and evaluate new materials, manufacturing processes, and technologies to improve product design and reduce costs.
  • * Maintain accurate and detailed design documentation, including design history files (DHF), engineering change orders (ECOs), and technical reports.
  • * Support manufacturing transfer activities and resolve production-related mechanical design challenges.

Essential Requirements:

  • Strong fundamentals in mechanical engineering design and analysis
  • Hands-on experience with:
    • Sheet metal, machined, fabricated components
    • Plastic parts (injection molded and thermoformed)
  • Expertise in 3D CAD modeling and 2D detailing (e.g., Creo, NX, SolidWorks, CATIA)
  • Proficiency in:
    • Tolerance stack-up analysis
    • FMEAs (DFMEA/PFMEA)
    • Design verification and validation
  • Solid understanding of Design for Manufacturability (DFM) and Design for Assembly (DFA)
  • Strong capability in mechanical BOM creation and management

2. Product Development & NPI Skills

  • Experience across full product development lifecycle, including:
    • Concept and architecture development
    • Detailed design and documentation
    • Prototyping and testing
    • Manufacturing introduction and service support
  • Ability to define and execute component, subsystem, and system-level verification
  • Experience working with prototype vendors and production manufacturers

3. Supplier & Manufacturing Skills

  • Leading DFM and drawing review discussions with suppliers
  • Supplier engagement on:
    • Part design and development
    • Manufacturing processes
    • Cost optimization and packaging
  • Experience in packaging design and validation
  • Understanding of strategic sourcing and common technology reuse

4. Cross-Functional & Communication Skills

  • Ability to work effectively with:
    • Cross-functional teams (Manufacturing, Quality, Supply Chain, Systems, Service)
    • Customers and technical leaders
  • Clear communication of technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders
  • Ability to “connect the dots” across technologies and platforms
  • Strong documentation and presentation skills

5. Problem-Solving & Decision-Making

  • Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills
  • Ability to resolve moderately complex technical issues independently
  • Sound engineering judgment within defined procedures and standards
  • Willingness to seek guidance for issues beyond defined scope

Additional Information

Relocation Assistance Provided: No

title: Okta Services Architect

Recognized by Gartner and KuppingerCole as a leading IAM professional services firm, we specialize exclusively in designing, deploying, and managing end-to-end Identity and Access Management programs for organizations across North America.

If you’re ready to grow your career alongside some of the industry’s best, come join us — you’re key to our success

회사 소개

쿠팡은 고객 감동 실현을 위해 존재합니다. 고객들이 "쿠팡 없이 그동안 어떻게 살았을까?" 라고 말할 때, 비로소 우리의 미션을 실현하고 있음을 알 수 있습니다. 고객들의 쇼핑과 식사, 생활 전반을 편하게 만들겠다는 유일한 집념으로 쿠팡은 수억 달러 규모의 이커머스 산업 전반의 혁신을 이끌고 있습니다. 쿠팡은 가장 빠르게 성장하는 이커머스 기업 중 하나로, 국내 커머스 업계에서의 독보적인 입지와, 고객 신뢰를 구축했습니다.

쿠팡은 스타트업 문화를 기반으로 한 글로벌 대형 상장사라고 자부합니다. 이것이 창립 당시의 기민함을 지하며, 신규 서비스를 끊임없이 출시하며 비즈니스를 확장해 나가는 우리의 성장 동력입니다. 쿠팡의 모든 임직원에게는 기업가 정신을 갖추고 새로운 혁신과 이니셔티브를 추진할 수 있는 기회가 주어집니다. 주저 없이 일에 뛰어들어 성과를 이루고자 하는 과감성이, 바로 쿠팡이 일하는 방식의 본질입니다. 쿠팡에서는 여러분 자신, 동료, 팀 그리고 회사 전체가 매일 성장하는 모습을 목격할 것입니다.

쿠팡의 모든 직원은 커머스의 미래를 만들겠다는 쿠팡의 미션에 진심입니다. 우리는 고객의 문제를 해결해 나가고, 전통적인 관념과 통념에 맞서며 실현 가능한 한계를 뛰어넘고 있습니다. 고가용성 (always-on) 과 최첨단의 앞선 기술 (high-tech), 초연결사회 (hyper-connected world) 에서의 놀라운 업무 경험을 원하신다면, 지금 바로 쿠팡에 합류하세요.

직무 소개

로켓그로스 패션 Account Management & Business Development는 쿠팡의 패션 비즈니스에서 새로운 사업 기회를 발굴하는 것부터 파트너와 함께 지속적인 성장을 만들어가는 것까지 End-to-End로 비즈니스를 주도하는 역할입니다.
현재는 백화점, 아울렛 및 다양한 리테일 파트너와의 협업을 통해 오프라인 매장의 상품을 쿠팡의 로켓배송과 연결하는 **셀러플렉스(Sellerflex)**를 중심으로 패션 비즈니스를 확장하고 있습니다.
단순히 기존 Account를 관리하거나 신규 파트너를 영입하는 것에 그치지 않습니다. 고객과 시장을 이해하고 어떤 브랜드와 상품이 필요한지 판단하여 새로운 비즈니스 기회를 발굴하고, 파트너를 설득하여 런칭하며, 이후에도 상품 구성(Selection), 재고, 프로모션, 고객 경험 등 다양한 성장 요소를 활용해 비즈니스를 지속적으로 성장시킵니다.
담당 파트너와 브랜드를 하나의 비즈니스로 바라보고 데이터를 통해 성과와 기회를 분석하며, 파트너 및 내부 유관부서와 협업하여 문제를 해결하고 새로운 성장 방식을 만들어갑니다.
패션 업계 경험은 필수 요건이 아닙니다. 이커머스 또는 리테일 비즈니스에 대한 이해를 바탕으로 새로운 카테고리, 브랜드와 상품을 빠르게 학습하고 스스로 전문성을 만들어갈 수 있는 분을 찾습니다. 특정 산업에서의 경험만큼이나 새로운 것에 대한 호기심, 빠른 학습 능력, 높은 업무 몰입도와 주도적으로 결과를 만들어내는 자세를 중요하게 생각합니다.

업무 내용

  • 백화점, 아울렛, 브랜드, 셀러 등 다양한 파트너와 관계를 구축하고 새로운 비즈니스 및 성장 기회를 발굴합니다.
  • 잠재력이 높은 파트너, 브랜드 및 상품을 발굴하고 신규 파트너 제안부터 협상, 계약 및 런칭까지 전 과정을 주도합니다.
  • 담당 파트너와 브랜드를 하나의 비즈니스로 바라보고 상품 구성, 재고, 프로모션, 고객 경험 등 핵심 성장 요소를 활용하여 지속적인 매출 성장을 만들어갑니다.
  • 고객과 시장, 브랜드 및 상품에 대한 지속적인 학습을 통해 성장 가능성이 높은 기회를 발굴하고, 데이터와 현장 인사이트를 기반으로 새로운 상품 구성과 비즈니스 기회를 제안합니다.
  • 사업 성과와 데이터를 분석하여 성장 기회 또는 문제의 근본 원인을 파악하고, 구체적인 실행 계획을 수립하여 실제 비즈니스 성과까지 연결합니다.
  • 파트너와 정기적인 Business Review를 진행하며 단기적인 실적 관리뿐만 아니라 중장기적인 성장 전략을 함께 수립하고 실행합니다.
  • Product, Operations 등 다양한 내부 조직과 긴밀하게 협업하여 파트너와 고객의 문제를 해결하고, 보다 효율적이고 확장 가능한 프로세스와 새로운 비즈니스 모델을 만들어갑니다.

자격 요건

  • 이커머스, 리테일 또는 관련 Commercial Business에 대한 높은 이해도를 보유하고 고객, 상품, 가격, 재고, 프로모션 등 주요 비즈니스 성장 요소를 이해하시는 분
  • Sales, Business Development, Account Management, Category Management, Merchandising 등에서 직접 비즈니스 성장을 만들어낸 경험이 있으신 분
  • 신규 고객, 파트너 또는 사업 기회를 스스로 발굴하고 관계 구축부터 협상 및 실행까지 End-to-End로 주도해본 경험이 있으신 분
  • 담당 비즈니스의 목표와 KPI를 명확하게 이해하고, 본인의 성과와 기여도를 구체적인 수치와 결과로 설명할 수 있는 분
  • 데이터를 활용하여 문제를 구조화하고 원인을 파악하며, 분석에 그치지 않고 실제 실행과 비즈니스 성과까지 연결할 수 있는 분
  • 정해진 방식이나 명확한 답이 없는 환경에서도 스스로 우선순위를 정하고 다양한 이해관계자와 협업하여 끝까지 결과를 만들어낼 수 있는 높은 주도성과 실행력을 보유한 분
  • 새로운 산업, 카테고리, 고객 및 비즈니스 모델에 대한 강한 호기심과 빠른 학습 능력을 갖추고 필요한 전문성을 스스로 빠르게 습득할 수 있는 분
  • 파트너와 직접 관계를 구축하고 대면 미팅, 외근 및 출장 등 적극적인 현장 활동에 어려움이 없는 분
  • 6년 이상 세일즈 관련 경력과 전문 학사 학위 이상을 보유한 분

우대 사항

  • 패션, 브랜드, 백화점, 아울렛 또는 관련 리테일/이커머스 비즈니스 경험이 있으신 분
  • 브랜드와 상품에 대한 관심이 높고, 고객 관점에서 브랜드, 상품 구성 및 상품의 성장 가능성을 판단할 수 있는 Commercial Sense를 보유한 분
  • 신규 Account, Channel 또는 Business를 처음부터 개척하고 성장시킨 경험이 있으신 분
  • 주요 브랜드 또는 대형 리테일 파트너와의 협상 및 관계 관리 경험이 있으신 분
  • 데이터를 기반으로 사업적 의사결정을 내리고 실제 비즈니스 성과를 개선한 경험이 있으신 분
  • 비즈니스 프로세스 개선 또는 새로운 운영 방식을 직접 설계하고 실행한 경험이 있으신 분
  • 비즈니스 수준의 영어 커뮤니케이션이 가능하신 분

전형 절차 및 안내 사항

  • 전형절차
    • 서류전형 - 전화면접 - 대면(화상)면접 – 최종 합격
    • 전형절차는 직무별로 다르게 운영될 수 있으며, 일정 및 상황에 따라 변동될 수 있습니다.
    • 전형 일정 및 결과는 지원서에 등록하신 이메일로 개별 안내 드립니다.
  • 참고사항
    • 본 공고는 모집 완료 시 조기 마감될 수 있습니다.
    • 지원서 내용 중 허위사실이 있는 경우에는 합격이 취소될 수 있습니다.
    • 취업 보호 대상자(보훈대상자, 장애인 등)는 관련 법률에 따라 채용우대를 받을 수 있습니다.
    • 직급과 담당 업무 범위는 후보자의 전반적인 경력과 경험 등 제반사정을 고려하여 변경될 수 있습니다. 이러한 변경이 필요할 경우, 최종 합격 통지 전 적절한 시기에 후보자와 커뮤니케이션 될 예정입니다.
    • 채용 및 업무 수행과 관련하여 요구되는 법령상 자격이 갖추어지지 않은 경우 채용이 제한될 수 있습니다.

개인정보 처리방침

  • 쿠팡 그룹은 입사지원자 개인정보 처리방침(아래 링크)에 따라 귀하의 개인정보를 수집하여 처리합니다.

서류 반환 정책

  1. 본 고지는 『채용절차의공정화에관한법률』 제11조제6항에 따른 것 입니다.
  2. 당사 채용에 응시한 구직자 중 최종 합격이 되지 못한 구직자는 『채용절차의 공정화에 관한 법률』에 따라 제출한 채용서류의 반환을 청구할 수 있음을 알려 드립니다. 다만, 홈페이지 또는 전자우편으로 제출된 경우나 구직자가 당사의 요구 없이 자발적으로 제출한 경우에는 그러하지 아니하며, 천재지변이나 그 밖에 당사에게 책임 없는 사유로 채용서류가 멸실된 경우에는 반환한 것으로 봅니다.
  3. 위2항 본문에 따라 채용 서류 반환 청구를 하는 구직자는 채용 서류 반환 청구서 [채용절차의 공정화에 관한 법률 시행규칙 별지 제 3 호 서식]를 작성하여 이메일 (recruitingops@coupang.com) 로 제출하면, 제출이 확인된 날로부터 14 일 이내에 지정한 주소지로 등기우편을 통하여 발송해 드립니다. 이 경우 등기우편요금은 수신자 부담으로 하게 되오니 유념하시기 바랍니다.
  4. 당사는 위2항 본문에 따른 구직자의 반환 청구에 대비하여 채용 여부가 확정된 날로부터 180 일간 구직자가 제출한 채용서류 원본을 보관하게 되며, 그때까지 채용서류의 반환을 청구하지 아니할 경우에는 『개인정보 보호법』에 따라 지체 없이 채용서류 일체를 파기할 예정입니다.
  5. 단, 위 1항 내지 4항의 내용은 대한민국의 노동 관계 법령이 적용되는 경우에만 적용됩니다. 그 이외의 경우에는 적용되지 않습니다.

반드시 첨부된 ‘사내공모지원서 양식’을 작성 후 제출하여 주시기 바랍니다.

Please complete the attached Internal Transfer Request Form and submit.

반드시 쿠팡 이메일 계정으로 지원해 주시기 바랍니다.

Please make sure to apply with your Coupang e-mail address.

title: Vastaanottovirkailija, Inari, Lappi
location: Helsinki, Oulu, Rovaniemi, Tampere, Turku, Finland
description:
Vastaanottovirkailija Inariin – tervetuloa pohjoisen sesonkiin!

Kaipaatko talveen maisemanvaihdosta, kansainvälisiä asiakkaita ja työpäiviä, joissa revontulet voivat olla osa työmatkaa?

Etsimme Inariin hotellin vastaanottovirkailijaa talvisesongille 2026–2027!

Tässä työssä olet hotellin käyntikortti. Vastaanotossa kohtaavat matkailijat eri puolilta maailmaa, ja sinun tehtäväsi on varmistaa, että jokainen vieras tuntee itsensä tervetulleeksi – heti ensimmäisestä hymystä lähtien.

Mitä työ pitää sisällään?

- asiakkaiden vastaanotto ja uloskirjautumiset
- varausten käsittely ja muutokset
- asiakkaiden neuvonta ja palvelu paikan päällä sekä puhelimitse ja sähköpostitse
- hotellin varaustietojen ja järjestelmien päivittäminen
- yhteistyö muun hotellihenkilökunnan kanssa
- vastaanoton sujuvasta arjesta huolehtiminen

Etsimme sinua, jos

Olet iloinen, ulospäinsuuntautunut ja aidosti asiakaspalvelusta innostuva tyyppi. Sinulla on jo kokemusta hotellin vastaanotosta ja tiedät, että vastaanotossa ei aina mennä käsikirjoituksen mukaan – silloin ratkaistaan, hymyillään ja homma hoidetaan.

Sinulta toivomme:

- 2–5 vuoden kokemusta hotellin vastaanottotyöstä
- sujuvaa suomen ja englannin kielen taitoa – nämä ovat tehtävässä pakolliset
- muiden kielten osaaminen katsotaan eduksi
- hotellien varausjärjestelmien tuntemusta
- reipasta ja itsenäistä työotetta
- hyviä vuorovaikutus- ja asiakaspalvelutaitoja
- valmiutta työskennellä vaihtelevissa työvuoroissa

Sesonki alkaa, kun pohjoinen herää talveen

Työt alkavat marras–joulukuussa 2026 ja jatkuvat sesongin loppuun saakka, arviolta maalis–huhtikuulle 2027.

Tämä on loistava mahdollisuus ottaa talveksi suunnaksi Inari, työskennellä kansainvälisten matkailijoiden parissa ja kartuttaa kokemusta yhdestä Suomen kiinnostavimmista matkailualueista.

Majoitus järjestyy

Ei tarvitse stressata talvikodin löytämisestä! Työntekijöille on tarjolla yhteismajoitus maltilliseen hintaan.

Ahkera tarjoaa

- mielenkiintoisen sesonkityön Lapin matkailun ytimessä
- kansainvälisen työympäristön
- yhteismajoituksen maltilliseen hintaan
- Ahkeran tuen koko työsuhteen ajan
- mahdollisuuden kartuttaa arvokasta kokemusta Lapin matkailusesongista

Laita hakemus tulemaan ja lähde talveksi Inariin!
Ehkä seuraava asiakas kysyy sinulta, missä revontulet näkyvät parhaiten.

Otathan huomioon, ettemme käsittele sähköpostitse saapuvia hakemuksia tietoturvasyistä.

Ahkera Crew on maanläheinen ravintola-alan ammattilaisten henkilöstönvälityspalvelu ja kohtaamispaikka. Vankkaa osaamistamme ovat sekä henkilöstövuokraus että suorarekrytoinnit. Alalla, jossa henkilökuntatarpeet saattavat vaihtua hyvinkin nopealla aikataululla, vaivaton toimintamalli ja tuttu asioiden hoitaja ovat Ahkera Crewn ehdoton vahvuus. Kauttamme pääset vaivattomasti osaamistasi vastaaviin työtehtäviin mielenkiintoisissa paikoissa tai löydät juuri oikean tekijän tarpeeseesi. Palvelemme sekä työntekijää että työnantajaa – henkilökohtaisesti. Meillä ymmärretään, että liiketoiminnan perusta on ihmiset.

title: Sairaanhoitaja
description:
Sairaanhoitaja, Kotisairaanhoito Elsa Oy

Kotisairaanhoito Elsa Oy hakee joukkoonsa sairaanhoitajaa määräaikaiseen työsuhteeseen.

Tehtävästä:

Työskentelet kotihoidon asiakkaiden parissa vastaten heidän sairaanhoidollisesta hoidostaan ja hyvinvoinnistaan. Olet osa tiimiä, jossa työskentelee neljä sairaanhoitajaa vastaten yhdessä asiakkaidemme hoidosta, palvelusta ja laadusta. Tiimissä tuemme toinen toistamme, ja sairaanhoitajien tukena toimii kaksi yksikön päällikköä.

Työhön kuuluu:

Omien asiakkaiden vastuusairaanhoitajana toimiminen
