title: Traveling Field Supervisor - Low Voltage
description:
Low-Voltage and IT Systems — New Construction and Existing Facilities

We are looking for a Traveling Field Operations Supervisor with experience in low-voltage, data, voice, wireless, CCTV, and access control within the senior living, MDU, and mid-rise commercial construction fields. This is a supervisory/leadership position.

Working alongside our internal project management teams, this supervisor will lead field crews delivering low-voltage structured cabling, wireless networks, phone systems, CCTV, access control, and IPTV systems — across both commercial new construction and active senior living facilities. Strong leadership is essential: you will work directly with construction superintendents, project managers, and IT directors to drive projects forward on schedule. You will read and work from construction drawings and network topology plans, maintain detailed documentation of tasks, punch lists, timelines, and milestones, and perform quality assurance inspections throughout each project phase. At completion, you will compile and deliver a comprehensive closeout package to the customer.

This position is based in Phoenix, Arizona. Because our senior living community portfolio spans the country, the role requires approximately 50% nationwide travel. Dual Path will cover all related travel expenses (air travel, rental car, and accommodations).

An ideal candidate will have at least 10 years of experience and proficiency in the following areas:

Essential Duties:

  • The primary role of this position is to function as a supervisor for on-site low-voltage installation crews on multiple projects in multiple locations concurrently
  • Projects will consist of new construction builds and network installation, with the low-voltage/systems installations being conducted in different phases until completion
  • Oversee strict project timelines to ensure the installation crews are on track with construction phases, deadlines, and milestones
  • Coordinate with onsite construction superintendents, customer project management, IT Directors, and internal project management teams
  • Interpret and work from construction drawings, as-builts, and network topology plans to guide installation activities
  • Perform quality control inspections on the low-voltage/systems installations to ensure compliance with industry standards, best practices, and design plans
  • Document man-hours, workflow, and progress throughout the lifecycle of each project
  • Conduct site surveys for ISP circuit deliveries, conduit pathways, site work, and new prospective projects
  • Resolve issues through the proper means and channels to guarantee project success
  • Compile and deliver comprehensive project closeout documentation to the customer upon project completion

Low-Voltage Skills:

  • Cat3, Cat6 commercial structured cabling installation
  • Cat3 riser commercial structured cabling installation
  • Cat3, Cat6 110/66 termination, certification, and troubleshooting
  • RG6, RG11 coaxial cabling installation, termination, and testing
  • MM and SM fiber-optic commercial structured cabling installation
  • MM and SM fiber-optic splicing, termination, and testing
  • MDF/IDF racking build-out and dressing
  • Ladder rack and cabling support systems
  • EMT/PVC conduit pathway requirements for facility trunk and drop cabling
  • PVC underground conduit pathway requirements for facility trunk cabling and entry point
  • Pedestal, hand-hole, man-hole pathway requirements for facility trunk cabling and entry point
  • Extensive knowledge of proper structured cabling practices for new construction including wood and concrete/steel structures
  • Knowledge of EIA/TIA, BICSI, and NEC standards
  • Knowledge of telecommunications, electrical, and building codes
  • Knowledge of senior living/multi-family/MDU/commercial facilities

Systems Implementation Skills:

  • Wireless Access Point deployments, testing, and heat-mapping
  • WAN/LAN network equipment deployments
  • CCTV indoor/outdoor camera installation and testing
  • Construction site cellular CCTV solar/battery pole installation and testing
  • Access Control card readers, door strikes, ADA, and intercom installation
  • FTTx carrier-based fiber-optic deployments
  • IPTV system deployment, configuration, and testing
  • VoIP / phone system installation and configuration
  • IoT and energy management systems

Personal Skills:

  • Detail-oriented with a keen eye for proper installation methods
  • Problem solver with the ability to properly manage issues as they arise
  • Natural ability to organize and maintain structure within complex projects
  • Great communication skills and the capability to collaborate with multiple teams
  • Deft hand for leadership and supervising installation crews
  • Passionate about low-voltage systems, and construction management
  • Crafty at using internal software, mobile platforms, and applications

title: Sygeplejersker til Hjemmeplejen Nord
description:
Hjemmeplejen Nord søger sygeplejersker fra 1. november 2026 og 1. januar 2027

Har du lyst til at prøve kræfter med hjemmesygeplejen, så er det nu du har muligheden for at blive en del af Team Sygepleje i Hjemmeplejen Nord.

Hjemmesygeplejen er et udfordrende og alsidigt arbejde, hvor du har mulighed for at udvikle dine færdigheder som sygeplejerske.

Brænder du for specifikke områder indenfor sygeplejen, kan du som faglig frontløber få ansvar for at udvikle området, afprøve indsatser og løfte den faglige kvalitet.

Opgaverne i sygeplejen spænder fra lange og komplekse forløb til korte og intensive indsatser.

Uanset om du er erfaren eller nyuddannet sygeplejerske kommer du til at indgå i et team, hvor erfarne kolleger vil hjælpe dig godt til rette og sidemandsoplære dig i nye opgaver.

Hjemmesygeplejersken har i det tværfaglige samarbejde en central rolle med at lede og koordinere indsatserne omkring den enkelte borger. Helt aktuelt arbejder vi meget med indsatserne under I Sikre Hænder, tidlig opsporing og akutsygepleje.

Stillingerne er på 37 timer i dagvagt med begrænset afløsning i aften eller nattevagt. Andet timetal kan aftales på opfordring fra ansøger
Der arbejdes hver fjerde weekend.

Hhv. 1. november 2026 og 1. januar 2027

Hjemmeplejen Nord har mødested på Industrivej 5 i Thisted og er fast arbejdsplads for 35 fastansatte sygeplejersker. Sygeplejen er inddelt i tre geografiske teams – Team Thisted Østby, Team Thisted Vestby og Team Nordthy/Hannæs.

Foruden sygeplejersker består medarbejdergrupperne i de tre teams primært af social- og sundhedshjælpere og social- og sundhedsassistenter.

Vi anvender Cura omsorgsjournal som dokumentationsredskab.

Løn og ansættelsesforhold sker i henhold til gældende overenskomst og efter reglerne om Lokal Løn.

title: Chatbot Developer – Conversational AI
description:
• Chatbot Developer – Remote
  • 100% Remote within USA
  • 9 months contract
  • Must be an employee of TriTech Enterprise Systems
  • Resumes are due by 9/22/2026

TriTech Enterprise Systems (TriTech) is seeking a talented, passionate Chatbot/Conversational AI Developer. This candidate will play a pivotal role in managing current-day chatbot implementations and designing, building, and optimizing our next-generation conversational experiences. In this role:
  • You will bridge the gap between classical NLU systems and modern Generative AI orchestrations
  • You will be responsible for maintaining our robust enterprise foundations while actively driving our migration strategy toward autonomous agent frameworks.
The ideal candidate possesses a deep technical background in the Microsoft conversational ecosystem, a strong understanding of enterprise integration layers, and a passion for delivering seamless, human-like, yet transparent user experiences.

Key Responsibilities:
  • End-to-End Development: Drive the full lifecycle development (from conversational design to production deployment) of scalable chatbots, virtual assistants, and AI agents.
  • Architecture Migration: Maintain and optimize our current Azure Bot Framework SDK v4 stack while actively participating in the architectural migration toward Microsoft Foundry and Agents 365 Azure SDK.
  • Enterprise Integration: Design and implement robust API integrations using MuleSoft as the central enterprise service bus to orchestrate data exchange between conversational front ends and core backend systems, including PeopleSoft and Salesforce.
  • Omnichannel Dialog Management: Author and manage rich, dynamic conversational interfaces using Microsoft Dynamics Adaptive Cards, Knowledge Management systems, and Automation Flows across web, mobile, and messaging channels.
  • Live Chat and Case Management: Build seamless escalation protocols, including live agent handoffs to Salesforce Live Chat and automated ticket routing via Salesforce Case Management APIs.
  • NLU and LLM Orchestration: Integrate Hybrid AI strategies by combining classical NLU (Azure Conversational Language Understanding/CLU) with Large Language Models (Azure OpenAI/GPT) for intelligent intent routing, fallback handling, and contextual content generation.
  • Performance Optimization: Analyze conversation logs, containment rates, and intent accuracy metrics using data visualization tools to continuously optimize conversational flows and minimize hallucinations.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner closely with Product Managers, UX Designers, and business stakeholders to translate complex business logic into intuitive user stories and turn technical constraints into delightful user experiences.

Required Experience:
  • 3+ years of dedicated experience in software development with a specialized focus on Conversational AI, NLP/NLU, or LLM agent development.
  • Microsoft Bot Stack Expertise: Deep, hands-on proficiency with Azure Bot Framework SDK v4 (including Waterfall Dialogs, custom middleware, and state management) alongside experience or strong theoretical knowledge of Copilot Studio / Agents 365.
  • Core Backend Skills: Strong programming fundamentals with advanced proficiency in C#, .NET, and JavaScript, combined with frontend capabilities (HTML/CSS) for custom web-chat styling and Adaptive Card rendering.
  • Enterprise Systems Integration: Direct experience working with MuleSoft layers to pull/push data from legacy enterprise platforms like PeopleSoft and CRM systems like Salesforce.

Preferred Experience:
  • Data and State Management: Experience configuring and querying Azure Cosmos DB for storing conversation state, user context, and telemetry logs.
  • Analytics Driven: Familiarity with utilizing Power BI or Azure Application Insights to analyze drop-off points, intent confusion matrices, and chatbot containment metrics.
  • Modern DevOps: Experience defining and maintaining CI/CD pipelines for conversational assets across Dev, Test, and Production environments.
  • Industry Context: Experience implementing conversational solutions within Higher Education or complex, multi-stakeholder enterprise environments is a plus.
  • Soft Skills: Exceptional communication skills with the ability to articulate technical AI constraints to non-technical business stakeholders.

Benefits & Culture:
  • Cutting-Edge Innovation: Be part of a forward-thinking team actively reshaping the digital student and staff experience through advanced AI and Agentic workflows.
  • Impact-Driven Work: Build tools that directly solve user pain points, handling high-volume transactions with immediate real-world impact.
  • Professional Growth: Work in a fast-paced environment that actively supports upskilling in Generative AI, LLM orchestration, and next-generation Microsoft AI technologies.
TriTech is an equal opportunity employer!

title: Client Service Monitor - PT
description:
Hope Mission Statement

The mission of Hope the Mission is to prevent, reduce and eliminate poverty, hunger, and homelessness by offering immediate assistance and long-term solutions.

Position Purpose and Summary

The Client Services Monitor (CSM) works directly on-site and is responsible for keeping participants safe, supporting daily operations, community standards and helping Hope the Mission's Interim Housing programs run smoothly. The CSM plays an important role in creating an environment that is safe, structured, and respectful — one where every participant is treated with dignity and fairness.

This position requires someone who shows up consistently, uses good judgment, and genuinely cares about serving people experiencing homelessness. Many participants in our programs have been through long periods of instability, crisis, and trauma. When a CSM shows up with calm, care, and compassion, it creates a sense of safety and routine that participants can count on as they work toward stable housing.

The CSM reports to the Program Manager or Assistant Program Manager and works alongside site staff to make sure the program runs well, meets contract requirements, and reflects Hope the Mission's values in every interaction.


Primary Duties and Responsibilities

Facility Maintenance and Sanitation

  • Assists with and facilitates routine cleaning of all facility areas to maintain cleanliness, safety, and operational readiness

  • Cleans and disinfects restrooms and shower areas after each use, without exception. Maintains sanitary and safe restroom and sink conditions at all times. Completes deep cleaning of restrooms and common areas.

  • Monitors and maintains hygiene areas and community areas; ensures resources are fully stocked, replenishing as needed.

  • Washes, dries, and prepares towels used for restroom and shower services

  • Monitors laundry rooms, restrooms, and common areas to ensure cleanliness and appropriate use

  • Maintains accurate shower and restroom usage logs

Participant Safety and Monitoring

  • Conducts required wellness checks each shift to ensure participant safety and well-being

  • Monitors participant movement, common areas, and site activity to promote safety and program compliance

  • Conducts routine site walk-throughs and safety checks during assigned shifts

  • Supports contraband control and safety procedures in accordance with agency policy

  • Responds to incidents and emergencies using trauma-informed de-escalation techniques and follows all incident reporting protocols

  • Supports emergency responses — including medical emergencies, overdoses, and evacuations — until leadership or first responders arrive

Participant Services and Engagement

  • Provides direct, respectful assistance to participants, including answering questions, responding to requests, and connecting participants to appropriate staff or resources

  • Assists with participant intake, orientation, and explanation of site guidelines as directed by management

  • Distributes hygiene supplies including soap, shampoo, towels, and related items to participants as needed

  • Supports meal service, supply distribution, and general operational duties as assigned

Documentation and Reporting

  • Completes Daily Activity Reports (DARs) accurately, objectively, and in a timely manner

  • Conducts intake, exit, and case notes in HMIS where applicable

  • Assists with documentation related to participant movements, wellness concerns, or incidents as required

  • Observes and reports safety concerns, maintenance issues, guideline violations, and unusual occurrences to site leadership promptly

Shift Operations

  • Provides support during shift pass-downs and communicates relevant updates between shifts

  • Provides overnight, evening, weekend, or holiday coverage as scheduled

  • Performs other duties as assigned

Transportation (Site Specific)

  • Transports participants to and from established routes and as directed by a supervisor

  • Maintains vehicle cleanliness inside and out at all times

  • Ensures the vehicle has sufficient fuel before and during each shift

  • Completes daily vehicle maintenance checks and reports any issues to the supervisors

  • Logs all mileage accurately and in accordance with departmental procedures

Skills

  • Strong observation and situational awareness skills

  • Trauma-informed communication and de-escalation techniques

  • Ability to maintain professional boundaries with participants

  • Clear, objective, and professional written documentation skills

  • Ability to follow policies, procedures, and chain of command

  • Strong teamwork and communication skills

  • Basic computer and email proficiency

  • Ability to lead with integrity and uphold organizational mission, values, and service philosophy.

  • Ability to cultivate and maintain collaborative relationships with community-based organizations and external service providers. Strong Interpersonal Skills.

  • Maintains professionalism, empathy, and sound decision-making when working in complex or emotionally challenging environments.


Qualifications

  • High school diploma or GED required

  • Previous experience in homeless services, shelter operations or social service preferred

  • Knowledge of trauma-informed care and harm reduction principles preferred

  • Ability to work flexible schedules including nights, weekends, and holidays


Mandatory Requirements

  • Background Screening – Employment is contingent upon the successful completion of background checks as required per worksite.

  • Drug and Alcohol Testing – Candidates must pass pre-employment and ongoing drug and alcohol screenings in accordance with company policy.

  • Motor Vehicle Record (MVR) Check – For roles requiring driving, employment is contingent upon an acceptable driving record.

  • Legal Eligibility to Work – Candidates must provide proof of legal authorization to work in the US.

  • Compliance with Company Policies and HIPAA standards – All employees must comply with company policies, including safety, confidentiality, and conduct standards.


Physical, Demands, Environmental Conditions, Equipment

The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of the job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential job functions. The employee is required to: walk and climb stairs; stand, bend, squat, climb, kneel, and twist on an intermittent or sometimes continuous basis; grasp, push, pull objects such as files, file cabinet drawers, and reach overhead; handle, finger, grasp and feel objects and equipment; reach with hands and arms; be mobile by moving oneself from place to place quickly and easily; repeat various motions with the wrists, hands, and fingers; be able to perform visual activities for (including, but not limited to) administrative and clerical tasks; ability to lift up to 25 lbs.; communicate, receive and exchange ideas, information by means of the spoken and written word; drive vehicles in and around Los Angeles County; be able to enter various buildings that may require climbing stairs; be periodically subjected to outside environmental conditions. The employee may work in proximity to service animals and emotional support animals; use a desktop and/or laptop computer; various office machines. Complete all required forms in personal writing.


Work Environment

The employee may be in contact with individuals and families in crisis who may be ill, using alcohol and drugs, and who may not be attentive to basic personal hygiene, health and safety practices. The employee may experience a number of unpleasant sensory demands associated with the participants’ use of alcohol and drugs, and lack of personal hygiene. The employee must be ready to respond quickly and effectively to many types of situations, including crisis situations and potentially hostile situations. The noise level in the work environment is usually moderate in an office setting. Sometimes work may become stressful when working under pressure or in crisis intervention. .


EEO: HTM (Hope the Mission) provides equal employment opportunities (EEO) to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability or genetics. In addition to federal law requirements, HTM complies with applicable state and local laws governing nondiscrimination in employment in every location in which the company has facilities. This policy applies to all terms and conditions of employment, including recruiting, placement, promotion, recall, transfer, leaves of absence, compensation and training.

HTM will consider qualified applicants with a criminal history pursuant to the California Fair Chance Act. You do not need to disclose your criminal history or participate in a background check until a conditional job offer is made to you. After making a conditional offer and running a background check, if HTM is concerned about a conviction that is directly related to the job, you will be given the chance to explain the circumstances surrounding the conviction, provide mitigating evidence, or challenge the accuracy of the background report. Find out more about the Fair Chance Act by visiting the California Department of Fair Employment and Housing’s Fair Chance Act webpage.

title: Principal Engineer HV OHL - Scotland
description:
Shape the Future of Scotland's Energy Network

At BakerHicks, we're playing a key role in delivering the UK's energy transition. Working alongside our construction colleagues at Morgan Sindall Utility Services, we have experienced significant growth within the Transmission & Distribution sector and continue to secure major framework commissions and infrastructure projects across the UK.

As demand for innovative, sustainable and resilient energy networks increases, we are looking for a Principal Overhead Line (OHL) Engineer to establish and lead our OHL design capability in Scotland. Based in our Motherwell office, this is a unique opportunity to influence the growth of a high-performing team while delivering critical transmission projects ranging from 132kV to 400kV.

Supported by our established OHL teams across England, you'll play a key role in shaping technical excellence, mentoring future talent, and delivering solutions that make a lasting impact on the UK's energy infrastructure.

What You'll Be Doing

As a Principal OHL Engineer, you will provide technical leadership across a portfolio of new-build and refurbishment overhead line projects while helping to grow and develop our Scottish OHL team.

Key responsibilities include:

  • Leading the delivery of detailed OHL design packages from concept through to implementation.
  • Providing technical oversight and ensuring designs meet client, industry and regulatory requirements.
  • Developing and mentoring engineers, supporting their technical and professional growth.
  • Producing and reviewing calculations, technical specifications, reports and design documentation.
  • Delivering consultancy services during feasibility and FEED stages, including client presentations and technical reports.
  • Ensuring compliance with CDM Regulations, health and safety legislation, and sustainability principles.
  • Managing project delivery to meet quality, programme, budget and safety objectives.

About You

We're interested in hearing from people who bring a combination of technical expertise, leadership capability and a collaborative approach. If you don't meet every requirement but believe you could add value to our team, we'd still love to hear from you.

Qualifications

Why Join BakerHicks?

At BakerHicks, we believe great engineering comes from diverse perspectives, inclusive teams and a culture where everyone can thrive. We are committed to creating an environment where people feel supported, valued and empowered to achieve their potential.

You'll benefit from:

title: Tilkaldevikarer til vuggestue og børnehave i Spilophuset
description:
Spilophuset i Hammerum og Gjellerup har fem Børnehuse. Vi er i alt ca. 300 børn og 90 ansatte. Vi er en institutionsleder og fire pædagogiske ledere. Stillingen er som udgangspunkt tilkaldevikariater, men da vi er en stor organisation, kan der opstå mulighed for et længere vikariat.

I Spilophuset arbejder vi tæt sammen i vores teams, hvor du også som vikar, vil have en afgørende rolle i hverdagen. Det er derfor vigtigt, at du kan tage ansvar og arbejde konstruktivt ind i et teamsamarbejde.

Vores værdisæt er: trivsel, fællesskab, faglighed, kommunikation, læring, nærvær, omsorg og anerkendelse. Den ”helt almindelige hverdag” er vigtig for os, og det er her vi skaber kvalitet i vores arbejde med børnene. Vi vægter en høj kvalitet ved at være bevidste om vores relationer til børnene, måden vi taler med dem og måden vi er sammen med dem.

Vores kultur er en uformel men professionel tone. Vi vægter tydelig kommunikation og derfor taler vi om tingene i øjenhøjde. Vi er meget nærværende over for børn og forældre. Det betyder, at når vi er sammen med børnene, er der fuldt fokus på dem og de aktiviteter der er i gang.

Vi er arbejder målrettet med Sprogtrappen som observationsredskab og vi har et tæt samarbejde med både vores AKT og de tværfaglige samarbejdspartnere.

Vi forventer, at du
  • Er omstillingsparat i forhold til at indgå på forskellige stuer og kan kontaktes i åbningstiden
  • Er klar på en dagligdag hvor tingene går stærkt, og hvor det ”at tage en for holdet” er en selvfølge
  • Vil indgå i et professionelt miljø
  • Er nysgerrig på den pædagogiske praksis og arbejdet med småbørn

Løn- og ansættelsesvilkår efter gældende overenskomst og aftale om lokal løndannelse.

Yderligere information
Vil du vide mere om jobbet, er du velkommen til at kontakte pædagogisk leder Christina Bennedsgaard på telefon 93 59 46 50 eller Linda Plougmann på telefon 22 60 98 39.

er onsdag den 5. oktober 2026.

title: Studentermedhjælper – Operations & AI
description:
Vil du arbejde med AI og procesoptimering i praksis – samtidig med at du får indblik i de operationelle processer i en specialiseret virksomhed? Hos Danmarks Skibskredit søger vi en studentermedhjælper til Operations Services, hvor vi ønsker at anvende AI til at reducere manuelle opgaver og styrke vores arbejdsprocesser. Vi søger en studentermedhjælper, som både har lyst til at indgå i den daglige drift og bringe nye kompetencer og perspektiver ind i teamet.

Om Operations Services

Operations Services varetager en række centrale operationelle funktioner inden for blandt andet Trade Services, Cash Management og Loan Administration. Afdelingen sikrer, at finansielle handler gennemføres korrekt, at betalinger håndteres, og at de nødvendige kontroller og processer fungerer i det daglige.

Den daglige drift er en vigtig del af jobbet, fordi den giver dig indsigt i de arbejdsgange, data og kontroller, som en specialiseret finansiel virksomhed bygger på. Den viden skal samtidig danne grundlag for, at du kan bidrage til at optimere vores processer gennem blandt andet anvendelse af AI.

Hvad du kommer til at arbejde med

Du bliver én af fire studentermedhjælpere i et team, der desuden tæller fem fuldtidsansatte. Du får en rolle, der kombinerer operationelle opgaver med udvikling af nye arbejdsgange.

Du vil blandt andet arbejde med:

  • Godkendelse af finansielle handler
  • Udførelse og vedligeholdelse af daglige kontroller
  • Identifikation og implementering af nye muligheder for procesoptimering, herunder anvendelse af SQL, AI-værktøjer og AI-agenter
  • Indhentning af regnskaber og øvrig dokumentation fra vores kunder
  • Ad hoc-opgaver og projekter på tværs af Operations Services og resten af Danmarks Skibskredit.

Vi forestiller os, at du arbejder på kontoret 2-3 dage om ugen, svarende til 15-20 timer. Vi har naturligvis fokus på fleksibilitet i forhold til eksamensperioder og studieplaner.

Vi forestiller dig

Du er i gang med en relevant videregående uddannelse med fokus på data, teknologi, økonomi eller finans og har mindst et par år tilbage af dit studie.

Du er nysgerrig på processer og teknologi og motiveres af at finde smartere måder at løse opgaver på. Du arbejder struktureret og detaljeorienteret med opgaver, hvor præcision er vigtig. Det gælder blandt andet i arbejdet med finansielle handler og større beløb. Samtidig tager du ansvar for dine opgaver og har lyst til både at bidrage til den daglige drift og omsætte dine idéer til løsninger, der fungerer i praksis.

Du har erfaring med AI-værktøjer og AI-agenter og er nysgerrig på, hvordan de kan bruges til at optimere arbejdsgange. Det vigtigste er dog, at du har lyst til at anvende og videreudvikle dine kompetencer hos os.

Samtidig er du socialt anlagt og trives i en organisation, hvor der lægges vægt på vidensdeling, samarbejde og et godt kollegialt fællesskab.

Vi tilbyder

Vi tilbyder et fagligt ambitiøst studiejob, hvor du får et solidt indblik i den daglige drift i en specialiseret finansiel virksomhed og mulighed for at præge, hvordan vi arbejder med AI og procesoptimering i Operations Services.

Du bliver en del af et miljø med høj faglighed, tæt sparring og en uformel omgangstone. Her får du ansvar og frihed i opgaveløsningen og kommer til at arbejde med konkrete løsninger, der kan gøre en reel forskel i hverdagen. Derudover får du mulighed for at blive en del af DS Ung, vores netværk for yngre medarbejdere på tværs af organisationen, og deltage i sociale arrangementer og fredagsbarer. Du får din daglige gang i vores nyrenoverede kontorlokaler på Langebrogade 5 i København.

Interesseret?

Vi ser frem til at modtage din ansøgning, dit CV, din karakterudskrift og øvrige relevante oplysninger hurtigst muligt. Vi afholder løbende samtaler og modtager ansøgninger frem til den 4. oktober.

Har du spørgsmål til stillingen, er du velkommen til at kontakte: Mette Thorgaard, Head of Operations, 22 99 15 77 / met@skibskredit.dk

Om os

Danmarks Skibskredit har siden 1961 ydet lån til den maritime sektor. Vi er højt specialiseret inden for skibsfinansiering og finansierer i dag over 500 skibe for vores kunder globalt. Vi arbejder for at understøtte den globale shippingindustris grønne omstilling og bidrager årligt med 15 % af vores overskud til Den Danske Maritime Fond.

Du bliver en del af en virksomhedskultur, der tager langsigtede beslutninger og lægger vægt på troværdighed, ordentlighed og et højt fagligt niveau. Vores arbejdsmiljø er ambitiøst og uformelt, og et godt samarbejde på tværs af organisationen sikrer en stærk opgaveløsning.

Læs mere om os: eller udforsk vores karriereside: skibskredit.dk/about/career/

title: Senior Software Engineer (m/v/x) - Lemon
description:
Over de Rol

Bij Lemon geloven we dat de beste software oplossingen voortvloeien uit diverse perspectieven. Ben jij een Senior Software Engineer die klaar is om technisch leiderschap te tonen en een cruciale impact te maken? Je neemt de leiding in het ontwerpen en implementeren van complexe, schaalbare en kwalitatieve oplossingen. Je fungeert als een technische ruggengraat en mentor binnen een hecht en zelfsturend team.

Jouw bijdrage

Wij Zoeken Iemand Die Een Proactieve Rol Wil Spelen

  • Leiden van de technische analyse en het oplossen van technische uitdagingen.
  • Ontwerpen, ontwikkelen en implementeren van robuuste en schaalbare software oplossingen, met oog voor de lange-termijn architectuur.
  • Coachen en begeleiden van medior en junior teamleden in hun technische ontwikkeling.
  • Samenwerken in een Agile omgeving en de technische brug slaan tussen het ontwikkelingsteam en de Solution Architecten.
  • Verantwoordelijkheid nemen voor een continue hoge standaard van code kwaliteit, performance en onderhoudbaarheid, en actief de technische visie mee bepalen.
  • Actief kennis delen tijdens lunch & learns en collegiale feedback geven via code reviews of peer reviews.
  • Op de hoogte blijven van en proactief adviseren over nieuwe trends en technologieën om de kwaliteit en efficiëntie van onze oplossingen te verbeteren.

Welke kwaliteiten breng je mee?

Gericht op competenties en potentieel, moedigen we je aan om te solliciteren als je denkt dat je voldoende vaardigheden bezit.

Essentiële Vaardigheden

  • Bewezen vermogen om zelfstandig complexe, grootschalige software oplossingen te ontwerpen, ontwikkelen en implementeren.
  • Diepgaande kennis van meerdere relevante programmeertalen (zoals Java, NodeJS, Angular, React) en ervaring met moderne frameworks en cloud-oplossingen. Ervaring met mobile development (React Native/ Flutter) is een pluspunt
  • Uitstekende probleemoplossende vaardigheden en het vermogen om technische uitdagingen op strategisch niveau aan te pakken.
  • Communicatieve vaardigheden in zowel Nederlands als Engels, met het vermogen om complexe technische concepten helder over te brengen.
  • Sterke mentor- en coachingsvaardigheden.
  • Gedrevenheid om voortdurend te leren en je professionele en technische vaardigheden verder te ontwikkelen.

Aanbevolen opleiding & ervaring

  • Een academische achtergrond in Computer Science, Software Engineering, of een gerelateerd studiegebied. Master niveau is een sterke troef óf een gelijkwaardig niveau bereikt door relevante werkervaring(en).
  • Doorgaans 4-6 jaar ervaring als Software Engineer, liefst in een consultancy-, agency- of binnen een project-gebaseerde omgeving.
  • Rijke ervaring met zowel front-end als back-end ontwikkeling en architectuurprincipes.

Wat we je bieden

  • Waarden: We moedigen een cultuur van respect en open dialoog aan.
  • Flexibiliteit: flexibele werkuren en de mogelijkheid tot thuiswerk om een gezonde balans te ondersteunen.
  • Ontwikkeling: De Lemon Academy staat centraal voor kennisdeling, mentorschap en voortdurende persoonlijke groei.
  • Inclusiviteit: We ondersteunen redelijke aanpassingen in de werkomgeving of - processen zodat jij optimaal kan functioneren.
  • Compensatie: Een all-in salaris pakket dat meegroeit met jouw impact. Dit omvat een flexibel verloningsplan, maaltijdcheques, bedrijfswagen met tankkaart, een performante laptop en een comfortabel gsm-abonnement.
  • Zorg & Welzijn: Een uitgebreide hospitalisatieverzekering en een ambulante verzekering die een breed scala aan medische kosten dekt.
  • Events: Vrijblijvende sociale momenten en teamactiviteiten die openstaan voor ieders voorkeur; zoals onze jaarlijkse skireis, de zomer-bbq, onze Lemon-running-group, een wederkerend padeltoernooi, en nog zoveel meer. Geheel divers, maar allemaal onvergetelijk!

Solliciteren bij

Lemon is een gelijke kansen werkgever. We behandelen alle sollicitaties vertrouwelijk en op basis van competenties. Lemon helpt klanten met hun digitale transformatie projecten, het uitbouwen van een future proof en veilige digitale architectuur en het ontwerpen, bouwen en onderhouden van alle soorten digitale tools. We werken samen met onze klanten op projectbasis of in een Team as a Service model.

www.lemon.be

title: Pædagogisk personale søges til socialpædagogisk botilbud
description:
Brænder du for relationsarbejde og for at gøre en forskel i andre menneskers hverdag? Har du lyst til at indgå i nære relationer, skabe trygge rammer og være en del af et fællesskab, hvor omsorg, respekt og samarbejde er i centrum? Så er du måske vores nye pædagog, pædagogisk assistent eller omsorgsmedhjælper på Eskadronsvej!

Om os

Eskadronsvej er et døgntilbud for 24 borgere fordelt i fire teams. Borgerne bor i egne lejligheder efter Almenboliglovens §105 stk. 4 og modtager støtte efter §85 i Serviceloven. Målgruppen er voksne med varig fysisk og/eller psykisk funktionsnedsættelse i alderen 35–79 år. Støttebehovet varierer, fra overtagende støtte til alle livets forhold til strukturerende samtaler og vejledning.

Vi støtter blandt andet borgerne i personlig pleje, indkøb, økonomi, sundhed, struktur i hverdagen og fritiden. Derudover hjælper vi med at styrke sociale relationer og støtte borgerne i at forstå sig selv og deres samspil med andre.

Vi søger dig, der…

  • er uddannet pædagog, pædagogisk assistent eller omsorgsmedhjælper
  • har lyst til at arbejde tæt på borgerne og skabe trygge, forudsigelige og meningsfulde hverdage i et botilbud
  • kan opbygge og fastholde professionelle relationer gennem nærvær, tydelighed og respekt
  • kan samarbejde med kolleger om den pædagogiske indsats og bidrage konstruktivt til fælles løsninger
  • er tryg ved IT og kan dokumentere det pædagogiske arbejde, så borgernes udvikling og trivsel bliver synlig
  • møder borgere og kolleger med nysgerrighed, refleksion og en anerkendende, ressourcefokuseret tilgang – gerne med humor
  • er indstillet på skiftende arbejdstider og kan arbejde dag- og aftenvagter på hverdage samt hver anden weekend

Vi tilbyder

  • En arbejdsplads i bevægelse – vi udvikler os sammen
  • En meningsfuld hverdag, hvor du gør en forskel
  • Mulighed for faglig indflydelse og medansvar i udviklingen af tilbuddet
  • Faglig sparring, supervision og kompetenceudvikling
  • Engagerede og hjælpsomme kolleger, der løfter i flok

Præsentation af virksomheden

Vi er Næstved Kommunes bo- og støttetilbud til voksne med nedsat funktionsevne og særlige sociale behov. Med ca. 330 medarbejdere og 19 tilbud i og omkring Næstved, støtter vi borgere i at leve livet ud fra deres egne behov, håb og drømme.

Vi arbejder ud fra fællesværdierne:

  • Vi finder vejen sammen
  • Mestre livets vilkår
  • Fokus på livet
  • Et attraktivt sted at bo og leve

Læs mere på

Du kan se job- og personprofilen som pædagog, pædagogisk assistent og omsorgsmedhjælper.

Løn og ansættelsesvilkår sker i henhold til gældende overenskomst indgået mellem KL og relevante faglige organisation.

title: Development Lead
description:
Capio Group is looking for an experienced Development Lead!

Full-time employee - Sacramento
Salary: $125,000 - $135,000

About Us:

Capio Group is a California-based Information Technology Consulting firm serving the public sector since 2010. We assist the Government in delivering large, complex systems and solutions. Capio Group is a small, but quickly growing firm that mixes good ideas, with great people, to achieve extraordinary results for our clients. We offer the salary and benefits of the bigger companies, with the added bonus of a flexible workplace and a great work-life balance.

Scope of Work:

Capio Group is looking for an experienced Development Lead to work as part of the team supporting a large-scale information technology modernization initiative to replace an approximately 30-year-old legacy system. The existing solution uses a PowerBuilder application with an Oracle database and supports the appointment and regulation of notaries public as well as the processing of Apostilles. The new solution will be a modern, cloud-based platform designed to digitize and streamline these services while supporting secure online capabilities, external integrations, Remote Online Notarization requirements, and future statutory and operational changes. The project encompasses the planning, architecture, design, development/configuration, testing, integration, data migration, implementation, training, stabilization, maintenance, and operational support of the system. The complete solution will include user interfaces, data models and databases, secure integration mechanisms and APIs, re-engineered business processes, system documentation, training materials, and ongoing support mechanisms. Project activities will involve supporting a hybrid Agile implementation delivered through multiple Program Increments, working collaboratively with client business and technical stakeholders, external partners, and other project participants.

The Development Lead will be responsible for tasks including but not limited to:

  • Managing all design, development, integration and implementation tasks, activities and resources.
  • Leading and managing all development activities and ensuring that the solution supports the requirements.
  • Managing all Program Increment tasks and activities.
  • Leading and managing Hybrid agile development efforts to deliver incremental Solution technical requirements, design, configuration, customization, features testing, and implementation.
  • Coordinating release content and efforts based on the backlog, Application Programming
    Interfaces (API), third-party applications and updates.
  • Managing risks and resolving issues that affect system performance, release scope, schedule, and quality.
  • Coordinating and ensuring satisfactory completion of data migration, data integration, security, testing and all other areas with the respective Contractor and the client Leads for these areas.
  • Planning and managing all development and release activities.
  • Managing configuration management methodologies, technologies and needs.
  • Overseeing and ensuring that documentation of key information, such as build and release procedures, dependencies, and defect fixes are reflected and documented accurately in the appropriate Deliverables documentation.
  • Leading the day-to-day activities of the technical staff who are engaged in the technical development and management of the Solution.
  • Managing technical resources to ensure that all technical issues are resolved.
  • Assessing proposed design alternatives based on all identified constraints, such as cost, schedule, usability, and reliability.
  • Developing solution components that protect Solution and data by establishing policies, practices, and tools that prevent unauthorized access, unauthorized use, unauthorized disclosure, unauthorized modification, or disruption.
  • Developing and delivering the Solution security design and overseeing implementation of security roles, separation-of-duties analysis rules, security role provisioning solutions, and application security scanning.
  • Ensuring security-related solution functions comply with the Contract requirements.
  • Managing the creation and maintenance of user accounts, and roles, as well as managing role hierarchy, function security policies, data security policies, and provisioning.
  • Managing security features, such as encryption and masking of sensitive data like credit card information, PII, and bank account numbers.
  • Identifying and resolving weaknesses and vulnerabilities in the Solution.
  • Performing security and penetration testing of all infrastructure and application components.
  • Creating the security test plan for infrastructure and all application components. Mapping security test plan items to NIST controls in conjunction with the client.
  • Coordinating Contractor’s response to information security vulnerabilities, incidents, breaches, audit requests and reporting.\
  • Providing the security implementation plan and architecture topology in advance of code deployment.
  • Working with the client to ensure that all security configurations and policies are in place.
  • Working with the Test Lead to ensure that all security testing, including penetration testing of all infrastructure and application components are in compliance with requirements.
  • Planning and leading implementation of accessibility standards, ensuring compliance with Web Content Accessibility Guidelines (WCAG) 2.2 meeting AA standards, Section 508 of the United States Rehabilitation Act, and Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA) guidelines.
  • Participating in design sessions with various team members to ensure that accessibility requirements and considerations are taken into account early in the design process.
  • Collaborating with Contractor developers on accessibility principles, solution development, code review, issue remediation, and best practices, including but not limited to, providing resources and leadership on accessible design, color contrast, error handling, usage of Accessible Rich Internet Applications (ARIA) attributes, document accessibility and testing.
  • Actively participating in all aspects of the software development lifecycle (SDLC), and resolving accessibility issues from design, development, testing and through deployment.
  • Leading accessibility audits of the design and solution, identifying accessibility issues, areas for improvement, and recommending appropriate fixes.
  • Leading automated and manual accessibility testing, in collaboration with the Test Lead, to test tools utilized by people with disabilities, including but not limited to keyboard navigation, screen reader testing, semantics testing, color contrast, focus, reading order, alternative text, language, and reading level.
  • Developing reports and logging defects with detailed findings, including the type of violation, references to WCAG guidelines and other applicable laws, screenshots, severity levels, and recommendations for remediation.
  • Performing regression testing to ensure accessibility bug fixes and documenting the results.
  • Coordinating activities with designers, developers, users, project managers, stakeholders and providing guidance on accessibility best practices and techniques, including the applicable laws and regulations, to ensure that accessibility is considered and implemented throughout the project lifecycle.

Mandatory Experience:

  1. Within the last ten (10) years, must have at least three (3) years of experience as the Development Lead or similar lead role/title on one or more ***Qualifying Software Solution implementation projects.
    ***A Qualifying Software Solution must meet all of the following attributes:
    • At least five million dollars ($5M) in Information Technology software contract cost in development and implementation, excluding maintenance and operations;
    • A solution that can accommodate at least twenty (20) internal end users;
    • A solution that provides a public website with at least one hundred thousand (100,000) external user logins;
    • A solution that manages highly confidential data and Personal Identifying Information; and
    • A solution that provides a secure data exchange interface with external system(s).
  2. Within the last ten (10) years, must have at least three (3) years of experience on a ***Qualifying Software Solution managing an agile or hybrid agile software development or similar agile development methodology.
    ***A Qualifying Software Solution must meet all of the following attributes:
    • At least five million dollars ($5M) in Information Technology software contract cost in development and implementation, excluding maintenance and operations;
    • A solution that can accommodate at least twenty (20) internal end users;
    • A solution that provides a public website with at least one hundred thousand (100,000) external user logins;
    • A solution that manages highly confidential data and Personal Identifying Information; and

Capio Group is a California-based Information Technology Consulting firm serving the public sector since 2010. We assist the Government in delivering large, complex systems and solutions. title: CNC-operatör
description:
Vi är ett specialsnickeri som i mer än 40 år har tillverkat specialinredningar. Hos oss kombineras det traditionella hantverksarbetet med senaste produktionsmetoderna för CAD/CAM. Vår styrka ligger i den långa erfarenheten samt en hög teknisk kompetens inom inredningsbranschen.

Våra kunder befinner sig främst inom den offentliga miljön med krav på exklusiva designade inredningar. Genom åren har vi varit med och levererat inredning till flera prisbelönta projekt inom branschen, vilket vi är mycket stolta över!

Som CNC-operatör hos oss ansvarar man för att ställa in rätt program och montera rätt verktyg, köra och övervaka CNC-maskinen. De komponenter som tillverkas skall sedan vidare ut i snickeriet för vidare bearbetning/sammansättning. Typiska arbetsuppgifter innebär att läsa ritningar och kapnotor, montera rätt verktyg, ställa in maskinen för material och dimensioner. Lättare underhåll av maskin och verktyg.

Vi söker dig som har relevant utbildning eller arbetslivserfarenhet som CNC-operatör.

Arbetstider: dagtid, måndag till fredag.

Intervjuer och urval kommer ske löpande varför vi önskar din ansökan så snart som möjligt.

title: Postdoc i børns læsekultur på folkebiblioteker
company: Arts - Institut for Kommunikation og kultur
description:
Afdelingen for Litteraturhistorie og Retorik ved Institut for Kommunikation og Kultur på Aarhus Universitet søger en postdoc i børns læse- og skrivekultur på folkebiblioteker. Postdoc-stillingen er tilknyttet projektet ”Fælles fortællinger. Litterære fællesskaber på biblioteker som vej til øget trivsel og handlemod for udsatte børn”, der er støttet af VELUXfondens HUMpraxis midler.

Postdoc-stillingen er en fuldtids- og tidsbegrænset stilling på 24 måneder. Stillingen er ledig til besættelse pr. 1. april 2027 eller snarest muligt derefter.

Institut for Kommunikation og Kultur støtter en mangfoldig arbejdsplads og opfordrer alle kvalificerede ansøgere til at søge stillingen uanset personlig baggrund.

Projektet

Postdoc-stillingen er knyttet til projektet ”Fælles Fortællinger”, der sætter børn i alderen 10-12 år i centrum for en undersøgelse af fællesskaber omkring fortællinger på biblioteker. Projektet bidrager med grundforskning i børns egne opfattelser af deres læse- og skrivekultur, og i hvilken grad deltagelse i aktiviteter omkring fortællinger kan styrke deres handlemod og deltagelsesmuligheder, særligt når det gælder børn i udsatte positioner. Projektet finder sted i et samarbejde mellem Aarhus Universitet, Aarhus Kommunes Biblioteker og VIA University College.

Postdoc-stillingen

Denne postdoc forventes at indgå som led i et forskerteam på fire forskere og skal udføre det ene af i alt fire delprojekter. Dette delprojekt skal overordnet generere viden om, hvordan børn oplever fællesskaber på biblioteket gennem bibliotekets aktiviteter i forbindelse med det overordnede projekt. Fokus skal være på, hvordan aktiviteter og oplevelser er knyttet til børnenes eksisterende læsekultur, på børns oplevelse af egen indflydelse og på de relationer og fællesskaber, som opstår ved både at skrive, læse og opleve fortællinger sammen. Postdoc’en skal tilrettelægge og gennemføre en kvalitativ, empirisk undersøgelse af ovenstående med udgangspunkt i aktiviteter under ”Fælles Fortællinger” og formidle den indsamlede viden i forskningsartikler og formidlingssammenhænge, samt deltage i relevante forskningsaktiviteter med øvrige projektdeltagere.

Kvalifikationer

Ansøgere skal have en ph.d. eller skal kunne dokumentere tilsvarende kvalifikationer inden for et relevant område som er knyttet til studiet af børns tekster og medier, litteratur- eller medievidenskab og/eller litteraturdidaktik.

Ansøgere skal kunne dokumentere følgende, med relevans for stillingen:
  • en internationalt orienteret forskningsprofil inden for et eller flere af ovennævnte felter
  • en innovativ ph.d.-afhandling eller tilsvarende publikationer på et område, der er inden for området eller tæt relateret til og relevant for projekterfaring med selvledelse af og bidrag til forskningsprojekter
  • kommunikative og sociale færdigheder, der vil gøre den kommende postdoc i stand til at engagere sig produktivt både i forskerholdet og med eksterne organisationer og institutioner.

Desuden anses det som en fordel, hvis ansøgere kan dokumentere:
  • forskningspublikationer af høj international standard, der svarer til det forventelige set i forhold til længden af ansøgerens akademiske karriere
  • viden om børns og unges tekster, medier og mediebrug
  • erfaring med indsamling af empirisk materiale blandt børn i projektets målgruppe
  • udlandsophold på et eller flere internationalt anerkendte forskningsinstitutioner.

OBS: Ansøgninger uden vedlagte publikationer (højst to) vil ikke blive taget i betragtning.

Arbejdsmiljø

Vi lægger vægt på gode samarbejdsrelationer, og vi forventer, at ansøgeren bidrager aktivt til et positivt, inkluderende og samarbejdsorienteret arbejdsmiljø samt deltager i styrkelsen af kollegiale og faglige fællesskaber. Vi forventer derfor, at medarbejderne er regelmæssigt og engageret til stede på instituttet. Vi respekterer balancen mellem arbejdsliv og privatliv og tilstræber at skabe et arbejdsmiljø, hvor denne balance kan opretholdes.

Aarhus Universitet tilbyder et udviklingsprogram for yngre forskere rettet mod karriereudvikling for postdocs på AU.

Da der indgår indsamling af empiri blandt dansktalende børn, forventes en kommende postdoc at være dansksproget.

Afdelingen/enheden

Tjenestestedet er Center for Børns Litteratur og Medier, Afdeling for Litteraturhistorie og Retorik, Langelandsgade 139, 8000 Aarhus C.
Potentielle ansøgere henvises til afdelingens hjemmeside.

Institut for Kommunikation og Kultur

Instituttet hører under Faculty of Arts. Yderligere information om instituttet, forskningsprogrammerne, afdelingerne og forskellige aktiviteter findes på instituttets hjemmeside.

Kontakt

For yderligere information om stillingen, kontakt venligst projektlederen/PI, Nina Christensen, nc@cc.au.dk

Hvis du har behov for hjælp i forbindelse med at uploade din ansøgning, eller spørgsmål vedrørende rekrutteringsprocessen, er du velkommen til at kontakte Arts HR-support: hsi@au.dk

Ansøgningen udfærdiges på dansk.

Der vil i forbindelse med ansættelsen blive indhentet børneattest, da stillingen indebærer direkte kontakt med børn under 15 år. Ansættelsen er betinget af en tilfredsstillende børneattest.

Kvalifikationskrav

Ansættelse som postdoc forudsætter videnskabelige kvalifikationer på ph.d.-niveau.

Formalia
  • Ansættelsesproceduren er yderligere beskrevet i ministeriets Bekendtgørelse om ansættelse af videnskabeligt personale ved universiteter.
  • Vedrørende kvalifikationskrav og stillingsindhold henvises til stillingsstrukturen.
  • Vedrørende ansøgning og bilag hertil henvises til vejledning for ansøgere til videnskabelige stillinger ved Arts.
  • Ansøgningen skal indeholde en motivation for at søge stillingen og vedlægges et curriculum vitæ, en fuldstændig liste over publicerede arbejder, relevante eksamenspapirer og videnskabelig produktion (maksimalt i alt 2 arbejder). Dette materiale fremsendes elektronisk i forbindelse med ansøgningen.

Hvis ikke andet er angivet i stillingsopslaget skal ansøgningen udfærdiges på engelsk. Ansøgningsfristen er kl 23.59 dansk tid.

Aarhus Universitet vil være en attraktiv og inspirerende arbejdsplads for alle og ønsker en kultur, hvor hver enkelt kan udfolde og udvikle sig. Vi ser ligestilling og diversitet som en ressource og opfordrer derfor alle interesserede til at ansøge.

Der kan benyttes shortlisting til at udvælge kandidater, der skal gå videre til en udfoldet faglig bedømmelse. Udvælgelsen sker ved et udvalg nedsat af institutlederen. Se her for yderligere information om shortlisting på Arts:

Løn og ansættelsesvilkår

Ansættelse sker i henhold til overenskomst mellem Finansministeriet og AC.

Løn- og ansættelsesvilkår følger overenskomsten for akademikere i staten. Du ansættes som postdoc i basisløntrin 4-8 med tillæg efter protokollat om visse ansættelsesvilkår for videnskabeligt personale ved universiteter.

Stillingsindhold og kvalifikationskrav er yderligere beskrevet i cirkulære om ansættelsesvilkår for videnskabeligt personale ved universiteter.

Om Arts

Faculty of Arts er et af Nordeuropas væsentligste fakulteter for forskning og videregående uddannelse inden for humaniora, teologi og pædagogik. Inden for denne faglige bredde huser fakultetet omkring 700 forskere, 200 ph.d.-studerende, 9.000 bachelor- og kandidatstuderende og 1.500 efter- og videreuddannelsesstuderende. Vi tror på, at de bedste idéer opstår i mødet mellem forskellige perspektiver – og at forskning, undervisning og innovation udvikles bedst i dialog med samfundet omkring os.

Du kan finde mere information her Faculty of Arts | Aarhus Universitet

Ansøgning sendes via Aarhus Universitets rekrutteringssystem, som kan tilgås under stillingsopslaget på Aarhus Universitets hjemmeside.

Als Java Back-end Developer ben jij verantwoordelijk voor de technische invulling van diverse softwareprojecten en draag je bij aan de groei en innovatie van onze systemen. Je werkzaamheden zijn zeer gevarieerd, met focus op zowel ontwikkeling als onderhoud. Jouw taken en verantwoordelijkheden omvatten:

  • Meedenken met de analist over mogelijke oplossingen voor technische vraagstukken.
  • Verantwoordelijkheid voor het technische design van applicaties en het ontwikkelen van gevraagde functionaliteiten.
  • Het opzetten van automatische testen om zowel functionele als regressietesten uit te voeren en goed functioneren van de software te waarborgen
  • Het operatief opvolgen en oplossen van incidenten samen met je team.
  • Technische analyse en het schrijven van user tests, inclusief Postman tests voor integratieprojecten.
  • Ondersteunen van onderhoudsactiviteiten door het onderzoeken en oplossen van incidenten.
  • Het beheer van de levenscyclus van bestaande technologieën en zorgen voor updates naar de laatste versies.
  • Begeleiden van het team in het opzetten en onderhouden van standaarden, met name voor event-driven architectuur.

Iets voor jou?

  • Je beschikt over minimaal een bachelordiploma of gelijkwaardige ervaring in softwareontwikkeling.
  • Je hebt ruime ervaring als Java Back-end developer (met Java 17/21) en hebt gewerkt met RESTful API’s. Daarnaast heb je ervaring met event-driven architectuur, wat jou in staat stelt om innovatieve oplossingen te creëren voor complexe vraagstukken.
  • Je hebt uitstekende kennis van Spring Framework en hebt gewerkt met GIT, Maven, Github Actions, en Helm.
  • Je hebt ervaring met het schrijven van unit- en integratietests (bijv. JUnit, Mockito, Testcontainers, Postman).
  • Je bent bekend met Docker, Kubernetes, Azure Cloud en het werken met Hexagonal/N-tier architectuur.
  • Je drukt je vlot uit in het Nederlands en hebt een goede beheersing van het Engels.

Waarom kiezen voor Acerta?

Hier ben jij onze grootste troef. Je krijgt de ruimte om op jouw unieke manier je stempel te drukken in HR digitale journey. En dat in een team waar iedereen er 100% samen voor gaat. Uiteraard kan je op heel wat meer rekenen:

  • State- of the art technologie
  • Dankzij gerichte opleidingen kan je groeien in je job en investeren we samen in je professionele en persoonlijke ontwikkeling.
  • Je krijgt een contract van onbepaalde duur (37,5u) met flexibele werkuren en 40 betaalde verlof- en feestdagen (waarvan 29 vrij te kiezen).
  • Je hebt de mogelijkheid om thuis te werken met een forfaitaire thuiswerkvergoeding van €120,88 netto/maand.
  • Een bedrijfswagen + nationale laadkaart behoren ook tot jouw loonpakket.
  • Daarnaast krijg je maaltijdcheques van €8/dag, ecocheques van €205 en cadeaucheques van €40 op jaarbasis.
  • We bieden jou een uitgebreid verzekeringspakket: een hospitalisatieverzekering (uitbreidbaar naar gezinsleden) en een groepsverzekering (pensioenspaarplan, overlijdensdekking en verzekering gewaarborgd inkomen bij langdurige ziekte).
  • Via ons cafetariaplan stel je jouw eigen loonpakket samen. Je krijgt de mogelijkheid tot het leasen van een fiets, aankoop van een smartphone of tablet, terugbetaling van een GSM-abonnement of internet thuis etc.

title: Apprentice People Services Assistant
description:
About THG Ingenuity

THG Ingenuity is a fully integrated digital commerce ecosystem, designed to power brands without limits. Our global end-to-end tech platform is comprised of three products: THG Commerce, THG Studios, THG Fulfilment.

Each represents a single, unified solution, overcoming challenges and taking brands direct-to-consumer. Our client portfolio includes globally recognised brands such as Coca-Cola, Nestle, Elemis, Homebase, and Proctor & Gamble.

About the People Team and the role

The People Team supports the full employee journey at THG Ingenuity, from attracting and welcoming new colleagues through to development, payroll, employee relations and leaving the business.

As an Apprentice People Services Assistant, you will join our People Services team and gain practical experience across a wide range of people administration activities. You will work closely with experienced colleagues, managers and employees, developing your knowledge of HR systems, processes and employment practices while completing your apprenticeship.

This is an excellent opportunity for someone who is organised, approachable and keen to build a career in HR.

As an Apprentice People Services Assistant, you will:

  • Support the People Services team with day-to-day HR administration.
  • Help collect and check new starter information and documentation.
  • Support the onboarding and induction process for new employees.
  • Maintain accurate electronic employee records and personnel files.
  • Assist with monitoring probation periods and preparing relevant reports.
  • Help respond to general queries from managers and employees, escalating more complex questions when needed.
  • Support the leaver process, ensuring information is recorded accurately and on time.
  • Assist with preparing resignation confirmations and other employee correspondence.
  • Support the preparation of change of terms letters, ensuring information is accurate and approved.
  • Update the HR system to reflect changes to employee information, reporting lines and organisational structures.
  • Assist with processing employment contracts through the appropriate approval process.
  • Help ensure contracts are issued and signed through the DocuSign portal.
  • Learn how different templates and processes apply across countries, departments, roles and acquired businesses.
  • Support regular checks to ensure documents have been returned, signed and filed correctly.
  • Assist with the preparation of weekly international payroll information.
  • Work collaboratively with colleagues and stakeholders across our international locations.
  • Develop a strong understanding of HR systems, including Frontier Software.
  • Support the wider People Team with projects and administrative tasks as required.
  • Take responsibility for completing your apprenticeship work and applying your learning in the workplace.

What skills and experience do I need?

We are looking for someone who is enthusiastic about starting a career in HR and is willing to learn. You do not need previous HR experience, but you should be able to demonstrate:

  • A genuine interest in people, HR and business administration.
  • A positive attitude and willingness to learn.
  • Good organisation skills and attention to detail.
  • The ability to manage tasks and meet deadlines.
  • Clear and professional communication skills.
  • The confidence to ask questions and seek guidance when needed.
  • The ability to work effectively as part of a team.
  • A discreet and confidential approach when handling personal information.
  • Basic IT skills, including Microsoft Office.
  • The ability to review information carefully and identify errors or missing details.
  • A practical and proactive approach to problem-solving.

What you will learn

During your apprenticeship, you will develop experience and knowledge in:

  • HR administration and employee lifecycle processes.
  • Recruitment, onboarding and leaver administration.
  • Maintaining accurate employee data and HR records.
  • HR systems and reporting.
  • Payroll processes and deadlines.
  • Employment documentation and change processes.
  • Providing effective support to managers and employees.
  • Confidentiality, data protection and compliance.
  • Working with stakeholders across different teams and countries.

You will receive support from the People Team throughout your apprenticeship, with regular guidance, feedback and opportunities to build your confidence and develop your career within HR.

THG Ingenuity is proud to be a Disability Confident Committed employer. If you are invited to interview, please let us know if there are any reasonable adjustments we can make to the recruitment process that will enable you to perform to the best of your ability.

THG Ingenuity is committed to creating a diverse & inclusive environment and hence welcomes applications from all sections of the community.

Because of the high volumes of applications our opportunities attract, it sometimes takes us time to review and consider them all. We endeavour to respond to every application we receive within 14 days. If you haven't heard from us within that time frame or should you have any specific questions about this or other applications for positions at THG Ingenuity please contact one of our Talent team to discuss further.

title: VVS-montør til industri og erhverv i Skive
description:
Er du VVS-montør og vil du have firmabil og fast arbejde?

Vi mangler en VVS-montør til industri og erhverv i Skive.

Du lander i en større forsyningshverdag, hvor drift, vedligehold og vandtekniske anlæg fylder mere end almindelige privatopgaver. Arbejdet hænger sammen med både vandforsyning og spildevand, så opgaverne skal løses ordentligt og med respekt for driften. Holdet er fordelt mellem kontor, renseanlæg, vandværker og ledningsnet, så du bliver en del af en arbejdsplads med flere fagligheder tæt på hinanden. Du arbejder i Skive og omegn, og rammerne er stabile.

Det her er for dig, der hellere vil have faste rammer end små korte opgaver. Du skal kunne tage ansvar for dit håndværk, møde stabilt og sige til hvis noget ikke stemmer. Firmabilen er med, og du får en hverdag hvor opgaverne typisk er koblet til drift og erhverv frem for små private servicebesøg.

Det får du

Løn: 200-220 kr. i timen

Firmabil: Ja

Arbejdsområde: Skive og omegn

Kolleger: Cirka 40 ansatte

Overenskomst: Ansat under gældende overenskomst

Ansættelse: Fastansættelse - vi søger folk, vi kan arbejde med i mange år. Ingen korte forløb.

Hverdag: Erhverv, forsyningsdrift og service

Din hverdag

Dagen handler om planlagte VVS-opgaver, vedligehold og praktiske løsninger, hvor driften skal fortsætte. Når en opgave ændrer sig, skal du kunne vurdere næste skridt og få givet besked i tide. Det kræver ro i hænderne og respekt for, at dit arbejde hænger sammen med resten af driften.

Du kommer blandt andet til at arbejde med:

  • Arbejder med VVS-opgaver inden for industri og erhverv
  • Monterer og servicerer vandinstallationer
  • Fejlfinder på tekniske installationer
  • Arbejder med rør, vandforsyning og vedligehold
  • Løser opgaver hvor drift og sikker levering skal hænge sammen

Når arbejdet er koblet til drift, handler det ikke om at skynde sig videre. Det handler om at løse opgaven rigtigt, så anlæg og installationer kan køre videre uden bøvl.

Vi leder efter dig, der kan sætte kryds ved det meste

Du behøver ikke kunne alt. Men du skal kunne arbejde selvstændigt og tage ansvar for dine aftaler.

Vi forestiller os, at du:

  • Har mindst 3 års erfaring som VVS-montør
  • Har kørekort
  • Kan arbejde med opgaver i industri og erhverv
  • Er stabil og møder som aftalt
  • Siger til, hvis noget ikke stemmer

Det er en fordel, hvis du har erfaring med drift, vedligehold eller tekniske anlæg. Men det vigtigste er, at du arbejder ordentligt og kan tage ansvar for det du afleverer.

Allerede i job?

Så skal det selvfølgelig give mening at skifte.

Derfor starter vi med en uforpligtende snak. Du kan høre mere om opgaverne, virksomheden, lønnen og hverdagen, før du beslutter noget. Og ja, det foregår diskret.

Hvis det her lyder som noget for dig, er opstart hurtigst muligt.

Du behøver ikke sende en lang ansøgning. Tryk på Ansøg job, så ringer vi dig op og tager den derfra.

Om PowerMatch

Hos PowerMatch matcher vi dig kun med job, der lever op til dine krav på løn, opgaver, kultur, firmabil og hvad der ellers betyder noget for dig.

Du starter direkte ude i virksomheden. Vi arbejder kun med forløb, hvor målet er fastansættelse. Ikke korte vikariater.

Hvis jobbet ikke viser sig at være det rigtige match, hjælper vi dig videre til noget, der passer bedre.

PowerMatch har 5 stjerner på Trustpilot baseret på 500+ anmeldelser fra håndværkere og fagfolk som dig.

Du optjener point hos PowerMatch, som du kan bruge på 1000+ forskellige gavekort som f.eks Circle K, Elgiganten og oplevelser.

Du får gratis Wolt+, WashWorld og Tv2Play abonnementer.

Du får ét ugentlig spin på vores app, hvor du kan vinde alt fra rejser til elektronik.

Søg uden lang ansøgning

Du behøver ikke skrive en roman.

Tryk Ansøg job, så ringer vi dig op til en kort og uforpligtende snak.

Passer jobbet til dig, går vi videre. Passer det ikke, prøver vi at finde et bedre match.

title: OfferUp: Software Development Engineer II Full Stack – Business (Remote @ Colombia)
description:
Headquarters: Remote @ Colombia

About the role:

The OfferUp Business team owns the platforms that power every business vertical on our marketplace; Storefronts, Auto Dealers, Services, Rentals, and Jobs. Our customers aren’t casually browsing; they’re running businesses on top of what we build, so every feature we ship has a direct, measurable impact on their livelihood and on OfferUp’s revenue. We operate the full stack end-to-end: including microservices that handle some of the highest RPS and TPS in the company, and integrations with partners like Stripe and Shopify. We move fast, instrument everything, and treat experimentation as a first-class part of the workflow. We’ve barely scratched the surface of what these verticals can become, and the roadmap is wide open for someone who wants to help shape it.

At many organizations, your role begins and ends with the code. On our team, we’re different. You own a feature from concept to fruition. Your responsibilities will include everything from writing well architected and thoroughly tested code, to rolling out the feature by analyzing metrics. You also get to take ownership beyond your technical area by working with cross-functional team members.

As a Full Stack Software Engineer II on the Business team, you’ll be a proven contributor who ships features end-to-end across the stack. From the React components our business customers interact with, to the Java services and data pipelines behind them. You’ll take real ownership of the work you deliver, raise the quality of the code around you, and grow into a high-performing, reliable contributor on the team.

Here’s more of what you will get to do:

  • Design, build, and deploy new user experiences and backend services across our five business verticals, using React, TypeScript, GraphQL, Node.js, and Java
  • Own features end-to-end: plan, design, develop, deploy, measure, and iterate
  • Break down complex engineering problems into achievable tasks and deliver them within committed timeframes
  • Work collaboratively with cross-functional teams (Product, Design, Data, Business stakeholders) to design and implement new features
  • Contribute to A/B tests and use experimentation results to decide what ships
  • Actively participate in code reviews and enforce good patterns, testing, and edge-case handling
  • Coach and mentor junior team members, new hires, and interns
  • Create shared components, utilities, and services that improve team velocity across the stack
  • Maintain and improve the runbooks, alerting, and monitoring for the features you ship
  • Participate in a reasonable on-call rotation with the rest of the team
  • Use AI coding tools (Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot, and similar) to increase your daily development velocity and code quality
  • Become a subject matter expert in one or more of the team’s sub-domains

You’ll thrive in this role if you have:

  • 2+ years of professional software engineering experience
  • Demonstrated ability to own the delivery of multiple features end-to-end (plan, design, develop, and deploy) with high efficiency, including breaking down engineering problems into achievable tasks
  • Strong coding skills across the full stack:
    • React, TypeScript, HTML, CSS, and modern web tooling; good grasp of responsive design, performance, and cross-browser compatibility
    • Java and a working understanding of microservices and distributed-systems fundamentals
  • Experience building and integrating with REST or GraphQL APIs
  • Good knowledge of data structures and object-oriented design
  • Hands-on experience using AI coding tools (Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot, or similar) in a real engineering workflow, and a point of view on when they help and when they don’t
  • Follows good coding patterns, writes appropriate tests, considers trade-offs, and actively seeks out edge cases
  • Comfortable giving and receiving feedback in code reviews
  • A bias toward shipping, learning from production, and iterating quickly
  • An insatiable desire and ability to learn
  • BS or MS in Computer Science, or equivalent practical experience

Helpful, but not required:

  • Fluency in any other modern OOO programming language
  • Experience with Agile development
  • Experience with AWS Cloud infrastructure
  • Experience around any of the following: web package managers, Bower, bundler system, NodeJS, Python, webpack
  • Experience with A/B testing platforms (Statsig, LaunchDarkly, Optimizely) and analytics warehouses (BigQuery, Snowflake)
  • Experience consuming or integrating LLM-based APIs (e.g., Bedrock, Vertex AI, OpenAI)
  • Familiarity with AWS cloud infrastructure and CI/CD pipelines
