title: Strategic Partnerships, UK
description:
About Gigs

At Gigs, we're building the operating system for mobile services—a platform that lets tech companies embed global connectivity into their products effortlessly.

Just as Stripe lets any business add a payment button in seconds, Gigs empowers platforms to weave in connectivity—bridging the traditional world of telecom with modern tech. From fintechs launching mobile services to HR platforms offering work phone plans, we automate provisioning and remove telecom complexity.

Our team of around 150 people across the US and Europe, backed by nearly $100 million in funding from Ribbit Capital, Google, and Y Combinator. As one of the fastest-growing tech companies, bringing together early-stage engineers, product builders, and business athletes from companies like Stripe, Airbnb, and Shopify. We’re tackling deep technical and regulatory challenges to make connectivity truly seamless.

If you’re driven by curiosity, creativity, and the chance to shape the future of telecom, we’d love to hear from you.

Things We Care About

We are building in a highly complex space and tackling a massive problem. We want people who lean in when things get hard.

  • Speed. We move and we ship. We set bold deadlines and treat every week like it matters.
  • Ownership. If you see something broken, fix it. We don't wait for permission.
  • Customer Obsession. Our customers' product is our product.
  • Ambiguity. We're building frontier technology in a complex domain. You'll need sound judgement and good instincts to make decisions without complete information.
  • First principles. We don't ask how things have been done before. We ask why they were done that way at all.

The Role

As a senior member of Gigs' UK Partnerships team, you'll lead the charge to land Gigs' next wave of banking and fintech partners in the UK. You'll own a focused list of target accounts end to end and draw on your knowledge of how large institutions actually make decisions to find and close the right partnership opportunities.

What You Will Do

  • Partnership Development: Lead end-to-end conversations with target banks and fintechs, from first outreach through deal structuring and commercial negotiation. Build relationships with decision makers across product, risk and innovation teams at target accounts.
  • Strategic Planning: Build and run the go-to-market plan for landing UK fintechs and banks. Map target accounts, find the right entry points, and design partnership structures that work for both sides.
  • Pipeline Management: Own a focused list of 10 to 20 target accounts end to end. Prioritize based on strategic fit, revenue potential, and how fast a deal can actually move.
  • Commercial Strategy: Structure commercial terms that fit large institutions' procurement and risk processes while protecting Gigs' economics. Work with legal and finance to get deals signed.
  • Cross-functional Leadership: Partner with GTM, Connectivity, and Partner Success to shape what Gigs offers bank partners. Contribute directly to UK&I market strategy, working closely with the market lead on priorities and positioning.
  • Own the number: You carry a revenue target for your account list. Success in your first 18 months looks like 2–3 signed bank or major fintech partnerships, with a qualified pipeline behind them.

What We Are Looking For

  • You're a proven deal-maker: you've closed complex, strategic partnerships with large banks, financial institutions, or fintechs that sell into them. You know how to navigate long enterprise sales cycles and build consensus across stakeholder groups.
  • You carry real commercial weight: 8+ years in enterprise B2B commercial roles, carrying quota or revenue targets, comfortable owning results end to end.
  • You have executive presence: you can walk into a room with C-suite bank executives and hold your own.
  • You're a highly autonomous operator: you thrive as an individual contributor, building your own pipeline without a team to lean on.
  • You think strategically: you can build an account plan, defend it under scrutiny, and adjust it as you learn.
  • You're a builder at heart: you're comfortable operating without a big company machine behind you. You roll up your sleeves, from writing the deck to chasing the signature.
  • Nice to have: a background at a startup that has sold into big banks.
  • Nice to have: existing relationships or insider knowledge of major UK banks.

Work At Gigs

At Gigs, we value in-person collaboration. We believe the best ideas, decisions, and relationships are built when teams spend meaningful time together, and our culture is designed around that belief. We support flexibility where it makes sense. Some focused work can be done remotely, and not every role or week looks the same. You should expect regular time in one of our hubs, as well as occasional travel for team workshops, customer meetings, and Gigs Republic, our bi-annual company off-site. Our offices are designed to feel like home-inspired workspaces, with plants, thoughtful tools, and small, tight-knit teams that make collaboration feel natural, energizing, and effective.

What We Offer

At Gigs, we believe in rewarding excellence. We offer competitive compensation and stock options because we see you as a true partner in our growth. We also provide stipends for your home office or work setup, a budget for learning and development to fuel your career, and of course, a free phone and international data plan

Want to learn more about our benefits, hubs, and what it’s like to work at Gigs? Check out our Careers page.

title: QA Engineer
description:
Scopely is looking for a QA Engineer to join our Royal lounge Casino team in Bangalore on a hybrid basis!

At Scopely, we care deeply about what we do and want to inspire play, every day - whether in our work environments alongside our talented colleagues, or through our deep connections with our communities of players. We are a global team of game lovers who are developing, publishing and innovating the mobile games industry, connecting millions of people around the world daily.

With 30M+ downloads, Grand Casino is home to slots, bingo, cards, and more! Team members are distributed across the globe with hubs in Bengaluru, Tel Aviv, Barcelona, among others

What you will do

  • Write, maintain & execute test cases for studio games on mobile (Android/iOS/Kindle) and web platform covering majority of devices & browsers
  • Conduct functional and non-function testing of Desktop and Mobile applications, including network data and logs
  • Work closely with scrum team, producers and QA lead to make sure submission meets high quality standards
  • Actively communicate with developers and business stakeholders for conducting defect triage and reducing defect age
  • Provide defects root cause analysis along with corrective & preventive action plan
  • Work in agile environment and ensure timely product delivery
  • Provides tradeoffs, risks and risk mitigation strategies
  • Have detailed understanding of studio games covering various corner cases
  • Prepare test documentation to improve the quality of the application

What we are looking for

  • 3+ years of experience in software testing
  • Passionate about gaming and must enjoy playing casual games
  • Good understanding of client-server architecture
  • Familiarity with web and mobile platforms from QA perspective
  • Experienced in test design & execution techniques
  • Experience with these or similar tools — Charles Proxy, Firebug, Fiddler, Jira, Test Rail,Crashlytics
  • Ability to write QA documentation -Test cases, Trainings, Test plans and Basic knowledge of SQL and database concepts
  • Strong exploratory testing skills and knowledge to apply the right level of testing approach and understanding Agile methodologies

At Scopely, we create games for everyone - and want to ensure that the people behind our games reflect that! We are committed to creating a diverse, supportive work environment where everyone is treated with respect. We are committed to providing equal employment opportunities and welcome individuals from all backgrounds to join us & embrace the adventure!

About Scopely

Scopely is a leading video game and global interactive entertainment company, home to many of the world’s most beloved and enduring experiences, including two of the most successful mobile games of all-time “MONOPOLY GO!” and “Pokémon GO,” along with “Stumble Guys,” “Star Trek™ Fleet Command,” “MARVEL Strike Force,” “WWE Champions,” the Scrabble® franchise, “Yahtzee® With Buddies,” and many others. Across mobile, web, PC, and console, Scopely creates, develops, publishes, and live-operates one of the most diversified and award-winning portfolios in the games industry — bringing hundreds of millions of players together through a shared love of play.

Founded in 2011, Scopely is powered by its exceptional team — including thousands of world-class gamemakers around the globe, a distinctive tenet-driven culture, and its proprietary technology platform, Playgami. Together, these strengths have fueled Scopely’s position as the #1 mobile games company in the U.S. and #2 globally, generating more than $10 billion in lifetime revenue. Whether building global sensations like “MONOPOLY GO!” from the ground up, or expanding through strategic acquisitions, including the FoxNext, GSN, and Scopely Explore games businesses — Scopely consistently delivers experiences players love today and return to for years to come.

Recognized multiple times as one of the "100 Most Influential Companies in the World" by TIME magazine and one of Fast Company's "World's Most Innovative Companies" and “Best Workplaces for Innovators,” Scopely believes that video games can be a force for good — creating meaningful connections, vibrant communities, and making life better through play.

Scopely has global operations and partners across four continents in more than a dozen countries worldwide. For more information, visit: .

Notice to Candidates: Scopely will never request payment or financial information during the application or hiring process. Please apply only through our official website and verify that all Talent Partner communications come from an email address ending in @.

Should you have any questions or encounter any fraudulent requests/emails/websites, please immediately contact recruiting@scopely.com. Our job applicant privacy policies are available here: California Privacy Notice and EEA/UK Privacy Notice.

Employment at Scopely is based solely on a person's merit and qualifications. Scopely does not discriminate against any employee or applicant because of race, creed, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity/expression, national origin, disability, age, genetic information, veteran status, marital status, pregnancy or related condition (including breastfeeding), or any other basis protected by law. We also consider qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records, consistent with applicable federal, state and local law.

title: Områdeleder til Dagtilbud Favrskov Nord
description:
Vil du være med til at sætte og forfølge den strategiske retning, der giver børnene i Favrskov Kommune de bedste kort på hånden? Så har vi en ledig plads i områdeledergruppen.

Vi søger en områdeleder til Dagtilbudsområde Favrskov Nord, som vil gå forrest i forhold til at udvikle kvaliteten i den pædagogiske praksis til gavn for børnene, og som kan skabe rum for refleksion og udvikling af den ledelsesmæssige praksis i et relativt nyfusioneret ledelsesteam.

Som områdeleder får du det strategiske og økonomiske ledelsesansvar for området og det overordnede ansvar for den faglige kvalitet og udvikling. Favrskov Nord består af otte institutioner i Voldum, Hadbjerg, Selling, Laurbjerg, Ulstrup, Thorsø og Sall med ca. 450 børn og 115 medarbejdere og har et budget på ca. 48 mio. kr. Du kommer til at lede et team af seks daglige ledere, og du refererer til dagtilbudschefen.

Om jobbet
En vigtig opgave bliver at etablere en fælles retning for lederteamet og udvikle det som et professionelt ledelsesfællesskab, der naturligt sætter teamets kompetencer i spil på tværs af området – med respekt for de daglige lederes ledelsesrum. Du skal sætte rammerne for den faglige ledelse af kvalitet, så de daglige ledere kan understøtte personalet i at skabe trivsel, udvikling og læring for alle børn i området, blandt andet gennem en stærk evaluerings- og læringskultur.

Vi vægter blandt andet, at du:
  • er en tydelig og nærværende leder, der skaber følgeskab gennem dialog, klare forventninger og beslutningskraft
  • har blik for både helheden og hverdagen og trives med at være synlig i alle dine institutioner
  • kan lede udviklingsprocesser med fokus på høj faglig kvalitet, trivsel og inkluderende børnefællesskaber
  • har stærke relationelle kompetencer og samarbejder tillidsfuldt med ledelse, medarbejdere, forældre og bestyrelse
  • har en relevant lederuddannelse og erfaring med ledelse i en politisk styret organisation, gerne fra dagtilbudsområdet.

Hvad tilbyder vi?
Du får et tæt samarbejde med dagtilbudschefen gennem løbende sparrings- og opfølgningssamtaler, og du indgår i et tæt og forpligtende samarbejde med dygtige områdelederkollegaer, blandt andet ved at være med i et læringsnetværk. Du tilbydes desuden dygtig og fleksibel understøttelse fra forvaltningens sekretariat.

Yderligere oplysninger
I job- og personprofilen kan du læse mere om opgaverne, vores forventninger til dine kvalifikationer, vores interne organisering og ansættelsesprocessen, og hvad vi tilbyder dig i denne spændende lederstilling. Se job- og personprofilen her: Områdeleder til Dagtilbudsområdet Favrskov Nord | Favrskov.dk.

Vi opfordrer alle interesserede kandidater til at kontakte dagtilbudschef Charlotte Ørbæk Langballe på 21 43 42 41. Send gerne en SMS, hvis hun ikke svarer. Din henvendelse vil naturligvis blive behandlet fortroligt.

Søg jobbet
Send din ansøgning til Favrskov Kommune senest fredag 16. oktober 2026 via nedenstående link. Du kan se alle ledige stillinger på

Favrskov Kommune kan kun modtage ansøgninger sendt elektronisk. Det er en forudsætning for ansættelsen, at den person, som vi ønsker at ansætte, ikke er straffet for forhold, som gør vedkommende uegnet til at bestride stillingen. Der vil derfor blive indhentet straffeattest på den kandidat, der tilbydes ansættelse.

title: Early Intervention Specialist - Screening
company: Early Learning Coalition of Hillsborough County
description:
POSITION SUMMARY

The Early Intervention Specialist – Screening is primarily responsible for guiding parents and providers through the process of Early Identification and Referrals for Special Needs and provides Individualized Intervention Practices for children in the School Readiness Program. Through the Warm Line, Early Intervention Specialists – Screening serves as subject area experts for families, providers, and community members on how to access support and services in the community for children with suspected or identified delays. The specialist is also responsible for monitoring ASQ’s for developmental concerns. Specialists provide training and technical assistance for childcare providers. This position develops, implements, and monitors intervention activities relating to the needs of a child identified through screenings. The specialist serves as a liaison with families and providers to access community resources. The specialist also supports early intervention services while promoting and growing inclusive early education programs in the community.


ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Guide parents and providers through the process of Early Identification and Referral for Special Needs and provide Individualized Intervention Practices to include Concern Identification, Concern Analysis, Intervention
  • implementation, Plan evaluation, Referrals to Early Intervention services or specialized care, and Accurate Data recording.
  • Independently manage workload and navigate complex processes; including guiding parents through the delicate process of discovering their child may need additional support and/or require special education services.
  • Advanced time management skills and handling multiple priorities
  • Ensure all data/contact made with families, providers, and agencies related to screening or intervention is accurately entered into the appropriate database.
  • Communicate with childcare providers about the needed follow up screenings for children scoring below developmental norms at the time of initial enrollment into School Readiness services and subsequent annual screenings.
  • Identify, educate, and promote awareness on the importance of inclusivity for children with disabilities and special health care needs.
  • For SR children with an IFSP/IEP, consult and collaborate with childcare center upon request, as well as assist in accessing the Special Needs Rate.
  • Actively engage families and providers in conversations related to the importance of early screening and intervention.
  • Review and follow up on weekly report of ASQ-3, providing triage and case management to address developmental concerns, provide individualized developmental strategies, additional screening, and the initiation of referral to Early Steps and Child Find and/or identify when support is no longer needed.
  • Prompt communication with families and providers on results of ASQ-3 for the purpose of creating and implementing an Individualized Intervention Support Plan, including discussion of recommended referrals, developmental activities, and/or community supports.
  • In collaboration with family, provider, and child, complete informal and/or formal standardized screenings and submit Child Find for the consideration of further evaluation. Screenings take place at Child Care Centers and the ELCHC Office.
  • Connect parents to community resources/agencies for children with individual needs.
  • Collaborate and follow up with community partners to streamline inclusion, referrals, screening, evaluation, and support children with developmental concerns.
  • Respond to field and remote Warm Line requests, providing resources, referrals, and supportive guidance to all school readiness families.
  • Work on special projects related to Inclusion and serving children with Special Needs, Social Emotional curriculum, Inclusion training of workforce development and other committees, as assigned
  • Attend regular professional development workshops, training and/or professional conferences documenting a minimum of 30 hours of professional development annually
  • Significant travel is required within Hillsborough County with compensation.
  • Site visits to childcare programs are required- to complete screenings.

SUPERVISORY RESPONSIBILITIES

None.

title: Azure Fabric Data Engineer
description:

title: Vi søger tilkaldevikarer til Midgård bo- og arbejdsfællesskab
company: Den selvejende institution Midgård Bo- og arbejdsfællesskab
description:
Vi søger tilkaldevikarer til Midgård bo- og arbejdsfællesskab

Hvem er vi?

Midgård er et bo – og arbejdsfællesskab, som ligger i den lille landsby Ølsted på Midtfyn. Midgård tilbyder botilbud efter servicelovens §107 og §108. På Midgård bor der 11 voksne mennesker med udviklingshæmning. Vores mål er at skabe et trygt og hjemligt miljø, hvor den enkelte oplever trivsel, udvikling og mulighed for at leve et så meningsfuldt og selvstændigt liv som muligt liv. Midgård tilbyder også beskyttet beskæftigelse efter servicelovens §103 og aktivitets- og samværstilbud efter §104. Vores værksteder danner rammen om en hverdag med arbejdsglæde, meningsfulde aktiviteter, fællesskab og mulighed for personlig udvikling.

Vores pædagogiske arbejde tager udgangspunkt i en nutidig steinerpædagogik og bygger på en grundlæggende respekt for det enkelte menneskes ressourcer, udviklingsmuligheder og ret til selvbestemmelse.

I vores arbejde med trivsel og konflikthåndtering anvender vi principperne fra Low Arousal. Vi arbejder forebyggende og søger at forstå de forhold, der påvirker trivsel og adfærd, fremfor alene at fokusere på selve situationen. Som en del af denne tilgang arbejder vi også med LA2, hvor der er fokus på trivsel, ressourcer og individuelle mestringsstrategier. Mennesker er forskellige og derfor tilpasses vores støtte altid den enkeltes beboeres ressourcer og behov.

Midgård er en lille arbejdsplads med korte beslutningsveje, hvor du har mulighed for at præge udviklingen og omsætte gode idéer til praksis. Vi ser det som en styrke, at medarbejdergruppen består af mennesker i forskellige aldersgrupper og med forskellige faglige baggrunde. Vi tror på, at de bedste løsninger skabes i fællesskab. Derfor prioriterer vi et arbejdsmiljø, hvor det er naturligt at spørge om hjælp, dele erfaringer og sparre om faglige dilemmaer.

Vi søger vikarer, der har lyst til at være en del af en dynamisk hverdag og understøtte beboernes behov. Du bliver som vikar både en del af arbejdet i vores værksteder (bageri, service og køkken) og i bodelen.

Arbejdstider:

Arbejdstiderne varierer og fordeler sig mellem dag-, aften-, weekend- helligdagsarbejde og en gang imellem sovende nattevagter.
Som vikar her, dækker du ind for det faste personale ved ferie, sygdom og kurser/uddannelse. Vi har derfor især også brug for vikarer, som kan hjælpe os i akutte situationer f.eks. ved sygdom i det faste personale.

Vi ønsker os en person som:

o har lyst til at være med til at skabe et trygt liv for beboerne på Midgård

o er åben for at lære nyt

o er reflekterende over egen praksis

o er en holdspiller

o er indstillet på at arbejde efter Midgårds værdigrundlag.

o er i besiddelse af et kørekort B

Det er vigtigt, at du som person hviler i dig selv og er god til at navigere i en til tider uforudsigelig hverdag. Du skal trives med at arbejde med det, vi kalder ”pædagogisk bøvl”, som er de komplekse og uforudsigelige situationer, hvor der ikke altid findes en enkel løsning. Derudover er det vigtigt, at du kommunikerer tydeligt, møder andre med empati og har tålmodighed, også når tingene bliver udfordrende.

Erfaring eller en relevant uddannelse inden for området er en fordel, men det er ikke et ufravigeligt krav. Det vigtigste for os er, at du har lyst til at lære, udvikle dig og engagere dig i arbejdet.

Vi er ikke omfattet af en overenskomst.

Ansættelsessamtaler afholdes løbende.

Ansøgningen mærkes ”Tilkaldevikar” og sendes kun på mail til kontor@midgaardfyn.dk

Har du ikke hørt fra os senest d. 9.10.2026, er stillingerne besat til anden side, og vi takker for din interesse.

Yderligere oplysninger fås hos forstander Malin Puhst eller souschef Ben Dittmann, tlf. 6269 1211

Mail adresse: kontor@midgaardfyn.dk

title: Underwriting Counsel
description:
WHO WE ARE

Relm is the only specialty insurer dedicated to supporting the world’s most innovative industries.

Whether it’s with startups harnessing zero-gravity conditions on the ISS to manufacture blindness-curing retinas, global crypto exchanges democratizing crypto trading, or biotech pioneers using gene-editing technology to advance personalized medicine, Relm works lockstep with innovators to understand and underwrite businesses shaping the future.

Relm’s team operates out of offices in London, New York, Dubai, Miami, Bermuda, executing market-leading insurance solutions for companies operating in digital assets and web3, AI, the space economy, financial technology, biotech, and more.

WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR

Where regular insurers look backwards, Relm differentiates by looking ahead. We operate at the forefront of innovative industries by hiring curious minds with deep sector experience. To continue helping businesses build the future, we need all of our team members to demonstrate curiosity, creativity, courage, and optimism. We need them to be accountable for ideation but able to execute collaboratively. In short: we hire people whose inquisitive minds help them break ground.

We are looking for an experienced Underwriting Counsel to join our Legal team and act as a key legal partner to Relm’s underwriting business.

Reporting to the Senior Legal Counsel – Insurance & Strategy, you will take day-to-day ownership of legal support for Relm’s underwriting teams, managing a varied portfolio of matters ranging from endorsements, amendatories and bespoke policy wordings to complex underwriting issues across Relm’s speciality insurance portfolio.

This is a hands-on role for a commercially minded insurance lawyer who enjoys working closely with underwriters. You will independently manage the Underwriting Counsel function and be comfortable working directly with senior underwriters, claims professionals, product teams and other stakeholders across the business.

WHAT YOU WILL DO

  • Act as a primary day-to-day legal adviser to Relm’s underwriting teams on policy wording, coverage and other underwriting-related legal matters.
  • Own and manage the Underwriting Counsel intake process, including triaging and prioritising requests and ensuring matters are progressed efficiently.
  • Draft and review endorsements, amendatories, manuscript wordings, policy forms and other insurance product documentation.
  • Advise on bespoke policy terms and coverage structures, translating underwriting intent and commercial objectives into clear and effective policy language.
  • Review and negotiate NDAs, underwriting authority letters and other routine underwriting-related agreements.
  • Partner with Underwriting and Product Innovation on the development, enhancement and lifecycle management of insurance products and coverage solutions.
  • Advise on legal and regulatory requirements relevant to underwriting activities, policy documentation and insurance products.
  • Work with Claims and Legal to identify lessons from claims, disputes and coverage issues and translate them into improvements to policy wording, products and underwriting practices.
  • Develop and maintain policy wording standards, endorsement libraries and precedents. Work with Underwriting to develop playbooks and practical guidance. Support Product to ensure product library remains up to date and meets regulatory and other requirements.
  • Identify emerging legal, regulatory and market developments affecting Relm’s products and underwriting activities and provide practical recommendations to the business.
  • Develop and deliver training and guidance to underwriting and other relevant teams on policy wording, coverage and relevant legal or regulatory developments.
  • Continuously improve Underwriting Counsel processes and ways of working to provide timely, consistent and commercially effective legal support.

WHAT YOU BRING TO THE TABLE

  • Juris Doctor (JD) from an accredited law school and admission to practice in at least one U.S. jurisdiction in good standing.
  • Minimum of 5 years of relevant legal experience, ideally gained in insurance coverage, underwriting counselling, specialty commercial insurance and/or an in-house insurance legal team.
  • Strong experience with commercial and/or specialty lines insurance products, coverage and policy wording.
  • Demonstrated experience drafting and reviewing policies, endorsements, manuscript language and bespoke coverage solutions.
  • Experience working directly with underwriters and translating commercial objectives and underwriting intent into practical legal solutions and effective policy language.
  • Strong understanding of insurance coverage principles and the legal and regulatory requirements relevant to insurance products and underwriting activities.
  • Strong commercial judgement and the ability to provide clear, practical and solution-oriented advice.
  • Excellent drafting, analytical, communication and relationship-building skills.
  • Ability to independently manage a varied portfolio of matters, prioritise competing requests and exercise sound judgement about when to seek input or escalate.
  • A collaborative, hands-on approach and comfort operating in a fast-paced environment supporting emerging risks, innovative industries and new insurance products.

WHY YOU’LL LOVE WORKING WITH US

Diversity and inclusion are a given in this day and age; Relm goes beyond the norm to provide genuine support for our team members. We believe in equipping our staff with whatever arsenal they need to do their best work (see below), and our commitment to staff growth is often cited by members as one of their most highly valued benefits.

Relm is a team of innovators redefining what’s possible in insurance. With us, you’ll launch industry-first programs within an environment designed to be antithetical to traditional insurance and the restraints that come with it. Our forward-thinking attracts forward thinkers.

title: Supervisor - København K
description:
Supervisor i Netto – Vil du være med til at gøre en forskel for kollegaer og kunder?

Er du klar til at tage ansvar og udvikle dig i et stærkt fællesskab? Som supervisor i Netto får du muligheden for at prøve kræfter med at have ansvar og du er både rollemodel og sparringspartner for dine kollegaer. Du bliver en central del af teamet og er med til at sikre, at butikken altid leverer gode oplevelser for vores kunder – hver dag.

Hvad indebærer jobbet?
Som supervisor har du ansvaret for at butikken er salgsklar og indbydende. Du bidrager til at motivere og støtte dine kollegaer. Dine opgaver vil blandt andet være:

  • Koordinering af vareopfyldning og trimning
  • Sikre korrekt skiltning
  • Kundeservice og betjening ved kassen
  • Bidrage til rengøring, orden i butik og baglokale
  • Områdeansvarlig for et eller flere udvalgte områder
  • Deltage i oplæring af nye kollegaer

Du får en grundig oplæring i Nettos koncepter, så du er godt klædt på til at tage ansvar for kollegaer og opgaver. Du vil på udvalgte vagter skulle være alene om ansvaret åbne eller lukke butikken – og synes at det er en spændende udfordring.

Hvorfor vælge Netto?
Hos os bliver du en del af et stærkt fællesskab med fokus på samarbejde, ansvar, feedback og fleksibilitet. Du får mulighed for at udvikle dig i rollen, lære om detailhandel og tage næste skridt i din karriere.

Vi søger dig, der:

  • Er serviceminded og trives med kundekontakt
  • Har lyst til at tage ansvar
  • Kan motivere og støtte et team, hvor vi løfter i flok
  • Er fleksibel i forhold til arbejdstider (dag, aften og weekend)
  • Har gåpåmod og lyst til at lære nyt

Vi tilbyder:

  • Et job med ansvar og gode udviklingsmuligheder
  • At du kan blive en del af et stærkt team – hvor vi samarbejder og hjælper hinanden
  • Et positivt arbejdsmiljø
  • Feedback fra chefer og kollegaer

Alle de gode grunde til at blive supervisor i Netto
Du får typisk mellem 20 – 40 kollegaer i butikken, og vi oplever ofte, at kollegaskabet udvikler sig til venskaber.

Du kan også glæde dig til:

  • Løn og arbejdsvilkår der følger HK overenskomst

  • Masser af gode personalegoder, fx rabatter i Bilka, føtex, Netto, Carl’s Jr. og Starbucks

  • Mulighed for at handle i vores fysiske Salling varehuse i Aalborg, Aarhus og snart i København, hvor vi åbner i 2026 med 35% rabat

Bliv en del af Netto-ånden: Sammenhold, engagement og fællesskab
I Netto fylder sammenhold, engagement og fællesskab rigtig meget. Vi kalder det Netto-ånden, og den bliver man hurtigt bidt af. Det er den hjælpende hånd, smilet der stadig sidder fast efter en lang dag, og det er sammenholdet, der får os til at løfte i flok.

Hos Netto skal alle medarbejdere opleve, at de er en del af et stærkt team, hvor de føler sig respekteret, og deres indsats er højt værdsat. Vi tilbyder varierende opgaver, der motiverer og udvikler dig – både til gavn for din fremtid hos os eller andre steder. Vi tager et stort ansvar for at gøre hverdagen bedre for medarbejdere, kunder og det samfund, vi er en del af.

Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig!

title: Functional Business Analist
description:
Functional Business Analyst: shape the future of how we work

At Schuberg Philis, we are looking for a Functional Business Analyst to help shape how our organisation uses technology to scale, collaborate and operate effectively.

You will work at the intersection of business processes, people and technology. Your role is not limited to gathering requirements or improving an existing workflow. You will help define the vision for a domain, translate that vision into a practical roadmap, align stakeholders and make sure the work gets done.

This may involve domains such as IT Service Management, AI, collaboration tooling, sales operations or people processes. Whatever the domain, your focus is the same: make deliberate choices, get the most value from our applications, and drive adoption across the organisation.

You are comfortable moving between strategy and execution. One day, you may facilitate conversations with stakeholders to define a target operating model; the next, you may be mapping a process, configuring an application, investigating an integration or working with engineers to resolve an issue. You understand that a good solution is not just well designed, it is useful, adopted and maintainable.

What you will do

  • Define and communicate a clear vision for one or more business technology domains;
  • Own and maintain roadmaps: identify opportunities, prioritise initiatives, align stakeholders and turn plans into delivery;
  • Analyse business processes, data flows and user needs, and translate these into clear requirements and functional designs;
  • Lead change initiatives from discovery through implementation, including scoping, planning, testing, rollout and adoption;
  • Help the organisation get more value from its application landscape: improve usage, simplify processes, reduce overlap and make sound investment choices;
  • Work closely with internal stakeholders, engineers and external partners to design sustainable solutions;
  • Drive adoption by ensuring new ways of working and new tooling are understood, supported and embedded in daily practice;
  • Get hands-on where needed. You do not need to be a software engineer, but you are comfortable discussing APIs, integrations, data flows and application configuration—and are not afraid to investigate or fix things yourself;
  • Balance long-term direction with practical progress: you know when to design, when to decide and when to simply get things moving.

What we are looking for

  • At least 5 years of experience in a business analysis, process improvement, functional consultancy, product ownership or similar role within an IT-enabled environment;
  • A strong track record of connecting business needs, processes, stakeholders and technology;
  • Experience defining roadmaps, scoping initiatives and leading projects or change programmes;
  • The ability to turn strategic ambitions into practical, measurable improvements;
  • Experience with application selection, implementation, configuration and/or adoption;
  • A solid understanding of integrations, APIs and how systems exchange data. Technical curiosity matters more than knowing every technology in detail;
  • Strong process analysis skills and the confidence to challenge existing ways of working when necessary;
  • A pragmatic, ownership-driven mindset: you take responsibility for outcomes, not just deliverables;
  • Clear communication skills.

What makes this role interesting

This is a broad role with real influence. You will not be handed a fixed list of requirements to process; you will help determine what matters, where we should invest and how we can make change stick. You will have the space to develop a domain, build relationships across the organisation and combine strategic thinking with hands-on delivery.

If you enjoy creating clarity in complex environments, helping people adopt better ways of working and turning technology into meaningful business value, we would like to talk to you.

Everyone we work with and consider working with has a right to equal treatment. The hiring and appraisal process at Schuberg Philis is designed to be thorough and equitable, implementing fair payment, benefits, and opportunities across all demographics.

It is our desire to be a company that brings together multiple nationalities, cultures, religions, genders, abilities, and talents within and across our teams. We welcome colleagues from diverse backgrounds to join Schuberg Philis and actively support diversity and inclusion in the tech industry.

title: Systemingenjör inom flygtrafikledning
description:
Vill du arbeta med avancerad teknik i framkant och samtidigt bidra till samhällsviktig verksamhet? Som systemingenjör på Combitech blir du en del av flygtrafikledningens tekniska ryggrad och arbetar med säkerhetskritiska system i en miljö där kvalitet, tillförlitlighet och samarbete står i centrum. Rollen kombinerar tekniskt djup med praktiskt genomförande och ger dig möjlighet att vara med och forma lösningar som används i verklig operativ drift.

Din roll som systemingenjör

Som systemingenjör hos oss blir du en del av ett kompetent och engagerat team i en trygg och stöttande arbetsmiljö. Du arbetar med avancerade system för militära flygledartorn samt andra kritiska tekniska lösningar där höga krav ställs på funktion, säkerhet och stabilitet. Rollen omfattar hela systemets livscykel. Du arbetar med systemdesign, validering och konfiguration samt ansvarar för installation och driftsättning hos kund. Du planerar och genomför tester, identifierar och hanterar risker och säkerställer att leveranser håller hög kvalitet. Arbetet sker i nära samverkan med tekniker, flygledare och andra slutanvändare, vilket gör att du får en central roll som länk mellan utveckling, drift och användning.

Dokumentation är en viktig del av arbetet. Du tar fram och förvaltar teknisk dokumentation samt säkerhetsdokumentation som är avgörande för spårbarhet, kvalitet och långsiktig förvaltning av systemen.

Tjänsten innebär ett visst antal resor inom Sverige.

Vem är du?

Du är högskole- eller civilingenjör, eller har motsvarande relevant arbetslivserfarenhet som systemingenjör inom tekniska system. Du trivs i komplexa tekniska miljöer och arbetar strukturerat och noggrant, samtidigt som du har förmågan att snabbt sätta dig in i både helhet och detaljer.

Du har god förmåga att arbeta både självständigt och i team och ser kommunikation och samarbete som naturliga delar av ett framgångsrikt arbete. Ett intresse för flyg och flygtrafikledning är värdefullt, men ingen förutsättning - vi ser till att du får den domänkunskap som krävs.

Vi ser gärna att du har erfarenhet av exempelvis mjukvaruutveckling, nätverk, Linux/Unix/Windows eller elektronik och el. Det viktigaste är dock din tekniska nyfikenhet, ditt problemlösningsdriv och ditt fokus på kvalitet och ansvar i det du levererar.

Vad vi erbjuder

Du får möjlighet att arbeta med varierande arbetsuppgifter som spänner från installation och finjustering av system till djupgående tekniska analyser samt planering och utformning av framtida lösningar.

Rollen ger dig även möjlighet att arbeta direkt på flygplatser och följa hur dina idéer och tekniska lösningar omsätts till fungerande system i en verklig och operativ miljö.

Du blir en del av en dynamisk verksamhet där du erbjuds både teknisk fördjupning och bredare utvecklingsmöjligheter, anpassade efter hur du vill utvecklas i din yrkesroll.

Stödet runt dig är starkt och nära. Genom tät samverkan med projektledare, teknikledning och programkontor har du tillgång till hela organisationens samlade kompetens, vilket ger dig en stabil grund för att lyckas i varje uppdrag.

Då tjänsten innebär arbete som omfattas av försvarssekretess krävs det att du genomför och godkänns i en säkerhetsprövning med registerkontroll.

Urval sker löpande. Vi ser fram emot din ansökan!

Kom & gör skillnad

På Combitech har vi ett löfte: vi investerar i våra medarbetare. Våra kunder förväntar sig att vi ska ligga i absolut framkant och kunna lösa även de svåraste problemen, därför behöver vi ständigt utvecklas, som företag, som team, och som individer.

Hos oss har du möjlighet att göra karriär och utmana dig själv som ledare, men också fördjupa din expertis och din domänkunskap. Vi brukar säga att här kan du byta jobb utan att byta arbetsgivare. Du kan arbeta med en mängd olika sektorer, branscher, tekniker, uppdragsgivare och projekt.

Vill du veta mer om hur det är att arbeta hos oss? Kolla in våra karriärsidor!

Kontaktperson: Elinor Ulfbratt - elinor.ulfbratt (@) combitech.se

Vi undanber oss rekryteringssamarbeten.

Inga ansökningar mottages via mail.

title: Funktionsleder til Bygningsdrift og -service, OUH
description:
Skab gode rammer for patienter, medarbejdere og den daglige drift

Vil du stå i spidsen for dygtige håndværkere og servicemedarbejdere, der hver dag får et hospital til at fungere? Og motiveres du af at være tæt på medarbejderne, skabe retning og udvikle driften i en organisation under forandring?

Vi søger en funktionsleder til Bygningsdrift og -service (BDS) på Odense Universitetshospital. Her får du en alsidig lederstilling med ansvar, indflydelse og en hverdag, hvor din indsats kan mærkes – både blandt medarbejderne og på hospitalets afdelinger.

Om jobbet Du får det faglige og personalemæssige ansvar for 14 engagerede medarbejdere, der løser opgaver inden for:

  • Pleje og vedligehold af grønne områder, veje, stier og øvrige udearealer.
  • Vintertjeneste og glatførebekæmpelse.
  • Snedker- og tømreropgaver.
  • Drift og vedligehold af hospitalets boliger.
  • Daglig kontrol af brændstof (fuel) samt løbende kontrol og tilsyn med hospitalets helikopterplads.
Medarbejderne har stor faglig viden og løser mange opgaver selvstændigt. Din opgave er at sætte en tydelig retning, sikre fælles prioriteringer og skabe rammer, hvor faglighed, ansvar og samarbejde trives.

Du er en synlig leder, der interesserer sig for medarbejdernes hverdag og følger op på både opgaver og trivsel. Du giver plads til gode løsninger og træffer beslutninger, når behovene er mange, og ressourcerne skal prioriteres.

Du binder mennesker, faglighed og drift sammen I tæt samarbejde med afdelingens øvrige funktionsledere sikrer du en stabil daglig drift og udvikler arbejdsgange på tværs af fagområder. Du får en bred kontaktflade til kliniske afdelinger, samarbejdspartnere og eksterne leverandører.

Dine opgaver omfatter blandt andet:

  • Personaleledelse med fokus på trivsel, udvikling og samarbejde.
  • Planlægning, koordinering og opfølgning på drifts- og vedligeholdelsesopgaver.
  • Sikring af, at kontroller af fuel og helikopterplads bliver gennemført og dokumenteret.
  • Brug og videreudvikling af Dalux til indmeldinger, planlagte opgaver og dokumentation.
  • Koordinering af mindre vedligeholdelsesprojekter og samarbejde med eksterne leverandører.
  • Økonomiopfølgning og administrative opgaver, herunder lønregistrering og fakturabehandling.
  • Løbende forbedringer med afsæt i medarbejdernes erfaringer og hospitalets behov.
Overgangen til Nyt OUH bliver en vigtig del af din hverdag. Du skal bidrage til at fastholde en velfungerende drift på det eksisterende hospital og samtidig være med til at udvikle samarbejde og opgaveløsning på tværs af de to matrikler.

God bygningsdrift er en del af et godt patientforløb I BDS sætter vi patienten først ved at skabe trygge og velfungerende fysiske rammer. Bygninger og udearealer skal understøtte hospitalets arbejde og være indbydende for patienter, pårørende og medarbejdere.

Du skal kunne omsætte dette til konkrete prioriteringer i hverdagen – fra en sikker adgangsvej om vinteren til en vedligeholdelsesopgave, der skal løses med hensyn til afdelingens patienter og personale.

Du refererer til sektionslederen for Teknisk Sektion i BDS. Dit daglige arbejdssted er i Odense, og du bidrager med faglig sparring på tværs af hospitalets matrikler.

Hvem er du Vi søger en leder med en relevant håndværksmæssig eller teknisk baggrund og erfaring med personaleledelse. Du har gerne en lederuddannelse eller er motiveret for at videreuddanne dig.

Derudover lægger vi vægt på, at du:

  • Har forståelse for bygningsdrift, vedligeholdelse og forskellige håndværksfag.
  • Skaber tillid gennem tydelig kommunikation, nærvær og opfølgning.
  • Inddrager medarbejdernes viden og giver plads til selvstændighed.
  • Bevarer overblikket og prioriterer, når planlagte opgaver møder akutte behov.
  • Har erfaring med koordinering af opgaver eller projekter samt økonomisk forståelse.
  • Er fortrolig med digitale værktøjer og nysgerrig på, hvordan de kan understøtte driften.
  • Bidrager aktivt til ledelsessamarbejdet og tager ansvar for fælles løsninger.
Du behøver ikke være specialist i alle fagområder. Det afgørende er, at du kan bringe medarbejdernes faglighed i spil og sikre, at opgaverne bliver fulgt til dørs.

Det tilbyder vi Du bliver en del af en afdeling med høj faglighed, en uformel omgangstone og plads til godt humør. Du får mulighed for at præge både den daglige opgaveløsning og udviklingen frem mod driften på Nyt OUH.

Vi tilbyder en lederstilling med tæt medarbejderkontakt, mange samarbejdsflader og mulighed for at udvikle dig fagligt og ledelsesmæssigt.

På OUH arbejder vi systematisk med forbedringer gennem Den Syddanske Forbedringsmodel. Som leder skal du gennemføre hospitalets læringsforløb i forbedringsledelse og bruge metoderne sammen med medarbejderne til at skabe forbedringer i hverdagen.

Om Bygningsdrift og -service BDS er en af OUH’s serviceafdelinger. Vi sikrer en sammenhængende og professionel drift, der understøtter hospitalets kerneopgave.

Afdelingen rummer en bred vifte af fagligheder, herunder håndværkere, teknikere, projektledere og administrative medarbejdere. Vi arbejder på tværs af matriklerne i Odense, Svendborg og Nyborg og bidrager til arbejdet med Nyt OUH.

Løn & Ansættelsesvilkår:

Aflønning sker efter principperne om Ny Løn og beror på en forhandling mellem forhandlingsberettigede organisation og BDS. Øvrige ansættelsesforhold sker i overensstemmelse med OUHs politikker og retningslinjer samt ansøgers faglige organisatoriske baggrund.

Regionen er forpligtet til at oplyse dig om startlønnen for stillingen an på din uddannelsesmæssige baggrund. Du får oplyst grundløn, centralt fastsatte tillæg og pension i nedenstående link via Overenskomst 33.18.1 "Professionsbachelorer på det tekniske område" eller 32.23.1 "Håndværkere, montører, elektronikteknikere m.fl.". Udover startlønnen, kan lønnen indeholde eventuelt forhandlede tillæg afhængigt af stillingen, dine erfaringer og kvalifikationer.

Startløn for stillinger i Region Syddanmark

I Region Syddanmark anvendes prøvetid på 3 måneder.

Praktisk information

  • Ansøgningsfrist: Søndag den 11. oktober 2026
  • Ansættelsessamtaler: Torsdag den 22. oktober 2026.
  • Ved spørgsmål: Kontakt Afdelingschef Thomas Jelling Pedersen på 21450039 eller thomas.jelling.pedersen@rsyd.dk.

Customers, including Anthropic, Bloomberg, NVIDIA, Microsoft, and Salesforce, rely on Grafana Labs. We are a 100% remote company with team members across 40+ countries, backed by leading investors including Lightspeed Venture Partners, Sequoia Capital, GIC, Coatue, J.P. Morgan, CapitalG, and Lead Edge Capital. Learn more at and follow us on LinkedIn and X.

We’re scaling fast and staying true to what makes us different: an open-source legacy, a global collaborative culture, and a passion for meaningful work. Our team thrives in an innovation-driven environment where transparency, autonomy, and trust fuel everything we do.

You may not meet every requirement, and that’s okay. If this role excites you, we’d love you to raise your hand for what could be a truly career-defining opportunity.

This is a remote opportunity, and we would be interested in applicants located in Spain, Sweden, UK, Ireland or Germany.

The Opportunity:

At Grafana Labs, we build observability tools that help users understand, respond to, and improve their systems – regardless of scale, complexity, or tech stack. We recently started a skunkworks initiative with a mission to bring observability to the rest of the business. Our goal is to make Grafana the single best place where humans and AI agents understand and act on real-time data from across the enterprise. As part of this initiative, we are building an AI-native data intelligence system that gives agents reliable, governed access to enterprise context. This system helps agents retrieve the right data, metadata, definitions, lineage, quality signals, and institutional knowledge without every agent builder having to maintain their own brittle context files. The principle is simple: the context system retrieves, agents decide, and data teams maintain the intelligence.

The new team is a mix of seasoned Grafanistas and new hires. We operate with a high degree of autonomy and ownership, both as individuals and as a team. Engineers are empowered to make decisions, move quickly, and validate ideas early – while being supported by a deeply collaborative culture that values curiosity, feedback, and cross-functional partnership.

We’re looking for a Staff-level Backend Engineer to help build the first production services for this context layer management system. You will design and ship the core backend architecture that powers ingestion, context storage, retrieval APIs, and agent-facing integrations. This is an early-stage role on a high-autonomy team, so you should be comfortable working through ambiguity, making pragmatic architectural decisions, and building systems that can evolve from internal dogfooding to production-grade SaaS. As the team matures, there’s a broad opportunity to expand or redefine this role based on impact and initiative.

What You'll Be Doing:

  • Build the core backend services: Design, implement, test, and operate the first services for context ingestion, context indexing, retrieval orchestration, API access, source configuration, and system administration.
  • Create a scalable SaaS foundation: Help define and build the architecture for a multi-tenant service, including tenant isolation, usage tracking, quotas, audit logs, background jobs, and reliable service boundaries.
  • Power agent-facing retrieval workflows: Build APIs and service interfaces that allow AI agents, MCP tools, CLIs, and internal applications to retrieve relevant context, provenance, confidence signals, and warnings.
  • Work across product and infrastructure: Partner with the team to make practical tradeoffs between fast experimentation and long-term reliability, especially as the project moves from prototype to production.
  • Operate what you build: Instrument services with metrics, logs, traces, alerts, and dashboards. Use observability tools to understand system behavior and improve reliability.
  • Contribute to technical direction: Help shape the architecture, service boundaries, storage choices, API contracts, deployment patterns, and engineering practices for a new product area.
  • Effective communication: You’ll be working in a highly dynamic and collaborative environment, so we need someone who can communicate effectively and contribute across teams.
  • Ownership and impact: Take full ownership of the AI solutions you develop, ensuring they are not only innovative but also scalable, maintainable, and aligned with real user workflows.

What Makes You a Great Fit:

  • Strong engineering skills: Solid experience building production-grade, user-facing software systems. You’re a self-starter, capable of tackling complex engineering problems and making UI design decisions with minimal supervision.
  • AI experience with a practical mindset: You’re familiar with AI technologies and frameworks, and you focus on delivering high-quality solutions that work in the real world, not just in theory.
  • Quick iteration and experimentation: You’re comfortable releasing prototypes, collecting feedback, and iterating with a pragmatic mindset.
  • Proven initiative: You take ownership and drive projects forward, pushing boundaries to find the most impactful solutions. You can deal with ambiguity and are able to define scope where things are loosely defined.
  • Collaborative attitude: You communicate effectively with your peers. You’re open to feedback, and you bring a solutions-oriented mindset to the table.
  • Experience with LLMs, prompt engineering, and building applications powered by GenAI.
  • Proven track record of delivering software that made it into production and is actively used by users.
  • Exposure to working in cloud-native environments (e.g., AWS, GCP, Azure).
  • Experience using observability tools to understand and troubleshoot system behavior.

Bonus Points for:

  • Experience building or working with agent frameworks or multi‑agent workflows.
  • Experience as a data analyst or work with data platforms (e.g., Looker, Tableau, PowerBI, Snowflake, DataBricks)
  • Experience building tools for data engineering.

How we work:

We are a remote-first team that meets regularly over video and does most of our work asynchronously, in writing. We value creativity, diverse perspectives, and clear communication. Tempo is relied upon by prominent global organizations to monitor critical applications and infrastructure, and we expect everyone on the team, including our Staff engineers, to contribute ideas that make it a more reliable, more useful, and more loved product.

Compensation & Rewards:

In Germany, the Base compensation range for this role is EUR 109,709 - EUR 131,651. Actual compensation may vary based on level, experience, and skillset as assessed in the interview process. Benefits include equity, bonus (if applicable) and other benefits listed here.

*Compensation ranges are country specific. If you are applying for this role from a different location than listed above, your recruiter will discuss your specific market’s defined pay range & benefits at the beginning of the process

Why You’ll Thrive at Grafana Labs:

  • 100% Remote, Global Culture - As a remote-only company, we bring together talent from around the world, united by a culture of collaboration and shared purpose.
  • Scaling Organization – Tackle meaningful work in a high-growth, ever-evolving environment.
  • Transparent Communication – Expect open decision-making and regular company-wide updates.
  • Innovation-Driven – Autonomy and support to ship great work and try new things.
  • Open Source Roots – Built on community-driven values that shape how we work.
  • Empowered Teams – High trust, low ego culture that values outcomes over optics.
  • Career Growth Pathways – Defined opportunities to grow and develop your career.
  • Approachable Leadership – Transparent execs who are involved, visible, and human.
  • Passionate People – Join a team of smart, supportive folks who care deeply about what they do.
  • In-Person onboarding - We want you to thrive from day 1 with your fellow new ‘Grafanistas’ to learn all about what we do and how we do it.
  • Balance is Key - We operate a global annual leave policy of 30 days per annum. 3 days of your annual leave entitlement are reserved for Grafana Shutdown Days to allow the team to really disconnect. *We will comply with local legislation where applicable.

Equal Opportunity Employer: Grafana Labs is an equal opportunities employer. We welcome applications from everyone regardless of race, colour, nationality, origin, caste, sex, gender reassignment identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, religion or belief, disability, veteran status, genetic information, pregnancy, maternity, marital, family or carer status, or any other characteristic which is protected by local law. title: After-School Director [IS 229]
description:
Start Date: August 1, 2026
Schedule: Monday- Friday, 10:00 am-6:00 pm
Job Type: Full-time, Salary Exempt
Location: 275 Harlem River Park Bridge, Bronx, NY 10453

Organization Overview
Replications, Inc. is a leading nonprofit organization dedicated to replicating and implementing high-impact educational models that foster student success and community engagement. Our vision is that every child in every community has access to a dynamic and joyful public school that empowers them to thrive. We partner with schools to provide comprehensive support services to drive student academic achievement and social-emotional development. To learn more about Replications, visit

Why Join Replications, Inc.?
This is your chance to contribute directly to an organization committed to transforming public education and empowering communities.

Position Overview
The Program Director oversees the daily operations of a school-based after-school program and provides leadership and supervision to staff to ensure program goals and student outcomes are achieved. As the on-site leader, the Program Director is responsible for the high-quality implementation of a DYCD-funded program (COMPASS/SONYC), with a focus on participant safety, regulatory compliance (DYCD, SACC, and organizational standards), and fiscal accountability. The Program Director serves as the primary liaison with the school principal and represents the program within the broader school community, including NYCPS staff, families, and community partners. The role leads the delivery of a dynamic program that includes academic enrichment, project-based learning, arts, sports, leadership development, and initiatives supporting students’ academic and social-emotional growth, including NYC Reads. The Program Director reports to the Regional Program Manager.

Key Responsibilities

  • Ensure program activities align with DYCD COMPASS and SONYC requirements and organizational goals.
  • Oversee daily site operations to maintain a safe, structured, and compliant program environment.
  • Manage attendance tracking, data entry, and required documentation in DYCD Connect.
  • Supervise and support site staff, including the Assistant Program Director, Group Leaders, and Activity Specialists.
  • Conduct staff observations and evaluations and provide ongoing coaching and professional development.
  • Ensure compliance with SACC regulations, including supervision ratios, safety protocols, and staff credential requirements.
  • Monitor the site budget and coordinate vendor oversight in collaboration with the Regional Program Manager and fiscal team.
  • Serve as the primary point of contact with NYCPS school personnel, families, and community partners.
  • Lead recruitment and retention efforts to meet DYCD enrollment and attendance targets.
  • Support high‑quality programming across literacy, STEM, arts, civic engagement, and NYC Reads initiatives.
  • Coordinate inclusion supports and manage Individualized Accommodation Plans (IAPs) for participants with diverse needs.

Requirements

  • DOE Fingerprinted
  • SACC Director Requirement
  • Statewide Central Registry clearance
  • Department of Health clearance
  • Bachelor’s degree in a child-related field (e.g., Education, Child Development, Psychology, Social Work) and at least two years of direct experience working with school-age children; or A minimum of three (3) years of supervisory or program management experience in youth development or educational settings.
  • Two years of college with 18 credits in Child Development, Elementary Education, Physical Education, Recreation or a related field

Qualifications

  • Knowledge of DYCD COMPASS and SONYC program requirements and experience working in partnership with NYCPS schools.
  • Demonstrated ability to supervise staff, manage program operations, oversee budgets, and maintain regulatory compliance.
  • Experience collaborating with school staff, families, and community partners.
  • Strong communication, organizational, and problem-solving skills, with a commitment to youth development, student safety, educational equity, and culturally responsive practices.

Approach to Work

  • Strong commitment to educational equity
  • Passion for working with students in under-resourced schools
  • Exceptional level of patience and focus to overcome challenges and achieve results

Pay and Benefits

  • $70,000-$80,000
  • Pre-tax commuter benefits
  • 3% 401k employer match
  • $3,000 tuition reimbursement
  • Sick and Safe Leave
  • FSA account option

title: Genbrugsmedarbejdere til genbrugsbutik på Egtved og Give Genbrugsplads
description:
Ressourcer & Genbrug søger kreative genbrugsmedarbejdere, der vil være med til at skabe indbydende, inspirerende og velfungerende genbrugsbutikker på genbrugspladserne i Egtved og Give.

Har du et skarpt blik for genbrugsguld og indretning - og vil du være med til at inspirere borgerne til endnu mere direkte genbrug? Trives du med orden, flow og god service, og er du ikke bange for også at tage fat, når der er brug for en praktisk hånd?

Så er du måske en af vores nye kreative genbrugsmedarbejdere.

Hvem er du?
Du kan se potentialet i både små og store ting - også dér, hvor andre måske bare ser affald - og du formår at omsætte det til flotte, funktionelle og inspirerende udstillinger i en tillidsbutik, hvor der er mange forskellige mennesker i spil.

Dit primære fokus er butikken, og her arbejder du med indretning, overblik og flow. Samtidig indgår du naturligt i driften på pladsen og er ikke bange for at give en hånd med, når der er brug for hjælp til praktiske opgaver. Du møder altid borgerne med god service og kan selv se, hvor der er brug for en indsats - både inde og ude.

Om jobbet
På genbrugspladsen i Egtved og Give udvikler vi vores genbrugsrum til en butik, hvor borgere kan købe gode brugte ting og give dem nyt liv. Derfor søger vi to kreative genbrugsmedarbejdere – én til Egtved og én til Give. Du bliver en vigtig del af den daglige drift og skal være med til at skabe en indbydende butik med spændende varer og gode oplevelser for kunderne.

Du er ikke kun ”inde i butikken”. Du er også ude blandt borgerne på pladsen for at spotte gode genbrugsmaterialer. Du giver en hånd med i stille perioder og bidrager til, at genbrugspladsen fungerer godt som helhed.

Dine arbejdsopgaver bliver at
* skabe indbydende og inspirerende udstillinger i butikken
* udvælge, sortere og prissætte genbrugseffekter
* klargøre og pakke genbrugseffekter til transport
* sikre et godt flow i butikken og bevare overblikket, når der er travlt
* vejlede de besøgende på genbrugspladsen - både private og virksomheder
* hjælpe med at holde pladsen pæn, præsentabel og velfungerende
* Genbrugsspotter

Vi forestiller os, at du
* har flair for genbrug og upcycling og kan se potentiale i forskellige effekter og materialer
* er kreativ, men forstår, at butikken også er en driftsopgave
* gerne har erfaring fra butik, udstilling, hotel eller andet servicefag
* møder mennesker med overskud og skaber en god tone
* kan bevare roen, også når der er travlt
* er fleksibel og ikke bange for at tage fat, når der er brug for det
* får energi af at yde god service
* er systematisk, vedholdende og kan følge ting helt til dørs
* har kørekort B

Til gengæld får du
* et spændende og afvekslende job, hvor du er med til at give flere ting nyt liv gennem direkte genbrug
* mulighed for at præge butikkens videre udvikling
* gode og engagerede kolleger, der arbejder på at skabe gode borgeroplevelser
* medindflydelse på din egen arbejdssituation
* en hverdag, hvor ikke to dage er ens
* en arbejdsplads, hvor der er højt til loftet

Om os
Ressourcer & Genbrug er en del af Facility Management & Ressourcer i Teknik & Miljø. Vi har ansvar for affalds- og ressourcehåndtering for mere end 124.000 borgere samt kommunale institutioner og mindre erhvervsvirksomheder.

Afdelingen består af ca. 65 medarbejdere med forskellige faglige baggrunde, som sammen håndterer ca. 100.000 ton ressourcer årligt. Derudover er det nok et af kommunens mest besøgte område, eftersom vores genbrugspladser har mere end 650.000 besøg om året med 361 åbningsdage.

Vil du vide mere?
Hvis du vil vide mere om stillingen som genbrugsvejleder, er du meget velkommen til at kontakte teamleder for Genbrugspladserne, Tim Schlaikjer, mobil: 22 80 06 69 eller mail tidws@vejle.dk.

Løn- og ansættelsesvilkår
Dine løn- og ansættelsesvilkår er i henhold til gældende overenskomst og principperne for Ny Løn.

Din primære arbejdsplads bliver enten Egtved Genbrugsplads, Nydamsvej 8, 6040 Egtved eller Give Genbrugsplads, Dyrskuevej 2, 7323 Give.

Stillingen er en fuldtidsstilling med en gennemsnitlig arbejdsuge på 37 timer over året. Du indgår i en vagtplan, hvor du har vagt hver anden weekend - også på helligdage.

Opstart er den 1. december 2026.

Ansøgningsfrist
Vi skal have din ansøgning senest den 8. oktober 2026.

Vi forventer at afholde samtaler den 14. oktober 2026. En eventuel anden samtale forventes afholdt den 22. oktober 2026.

Send din ansøgning
Vi foretrækker, at du søger stillingen online ved at bruge knappen ”Send ansøgning”. Husk at vedhæfte din ansøgning og CV samt andre relevante bilag.
Når du har sendt ansøgningen, modtager du en e-mail som kvittering.

Vær opmærksom på, at mailen kan være placeret i din mappe Uønsket post.

Vejle Kommune opfordrer alle til at søge stillingen uanset køn, alder, etnisk baggrund, handicap m.v.

Overvejer du at flytte til Vejle? Så kan du få hjælp til bosætning. Se mere på www.vejle.dk/tilflytter.

title: CVDP Triage Team Lead
description:
We are seeking an experienced cybersecurity professional to lead our Crowdsourced Vulnerability Discovery Programme (CVDP) triage team. This role encompasses managing daily operations, leading a team of triage specialist, and ensuring effective handling of vulnerability reports across government systems for the Government Bug Bounty Programme (GBBP), Vulnerability Disclosure Programme (VDP), and Vulnerability Rewards Programme (VRP) across Whole-of-Government (WoG) systems.

What you'll do

  • Lead a lean team of triage specialists, ensuring quality, efficiency, and timely processing of vulnerability reports
  • Manage team performance, workload, and resource planning and perform hands-on triage and validation when required, particularly during peak periods or complex escalations
  • Act as escalation point for complex vulnerability validation and severity rating decisions
  • Mentor and train triage specialists on analysis, assessment, and documentation standards
  • Own and continuously improve triage SOPs, workflows, and tools, including integration and maintenance of key triage platforms
  • Develop scripts and automation (e.g., Python, workflow tools) to streamline triage processes, reporting, and platform integrations
  • Liaise with government agencies, system owners, and security researchers, and support the Programme Team in facilitating smooth internal-external collaboration
  • Analyze vulnerability trends, deliver presentations on notable findings, and prepare reports for management and stakeholders
  • Undertake additional responsibilities as required to support programme objectives

What you need

  • Degree in Cybersecurity, Computer Science, or related technical field
  • OSCP certification
  • Familiarity with web vulnerabilities (e.g. OWASP Top 10), including severity rating, vulnerability categorisation, root cause analysis, and remediation options
  • Familiarity with Burp Suite and Kali Linux to validate vulnerabilities
  • Good command of English (Oral and Written)
  • Experience mentoring junior team members
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities
  • Outstanding communication and stakeholder management skills
  • Collaborative leadership style with a strong commitment to mentoring and fostering a supportive team environment
  • Bug bounty or government/regulated environment experience preferred
  • Ability to plan leave around scheduled GBBP and Pre-GBBP cycles

Why join us

Lead a specialised team in a high-impact government cybersecurity programme, with direct exposure to complex vulnerability work and a clear pathway to senior security leadership roles.

title: Senior Project Officer Allied Health - Transformation and Innovation

title: Strategisk inköpare sökes till vår storkund i Göteborg
description:

title: Strategic Projects Lead, Managed Services
description:
Strategic Projects Lead, Managed Services

Prolific isn’t just enabling AI innovation – we’re redefining it. While foundational AI technologies are becoming commoditized, Prolific’s human data infrastructure provides the high-quality, diverse data required to train the next generation of AI models. Through our platform, we empower researchers and companies to access a global, ethically curated participant base, ensuring cutting-edge AI research and training grounded in inclusivity and precision.

The Role

As a Strategic projects lead focused on AI projects, you’ll play a key role in delivering some of Prolific’s most important and complex client programmes.
You’ll own client engagements end to end, working directly with clients to understand what they’re trying to achieve and translating their requirements into successful human data programmes. You’ll bring together teams across Prolific to deliver the right solution, while owning the client relationship, project execution and overall success of the engagement.
This is a hands-on role in a fast-moving area of AI. Projects can be complex and requirements can evolve quickly, so you’ll need to be comfortable working through ambiguity, getting into the detail when needed and making sound decisions to keep delivery moving.
You’ll combine strong client management with an understanding of AI and human data workflows, helping us deliver excellent work for our clients while continuing to improve how we deliver AI projects at scale.

What You’ll Be Doing

  • Own the end-to-end delivery of complex AI projects, from understanding client requirements and shaping the delivery approach through to execution and completion.
  • Act as the primary point of contact for your clients, building strong relationships and providing clear, consistent communication throughout the project lifecycle.
  • Work with clients to translate complex or evolving requirements into clear project scopes, delivery plans, success criteria and practical solutions.
  • Partner closely with Sales, Operations, Product and Engineering to coordinate resources, solve delivery challenges and ensure projects meet both client and Prolific goals.
  • Stay close to project execution, identifying risks or issues early and working through problems directly to keep delivery on track.
  • Own and track key delivery metrics including quality, timelines, budgets and profitability, using project data to identify opportunities to improve outcomes.
  • Help improve the way we deliver AI projects, developing more effective and scalable processes, tools and ways of working as our client base grows.

What You’ll Bring to the Role

  • 3–6+ years of experience managing complex client projects or programmes, ideally within AI/ML, human data, data services or another technical environment.
  • A solid understanding of AI technologies and the AI/ML development lifecycle, including familiarity with areas such as data collection, annotation, evaluation or validation.
  • Strong client-facing skills, with experience building trusted relationships and communicating effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Experience taking complex or ambiguous client requirements and turning them into clear, executable plans and successful outcomes.
  • A hands-on approach to delivery and problem-solving, with the ability to get into the detail, identify what’s going wrong and drive solutions forward.
  • Strong analytical and commercial judgement, with experience managing project KPIs, budgets, profitability, quality and delivery performance.
  • Proven ability to lead across teams, align different stakeholders and operate effectively in a fast-moving environment where priorities and requirements can change.

Why Prolific is a great place to work

We've built a unique platform that connects researchers and companies with a global pool of participants, enabling the collection of high-quality, ethically sourced human behavioral data and feedback. This data is the cornerstone of developing more accurate, nuanced, and aligned AI systems.

We believe that the next leap in AI capabilities won't come solely from scaling existing models, but from integrating diverse human perspectives and behaviors into AI development. By providing this crucial human data infrastructure, Prolific is positioning itself at the forefront of the next wave of AI innovation – one that reflects the breath and the best of humanity.

Working for us will place you at the forefront of AI innovation, providing access to our unique human data platform and opportunities for groundbreaking research.

Join us to enjoy a competitive salary, benefits, and remote working within our impactful, mission-driven culture. title: FPGA Embedded Developer - 19547
description:
Veritaz is a leading IT staffing solutions provider in Sweden, committed to advancing individual careers and aiding employers in ensuring the perfect talent fit. With a proven track record of successful partnerships with top companies, we have rapidly grown our presence in the USA, Europe, and Sweden as a dependable and trusted resource within the IT industry.

Assignment Description

We are looking for an experienced FPGA & Embedded Developer to join an advanced embedded team within the space industry in Uppsala.

The role combines FPGA development, embedded software and system-level development, with integration against Linux- and FreeRTOS-based platforms. You will contribute across the development lifecycle, from requirements and architecture through implementation, verification and integration.

The role suits someone who enjoys working at the intersection of hardware and software and can turn high-level or incomplete requirements into practical technical solutions.

What You Will Work On

  • Design, implement and verify embedded solutions
  • Contribute to system architecture and technical decisions

  • Develop hardware-near software and digital electronics solutions
  • Translate high-level requirements and concepts into technical implementations
  • Collaborate with FPGA, embedded and system developers
  • Participate throughout the development lifecycle from concept to integration

What You Bring

  • Several years of hands-on FPGA development experience
  • Strong embedded development experience
  • Experience with Linux-based development environments
  • Good understanding of digital electronics and hardware-near development
  • Experience with high-speed interfaces and communication protocols
  • Ability to develop technical solutions from high-level or incomplete requirements
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
  • Swedish citizenship is required
