title: Seniorkonsulent med stærk kemifaglig profil og blik for rådgivning og udvikling
description:
Vil du bruge din kemiske faglighed til at løse komplekse problemstillinger og skabe værdi for danske virksomheder? Som vores nye seniorkonsulent omsætter du kompliceret kemi til strategisk rådgivning for virksomheder. Du får faglige udfordringer, stor indflydelse på at forme nye løsninger og muligheden for at gøre en forskel.

Sæt din faglighed i spil dér, hvor kemi skaber retning og værdi
I Kemisk Karakterisering og Rådgivning arbejder vi med at omsætte dyb kemisk forståelse af produkter, materialer og processer til løsninger, der styrker virksomhedernes udvikling, kvalitet og beslutningsgrundlag. Vi hjælper kunder med at forstå deres produkter bedre, dokumentere egenskaber og sikkerhed, løse komplekse udfordringer og træffe mere kvalificerede beslutninger.

Du bliver en nøgleperson i krydsfeltet mellem faglig indsigt, uvildig rådgivning og kundeudvikling. Du gennemskuer problemstillinger, skaber struktur i uklare behov og omsætter kemisk viden til løsninger med høj faglig kvalitet og tydelig værdi for kunden. Du kommer til at indgå i et fagligt fællesskab, hvor sparring, videndeling og fælles refleksion er en naturlig del af hverdagen.

Dine ansvarsområder vil bl.a. inkludere:

  • Kunderelation og værdiskabelse: Du tager ansvar for kundedialoger fra den indledende problemforståelse til tilbud, projektgennemførelse og opfølgning.
  • Behovsafklaring og rådgivning: Du identificerer sammenhænge, behov og udviklingsmuligheder hos kunder og omsætter dem til fagligt stærke og værdiskabende projekter.
  • Formidling og rådgivning: Du formidler komplicerede kemiske problemstillinger og testresultater klart, præcist og overbevisende til både fagfolk og beslutningstagere.
  • Forretningsudvikling: Du bidrager aktivt til at udvikle og skærpe centerets ydelser, metoder og faglige position i markedet.
  • Tværfagligt samarbejde: Du samarbejder tæt med kolleger og øvrige specialister på Instituttet om at løfte komplekse opgaver med høj kvalitet og integritet.

Faglig tyngde, rådgivningsgen og lyst til udvikling
Du trives i et miljø, hvor der sjældent findes et standardsvar, og hvor du skal bruge din analytiske sans og nysgerrighed til at finde de rigtige løsninger. Du er struktureret, har et naturligt drive og motiveres af at skabe overblik, se sammenhænge og udvikle løsninger, der holder både fagligt og i praksis.

Vi forestiller os, at du:

  • har en akademisk baggrund inden for kemi, medicinalkemi, miljøkemi eller lignende
  • har solid erfaring med kemisk karakterisering, analytisk kemi, materialekemi eller relaterede fagområder
  • gerne har flere års erfaring fra konsulentarbejde, teknisk rådgivning eller lignende roller med tæt kundekontakt
  • evner at gå fra komplekse faglige problemstillinger til tydelige anbefalinger eller løsninger
  • trives med ansvar, faglig sparring og at få indflydelse på opgaver og faglig retning

Det er en fordel, hvis du har erfaring med virksomheder inden for produktionsindustrien, medicoindustrien eller andre brancher, hvor kemisk dokumentation, karakterisering og kvalitet er forretningskritiske elementer.

Bliv en del af et fagligt miljø med dybde, tillid og reel indflydelse
Du bliver en del af et stærkt fagligt miljø, hvor vi arbejder anvendelsesorienteret med kemi i tæt samspil med erhvervslivet. Vi kombinerer specialistviden, analytiske metoder og rådgivning med en ambition om at skabe løsninger, der både er fagligt solide og strategisk relevante for kunden.

Hos os får du:

  • mulighed for at arbejde med komplekse og meningsfulde problemstillinger med høj relevans for dansk industri
  • en rolle med stor selvstændighed og mulighed for at tage ansvar for egne kunder, projekter og faglige initiativer
  • et miljø med høj faglighed, dybe specialistkompetencer og kolleger, der prioriterer kvalitet og videndeling
  • reel indflydelse på udviklingen af ydelser, samarbejder og den faglige retning i centret
  • et stærkt kollegialt miljø, hvor sparring, videndeling og fælles faglig nysgerrighed er en naturlig del af hverdagen

Capio Group is a California-based Information Technology Consulting firm serving the public sector since 2010. We assist the Government in delivering large, complex systems and solutions. The complete solution will include user interfaces, data models and databases, secure integration mechanisms and APIs, re-engineered business processes, system documentation, training materials, and ongoing support mechanisms. Project activities will involve supporting a hybrid Agile implementation delivered through multiple Program Increments, working collaboratively with client business and technical stakeholders, external partners, and other project participants.

With 20 years of experience, 50M+ identities managed, and 1,000+ successful deployments, our team is our strongest asset and is built by design to help clients protect critical infrastructure, enable digital transformation, and ensure compliance with confidence.

We deliver comprehensive solutions across IAM domains, including:

  • Workforce IAM (Access Management, Identity Governance and Administration, Privileged Access Management)
  • Consumer IAM (Identity Verification, Authentication and Access, Threat Detection) in highly regulated industries.

If you’re ready to grow your career alongside some of the industry’s best, come join us — you’re key to our success

We are currently looking for an Okta Services Architect to join KeyData Cyber's Architecture and Delivery team! In this role, you will act as a technical authority, leading the design and implementation of enterprise-scale Identity and Access Management (IAM) solutions using Okta. You will work closely with customers, stakeholders, and delivery teams to translate business needs into scalable identity strategies, ensuring successful deployments and long-term value realization. This role plays a critical part in shaping customer identity programs and driving high-impact outcomes. If you're passionate about working in an environment where you can experience accelerated growth, development, and high impact, this role could be for you!

Location: Canada

Employment Type: Remote, 6 months contract with a possibility of extension

What You’ll Do:

  • Lead discovery sessions to gather business, functional, and technical requirements
  • Design and architect enterprise IAM solutions using Okta
  • Translate customer requirements into scalable and secure identity architectures
  • Provide technical leadership in defining Statements of Work (SOW), solution scope, and delivery approach
  • Develop IAM strategies, standards, and governance frameworks across organizations
  • Collaborate with Sales and Professional Services teams to support solutioning and pre-sales activities
  • Guide delivery teams to ensure successful implementation and alignment with architecture
  • Conduct architecture reviews, customer health checks, and ongoing optimizations
  • Define best practices for interoperability across multiple IAM and enterprise systems
  • Build strong relationships with stakeholders, including senior leadership and business teams

Who We’re Looking For:

  • Mandatory Requirement: Okta Certified Architect / Okta Consultant Certification
  • 8+ years of experience in IT, solution architecture, or software development
  • 4+ years of experience in IAM architecture and design
  • 5+ years of consulting experience working with enterprise customers
  • Strong experience designing and implementing Okta-based solutions
  • Deep understanding of IAM concepts including SSO, MFA, RBAC, OAuth, OpenID Connect, LDAP, and Active Directory
  • Experience with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP) and enterprise integrations
  • Proven ability to lead discovery workshops and define technical solutions
  • Strong stakeholder management skills, including engagement with senior executives
  • Excellent communication skills with the ability to translate technical concepts to business audiences

Nice-to-Have Skills:

  • Experience with IAM tools such as Ping, SailPoint, Saviynt, or Microsoft Identity
  • Knowledge of security architecture, cryptography, and Zero Trust principles
  • Experience with distributed systems and application architecture design
  • Programming experience (Java, Python, .NET, Ruby, or similar)

Compensation: The hourly rate range for this position is $70–$77 CAD per hour. The final rate will be determined based on the candidate’s experience, overall fit for the role, and expected ramp-up time. This is a 6-month, full-time contract role with a possibility of extension, working 40 hours a week. At KeyData Cyber, we are committed to fair and competitive compensation. We regularly benchmark across positions, industries, sectors, and experience levels, ensuring our approach recognizes each person’s unique strengths, contributions, and the value they bring to the organization. Why You’ll Love Working Here

At KeyData Cyber, we put people first, valuing learning, growth, and work-life balance. We offer extensive opportunities to advance your career through leading digital identity projects across North America. Our culture is built on respect, inclusion, and equal opportunity for everyone.

title: .NET-udvikler til Compliance og HR Systemudvikling
description:
Ønsker du at arbejde i et uformelt og agilt miljø, hvor godt humør, samarbejde og faglighed vægtes højt? Søger du et job, hvor dine kompetencer inden for C# og .NET er i fokus, og hvor du får mulighed for at arbejde med forskellige systemer og teknologier? Så er det måske dig, vi leder efter til vores kontor i Silkeborg.

Jyske Banks vision er at gøre en forskel også i systemunderstøttelsen af virksomhedens interne og administrative processer. Derfor søger vi en udvikler, som kan bidrage til udvikling, modernisering og vedligeholdelse af vores løsninger.

Din hverdag som udvikler i Jyske Bank

Du bliver en del af Compliance og HR Systemudvikling, hvor vi arbejder med udvikling og drift af interne IT-løsninger inden for blandt andet HR, compliance og økonomi.

Vi arbejder agilt og tæt sammen med forretningen og andre IT-specialister. Opgaverne spænder fra udvikling af applikationer og integrationer til modernisering og videreudvikling af eksisterende løsninger.

Der kan til tider være travlt, men vi prioriterer vores opgaver løbende for at sikre, at vi arbejder med det rigtige. Vi har en tillidsbaseret og udviklingsorienteret kultur, der understøtter både vores performance og personlige udvikling.

Dine arbejdsopgaver vil blandt andet være:

  • Udvikling og vedligeholdelse af applikationer i C# og .NET
  • Udvikling og optimering af integrationer mellem interne systemer
  • Videreudvikling og modernisering af eksisterende løsninger
  • Omsætning af forretningsmæssige behov til robuste og vedligeholdelsesvenlige løsninger
  • Test, kvalitetssikring og løbende forbedring af vores udviklingspraksis

Vores forventninger til dig

Du er nysgerrig, dygtig analytisk og trives i et samarbejdsorienteret miljø, hvor du bidrager engageret med din faglige indsigt.

Du har solid erfaring inden for .NET-udvikling og gerne integrationer, og får desuden nemmere ved at klare dig godt i jobbet, hvis du:

  • Har solid erfaring med .NET/.NET Core/.NET Framework og C#
  • Har erfaring med udvikling af applikationer og integrationer
  • Har kendskab til webservices/REST API'er og SQL
  • Har erfaring med versionsstyring (Git) og deployment pipelines
  • Har kendskab til teststrategier som unit tests, integrationstests og end-to-end tests
  • Arbejder struktureret og trives i et agilt setup
  • Har en god forretningsforståelse og er hurtig til at sætte dig ind i nye domæner
  • Trives med samarbejde, men samtidig tager ansvar for egne opgaver

Du har herudover solidt kendskab til AI-værktøjer og inddrager dem aktivt i dit arbejde for at optimere processer, understøtte beslutninger og højne kvaliteten af resultaterne. Du arbejder bevidst med prompts og AI-understøttede arbejdsprocesser og kan tilpasse og kvalificere output, så det skaber værdi i praksis. Samtidig har du forståelse for AI's begrænsninger og anvender teknologien ansvarligt.

Du kan også have erfaring med:

  • Entity Framework
  • Angular eller andre frontend-teknologier
  • JavaScript/TypeScript
  • HTML5 og CSS
  • Azure og Microsoft Entra ID

Uddannelsesniveau og teknisk forståelse

Du har en relevant videregående uddannelse inden for IT og en solid teknisk forståelse.

Du har erfaring med softwareudvikling og trives med at sætte dig ind i både eksisterende og nye teknologier. Du er fagligt nysgerrig og har lyst til at bruge din viden til at udvikle gode, stabile og værdiskabende løsninger.

Ansøgning

Er du interesseret i jobbet, så send os din ansøgning og CV snarest muligt. Der er ansøgningsfrist d. 21. sep. 2026.

Hør mere om jobbet

Hvis du er interesseret i jobbet, eller har spørgsmål, er du meget velkommen til at kontakte os.

title: REVISOR SØGES TIL UNIK, SOCIALØKONOMISK VIRKSOMHED
description:
Vi søger en kompetent og forretningsorienteret leder til Huset Venture Aarhus’ afdeling for regnskabsservice. Du skal – udover et stort driftsfokus – være optaget af social ansvarlighed, da vi er en socialøkonomisk virksomhed, der har det formål at ansætte mennesker i fleksjob.

Huset Venture Aarhus søger en revisor til en lederstilling med praktisk erfaring til en stærk socialøkonomisk virksomhed.

Du har styr på revisionshåndværket, kunderne og rådgiverrollen. Hos Huset Venture får du muligheden for bl.a. at forme et kapitel i din karriere som leder af Regnskabsservice – en afdeling med dedikerede medarbejdere alle i fleksjob. Vi søger en stærk faglig profil, der ønsker at kombinere forretningsmæssig drift, kundekontakt og afdelingsledelse med et rummeligt og meningsfuldt arbejdsmarked.

Huset Venture er en registreret socialøkonomisk virksomhed, hvor vi driver en professionel og succesfuld regnskabsservice for et bredt udsnit af mindre og mellemstore virksomheder (SMV’er).

Om hverdagen i Huset Venture

Vi har en driftig afdeling med mange spændende opgaver til eksterne kunder. Dagen starter måske med faglig sparring eller kvalitetssikring af en opgave for en privat person, en ejerledet virksomhed eller et selskab. Senere sidder du overfor en kunde eller ny potentiel kunde, der har brug for tæt rådgivning om regnskab, skat og forretningsmæssige beslutninger. Inden dagen er omme, har du vendt faglige problemstillinger og drift med holdet på kontoret, hvor nærværende ledelse, sparring og udvikling er en naturlig del af hverdagen.

Dine primære opgaver og ansvarsområder:

  • Afdelingsledelse med rummelighed: Faglig og personalemæssig ledelse af regnskabsteamet. Du leder med høj faglighed og udviser den rummelighed og menneskelige indsigt, der kendetegner en socialøkonomisk virksomhed. Du er hands-on på jobbet med fokus sammen med medarbejderne på de enkelte opgaver. Du er kvalitetsbevidst og dedikeret.

  • Kundeansvar og rådgivning: Ansvar for afdelingens kunder og tilgang af nye. Du fungerer som tæt sparringspartner for private ejerledere, SMV’er, foreninger, mv. og kan lide at arbejde med at skabe værdi, der rækker ud over selve regnskabet.

  • Kundetilgang og salg: Du kan aktivt opbygge relationer, tiltrække nye kunder og udbygge kundeporteføljen til Regnskabsservice.

  • Kvalitetssikring & udvikling: Du kan sikre høj kvalitet i regnskaber, bogholderi, løn, skatteopgørelser og erklæringer samt løbende optimere og digitalisere arbejdsprocesser.

Hvem er du?

  • Baggrund og erfaring: Du har +5 års erfaring fra revisionsbranchen og er uddannet HD(R), cand.merc.aud. eller lignende. Meget gerne bestalling evt. deponeret. Du behersker regnskab, bogholderi, skat og erklæringsopgaver for både selskaber, personligt ejede virksomheder og foreninger.

  • Tryghed og fremdrift: Du driver dine opgaver og afdelingen sikkert fra planlægning til levering og trives med det fulde overblik.

  • Relationer og salg: Du motiveres af den løbende dialog med kunder og har tæft og lyst til at opbygge netværk og skaffe nye kunder.

  • Engageret leder: Du er nysgerrig på at udvikle medarbejdernes evner og egne lederevner. Du motiveres af at se dine medarbejdere trives og udvikle sig.

Kort om Huset Venture — hvad tilbyder vi?

Hos Huset Venture støtter vi dine professionelle og personlige mål. Vi tilbyder en central lederstilling med stor indflydelse, et uformelt arbejdsmiljø præget af åbenhed, respekt og høj faglighed — samt muligheden for at kombinere en stærk karriere med et vigtigt socialt formål. Du får løn svarende til kvalifikationer, pension, sundhedsordning og fleksible arbejdsforhold. Du refererer til økonomichefen.

Interesseret?

Send din motiverede ansøgning, CV samt evt. relevante bilag via dette link:

REVISOR SØGES TIL UNIK, SOCIALØKONOMISK VIRKSOMHED – Husetventure Job

title: Software Developer for Spacecraft Integration – Join the Future of Exploration
description:
Are you an experienced software developer with a dream of working with cutting-edge technology? Do you want to contribute to missions that shape the future of space exploration? Then this opportunity is for you!

We are looking for a dedicated and innovative Software Developer who is eager to create software solutions that make space more accessible, affordable, and useful.

Your role:

In this role, you’ll work closely with engineers to integrate, configure, and test cutting-edge satellite subsystems. Your expertise will help enhance system testing and software tools, all while playing a vital role in satellite integration.

You will join our software team in the Satellite Systems Business Unit, consisting of 12 software engineers divided into two equally sized groups: Payload & Payload Interfacing and Spacecraft Integration. The team works closely with systems, hardware, mechanical and electrical engineers, manufacturing, and project managers to develop, integrate and deliver complete satellite missions.

The Payload & Payload Interfacing group is responsible for software supporting customer payloads and the interfaces between payloads and the spacecraft platform. The Spacecraft Integration group focuses on software tools, integration, verification, and system-level testing, ensuring that subsystems and payloads operate together as a complete spacecraft.

As part of the Spacecraft Integration group, you will work hands-on with satellite integration, verification, and automated testing. You will collaborate closely with engineers across disciplines to configure, integrate and validate satellite subsystems and complete spacecraft, while developing and maintaining software tools that improve testing efficiency and product quality. This includes close cooperation with the Payload & Payload Interfacing group to ensure seamless integration between payloads and platform systems.

You will have the opportunity to contribute throughout the spacecraft development lifecycle, from subsystem integration and verification activities to supporting mission delivery and in-orbit operations, helping ensure that our satellites perform reliably in some of the most demanding environments imaginable.

Your task include:

  • Collaborate with engineers to understand, configure, integrate, and verify satellite subsystems and the entire satellite system.
  • Create and expand Python-based test cases to enhance satellite testing and system quality.
  • Improve and maintain software tools that streamline satellite development and testing.
  • Use tools like Linux, git, Python, pytest, C, Docker, and Jenkins, while participating in code reviews to maintain high software standards.

What you bring:

At GomSpace, it’s not just your technical skills that matter - your character is also important. We value individuals who bring a positive, proactive attitude, and can build trust across cultures. The ideal candidate will have a software background, a passion for space, a personal drive to get things done, and a desire to work on challenging engineering projects.

You likely:

  • Bring 3+ years of experience in software development using C, C++, and Python
  • Have a solid understanding of embedded systems, RTOS, and hardware-software integration
  • Possess hands-on experience with testing critical systems, particularly using Python and automated test frameworks
  • Be comfortable working with Git, Linux, and modern development tools
  • Take initiative and ownership of your tasks while contributing effectively as part of a team
  • Apply a structured and methodical approach to software development and task execution

Who you are:

  • Helpfulness – you support teams, ask purposeful questions and pursue the answers you need
  • Open communication – you communicate transparently and proactively and follow through
  • True commitment – you take ownership, act with integrity and drive progress with confidence
  • Human insight – you listen, understand different perspectives and turn input into clear conclusions

Here’s why you’ll love working with us:

At GomSpace, we’re on a mission to shape the future of space – one mission at a time. Here, you’ll be part of something bigger than just a project or a product. You’ll help build systems that connect people, enable science and expand humanity’s reach beyond Earth.

We believe the best results come when talented people are trusted, supported, and inspired to push boundaries together.

  • Be part of a global company making a real impact in the space industry
  • Get freedom under responsibility from day one – and grow with us
  • Join a dynamic, full-service environment where no two days are alike
  • Work across borders and build a strong international network
  • Be part of a culture where collaboration beats competition – and milestones are celebrated together

You will become part of the Satellite Systems Business Unit that builds and integrates satellites and missions for our customers.

The development and delivery of missions and spacecraft happen in close cooperation between system and software engineers, hardware, mechanical and electrical engineers, manufacturing, and project managers.

You will:

  • Work at the forefront of space technology, contributing to innovative satellite systems
  • Collaborate with a talented, dynamic team and continuously develop your skills in a fast-paced environment
  • Gain hands-on experience in both satellite and ground station integration

JOIN OUR MISSION

You are welcome to send your application in Danish or English. Interviews will be conducted on a continuous basis. Apply for the job by following the link below.

Workplace will be at our premises at Langagervej 6, Aalborg, Denmark and it is expected that most of the time is in the offices.

As part of our recruitment process, employment requires you to complete a background check conducted by an authorized third-party provider in accordance with applicable legislation.

At GomSpace WE MAKE SPACE YOURS

GomSpace is a globally leading designer, integrator and manufacturer of high-end nano and microsatellites for customers in the academic, government and commercial markets. Our positions of strength include systems integration, small satellite subsystems and advanced miniaturized radio technology. At the core of our mission are our core values: Be helpful, communicate openly and frequently, and show true leadership.

Our international team is devoted to understanding our customers’ requirements and delivering high quality. We are listed in Stockholm (GOMX), headquartered in Denmark and have subsidiaries in Sweden, Singapore, France, North America and Luxembourg. We have more than 300 employees servicing customers in more than 60 countries. Learn more on

Join us in shaping the future of space exploration!

title: Operatør / Opstiller
description:
Operatør / Opstiller

Vi søger en dygtig og teknisk stærk opstiller/operatør til vores følebanker område. Du bliver en del af et mindre, velfungerende team på 3-4 kolleger, hvor samarbejde, kvalitet og løbende udvikling er i centrum.

Du vil få ansvar for opsætning, indkøring og optimering af produktionsudstyr samt drift og overvågning af maskiner. Derudover indgår løbende kvalitetskontrol og dokumentation som en vigtig del af dine daglige opgaver.

Du bidrager til at holde arbejdsområdet rent, sikkert og velorganiseret og bidrager til at sikre et højt niveau af orden og arbejdsmiljø i produktionen.

Vi søger en medarbejder med en solid teknisk baggrund, gerne uddannet som mekaniker, smed eller maskinarbejder, og meget gerne med teknisk erfaring.

Du er interesseret i maskiner og produktionsprocesser og arbejder struktureret i forhold til kvalitet, sikkerhed og procedurer. Kendskab til kvalitets- og sikkerhedsarbejde er en fordel.

Du behersker dansk på højt niveau, og det er en fordel, hvis du også kan kommunikere på tysk og engelsk.

Du arbejder ansvarsfuldt og kvalitetsbevidst og trives med at tage ejerskab for dine opgaver. Du motiveres af muligheden for at oplære og støtte nye kolleger, når du har opnået den nødvendige erfaring.

Arbejdstid og ansættelse

Oplæringen foregår på daghold, hvorefter du indgår i skiftehold.

Ansøgning og kontaktoplysninger

Arbejdssted:

Steel Products beskæftiger ca. 350 medarbejdere på to produktionssteder: Aage Østergaard i Horsens og DFT i Nordborg. Vi er én af Europas førende underleverandører indenfor koldformningsprocesser, flydepresning, stansning, dybtræk og pladebearbejdning.

Vi mestrer både de komplekse og de enkle processer til fremstilling af innovative og optimerede produkter.

title: Administrativ medarbejder med flair for struktur og tal
description:

Virksomheden er kendt for at levere fleksible løsninger, høj service og et stort fokus på at få opgaverne løst ordentligt første gang.

Du bliver en del af et administrativt team på tre personer. Hverdagen er præget af mange opgaver, og du får en vigtig rolle i at sikre, at faktureringsgrundlag, kundehenvendelser og administrative processer håndteres korrekt og til tiden.

Stillingen passer til dig, der motiveres af at skabe struktur, holde overblik og få afsluttet dine opgaver. Du trives med at skifte mellem forskellige arbejdsopgaver i løbet af dagen og forstår samtidig vigtigheden af præcision, når der arbejdes med tal og dokumentation.

Arbejdsopgaver

  • Fakturering (ca. 70%)

  • Håndtering og besvarelse af indkomne mails
  • Telefonisk kundekontakt og besvarelse af henvendelser
  • Opsætning og klargøring af iPads til nye medarbejdere

Med afsæt i dine kompetencer og ønsker, vil der på sigt være mulighed for flere andre opgaver.


Mere om stillingen

Virksomheden tilbyder:

  • Fastansættelse i en stabil og veletableret virksomhed
  • Løn efter erfaring
  • Grundig oplæring og sparring fra erfarne kolleger

title: Software Engineer
location: San Francisco, CA; Seattle, WA; NYC, NY
description:
About the team

DoorDash Labs is an independent robotics group within DoorDash working on autonomous solutions for the core business. This is the team that builds Dot, our self driving delivery robot designed from the ground up. If you are passionate about deploying autonomous technology at scale, then we want to talk to you.

About the Role

As a software engineer on the data visualization team you will own the applications used to introspect robot data. Bridge the gap between sensors, logs, diagnostics, telemetry, mission intel, and a diverse set of users across the Dot team. You will be expected to architect and develop systems with a high degree of autonomy. You will set roadmaps, identify opportunities for new systems, and execute. The applications you build should be intuitive, practical, and delightful to use. This role requires end to end ownership of both backend and frontend systems.

You're excited about this opportunity because you will…

  • Build tools that help users across autonomy, operations, product, and executive teams understand robot behavior both on-road and in simulation
  • Expand upon extensive web tooling for interaction with time series data, video playback, and 3D scene reconstruction
  • Maintain a robust C++ visualization framework for transforming robot data into informative and beautiful 2D and 3D web output
  • Develop a portfolio of data introspection capabilities to support an expanding fleet of next generation robots
  • Maintain a high bar for quality and take pride in your work!

We’re excited about you because you…

  • Are passionate about web technologies, game development, 3d computer graphics
  • Have an eye for UX and empathy with a wide range of users
  • Have experience in
    • Robotics, self driving, scientific visualization, simulation
    • High performance browser technologies (WebCodecs, Web Workers)
    • 3D technologies (WebGL, , Open3D) or game engines
    • Distributed/batch compute (Ray, Temporal, Buildkite, Docker, Kubernetes)
    • AWS infra (ECR, S3, lambda, api-gateway, Cloudfront)
    • Application profiling and optimization
    • Modern C++, STL

Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science or related field
  • 5+ years of experience in full stack software development
  • Fluency with React and Typescript
  • Experience in 3d computer graphics
  • Comfortable independently identifying and solving problems with high levels of ambiguity
  • Excel at working cross-functionally with stakeholders up and down the stack

Applications for this position are accepted on an ongoing basis

Compensation

The successful candidate’s starting pay will fall within the pay range listed below and is determined based on job-related factors including, but not limited to, skills, experience, qualifications, work location, and market conditions. Base salary is localized according to an employee’s work location. Ranges are market-dependent and may be modified in the future.

In addition to base salary, the compensation for this role includes opportunities for equity grants. Talk to your recruiter for more information.

DoorDash cares about you and your overall well-being. That’s why we offer a comprehensive benefits package to all regular employees, which includes a 401(k) plan with employer matching, 16 weeks of paid parental leave, wellness benefits, commuter benefits match, paid time off and paid sick leave in compliance with applicable laws (e.g. Colorado Healthy Families and Workplaces Act). DoorDash also offers medical, dental, and vision benefits, 11 paid holidays, disability and basic life insurance, family-forming assistance, and a mental health program, among others.

To learn more about our benefits, visit our careers page here.

See below for paid time off details:

  • For salaried roles: flexible paid time off/vacation, plus 80 hours of paid sick time per year.
  • For hourly roles: vacation accrued at about 1 hour for every 25.97 hours worked (e.g. about 6.7 hours/month if working 40 hours/week; about 3.4 hours/month if working 20 hours/week), and paid sick time accrued at 1 hour for every 30 hours worked (e.g. about 5.8 hours/month if working 40 hours/week; about 2.9 hours/month if working 20 hours/week).
The national base pay range for this position within the United States, including Illinois and Colorado.
$193,800—$285,000 USD

About DoorDash

At DoorDash, our mission to empower local economies shapes how our team members move quickly, learn, and reiterate in order to make impactful decisions that display empathy for our range of users—from Dashers to merchant partners to consumers. We are a technology and logistics company that started by enabling door-to-door delivery, and we are looking for team members who can help us go from a company that is known as the place you order food to a company that people turn to for any and all goods.

DoorDash is growing rapidly and changing constantly, which gives our team members the opportunity to share their unique perspectives, solve new challenges, and own their careers. We're committed to supporting employees’ happiness, healthiness, and overall well-being by providing comprehensive benefits and perks including premium healthcare, wellness expense reimbursement, paid parental leave and more.

Our Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion

We’re committed to growing and empowering a more inclusive community within our company, industry, and cities. title: IT Support Technician
description:
This is a hands-on, generalist IT role with real variety and room to grow within an iconic New Zealand-owned business, with a commitment to quality, long-term thinking and strong culture.


Whittaker’s is looking for an experienced IT Support Technician to join a small, high performing IT team. This is a broad, hands-on role where you’ll work across the technology environment and with people throughout the business.

If you’re an experienced IT support professional who enjoys being the person people turn to when something needs figuring out, this could be a great next step.

We’re looking for someone who continues to ask, “What could we do better?”, identifies opportunities and takes ownership of making improvements happen.



What You’ll be Doing

No two days are likely to look the same. You could be:

  • Troubleshooting hardware, software, application or connectivity issues
  • Checking server and system health and investigating anything that doesn’t look right
  • Building PCs and setting up laptops, phones and other devices
  • Managing the IT side of onboarding and offboarding employees
  • Providing hands-on support across the business, from everyday user issues through to more complex technical problems
  • Working across Microsoft environments, systems, infrastructure and networking
  • Coordinating external providers across networking, security, telecommunications and other specialist areas
  • Getting to the root cause of recurring problems rather than simply applying a quick fix
  • Identifying opportunities to improve processes, systems and ways of working
  • Contributing to technology projects, upgrades and new solutions
  • Owning problems end to end and bringing in specialist expertise when you need it


What We’re Looking For

You’ll be a strong IT all-rounder who has built a broad technical foundation and enjoys figuring things out.

You’ll likely bring:
  • Solid experience in IT support, systems or a similarly broad technical role
  • Strong troubleshooting skills across hardware, software and Microsoft environments
  • Exposure to servers, networking and infrastructure
  • Confidence working independently and taking ownership of technical issues with end to end solution design
  • Experience working with external vendors or technology providers
  • The ability to explain technical concepts in straightforward language
  • A proactive mindset and an interest in finding ways technology can work better for the business
  • Excellent communication skills, with the ability to explain technical concepts in straightforward language for varying levels of technical knowledge and confidence
  • Strong stakeholder management skills, with the ability to work with everyone from new employees and operational teams through to senior leaders
  • The ability to wear multiple hats and get involved in whatever needs doing

This is an opportunity to move beyond traditional IT support and own, understand and improve a complete technology environment.

You’ll have the variety of a hands-on generalist role, direct exposure to the wider business, and the autonomy to find better ways of doing things. You’ll also work closely with an experienced IT Manager, with the opportunity to broaden your skills and genuine career development opportunities.


This is an on-site role, based in Porirua



If this sounds like your next step Apply Now
For more information contact kirstie.parsons@beyond.co.nz

title: Engagerede og motiverede matematik- og dansklærere til Arena Skole og Fritid
description:
Vil du være med til at forme en ny skole i hjertet af Ørestad? Så læs her

Vi søger tre lærere – to til indskolingen og en til udskolingen. Arbejdstiden udgør 37 timer ugentligt i alle tre stillinger.

I den ene indskolingsstilling indgår et matematikhold på 1. årgang samt natur/teknik og musik på årgangen. Stillingen indeholder også en spændende funktion som løft-underviser, hvor du har til opgave at undervise de fagligt svage og stærke elever i mindre grupper.

I den anden stilling i indskolingen indgår et danskhold på 1. årgang samt kristendom. Stillingen indeholder også en spændende funktion som løft-underviser, hvor du har til opgave at undervise de fagligt svage og stærke elever i mindre grupper.

I udskolingsstillingen vil der indgå matematik og naturfag. Der vil være plads til at udvikle matematik- og naturfagsundervisningen på skolen, da vi er ved at opbygge vores udskoling.

Vi er åben for en drøftelse af opgaverne, hvis du er interesseret i en af stillingerne.

Om Arena Skole og Fritid
Arena Skole og Fritid er en ny og voksende folkeskole beliggende i Ørestad. I skoleåret 2026/2027 har vi klasser fra børnehaveklasse op til 7. klasse.

Vi arbejder tæt sammen på tværs af skole og fritid for at skabe en varieret og helhedsorienteret hverdag, hvor projektbaserede læringsforløb, bevægelse og stærke børnefællesskaber er i centrum.

Inden længe flytter vi ind i vores topmoderne nybyggede skole foran Royal Arena. Vi forventer at flytte ind i uge 43. Skolen er designet til at understøtte innovative læringsformer, kreativitet og trivsel.

Vi har en stor kulturel og sproglig mangfoldighed blandt eleverne – en styrke, vi værdsætter højt. Derfor søger vi lærere, der ser forskellighed som en ressource og kan bidrage til inkluderende fællesskaber.

Vi søger lærere, som

  • brænder for at skabe en tryg, motiverende og lærerig undervisning
  • kan differentiere undervisningen og løfte både de stærkeste elever og dem, der har brug for et ekstra skub
  • har erfaring – men vigtigst af alt lysten til at udvikle sig fagligt og personligt sammen med os
Vi tilbyder

  • en åben, nysgerrig og udviklingsorienteret arbejdsplads med engagerede kolleger
  • en enestående mulighed for at være med til at sætte retningen for en ny skole og bidrage til at opbygge kultur og praksis fra bunden
  • gode rammer for faglig sparring, efteruddannelse og samarbejde i professionelle læringsfællesskaber
  • en hverdag præget af hjælpsomhed, humor, arbejdsglæde og stærke fællesskaber
Vi forventer, at du

  • er uddannet lærer eller har tilsvarende kompetencer og har erfaring med at undervise
  • arbejder med et ressourceorienteret børnesyn og har fokus på relationsarbejde
  • er fleksibel, parat til at favne en omskiftelig hverdag i en flytteproces og trives i udvikling og forandringer
  • har stærke kompetencer inden for klasserumsledelse og ser et tæt og tillidsfuldt forældresamarbejde som en naturlig del af din lærergerning
  • trives i tæt samarbejde med kolleger og på tværs af fag og teams
Ansættelsesvilkår
Løn- og ansættelsesvilkår sker efter gældende overenskomst og Ny Løn.

I forbindelse med ansættelsen indhenter vi børne- og straffeattest samt referencer.

Ansættelse er fra den 1. november 2026 eller snarest muligt.

  • Indskolings afdelingsleder Line Aviaja Jørgensen på 2484 3871 eller mail GR54@kk.dk
  • Udskolings afdelingsleder Kristian Milsted på 2341 1036 eller mail h946@kk.dk

title: Full Stack Developer (Back-end focused)
description:
At Caravelo, we are revolutionizing the travel industry with subscription-based solutions that help airlines and travel companies unlock new revenue streams while enhancing customer loyalty. Our SaaS platform enables seamless subscription management, dynamic pricing, and automation, helping airlines transition from traditional ticket sales to more sustainable, customer-centric models.

With a team of passionate innovators, engineers, and industry experts, we are building the future of travel technology. Headquartered in Barcelona, we operate globally, partnering with some of the world’s leading airlines to drive digital transformation and create frictionless, modern travel experiences.

We're looking for a Full Stack Developer who is analytical, results-driven, and grounded in Java backend development. Your center of gravity will be the backend: designing, building and maintaining the robust, scalable systems that power our SaaS platform in a high-transaction fintech and traveltech environment.
That said, this isn't a purely backend role. You don't need to be a frontend expert, but you need to be sharp enough to pick up a ticket that touches the UI, lean on AI to vibe-code your way through the Vue side of it, and get it done properly rather than handing it off. Most of your work will be backend; some of it won't be, and you should be able to move between the two without friction. Architecture and APIs
  • Design, develop and maintain scalable backend systems using Java
  • Build and evolve public and internal APIs, applying best practices in API security and data handling to meet stringent compliance requirements
  • Apply Hexagonal Architecture principles to keep systems modular, maintainable and testable

Data and performance
  • Work across relational and non-relational databases, including Couchbase, to design efficient, high-availability data models and queries for high-transaction workloads
  • Proactively identify and resolve performance bottlenecks, using observability tools like Datadog to monitor system performance

Quality and reliability
  • Ensure high-quality code through rigorous unit, integration and automated testing, and lead by example in code reviews
  • Implement observability practices (metrics, logging, tracing) to monitor system health and catch issues before they become incidents
  • Proactively identify technical debt and drive the improvements needed to keep the codebase clean

Frontend collaboration
  • Pick up frontend work in Vue.js when a feature calls for it, leaning on AI to vibe-code the UI side and working end-to-end rather than only on the backend half of a ticket
  • Collaborate with the frontend team to keep the product consistent across the stack

AI-assisted engineering
  • Use AI coding assistants (Claude Code, GitHub Copilot and similar) as part of your daily workflow in implementation, testing, debugging and documentation
  • Apply Spec-Driven Development: write clear specs up front and use them to guide and validate AI-assisted implementation, so AI-generated code stays reliable and maintainable

Documentation and collaboration
  • Create and maintain technical documentation that supports backend operations and team collaboration
  • Work across disciplines to keep the product consistent and the customer experience solid
Must have:
  • Extensive experience in Java backend development, with a solid understanding of the broader product development process
  • A track record designing and implementing large-scale backend solutions in cloud environments, particularly AWS
  • Sharp enough with frontend concepts (Vue.js) to use AI to build or modify a UI feature and know if what comes out is right. You don't need to be a Vue expert, but you can't be lost in it either
  • Strong experience building RESTful APIs and microservices architectures
  • Proficiency with both relational and non-relational databases (e.g., Couchbase)
  • Expertise in automated testing (unit, integration, E2E), TDD, and CI/CD pipelines
  • A solid grasp of observability tools and practices (e.g., Datadog): metrics, logs, traces
  • Familiarity with build automation tools (Maven, Gradle) and Git-based workflows, including branching, merging and code review
  • Strong debugging and troubleshooting skills, including with asynchronous callbacks, multi-threaded environments and parallel computing Hands-on daily use of AI coding assistants — writing prompts, reviewing AI-generated code, and using them to speed up real work
  • An analytical mindset, good time management, and a genuine curiosity about new technologies
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering or a related field

Good to have:
  • Experience with Nuxt, beyond core Vue
  • Advanced performance tuning, caching and resource management, including Couchbase indexing and query optimization
  • Experience in security, compliance or enterprise SaaS environments
  • Ability to mentor other engineers, run code reviews, and facilitate technical workshops

  • Competitive salary structure with a clear progression framework.

  • Tax-free benefits: private health insurance, restaurant and transport cards, and kindergarten subsidies.

  • Flexible working hours and locations for a healthy work-life balance.

  • Hybrid work model with a vibrant Barcelona office.

  • Generous budget for training and conferences.

  • Regular company events and celebrations.

  • 23 days holiday.

title: CDL Program Director-AAI
location: AAI - Glendale AZ, Glendale, AZ, US
description:
Job Summary

Reporting to the Director of Education, the CDL Program Director is responsible for providing leadership for the CDL Program. The CDL Program Director provides subject matter expertise and actively participates in curriculum development, revision, and implementation process. As the subject matter expert in a particular program, the CDL Program Director provides product knowledge training to the campus leadership and Admissions team, utilizing materials generated via the centralized curriculum development process. This position is responsive to the campus leadership and Admissions team when asked to engage with potential students and actively participates in new student orientation. The CDL Program Director is responsible for hiring, assigning, orienting, developing, evaluating, and recognizing Driver Trainers within the program(s) of study. The CDL Program Director will convene meetings with faculty on a regular basis. The CDL Program Director is also responsible for monitoring and supporting the student population within his/her program of study. The CDL Program Director plays an active role in the student advising process, including advising students during the provisional period, meeting with students who initiate a complaint, advising students who have career-oriented questions, and consulting with students whose engagement and/or academic progress is in question. The CDL Program Director analyzes student population data, working with faculty and staff to identify students who may be at risk, and contacting students to identify barriers to success and to provide support and information concerning student services. Finally, the CDL Program Director is responsible for continuous improvement of the program. Actively engaged in the development and maintenance of the campus effectiveness plan, the CDL Program Director collects data for purposes of analyzing program performance.

Key Responsibilities

I. Provides Services to Students

  • Supplements Driver Trainer advising for students receiving failing assessments.

  • Provides academic advising/counseling as needed to students. Provides referrals to outside resources when counseling needs go beyond the scope of the school. Provides or arranges for student tutoring when needed.

  • Leads student retention initiatives for students in the program who experience barriers to success.

  • Maintains regular contact with all students within the program area and responds to their questions and/or concerns in a timely manner. Posts office hours for students.

  • Refers students to appropriate staff for non-academic problem resolution.

  • Contacts students who miss days from class or whose absence during the week results in more than four absences during the course.

  • Maintains records of interactions and correspondence with students (i.e. phone calls, emails, mail).

  • Monitors contact, and results of contact, from Driver Trainers to students in assigned program area(s). Makes calls weekly to students who (a) were not called or could not be reached; (b) did not return as promised; or (c) did not offer plans to return by a specific date. Offers appropriate academic advice and demonstrates genuine interest in students.

  • Identifies students needing tutoring.

II. Oversees Status of Quality of Curriculum, Instructional Materials, Equipment, and Facilities

  • Serves as a subject matter expert regarding academic curriculum for program area.

  • Actively participates in the curriculum development/revision process led by the Home Office Executive team.

  • Provides leadership in the implementation of new and revised curriculum.

  • Provides input into creating the master schedule regarding course sequencing, offerings, room assignments, and Driver Trainer teaching assignments.

III. Oversees Faculty Performance and Development

  • Assists the Company/Regional Program Director in the recruitment, interviewing, and hiring of faculty for program of study.

  • Orients, monitors, supervises, mentors, and assists new Driver Trainers.

  • Ensures that all program area Driver Trainers adhere to required administrative and classroom delivery duties and requirements as outlined in the job description for CDL Driver Driver Trainer.

  • Ensures completeness of faculty files and documentation of official transcripts, professional development, observations, and performance reviews.

  • Provides leadership and supports all Driver Trainers and supervises their instructional and program needs.

  • Observes classes within the program area and coaches Driver Trainers to continually improve instructional presentation and classroom management skills.

  • Conducts performance appraisals of department faculty members, including areas of strength and recommendations for improvement and future skillset development.

  • Conducts regular weekly day and evening faculty meetings. Meeting topics may include improvement of course offerings, methods of instructional delivery, selection of texts, and such other purposes which serve to improve the quality of the instructional program. Documents all meetings.

  • Provides departmental product knowledge training to Account management and Career Services personnel as requested.

  • Provides information to all departments as trends and changes in program specialty areas occur.

  • Assists account management personnel with student recruitment as requested.

  • Promotes faculty participation and provides leadership in the professional development activities of program faculty members and the documentation of those activities.

  • Participates actively in a minimum of one professional organization within the community.

  • Attends faculty meetings and in-service programs. Maintains a record of professional development activities.

  • Maintains current personal knowledge of federal and state institutional regulations, and accreditation standards related to program area.

  • Participates in preparation of government and accreditation reports and ensures their timely submission and accuracy.

  • Assists the Area Manager/Regional Program Director in evaluating data collected from student questionnaires and conducts faculty conferences when necessary to discuss the results and provides recommendations for improvement.

  • Maintains regular office hours each week to ensure consistency between day and evening policies, procedures and instruction.

  • Collaborates with peers and associates to ensure coordination of interdepartmental activities.

  • Intervenes in and works to resolve any personnel issues that arise among program area Driver Trainers.

  • Assists the Area Manager/Regional Program Director in planning program budgetary needs if and when applicable.

title: Vedligeholdelsestekniker til fast aftenhold – 4-dages arbejdsuge
description:
Vedligeholdelsestekniker

Vedligeholdelsestekniker til fast aftenhold – 4-dages arbejdsuge

Har du en bred teknisk forståelse, og trives du med fejlfinding, reparation og problemløsning tæt på produktionen? Kan du arbejde selvstændigt og bevare overblikket, når produktionen har brug for teknisk assistance?

Så er du måske vores nye vedligeholdelsestekniker på fast aftenhold.

Om jobbet

Vi søger en dygtig og engageret vedligeholdelsestekniker til vores vedligeholdsafdeling. Du bliver en del af vores tekniske team og får en vigtig rolle i at sikre stabil drift af vores produktionsudstyr.

Stillingen er på fast aftenhold med en 4-dages arbejdsuge.

Din vigtigste opgave bliver at supportere produktionen og få udstyret hurtigt og sikkert i drift igen, når der opstår tekniske problemer. En stor del af din hverdag vil derfor bestå af fejlfinding og reparation på forskellige typer produktionsudstyr, herunder vores mekaniske og hydrauliske pressere.

Forebyggende og planlagt vedligehold er også en del af jobbet, når produktionen og tiden tillader det. Hovedparten af det planlagte vedligehold varetages på dagholdet.

På aftenholdet vil der være perioder, hvor du arbejder meget selvstændigt. Det er derfor vigtigt, at du er tryg ved at tage ansvar, prioritere mellem opgaverne og træffe tekniske beslutninger, når situationen kræver det.

Dine primære opgaver vil være:

  • Fejlfinding og reparation på produktionsudstyr
  • Håndtering af akutte driftsstop og tekniske problemer
  • Mekanisk fejlfinding samt fejlfinding på elektriske og automatiserede systemer
  • Fejlfinding og reparation på blandt andet hydrauliske og mekaniske pressere
  • Forebyggende og planlagt vedligehold, når driften tillader det
  • Dokumentation af udførte reparationer og vedligeholdsopgaver
  • Tæt samarbejde med produktionen og resten af vedligeholdsafdelingen om at sikre en stabil drift

Om dig

Din præcise uddannelsesmæssige baggrund er ikke afgørende. Du kan eksempelvis være maskinarbejder, mekaniker, landbrugs- og maskinmekaniker, automatiktekniker, elektriker, smed eller have en anden relevant teknisk baggrund.

Det vigtigste er, at du har en bred teknisk forståelse, interesse for produktionsudstyr og lyst til at finde årsagen, når noget ikke virker.

Du arbejder selvstændigt og tager ansvar for dine opgaver. Samtidig har du en praktisk og løsningsorienteret tilgang til tekniske problemer og arbejder systematisk med din fejlfinding – også når løsningen ikke er åbenlys fra starten.

Du trives i en produktionsvirksomhed, hvor prioriteringerne kan ændre sig hurtigt, og hvor et akut driftsstop nogle gange betyder, at dagens plan må ændres.

Det vil være en fordel, hvis du har erfaring med et eller flere af følgende områder:

  • Fejlfinding og reparation af industrielt produktionsudstyr
  • Elektrisk fejlfinding
  • PLC og automation
  • Hydrauliske og pneumatiske systemer
  • Forebyggende vedligehold
  • Tekniske forbedringer og optimering af produktionsanlæg

Vi forventer ikke, at du kan det hele. Det vigtigste er, at du har en god teknisk grundforståelse, er nysgerrig og har lyst til at lære og udvikle dine kompetencer.

Da stillingen er på fast aftenhold, er det vigtigt, at du trives med denne arbejdstid. Har du tidligere arbejdet på aften- eller skiftehold, er det en fordel, men ikke et krav.

Du skal kunne tale og forstå dansk samt kunne læse og forstå engelsk, da tekniske manualer og anden dokumentation ofte er på engelsk.

Vi tilbyder

Du får en alsidig teknisk stilling med stor variation i opgaverne og en central rolle tæt på produktionen.

Vi tilbyder blandt andet:

  • Fast aftenhold med 4-dages arbejdsuge
  • En teknisk hverdag med mange forskellige typer produktionsudstyr
  • Stor grad af selvstændighed og ansvar
  • Tæt samarbejde med produktionen og dine kolleger i vedligeholdsafdelingen
  • Mulighed for faglig udvikling og for at udvide dine tekniske kompetencer
  • En arbejdsplads, hvor din tekniske indsats har direkte betydning for den daglige produktion

Lyder det som noget for dig?

Vi vil se frem til at modtage dit CV og en kort beskrivelse af hvorfor du tænker dette job er interessant for dig.

Vi vurderer ansøgninger løbende, så ansøg her: HR@steelproducts.dk.

Vi glæder os meget til at høre fra dig.

Arbejdssted: Islandsvej 25, 8700 Horsens

Steel Products beskæftiger ca. 400 medarbejdere på tre produktionssteder: Aage Østergaard i Horsens, DFT i Nordborg og Steel Products India. Vi er én af Europas førende underleverandører indenfor koldformningsprocesser, flydepresning, stansning, dybtræk og pladebearbejdning.

Vi mestrer både de komplekse og de enkle processer til fremstilling af innovative og optimerede produkter.

Vores grundprincip er at indsatserne skal skabe værdi for alle, så vi til hver en tid foretager de rette valg i forhold til processer, flow og udstyr, så det matcher vores kundernes forventninger.

Vi investerer i vores medarbejdere fordi vores nuværende og fremtidige kompetencer skal tilsikre kontinuerlig udvikling og samtidig gøre Steel Products til en attraktiv arbejdsplads og samarbejdspartner for vores kunder. Læs mere om os, vores processer, produkter og værdier her på hjemmesiden.

title: Business Director, Innovation
description:
About WPP Media

WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. With exceptional talent, trusted data and intelligence, and world-class partnerships – all united by our pioneering agentic marketing platform, WPP Open – we help clients navigate change, capture opportunity, and deliver transformational growth.

WPP Media is WPP's AI-driven media operating unit, bringing together media, data, and partnerships to deliver creative personalisation at scale. Connected through WPP Open and powered by Open Intelligence, clients see exactly where, how, and why their media investment is working.

For more information, visit wppmedia.com.

2097 - Business Director, Innovation - UK

Role Summary and Impact

About WPP 650

Join an award-winning team at the heart of UK government, where your work will genuinely shape lives. As part of WPP 650 you'll be part of a supportive, collaborative environment that values curiosity, kindness, and growth. Together, we use behaviour change principles to design smarter services, influence better decisions, and help millions of people across the country.

Named WPP 650, after the 650 UK constituencies, the name is a reminder that our work must reflect the full breadth of the country, every community, every audience. No two days are the same. The challenges are complex, the problems worth solving, and the learning constant. You'll tackle issues that matter, alongside talented colleagues who care deeply about what they do. It's demanding - but always rewarding.

This is meaningful work with real-world impact - the kind you can point to with pride.

The advertising industry is in the midst of the biggest multi-generational communications shift in history. CMOs and public sector leaders are mastering two critical transformations: delivering a data, technology & AI-powered future, and moving beyond paid advertising. Organizations must shift from interrupting people with ads to engaging people with highly relevant, trust-building experiences.

WPP Media is establishing The Experience Capability, a transformational offering that sits at the heart of integrated ESOP (Earned, Shared, Owned, Paid) strategies. This capability creates and integrates experiences across Platforms, Applied Innovation, DCO, Creators, and Creative Excellence to unlock growth for our clients' most pressing business challenges.

We are seeking a Business Director (BD), Innovation to serve as the key strategic and operational driver for our flagship UK Government account (WPP 650). Reporting directly to the VP, Innovation, this role is instrumental in developing breakthrough innovation strategies, designing cutting-edge thought-leadership frameworks, and translating complex technology/media trends into actionable public-sector campaigns.

You will work closely with multi-disciplinary planners and strategists across the entire WPP 650 team. Crucially, you will act as a key collaborative bridge—partnering with Citizen Consultancy and Behavioural Science specialists to ground creative technology in deep audience understanding, integrating DE&I frameworks to ensure innovations are accessible and representative, operationalising the implementation of innovation with Activation, Data, Tech & Analysis teams, and coordinating with dedicated Hub teams to turn strategies into high-impact public service campaigns.

A core component of this leadership role is the direct line management, mentorship, and development of 1 Account Manager, while driving a culture of creative, evidence-based experimentation across our client-facing teams.

Skills and Experience

This leader will possess a potent mix of strategic sharpness, creative curiosity, and operational discipline. They will be highly skilled at taking abstract emerging technology trends and framing them into practical, highly structured briefs that solve immediate government communication challenges.

The role demands exceptional interpersonal skills, high EQ, and organizational agility. You will navigate a complex, multi-department government landscape, building trusted relationships with senior civil servants, GCS (Government Communication Service) leads, and diverse internal agency capabilities. You must be comfortable presenting in client boardrooms and skilled at simplifying complex concepts into clear, persuasive, inclusive, and award-worthy narratives.

Key Requirements:

  • Strategy, creative, or technology-driven planning experience within a leading media agency, digital shop, or innovation consultancy.
  • Strong strategic and analytical thinker with a deep understanding of digital media, experience design (CX), and emerging technologies (such as Applied AI, conversational interfaces, and immersive formats).
  • Proven track record in strategy development—specifically in turning cultural insights and technological trends into multi-channel communication strategies.
  • Collaborative mindset with experience working alongside specialized divisions, such as behavioral scientists, qualitative research consultancies, and DE&I advisory specialists.
  • Direct report management experience with a passionate approach to mentoring junior talent, fostering their skills in strategic thinking and creative application.
  • Impeccable presentation and storytelling skills, with the ability to confidently pitch bold, evidence-based ideas and command rooms of diverse stakeholders.
  • Strong operational and organizational skills, with the ability to manage multiple complex projects, keep delivery on track, and meet tight deadlines in a fast-paced environment.
  • Experience in creating thought-leadership content, such as trends whitepapers, capability-building workshops, and client-facing educational playbooks.
  • An active problem-solver and self-starter who naturally challenges the status quo and seeks out novel ways to improve processes.

Leadership Areas

Strategic Leadership & Operationalisation (~30%)

  • Develop the UK Government Innovation Agenda: Partner with planners and strategists across the WPP 650 team to embed innovation strategies into the core of integrated communications planning.
  • Design Solution Frameworks: Develop and scale proprietary strategic methodologies tailored to public-sector challenges, aligning them to WPP Media's core priority territories.
  • Integrate Multidisciplinary Insights: Lead the strategic intersection between technology, media, and human insights by collaborating with Citizen Consultancy and Behavioural Science teams to ensure all innovation frameworks are rooted in public trust and verified behavioral change models.
  • Embed DE&I into Experience Design: Champion inclusive innovation by ensuring emerging technology applications (e.g., conversational AI, gaming, and digital hubs) are designed with accessibility, representation, and digital inclusion at their core.
  • Operationalize the Innovation Pipeline: Run the day-to-day workflows that take innovation concepts from initial brief to live campaign implementation, measurement, and post-campaign scaling.
  • Coordinate with Data, Tech & Analytics (DTA): Partner directly with the DTA team to ensure all innovation pilots have established tracking, data clean room structures, and real-time dashboarding so that clients can clearly verify performance.

Client Leadership & Consultative Impact (~40%)

  • Partner with Department & Mission Hubs: Act as the primary innovation interface for dedicated Department & Mission Hubs, translating central innovation frameworks into highly localized, campaign-specific plans that meet distinct policy and operational goals.
  • Consult on High-Stakes Briefs: Deliver bespoke strategic consultancy for key briefs across various UK Government departments, translating policy challenges into innovative, accessible citizen experiences.
  • Lead Key Client Presentations & Workshops: Articulate the commercial, operational, and social impact of WPP Media's innovation solutions during strategic reviews, pitches, and senior-level briefing responses.
  • Establish a Robust "Test & Learn" Culture: Formulate clear hypotheses and design rigorous measurement frameworks alongside behavioural scientists to validate the real-world impact (such as trust elevation or behavioral change) of innovative pilots.
  • Cultivate Key Stakeholder Relationships: Act as a primary strategic liaison for senior marketing directors, department heads, and GCS specialists, positioning yourself as their go-to advisor for creative tech and media innovation.

Team Leadership & Capability Development (~20%)

  • Directly Manage and Mentor: Line-manage, inspire, and guide 1 Account Manager, actively delegating tasks and fostering their professional growth in project execution and innovation strategy.
  • Upskill the Wider Agency: Run internal training, masterclasses, and capability programs to elevate the collective strategic capability of the wider WPP 650 planning team in emerging media, inclusive design, and behavioral-led innovation.
  • Oversee Strategy End-to-End: Ensure high standards of strategic delivery from initial citizen insight generation and behavioral mapping through to concept development, partner evaluation, and final campaign measurement.

Network Collaboration & Internal Enablement (~10%)

  • Bridge Strategy and Creative Tech: Act as the primary interface between the WPP 650 strategic planners, behavioral scientists, and the Creative Media & Tech Lab to ensure strategic insights are seamlessly translated into practical, inclusive, and executable prototypes.
  • Collaborate with Specialist Divisions: Foster seamless cross-functional collaboration within The Experience Capability, integrating innovation strategies with Platform & Creators, Applied Innovation, and WPP Production (HEX).
  • Cultivate External Partner Ecosystems: Build and maintain active relationships with external tech partners, social platforms, and creator networks to secure first-to-market opportunities and inclusive beta tests for government campaigns.

Life at WPP Media & Benefits

Our passion for shaping the next era of media includes investing in our employees to help them do their best work, and we’re just as committed to employee growth as we are to responsible media investment. WPP Media employees can tap into the global WPP Media & WPP networks to pursue their passions, grow their networks, and learn at the cutting edge of marketing and advertising. We have a variety of employee resource groups and host frequent in-office events showcasing team wins, sharing thought leadership, and celebrating holidays and milestone events. Our benefits include competitive medical, group retirement plans, vision, and dental insurance, significant paid time off, preferential partner discounts, and employee mental health awareness days.

WPP Media is an equal opportunity employer and considers applicants for all positions without discrimination or regard to characteristics. We are committed to fostering a culture of respect in which everyone feels they belong and has the same opportunities to progress in their careers.

We believe the best work happens when we're together, fostering creativity, collaboration, and connection. That's why we’ve adopted a hybrid approach, with teams in the office around four days a week. If you require accommodations or flexibility, please discuss this with the hiring team during the interview process.

Please read our Privacy Notice ( for more information on how we process the information you provide.

While we appreciate all applications received, only those candidates selected for an interview will be contacted.

title: Vil du skabe trygge eftermiddage med gåture, puslespil og pædagogik?
description:
Vil du bruge din pædagogiske faglighed i en rolig 1:1-opgave, hvor struktur, nærvær og genkendelige aktiviteter er i fokus? Så får du her mulighed for at skabe trygge eftermiddage med blandt andet gåture og puslespil for en ung kvinde i Odense N.

Om opgaven

Du bliver en fast pædagogisk støtte for en 19-årig kvinde i Odense N. Din opgave er at være sammen med hende, indtil hendes forældre kommer hjem, og skabe en tryg og forudsigelig ramme omkring eftermiddagen.

Hun har generelle indlæringsvanskeligheder og har brug for struktur, skærmning og genkendelige aktiviteter. Hun holder blandt andet af at være udenfor, gå ture og lægge puslespil. Hun har brug for støtte til at komme i gang med aktiviteter, og du tager initiativ med udgangspunkt i hendes interesser og dagsform.

I kommunikationen har hun brug for korte og enkle beskeder. Hvis hun bliver urolig eller frustreret, har hun brug for en rolig og tydelig tilgang, hvor du kan give plads til en pause og hjælpe hende med at finde ro igen.

Der indgår også lettere personlig pleje. Hun går selv på toilettet, men har brug for støtte og guidning efter toiletbesøg.

Om dig

Du er uddannet pædagog og har gerne erfaring med voksne med udviklingshæmning. Du kan skabe struktur og forudsigelighed og kommunikere kort, enkelt og tydeligt.

Det er vigtigt, at du har en rolig tilgang og kan rumme frustrationer. Du tager initiativ til aktiviteter og kan samtidig tilpasse samværet efter hendes behov og dagsform.

Det er en fordel, hvis du har kørekort og egen bil, da du så har mulighed for at hente hende i den klub, hun går i. Ved kørsel i forbindelse med opgaven bliver du aflønnet med højeste takst for kilometerpenge.

Arbejdstid

Stillingen er på 6,5 timer om ugen fordelt på tre faste eftermiddage:

Mandag kl. 16.00–18.00
Tirsdag kl. 16.00–18.00
Fredag kl. 15.30–18.00

Byd gerne ind på de vagter, du ønsker.

Vi tilbyder

Du bliver en del af en familieejet virksomhed med en masse engagerede medarbejdere. Du har en fast rådgiver, som du altid kan få sparring hos. Udenfor kontorets åbningstid er der altid en bemandet vagttelefon, så du er aldrig alene. Løn og pension i henhold til Landsoverenskomst indgået mellem FOA og Dansk Erhverv. Du er dækket af DUOS’ ansvars- og arbejdsskadeforsikring og sundhedsforsikring er en del af din pensionsordning. Vi tilbyder en bred variation af kurser, og du modtager relevant introduktion og løbende opkvalificering som medarbejder hos DUOS. Og så kan du slet ikke undgå at udvikle dig både personligt og fagligt, når du arbejder med mennesker hos os i DUOS.

Vil du være vores nye kollega?

Så send en ansøgning via linket. Du skal have en profil på mit.duos.dk og være logget ind for at søge. Vi holder samtaler løbende, send derfor gerne din ansøgning med det samme. Tiltrædelse snarest muligt. Har du yderligere spørgsmål, er du velkommen til at kontakte rekrutteringskonsulent Anika Christiansen på 3634 4990. Du kan altid finde svar på generelle spørgsmål her: FAQ

Vi er mennesker, der hjælper mennesker

I DUOS hjælper vi mennesker i hverdagen, støtter dem i svære situationer og bidrager til deres trivsel og livskvalitet. Som en af Danmarks største og ældste velfærdsleverandører stræber vi efter at være til stede der, hvor behovet er. Vi kender betydningen af den rette empati og den rette faglige viden, og vi ved, at det er afgørende at sikre det rette match mellem medarbejder og borger, hvis vores ydelser skal have værdi.

Kom og vær med på DUOS-holdet. Og gør en vigtig forskel for et andet menneske.
