title: Pædagogmedhjælper til Dybkær Specialskole - Vikariat
description:
Har du lyst til at arbejde med de dejligste børn med særlige behov?

Dybkær Specialskole søger en Pædagogisk assistent/Pædagogmedhjælper, til et vikariat, i vores særligt skærmede afdeling på Vibevej.

Stillingen er som udgangspunkt med en ugentlig arbejdstid på 37 timer, med start 1. november 2026 og frem til 25. juni 2027.

Dybkær Specialskole

Dybkær Specialskole er Silkeborg Kommunes undervisnings- og fritidstilbud til børn og unge med svære generelle indlæringsvanskeligheder. Skolen modtager elever fra Silkeborg og de omkringliggende kommuner, og i skoleåret 2026/27 går der ca. 130 elever på skolen.

På Vibevej er der to elever, der på baggrund af et særligt behov for skærmning og 1:1 tilgang, har deres skoledag i disse rammer. Arbejdet omkring eleverne består i at understøtte deres kommunikation, støtte i regulering, følge deres initiativer, tilbyde relevante aktiviteter – fx ture på sofacykel, gåtur i jogger, svømning, turtagningslege, køkkenaktiviteter, pædagogisk massage m.fl.

Pædagogisk grundlag

”Det er Dybkær Specialskoles centrale opgave at være med til at styrke og udvikle eleverne fagligt, socialt og personligt. Dybkær Specialskole skal udgøre en pædagogisk ramme om elevernes dannelse og uddannelse, så hver enkelte elev i skolens hverdag, oplever livsduelighed som menneske og samfundsborger. Når en elev går på skolen, kan han/hun forvente at blive mødt med anerkendelse og respekt. Eleven inddrages naturligt i fællesskaber og møder en tryg og struktureret hverdag. Lærere, pædagoger og medhjælpere udformer og tilrettelægger i samarbejde en meningsfuld hverdag for eleven, ud fra dennes forudsætninger og behov.

Det tætte tværfaglige samarbejde mellem pædagoger, lærere, medhjælpere og øvrige aktører, er med til at sikre de bedste vilkår for elevernes faglige, sociale og personlige udvikling. Der foregår således læring på forskellige niveauer og i forskellige situationer gennem hele elevens dag”.

Skolens elever kendetegnes ved deres behov for vidtgående specialundervisnings - og fritidstilbud. Elevernes indlæringsvanskeligheder har overordnet generel karakter, og en stor del af børnene har komplekse handicaps, som bl.a. forudsætter forståelse for- samt brug af - alternative kommunikations-strategier og hjælp til personlig pleje.

Vi arbejder med afsæt i neuroaffektiv afstemning og alle nye medarbejdere bliver opkvalificeret i den neuropædagogiske tilgang.

Vi kan tilbyde:

  • En dynamisk og travl arbejdsplads under udvikling.
  • Gode, engagerede kolleger.
  • Et veludviklet tværfagligt samarbejde.
  • Arbejde med en forskningsbaseret viden om, hvordan der skabes udvikling og læring for særligt udsatte elever (Dette baserer sig primært på en neuroaffektiv tilgang).
  • Et job med mulighed for personlig udvikling samt udvikling af dine faglige kompetencer.
  • Faglig sparring og supervision, i samarbejde med den øvrige personalegruppe.

Din profil:

  • Mod på og lyst til specialpædagogisk arbejde.
  • Brænder for at arbejde med børn og unge med særlige behov, hvor udgangspunktet er at børnene gør det bedste de kan.
  • Lyst og evne til at omsætte egen viden og ressourcer til praktisk omsorg, nærværende samvær samt målrettet aktivitet.
  • Er tydelig i din kommunikation og har et godt overblik.
  • Erfaring med – eller lyst til at tilegne dig viden om - alternative kommunikationsformer (bl.a. IKT-baserede kommunikationshjælpemidler, Tegn-til-tale og piktogrammer).
  • Kan varetage personlig pleje af børn og unge med vidtgående handicaps.
  • Kan bevare roen, når eleven reagerer uhensigtsmæssigt.

Vi ser frem til at modtage en motiveret ansøgning, hvor du tilkendegiver hvorfor du ønsker at arbejde med målgruppen og hvad du kan bidrage med af faglige og personlige kompetencer.

Ansøgningsfrist torsdag den 24. september 2026. Samtaler finder sted mandag den 28. september 2026.

Yderligere information:
Vil du vide mere om jobbet, kan du kontakte pædagogisk leder Anya Kaas Doktor – 29653619.

Løn- og ansættelsesvilkår efter gældende overenskomst og aftale om lokal løndannelse.

Der henvises i øvrigt til skolens hjemmeside: dybkaerspecialskole.aula.dk

Vi foretrækker, at du sender din ansøgning online.
Klik på Ansøg. Vedhæft din ansøgning og relevante bilag.

Vi gør opmærksom på, at der indhentes offentlig straffeattest og børneattest på den person, der ønskes ansat.

title: Residential Administrator
description:
With traumatic brain injury, life changes in an instant. For us, there is no greater reward than easing human suffering and helping people put their lives back together. As a Residential Rehabilitation Manager, you will play a critical role in transforming lives and helping individuals regain their independence and quality of life.


At CNS, we are a community of "PATHfinders" who work together to find every path possible for our patients to reach their maximum independence and quality of life. We create a supportive work environment through selflessness, innovation, and hard work. We take work very seriously, but we also enjoy a great atmosphere of fun and professional development, and we are committed to promoting a rich environment for each other to thrive through collaboration and empowerment.

Responsibilities

The Residential Rehabilitation Manager directs and coordinates activities of personnel in the Residential Rehabilitation Program to carry out its objectives in the provision of rehabilitative care. Is on the premises the number of hours necessary to manage and administer the facility in compliance with applicable law and regulation. A high degree of accuracy in documentation and observation, adaptability to a variety of situations, strong organizational and communication skills, decision making and an ability to evaluate situations as they occur is needed for this position.

This is a full-time position on the AM shift in a residential facility that operates 24 hours a day, 7 days a week. Will also include rotation of on-call work. Work is performed at the residential site and clinic and may also include the community.
  • Hires, trains, and supervises residential staff
  • Prepares weekly staffing requirement reports
  • When patients have needs identified in the needs and services plan which cannot be met by the facility but can be met by community programs, the RRM arranges for the patients to attend available community programs
  • Assures that communication between the clinic and residential setting is upheld in a manner to promote quality operations that work for the good of the patients
  • Coordinates patient admissions and discharges including NRS (Direct Care Staff) scheduling concerns
  • Conducts tours of facility for outside sources including potential patients, families, and insurance representatives
  • Maintains awareness of Residential departmental operation and objectives and need for addition, adaption or elimination of any techniques which would result in more effective service to patients
  • Assures that licensing requirements are met
  • Maintains Administrator certification as required by licensing regulations

Qualifications

Successful candidates will have:

Knowledge of the requirements for providing the type of care and supervision needed by patients, including ability to communicate with such patients
  • Knowledge of and ability to comply with applicable laws and regulations
  • Ability to establish and maintain the facility’s policy, program, budget, and financial/other records
  • Ability to recruit, employ, train, and evaluate qualified staff, and to terminate employment of staff, if applicable to the facility

Experience and Education

  • Age Requirement: Must be at least 21 years of age.
  • Educational Background: Must have at least a high school diploma or pass a general educational development test (GED). Bachelor’s degree or higher in a related field is highly preferred.
  • Work Experience: One year of work experience in residential care is required. Experience in which potential administrative and supervisory competence has been demonstrated is required.
  • Specialized Knowledge: Previous experience and/or working knowledge in rehabilitative care is highly preferred.
  • Certification: Must obtain and keep current Assisted Living Manager (ALM) certificate issued by State of Texas; however, a current Assisted Living Manager (ALM) certificate issued by Texas is highly preferred.

Benefits Package Includes:


At CNS, we value our employees and offer a comprehensive benefits package to support your well-being and professional growth. Here are some of the benefits you can enjoy as a full-time staff member:

  • Paid Time Off: Enjoy generous paid time off to relax and recharge.
  • Extended Sick Leave: Take the time you need to recover with extended sick leave.
  • Insurance: Access to PPO medical, dental, life, and vision insurance starting the 1st of the month after hire. Employment includes annual enrollment in One Medical () with telehealth also available through the company health plan.
  • We offer Daily Pay!- access your earning immediatley after you complete your shift!
  • 401(k) Plan: Plan for your future with our company matching 401(k) retirement savings plan.
  • Professional License Reimbursement: Get reimbursed for your professional license fees.
  • Continuing Education Assistance: Pursue further education with our continuing education assistance program.
  • LifeMart Benefits: As a valued member of our team, you have access to exclusive discounts and savings through LifeMart, a proprietary, members-only discount shopping website. LifeMart provides real savings on a wide range of products and services to help you manage everyday needs. Some of the benefits include:
    • Travel: Discounts on flights, hotels, car rentals, and vacation packages.
    • Tickets: Savings on movie tickets, theme parks, and other entertainment options.
    • Electronics: Deals on the latest gadgets, computers, and home electronics.
    • Family Care: Discounts on childcare, eldercare, and pet care services.
    • Wellness: Savings on gym memberships, fitness equipment, and wellness programs.
    • Home & Auto: Discounts on home improvement services, appliances, and auto care.
    • Financial and Legal: Savings on financial planning, tax services, and legal assistance.
    • Apparel: Deals on clothing, shoes, and accessories from top brands.
    • Flowers & Gifts: Discounts on flowers, gift baskets, and other special occasion items.
    • Restaurants and Dining: Savings on dining out at popular restaurants9.

Wisely Financial Services:

As part of our comprehensive benefits package, we are pleased to offer access to Wisely's financial services. These services are designed to provide flexibility and control over your finances, helping you manage your money more effectively and achieve your financial goals. Here are some of the key services offered by Wisely:

  • Early Direct Deposit: Opt-in to receive your paychecks early through direct deposit.
  • Cashback Rewards: Earn cashback rewards on purchases at participating merchants, accessible through the myWisely mobile app.
  • Prepaid Debit Cards: Use Wisely's prepaid debit cards for everyday financial transactions.

Who are you?

You have several years of relevant software development experience and strong skills in C# and Angular.

You may have a background as a computer scientist, software engineer or similar, but your practical experience and technical skills matter more than your formal education.

Experience with Microsoft Fabric, Azure, data warehouse solutions or ERP integrations is an advantage.

title: Acoustician / Researcher in Underwater Acoustics
description:
IVL Swedish Environmental Research Institute is an independent research institute with Sweden’s broadest environmental profile. Together with industry, public agencies, and the research community, we drive the transition to a sustainable society, from science to real-world impact. We operate across the full environmental and sustainability spectrum, and our activities are organized into several larger areas that bring together related expertise and perspectives.

About the Role

IVL’s activities in underwater acoustics are expanding through several new large-scale projects, and we are looking to strengthen our acoustics team. Depending on your interests, qualifications and experience, your work may include applying and developing methods for analysing and modelling underwater sound, planning and conducting field measurements, and contributing to research and innovation projects focused on the marine environment.

We welcome applications from both early-career and experienced professionals, and the scope and level of responsibility in the role will be adapted to the successful candidate’s experience and qualifications.

We are looking for a colleague who can plan and coordinate field measurements of underwater sound. Depending on your previous experience, you will either develop these skills with support from experienced team members or take a leading role from the outset. The role involves extensive collaboration with clients, partners and colleagues, requiring strong organisational skills, flexibility and the ability to communicate effectively with a variety of stakeholders.

Prior experience in underwater acoustics is not required. What matters most is a solid technical foundation and a willingness to learn. You will become part of a highly experienced team that will support your development in this exciting and rapidly evolving field.

Underwater acoustics shares many principles with airborne acoustics, but it is a younger field with fewer established standards. This means that you will often need to apply sound technical judgement rather than follow fixed methods. The role offers considerable scope for creativity, supported by close collaboration within an experienced and supportive team.

Much of our work focuses on solving practical technical and engineering challenges rather than purely acoustical ones. Therefore, curiosity, problem-solving skills and a willingness to learn are just as important as previous acoustics experience.

Current projects include developing a new measurement system for ship underwater noise (InciteShip) and creating innovative methods for mapping underwater noise from boats in coastal environments (DEMASK). These projects combine fieldwork, advanced measurements, modelling and international collaboration.

IVL is a project-oriented organisation where work is planned and executed through projects. At any given time, you will typically work in several parallel projects. You will mainly contribute to research projects, but also to commissioned assignments, often in cross-disciplinary teams.

Many projects involve close collaboration with marine biologists studying the environmental effects of underwater noise. An interest in understanding and reducing these impacts is therefore important.

You will be part of the Process Modelling and Digitalisation group. The underwater acoustics team is based in Göteborg and Fiskebäckskil, but for the right candidate it may be possible to be based at another IVL office.

Your Background

You should hold at least an MSc degree in engineering, physics, oceanography, marine science or a related field.

Relevant experience may include:

  • Acoustics
  • Signal processing
  • Programming
  • Marine measurements
  • Modelling
  • Environmental analysis


An interest in practical fieldwork is valuable, as it is an important part of most of our underwater acoustics projects. Experience from marine environments, whether through boating, studies or professional experience, is also considered an advantage.

We welcome applications from both early-career and experienced professionals:

For a junior role

  • Research experience is an advantage but not required.
  • Experience from project-based environments is beneficial.


For a senior role

  • A PhD and documented research experience within a relevant discipline are expected.
  • Experience in leading research projects, coordinating work packages, participating in international collaborations and securing research funding is highly valued.


We welcome English-speaking candidates. However, proficiency in Swedish is considered an advantage, particularly for external collaboration and stakeholder interactions.

Your Personal Qualities

We place great emphasis on personal qualities. You are proactive, responsible and well structured, with the ability to work both independently and collaboratively. Curiosity, initiative and a strong willingness to learn are essential for success in this role. Just as importantly, you will enjoy working in a positive, ambitious and collaborative team environment where people support one another and enjoy tackling new challenges together.

What We Offer You

You will join one of the leading underwater acoustics research teams in the Nordic region, with extensive experience, strong international networks and a growing portfolio of impactful projects.

At IVL, you will work in a creative, knowledge-driven environment with considerable personal responsibility and excellent opportunities for professional development. You will collaborate with experts from a wide range of disciplines and contribute to projects that support sustainable management of marine environments.

We offer an inclusive and engaging workplace that values diversity, collaboration, innovation and commitment. Employees can take part in a range of social initiatives, including a sports club, an art association and other community activities. We work in modern activity-based offices and foster a culture of knowledge-sharing, flexibility and wellbeing. At IVL, sustainability is not just something we talk about, it is at the core of everything we do.

title: Postdoctoral Fellow in Human-Centered AI and Data Visualization at Department of Computer Science, Aarhus University
description:
The Department of Computer Science at Aarhus University (Denmark) invites applications for a 18-month Postdoctoral Research Fellow position focused on Human-Centered AI and Data Visualization. The position is funded by the Center for Anytime Anywhere Analytics (CA3).

This is a full-time, on-site role located in Aarhus for a Postdoctoral Fellow at the Department of Computer Science, Aarhus University. The position is limited to 18 months (1.5 years), with an expected start date of April 1, 2027. The postdoctoral fellow will conduct research at the intersection of human-centered artificial intelligence and data visualization, funded by a Villum Investigator grant and situated within the Center for Anytime Anywhere Analytics (CA3). The focus of the position is on visualization dashboards, generative AI agents for data analysis, and the design of interactive systems that keep human analysts in control of AI-assisted sensemaking.

Responsibilities

  • Conduct research on agentic visualization: generative AI agents that collaborate with human analysts in exploratory data analysis, dashboard authoring, and visual sensemaking.
  • Design, implement, and evaluate visualization dashboards and visual analytics systems for real-world analytical workflows.
  • Collaborate with faculty members and fellow researchers on novel software tools and platforms for human-centered AI and visualization.
  • Lead and contribute to research projects spanning data visualization, human-computer interaction, and human-centered AI.
  • Coordinate scientific project activities, including planning, reporting, and coordination across collaborating partners.
  • Provide guidance and mentorship to graduate and undergraduate students working on related research projects.
  • Publish research findings in top-tier conferences and journals in computer science and related fields.
  • Contribute to grant writing and securing funding for research initiatives.
  • Participate in academic activities such as seminars, workshops, and conferences to stay abreast of the latest developments in the field.

Required Qualifications

  • Ph.D. in computer science, informatics, or closely related fields (by the start date).
  • Demonstrated expertise in data visualization, with a track record of designing and building visualization dashboards.
  • Research experience in human-centered AI, or in the integration of AI and machine learning methods into interactive visualization and analysis systems.
  • Strong background in web-based software development.
  • Knowledge of data analytics techniques and tools, including machine learning and data visualization.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills with the ability to work effectively in a collaborative research environment.
  • Strong organizational and time-management skills, with the ability to prioritize tasks and meet project deadlines effectively.
  • Ability to work independently and demonstrate initiative in formulating and executing own research projects.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with generative AI agents applied to data analysis or visualization authoring.
  • Scientific project management experience, including coordination of multi-partner research activities.
  • Experience with cloud computing platforms (e.g., AWS and Microsoft Azure).
  • Experience with commercial business intelligence and visualization tools (e.g., Tableau and Microsoft Power BI).

Place of work

Department of Computer Science, Aarhus University, Åbogade 34, 8200 Aarhus N.

For more information about the position, contact Professor Niklas Elmqvist by email: elm@cs.au.dk or by phone + 45 21 77 79 00

Application procedure

Shortlisting is used. This means that after the deadline for applications – and with the assistance from the assessment committee chairman, and the appointment committee if necessary, – the head of department selects the candidates to be evaluated. All applicants will be notified whether or not their applications have been sent to an expert assessment committee for evaluation. The selected applicants will be informed about the composition of the committee, and each applicant is given the opportunity to comment on the part of the assessment that concerns him/her self.

Formalities and salary range

Natural Sciences refers to the Ministerial Order on the Appointment of Academic Staff at Danish Universities under the Danish Ministry of Science, Technology and Innovation.

The application must be in English and include a curriculum vitae, degree certificate, a complete list of publications, a statement of future research plans and information about research activities, teaching portfolio and verified information on previous teaching experience (if any). Guidelines for applicants can be found here.

Appointment shall be in accordance with the collective labour agreement between the Danish Ministry of Taxation and the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations. Further information on qualification requirements and job content may be found in the Memorandum on Job Structure for Academic Staff at Danish Universities.

Salary and terms as agreed between the Danish Ministry of Taxation and the Confederation of Professional Unions at basic salary steps 4-8.

Aarhus University’s ambition is to be an attractive and inspiring workplace for all and to foster a culture in which each individual has opportunities to thrive, achieve and develop. We view equality and diversity as assets, and we welcome all applicants.

Research activities will be evaluated in relation to actual research time. Thus, we encourage applicants to specify periods of leave without research activities, in order to be able to subtract these periods from the span of the scientific career during the evaluation of scientific productivity.

Aarhus University offers a broad variety of services for international researchers and accompanying families, including relocation service and career counselling to expat partners. Read more here. Please find more information about entering and working in Denmark here.

Aarhus University also offers a Junior Researcher Development Programme targeted at career development for postdocs at AU. You can read more about it here.

At the Faculty of Natural Science at Aarhus University, we strive to support our scientific staff in their career development. We focus on competency development and career clarification and want to make your opportunities transparent. On our website, you can find information on all types of scientific positions, as well as the entry criteria we use when assessing candidates. You can also read more about how we can assist you in your career planning and development.

title: VASTAAVA SAIRAANHOITAJA, Hyvinvointieskus Herttuankulma- Ikifit, Turku
description:
VASTAAVA SAIRAANHOITAJA, tervetuloa meille Herttuankulmaan!

Meille on tärkeintä, että jokainen asukas saa elää turvallista, arvokasta, yksilöllistä elämää ja että työntekijämme viihtyvät ja voivat hyvin työssään. Työkavereiksi etsimme hyviä tyyppejä.

Perustehtäväsi on vastata yksikön hoidollisesta osaamisesta ja lääkehoidosta. Toimit johtajan apuna ja kykenet sijaistamaan yksikön johtajaa mm. loma-aikoina. Osallistut myös asukkaiden hoitoon ja kuntouttavaan hoivatyöhön.

Edellytämme sairaanhoitajan koulutusta sekä hyvää suomen kielen taitoa. Sinulla on aiempaa kokemusta sekä vanhusten parista asumispalveluissa että vastuutehtävistä. Ammattioikeus on oltava todennettavissa Valviran rekisteristä. Tehtävään valittavan henkilön on esitettävä nähtäväksi rikosrekisterilain 6 §:n 2 momentissa tarkoitettu rikosrekisteriote.

Tarjoamme avoimen ja joustavan työilmapiirin, toimivan työympäristön, lakisääteistä laajemmat työterveyspalvelut, ateriaedun sekä ePassin ylläpitämään työkykyäsi. Palkkaus on yksityisen sosiaalipalvelualan TES G24 D mukainen + tehtäväkohtainen lisä. Käymme hakemuksia läpi jo hakuajalla ja haku sulkeutuu, kun valinta on tehty.

Olemme savuton työpaikka. Myös hyvinvointikeskusten ja -kotien pihapiirit kuuluvat savuttomaan alueeseen.

Ikifit -Hyvinvointikeskus Herttuankulma tarjoaa ympärivuorokautista hoivaa ja hoitoa ikäihmisille sekä muistisairaille. Hyvinvointikeskus jakautuu kahteen hyvinvointikotiin; Maliniin ja Oskariin, jotka ovat 25 paikkaisia ryhmäkoteja. Panostamme asukkaidemme hyvään, mielekkääseen arkeen ja kuntoutukseen.

Ikifit on täysin kotimainen, ikäihmisten palvelujen ammattilainen. Päätehtävämme on tuottaa korkealaatuista, kokonaisvaltaista ja yksilöllistä palvelua asiakkaillemme. Monipuoliset palvelumme parantavat ikäihmisen arkea ja elämänlaatua.

title: Parts Advisor
description:

We believe our people are our greatest asset, and we’re committed to recognising the valuable contribution each person makes. That’s why we continue to invest in a leading rewards and benefits package designed to support your career, wellbeing, and life outside of work.

title: KOKKI
description:
PALKATAAN KOKKI MONIPUOLISIIN TEHTÄVIIN, VAKITUISEEN JA KOKOAIKAISEEN TYÖSUHTEESEEN

Haemme ammattitaidostaan ylpeää kokkia yksityiseen perheyritykseen hotelli Gustavelundiin. Hotellimme sijaitsee Tuusulanjärven rannalla kauniissa puistomaisemissa, noin 15 min Helsinki-Vantaan lentokentältä ja puolen tunnin ajomatkan päässä Helsingin keskustasta.

Asiakaskuntamme koostuu kokouksissa, koulutuksissa ja erilaisissa yritystapahtumissa kokoontuvista ryhmistä, joille valmistamme kokoustarjoiluja, ryhmäillallisia sekä buffetruokailuja. Toteutamme laadukkaasti ja korkeatasoisesti monipuolisia ja vaihtuvia tuotteita: päivittäin tarjolla on hotelliaamiainen sekä lounas, iltaisin tarjoillaan bankettien lisäksi A la Cartea. Viikonloppuisin tarjoilemme brunsseja, olemme myös suosittu perhejuhlien pitopaikka. Terassillamme kesäkeittiössä valmistetaan grilliruokia ryhmille sekä salaatteja, pizzoja ja hampurilaisia walk-in asiakkaille. Hotellissamme järjestetään festivaalityyppisiä tapahtumia, kuten urheiluautotapaamisia, juhannusjuhla, bändi-iltoja ja varttuneemman väen disco-iltoja. Haluamme tarjota vieraillemme mahdollisimman paljon itse tehtyä ruokaa, leivomme ja valmistamme annoksia tuoreista raaka-aineista.

Työkielenämme on suomi. Toivomme sinulta kausivaihteluiden vuoksi joustavuutta: käytössämme on MaRaTes tasausjärjestelmä. Työskentelemme pääsääntöisesti kahdessa vuorossa, arkisin kello 6.00 - 20.30, viikonloppuisin alkaen kello 7.00 ja päättyen aina kulloisenkin tilaisuuden mukaan. Työ sisältää ilta- ja viikonloppuvuoroja. Palkkauksen pohjana on MaRaTes sekä normaalit ilta-, sunnuntai- yms. lisät, Kokemuksen määrän ja laadun mukaan palkka on myös neuvoteltavissa.

Arvostamme asiakaspalvelutaitoja, vastuullisuutta ja vieraanvaraisuutta sekä innostunutta ja innostavaa asennetta. Hyvät vuorovaikutustaidot sekä ammattikoulutus ovat työssä onnistumisen edellytyksiä. Hakijoilta edellytämme aiempaa kokemusta ravintolan keittiössä työskentelystä sekä hygieniapassia.

Tarjoamme monipuolisen työpaikan, jatkuvan kehityksen ja uudistuksen alla olevat upeat puitteet, mukavat asiakkaat ja huippuluokan työkaverit. Kanssamme olet mukana kehittämässä toimintaa perheyrityksessä, jossa on helppo tuoda esiin omia näkemyksiä ja ideoita ja osallistua toiminnan kehittämiseen.

Työ alkaa heti.

title: Union Flagger
description:
About the Role:

The Union Flagger plays a critical role in maintaining safety and efficient traffic flow around construction sites, road maintenance areas, and other work zones. This position involves directing vehicles and pedestrians safely through or around work zones, ensuring compliance with all relevant safety regulations and standards. The Union Flagger acts as a vital communication link between the work crew and the public, helping to prevent accidents and minimize disruptions. This role requires vigilance, quick decision-making, and the ability to respond calmly under pressure to changing traffic conditions. Ultimately, the Union Flagger contributes to a safe working environment for both workers and the public, supporting the successful completion of infrastructure projects.

Minimum Qualifications:

  • Valid flagger certification or completion of an approved flagger training program.
  • Ability to understand and follow safety protocols and traffic control plans.
  • Physical ability to stand for extended periods and work outdoors in various weather conditions.
  • Strong communication skills to interact clearly with drivers and crew members.
  • Valid driver's license

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Previous experience working as a flagger in construction or road maintenance environments.
  • Familiarity with union work practices and adherence to union guidelines.
  • Basic knowledge of first aid and emergency response procedures.
  • Ability to operate two-way radios or other communication devices.
  • High school diploma or equivalent.

Responsibilities:

  • Direct and control traffic using hand signals, flags, and signs to ensure safe passage through work zones.
  • Set up and remove traffic control devices such as cones, barricades, and warning signs in accordance with project plans and safety guidelines.
  • Communicate effectively with construction crews, equipment operators, and motorists to coordinate safe traffic flow.
  • Monitor traffic patterns and adjust flagging procedures as necessary to respond to changing site conditions and emergencies.
  • Report any safety hazards, incidents, or equipment malfunctions promptly to supervisors.

Skills:

The required skills enable the Union Flagger to maintain clear and effective communication with both the public and work crews, ensuring safety and compliance with traffic regulations. Physical stamina and alertness are essential for managing traffic flow and responding to dynamic work zone conditions. Preferred skills such as experience with union protocols and emergency response enhance the flagger's ability to integrate smoothly into team environments and handle unexpected situations. Proficiency with communication devices supports coordination across the worksite, improving overall operational efficiency. Together, these skills ensure the flagger can perform their duties reliably, contributing to a safe and productive work environment.

title: Budtender Part Time (R. Greenleaf)
description:
​​

Who we are:
Vireo Health of Rocky Mountain is a vertically integrated cannabis company focused on retail excellence, cultivation quality, and strategic brand partnerships across our markets. We are an organization committed to delivering an exceptional customer experience while driving disciplined, sustainable growth.

Guided by our HEART values — Hard Work (Hustle), Excellence, Attitude, Respect, and Teamwork — we operate with accountability, collaboration, and a shared commitment to performance. As we continue to scale, we are building a high-performing team ready to execute and lead in a competitive environment.

What we offer:
  • Compensation: $13.00 per hour with earning potential up to $22.40 per hour including tips*
  • Part-time hours at our R. Greenleaf in ( West Side ) Albuquerque, New Mexico
*As a tipped industry, tips are and can be variable as a result of many factors, including shift availability, schedule, full-time/part-time status, hours of operations, weekends/nights, and specific dispensary. Our wage range is a realistic representation of the overall earnings opportunity when joining the Vireo Health of Rocky Mountain team, which includes prominent banners such as Star Buds, LivWell, and EveryDay Weed.

What the role is about:
As a Budtender, you play an integral role in providing exceptional customer service, offering in-depth product knowledge, and ensuring a positive and educational shopping experience for our valued customers. Your enthusiasm for cannabis products, dedication to compliance, and commitment to creating a welcoming environment contribute to our mission of promoting responsible and informed consumption.

What impact you’ll make:
Customer Service and Product Expertise (50%)
  • Extend a warm and professional welcome to customers, attentively listening to their unique preferences and requirements
  • Offer expert insights and personalized product recommendations tailored to individual preferences and usage scenarios
  • Educate customers about the advantages, potential effects, and safe consumption methods of diverse cannabis products, ensuring they make informed choices
Store Operations and Compliance (30%)
  • Uphold the appeal of our store environment, keeping it neat and visually enticing, and maintaining well-organized product displays
  • Stay updated on industry trends, the latest product releases, and ever-evolving regulations to provide accurate and timely information to customers
  • Efficiently manage cash transactions and utilize our point-of-sale system for streamlined sales processing
  • Demonstrate unwavering adherence to all company policies and procedures, ensuring full compliance with state and local regulations
Communication and Team Collaboration (20%)
  • Collaborate seamlessly with your fellow team members to cultivate a positive, customer-centric work atmosphere
  • Provide valuable support to the Management Team in various store activities and operations, including customer assistance, checkouts, and cash handling
  • Embrace other duties as assigned by the Management Team to ensure a cohesive and efficient team dynamic
Please note that the percentage allocations are a general estimate and may vary based on business needs and priorities. Additional duties may be required as needed to support overall operations.

What you’ve accomplished:
  • High school diploma or equivalent preferred
  • Must be at least 21 years of age
  • Previous experience in a retail or customer service role is preferred
  • Knowledge of cannabis and its products is a plus
  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills
  • Ability to work in a fast-paced environment
  • Proficient in cash handling and accurate basic math calculations
  • Reliable, punctual, and possesses a strong work ethic
Working Conditions (Schedule, Environment, Travel
  • Ability to lift 25 lbs. or more multiple times per day
  • Stores are open 7 days a week from 8:00 am – 11:45 pm (varying by location), nights, weekends & holidays
  • The schedule will vary depending on the needs of the business
  • Must be able to obtain and maintain a valid New Mexico Food Handler License to support safe and compliant handling of cannabis products.
Why Choose Vireo?
Life’s too short to work somewhere that doesn’t ignite your passion. The cannabis industry is fast-paced, innovative, and full of opportunity—where science meets creativity, and wellness meets culture.

At Vireo Health, we’re pioneering the future of cannabis with a team that’s as dynamic as the industry itself. Here, you’ll find a workplace that’s collaborative, inclusive, and driven by HEART and purpose, where your work has a real impact on people’s lives.

Whether you’re cultivating the highest-quality plants, crafting cutting-edge products, or shaping unforgettable customer experiences, you’ll be part of something bigger. If you’re looking for a career that’s exciting, meaningful, and full of growth, let’s build the future of cannabis together.

✅ A Growing Industry: Work at the leading tech company in the cannabis industry and help shape the future
✅ Passionate Culture: Join a team that truly cares about the plant, the people, and the purpose behind what we do
✅ Employee Perks: Enjoy competitive pay and benefits, paid time off and employee discounts
✅ Making an Impact: We’re committed to education, sustainability, and giving back to the communities we serve.

EEO Statement
Vireo Health, Inc. is an equal opportunity employer, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws. www.vireohealth.com

title: Administrativ generalist til Familie og Sundhed
description:
I Familie og Sundhed søger vi en ny kollega til en stilling som administrativ medarbejder. Vi ser frem til at byde en ny kollega velkommen til vores fællesskab og til en hverdag, der er præget af alsidighed og imødekommende understøttelse til et bredt fagområde, der til hverdag gør en stor forskel på børn, unge og familier i Gentofte Kommune.

Om jobbet

Du bliver en del af sekretariatet i Familie og Sundhed, som består af fem medarbejdere i administrationen, tre ledelses- og udviklingskonsulenter, en jurist, praktikant og studentermedhjælpere. Vi arbejder alle både med faste ansvarsområder og tværgående ad hoc-opgaver.

Stillingen er først og fremmest en generalistfunktion, hvor du skal have lyst til at sætte dig ind i forskellige opgaver og bidrage bredt til den administrative understøttelse af fagområderne i Familie og Sundhed. Samtidig får du et særligt ansvar for udvalgte opgaver, hvor du bliver vores administrative nøgleperson.

Dine primære ansvarsområder bliver:

  • Administrativ understøttelse af PPR
  • Administration af aflastere, herunder ansættelse, løn og opfølgning på bevillinger
  • Understøttelse af tilgængelighed i Gentofte Kommune
  • Tværgående administrative opgaver og udvikling af arbejdsgange
  • Sparring med ledelse og medarbejdere om brugen af vores administrative systemer

Derudover vil du indgå i en række fælles opgaver sammen med dine kolleger om blandt andet:

  • Børn- og ungepostkassen
  • Underretninger og kvitteringsbreve
  • Tværgående aktindsigter
  • Lettilgængelige behandlingstilbud
  • Telefonbetjening og borgerkontakt
  • Onboarding af nye medarbejdere
  • Indgå i afdelingens hjemmeside-team og sikre, at afdelingens websider er opdaterede
  • Administrative opgaver i forbindelse med visitationsudvalg og andre tværgående indsatser

Vi arbejder tæt sammen om opgaverne og hjælper hinanden ved ferie, fravær og spidsbelastninger.

Hvem er du?

Vi forestiller os, at du:

  • Er serviceminded og møder borgere og samarbejdspartnere professionelt
  • Har erfaring med administrative opgaver – gerne fra en kommune eller anden offentlig organisation
  • Har gode IT-kompetencer og lærer nye systemer hurtigt
  • Arbejder struktureret, selvstændigt og har blik for detaljer
  • Er god til at skabe overblik og er opsøgende på opgaver
  • Trives med en varieret arbejdsdag og mange samarbejdsflader
  • Er en holdspiller, som bidrager til et godt samarbejde og vores fælles arbejdsmiljø

Kendskab til PPR eller børne- og ungeområdet er en fordel, men ikke et krav.

Om os

Familie og Sundhed arbejder for at skabe de bedste rammer for børn, unge og familier i Gentofte Kommune.

Du bliver en del af fælles sekretariaet i Familie og Sundhed – i daglig tale ”Staben” - som understøtter hele området. Vi er en enhed, der lægger vægt på samarbejde, fleksibilitet og høj faglighed. Hos os hjælper vi hinanden, deler viden og udvikler løbende vores arbejdsgange, så vi kan skabe den bedste understøttelse af både borgere og kolleger.

Vi er en del af en lærende organisation, hvor udvikling, psykologisk tryghed og fælles ansvar er vigtige værdier i hverdagen.

Vi tilbyder

  • En meningsfuld hverdag tæt på kerneopgaven
  • En bred stilling med stor variation i opgaverne
  • En rolle med både selvstændigt ansvar og tæt samarbejde med kollegaer
  • Dygtige og engagerede kolleger
  • Fleksibilitet og mulighed for hjemmearbejde
  • Gode muligheder for faglig og personlig udvikling, blandt andet gennem kompetenceudvikling og Styrket Borgerkontakt
  • En kollegial hverdag med fokus på samarbejde, omsorg og plads til både faglighed og fællesskab

Løn- og ansættelsesvilkår

Stillingen er fleksibel på mellem 32-37 timer om ugen med flekstid, og vi hjælper hinanden med at få arbejdsliv og privatliv til at hænge godt sammen.

Løn- og ansættelsesvilkår sker i henhold til gældende GKF, som lokalforhandler ud fra HK-overenskomst.

Der vil i forbindelse med ansættelsen blive indhentet straffe- og børneattest.

Vi opfordrer alle kvalificerede ansøgere til at søge uanset etnisk oprindelse, religion, alder, køn, handicap eller anden baggrund.

Vil du vide mere?

Hvis du vil høre mere om stillingen, er du velkommen til at kontakte souschef Nicoline Pontoppidan Jørgensen på telefon 20 34 99 60.

Det praktiske

Send din ansøgning senest søndag den 18. oktober kl.12.00.

Vi forventer at afholde samtaler i uge 43, og du skal forvente to samtalerunder.

Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig.

title: Chefkonsulent med solid erfaring i økonomi-, produktions- og risikostyring samt ledelsesstøtte
description:
Vil du arbejde med økonomi- og produktionsstyring? Og bringe dine erfaringer i spil et kontor, der yder ledelsesstøtte til direktør og underdirektører. Har du en skattefaglig baggrund og erfaring fra en stor offentlig organisation? Så er det måske dig, vi skal have en ansøgning fra.

Ansvarsområder og opgaver
Du får til opgave at styrke, udvikle og videreføre tværgående opgaver, herunder at støtte Persons 4 driftsafdelinger med produktionsstyring. Dine arbejdsopgaver vil blive tilrettelagt efter din profil, men du kan forvente at skulle bidrage med at:

  • Tværgående analyser af produktionsdata
  • Styring af Persons økonomi- og produktionsdata
  • Understøtte og deltage i udvikling af nye driftsstyringskoncepter
  • Fungere som sparringspartner for særligt kontorets nye kollegaer
  • Deltage i div. arbejdsgrupper mv. på tværs af Skattestyrelsen
Du bliver en del af Persons Styringskontor der med 14 medarbejdere, en kontorchef og en souschef, der blandt andet har ansvaret for økonomi- og produktionsopfølgning, udvikle div. analyser, samt generel understøttelse af fagområdet Persons proces og driftsafdelinger.

Hvorfor vælge os?
Du kommer ind i en af Danmarks største arbejdspladser med de fordele der er ved det. Fx meningsfulde og udviklende opgaver i en organisation, der skaber samfundsmæssig værdi i et sundt arbejdsmiljø og med gode arbejdsvilkår. Som en stor offentlig organisation kan vi tilbyde ordnede og regulerede forhold, fleksibilitet og løbende faglig udvikling.

Vores kultur er præget af et stærkt fagligt miljø, der udvikler og udfordrer dig. Vi prioriterer det gode samarbejde og du kan forvente en travl, meningsfuld og sjov hverdag i en kompleks organisation med mange kolleger og samarbejdspartnere på tværs af Skatteforvaltningen.

Vi arbejder dagligt med afsæt i vores 4 værdier:

  • Høj faglighed skal sikre de rigtige processer og produkter.
  • Vi samarbejder i alle dele af Skatte- og Vækstministeriets koncern med en særlig forpligtelse til at pleje og vedligeholde relationer, fordi det skaber merværdi og øger kvalitet.
  • Vi tager ansvar i alt, hvad vi laver, og gør gerne en ekstra indsats, når det er nødvendigt.
  • Vi har udsyn og altid øje for, hvordan vores løsninger påvirker vores omverden.
Skatte- og Vækstministeriet lægger vægt på at understøtte fleksible arbejdsvilkår, og rammerne for arbejdstilrettelæggelsen drøftes mellem leder og medarbejder med udgangspunkt i den samlede opgaveløsning.

Om dig
Med udgangspunkt i ovenstående søger vi en stærk profil med betydelig erfaring fra lignende funktioner. Opgaveporteføljen kræver betydelig skattefaglig indsigt. Vi forestiller os derfor, at du har en relevant uddannelsesmæssig baggrund med efter- og videreuddannelse inden for området.

Samtidig søger vi en profil, for hvem styring, opfølgning, faglighed og samarbejde falder naturligt. Vigtigt er også, at du har lyst til videndeling og sparring i forhold til interessenter og kolleger med forskellig uddannelsesmæssig baggrund og erfaring.

Kontakt og ansættelsesvilkår
Ansøgning og CV bedes sendt via linket ”Søg stillingen” senest fredag den 2. oktober 2026. Har du spørgsmål til stillingen, er du velkommen til at kontakte funktionsleder Lars Lynge Christensen på 72 38 88 31.

Vi forventer at holde første samtaler uge 41. For ansøgere, der går videre i processen, kan det komme på tale, at der indgår en personprofilanalyse samt en logisk test som en del af rekrutteringsprocessen. Inden ansættelse indhentes der straffeattest og referencer.

Hvis du går videre til ansættelse i rekrutteringsforløbet, skal du være opmærksom på, at vi foretager en undersøgelse af, om du har gæld, der er sendt til inddrivelse hos det offentlige. Vi undersøger ligeledes, om du har afgjorte kontrol- og/eller straffesager på skatte- og afgiftsområdet. Din ansættelse sker under forudsætning af, at vi ikke finder oplysninger om dig, der er uforenelige med en ansættelse i Skatte- og Vækstministeriets koncern.

Du bliver ansat på overenskomstvilkår i henhold til enhver tid gældende overenskomst for akademikere i staten (AC) eller overenskomst for fuldmægtige m.fl. (DTS) i Skatte- og Vækstministeriet. Du bliver ansat i Skatte- og Vækstministeriet med tilhørende institutioner.

Dagen kan ligge på en byggeplads, i en renovering eller som et mindre servicebesøg, alt efter hvad der er planlagt. title: Electronic Trading Engineer (Retail Routing)
description:
Virtu is a leading financial firm that leverages cutting-edge technology to deliver liquidity to the global markets and innovative, transparent trading solutions to our clients. As a market maker, Virtu provides deep liquidity that helps to create more efficient markets around the world. Our market structure expertise, broad diversification, and execution technology enables us to provide competitive bids and offers in over 19,000 securities, at over 235 venues, in 36 countries worldwide.

The firm's complementary core offerings—market making, client execution services, and trading venues give Virtu a competitive advantage in developing and applying innovative tools that deliver efficiencies and performance across the organization.

THE ROLE

Virtu's Risk Management team is a globally connected and fast-paced group, responsible for the framework that routes retail equity orders to market. Sitting at the intersection of trading and engineering, the team plays a central role in how Virtu manages risk in real time, across markets and around the clock.

As markets move toward 23/5 trading, overnight coverage has become a core part of how this framework operates globally. In this role, you'll support live systems during Asia hours, acting as the first line of defense while our US teams are offline, thinking like a trader when markets move, and like an engineer when the system needs to evolve. It's a hands-on, coding-intensive role with real ownership over production systems, that blends disciplined risk management with the deeper work of building and improving the systems behind it.

  • Monitor automated trading and risk infrastructure, identifying and resolving issues in real time and escalating issues when needed
  • Develop new strategy features and deploy code changes through the team's standard review process
  • Design, run, and report on retail routing experiments
  • Shape the team's priorities based on what you see overnight, and help support the shift to 23/5 trading
  • Partner with traders and developers across regions to strengthen system resilience as overnight coverage expands
  • Develop a deep, hands-on understanding of risk systems, order flow, and market structure

THE CANDIDATE

  • Minimum 3 years of experience at a financial institution
  • Bachelor’s Degree in a quantitative field preferred
  • Strong experience with Python
  • Experience working with large datasets in SQL
  • Knowledge of US equity market structure (venues, smart order routing, order types, trade reporting) a plus
  • Experience with Java or C++ a plus
  • Statistical analysis experience a plus
  • Calm under pressure in fast-moving, time-sensitive environments
  • Strong attention to detail and a track record of accurate, high-quality work
  • Excellent problem-solving and communication skills
  • Team player with flexibility in time commitment

THE PROCESS

After passing an application screening, candidates will be sent an online programming test via email from a service called HackerRank as a first step of the process. This is to gain an understanding of candidates coding ability.

Virtu Financial is an equal opportunity employer, committed to a diverse and inclusive workplace, welcoming you for who you are and does not discriminate on the basis of race, national origin, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, or other legally protected status.

title: Handicaphjælper nat/dag søges til BPA-ordning i Ørestad
description:
67-årig mand, tidligere forsker, søger hjælp til både natte- og dagvagter.

Jeg er halvsidigt lammet, i kørestol, og søger 1-2 nye hjælpere (16-32 timer ugtl.) til min BPA-ordning, Der er tale om vågne nattevagter (mulighed for hvil) og dagvagter af mindst 7-9 timers varighed i fast rul. Vagterne vil lejlighedsvis kunne være længere, og det er meningen, at hjælperne skal kunne dække hinanden ved sygdom og ferie. Jeg har brug for hjælp 24-7. Mit hjælperhold består af 6-7 hjælpere. Jeg søger 1-2 nye hjælpere, da én skal på studieophold i udlandet, en anden går ned i tid. Jeg er meget glad for mine hjælpere, og de fleste har været hos mig i lang tid.

Jeg er 67 år gammel, vokset op i England, har arbejdet som forsker (økonomi) og har også tilbragt en del år af mit arbejdsliv udenfor Danmark. Der kommunikeres både på engelsk og dansk i hjemmet, ved hjælpermøder udelukkende på engelsk, så et godt engelsk er et must. Bor nu centralt i Ørestad, tæt på metro og togstation, sammen med min kone og hund (en whippet). Havde et aktivt internationalt liv før jeg blev syg , og fritiden gik med golf, hiking, jagt, fiskeri, læsning, museumsbesøg, historisk og naturvidenskabeligt interesseret, god mad og aktivt socialt liv med venner og familie. Blev for snart fem år siden ramt af invaliderende blodprop i hjernen. Jeg er nu lam i venstre side af kroppen, sidder i manuel kørestol og har mistet venstre synsfelt.

Der er behov for hjælp til det meste: F.eks.: personlig pleje, toiletbesøg, påklædning, klargøring af måltider, forflytninger, rengøring af opholdsrum, bil og hjælpemidler, vasketøj samt diverse praktiske opgaver, som jeg ikke længere er i stand til at udføre. Herudover hjemmetræning af såvel krop som syn samt ledsagelse til træning hos neuro-fysioterapeut m.m. Jeg har desværre også brug for hjælp om natten, dvs. nogle gange skal jeg op at sidde pga. kramper, og ellers forebyggende og aflastende øvelser, hjælp til at blive vendt, toiletbesøg m.m.

Jeg har min egen handicapbus, og hvis du er en erfaren og sikker chauffør, vil du også kunne køre mig. Kørekort er dog ikke noget krav. En god kemi er det vigtigste.

Selv om jeg stadigvæk er svært handicappet, har jeg fået trænet en del tabte kræfter tilbage, især i ben, og er derfor meget motiveret til fortsat at træne såvel gangfunktion som syn. Det er vigtigt, at du selv er robust og i god form.

Når alt dette er sagt, er jeg også en meget privat person, jeg udtrættes meget let, og har ofte brug for ro. Når der således ikke er brug for dig, må du gerne trække dig til hjælperværelset, det samme gælder, når jeg er sammen med min familie.

Du kommer derfor til at tilbringe en del tid på hjælperværelset, både nat og dag, hvor du kan studere, læse eller. lign.

Lidt om dig: Du er mellem 22 og 67 år gl.. God fysik. Du skal kunne tale engelsk og dansk. Ikke ryger. God hygiejne vægtes højt. Sitationsfornemmelse.

Der vil løbende indkaldes til samtale.

Husk gerne at notere dit telefonnummer i ansøgningen.

title: Staff Data Scientist
description:
About Us

Riskified empowers businesses to unleash ecommerce growth by taking risk off the table. Many of the world’s biggest brands and publicly traded companies selling online rely on Riskified for guaranteed protection against chargebacks, to fight fraud and policy abuse at scale, and to improve customer retention. Developed and managed by the largest team of ecommerce risk analysts, data scientists and researchers, Riskified’s AI-powered fraud and risk intelligence platform analyzes the individual behind each interaction to provide real-time decisions and robust identity-based insights.

Riskified is proud to work with incredible companies in virtually all industries including Booking.com, Acer, Gucci, Lorna Jane, GoPro, and many more.

Abundant opportunities to create and contribute provide us with a sense of purpose that extends beyond ourselves, leaving a lasting impact. These sentiments capture why we choose Riskified every day.

About the Role

The Data Science department powers Riskified’s core engine by building production-grade algorithmic solutions at immense scale. As a Staff Data Scientist on the Identity team, you will drive the innovation roadmap for our Identity Graph Engine. You will architect, research, and deploy state-of-the-art machine learning models - spanning graph neural networks, transformers, and deep tabular architectures - to solve complex entity resolution and fraud prevention challenges at scale.

What You'll Be Doing

  • Drive Identity Graph Innovation: Architect and advance the next generation of our Identity Graph Engine using state-of-the-art graph models, transformers, and machine learning techniques.
  • Technical Leadership: Define the research roadmap for identity resolution, setting technical standards and guiding complex research projects from initial concept to high-throughput production systems.
  • Large-Scale Modeling: Build scalable predictive and representation-learning models over massive tabular, sequence, and graph-structured datasets.
  • Cross-Functional Architecture: Collaborate closely with Data Engineering, Core Software, and Product teams to seamlessly integrate complex ML pipelines into real-time production environments.
  • Mentorship & SOTA Research: Benchmark and import cutting-edge academic research into practical business solutions while mentoring senior data scientists on modern modeling paradigms.

Qualifications

  • Education: M.Sc. or Ph.D. in Computer Science, Statistics, Mathematics, or a related quantitative field.
  • Experience: 6+ years of hands-on experience designing, training, and deploying complex machine learning models in large-scale production environments.
  • Deep Learning & SOTA Models: Proven expertise with Transformers, Deep Neural Networks (DNNs), Graph Neural Networks (GNNs), or Advanced Tabular Learning architectures.
  • Big Data Ecosystem: Strong practical experience working with large-scale distributed data processing systems (e.g., Spark, Databricks) and graph databases/frameworks.
  • Technical Influence: Proven track record of technical leadership, setting architectural direction, and translating complex business requirements into high-impact algorithmic solutions.

Advantages

  • Experience in fraud detection, risk management, or fintech.
  • Experience in Identity Resolution, Entity Disambiguation, Link Analysis, or Complex Network Modeling.

title: Miljø- og Logistikteamet på Rigshospitalet Glostrup søger vikarer til rekvirentteamet.
description:
Vi mangler to kollegaer der har lyst til at være en del af vores team og deltage i alle de forskelligartede opgaver vi har: Servicering af hospitalets afsnit med engangsartikler og varer, udbringning af medicin og linned samt vask af bl.a. dyner og puder på vores interne vaskeri.

Vi er en mindre gruppe på 6 rekvirenter plus 4 hospitalsmedhjælpere i Uniformsbutik/vaskeri, og er en del af vores store enhed på knap 35 kollegaer. Vi er meget afhængige af hinanden, og det er derfor vigtigt for os, at vi kan hjælpe hinanden på tværs af vores arbejdsopgaver. Derfor er der også mulighed for at få kendskab til og viden om vores nærmeste kollegaers arbejde, der er dygtige inde for deres felt som er uniformsbutikkerne, vaskeriet, mindre flytninger samt affaldshåndtering.

Vi er en gruppe på 35 meget forskellige mennesker, med forskellig baggrund og alder, og vi bidrager alle til en god arbejdsdag med godt humør og professionel adfærd.

Vi kan love dig følgende:

  • Fri i weekender og en arbejdstid der ligger i tidsrummet kl. 7.00-15.00.
  • Gennemsnitlig 37 timers arbejdsuge over en normperiode.
  • En god sidemandsoplæring hvor vi har særlig fokus på hygiejne og varesikkerhed (dit kerneområde).
  • Altid at have noget at lave, da vi har hænderne på alt hvad der skal frem til afsnit og retur fra afsnit.
  • Kendskab til vores IT, da alle vores opgaver og oplæringsprogrammer ligger på en mobiltelefon (CSL).
  • Nogle rigtig gode kollegaer, der favner bredt.
  • Et fysisk arbejde med fokus på korrekte løfteteknikker, benyttelse af hjælpemidler og altid fokus på smarte arbejdsgange for at minimere dobbelthåndteringer.
  • Mulighed for medlemskab af hospitalets eget motionscenter Pusterummet for kr. 125 pr. mdr., hvor man kan træne på alle tidspunkter uden for arbejdstid. Der er mulighed for, at en pårørende kan blive medlem.
Hos os er det vigtigt at:

  • du vægter faglighed meget højt.
  • du er i fysisk god form, da det er et hårdt fysisk arbejde med varer der skal leveres.
  • du bidrager med god energi i vores enhed og kan nikke ja til at leve op til vores værdier, som er professionalisme, ansvarlighed, trivsel og troværdighed.
  • vi og hospitalet kan regne med dig.
  • du kan arbejde selvstændigt og tage beslutninger.
  • du ikke er bange for at hjælpe i den store gruppe, hvis det brænder på. Vi løfter i flok.
  • du er bevidst om, at du er en del af en meget vigtig opgave, så patienterne behandles korrekt og til tiden.
  • du har forståelse for IT, da vi benytter det i vores dagligdag.
Det er en fordel, hvis du har erfaring med at arbejde i en større virksomhed.

Stillingen er til besættelse hurtigst muligt og senest 1. december 2026 til og med 30. november 2026 med efterfølgende mulighed for fastansættelse.

De første 8 måneder er månedslønnen kr. 26.952,83. Efter 8 måneder stiger månedslønnen til kr. 27.634,33 + pension.

Miljø- og Logistikteamet er en serviceenhed under Klinisk Forsyning og Logistik og er forankret i Servicecentret sammen med de øvrige serviceafdelinger.

Ansøgning sendes senest torsdag den 1. oktober 2026, kl. 12.00.

Ansættelsessamtaler afholdes i uge 41 og 42.

Rigshospitalet er røgfrit og rygning tillades ikke på hospitalets område.

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=iBQ4gLVraJ0

title: IT and Security Lead
description:
This role brings IT and security ownership in-house. You'll take responsibility for the platform architecture and security practices that protect Holistic AI's systems, data and the trust of our enterprise customers, working closely with Engineering, leadership and commercial teams as we build and scale our security capabilities.


It's a hands-on role with broad ownership across IT, security, platform architecture and customer security requirements. You'll establish practical security practices, support enterprise customers and make sure security stays embedded in how we build and run our platform.


About Holistic AI


Holistic AI builds AI governance and assurance tooling for enterprise customers. Our platform helps organisations test AI systems responsibly and align their governance with frameworks such as the EU AI Act and NIST. We're a team of about 40 people, hiring carefully: quality over speed. As we grow, we need dedicated in-house ownership of IT and security.


What you'll do


  • Own and advance our IT and security posture across company systems and the product platform.
  • Contribute to platform architecture decisions with a security-first lens.
  • Establish and maintain practical security controls, access management and operational hygiene.
  • Support enterprise customer and audit expectations on security, including the processes and evidence they require.
  • Partner with Engineering on secure design, vulnerability management and incident readiness.
  • Work with Sales and other teams on customer RFPs, security and InfoSec questionnaires, and other customer security requirements.
  • Join customer calls to explain our security controls, practices and approach, and address customer security concerns.
  • Develop and maintain security policies, procedures and documentation as the company grows.
  • Support security risk management across systems, vendors and third-party services.
  • Build IT and security capabilities towards sustainable in-house ownership.


What you'll bring


  • 7+ years of experience in IT security, security engineering, or platform or security ownership roles.
  • Working knowledge of cloud security, identity and access management, and secure architecture fundamentals.
  • Experience supporting enterprise customer security requirements, including RFPs and InfoSec questionnaires.
  • Confidence speaking directly with customers and explaining security concepts and controls to technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Comfort working independently, getting hands-on where needed and building structure where none exists yet.
  • The ability to prioritise risk pragmatically in a growing company: protecting what matters without freezing delivery.
  • Clear communication with technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • An ownership mindset and strong documentation habits that support a growing team.


Nice to have


  • Experience with security frameworks, audits or compliance requirements such as SOC 2, ISO 27001 or GDPR.


Location and working model


  • London, United Kingdom.


Compensation


We offer competitive benefits; details are shared during the hiring process.

  • HR screen
  • Hiring manager interview
  • Technical assessment
  • Task or skills assignment
  • Culture fit
  • Offer

title: Personlig assistent sökes – till aktiv 8-årig kille
description:
Vi söker en trygg, lyhörd och engagerad personlig assistent som vill arbeta 50-70% hos en härlig 8-årig kille. Han tycker om fart, lek och att vara aktiv, så detta är ett jobb för dig som gillar att röra på dig och hitta på roliga och aktiva saker tillsammans med honom.

Som personlig assistent blir du en viktig del av hans vardag och hjälper till att skapa en trygg, rolig och meningsfull tillvaro.

Han har epilepsi, autism och en intellektuell funktionsnedsättning. Han kan ibland bli utåtagerande. Det är därför viktigt att du är lugn, trygg och kan bemöta honom på ett respektfullt och anpassat sätt. Erfarenhet av autism, epilepsi och lågaffektivt bemötande är meriterande, men det viktigaste är att du är villig att lära dig och förstå hans individuella behov.

Vi söker dig som:

  • Är trygg, lugn och lyhörd

  • Är flexibel och kan hoppa in vid behov

  • Tycker om att vara aktiv och hitta på roliga saker

  • Har erfarenhet av epilepsi, autism eller intellektuell funktionsnedsättning, eller är villig att lära dig

  • Har kunskap om lågaffektivt bemötande eller är intresserad av att lära dig

  • Har tålamod och ett respektfullt förhållningssätt

  • Är rökfri

  • Gärna har möjlighet att arbeta kvällar, helger och lov

Det viktigaste är att du är en person som kan vara närvarande, flexibel och lyhörd för hans behov. Du behöver kunna anpassa dig efter dagsform och situation och samtidigt bidra med trygghet, energi och glädje.

Om oss

Omsorg Assistans är ett assistansbolag med huvudkontor i Eskilstuna och kunder över hela Sverige. Vår målsättning är att skapa de bästa förutsättningarna för en trygg, individanpassad och kvalitativ personlig assistans.

Vår värdegrund bygger på engagemang, lyhördhet och tillgänglighet.

Som anställd hos oss får du bland annat:

  • Kollektivavtal

  • Marknadsmässig lön

  • Tjänstepension

  • Försäkringar

  • Friskvårdsbidrag

För oss är trygghet viktigt – både för våra kunder och våra medarbetare.

Vi begär alltid utdrag ur polisens belastningsregister i samband med anställning.

🌻 Låter detta som något för dig?

Vi söker dig som vill ha ett meningsfullt extrajobb där du får göra skillnad och samtidigt vara med på en aktiv och rolig vardag.

Skicka gärna in din ansökan och berätta lite om dig själv, din erfarenhet och varför du tror att du skulle passa som personlig assistent.

Varmt välkommen med din ansökan – vi ser fram emot att höra från dig! 🌻

title: Designer - Womens/Missy
description:
Hybrid’s humble beginnings started in 1997 in the back of a print shop designing, selling, and printing tee shirts. Today, Hybrid is a global apparel industry powerhouse in brand and licensing management. Hybrid provides its expertise and fully vertical operations capability – design, merchandising, development, sourcing, production, and distribution – to a broad suite of branded, licensed, generic, and private label partners. Hybrid’s full-service apparel design and manufacturing expertise extends across the apparel category, including knits, woven tops, bottoms, tees, and accessories.

As our organization has evolved, so has our philosophy of doing business. We have made concerted efforts to remove ourselves from the antiquated approach of other apparel manufacturers and doing things differently has been our focus. We are building a company ethos that breeds innovation, collaboration, integrity and excellence in customer service.

What is my role?
As a Designer, you are responsible for supporting the Design Director in all aspects of creating and executing monthly retailer presentations and special projects (from concept to final proto samples).

What You'll Do

  • Drive creative along with the Design Director in creating styles from concept to completion; direct Associate, Assistant Designers through line development
  • Monitor development of preproduction samples in partnership with the Product Developer
  • Work with Sales and Director to create direction in silhouette, fabric, and concept for specific retailers/market
  • Ensure presentations are executed at the highest creative level
  • Attend and lead in fit sessions

Key Accountability Area: Capability

  • Ability to give direction to Team members to create a cohesive product line
  • Working knowledge of garment construction, textile, and current finishing techniques
  • Artistic Hand, strong sense of color and style
  • Manage deadlines in accordance with the calendar
  • Demonstrate strong verbal, organization and written communication skills
  • Strong Team player who can work independently in a fast paced environment
  • A multi-tasker; proactively seeks out opportunities to support the Team with can-do and follow through attitude
  • Timely sense of trends and market encompassing color, fabric, silhouettes, and graphics

· Bede indgangsbøn og udgangsbøn

· Bistå ved nadveruddeling

· Har en god sangstemme

· Selvstændigt kan lære nye salmer og sange

· Er loyal i forhold til hvad vi som kirke samles om

Vi tilbyder:

· En velsyngende menighed

· Engagerede kollegaer

· Et godt arbejdsmiljø med høj faglighed og godt samarbejde med præster, ansatte og menighedsråd

· Mulighed for at ansøge om relevante kurser

Gjellerup Sogn er et stort og aktivt sogn med en engageret menighed. Der er ofte to højmesser om søndagen og dåbsgudstjeneste og andre kirkelige handlinger om lørdagen.

Visionen for Gjellerup Sogn er at være ”En kirke, der rækker ud til alle i sognet gennem et mangfoldigt og udadvendt kirkeliv”.

Ansættelsen sker ved Gjellerup menighedsråd, Kirkebyvej 1, Gjellerup, 7400 Herning.

Ansættelse af en kirkesanger er omfattet af Fællesoverenskomsten mellem Skatteministeriet og CO10 - Centralorganisationen af 2010 og organisationsaftale mellem Kirkeministeriet og CO10 for kirkefunktionærer med kerneopgaver som henholdsvis kordegn, sognemedhjælper/kirke- og kulturmedarbejder eller kirkemusiker og det tilhørende protokollat for kirkemusikere.

Aftalerne kan ses på .

Årslønnen aftales indenfor intervallet 333.747,00 kr. – 475.590,00 kr.
Der er rådighedsforpligtelse til stillingen. Rådighedstillægget udgør årligt 27.641,00 kr.
OK-tillæg på 1.082,00 kr. pr. år.
Alle ovenstående beløb er anført i nutidskroner pr. 01.08.2026 for en fuldtidsstilling.
Ved deltidsansættelse vil der ske regulering af lønnen i forhold til ansættelseskvoten.

Aftale om indplacering i lønintervallet indgås mellem menighedsrådet og Dansk Kirkemusiker Forening.
Der er 3 måneders prøvetid.
Der indhentes børneattest ved ansættelse.

Nærmere oplysninger om stillingen fås ved henvendelse til personaleansvarlig, Per Aarestrup Wedel tlf. 2228 3430 eller administrationschef Jan Brøchner 3036 5246.

Ansøgning med relevante bilag sendes til menighedsrådet på mail: 8799fortrolig@sogn.dk senest søndag d. 18. oktober 2026. Ansættelsessamtaler forventes at finde sted i uge 43.

title: Supply Chain Coordinator
description:
AtriCure, Inc. provides innovative technologies for the treatment of Afib and related conditions. Afib affects more than 33 million people worldwide. Electrophysiologists and cardiothoracic surgeons around the globe use AtriCure technologies for the treatment of Afib and reduction of Afib related complications. AtriCure’s Isolator® Synergy™ Ablation System is the first medical device to receive FDA approval for the treatment of persistent Afib. AtriCure’s AtriClip® Left Atrial Appendage Exclusion System products are the most widely sold LAA management devices worldwide. AtriCure’s Hybrid AF™ Therapy is a minimally invasive procedure that provides a lasting solution for long-standing persistent Afib patients. AtriCure’s cryoICE cryoSPHERE® probe is cleared for temporary ablation of peripheral nerves to block pain, providing pain relief in cardiac and thoracic procedures. For more information, visit AtriCure.com or follow us on LinkedIn.

ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS OF THE POSITION:

  • Supervise warehouse/customer service activities outsourced to the 3PL

  • Coordinate Rework and Quarantine disposition activities

  • Coordinate item master data activities

  • Marketing & Professional Education Outbounds

  • Weekly Stock Reconciliation

  • Work closely with Warehouse operator

  • Assist/Back up Logistics/Operations/Sales Operations activities

ADDITIONAL ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS OF THE POSITION:

  • Ability to work under fast-paced conditions

  • Ability to make decisions and use good judgment

  • Ability to prioritize various duties and multitask as required Ability to successfully work with internal and external customers

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS SKILLS & REQUIREMENTS:

  • MBO degree

  • Minimum 3-5 years' experience in supply chain, customer service or sales support Strong written/verbal communication in English

  • Ability to work in a variety of systems (ERP systems, CRM, Service Management Systems, WMS/TMS)

  • Basic import and export knowledge

  • Ability to commute to primary place of work at AtriCure Service Center in Den Bosch, The

  • Strong MS Excel skills

What We Offer

With AtriCure, you'll get the opportunity to work with a team that is passionately dedicated to improving the lives of patients with Atrial Fibrillation worldwide. It is also a company that will invest in your professional development to help you grow and be successful in your role.

In Addition, AtriCure Also Provides:
The chance to work with an international team with more than 20 different nationalities, with 150+ international employees (on-site and in the field) which makes it a dynamic place to work.

The offer includes a competitive base salary, company bonus plan, mobility or Company car policy (depending on position), training and development opportunities, Paid annual leave, 2 days’ volunteer time off + 1 cultural heritage day per year, mental health support benefit, and dynamic company events.

Our Process

If this round is successful, you will get to meet a few of our team members to give you diverse perspectives about AtriCure. After all the interviews, we conduct reference checks to help us make the final decision.
