title: Declaration of interest regarding PhD project in renal calcium transport
description:
Declaration of interest regarding PhD project in renal calcium transport

The laboratory of Henrik Dimke, Cardiovascular and Renal Research Unit at the Department of Molecular Medicine, University of Southern Denmark is seeking a highly motivated PhD student in the field of renal transport physiology. Particular emphasis will be placed on signalling through the calcium-sensing receptor and the regulation of renal calcium transport in transgenic models.

Research environment

The PhD student will join the laboratory of Professor Henrik Dimke in the Cardiovascular and Renal Research Unit. The laboratory studies epithelial ion transport and the mechanisms that maintain calcium, magnesium, and phosphate balance, with particular emphasis on renal calcium transport, the calcium-sensing receptor, claudins, and kidney stone disease. The Research Unit focuses on innovative molecular and biomedical research related to cardiovascular and renal physiology. We offer a stimulating, international research environment where English is the preferred language at meetings and seminars. You will work in the modern NytSUND building, which is directly connected to the new Odense University Hospital and provides state-of-the-art laboratory and animal facilities. You can read more about the department and institute here.

Project description

The project will investigate how altered calcium-sensing receptor (CASR) signalling disrupts the endocrine and renal control of calcium homeostasis. Particular attention will be given to autosomal dominant hypocalcaemia type 1, in which excessive CASR activity suppresses parathyroid hormone secretion and promotes renal calcium loss. The project will examine the signalling mechanisms linking CASR activation to renal calcium transport and whole-body calcium balance. The successful applicant will use clinically relevant genetic models, including inducible and cell-specific transgenic approaches, together with detailed physiological characterization, molecular and biochemical techniques, and imaging.

Qualifications

Qualified and highly motivated candidates from all nationalities are encouraged to apply.

The successful applicant must have

  • A Master's degree (Danish: kandidatgrad) or another relevant degree that concludes a research-based study programme of minimum five years’ duration at an institution of higher education. If you do not have a Master's degree, the Graduate School will make an individual assessment of your academic qualifications.

  • Good oral and written English language skills

  • you must at the time of submission have documented research experience. E.g. be the author or co-author of an article in a peer-reviewed international journal (must at least be submitted) or of a published abstract from an international scientific conference, or have worked as research assistant full time for at least 6 months (after completing your masters degree). The research experience of each applicant is individually assessed by the Graduate School.

The successful applicant should have

  • The ability to work independently and in a structured manner.

  • Good collaborative and interpersonal skills.

  • Previous experience with experimental animal work or relevant molecular and biochemical techniques, such as western blotting or immunohistochemistry, is preferred but not required.

For further information about the project, please contact:

Professor Henrik Dimke

Department of Molecular Medicine

University of Southern Denmark (SDU)

Tel. +45 65 50 83 10 E-mail: hdimke@health.sdu.dk


Applications must include:

• A letter stating the interest, motivation and qualifications for the project (max. 2 pages) - upload under “Application form”.
• Detailed CV, including personal contact information
• Certified copy of diploma (Master’s degree in a relevant field)

• • Contact details for at least one professional reference who may be contacted during the assessment process.


Shortlisting may be used in the assessment process. References will normally be contacted only for shortlisted candidates.

Further information about the PhD-program can be found at the homepage of the University.


Applications must be submitted electronically using the link "Apply now". Attached files must be in Adobe PDF format. We strongly recommend that you read How to apply for a position at SDU before you apply.

Incomplete applications and applications received after the deadline will neither be considered nor evaluated.

Closing date: October 12th, 2026


Successful candidates will be asked to send an application to the PhD Secretariat, Faculty of Health Sciences, to be enrolled as PhD students.

The PhD programme will be carried out in accordance with Faculty regulations and the Danish Ministerial Order on the PhD Programme at the Universities (PhD order).

Salary and Working Conditions at SDU

PhD students employed at SDU are employed as PhD fellows according to the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations in public employment (AC) agreement.


Salary and any salary supplement are paid according to your seniority level and as negotiated with your union representative. The base salary (excluding 18.07% pension contribution) is DKK 374,912.98.

The Faculty of Health Sciences at the University of Southern Denmark is one of Denmark’s leading faculties of health sciences. With nine departments, internationally top‑class research, and a broad range of health‑related study programmes, we contribute to developing the knowledge, treatments, and healthcare system of the future.

As an employee at the faculty, you become part of an ambitious and interdisciplinary environment characterised by high academic standards, strong collaborations, and excellent opportunities for professional development. The faculty has activities in Odense, Esbjerg, and Copenhagen. In Esbjerg and Copenhagen, strong academic communities provide the framework for research and education, while our modern faculty building in Odense brings research, education, and administration together under one roof and is directly connected to Odense University Hospital.

The University wishes our staff to reflect the diversity of society and thus welcomes applications from all qualified candidates regardless of personal background.

title: Deputy Money Laundering Reporting Officer
description:
Who We Are

At OKX, we believe crypto will help reshape the future and contribute to greater individual freedom.
OKX is a leading crypto exchange and the developer of OKX Wallet, giving millions of customers access to crypto trading and decentralised applications. OKX is also trusted by institutions seeking secure access to crypto markets and is supported by its Proof of Reserves programme.
Across our global offices, we are united by three core principles: We Before Me, Do the Right Thing, and Get Things Done. These values shape how we work and help us create a collaborative, rewarding and diverse environment for every OK-er.

About the Team

The Compliance function is responsible for promoting a strong compliance culture and supporting the safe, sustainable growth of OKX. We are a team of risk-minded problem solvers who advise the business on regulatory obligations, conduct expectations and enterprise risks.

About the Opportunity

We are looking for a Deputy Money Laundering Reporting Officer (Deputy MLRO) to support the MLRO in overseeing and further developing the organisation’s AML/CFT and financial crime compliance framework within a MiCA-regulated crypto-asset environment. The role will provide exposure to a broad range of financial crime matters, including customer due diligence, transaction and blockchain monitoring, investigations, suspicious activity reporting and regulatory engagement.
The Deputy MLRO will act as a key AML/CFT subject-matter expert across the organisation, providing oversight, advice and challenge to ensure that financial crime risks are appropriately identified, assessed and managed. The role will also support the continuous enhancement of AML/CFT systems and controls, ensuring that they remain effective, proportionate and aligned with the organisation’s evolving products, customer base and risk profile.
Working closely with the MLRO and stakeholders across Compliance, KYC, Transaction Monitoring, Operations, Product, Legal and Risk, the successful candidate will play an important role in maintaining a strong financial crime compliance framework while supporting an efficient and risk-based customer experience.

What You’ll Be Doing

  • Support and deputise for the MLRO, including assisting with AML/CFT governance, management and Board reporting, regulatory matters and oversight of the organisation’s financial crime compliance framework.
  • Oversee complex AML/CFT investigations and escalations, including transaction monitoring alerts, blockchain activity, higher-risk customer relationships and internal suspicious activity reports, ensuring decisions and rationale are appropriately documented.
  • Support suspicious activity reporting processes, including assessment of potential suspicion, preparation and review of external reports where appropriate, and maintenance of appropriate confidentiality and controls against tipping off.
  • Provide second-line oversight of KYC, CDD and EDD, including higher-risk customers, Source of Funds and Source of Wealth assessments, customer risk classification, ongoing monitoring and periodic or trigger-based reviews.
  • Oversee and enhance transaction and blockchain monitoring controls, including scenario and threshold calibration, effectiveness testing, identification of emerging typologies and initiatives to improve detection quality and reduce unnecessary false positives.
  • Provide AML/CFT expertise on crypto-specific risks, including self-hosted wallets, cross-chain activity, DeFi, mixers, privacy-enhancing technologies and other emerging risks, as well as applicable Travel Rule requirements.
  • Support regulatory engagement and continuous improvement, including regulatory inspections and information requests, audits, remediation programmes, new product and service risk assessments, AML/CFT training and implementation of relevant regulatory developments.

What We’re Looking For

  • Relevant AML/CFT and financial crime experience, preferably gained within a regulated CASP/VASP, crypto exchange, fintech, payments business or financial institution, with experience in a senior AML, financial crime or compliance role considered an advantage.
  • Strong knowledge of EU AML/CFT requirements and the risk-based approach, together with a good understanding of the regulatory framework applicable to CASPs, including MiCA and the EU Transfer of Funds Regulation/Travel Rule.
  • Practical experience across core AML/CFT disciplines, including CDD/EDD, Source of Funds and Source of Wealth, customer risk assessment, transaction monitoring, investigations and suspicious activity reporting.
  • Strong understanding of crypto-assets and blockchain-related financial crime risks, with experience using or interpreting blockchain analytics and transaction monitoring tools considered a strong advantage.
  • Strong analytical and investigative skills, with the ability to assess complex customer and transactional activity, distinguish unusual but legitimate behaviour from genuine financial crime concerns, and reach well-reasoned and defensible decisions.
  • Excellent judgement, communication and stakeholder-management skills, including the confidence to provide independent challenge, escalate material concerns and communicate effectively with senior management, operational teams, auditors and regulatory authorities.
  • Relevant academic or professional qualifications, with a degree in law, finance, economics, compliance, risk or a related field and/or recognised AML/financial crime qualifications such as CAMS, ICA or equivalent considered an advantage.

Perks & Benefits

  • Competitive total compensation package.
  • Learning and development programmes and an education subsidy.
  • Team-building programmes and company events.
  • Wellness and meal allowances.
  • Comprehensive healthcare schemes for employees and dependants.
  • Additional benefits that we would be pleased to discuss during the recruitment process.

OKX Statement

OKX is committed to providing equal employment opportunities regardless of race, colour, genetic information, creed, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, lawful alien status, national origin, age, marital status, non-job-related physical or mental disability, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.
Notice:
All official OKX vacancies are published on this website. While roles may appear on selected third-party platforms from time to time, information on other sites may be inaccurate or outdated. If in doubt, please apply directly through our official careers website.
Information collected and processed as part of the recruitment process of any job application you choose to submit is subject to OKX's Candidate Privacy Notice.

title: Klargøringsmedarbejder til Porsche Center København - En del af Semler Premium
description:
Er du serviceminded og ønsker at arbejde med nogle af verdens mest ikoniske bilmodeller? Semler Premium søger lige nu en erfaren klargøringsmedarbejder, der kan sikre, at vores biler altid fremstår i perfekt stand. Hvis det lyder som noget for dig, så er det nu, du skal slå til!

**
Om jobbet**
Du bliver en del af et team, som hver dag stræber efter at sikre høj kundeservice. I afdelingen har vi et meget tæt samarbejde, som er helt centralt for at lykkedes i hverdagen. Dine opgaver indebærer at klargøre biler til salg både nye og brugte, samt udføre kundesolgte klargøringsydelser som polering og coating.

Arbejdstiden udgør 37 timer om ugen, og veksler inden for tidsrummet kl. 07.00 – 16.00.

Om dig
Som person har du et stort servicegen og går aldrig på kompromis med kvaliteten. Du bidrager med godt humør, gåpåmod og en positiv attitude, der smitter af på dine kollegaer. Vi søger en dygtig kollega med erfaring inden for klargøring af biler og et godt kendskab til, hvad arbejdet indebærer. Det er et krav, at du har gode færdigheder med polering og coating af biler, gerne keramisk coating.

Derudover forventer vi, at du:

  • Trives med selvstændigt arbejde og tager ansvar for dine opgaver
  • Ikke er bange for at tage fat og trives med at vaske og klargøre biler
  • Har lyst og evne til at arbejde i et team med højt tempo
  • Er mødestabil og omstillingsparat, da teamet har flere forskellige ansvarsområder i forretningen
  • Har kørekort til personbil

**Om os
**Semler Premium i København er en del af Semler Gruppen, som er Danmarks største virksomhed i bilbranchen med over 100 års erfaring inden for import og salg af biler. Du kan derfor se frem til at blive en del af et inspirerende og dynamisk bilhus med gode kolleger.

Vi tilbyder frokostordning, sundhedssikring samt fordelagtige medarbejdergoder, vi prioriterer et godt arbejdsmiljø, samt sociale arrangementer.

**
Hvad kan du forvente af mig som leder?**
Jeg værdsætter en positiv fejlkultur. Alle kommer før eller senere til at lave en fejl. Det vigtige er, at vi lærer af vores fejl og deler dem med vores kolleger. På den måde gør vi hinanden bedre. Og endelig er jeg optaget af vores kunder. Det er i sidste ende dem, der betaler vores løn. Derfor betyder det meget for mig, at vi sammen hjælper hinanden med at give kunderne de bedst tænkelige oplevelser. Jeg går meget op i, at vi har et fantastisk arbejdsmiljø, og værdsætter en direkte og ærlig dialog.

**Lyder dette som noget for dig?
**Så vil vi se frem til at modtage din ansøgning. Vi indkalder løbende til samtale, så søg gerne allerede i dag. Ansøgningsfristen er den 15.oktober 2026.

Tiltrædelse er hurtigst muligt. Har du spørgsmål til stillingen, er du velkommen til at kontakte Værksteds- & Klargøringschef Dennis Larnkjær Lassen på tlf. 46911909 eller dela@porsche.dk

Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig.

Din vej. Fælles fremtid

Som ny kollega i Semler Gruppen bliver du en del af et stort fællesskab på mere end 3000 kollegaer. Vi er fordelt over hele landet, og arbejder med alt fra landbrugets tungeste maskiner til selvkørende teknologi og delebiler.

At være en del af en stor organisation betyder, at der er talrige muligheder for at udvikle sig både fagligt og personligt. Vi har f.eks. en hel uddannelsesafdeling, som tilbyder efteruddannelse og certificeringer i samarbejde med vores producenter. Sidst men ikke mindst kan vi hjælpe dig på vej med vores udviklingsværktøj GROW, som intelligent og systematisk matcher dine kompetencer op imod udviklingsmulighederne i Semler Gruppen.

Alle er vi forenet af et sæt fælles værdier, der fungerer som den daglige gps for vores måde at arbejde på.

Vi er ordentlige. Vi holder hvad vi lover, også når det kræver en omvej. Sådan er det, når ambitionen er at have de mest tilfredse kunder og leverandører i de brancher vi operer i.

Vi er dedikerede. Vi står distancen og kommer i mål.

Vi er nytænkende. Fordi man ikke bliver Danmarks største bilaktør af at køre på autopilot.

Vi har glimt i øjet. Med respekt for hinanden og godt humør bliver det rarere at gå på arbejde.

title: Muottitimpuri
description:
Etsimme ammattitaitoista muottitimpuria Turkuun!

Tehtäviisi kuuluu monipuoliset muotti- sekä valutyöt julkisivusaneerauskohteessa. Sinulla tulee olla kokemusta kyseisistä työtehtävistä ja eduksi katsotaan kokemus parvekeremonteista. Työmaa sijaitsee Turussa ja työt alkaa heti sopivan henkilön löydyttyä. Hyvälle tekijälle on tiedossa pitkäaikainen projekti.

Odotamme sinulta:

* Aikaisempaa kokemusta muotti- ja valutöistä vähintään muutaman vuoden ajalta
* Kykyä työskennellä korkealla
* Hyvää asennetta ja fyysistä kuntoa
* Voimassa olevaa työturvallisuuskorttia

Tarjoamme sinulle:

* Mahdollisuuden pitkään työsuhteeseen
* Mahdollisuuden kehittyä alalla
* Mukavan työporukan
* Yrityksemme tuen koko työsuhteesi ajan


Palkka: Rakennusalan TES:n mukaan (n. 15,60-18,70 €/h), aikaisempi kokemuksesi huomioon ottaen.
Jätäthän hakemuksesi ensisijaisesti työpaikan hakulinkin kautta, kiitos.

Lisätietoja tehtävästä antaa: Samu Virtanen, samu@arworekry.fi, p. 044 902 3278


Arwo Rekry Oy - Tunnemme työsi arvon.

Yrityksemme synty perustuu yksinkertaiseen, mutta vahvaan ajatukseen: kaikki lähtee kohtaamisesta. Meille henkilöstöpalvelu ei ole vain työpaikkojen täyttämistä, vaan luottamuksen rakentamista ja kestävien kumppanuuksien luomista. Olemme helposti lähestyttävä, ihmisläheinen ja asiantunteva kumppani, joka tarttuu toimeen ja seisoo sanojensa takana. title: KYC Specialist – French Market
description:
About the opportunity

We are looking for a Specialist in Know-Your-Customer (KYC) to join our growing French Market KYC team in our Madrid office. In this role, you will take ownership of key processes within KYC and ensure an optimal user experience.

In KYC, our goal is to lead and shape the industry by fostering a culture of compliance within N26 that is trusted by authorities, customers, and shareholders. For that purpose, your expertise in KYC is fundamental. Particularly in Ongoing Due Diligence (ODD) and Enhanced Due Diligence (EDD) for Customers and Politically Exposed Persons (PEP), will be instrumental for your success in this position.

The Specialist role is centered on operational excellence and the effective management of daily cases. Through dedication and continuous learning, an L1 becomes a fundamental member of the team in ensuring N26's regulatory compliance.

In Your Next Challenge, You Will:

  • Apply In-depth knowledge of regulatory requirements and industry best practices related to EDD and ODD processes.

  • Apply your experience with due diligence processes related to High-Risk Customers (HRC) and Politically Exposed Persons (PEP).

  • Correctly apply established policies in each case assessment, maintaining a clear understanding of compliance requirements to ensure quality work.

  • Contribute to the maintenance of the Service Level Agreement (SLA): Efficiently manage assigned cases, ensuring deadlines are met.

  • Showcase your proficiency in using KYC tools, platforms, and software for efficient processing and management of EDD and ODD cases.

  • Demonstrate your analytical and investigative skills to assess and mitigate risks associated with High Risk customer profiles.

  • Showcase your ability to interpret and analyse financial statements, transactions, and other relevant data to make informed decisions.

  • Conduct thorough and accurate assessments, identifying risks and relevant documentation.

  • Demonstrate a high level of Problem-Solving skills, continuously proving the ability to identify and solve problems independently.

  • Exhibit outstanding team Collaboration, working collaboratively in a multicultural and fast-paced team environment.

  • Foster open dialogue within the team and share key case findings. Actively seek help and feedback for professional growth.

  • Collaborate with other internal teams (such as MLRO or Customer Support) to resolve questions quickly and effectively.

  • Adapt quickly to process changes and maintain a positive attitude. Actively participate in the adoption of new guidelines and tools.

  • Be exposed to a fast-paced environment, demonstrating openness to learning and incorporating new methodologies and technologies into the KYC workflow.

  • Participate in projects, contribute ideas, and execute assigned tasks.

  • Embrace our Customer-Centric Approach, focusing on enhancing the user experience for our customers undergoing the KYC process, balancing compliance requirements with a seamless and user-friendly approach.

What You’ll Need to Be Successful

Background:

  • Hands-on experience in KYC, ideally with exposure to Enhanced Due Diligence (EDD) and Ongoing Due Diligence (ODD).

  • Proven track record of managing and resolving KYC cases efficiently.

  • Previous experience in similar fast-paced Finance and Banking companies is desired, but not mandatory.

Skills:

  • Excellent hands-on experience in KYC Operations.

  • Knowledge of banking regulations is preferable.

  • Strong analytical skills, with the capability to independently generate insights.

  • Proactive and detail-oriented with the ability to maintain a positive mindset and excel under pressure.

  • Fluency in English and French is mandatory; proficiency in additional languages is an added value.

  • Exceptional interpersonal and communication skills, with proven experience in supporting stakeholders through complex situations.

What’s in it for you

  • Accelerate your career growth by joining one of Europe’s most talked about disruptors .

  • Employee benefits that range from a competitive personal development budget, work from home budget, discounts to fitness & wellness memberships, language apps and public transportation.

  • As an N26 employee you will have access to a Premium subscription on your personal N26 bank account. As well as subscriptions for friends and family members.

  • Vacation days vary depending on your location of work. Additional day of annual leave for each year of service.

  • A high degree of autonomy and access to cutting edge technologies - all while working with a friendly team of peers of diverse nationalities, life experiences and family statuses.

  • A relocation package with visa support for those who need it.

Who we are

N26 has reimagined banking for today’s digital world. Technology and design empower everything we do and it’s how we are building the global banking platform the world loves to use.

We've eliminated physical branches, paperwork, and hidden fees for an elegant digital experience and supreme savings. Giving people the power to live and bank their way is what gets us out of bed in the morning and inspires the work that we do.

Founded in 2013, N26 now has 7 million customers in 24 markets. We employ more than 1,500 employees across 3 office locations in Berlin, Vienna and Barcelona. Besides the main offices, N26 also has local offices in Paris, Madrid, Milan, and São Paolo.

Sounds good? Apply now for this position.

N26 is an equal opportunity employer and values diversity. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status or disability status.

title: Mid SOC Analyst
description:
Wrike is the most powerful work management platform. Built for teams and organizations looking to collaborate, create, and exceed every day, Wrike brings everyone and all work into a single place to remove complexity, increase productivity, and free people up to focus on their most purposeful work.
Wrike is our people, not a place. As a distributed team, we own our growth, stay globally connected, and rely on the product we build to deliver impactful work alongside brilliant minds. You'll have real ownership over meaningful work, a global team that has your back, and the flexibility to do your best work your way. If that sounds like you, we'd love to hear from you.
Our vision: A world where everyone is free to focus on their most purposeful work, together.

About the Role:

With flexible, distributed-first ways of working, you'll have the support to do your best work, wherever you are. Wrike commits to its customers that their data is monitored around the clock. Our Security Operations Center delivers on that promise through a hybrid model with a 24/7 managed detection partner (Rapid7)—and our analysts are the core drivers who handle escalations, conduct deep-dive investigations, and execute immediate action.

As an L2 SOC Analyst, you will play a pivotal role in our security rotation: monitoring and triaging security alerts, responding to escalations from our MDR partner, investigating incidents end-to-end, and continuously maturing our detection capabilities to protect Wrike and our customers.

Your Impact:

  • Alert Triage & Escalation: Monitor, triage, and investigate security alerts and events, including direct escalations from our 24/7 MDR partner (Rapid7).
  • Incident Containment & Forensics: Assess risk and impact of potential incidents, conducting end-to-end investigations (log analysis, endpoint forensics, scoping) and taking swift remediation actions.
  • On-Call Coverage: Participate in the SOC on-call rotation to guarantee round-the-clock escalation coverage.
  • Detection Engineering & Tuning: Continuously refine and tune detection rules to minimize false positives and identify genuine threats faster.
  • Proactive Threat Hunting: Contribute to threat hunting initiatives across endpoints, identity providers, SaaS platforms, and cloud environments.
  • Process Improvement: Help document, refine, and optimize SOC playbooks, runbooks, incident reports, and operational escalation workflows.

Your Qualifications:

  • Experience: 2–3+ years of hands-on experience in a SOC or security monitoring environment (alert triage, incident investigation, and response).
  • Technical Proficiency: Hands-on experience with SIEM platforms (Rapid7 InsightIDR or similar) and EDR/antimalware tooling for endpoint investigations.
  • Core Knowledge: Strong understanding of network security fundamentals, common threat vectors, and attack frameworks (MITRE ATT&CK).
  • Problem-Solving & Communication: Sharp logical thinking and analytical skills paired with advanced written and verbal English communication abilities.
  • Availability: Ability and willingness to participate in an on-call rotation, including occasional nights and weekends.

Standout Qualities:

  • Hybrid Model Experience: Prior experience collaborating directly with an MDR or MSSP partner in a hybrid SOC environment.
  • Extended Tooling Expertise: Hands-on familiarity with tools such as Splunk, Wazuh, Microsoft Defender for Endpoint, Crowdtrike, Okta, Google Workspace, AWS, or GCP.
  • Advanced Capabilities: Previous experience in active threat hunting, detection engineering, or task automation using Python/Bash.
  • Industry Certifications: Relevant security certifications (e.g., Security+, CySA+, GCIH, GCDA, or vendor-specific certifications).

Team Dynamics:

You will join a highly collaborative, vigilant, and supportive Security Operations Center team. In this role, you will work closely with internal incident responders, cross-functional IT and infrastructure teams, and directly alongside analysts from our 24/7 MDR partner (Rapid7). The team culture values transparent communication, continuous learning, and collective ownership of security outcomes.

Our Work Style:

We operate in a dynamic, hybrid security model utilizing modern cloud-first security tooling.

  • Tech Stack & Tools: Rapid7 InsightIDR, EDR/XDR platforms, Okta, Google Workspace, AWS/GCP, and custom Python/Bash automation scripts.
  • Methodologies: Framework-driven incident response aligned with MITRE ATT&CK, structured playbooks, and continuous threat-hunting cycles.
  • What Makes Us Different: Unlike traditional SOC environments burdened by endless repetitive alerts, our hybrid model leverages an MDR partner to offload initial noise. This allows our L2 Analysts to focus on complex investigations, high-impact threat hunting, and genuine detection engineering.

Benefits & Perks:

  • 18 calendar days of paid vacation
  • 12 days of National & Festival holidays (10 fixed, 2 flexible)
  • Sick Leave Compensation (5 Paid Uncertified Sick Days)
  • Menstrual Leave: Twelve (12) days per calendar year. Women employees are eligible for up to 1 day of menstrual leave per month.
  • Parental Leave: 26 Weeks Maternity / 4 Week Paternity
  • 2 Volunteer Days
  • Group Medical Insurance (Employees + Dependents)
  • Term Life Insurance (Rs 50,00,000)
  • Personal Accident Insurance (Rs 50,00,000)
  • Monthly Broadband / Internet Reimbursement (INR 1500)
  • Hybrid Working Model + Complimentary Lunch & Snacks

Your recruitment buddy will be Nandini Singh, Recruiter.

#LI-NS2

Who Is Wrike and Our Culture

We’re a team of innovators and creators who solve the complex work problems of today and tomorrow.
Hybrid work mode

Wrike is our people, not a place. With 1,000+ employees collaborating across nearly every time zone, we support talent through 10 global hubs — Australia, Costa Rica, Cyprus, Czechia, Estonia, France, India, Ireland, Japan, and the United States — offering flexible ways of working that include remote work, hybrid environments, and co-working spaces across many locations.
While flexibility looks different across teams and regions, employees located near certain hubs — particularly in Prague (CZ), Nicosia (CY), Bangalore (IN), and Rennes (FR) — are generally expected to collaborate in person around 2–3 days per week, balancing the flexibility of distributed work with opportunities for in-person collaboration and connection.

Our persona

💡 Smart: We love what we do, and we’re great at it because this is our domain. Our combined knowledge in this space is unmatched.
💚 Dedicated: We get up every day focused on helping our customers win. We’re committed to helping our teammates win, too!
🤗 Approachable: We're friendly, easy to get along with, considerate, and helpful.

Our culture and Values

🤩 Customer-Focused

We care about our customers. We understand the customer journey, experience, and value derived from Wrike. Decision-making and action-taking are done with the customer in mind.

🤝 Collaborative

We work as one and win together, each bringing unique strengths that contribute to diversity of thought for better outcomes. Leveraging our own work management platform, we foster an environment of creative collaboration and shared achievement.

🎨 Creative

We strive to succeed through continuous innovation. It’s our pursuit of novel concepts that helped us create a market category. We continue to cultivate a workplace that fosters creative thinking as a means of transcending conventional boundaries and empowers us to break new ground to deliver extraordinary work management solutions.

💪 Committed

We believe in ownership at all levels of the organization, by owning workflows from start to finish. Each member of our team is an integral part of this commitment, establishing work as a platform for personal growth and transformation, as well as collective success and growth.

Check out our LinkedIn Life Page, Company culture page, Instagram, Wrike Engineering Team, Medium, , Youtube for a feel for what life is like at Wrike.

title: Local Democracy Reporter
description:
The Westmorland Gazette and daily title The Mail is looking for an outstanding reporter to cover politics in one of Newsquest’s busy Cumbrian newsrooms as part of the Local Democracy Reporting scheme.

You will join a team with an award-winning track record of agenda-setting council stories and play a vital role in supporting the BBC’s public journalism programme.
We need someone with excellent knowledge and passion for local government, as well as the ability to write engaging content.

The vacancy is available as part of the BBC-funded local democracy scheme and is ideal for a senior reporter looking to expand their career. Applications will also be considered from outstanding newly NCTJ-qualified reporters.

The Local Democracy Reporting Service is a partnership between major news publishers and the BBC, meaning your stories will be seen across numerous print and online products.

This is a flexible role that requires covering council meetings, some of which are held in the evenings, while also providing a good work-life balance.

The role will be based at the Westmorland Gazette’s Kendal office within a flexible hybrid working model, with some days working from home.

This is a fantastic opportunity to join a great team on a competitive salary, hone your skills and learn from some of the best journalists across regional news and the BBC.
  • Cover local politics and council meetings across Cumbria.
  • Produce engaging, accurate and impactful journalism on local government issues.
  • Deliver agenda-setting council stories that inform and engage local audiences.
  • Support the BBC’s public journalism programme through the Local Democracy Reporting Service.
  • Create content for publication across multiple print and digital news platforms.
  • Attend evening council meetings where required.
  • Excellent knowledge of and passion for local government and politics.
  • Strong news-gathering, interviewing, and reporting skills.
  • Ability to write engaging and accurate content to deadline.
  • Strong understanding of public interest journalism.
  • Senior reporter experience is welcome, although we will also consider outstanding newly NCTJ-qualified reporters.
  • Ability to work independently while contributing effectively to a wider newsroom team.
  • A flexible approach to working patterns, including attending some evening meetings.
The closing date for applications is October 2, 2026.

Applications will be reviewed as they are received, so submit your details as soon as possible.

title: Svejser til maskinbygning og servicesvejsning i Broager
description:
Vil du have firmabil, fast arbejde og svejsning på specialmaskiner?

Vi mangler en svejser til maskinbygning og servicesvejsning i Broager.

Du lander i en industrivirksomhed, hvor svejsning hænger tæt sammen med maskinbygning og teknik. Her bygges og serviceres produktions- og indpakningsmaskiner til industrien, så arbejdet kræver mere end bare at lægge en pæn fuge. Maskinerne bliver tilpasset kundernes produktion, og derfor skal reparationer og småændringer laves ordentligt første gang. Arbejdet foregår i Broager, hvor du bliver en del af et setup med både produktion, service og tekniske folk omkring dig.

Rollen passer til dig, der kan tage ansvar for din svejsning og sige til, hvis noget ikke stemmer. Du får firmabil som en del af pakken, og lønnen ligger på 200-220 kr. i timen. Mottoet er enkelt: Det skal være sjovt at gå på arbejde.

Det får du

Løn: 200-220 kr. i timen

Firmabil: Ja

Arbejdsområde: Broager og omegn

Overenskomst: Ansat under gældende overenskomst

Ansættelse: Fastansættelse - vi søger folk, vi kan arbejde med i mange år. Ingen korte forløb.

Hverdag: Maskinbygning, reparation og servicesvejsning

Din hverdag

Dagen handler om konkrete svejseopgaver på maskindele, reparationer og serviceopgaver, der skal videre i produktionen. Du vælger metode ud fra opgaven, bruger MAG, MIG eller MMA, og siger til hvis noget ikke stemmer.

Du kommer blandt andet til at arbejde med:

  • Udfører MAG, MIG og MMA svejsning
  • Reparerer og servicesvejser på maskiner og komponenter
  • Svejser i sort stål eller rustfrit
  • Udbedrer fejl, så delene kan videre til næste trin

Når en reparation viser sig større end først vurderet, melder du det videre, så der bliver taget stilling før næste trin. Det vigtigste er, at svejsningen holder, og at du ikke afleverer noget halvt.

Vi leder efter dig, der kan sætte kryds ved det meste

Du skal ikke være ekspert i hvert eneste hjørne af faget. Men du skal kunne stå inde for det du afleverer.

Vi forestiller os, at du:

  • Har mindst 3 års erfaring som svejser
  • Har kørekort
  • Kan arbejde sikkert med MAG, MIG eller MMA
  • Møder stabilt og holder dine aftaler
  • Siger til, hvis noget ikke stemmer

Det er en fordel, hvis du har erfaring med reparation og servicesvejsning. Men det vigtigste er, at du kan tage fat og lave svejsning der holder.

Allerede i job?

Så skal det selvfølgelig give mening at skifte.

Derfor starter vi med en uforpligtende snak. Du kan høre mere om opgaverne, virksomheden, lønnen og hverdagen, før du beslutter noget. Og ja, det foregår diskret.

Hvis det her lyder som noget for dig, er opstart Hurtigst muligt.

Du behøver ikke sende en lang ansøgning. Tryk på Ansøg job, så ringer vi dig op og tager den derfra.

Om PowerMatch

Hos PowerMatch matcher vi dig kun med job, der lever op til dine krav på løn, opgaver, kultur, firmabil og hvad der ellers betyder noget for dig.

Du starter direkte ude i virksomheden. Vi arbejder kun med forløb, hvor målet er fastansættelse. Ikke korte vikariater.

Hvis jobbet ikke viser sig at være det rigtige match, hjælper vi dig videre til noget, der passer bedre.

PowerMatch har 5 stjerner på Trustpilot baseret på 500+ anmeldelser fra håndværkere og fagfolk som dig.

Du optjener point hos PowerMatch, som du kan bruge på 1000+ forskellige gavekort som f.eks Circle K, Elgiganten og oplevelser.

Du får gratis Wolt+, WashWorld og Tv2Play abonnementer.

Du får ét ugentlig spin på vores app, hvor du kan vinde alt fra rejser til elektronik.

Søg uden lang ansøgning

Du behøver ikke skrive en roman.

Tryk Ansøg job, så ringer vi dig op til en kort og uforpligtende snak.

Passer jobbet til dig, går vi videre. Passer det ikke, prøver vi at finde et bedre match.

title: Service Provider Operations Developer
description:
Hej Service Provider Operations Developer,


Do you want to go to work and help create a better life at home?

With us, you can feel at home in your work while sharing that feeling with millions of people around the world. We encourage you to stand up for yourself and others, creating an environment where everyone feels welcome. We invite you to open new doors, embrace mistakes, and grow from them. Your new job

Your primary focus will be securing and continuously improving our service providers' operations performance. The impact of our work will resonate in homes and hearts across the world.   • Contribute to the development of working methods and other steering documents
  • Ensure execution of signed contracts as well as perform compliance checks at service providers to verify quality of equipment, safety & security etc.

What we’d like you to bring to the table

The role as a Service Provider Operations Developer requires you to have:

  • Worked within logistics or supply chain in an international organisation for at least 2 years
  • Knowledge in specific transportation and warehousing aspects as well as know the ins and outs of impacting operational performance
  • Experience in working with Excel including performing analysis and putting together reports
  • Fluent in English, both in writing and speaking

It’s a plus if you also:

  • Analytical and knows how to follow up while managing yourself while driving he operational agenda with stakeholders
  • Have strong stakeholder management skills
  • Flexible and adaptable in daily work, fast learner and fast adapter
  • Ready to act with a spead on every opportunity

Be yourself, a Service Provider Operations Developer, and more!

Inter IKEA Group is the group of companies that connects IKEA franchisees with range development and suppliers and aligns the overall IKEA strategic direction. Every day, we strive to develop, produce and sell products and services that are affordable and accessible to everyone. With us, you contribute to building a democratic brand and workplace that has a positive impact on both the planet and people's lives.

Your health, wellbeing, and development matter most to us, and our benefits are designed with you in mind. As a co-worker and a person, you are an essential part of our down to earth, playful, and inclusive culture, collaborating with others across roles, departments, and even across the globe. In this curious and optimistic environment, you’ll find endless opportunities to grow. Make us the home of your career.

We welcome your application

Get ready to assemble something new! We look forward to receiving your application by the 28th of September 2026

We always recruit based on values, competence, potential and diversity. Once competence requirements are met, we will first consider impacted co-workers employed in IKEA Supply Services (Sweden) AB and secondly impacted co-workers at Inter IKEA Group.

At IKEA, we are looking for people who believe everyone deserves a seat at the table. You’re welcome no matter where you come from, what you believe, and what you look like. We don’t even care how you have furnished your home. We’re interested in you simply because you’re you. Even if your experience doesn’t align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway. We believe that people’s different perspectives, backgrounds, and personalities make us better at understanding our customers’ dreams and needs. At IKEA we’re all on the same project.

title: Cyber Security Lead
description:
Salary: $140,000 – $160,000 per year

Lindian Resources is seeking a Cyber Security Lead to join our Technology team during an exciting phase of growth. This is a unique opportunity to build, influence and lead cyber security capability across a global rare earths business with operations spanning Australia and international project locations.

Reporting to the Head of Technology, you will play a critical role in protecting the organisation’s information assets, technology platforms and operational systems. Combining strategic leadership with hands-on technical expertise, you will help drive security maturity, strengthen resilience and ensure cyber security remains a key enabler of business success.

This role will suit an experienced cyber security professional who enjoys balancing strategy with technical execution and thrives in an environment where they can make a genuine and visible impact.


About the Role

This role has been created to support Lindian’s continued growth, operational readiness and technology capability uplift. You will be responsible for leading the organisation’s cyber security function while remaining actively involved in security operations, threat management and security architecture.

Working closely with Technology, Finance, Operations, Compliance and external partners, you will help establish and embed security practices that protect both IT and operational technology environments across geographically dispersed operations.


Key Responsibilities

· Develop and maintain comprehensive cybersecurity strategy aligned with business objectives

· Design and implement security architecture for our IT/OT systems including network segmentation

· Conduct hands-on security assessments, penetration testing, and vulnerability management

· Establish security standards, policies, and procedures for systems and data protection

· Lead evaluation and selection of security tools and technologies

· Monitor emerging threats and ensure systems remain current with security patches

· Establish and manage 24/7 security monitoring and alerting systems

· Develop and maintain incident response procedures and playbooks

· Lead hands-on investigation of security incidents and breaches

· Oversee security operations center (SOC) activities

This role combines hands-on technical expertise with leadership responsibilities and will play a critical role in protecting the organisation's systems, data and operational technology environment.


About You

You are a technically strong and commercially aware cyber security professional who enjoys solving complex challenges and influencing outcomes across a growing organisation. You bring a proactive approach, sound judgement and the ability to communicate effectively with both technical teams and senior stakeholders.

You will bring

· Bachelor's degree in Cyber Security, Information Technology, Computer Science or a related discipline.

· Industry-recognised certifications such as CISSP, CISM, CRISC or equivalent.

· Capability to conduct hands-on security assessments, penetration testing, and vulnerability management

· Ability to perform threat analysis, forensic investigation, and root cause analysis

· Experience with security architecture review and technical implementation

· Knowledge of relevant security standards (ISO 27001, SOC 2, etc.)

· Capability to direct hands-on access control management and identity verification processes


What We Offer

· A career-defining opportunity to join Lindian Resources during an exciting phase of growth.

· Exposure to the rapidly growing rare earths sector and major projects in Malawi and Kazakhstan.

· A collaborative, supportive and hands-on team environment.

· Perth-based role with opportunities to engage with international and remote operations, including occasional travel where required.

· Free gym membership and frequent social activities for team building.


About Lindian Resources

Lindian Resources Ltd (ASX: LIN) is an Australian-based integrated rare earths company with a growing international footprint. Our Kangankunde Rare Earths Project in Malawi is the cornerstone of our asset portfolio and represents a significant opportunity in the global rare earths sector.

As Lindian continues to scale, we are strengthening the people, systems, governance and operational capability required to support our next stage of growth. Lindian’s rare earths cracking plant in Stepnogorsk, Kazakhstan further supports our downstream capability and long-term strategic growth ambitions.


Next Steps

If you are excited by the opportunity to contribute to a growing company, work with capable people and make a tangible impact, we would love to hear from you.

To apply, please submit your resume and any requested supporting information.

Candidates may be required to complete pre-employment checks relevant to the role, which may include working rights verification, reference checks, qualification or licence checks, medical assessment, drug and alcohol screening, national police clearance or other role-specific requirements.

Lindian Resources is committed to considering candidates fairly and respectfully.

    • a. 10 of those years must be acting as a Construction Administrator

    • d. Projects shall have a construction value of $8M or more for a single project or with a combined cumulative project value of $80M.
OR
  • 15 years full time paid professional experience as a Project Superintendent or Project Manager on a public/educational facility construction and/or large commercial projects with full responsibility for coordinating complex projects with construction value of a single project in excess of $30M with a combined cumulative project value of $400M.
OR
  • 10.3 Minimum of two (2) years of college level coursework from a recognized college, university or trade school and five (5) years additional experience may be substituted for the educational requirement.
Additional Qualifications:

title: Elektriker til industri og erhverv i Kolding
description:
Vil du have firmabil, fast arbejde og erhvervsopgaver som elektriker?

Vi mangler en elektriker i Kolding til industri, erhverv og renovering.

Du bliver en del af et større elektrikerhold, hvor arbejdet ligger i Kolding og omegn og også kan række længere ud. Opgaverne spænder fra erhverv og industri til detail og private installationer, så du får en bred hverdag uden at stå fast i én type sag. Der er erfaring i huset med elinstallationer, netværk og alarmer, og kunderne forventer at aftaler bliver holdt.

Rollen passer til dig, der gerne vil have ansvar uden at blive efterladt alene med alt bøvlet. Du får firmabil og skal kunne tage turen ud til opgaverne, tale ordentligt med kunderne og melde klart tilbage, hvis noget ændrer sig. Kørekort er nødvendigt, fordi du kører ud til opgaverne.

Det får du

Løn: 220-240 kr. i timen

Firmabil: Ja

Arbejdsområde: Kolding og omegn

Overenskomst: Ansat under gældende overenskomst

Ansættelse: Fastansættelse - vi søger folk, vi kan arbejde med i mange år. Ingen korte forløb.

Hverdag: Industri, erhverv og renovering

Din hverdag

Dagen starter med den sag, der er planlagt for dig. Nogle dage handler det om nye installationer, andre om renovering hvor du fejlfinder, tilpasser og får eksisterende el til at spille. Når noget ændrer sig, melder du det videre, så kunden ved hvad der sker.

Du kommer blandt andet til at arbejde med:

  • Elinstallationer i industri og erhverv
  • Renovering af eksisterende elinstallationer
  • Fremføring af kabler og ledninger
  • Montering af belysning og armaturer
  • Netværksinstallationer og mindre tavleopgaver

Det er en hverdag, hvor du skal kunne tage fat og bruge hovedet samtidig. Hvis en sag vokser undervejs, siger du til i tide, så der bliver styr på aftalen før næste fag skal videre.

Vi leder efter dig, der kan sætte kryds ved det meste

Du behøver ikke kunne alt. Men du skal kunne arbejde selvstændigt og tage ansvar for dine aftaler.

Vi forestiller os, at du:

  • Har kørekort
  • Har erfaring som elektriker
  • Kan arbejde sikkert i industri og erhverv
  • Taler ordentligt med kunderne
  • Siger til, hvis noget ikke stemmer

Det er en fordel, hvis du har arbejdet med netværk, alarmer, detail eller renovering før. Men det vigtigste er, at du møder stabilt og afleverer noget, du kan stå inde for.

Allerede i job?

Så skal det selvfølgelig give mening at skifte.

Derfor starter vi med en uforpligtende snak. Du kan høre mere om opgaverne, virksomheden, lønnen og hverdagen, før du beslutter noget. Og ja, det foregår diskret.

Hvis det her lyder som noget for dig, kan du starte om Hurtigst muligt.

Du behøver ikke sende en lang ansøgning. Tryk på Ansøg job, så ringer vi dig op og tager den derfra.

Om PowerMatch

Hos PowerMatch matcher vi dig kun med job, der lever op til dine krav på løn, opgaver, kultur, firmabil og hvad der ellers betyder noget for dig.

Du starter direkte ude i virksomheden. Vi arbejder kun med forløb, hvor målet er fastansættelse. Ikke korte vikariater.

Hvis jobbet ikke viser sig at være det rigtige match, hjælper vi dig videre til noget, der passer bedre.

PowerMatch har 5 stjerner på Trustpilot baseret på 500+ anmeldelser fra håndværkere og fagfolk som dig.

Du optjener point hos PowerMatch, som du kan bruge på 1000+ forskellige gavekort som f.eks Circle K, Elgiganten og oplevelser.

Du får gratis Wolt+, WashWorld og Tv2Play abonnementer.

Du får ét ugentlig spin på vores app, hvor du kan vinde alt fra rejser til elektronik.

Søg uden lang ansøgning

Du behøver ikke skrive en roman.

Tryk Ansøg job, så ringer vi dig op til en kort og uforpligtende snak.

Passer jobbet til dig, går vi videre. Passer det ikke, prøver vi at finde et bedre match.

title: Frøbjerg-Orte Friskole, Børnehave og Vuggestue søger pædagogmedhjælper/pædagogisk assistent til vores børnehave/vuggestue.
description:
Er du initiativrig, nysgerrig og drømmer du om at være en del af:

- en medarbejdergruppe, der har fokus på udvikling, og hvor der er plads til grin og forskellighed?

- et hus, hvor der er højt til loftet, skønne omgivelser og en kultur båret af højt fagligt niveau?

Så er det dig, vi har brug for!

Vores hus er opdelt i 2 grupper:

Yngstegruppen er vores vuggestue, og den er inddelt i tre grupper: Hoppelopperne, Løbebillerne og Springfrøerne.

Ældstegruppen er vores børnehave, og den er inddelt i Græshopperne, som er de ældste og kommende skolebørn, Mariehøns og Sommerfugle for de 3-4-årige.

Alle børn tilknyttes hver deres gruppe og primære voksne, samtidig med, at vi laver hverdagsaktiviteter på tværs af grupperne, når det giver mening.

Vi har en ledig stilling i vores børnehave på 30-34 timer.

Vi ser værdien i at bringe de ansattes kompetencer i spil i for alle børn og da vi dagligt både morgen og eftermiddag arbejder på tværs af Yngste og Ældste, skal du være åben for at kunne se dig selv i hele huset.

Vores pædagogik hviler på et fundament af grundmotorik og sanseintegration, altid bakket op af anerkendelse, nærvær, tilknytning og stjernestunder. Der skal være plads til udfoldelse og tid til fordybelse sammen med børnene og børnene imellem.

Vores naturskønne område med skov i baghaven og Frøbjerg Bavnehøj som nærmeste nabo, lægger op til en aktiv hverdag præget af aktiviteter både ude og inde. Kun fantasien sætter grænser…... også for de voksne.

Vi lægger stor vægt på fællesskabets betydning for alle børn. Ved at understøtte den enkeltes udvikling, sikrer vi barnets mulighed for at føle sig inkluderet og som en del af en helhed.

Vi prioriterer et tæt forældresamarbejde, hvor vi i fællesskab altid sigter mod at vende vilkår til muligheder.

Vi drømmer om at:

· Du elsker udelivet og ser uderummet som en integreret del af børnelivet.

· Du har stor interesse for, og gerne erfaring med sanseintegration og børns motoriske udvikling.

· Du er optaget af LEG og Langsom Pædagogik, og du understøtter naturligt børnenes egne initiativer og fordybelse.

· Du har fagligheden i fokus og reflekterer gerne over egen og andres praksis.

· Du kan se dig selv i en personalegruppe, hvor der er plads til livsglæde, humor, selvstændighed, fleksibilitet og gå på mod.

· Du får øje på fordelene i at være en del af friskolelivet, -det tværfaglige samarbejde og den røde tråd på hele Frøbjerg-Orte Friskole, Børnehave og Vuggestue.

Frøbjerg-Orte Friskole, Børnehave og Vuggestue rummer tilsammen pt. 185 skoleelever, 47 børn på Ældstegruppen og 33 børn på Yngstegruppen. Stedet drives af en forældrevalgt bestyrelse, bakket op af forældreråd i børnehave/vuggestue.

Vi er ca. 48 medarbejdere fordelt mellem lærere, pædagoger, pædagogmedhjælpere, studerende, forretningsfører samt praktisk personale. Ledelsen består af Konstitueret Skoleleder og Pædagogisk Leder.

Hvordan ansøger du?

Stillingen er til ansættelse pr 1. december 2026.

Vi ser meget gerne at du prioriterer at komme og besøge os, da det giver os mulighed for at vise dig alt det vi kan tilbyde og samtidig kan du mærke stemningen i huset. Ring til os for at lave en aftale om besøg.

Ansøgningsfrist er senest d. 5. oktober 2026. Samtaler vil blive afholdt løbende.

Ansøgning og bilag sendes som en PDF til: ansoegning@fofri.dk Skriv dit navn i emnefeltet.

Du kan læse og se meget om os på vores hjemmeside

Personlig kontakt til pædagogisk leder: Rikke Skovhøj tlf. 54552155 mail: bhleder@fofri.dk

eller konstitueret skoleleder Kim Hedegaard tlf. 25143454 mail: viceleder@fofri.dk

Ansættelse sker i henhold til enhver tid gældende overenskomst ”aftale om løn – og ansættelse for pædagogisk personale i de frie grundskoler”.

Hvis du ikke har hørt fra os inden d. 30. oktober 2026, er stillingen besat til anden side.

Din ansøgning vil blive opbevaret i 6 mdr. Herefter bliver den slettet.

title: Psykolog eller pædagogisk psykologisk konsulent søges til PPR-funktion og det Let tilgængelige behandlingstilbud i Tværfagligt KompetenceCenter, Faxe Kommune
description:
Psykolog eller pædagogisk psykologisk konsulent søges til PPR-funktion og behandlingsopgaver under let tilgængelige behandlingstilbud i Tværfagligt KompetenceCenter, Faxe Kommune

Vi søger engagerede psykologer eller pædagogiske psykologiske konsulenter til faste stillinger på 37 timer til start d. 1. december 2026, som kan være med i den rivende udvikling, der er i Tværfagligt KompetenceCenter og PPR-funktionen i Faxe Kommune.

Der kommer nye, spændende opgaver, og vi har brug for kollegaer, som brænder for at fremme trivsel og udvikling for børn og unge samt har interesse for behandlingsopgaver i regi af de let tilgængelige behandlingstilbud.

Har du lyst til at være en del af et stærkt tværfagligt fællesskab og være med til en spændende udvikling i PPR-funktionen Faxe Kommune?

Du bliver medarbejder i et team, der er gode til at skabe et godt arbejdsmiljø præget af respekt for hinanden og som tager ansvar for fælles opgaveløsning. Et team som formår at holde balancen mellem en rar og uformel omgangsform og en stærk faglighed, der medvirker til udvikling. Psykolog- og Konsulentteamet er et åbent team, som glæder sig til at lære nye kollegaer at kende. Et team, hvor du skal bidrage til et stærkt fagligt miljø, hvor der er plads til såvel nyuddannede som erfarne psykologer. Vi har kontor i Haslev tæt på offentlig transport.

Tværfagligt KompetenceCenter har gang i en udviklingsproces, hvor bl.a. vi i PPR-funktionen arbejder tæt på praksis, og hvor tidlig indsats fylder mere og mere med afsæt i en løsningsfokuseret tilgang (LØFT). Vi er i tæt dialog med dagtilbud og skole om udvikling af stærke samarbejder på tværs, et fælles mindset, fælles mål og høj grad af inddragelse af børn og forældre.

Som medarbejder i Psykolog- og Konsulentteamet, arbejder vi i tværfaglige kontekster rundt omkring børn og børnefællesskaber, hvor vi bidrager til at skabe de bedste rammer for trivsel, udvikling og læring for børnene. Vi har en samskabende tilgang, hvor fælles børn er et fælles ansvar. Tværfagligt styrker vi børns muligheder for trivsel, udvikling og læring. Vi tror på, at børn og unge ikke er problemet – de viser problemet.

Faxe Kommune og Tværfagligt KompetenceCenter er en del af STIME partnerskabet med Region Sjællands børne- og ungdomspsykiatri. Derfor er vi ved at udvikle det lettilgængelig behandling til børn, unge og deres familier. Hos os er der således gode muligheder for både at varetage de traditionelle PPR-opgaver såvel som let tilgængelige behandlingsforløb.

Vi søger en psykolog/pædagogisk psykologisk konsulent, og vi ser:

  • hvis du er psykolog, at du gerne er praksisuddannet (klinisk psykolog)
  • hvis du er konsulent, at du gerne har solid faglig relevant erfaring inden for PPR området
  • kan yde konsultativ vejledning til dagtilbud og skoler med henblik på, at fremme børns deltagelsesmuligheder i børnefællesskaber
  • ser værdien i såvel monofaglige som tværfaglige makkerskaber i opgaveløsningen og herigennem skaber løsninger i samarbejde med børn, forældre og dagtilbud/skole
  • har erfaring med specialpædagogiske tilgange og metoder
  • kan omsætte undersøgelsesresultater og teoretisk viden til praksisnære pædagogiske indsatser
  • har erfaring med manualbaseret behandling
  • kan arbejde selvstændigt og samtidig være en god holdspiller
  • kan prioritere i arbejdsopgaver og tid samt navigere i en hverdag med mangeartede opgaver
  • er bevidst om dine egne styrker og kompetencer
Vi tilbyder:

  • et godt kollegialt arbejdsmiljø bestående af 50 dygtige og samarbejdsvillige kollegaer, heraf 13 psykologer og 3 konsulenter i Psykolog- og Konsulentteamet
  • en selvstændig PPR-funktion, hvor indflydelse og kompetenceudvikling er en naturlig del af arbejdet
  • hvis du ikke har praksisuddannelse (kan kalde dig klinisk psykolog), at dette bliver en del af din kompetenceudvikling de næste år
  • at du tilbydes kompetenceudvikling i forhold til de let tilgængelige behandlingsopgaver
  • en arbejdsplads, hvor der er plads til et godt grin og højt til loftet
  • at du bliver tilknyttet en mentor som du følger de første par uger og får et introduktionsprogram, som passer til dine kompetencer
  • ugentlig intern supervision til PPR-opgaver såvel let tilgængelige behandlingsopgaver
Vi bestræber os på at lave en opgavesammensætning, som matcher dine kvalifikationer og ambitioner samt et arbejdsliv der passer ind i din livssituation.

Hvis du vil høre mere om stillingen, er du velkommen til at henvende dig til teamleder Charlotte Daugaard eller TR Nanna Baasch Olsen.

Om Faxe Kommune:

I Faxe Kommune er vi et stort fællesskab bestående af cirka 37.200 borgere og 2.550 medarbejdere.

Du bliver en del af en stor organisation, hvor rigtig mange faggrupper samarbejder om, at skabe de bedste tilbud, muligheder og resultater inden for både velfærdsområderne, erhverv, infrastruktur, uddannelse, frivillighed – og alt det, der hører med til "det hele liv". Vi samarbejder gerne på tværs af faggrænser indadtil og med borgerne og civilsamfundet udadtil.

Faxe Kommune er centralt placeret på Sjælland med gode motorvejsforbindelser mod syd og nord. Vi har desuden fire togstationer, der kan bringe dig hurtigt og smidigt mod Køge, Næstved, Roskilde og København.

Det tager ca. 45 minutter på motorvej fra fx Roskilde, København til Haslev. Samt ca. 50 minutter fra Nykøbing F.

title: Servicemontør – start arbejdsdagen hjemmefra og få frihed i hverdagen
description:
Har du erfaring med service, montage og fejlfinding – gerne inden for porte, kraner eller andet teknisk udstyr? Og trives du bedst i et job, hvor du får ansvar for dine egne opgaver og frihed til at planlægge din arbejdsdag?

Så kan det være dig, vi leder efter.

Flair søger på vegne af virksomhed en erfaren servicemontør til Djursland og omegn, som kan arbejde selvstændigt og har en solid teknisk baggrund inden for el og gerne mekanik.

Her starter arbejdsdagen hjemmefra.

Du får stillet firmabil til rådighed og kører direkte hjemmefra ud til dagens kunder. Kunderne er hovedsageligt erhvervs- og industrikunder, og du kommer til at arbejde med montage, service, eftersyn og fejlfinding på blandt andet porte, kraner, løftegrej, stiger og PPE/sikkerhedsudstyr.

Det er et job til dig, der kan lide at være på farten, møde forskellige kunder og selv tage ansvar for at få opgaverne løst.

Din hverdag:

Du får en varieret arbejdsdag, hvor du arbejder selvstændigt ude hos kunderne og løser både planlagte serviceopgaver og tekniske udfordringer.

Dine opgaver vil blandt andet være:

  • Montage, service og vedligeholdelse af porte
  • Service og arbejde på kraner og krananlæg
  • Fejlfinding på elektriske og mekaniske komponenter
  • Eftersyn og service af løftegrej, stiger og PPE/sikkerhedsudstyr
  • Kundekontakt og rådgivning
  • Dokumentation og rapportering af det udførte arbejde

Du får ansvar for dine egne opgaver og kunder, og derfor er det vigtigt, at du har erfaringen og den tekniske forståelse til selv at kunne vurdere en opgave, finde fejlen og få den løst.

Hvem er du?

Vi leder efter dig, der allerede har erfaring fra en lignende teknisk stilling, og som er vant til at arbejde selvstændigt ude hos kunder.

Din uddannelsesmæssige baggrund kan være forskellig. Du kan f.eks. være elektriker, industrielektriker, automatiktekniker, portmontør, kranmontør, servicemontør eller have en anden relevant teknisk baggrund.

Det vigtigste er, at du har en god el-teknisk forståelse og gerne erfaring med mekanik.

Vi ser gerne, at du:

  • Har erfaring med service, montage og vedligeholdelse af tekniske installationer
  • Har en solid forståelse for el og elektrisk fejlfinding
  • Har mekanisk forståelse og hænderne godt skruet på
  • Gerne har erfaring med porte, kraner, løfteudstyr eller lignende
  • Har erfaring fra industrien og er vant til industrielle opgaver
  • Kan arbejde selvstændigt og tage ansvar for en opgave fra start til slut
  • Trives med kundekontakt og yder en professionel service
  • Har almindelige IT-kundskaber til dokumentation og rapportering

Da du kommer til at arbejde meget selvstændigt ude hos kunderne, er det vigtigt, at du allerede har en solid teknisk værktøjskasse med dig. Der er ikke tale om en stilling, hvor du skal oplæres fra bunden.

Frihed under ansvar – helt konkret

Her får du en arbejdsdag med stor selvstændighed.

Du kører direkte hjemmefra til dagens første kunde og får ansvar for dine egne opgaver og kunder. Det kræver, at du kan træffe beslutninger og finde løsninger på egen hånd – til gengæld får du også friheden til at tage ansvar for dit arbejde.

Arbejdstiden er som udgangspunkt:

Mandag–torsdag kl. 07.00–15.30
Fredag kl. 07.00–13.15

Der er desuden flextid, som giver mulighed for fleksibilitet i hverdagen.

Det får du

  • Firmabil med nødvendigt værktøj og udstyr
  • Mulighed for at starte arbejdsdagen hjemmefra
  • Stor frihed under ansvar
  • En varieret arbejdsdag hos forskellige kunder
  • Egne opgaver og kundekontakt
  • Flextid
  • Et godt kollegialt fællesskab og mulighed for faglig sparring
  • Attraktiv lønpakke
  • Pension og fritvalgsordning
  • Sundhedsordning

Er du klar til mere frihed i din arbejdsdag?

Hvis du allerede arbejder med service og teknik og gerne vil have en hverdag med mere selvstændighed, egne kunder og mulighed for at køre direkte hjemmefra, så vil vi meget gerne høre fra dig.

Send dit CV og din ansøgning – eller kontakt os for en uforpligtende snak om jobbet.

Stillingen er et Try & Hire-forløb med henblik på fastansættelse hos virksomheden.

title: Kökspersonal
description:
Vi öppnar Restaurang Flammen i Jönköping – och söker hela vårt köksteam!
