title: IT Onsite Specialist
description:
🚀 Challenge the Impossible​ ​

About Beyond Gravity

Beyond Gravity, headquartered in Zurich, Switzerland, is the first space company to combine a startup mindset, agility, speed and innovation with decades of experience and proven quality. Approximately 1800 employees at 12 locations in six countries (Switzerland, Sweden, Austria, USA, Finland and Portugal) develop and manufacture products for satellites and launch vehicles with the goal of advancing humankind and enabling the exploration of the world and beyond. Beyond Gravity is the preferred supplier of structures for all types of launch vehicles and a leading provider of selected satellite products and constellation solutions in the New Space sector. More information at: www.beyondgravity.com

Our Crew

The Onsite IT Specialist will be part of the IT Service Desk and Field Service Team being responsible to support the business on the daily usage of all the IT services, maintaining a direct relationship across the business and tech enterprise teams, being responsible for the stability of the IT equipment ensuring the service remains stable, performant, and operational. It will work in close collaboration within the Beyond Gravity Service Delivery & Support organization and across Tech Infrastructure & Operations functions to limit the operational and revenue impact by reducing the Mean Time to Detect (MTTD), Mean Time to Respond (MTTR) and Mean Time to Root Cause (MTTRC) on IT Incident and Problem tickets.


This role will be a key part of the Service Delivery Team, ensuring our technology solutions and in life Service & business processes are fully aligned and contribute to the vision and strategic direction of the organization.


Your Mission

  • Serve as the first point of contact for the end users seeking for technical assistance over the phone or ticket.
  • Perform remote troubleshooting through diagnostic techniques and pertinent questions for Windows-based user applications.


  • Determine the best solution based on the issue and details provided by customers.


  • Walk the customer through the problem-solving process.


  • Direct unresolved issues to the next level of support personnel.


  • Provide accurate information on IT products or services.


  • Record events and problems and their resolution in logs.


  • Follow-up and update customer status and information.


  • Pass on any feedback or suggestions by customers to the appropriate internal team.


  • Identify and suggest possible improvements on procedures.


  • User management - permission management of several systems.

  • Collaboration on IT projects throughout the life cycle of IT infrastructure/organizational programs.

  • Assisting the support staff of other service-providers.
  • May require some staggered shifts.
  • Other duties may be assigned.

Your Story

Must’s:

  • Completed technical education with a focus on IT or equivalent work experience.


  • Years of experience: Intermediate, typically 2 to 5 years of applied skills and experience.


  • Work experience in a similar role with a focus on technical support and help desk.


  • Good knowledge in the areas of network technology (LAN, WAN, Wi-Fi, DNS, DHCP….) and server landscapes, Soft- und Hardware, AD, Client-Infrastructure.


  • Knowledge of Windows Client and Server operating systems and MS Office.


  • Familiarity with iOS, and Android operating systems to provide best-effort support to End users using related devices.


  • Working technical knowledge of Windows operating systems to allow for resolution of issues, or full rebuild of the PC using client specific documentation provided by the client.


  • Working technical knowledge of Microsoft Office Products, antivirus products, desktop services to allow for resolution of software application issues


  • Solution oriented approach and team player


  • High operational readiness, problem-solving competence, and proactivity


  • Excellent English and Swedish


  • Distinctive service and customer orientation


  • Teamwork, experience in working with remote teams, communication skills with internal and external stakeholders.


  • Ability to utilize provided knowledge article to resolve issues with specific applications/knowledgebases.


  • Customer-facing “soft skills” including strong verbal and written communications.


  • Ability to apply intermediate level of subject matter knowledge to solve a variety of common IT issues.


  • Exercises independent judgment within defined practices and procedures to determine appropriate action.


  • Acts as an informed team member providing analysis of information and limited project input.


  • Evaluates unique circumstances and makes technical and procedural recommendations.


Nice to have’s:

  • CompTIA A+ certification


  • ITIL certification


Why Beyond Gravity?

  • Work in a growing high-tech company with career opportunities both locally and internationally
  • Be part of a dedicated team with the ambition to redefine space!
  • Wellness allowance via the benefits portal Epassi
  • In Linköping, we have experienced and skilled staff and a diverse management team

title: Nautarehun myyjä, Värväämö Group Oy
description:
Nautarehujen myyjä Rehux Oy
Haluatko päästä osaksi suomalaisen maatalouden menestystarinaa ja työskennellä alan kokeneiden ammattilaisten rinnalla?
Etsimme asiakkaallemme Rehux Oy:lle nautarehujen myyjää vakituiseen työsuhteeseen. Työsuhde solmitaan Värväämön kanssa.
Tässä tehtävässä pääset osaksi asiantuntevaa ja kokenutta tiimiä, jonka jäsenillä on vuosien kokemus nautakarjataloudesta, rehustuksesta sekä asiakastyöstä. Rehuxilla arvostetaan käytännön osaamista, asiakkaiden liiketoiminnan ymmärtämistä ja pitkäjänteisiä kumppanuuksia. Uutena tiimin jäsenenä saat tueksesi kokeneet kollegat, joiden kanssa ajatuksia voi sparrata ja joiden osaamisesta pääset hyötymään päivittäin.
Tehtävään on helppo tulla mukaan. Saat kattavan perehdytyksen yritykseen, tuotteisiin ja toimintatapoihin, eikä sinun tarvitse hypätä heti yksin kentälle. Kun talo, tuotteet ja asiakkaat tulevat tutuiksi, pääset asteittain mukaan myös asiakaskäynneille ja rakentamaan omia asiakassuhteitasi
Tehtäväsi
Nautarehujen myynti ja asiakassuhteiden kehittäminen
Asiakkaiden neuvonta ja ruokintaratkaisujen tarjoaminen
Uusasiakashankinta ja myynnin kasvattaminen omalla alueellasi
Pitkäjänteinen yhteistyö asiakkaiden kanssa
Asiakaskäynnit
Mitä odotamme sinulta?
Kokemusta nautataloudesta, rehustuksesta tai muulta maatalousalalta
Myynnillistä asennetta ja halua auttaa asiakkaita menestymään
Kykyä rakentaa ja ylläpitää luottamuksellisia asiakassuhteita
Oma-aloitteista ja vastuullista työotetta
Hyviä vuorovaikutustaitoja
B-ajokorttia
Mitä tarjoamme?
Vakituisen työsuhteen Värväämö Oy:n kautta
Säännöllisen arkityön pääsääntöisesti ma-pe klo 8.00-16.00
Itsenäisen ja vastuullisen työnkuvan
Kilpailukykyisen palkkauksen
Kattavan perehdytyksen tehtävään ja tuotteisiin
Mahdollisuuden työskennellä kokeneessa ja ammattitaitoisessa työyhteisössä, jossa osaaminen perustuu vuosien käytännön kokemukseen nautakarjataloudesta ja rehuliiketoiminnasta
Hae mukaan tiimiimme!
Kiinnostuitko?
Lähetä hakemuksesi ja CV:si mahdollisimman pian. Käsittelemme hakemuksia jo hakuaikana ja paikka täytetään sopivan henkilön löydyttyä.

title: Co-Occurring IOP/OP Program Intern
description:
Job Title

Co-Occurring IOP/OP Program Intern

Reports to:

Co-Occurring IOP/OP Programs Supervisor

FLSA

Unpaid Internship

Orig. Date

June 2022

Revised:

July 2025

JOB SUMMARY

The Co-Occurring IOP/OP Program Intern supports the overall functioning of the IOP/OP programs by assisting staff and engaging directly with members. Interns gain hands-on experience working in a behavioral health setting with a focus on substance use and co-occurring disorders, while developing skills in documentation, facilitation, and member support.

ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS

Member Orientation Support

  • Assist members in completing intake and enrollment documents
  • Conduct initial assessments under supervision
  • Foster a welcoming, respectful, and inclusive environment for new and potential members

Support for IOP/OP Counselors

  • Assist in maintaining accurate and timely documentation within the Electronic Health Record (EHR)
  • Compile and deliver daily attendance sheets to Program Supervisor
  • Attend weekly team and care coordination meetings as requested
  • Participate in ongoing training and learning opportunities
  • Help maintain a comprehensive database of recovery support services in the community
  • Represent the program in a professional manner with external partners
  • Uphold the agency's Code of Ethics
  • Advocate for recovery with members, referral sources, and internally within the agency

Co-Occurring Therapeutic Services

  • Co-facilitate and/or facilitate IOP/OP therapy groups under supervision
  • Provide individual support to members through counseling sessions
  • Participate in treatment planning and ongoing assessment of member progress
  • Contribute to a healing and strengths-based therapeutic environment
  • Collaborate with supervisor to coordinate outings promoting recovery and community integration
  • Maintain confidentiality in accordance with CFR 42, Part 2, and agency policy

Cultural Competence and Diversity

  • Engage collaboratively with staff, members, and community partners from diverse backgrounds
  • Take active steps to build personal cultural competency (e.g., trainings, events, discussions)

Additional Duties

  • Attend staff meetings as needed
  • Support members with transportation-related challenges
  • Assist in collecting member stories, feedback, and images for marketing and member engagement
  • Complete other duties as assigned

QUALIFICATIONS

  • Interest in behavioral health, substance use treatment, and/or social work
  • Willingness to learn, collaborate, and grow professionally
  • Strong self-reflection and communication skills
  • Ability to meet deadlines and manage responsibilities
  • Comfort using computer systems and digital tools
  • Ability to work independently and as part of a team
  • Commitment to ethical and professional conduct

WORKING CONDITIONS

Interns will primarily work in an office setting; however, some responsibilities may involve accompanying program members on community outings or participating in outdoor activities as part of the recovery support process.

PHYSICAL DEMANDS

The physical requirements described here represent those an intern must meet to successfully carry out the essential functions of the role. Interns must be able to effectively communicate with both members and staff. The position involves periods of desk work as well as mobility throughout the facility and during community-based activities.

DIRECT REPORTS

None

DISCLAIMER

This internship description is not intended to be all-inclusive. Interns may be assigned additional responsibilities that are reasonably related to the role. Park Center reserves the right to modify duties and responsibilities as needed.

title: Vi vokser og udvider: Sygeplejerske søges til ambulatorium med enestående godt samarbejde og fokus på det positive arbejdsmiljø
description:
I Afdeling for Kræftbehandling, Klinik 3, søger vi en sygeplejerske med interesse for kvalificeret behandling af patienter med brystkræft. Har du lyst til at påvirke fremtidens sygepleje? – så har du chancen nu.

Som sygeplejerske hos os skal du selvstændigt og i et tæt samarbejde med sygepleje- og lægefaglige kolleger tilrettelægge, pleje og behandle vores patienter med kemoterapi, immunterapi, antistoffer, antihormoner med mere -gode samarbejdsevner er derfor i høj kurs hos os. Du bliver en vigtig støtte for patienter og pårørende i en livsomvæltende situation, hvor omsorg, faglighed og tryghed gør en stor forskel.



Vi tilbyder:

  • en fast stilling primært i vores ambulatorium med dagvagter varierende mellem kl. 7.30 og 17.00- samt dag eller aftenvagt hver 6. weekend i vores sengeafsnit i Afdeling for Kræftbehandling
  • en spændende afdeling, hvor medarbejdere og ledere er opmærksomme på at gøre deres bedste
  • en arbejdsplads i konstant udvikling
  • et tværfagligt team med fagligt kompetente og engagerede kolleger
  • mulighed for at påvirke egen og klinikkens udvikling gennem faglighed og nytænkning
  • grundig oplæring og introduktion
  • kursus i medicinsk kræftbehandling
  • engagerede og erfarne kolleger.


Vi søger en sygeplejerske der:

  • har erfaring, gerne fra specialet, men det er ikke en betingelse
  • er engageret i pleje og behandling af alvorligt syge patienter og deres pårørende
  • er fleksibel og positiv
  • vægter tværfagligt samarbejde højt
  • har gode kommunikative evner
  • har evner for planlægning og prioritering
  • kan lide at arbejde selvstændigt
  • er løsningsorienteret og kan tænke ”ud af boksen”.


Er du blevet nysgerrig og vil vide mere?

Du er meget velkommen til at kontakte oversygeplejerske Heidi Kallehauge på telefon 38 68 21 97.

Ansøgningen skal modtages senest d 18/10-2026

Vi glæder os til at møde dig.

title: Senior Azure Cloud Consultant
description:
Cloud-konsulent til førende cloud-leverandør

Du får

  • Spændende Azure-projekter, hvor du arbejder hands-on med migration, automatisering og moderne cloudplatforme
  • Ansvar for egne leverancer og mulighed for at præge de tekniske løsninger – tæt på både kunderne og teknologien
  • Dygtige kolleger at sparre med og mulighed for at styrke din ekspertise gennem videndeling, certificeringer og nye udfordringer

Din rolle

  • Du bygger, migrerer og optimerer Azure-løsninger, der gør en mærkbar forskel for kundernes forretning
  • Du bringer løsninger fra design til virkelighed med Bicep, Azure DevOps og automatisering – i tæt samarbejde med vores arkitekter og konsulenter

Du er

  • En erfaren Azure-konsulent, der brænder for cloudteknologi og motiveres af at løse komplekse udfordringer sammen med kunderne
  • Nysgerrig, initiativrig og en stærk holdspiller, der tager ejerskab, deler sin viden og har stolthed i det, du leverer

Senior Azure Cloud Consultant

Vil du være med til at bygge, migrere og optimere Azure-løsninger, som skaber værdi for kunderne fra første dag? Så kan du blive en vigtig del af vores Azure-team.

Som Senior Azure Cloud Consultant arbejder du hands-on med implementering og projektleverancer i Microsoft Azure. Du omsætter arkitektur og kundekrav til velfungerende løsninger og tager ansvar for dine egne tekniske workstreams - fra planlægning og estimering til build, test, dokumentation og overdragelse.

Du bliver en del af et fagligt stærkt team og arbejder tæt sammen med Solution Architects, projektledere, andre konsulenter og Operations. Sammen sikrer I, at løsningerne ikke blot bliver implementeret, men også er sikre, standardiserede, veldokumenterede og klar til stabil drift.

Du kan arbejde hybridt fra vores kontor i Ballerup / Odense / Aarhus, hjemmefra og efter behov hos kunder. Rejseaktiviteten er begrænset og vil primært være knyttet til kundemøder og leverancer i Danmark.

Hvad forventer vi af vores Senior Azure Cloud Consultant

Dine ansvarsområder

  • Deltage i discovery, assessments og tekniske workshops og omsætte godkendte designs til konkrete leveranceplaner, aktiviteter og estimater
  • Implementere og udvide Azure Landing Zones med management groups, subscriptions, policy, identity, networking og governance
  • Bygge og vedligeholde genanvendelige Infrastructure as Code-moduler med Bicep og gennemføre kontrollerede deployments via Azure DevOps og CI/CD-pipelines
  • Implementere sikre og driftsegnede Azure-platforme og workloads på tværs af blandt andet compute, storage, netværk, identity, databaser og containerløsninger
  • Etablere og konfigurere monitorering, logging, backup, disaster recovery, Key Vault og relevante sikkerheds- og governancekontroller
  • Håndtere tekniske afhængigheder, risici og ændringer og skabe tydelig fremdrift i dine egne workstreams
  • Sikre en struktureret overdragelse til Operations og bidrage i den aftalte stabiliseringsperiode efter idriftsættelse

Din profil

  • Vi forestiller os, at du har omkring fem års relevant erfaring med Azure-leverancer og er vant til at tage selvstændigt ansvar i kunde- eller produktionskritiske miljøer. Du arbejder struktureret og har både den tekniske dybde og den leverancedisciplin, der skal til for at føre en løsning sikkert i mål
  • Har dokumenteret erfaring med selvstændig implementering af Azure-løsninger i kundevendte eller forretningskritiske miljøer
  • Har erfaring med Azure Landing Zones og Cloud Adoption Framework, herunder management groups, subscriptions, Azure Policy, identity, networking og governance
  • Har praktisk erfaring med migrationsforløb og Azure Migrate, herunder discovery, readiness, sizing, wave planning og migrering af workloads
  • Har stærke kompetencer inden for Bicep og Infrastructure as Code
  • Har erfaring med Azure DevOps, repositories, branches, pull requests, variable groups og CI/CD-pipelines
  • Har erfaring med Azure IaaS og PaaS samt centrale platformservices som virtuelle maskiner, storage, netværk, Microsoft Entra ID, RBAC/PIM, Key Vault, Azure Monitor, backup og disaster recovery
  • Har erfaring med AKS eller andre containerplatforme og forstår networking, identity, security og deployment i containerbaserede løsninger
  • Kan planlægge og estimere egne leverancer, håndtere risici og ændringer og dokumentere løsninger på et niveau, som andre kan arbejde videre med
  • Forstår managed services og tænker monitorering, support, sikkerhed, standardisering og overdragelse ind fra starten
  • Kommunikerer klart med både kunder og kolleger og behersker engelsk på et professionelt niveau. Dansk er en fordel, men ikke et krav

Om Sentia, et selskab i Aeven Group

Aeven Group består af Aeven og Sentia, to danske leverandører af managed IT-services, som leverer innovative digitale løsninger til både private og offentlige virksomheder i Danmark. I en verden i konstant forandring hjælper Aeven Group kunder med at opnå digital succes gennem tilpasningsdygtige digitale løsninger, der dækker alt fra kritisk IT-infrastruktur og cloud til cybersikkerhed og digitale brugeroplevelser. Med hovedkontor i Ballerup og flere datacentre i Storkøbenhavn beskæftiger Aeven Group over 1.600 medarbejdere i Danmark, Tjekkiet, Filippinerne og Ungarn.

Vi løser forretningsudfordringer med IT-løsninger

I Sentia trives vi ved at være vores kunders fortrukne og langsigtede samarbejdspartner. Derfor er det vigtigt for os at vi skræddersyer markedets bedste løsninger, som passer til kundens forretning, om det er pure Public Cloud, hybrid, Sentia Cloud eller andre managed services. Det vigtigste er, at vi skaber langsigtede løsninger sammen med vores kunder og derved sikrer et stærkt fundament for fremtidigt samarbejde. Vi mener, at den digitale verden er kernen i enhver virksomhed, og vi drives af at finde den bedste IT-løsning sammen med vores kunder. Vi er i øjeblikket på en spændende transformationsrejse, hvor vi optimerer vores interne struktur, fra vores systemlandskab til at udfordre traditionelle arbejdsmetoder. Vi inviterer dig på denne spændende rejse, hvor vi konstant er i udvikling, og derfor kan du ikke lade være med at vokse sammen med os.

Vil du med på rejsen?

Vi indkalder til samtaler løbende og ansætter, når vi har fundet det rette match. Vi vil derfor gerne invitere dig til at sende os dit CV og nogle passionerede linjer hvor du fremhæver hvorfor DU netop er det rette match for Sentia. Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig! Hvis du har specifikke spørgsmål vedr. Sentia eller positionen, så er du velkommen til at kontakte Team Lead public Cloud Operations, Daniel Svagin Luplau på e-mail: daniel.svagin.luplau@sentia.dk

title: Python Data Engineer
description:
About the Company

At Avaron, you get the security of permanent employment combined with the variety of working at different customers. We place specialists across everything from tech, IT and industry to project management and business support – and whatever the assignment, you have a consultant manager who is there for you and your development.

About the Role

You will join a data-focused engineering team that keeps critical production services running while building the next generation of cloud-native solutions on Google Cloud Platform. The role combines operational responsibility with modern development, giving you the chance to work close to both existing business-critical services and new platforms that improve how data is processed, exposed and used.

You will work with technologies such as Python, PostgreSQL, GCP, GraphQL, Terraform, Cloud Run, Cloud SQL and BigQuery. This is a strong opportunity for you if you enjoy balancing stability and modernization in an environment where you can influence both day-to-day reliability and long-term technical direction.

Job Description
  • You will maintain and improve existing production services built in Python and PostgreSQL.
  • You will develop and operate data pipelines, APIs and cloud-native services on GCP.
  • You will help modernize existing services by building scalable alternatives with a more current architecture.
  • You will work with infrastructure as code to support reliable and repeatable deployments.
  • You will handle incidents, troubleshoot issues in production and contribute to stable operations.
  • You will collaborate with stakeholders to understand needs and turn them into robust technical solutions.
  • You will contribute to modern software delivery practices, including CI/CD and continuous improvements in the development workflow.
Requirements
  • 5 years or more experience in software development, particularly with Python and PostgreSQL.
  • Experience from running services on GCP.
  • Experience from incident handling and stakeholder management.
  • Proven ability in designing and maintaining data pipelines, data processing, and database technologies.
  • Experience with Infrastructure as Code, preferably Terraform.
  • Experience with API development and integrations using GraphQL and/or REST.
  • Experience with CI/CD and modern software delivery practices.
  • Experience using AI coding assistants in a good way.
  • You communicate fluently in Swedish and English.
What We Offer
  • Permanent employment at Avaron AB
  • Occupational pension
  • Wellness allowance of SEK 5,000 per year
Application

Selections are made on an ongoing basis – apply as soon as you can.

title: Kurator Smärtcentrum, Umeå
company: Region Västerbotten, Neuro huvud och halscentrum
description:
Region Västerbotten arbetar för att god hälsa och hållbar utveckling ska stärka varandra. Vi tar ansvar för en jämlik välfärd och för att forskning och innovation ger resultat.

Smärtcentrum ingår i Neuro-Huvud-Halscentrum (NHHC) vid Norrlands Universitetssjukhus (NUS). Målet för verksamheten är att i norra regionen bedriva nationellt ledande högspecialiserad bedömning, behandling och rehabilitering för patienter med smärta. Verksamheten består av Smärtmottagning, Smärtrehabmottagning och -rehabiliteringsprogram, som bemannas av ca 35 medarbetare.

I rehabiliteringsverksamheten finns två mottagningsteam, som gör bedömningar av patienterna som kallas till oss, och två programteam, som bedriver rehabiliteringsprogram med målsättningen att våra patienter ska ges verktyg att utveckla hanteringsstrategier för att bibehålla eller öka sin arbetsförmåga. 

Eftersom en av våra två kuratorer kommer vara föräldraledig en tid framöver söker vi nu en kurator som vill förstärka vårt team! Utrymmet är just nu ett 12 månaders vikariat. Kanske passar det dig som är i början av din karriär och vill testa på olika arbetsplatser, men också dig som är mitt i karriären, men känner att du vill förstärka din kompetens inom området smärta?

Hos oss arbetar du dagtid med möjlighet till flexibel arbetstid. Du har dessutom möjlighet att utnyttja friskvårdstimme. Vi erbjuder heltid med möjlighet till deltid.

1 plats(er). 

ARBETSUPPGIFTER
Som kurator hos oss bidrar du till att ta väl hand om andra och få människor att må bättre.

Hos oss arbetar du i team tillsammans med fysioterapeut/sjukgymnast, arbetsterapeut, psykolog och läkare. I teamet utgör du den psykosociala kompetensen i bedömning, intervention och uppföljning. Ditt fokus ligger i stor utsträckning på psykosocialt stöd och du träffar patienter både i grupp och individuellt. Du delar även rollen som kontaktperson till patienter som deltar i programmet tillsammans med dina kollegor i teamet. Kontakter med externa aktörer som exempelvis arbetsgivare, hälsocentraler och kommuner förkommer. 

Vi arbetar kontinuerligt med utveckling och förbättring av vår verksamhet och ser deltagande i utvecklingsarbete som en självklar del i arbetet.

KVALIFIKATIONER
Vi söker dig som är utbildad socionom, gärna legitimerad hälso- och sjukvårdskurator, med något års erfarenhet av yrket. 

Du har goda kunskaper i svenska språket, både i tal och skrift. Som person är du lyhörd, känner dig trygg i din roll som kurator och har god empatisk förmåga. Du är strukturerad och kan självständigt planera din dag, samtidigt som du har en god förmåga att samarbeta i team. Vi ser gärna att du är tydlig i din kommunikation samt att du, när du kommit in i arbetet, själv tar ansvar för dina arbetsuppgifter och kan göra nödvändiga prioriteringar.

 Stor vikt kommer läggas vid personlig lämplighet och goda referenser. 

Välkommen med din ansökan!

Anställningsform: Tidsbegränsad anställning.
Varaktighet: 6 månader eller längre, tillträde: Tillträde enligt överenskommelse.

Läs mer om våra förmåner för dig som jobbar med oss på webbsidan

https://www.regionvasterbotten.se/nar-du-jobbar-hos-oss/formaner

Vi strävar efter en jämn könsfördelning och ser mångfald som en styrka och välkomnar därför sökande med olika bakgrund.

Inför rekryteringsarbetet har vi tagit ställning till rekryteringskanaler och marknadsföring. Vi undanbeder oss därför bestämt kontakt med mediesäljare, rekryteringssajter och liknande.

Om du har skyddad identitet och vill ansöka så kontaktar du rekryterande chef och skickar sedan in dina ansökningshandlingar via post.

title: Purchasing
description:
Pay: $24.00 - $28.00 per hour

Join our team:

Unisource is seeking a purchasing specialist to join our industrial purchasing department. As a Purchasing Specialist, you will play a key role in driving profitability and customer satisfaction by procuring materials efficiently and cost-effectively. Manage supplier relationships, oversee procurement activities, and ensure pricing is aligned with optimal order quantities. You will analyze market trends, cost fluctuations, and sales data to time purchases strategically and prevent overstock. This is a full-time, in-office position scheduled Monday-Friday.


What you will do:

Procure materials efficiently and on time by following established processes within the ERP system.

Develop processes to attain required inventory turns per year.

Analyze trends in supplier pricing, lead times, and sales order activity to determine the correct timing of purchases.

Track supplier purchases for on-time delivery, price control, and consistent quality.

Work with individual product line groups to optimize the reduction of excess and obsolete materials.

Collaborate with departments to improve processes related to inventory activities.

Work with engineering, supplies, and sales, to ensure a smooth transition of new products from development to production.

Report price increases from the supply base to the manager.

Document increases and provide a total increase to the manager for sales price lists.

Develop primary and secondary suppliers for all products and components.

Issue purchase orders to selected suppliers and manage each state of the PO process through receiving.

Verify the accuracy of computerizes purchasing records


Skills & Qualifications:

Skilled in Microsoft Office, emphasis on Excel skills

Ability to recognize and resolve problems in a timely manner

Gathers and analyzes data skillfully

Ability to speak clearly and persuasively in positive or negative situations

Strong negotiation and analytic skills

Prioritize and plan work activities based on daily need with competing priorities and deadlines, and last minute changes

Ability to use time efficiently and develop realistic action plans

Dependable, reliable, and consistent

Ability to follow and respond to management direction appropriately.

Ability to communicate effectively with other employees, managers, and external relationships while maintaining confidentiality

Minimum one year experience in a purchasing environment


Physical Requirements:

Frequent use of computer systems, with routine typing and sitting for prolonged periods of time.

Ability to sit, walk and stand for extended periods of time.


Upon being selected for this position you will be required to pass a background check and urinalysis test.


What’s in it for You?

Pay starting at $24.00-$28.00 depending on experience

Quarterly profit-sharing bonuses

Intercompany Growth opportunities

Health Insurance, HSA, FSA Dental, Vision, Life/Disability insurance

401(k) with employer match

Paid Time Off

Paid Holidays

Employee Assistance Program


Job Type

Full-Time, Non-Exempt

On-Site

Monday through Friday

title: Senior projektplanerare sökes för konsultuppdrag genom TIKK TAKK
description:
Har du gedigen erfarenhet av projektplanering, kostnadsstyrning och Primavera P6? TIKK TAKK söker nu en senior projektplanerare för ett konsultuppdrag inom Capital Portfolio Delivery. Du får en central roll i planeringen och uppföljningen av större projekt och program i en internationell och föränderlig verksamhet.

Om uppdraget

Som senior projektplanerare stöttar du projekt- och programledare med att utveckla heltäckande tidplaner, budgetar och beslutsunderlag. Du ansvarar för att samordna projektens aktiviteter, resurser och kostnader samt säkerställer att planeringen är aktuell och följer etablerade standarder.

Du bidrar även till verksamhetens långsiktiga investeringsplanering genom att samordna underlag, analysera prioriteringar och stötta ledningen i strategiska beslut.

Dina huvudsakliga arbetsuppgifter

Utveckla och förvalta övergripande tidplaner och kostnadsplaner för projekt och program.

Skapa integrerade tidplaner för projektens olika arbetspaket.

Strukturera aktiviteter och leveranser utifrån projektens Work Breakdown Structure, WBS.

Lägga in resurs- och arbetsinsatsbehov i tidplanerna.

Identifiera resursöverbelastning, kritiska aktiviteter och beroenden mellan olika funktioner.

Följa projektens framdrift och analysera avvikelser från beslutad plan.

Identifiera riskområden och föreslå återhämtnings- och korrigeringsåtgärder.

Delta aktivt i regelbundna projekt- och uppföljningsmöten.

Ta fram statusrapporter, fyraveckorsprognoser och underlag till projekt- och programledning.

Utveckla och följa upp relevanta nyckeltal och projektmått.

Samordna budget, kostnadsuppföljning och kassaflödesprognoser tillsammans med ekonomifunktionen.

Stötta projekt- och programledare med omfattning, milstolpar, risker, åtgärdsplaner, budgetar, resurser och fastställda basplaner.

Samordna ändringshantering och bedöma hur förändringar påverkar omfattning, tid, resurser och kostnader.

Säkerställa att projektplaner och budgetunderlag är kompletta, aktuella och korrekt dokumenterade.

Bidra till utvecklingen av gemensamma arbetssätt och standarder för tids- och kostnadsstyrning.

Stödja strategisk investeringsplanering genom analys, samordning och framtagning av beslutsunderlag.

Vem är du?

Vi söker dig som arbetar strukturerat och analytiskt och som kan skapa kontroll och tydlighet i komplexa projektmiljöer. Du är van vid att samordna flera funktioner, hantera beroenden och kommunicera med både interna beslutsfattare och externa leverantörer.

Du är proaktiv, resultatinriktad och trygg i att lyfta risker och avvikelser. Rollen kräver att du kan prioritera mellan flera parallella uppgifter och samtidigt behålla ett tydligt helhetsperspektiv.

Relevant universitetsexamen, exempelvis inom teknik, ingenjörsvetenskap, farmaci eller motsvarande område.

Minst fem års erfarenhet av att arbeta tillsammans med projekt- eller programledare och entreprenörer i en internationell miljö.

Avancerade kunskaper i professionella planeringsverktyg, särskilt Primavera P6 och Microsoft Project.

Erfarenhet av resursplanering, kritisk linje, kostnadsstyrning och uppföljning av projektavvikelser.

Mycket goda kunskaper i Office 365, inklusive Teams.

Flytande kunskaper i svenska och engelska, både i tal och skrift.

Välkommen med din ansökan!

title: Mekaniker / Automontør søges til MAX DUE A/S i Slagelse
description:
Vi har meget travlt og søger i den forbindelse en ekstra mekaniker / automontør til vores KIA og MG afdeling i Slagelse

Vores primære arbejdsområde er KIA og MG som vi er autoriseret forhandler af. Et par spændende mærker under en importør, som vi har et godt samarbejde med, og gode og stabile forhold hos.

Som supplement til nyvogns-forretningen, beskæftiger vi os også med brugtbilssalg, både af egne og fremmede mærker, som vi også håndterer mekanisk.

Du kommer til at arbejde med både konventionelt mekanisk arbejde samt fejlsøgning, garantiarbejde & servicering. Herudover vil du især komme til at arbejde med Hybrid & Elbiler - et spændende område, vi og vores nyvogns-mærker især bestræber sig på at være førende indenfor.

Vi forventer, at du:

  • Er uddannet automekaniker/automontør
  • Er i stand til at arbejde effektivt, selvstændigt og struktureret.
  • Er grundig og kvalitetsbevidst.
  • Er mødestabil og fleksibel.
  • Er en holdspiller, der kan indgå som en vigtig del værkstedsteamet.
  • Er indstillet på at lære nye systemer i en branche der udvikler sig.

Vi tilbyder:

  • Et udfordrende job i en velfungerende forretning.
  • En hverdag i en travl virksomhed, hvor samarbejde og gode kollegaer er grundlæggende for et godt arbejdsmiljø
  • Plads til at arbejde selvstændigt og med høj grad af frihed under ansvar.
  • Løn efter kvalifikationer, og god mulighed for udvikling og efteruddannelse.

Om os:

MAX DUE A/S er en velkonsolideret og familiedrevet organisation med mere end 50 års erfaring indenfor autobranchen, og har afdelinger i Køge, Næstved, Ringsted og Slagelse. Vi beskæftiger i dag 85 medarbejdere, og kan bryste os af at langt de fleste har været hos os i rigtigt mange år.

Som virksomhed bestræber vi os på at være på forkant med tiden, men vi tror stadig på gamle principper om at det er vores kollegaer der gør forskellen i hverdagen.

MAX DUE A/S er i afdelingen i Slagelse autoriseret forhandler af Kia og MG, et par spændende mærker, som især har fået fart på i takt med at danskerne er begyndt at vælge el-biler.

Vi beskæftiger os desuden med handel af brugte biler fra afdelingen, og har herudover også skadesværksted i huset. Hverdagen i Slagelse er præget af en god dynamik, som i høj grad er fordret af afdelingens gode sammenhold, der mærkes både på gulvet og på tværs af husets andre afdelinger.

Ansøgning og kontakt:

Er du interesseret, så send CV & ansøgning til Eftermarkedschef Jesper Bækgaard Jespersen på mail: jeje@maxdue.dk

Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig

title: Lead Software Engineer - Settlements and Disputes
description:
Company Description

Forward with Cuscal

Ever tapped your phone to buy a morning coffee or made a purchase from your favourite online store? Chances are, we've made it happen.

At Cuscal, we've been at the forefront of payments innovation for nearly 60 years, enabling seamless, secure solutions that millions of Australians rely on every day. From launching Australia's first ATM to helping shape the future of digital payments, we continue to transform the way money moves.

Job Description

What you’ll be doing

As a Lead Engineer, you’ll work closely with Product Owners, Engineers and delivery squads to turn the core banking business needs into technical solutions.

You’ll be responsible for:

  • Leading technical solution design and delivery ensuring alignment with domain architecture strategies
  • Providing hands-on engineering support and helping developers resolve technical challenges
  • Reviewing code and ensuring solutions meet quality, security and engineering standards
  • Identifying technical risks, dependencies and roadblocks and driving these through to resolution
  • Embedding effective development, testing and operations practices across the squad
  • Supporting root cause analysis, post-incident reviews and the prioritisation of technical defects
  • Leading release planning, change sequencing and technical delivery decisions
  • Contributing to strategic technical roadmaps in partnership with product and architecture teams
  • Creating and maintaining clear technical documentation, standards and processes
  • Mentoring engineers and helping uplift technical capability across the team
Qualifications

About you

You’re an experienced software engineer who enjoys solving complex problems, leading technical conversations and helping others deliver their best work. You can balance hands-on engineering with broader platform, product and delivery considerations.

You’ll bring:

  • Extensive experience as a software engineer including previous leadership experience
  • Domain knowledge in Payments, Settlements and Disputes
  • Hands-on experience designing, building and delivering software solutions
  • Experience implementing development automation, CI/CD, test automation, DevOps practices and modern deployment approaches
  • Strong knowledge of scalability, performance, resilience and disaster recovery
  • Programming experience with Java or Node.js
  • Knowledge across AWS cloud components
  • Experience reviewing code and supporting developers and testers through design, build and delivery
  • The ability to identify delivery risks, sequence technical work and resolve roadblocks
  • The ability to communicate complex technical information clearly to technical and non-technical stakeholders
Additional Information

Why Cuscal?

At Cuscal, you’ll experience interesting work that’s transforming. You get the security of an established organisation and the energy of a company committed to innovation. For 60 years, we’ve set the standard in payments, and now we’re preparing to redefine it for the future.

You’ll also enjoy a range of benefits, including:

  • Recognition and growth: Celebrate achievements through IGNITE and grow with tailored development opportunities
  • Wellbeing focus: We support your physical, mental and financial health with holistic initiatives and access to discounts via Cuscal Advantage
  • Diversity and inclusion: Join a workplace that values different perspectives and flexible work arrangements

If you’re excited about this opportunity, we’d love to explore how you can contribute to our vision. Applications may be reviewed as they’re received, so don’t wait - apply now.

Cuscal is an equal opportunity employer committed to creating a diverse, inclusive and barrier-free workplace. We welcome applications from Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander peoples, people living with disability, LGBTQIA+ communities and individuals from culturally diverse backgrounds.

Note: Cuscal does not accept unsolicited resumes from recruitment agencies or search firms.

title: Principal Applications Security Architect
description:
ZoomInfo is where careers accelerate. We move fast, think boldly, and empower you to do the best work of your life. You’ll be surrounded by teammates who care deeply, challenge each other, and celebrate wins. With tools that amplify your impact and a culture that backs your ambition, you won’t just contribute. You’ll make things happen–fast.

Position Overview:

This role is responsible for defining and advancing ZoomInfo’s security architecture across cloud platforms, applications, data, identity, networks, corporate technology, and AI-enabled systems. The Security Architect partners closely with Engineering, Infrastructure, Product, IT, Privacy, Data, and other stakeholders to embed security into technical design decisions and deliver secure, scalable, and resilient solutions.

The role provides technical leadership for complex security and risk decisions, including cloud and application architecture, identity and access management, data protection, network segmentation, API security, encryption and key management, logging and detection capabilities, secure software delivery, and AI security and governance. This includes assessing AI and machine-learning solutions, model and data risks, third-party AI services, prompt and data-handling risks, access controls, and the security implications of AI-enabled products and internal use cases. Working collaboratively with delivery teams, the Security Architect translates security, privacy, compliance, and responsible AI requirements into practical architecture patterns, technical standards, and implementation guidance that support business objectives while managing risk.

What you will do:

Enterprise Security Architecture & Strategy

  • Define and evolve the enterprise security architecture, principles, reference architectures, security patterns, and technical standards.
  • Lead architecture reviews for high-impact initiatives, new products, major platform changes, acquisitions, strategic integrations, and material technology transformations.
  • Establish and maintain security design standards across cloud, application, IAM, data protection, and zero-trust networks.
  • Translate security, privacy, and compliance requirements into actionable technical requirements and implementation guidance.
  • Influence security roadmaps and investment decisions through expert analysis of emerging threats and technology changes.
  • Create and maintain threat models, architecture risk assessments, security exception processes, and security design documentation.

AI Security & Governance

  • Define and promote security architecture patterns for AI-enabled products, machine-learning workloads, generative AI applications, and internal AI use cases.
  • Partner with Engineering, Product, Data, Privacy, Legal, and Risk teams to assess AI threats, including prompt injection, data leakage, model abuse, insecure integrations, supply-chain risks, and unauthorized access to models or training data.
  • Establish practical controls and review processes for AI systems, including data classification, model and vendor risk assessments, access management, monitoring, logging, testing, incident response, and ongoing governance.

Technical Leadership & Risk Management

  • Independently assess complex security risks across multi-cloud environments, applications, data platforms, identity systems, networks, endpoints, and third-party integrations.
  • Design pragmatic, scalable security controls that balance risk reduction, engineering velocity, customer commitments, and regulatory obligations.
  • Partner with engineering and technology leaders to resolve architectural tradeoffs, address inherited technical risk, and prioritize security investments.
  • Identify systemic security issues and develop long-term remediation strategies rather than isolated findings.
  • Serve as a trusted technical advisor during significant security incidents, identifying architectural contributing factors and defining durable corrective actions.
  • Mentor security engineers and architects, raising the technical capability and architectural maturity of the broader Security organization.

Cross-Functional Collaboration & Governance

  • Create formal collaboration networks across Security, Engineering, Infrastructure, Product, Data, IT, Privacy, and Legal teams.
  • Develop risk-based decision frameworks and present recommendations to senior technical and business stakeholders.
  • Represent Security in formal cross-functional forums, governance bodies, customer discussions, and executive-level technical reviews.
  • Drive adoption of approved security architecture standards and patterns across the organization.
  • Support customer security assessments, enterprise sales engagements, and audit or regulatory requirements.

What you bring:

Education and Experience:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Security, Engineering, or a related technical discipline, plus 8+ years of relevant experience; or Master’s degree plus 5+ years of relevant experience; or PhD with 5 years of experience; or an equivalent combination of education and experience.
  • Typically requires a minimum of 12 years of related professional experience in information security, security engineering, architecture, infrastructure, or software engineering.
  • Demonstrated expertise designing and implementing security architecture in complex, distributed, cloud-based environments.
  • Experience evaluating ambiguous situations, synthesizing complex technical and business inputs, and developing independent, risk-based recommendations.
  • Experience influencing senior engineering, product, infrastructure, and business leaders without direct authority.
  • Experience developing security standards, reference designs, architectural governance processes, or enterprise-wide security programs.
  • Experience in a SaaS, data platform, B2B technology, or highly regulated environment preferred.

Certifications (Preferred):

  • CISSP, CCSP, CISM, GIAC, AWS Security Specialty, Azure Security Engineer, Google Professional Cloud Security Engineer, or equivalent.

Technical Knowledge & Skills:

Security Architecture & Frameworks:

  • Cloud and multi-cloud security architecture, including AWS, GCP, and Azure.
  • Application and API security architecture, including OWASP Top 10 and secure SDLC practices.
  • Identity and Access Management (IAM) and enterprise identity ecosystems.
  • Data protection, encryption, key management, and data governance.
  • Network segmentation, zero-trust architecture, and secure networking.
  • Logging, monitoring, detection, and incident response integration.
  • Third-party and software supply-chain security.

Core Competencies:

  • Ability to work independently to determine methods and procedures for new or specialized assignments.
  • Expertise in addressing significant and unique issues where analysis of situations or data requires evaluation of intangibles.
  • Strong independent judgment in methods, techniques, and evaluation criteria for obtaining results.
  • Ability to create formal networks involving coordination among groups and contribute to company objectives in creative and effective ways.

title: Tilsynsførende til rengøring på Københavns Universitet i København
description:
"I Forenede har vi fokus på, at vores medarbejdere går glade på arbejde"

Forenede Service søger en engageret og serviceorienteret tilsynsførende til rengøring i en fuldtidsstilling, som finder det naturligt at tage ansvar, prioriterer det gode samarbejde og lægger en ære i at sikre trivsel blandt medarbejderne.

Du vil føre tilsyn på Københavns Universitet i København. Det er din fornemmeste opgave, at sikre dine medarbejdere er motiveret og rustet til at udføre de aftalte opgaver.

Som tilsynsførende:

  • assisterer du servicelederen med den daglige ledelse af serviceassistenterne.
  • er det din opgave at føre tilsyn samt kvalitetssikre, at leverancerne lever op de aftalte krav.
  • er du synlig i driften og bidrager til at sikre proaktivitet og engagement i dit team.
  • er den primære arbejdstid morgen

Som person er du:

  • en holdspiller som er engageret, tager initiativ og trives med at have og tage ansvar
  • omhyggelig og detaljeorienteret, men samtidig ser det store billede
  • serviceorienteret og imødekommende overfor dine kunder, dine kolleger og ikke mindst dit team.

Vi forventer desuden at du:

  • har erfaring fra en lignende stilling i service- og rengøringsbranchen
  • er PC vant
  • taler, skriver og forstår dansk.

Det er en fordel hvis du er INSTA 800 certificeret, men ikke et krav.

I Forenede Service er medarbejderen i fokus. For når vi er glade, er vi bedre til at gøre vores kunder glade.

Vi efterstræber, at alle medarbejdere har mulighed for at udvikles og udfordres i deres faglighed. Vi samarbejder om at skabe en motiverende arbejdsplads med både teamspirit og engagement.

Vi tilbyder desuden;

  • en ansvarsfuld stilling hvor du kan gøre en forskel
  • løn efter kvalifikationer
  • sundheds- og pensionsordning
  • mulighed for at leje attraktive og billige ferieboliger i Danmark og udlandet.

Vores værdier udgør fundamentet for vores kultur og er: Ansvar - Engagement - Omtanke

Det betyder, at vi tager ansvar for at sikre, at der er gjort ordentligt rent og vedligeholdt så vi leverer kvalitetsservice hos vores kunder. Vi viser engagement ved at have et professionelt udtryk, som betyder at vi fremtoner ordentligt og præsentabelt og bruger de metoder der oplæres i. Vi bruger omtanke ved at vise hensyn og respekt for de mennesker vi møder, og som vi hver dag gør en forskel for.

Vil du med på holdet?

Hvis du har spørgsmål, er velkommen til at kontakte Serviceleder Beverlyn Lysgaard på 21378646 eller bely@forenede.dk.

Vi holder samtaler løbende, så hvis du kan se dig selv i denne rolle omgivet af fantastiske kolleger i et dynamisk miljø så skynd dig at sende din ansøgning.

Du søger ved at klikke på den blå knap "Ansøg". Du bedes uploade CV og ansøgning.


Velkommen til Danmarks største privatejede Facility Service virksomhed

Forenede Service A/S er en mangfoldig virksomhed, der beskæftiger ca. 2.600 medarbejdere, som repræsenterer +80 forskellige nationaliteter. Vores medarbejdere servicerer flere hundredtusinder personer, når de dagligt leverer services inden for rengøring, kantine og ejendomsdrift til offentlige og erhvervsvirksomheder i Danmark.

Forenede Service A/S er en del af Forenede koncernen, som er en familieejet servicekoncern med en omsætning på mere end DKK 3 mia. Forenede Koncernen leverer omsorgsydelser og Facility Service gennem virksomhederne Forenede Service i Danmark og Forenede Care i Danmark og Sverige.

title: CNC-operatör
description:
TopWork är ett auktoriserat företag som arbetar med bemanning och rekrytering. Våra kunder finns inom branscher som industri, lager, logistik, bygg och administration. Vi är din trygga, professionella partner oavsett om du söker nya medarbetare eller nya utmaningar. TopWork - vi hittar rätt medarbetare till rätt arbetsgivare och arbetsplats.

CNC-operatör till Staffanstorp

Vi på TopWork söker nu erfarna CNC-operatörer till en kund i Staffanstorp. Här får du möjlighet att bli en del av ett stabilt team i en modern verkstad med fokus på kvalitet, precision och noggrannhet.

Det finns just nu två tjänster att söka, en på ständig dagtid och en på ständigt kvällsskift. Vi söker dig som har erfarenhet av CNC-bearbetning och trivs med ett praktiskt och tekniskt arbete där kvalitet står i fokus.

Dina arbetsuppgifter

Som CNC-operatör kommer du att arbeta med att ställa och köra CNC-maskiner samt följa produktionen från start till färdig detalj. Du kommer bland annat att läsa ritningar, mäta och kontrollera detaljer samt säkerställa att produktionen håller rätt kvalitet. I arbetet ingår även daglig tillsyn av maskinerna och enklare underhåll.

Programmeringskunskaper är meriterande, men det viktigaste är att du har en god praktisk erfarenhet av CNC och känner dig trygg i maskinerna.

Vi söker dig som

Har tidigare erfarenhet av CNC-bearbetning och är van vid att arbeta noggrant och kvalitetsmedvetet. Du har god ritningsläsningsförmåga och erfarenhet av mätteknik. Som person är du ansvarstagande, tekniskt intresserad och trivs med att samarbeta med andra.

Du behöver kunna arbeta självständigt, ta ansvar för ditt arbete och samtidigt vara en lagspelare i produktionen.

Arbetstider

Tjänsterna är förlagda till:

Ständig dagtid

Ständigt kvällsskift

Vi ser gärna att du som söker är intresserad av en långsiktig möjlighet och vill utvecklas tillsammans med företaget.

Låter det intressant? Skicka in din ansökan redan idag – vi intervjuar löpande!

Tjänsten inleds hos TopWork med ett mål om att kandidaten senare ska övergå till en anställning hos kund. Som konsult hos TopWork får du en konsultchef som stöttar dig i ditt uppdrag hos kund. Vi ger dig råd och rekommendationer om hur du kan utvecklas i ditt arbete.

title: Program Director
description:
Seeking a highly motivated and experienced Digital Lead with project level oversight and delivery accountability of end-to-end digital elements of a complex program of works. As a Digital Lead you will have accountability for scope, schedule, budget, requirements, customer, stakeholder management, digital planning, and vendor management to enable delivery of all digital components within new builds and ongoing redevelopment of large Hospital facilities through to the successful conclusion of the Information, Communication and Technology (ICT) Program/Project.

The role:

Queensland Health is currently undertaking one of the largest health infrastructure programs ever seen in Australia. The largest of these, the Hospital Rescue Plan (HRP) is a visionary program designed to bring service and capabilities to more Queenslanders than ever before. The Hospital Rescue Plan will deliver 3 new hospitals, a new Queensland Cancer Centre, and the expansion of 11 existing hospitals resulting in 2,600 additional beds across Queensland.

Do you want to be a part of a dynamic, fast paced and agile project team? Do you want to make a real difference by laying the foundations; and building clinical care capability that will provide digital healthcare solutions in the home and at the bedside, both now and in the future?

Driven by a desire to improve healthcare outcomes, you will have vision and motivation and will be able to use exceptional communication skills to provide strategic advice and direction to both your team and external stakeholders.

Are you right for this role?

To be successful in this role you will demonstrate the following skills and experience:

  • High level leadership, and management of complex high-risk IM/ICT Projects.
  • Leads project planning, scheduling, controlling, and reporting activities for strategic, high impact, high risk projects.
  • Develops accurate budgets (within a probability range) and forecasts for projects including tracking actual, maintenance, and support costs. Drives adoption of, and adherence to, financial management policies and standards.
  • Demonstrates flexibility in response to change and supports the workforce to embrace new expectations through clarity of the intended outcomes.
  • Facilitates the early adoption of emerging digital technologies and data to deliver greater efficiency in services.

The following experience will be highly regarded:

  • Demonstrated experience in new hospital projects (ideally within Queensland Health) and understands the commercial constructs under which the digital scope is delivered.
  • Demonstrated experience in brownfield construction projects and in particular healthcare capital development projects will be highly regarded.
  • Demonstrated experience in leading large multi-disciplinary project teams.
  • Demonstrable experience in managing complex ICT infrastructure projects in a building construction environment.
  • Understanding technology streams, network, phones, EUC etc.
  • At this senior level multiple projects would have had to be undertaken by the successful candidate to be considered.

To be considered for this exciting opportunity submit your CV or resume and a short statement (maximum 2 pages) addressing your experience in each of the key areas outlined above via Smart Jobs today.

About the Digital Capital Program - eHealth Queensland

eHealth Queensland (eHQ) is one of the largest Information Communication Technology operations in the state. It is responsible for ensuring the smooth operation of information systems and technologies so that Queensland Health employees and health providers have access to information that supports the delivery of health care.

eHQ advises on state-wide eHealth innovation, strategy, planning, standards, architecture and governance and is responsible for delivering clinical, corporate and infrastructure ICT programs in line with the Queensland Health vision and investment priorities, providing modern ICT infrastructure and customer support for desktop, mobile, smart devices, telehealth, data centres, network and security.

The Delivery Services Branch (DSB) is Queensland Health's trusted partner and advisor for digital health project delivery excellence.

DSB ensures the successful delivery of major IT projects, operational ICT delivery and initiatives to our customers across Queensland Health for the benefit of all Queenslanders. This function is critical to eHealth Queensland realising its overall vision, which is to 'advance healthcare through digital innovation'.

The DCP has been established within DSB to support the delivery of the Queensland Government Health Infrastructure Capital Program in partnership with the Health Capital Division to meet the growing demand for health services.

eHQ were appointed the Master System Integrator (MSI) for all health infrastructure capital projects and have established the DCP to standardise and centralise the delivery of digital components required for all Health Infrastructure Capital Program initiatives.

title: Principal Engineer, Analog Design (Team Lead)
description:
Company Overview

Ambiq is on a mission to enable intelligence everywhere — powering the AI edge revolution with the world's lowest-power semiconductor solutions.

Built on our proprietary sub- and near-threshold technology, our chips deliver multi-fold improvements in energy efficiency without costly process scaling. Since 2010, we've shipped over 300 million units to customers building smarter wearables, medical devices, IoT products, and AI-powered edge applications.

Our cross-functional teams span design, research, development, production, marketing, sales, and operations across Austin, Hsinchu, Shanghai, Shenzhen, and Singapore. We move fast, tackle hard problems, and create space for people to grow through complex, meaningful work that shapes the future of technology.

We're looking for self-motivated, creative problem-solvers who are eager to push technological limits and make a real impact in energy efficiency.

At Ambiq, we live by five values: Innovate. Collaborate. Focus. Learn. Achieve.

If that's you, join us — the intelligence everywhere revolution starts here.

Scope

As Principal Engineer, Analog Design (Team Lead) at Ambiq, you will contribute to the technical roadmap and architecture for the company's core analog subsystems — including PMUs, clocking, and data converters — while directly leading and developing a team of analog designers.

This role sets technical direction across multiple concurrent programs, partners with Architecture, RTL, and Product teams at the roadmap level, and represents Ambiq's analog design capability to customers and partners. Designs span leading-edge technologies such as 22nm, 12nm, and beyond.

You will balance individual technical contribution with people leadership: driving the highest-risk architectural decisions personally while coaching Staff and Senior engineers through their own design cycles, spec definition, and career growth.

The successful candidate is a proven technical leader who elevates the people around them, sets a high bar for design rigor, and is comfortable being the final escalation point on the toughest analog design and organizational challenges.

This role will be onsite, and the candidate will be expected to have a presence on site 5 days a week.

Responsibilities

  • Own multi-generation architecture strategy and chip/block-level spec definition across analog subsystems
  • Lead, mentor, and grow a team of analog design engineers, including hiring, career development, and performance management
  • Set technical standards and design methodology for circuit architecture, verification, and layout supervision across the team
  • Make final calls on the highest-risk circuit architecture and verification trade-offs
  • Directly conduct or supervise transistor-level analog IC design for the most critical or novel circuit blocks
  • Chair design reviews across multiple projects; drive resolution of the most complex action items
  • Partner with digital design leadership to align interface specs and verification strategy for analog/digital integration
  • Own the analog test and validation strategy for prototype bring-up through high-volume production
  • Represent analog engineering in cross-functional roadmap, customer, and executive discussions
  • Support Marketing, Product Engineering, and Applications leadership on product definition and customer commitments
  • Drive continuous improvement in design flow, tools, and reuse strategy across the analog team

title: Replenishment Planner
description:
In Supply Chain Operations, we lead, plan and execute the supply of IKEA products between suppliers and retailers. We work across the IKEA value chain to make sure products reach stores and retail partners in a simple, efficient and responsible way. Our shared goals are clear: availability, affordability and sustainability. Together, we help make IKEA products available for the many people.


Within SCO, Category Area Logistics Services secures and develops the logistics services that make the goods flow work in practice. We work with distribution, mid-receiver units and food logistics services. Together with our logistics service providers, we secure the right capacity, cost, service, quality, safety and sustainability.


Category Food Logistics Services is part of CALS and focuses on securing logistics solutions for IKEA Food, including warehousing, cold-chain transportation and goods flow to stores. We work with temperature-controlled flows and everyday follow-up to support availability, food safety, freshness, cost efficiency and sustainability across markets.

IKEA Food is an important part of the total IKEA experience. It helps us welcome people, bring Swedish food traditions to life, support everyday moments in our stores, and make good food available to the many people. Behind every meal, snack and food product, there is a goods flow that needs to be safe, fresh, reliable and cost-conscious. In Category Food Logistics Services, we commit to make that happen.


About the role

We are now looking for a Replenishment Planner who wants to be part of the IKEA Food goods flow, where planning accuracy and clear retail connection support availability, freshness, food safety and a stronger customer experience. In this role, daily planning and execution come together so food products can move reliably and efficiently from distribution centres to stores and into the IKEA Food experience.

The role works closely with markets, retail partners, distribution centres, logistics service providers and internal planning teams. You will use signals from orders, stock, sales, forecasts and distribution to take clear replenishment actions, supporting the Food transformation ambition to simplify execution, reduce handovers and focus planning where it creates business value.


In this role, you will:

  • Own DC-to-store replenishment availability for assigned markets, retail partners and product flows.
  • Work with retail orders, replenishment parameters, exceptions and outbound flow execution within agreed ways of working.
  • Analyse orders, stock, sales, forecasts and distribution signals to see risks early and act in time.
  • Balance availability, food safety, freshness, cost, sustainability and service level when planning and following up the outbound flow.
  • Coordinate replenishment needs linked to range changes, sales activities, phase-in, phase-out, market-specific products and limited shelf life.
  • Identify shortage, overstock, short shelf-life and service risks, and recommend practical actions or escalation.
  • Improve ways of working together with markets, retail partners, DC/LSP operations and internal stakeholders.

We are looking for someone who:

  • Has experience from replenishment planning, order management, outbound logistics, retail supply operations or food goods flow.
  • Works confidently in ERP e.g. Infor tools, order-management, replenishment and planning systems.
  • Uses operational KPIs, order data, stock data and deviation follow-up to make clear decisions, including using excel and Power Bi.
  • Understands availability, freshness, quality, shelf-life and service risks, and knows when to act or escalate.
  • Communicates well across markets, retail partners, logistics service providers and internal teams.
  • Takes pride in accuracy, structure and keeping the retail goods flow reliable every day.


Reliable availability depends on many small replenishment and outbound flow decisions done right, every day.


As Replenishment Planner, you help secure the right products in the right place at the right time, with good freshness, service and cost-conscious flow. You turn retail and distribution signals into action so stores and partners can rely on stable availability, and IKEA Food can be enjoyed with trust, quality and care across markets.

We look forward to receiving your application by the 28th of September, 2026.

We always recruit based on values, competence, potential and diversity. Once competence

requirements are met, we will first consider impacted co-workers at Inter IKEA Group.

title: Loss Mitigation and Collections Specialist
location: Headquarters North, Santa Ana, CA, US
description:
At Orange County’s Federal Credit Union (OCFCU), banking is personal—and it always has been. For more than 87 years, we’ve built genuine relationships, provided trusted guidance, and put people before transactions to help our members achieve life’s most important milestones.

Today, with more than $3 billion in assets and 145,000+ members, we continue to grow while staying true to the values that have made us one of Orange County’s most respected financial institutions. We’ve been named #1 Credit Union by the Orange County Register for several years and most recently in 2024 & 2025. We’re also honored with workplace satisfaction—driven directly by employee voices. When you join OCFCU, you’re joining a workplace where people genuinely enjoy showing up and feel empowered to do meaningful, impactful work every day.

In the role of loss mitigation and collections you will be performing collection efforts on delinquent loans, negative shares, mitigating losses and maximizing loss recoveries. The position maintains current knowledge of collection laws, regulations, department policies & procedures and ensures a minimum loss of funds and maximum retention of Member goodwill. The role represents the credit union in a positive professional manner to members and the public.


ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS:

  • Contacts borrowers through various approved methods in order to identify the true cause of non-payment and helps to provide personalized loan repayment options. Collects on delinquent loans, credit cards, and negative shares.
  • Utilizes strong knowledge of establishing effective payment plans that will bring accounts current, including promises to pay and following up on broken promises.
  • Works in a call center environment handling both inbound and outbound calls.
  • Make repossession recommendations, provides reinstatement/redemption requirements to borrowers, and generates Final Demand Letters.
  • Remains current with changes in laws and regulations, recommends changes in policies and procedures as necessary to ensure credit union is in compliance. Disseminates regulatory changes to the Loan Servicing Team and insures compliance.
  • Assists the Management Team with ensuring the department makes every effort to recover deficiency balances through the resources of the Loan Servicing Associates and/or outside collection agencies.
  • Represents the credit union in a positive professional manner to members and the public.
  • Maintains and promotes established standards of service and metrics within the Loan Servicing Team. Meets or exceeds goals and expectations established by management.
  • Maintains high level of Member service in every member interaction. Promotes Credit Union products and services.
  • Working knowledge of Fair Debt Collections Practices Act (FDCPA), Fair Credit Reporting Act (FCRA), Bankruptcy Laws and Consumer Financial Protection Bureau (CFPB) Collection Regulations/Guidance
  • Works closely with Loan Servicing Associates and other departments to communicate any issues that may arise that relate to Member service and Loan Servicing. Placing a premium on handling inquiries in a professional, efficient and timely manner.


QUALIFICATIONS:

Experience / Training / Education:

  • High school education or equivalent required.
  • At least one year of relevant work experience in collections, recoveries, loan servicing, or financial institution required.
  • Experience in customer relations, problem resolution, and error correction required.
  • Knowledge of the Fair Debt Collections Practices Act, Fair Credit Reporting Act. Reg B and Reg Z, bankruptcy procedures, Consumer Financial Protection Bureau Collection Regulations/Guidance, delinquency activities, and financial counseling.
  • Knowledge of Rees Levering, CA Uniform Financial Code, and other State or Federal regulations governing collections.


If you're looking for an opportunity where you can make a difference, grow your skills, and help create exceptional workplace environments, we'd love to hear from you.

  • We believe great talent deserves fair, transparent pay—and room to grow. Hourly pay is based on experience, internal equity, and level: Loan Servicing and Collections Specialist I is $20.00 - $25.00 per hour.
  • Award‑winning workplace culture.
  • People before profits—always.
  • A team that supports each other and celebrates wins.
  • Health Coverage: Comprehensive benefits, including Anthem, Delta Dental, and VSP, effective from your first day.
  • Financial Security: Life insurance at no cost and a 401(k) plan with an employer match up to 6%.
  • Work-Life Balance: 13 days of vacation and seven (7) sick days annually and paid holidays.
  • Recognition & Growth: Annual merit increases, annual discretionary bonus, as well as educational grants up to $1,000 per year.

Orange County's Federal Credit Union is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Pre-employment screenings, including background and credit checks, are required.
