title: Domain Architect - AI
description:
A new transformational adventure awaits you…

How does 5 weeks of annual leave, a fulfilling career you'll genuinely enjoy, and working for a reputable organization that promotes wellbeing and drives digital transformation sound to you?

As one of Forbes 2024 ‘World’s Best Employers’ and Fortune’s ‘World’s Most Admired Companies’ for 2025, Zurich - a leader in the insurance industry, is on a journey towards a brighter future… A brighter future for you - focused on your career, your wellbeing, and your community - as well as our customers and the planet.

Join us on this thrilling journey as we work towards our vision of becoming Australia's leading digital insurer. If you're eager to be part of a values-driven global organisation that's experiencing real growth and transformation, and if you share our commitment to making a tangible difference and taking continuous steps towards a sustainable future for our people, customers, communities, and our planet, then keep reading!

Let’s create a brighter future together, let’s make a difference

It’s important to know, what you do matters. At Zurich, we don’t just cover, we care.

As our Domain Architect – AI, you’ll play a critical role in shaping the future of AI across Zurich Australia and New Zealand. Sitting within our Technology team, you'll help define the architecture, capabilities and roadmap that enable AI solutions to be delivered safely, responsibly, and at scale, supporting our ambition to become Australia's leading digital insurer.

This is an opportunity to influence enterprise-wide technology decisions, work alongside talented engineering and business teams, and turn emerging AI capabilities into practical solutions that create value for customers, employees and the wider business. You'll help establish the foundations that allow innovation to thrive while maintaining strong governance, security and compliance standards.

What does this look like in practice:

  • Defining and evolving AI capabilities that support generative AI, agentic AI and machine learning solutions at scale
  • Developing architecture roadmaps and target-state designs for Zurich’s AI platforms and capabilities
  • Providing technical leadership and guidance to engineering teams integrating AI into business solutions
  • Evaluating, selecting and governing AI technologies to support innovation and business outcomes
  • Collaborating with business and technology stakeholders to translate requirements into scalable AI solutions
  • Driving best practice across AI architecture, security, data privacy, compliance and governance frameworks

Important to your success – let’s grow together

You are a strategic thinker who enjoys solving complex problems and turning emerging technologies into practical business outcomes. You build trusted relationships across technical and non-technical teams, bring people together around a shared vision, and are passionate about mentoring others while fostering innovation and continuous improvement.

In order to be successful, you will have the following:

  • Significant experience in architecture roles delivering target states, roadmaps, capability models and solution designs
  • Experience designing and delivering AI and machine learning solutions into production environments
  • Strong knowledge of AI-specific non-functional requirements, including scalability, resilience, observability and governance
  • Hands-on experience with modern AI development technologies such as Python, JavaScript and leading GenAI frameworks
  • Experience guiding engineers and technical leaders to deliver solutions aligned with architectural intent
  • Demonstrated experience integrating AI solutions with enterprise applications and modern integration patterns including APIs

Belong. Zurich is here to support you

There are so many reasons why Zurich is a great place to be and the right choice for you, but here are just a few.

  • Enjoy 5 weeks of annual leave for permanent staff through our Z leave initiative, along with 15 days of personal/carer’s leave as we empower our people to manage their own wellbeing. Plus, access to Family Care (parental leave).
  • Benefit from a hybrid working arrangement – 3 days in the office and 2 days working from home per week for full-time employees.
  • Access programs to stay healthy and feel healthier, receive an AUD$500 wellbeing payment per year, and a AUD$295 new starter e-voucher for your work-from-home setup (flex work - hybrid working), along with other great benefits through our Shine portal.
  • Grow and thrive in your career with our award-winning training programs. We support and encourage your development because our strength lies in our people, and we value your individuality.
  • Work with global, diverse, and inclusive teams; explore your passions, fuel innovation, drive equity, collaborate, and make a positive difference beyond your role.
  • Take advantage of global mobility opportunities across more than 200 countries worldwide.
  • Volunteer and work in our state-of-the-art Green Star rated offices (when you are in the office) and dress for your day.
  • We plant a tree for every new employee.
  • Not to mention our various employer of choice awards/memberships – WGEA; Family Inclusive Workplace; Gold AWEI Employer, Pride in Diversity… to name a few.

We could go on, but the main point is that Zurich is a great place to be, where you can truly belong, be yourself, maintain work/life balance, and thrive in a supportive environment.

Zurich is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to ensuring that our recruitment process is fair and accessible for all candidates. If you require any special accommodations to participate in our recruitment process, we encourage you to please let us know at the time of your application.

So, if you want to come on an adventure that will build a brighter future together, and feel a sense of togetherness, then please apply today to start your adventure!

title: Senior Product Manager, POS
description:
About the job

At Flatpay, we're building products that make running a business simpler.

Flatpay is one of Europe's fastest-growing fintechs. Founded in Copenhagen in 2022, we've grown to 100,000+ merchants across seven markets - Denmark, Finland, France, Italy, the UK, Germany, and the Netherlands - and recently became Denmark's fastest-ever unicorn at a €1.5B valuation.

Thousands of merchants rely on our payment solutions every day. As we continue expanding our POS offering, we're looking for a Senior Product Manager who can turn complex merchant needs into products that are intuitive, reliable, and commercially impactful.

We're now scaling aggressively across Europe and investing heavily in product. This is not a role for someone who wants to manage a backlog from a distance. We need a product leader who enjoys spending time with customers, challenging assumptions, making difficult prioritization decisions, and working closely with engineers, designers, commercial teams, and leadership to shape the future of our POS platform.

What you'll do

You'll own a meaningful slice of our POS product - the software that runs the front of house for thousands of restaurants, cafés, retail stores, and salons across Europe - and be accountable for delivering outcomes, not just features.

Our merchants are not procurement teams at large enterprises. They're owner-operators. That means the bar for usability, reliability, and clarity is brutally high — a confusing settings menu or a slow checkout flow costs them real sales on a Friday night. You'll spend real time in those venues, not just in Figma.

Your work will include:

  • Defining and driving product strategy for POS solutions across multiple merchant segments

  • Sit with merchants and watch them work. Learn the difference between what they say in interviews and what they actually do on a busy Friday lunch. Bring those insights back into the roadmap

  • Translating customer insights, business objectives, and technical constraints into clear product direction

  • Understand the critical merchant value and plan the MVP rather than big deliveries

  • Working closely with engineering and design teams to deliver high-quality solutions at pace

  • Using data, customer feedback, and market insights to evaluate product performance and guide decisions

  • Helping establish product management best practices as Flatpay continues to scale

Who you are

We're less interested in whether you've worked with a specific framework and more interested in how you think and operate. We hope you are comfortable operating in a hyper-growth environment where the org chart and the roadmap both move fast.

You likely bring:

  • 6+ years of product management experience in software, fintech, payments, POS, SaaS, or a similarly complex domain

  • Background launching products 0->1 and 1->10 into multiple European markets

  • The ability to navigate ambiguity and create clarity for teams around you

  • Experience working with cross-functional product development teams

  • Confidence communicating with both technical and non-technical audiences

  • A data-informed mindset without becoming data-dependent

  • Excellent written and spoken English. Danish, French, Italian or German is a plus, not a requirement

  • Strong commercial instinct. You think about adoption, revenue, and unit economics, not just feature usage

  • Willingness to spend time in the field with merchants across our markets

  • AI literacy and implementation into everyday life and products is highly required

Bonus points if you have experience with:

  • Payments or acquiring

  • Point-of-sale systems

  • Merchant-facing products

  • Omnichannel commerce

  • Subscription or transaction-based business models

  • Familiarity with Android-based payment hardware (PAX, Ingenico, or similar)

After your 3 months, you have:

  • Built deep knowledge of merchant needs and operational realities across multiple markets

  • Established a clear product direction in a collaboration with other PMs and Product Director

  • Built deep knowledge of Flatpay product offering and identify gaps

  • Delivered meaningful improvements that merchants actively value

  • Created strong partnerships across product, engineering, design, commercial teams, and leadership

  • Contributed to a stronger product culture across Flatpay

Why Flatpay?

We're building in a market where reliability matters, customer expectations evolve quickly, and product decisions have a direct impact on real businesses.

You'll join a company with ambitious growth plans, short decision-making paths, and the opportunity to influence products used every day by merchants across Europe.

If you're excited by solving real-world problems, working closely with customers, and building products that combine software, payments, and commerce, we'd love to hear from you.

WHAT IS FLATPAY? At Flatpay, we believe that merchants deserve a payment solution that is easy to understand, affordable, and free from hidden fees. That's why we offer a straightforward pricing model with no setup fees for terminals, no subscription fees, and a flat rate for all card types. It's a breath of fresh air compared to the complicated and confusing pricing structures of our competitors. What sets Flatpay apart is our dedication. We continuously strive to stay ahead of the curve, adapting our solutions to meet our client's evolving needs. Ready to be part of something extraordinary? WHAT's THE CULTURE LIKE? Flatpay is a fast-moving, performance-driven environment where people are trusted to take ownership from day one. We value initiative, resilience, and a strong work ethic. Our teams are collaborative and supportive, but we also set clear expectations and hold ourselves accountable to results. As a growing business, things move quickly. That means you’ll have the opportunity to take on real responsibility early, contribute ideas, and see the impact of your work directly. It also means being comfortable with change, solving problems as they arise, and continuously improving how we operate. We’re best suited to people who are motivated by challenge, enjoy working towards clear goals, and want to develop in a commercial, high-energy environment. WHY CHOOSE FLATPAY? Flatpay offers the opportunity to take real ownership, develop valuable skills, and grow your career in a fast-moving, ambitious company where performance and initiative are recognised.

title: Bogense: Fuldtidsansat (35 timer) handicaphjælper søges hurtigst muligt
description:
Om mig kan jeg fortælle følgende:

Jeg er:

- meget heldig, at have et team på 3 trofaste hjælpere i alderen 32 til 64 år, og nu mangler vi den næste.

- 62 år ung og bor på landet sammen med min mand uden for Bogense på Nordfyn. Her har vi racehøns og 3 hunde.

- en glad pige, som holder af både sort humor og ikke mindst selvironi.

- en der altid har haft mange bolde i luften, og er meget kreativ på mange områder, hvor jeg bl.a. tager ud og hjælper/vejleder andre i bl.a. renovering af hus oma.

Vores mad er så vidt muligt dyrket herhjemme og hjemmelavet, på samme måde som saft, juice, marmelade, gele og kompot.

Når muligheden byder sig, ja så går turen også til diverse kurser, et spil bingo, en tøse tur, en tur i det blå med en lille madkurv, eller en weekendtur.

Jeg går til bassintræning to gange, og fysioterapi 1 gang om ugen.

Min aktivitet er bestemt af mit smerteniveau, og af den grund er jeg meget impulsiv. Jeg har en sjælden lidelse der hedder CRPS som er det autonome nervesystem der overreagerer og 2 inflammatoriske gigtlidelser.

Jobbet indebærer:
- At hjælpe mig med praktiske opgaver såsom rengøring, madlavning, vasketøj og alt hjælp ud af huset. Jeg er meget aktiv, når muligheden byder sig.

Du er selvfølgelig også med omkring både hunde og hønsene, som er et must at have lyst til.

Du skal også hjælpe mig med personlig pleje og I det hele taget skal du være mine hænder og fødder, men ikke mit hoved.



Dine kvalifikationer skal være følgende:
- Stabilitet; Jeg er meget afhængig af dig i min hverdag, og derfor er det vigtigt at du er stabil, og at jeg kan regne med dig. Du skal også være med til at afløse dine kollegaer ved både ferie og sygdom.

- Fleksibilitet; Min hverdag og aktiviteterne i den, er ofte smertebestemt, derfor har jeg behov for, at du er fleksibel. Som regel er tingene ikke planlagte, og derfor skal du kunne takle ikke altid at vide hvad dagen bringer, da jeg sætter dagsordenen, efter min formåen.

På samme måde vil jeg også være fleksibel og imødekomme dine ønsker, så vidt det er muligt.

- Rengøring; Du er glad for at gøre rent og holde orden i hjemmet. Jeg er allergiker, derfor er det et must, at du er god til at komme i alle krogene.

- Situationsfornemmelse/Tavshedspligt; Dette er en stor del af, at være hjælper. Du færdes i vores hjem hvor alt i vores liv er sat til skue for dig, og du skal kunne være fluen på væggen og samtidig have øjne for, hvornår jeg har brug for hjælp. Du forstår selvfølgelig, at du har tavshedspligt vedr. alt du oplever på dit arbejde her.

- Du skal lære, hvornår du skal træde til, og hvornår du skal trække dig. Du skal gerne selv være ironisk og have sort humor.

- Du skal være vant til omgang med hunde og høns.

- Have B kørekort og gerne BE, eller være villig til at tage BE og ikke være bange for at køre en stor bil. Samt deltage i undervisning vedr. køresikkerhed.

De bedste løsninger, når vi frem til, med god kommunikation og fleksibilitet fra begge sider af.

Vi tilbyder:

Lange arbejdsdage, med mange fridage imellem, med varieret arbejde både ude og inde.

En arbejdsplads hvor der er plads og hensynstagen til det enkelte menneske.

En respektfuld, afslappet omgangstone, krydret med sort humor, og ironi i hverdagen.

Vi har en madordning til vore ansatte, som man frivilligt kan være med i, hvis man ønsker det.

Vagterne:

Der er et fast rul med 18 vagter på 8 uger, hvor man oftest har 2 sammenhængende vagter ad gangen, og flere dage fri. Her er også mulighed for overnatning. Vagterne starter kl. 8.00 og er på 15,5 timer i hverdagene og 16 timer i weekenderne.

Der forventes også at alle afløser hinanden ved ferie og sygdom.

Overenskomst og ansættelse sker under LOBPA.

Timelønnen er pr. 1.6.2026 ca. på 191,50 kr. i gennemsnit Incl. alle tillæg.

Som minimum er stillingen på 35 timer om ugen i gennemsnit. Ansættelsen er et langt sygevikariat, med start snarest muligt, og kan efterfølgende munde ud i en fast stilling på ca. 30 timer ugentligt.

bpa1planhus@gmail.com

title: Konsultuppdrag Lead Automation
description:
Vill du arbeta med industriell automation, PLC och robotik till ett investeringsprojekt i en senior konsultroll?

Vi söker en erfaren konsult inom industriell automation till ett väletablerat industribolag i Örebro län. Du har erfarenhet av investeringsprojekt från förstudie och koncept till implementation, driftsättning, SOP och fungerande leverans. Du är van att ta tekniskt ansvar inom automation, systemarkitektur, PLC/Safety PLC, SCADA/OT och systemintegration samt att definiera krav, genomföra Design Review, utvärdera leverantörer och fatta tekniska vägval.Du arbetar nära produktion, projektteam och externa leverantörer och driver lösningar genom FAT/SAT fram till en robust och driftsäker leverans.Uppdraget startar omgående och löper initialt i minst sex månader.

Ditt anställningserbjudande

Du får möjlighet att arbeta i investeringsprojekt som har stor påverkan på verksamhetens framtida produktion och tekniska utveckling. Rollen erbjuder en varierad vardag med många kontaktytor där du samarbetar med projektledare, tekniska specialister och leverantörer.

Uppdraget är ett konsultuppdrag med placering hos vår kund inom tillverkningsindustrin, strax utanför Örebro. Arbetet sker på plats i produktionen och i projektmiljö. Antingen är du anställd via TNG under uppdragets löptid eller går in som underkonsult via TNG.

Som anställd konsult via TNG Tech arbetar du tryggt med kollektivavtal, försäkringar och självklart friskvårdsbidrag. Som underkonsult hos TNG får du friheten att styra dina uppdrag och arbetstid, samtidigt som du får stöd och nya möjligheter via vårt breda uppdragsnätverk!

Dina arbetsuppgifter

  • Delta i och driva automationsrelaterade delar av investeringsprojekt
  • Delta i tekniska diskussioner kring robotik, PLC system, styrsystem och integrationer
  • Utvärdera leverantörslösningar inom industriell automation
  • Säkerställa att automationslösningar möter verksamhetens tekniska krav
  • Delta i tekniska diskussioner kring PLC system, styrsystem och integrationer
  • Samarbeta med projektledare, produktion, teknikteam och externa leverantörer
  • Bidra med teknisk rådgivning och riskbedömningar
  • Följa upp implementation och kvalitetssäkring av automationslösningar

Värt att veta

Uppdraget är ett konsultuppdrag med placering hos kund strax utanför Örebro.

Vi söker dig som är tillgänglig för uppdrag omgående och trivs med att arbeta på plats hos kund. Du har goda svenska kunskaper, B-körkort och tillgång till bil är en förutsättning.

Våra förväntningar

Vi söker dig som har flera års erfarenhet inom industriell automation och som tidigare arbetat i investeringsprojekt inom industri eller produktion. Du har god kunskap inom PLC system och robotik samt erfarenhet av att utvärdera tekniska lösningar och leverantörer.

Som person är du strukturerad, kommunikativ och trygg i dialogen med både interna och externa intressenter. Du är van att ta ansvar, driva frågor framåt och bidra med ett lösningsorienterat perspektiv även i tekniskt komplexa sammanhang. Du har förmåga att snabbt sätta dig in i nya projekt och skapa förtroende genom din kompetens och erfarenhet.

Intresserad?

Detta är ett interimsuppdrag där du antingen kan bli anställd som konsult hos oss på TNG Tech eller blir anlitad som underkonsult för att arbeta på plats hos vår kund. TNG hjälper kandidater och konsulter att ta nästa steg i karriären, oavsett om de söker en ny tjänst eller vill kliva in i ett konsultuppdrag. Med en rättvis och datadriven metod, baserad på fakta och vetenskap, matchar vi dig med arbetsgivare som ser bortom ålder, titel och magkänsla och istället fokuserar på potential, rätt erfarenhet och nya perspektiv. Vi ser fram emot att få din ansökan med CV eller LinkedIn-profil och utan personligt brev. Notera att vi inte kan ta emot ansökningar via e-post, men att du alltid är välkommen att maila rekryteraren vid frågor. Efter inskickad ansökan kommer vi anonymisera dina personuppgifter och troligtvis be dig att genomföra vetenskapliga rekryteringstester och / eller en intervju med vår AI-avatar Tengai, innan vi gör en första bedömning. Givetvis får du mer information om varje steg när det är dags och så snart du skickat in din ansökan kan du följa den i realtid via vår hemsida. Observera att vi gör urval löpande och tjänsten kan därför tillsättas före sista ansökningsdatum. Varmt välkommen!

title: Juniorsælger / Trainee til B2B-salg af erhvervsbiler
description:
Tiltrædelse snarest muligt

Har du drive, forretningsforståelse og lyst til at skabe nye kunderelationer?

N. Kjær Bilcentret A/S søger en juniorsælger / trainee til vores salg af erhvervsbiler.

Du får en vigtig rolle i at udvikle vores B2B-forretning inden for varebiler og erhvervskøretøjer. Du skal være med til at opdyrke nye markeder, skabe kunderelationer og finde rigtige løsninger for virksomheder – med særligt fokus på overgangen fra traditionelle drivlinjer til elektrificerede løsninger. Rollen kombinerer opsøgende salg og markedsudvikling med en struktureret og analytisk tilgang.

Dine vigtigste opgaver

  • Opsøge nye erhvervskunder og identificere relevante brancher, kundeemner og salgsmuligheder
  • Arbejde målrettet med elektriske varebiler og rådgive om overgangen fra ICE til elektrisk drift
  • Udarbejde og formidle TCO-beregninger, så kunden får et klart billede af økonomien i forskellige løsninger
  • Bearbejde markedet for traditionelle varebiler og øvrige ICE-køretøjer
  • Identificere nicheområder og muligheder inden for specialopbygninger, herunder f eks pick-ups og køretøjer til handicapområdet
  • Arbejde aktivt med salg, lager og omsætningshastighed på nye og brugte erhvervsbiler
  • Have tydeligt fokus på rentabilitet, indtjening og markedsandele
  • Opbygge og følge systematisk op på pipeline, leads, tilbud og kundedialoger

Du får sparring fra erfarne kollegaer undervejs, men vi forventer, at du tager initiativ, skaber aktivitet og gradvist tager større ansvar.

Hvem er du?

Din baggrund kan være kommerciel, teknisk eller håndværksmæssig, og du er måske tidligt i din karriere. Bilbrancheerfaring er ikke et ubetinget krav.

Vi lægger især vægt på, at du:

  • Er udadvendt, tillidsskabende og naturligt opsøgende
  • Har lyst til at skabe nye kunderelationer og forretningsmuligheder
  • Har interesse for teknik, erhvervskøretøjer og kundernes anvendelsesbehov
  • Kan formidle tekniske og økonomiske forhold enkelt og forståeligt
  • Arbejder struktureret og analytisk og følger konsekvent op
  • Har god talforståelse og interesse for økonomi, rentabilitet og TCO
  • Har høj energi, initiativ, vedholdenhed og lyst til at lære

Vi vægter dit potentiale, ”drive” og motivation for B2B-salg højt.

Du bliver en del af N. Kjær Bilcentret

Hos N. Kjær Bilcentret tror vi på, at gode resultater kommer, når vi tager ansvar, hjælper hinanden og har lyst til at gøre en forskel.

Vi er en familieejet virksomhed med mere end tre generationers historie i Svendborg. For os handler det ikke kun om biler, men om mennesker, relationer og det lokale engagement. Vi kender vores kunder, og vi kender hinanden – og vi står sammen om at skabe en god forretning.

Hos os får du plads til at udvikle dig, tage ansvar og prøve dine idéer af. Du bliver en del af et team, hvor vi deler viden, hjælper hinanden og forventer, at alle bidrager. Vi tror på, at man bliver dygtigere af at få ansvar – og at ansvaret vokser i takt med, at man gør det godt.

Vi forventer noget af dig – men vi investerer også i dig.

Vi tilbyder

Du får en udviklende rolle i en veldrevet bilforretning med korte beslutningsveje og mulighed for at præge et område i vækst. Hverdagen bliver varieret med kundekontakt, opsøgende salg og mulighed for at opbygge stærke kompetencer inden for salg, elektrificering og kommerciel rådgivning.

Arbejdssted: N. Kjær Bilcentret A/S, Svendborg

Lyder det som dig?

Send ansøgning og CV til Christian Kjær Christensen på mail ckc@nkjaer.dk

Har du spørgsmål, er du velkommen til at kontakte Christian på tlf. 62 17 28 00

Vi afholder samtaler løbende.

Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig.

title: SOFTWARE ARCHITECT
description:
We are looking for a Software architect to lead the architecture of our Smart Locker platform as part of our development team, from embedded devices to cloud services, as we scale internationally.

This role sits at the intersection of embedded engineering, backend development, and cloud infrastructure. You will work closely with our embedded, backend and frontend teams to design a secure, scalable architecture spanning embedded devices, Python applications, and Google Cloud Platform services.

A major part of the role is defining and documenting architectural decisions for device-to-cloud communication, multi-tenant data isolation, security and device identity, and infrastructure-as-code. You will also review code across embedded and backend codebases and act as a technical sparring partner for the team.

This is a role for someone who is comfortable taking ownership of complex, cross-cutting technical decisions and drawing a clear line between implementation questions and architecture decisions. You should be motivated by building robust, well-documented systems in a company where growth is real and your work has a visible impact.

What you will do

  • Design and document end-to-end system architecture from embedded devices to cloud services, including architecture decision records (ADRs)

  • Define device-to-cloud communication, security and device identity for 32-bit microcontroller-based products, including secure boot, OTA updates and certificate lifecycle

  • Architect multi-tenant, event-driven cloud systems on Google Cloud Platform (Cloud Run, Pub/Sub, IAM, Cloud SQL, Firestore)

  • Own infrastructure-as-code and CI/CD architecture across Terraform, Ansible, Kubernetes and GitHub Actions

  • Lead code reviews and set technical quality standards across embedded (C/C++) and backend (Python) codebases

  • Evaluate architecture trade-offs and communicate their cost and risk implications to the business

  • Draw the line between implementation-level decisions and architecture decisions, and document recurring questions for the team

What we are looking for

We are looking for a person with solid experience in software architecture spanning both embedded systems and cloud platforms in a technical product business. You should be comfortable working independently, reading unfamiliar code and documentation, and communicating clearly and asynchronously in writing.

Preferred background

  • Strong experience designing architecture for embedded products (e.g. ESP-IDF/ESP32 or Zephyr/nRF Connect SDK) and cloud platforms, preferably GCP

  • Track record building Python-based backend services (FastAPI or Django)

  • Experience with multi-tenant isolation, event-driven architecture and device-to-cloud topologies

  • Security architecture knowledge: IAM, secret management, key management, device identity and certificate lifecycles

  • Experience leading cross-functional technical projects involving embedded, backend and infrastructure teams

Skills and qualities

  • Strong technical judgment across embedded, backend and cloud domains

  • Ability to structure complex technical topics, compare alternatives and drive decisions forward

  • Ability to get familiar with unfamiliar code and system documentation independently

  • Confidence to challenge and be challenged in code review, in both directions

  • Understanding of infrastructure economics and cost trade-offs

  • Strong written technical English for design documents and ADRs

  • Hands-on working style, comfortable moving between architecture, review and coding

  • Clear communication skills in written and spoken English. Finnish is considered an advantage

title: Senior Software Engineer, Backend (Insurance Operations)
description:
About Grab and Our Workplace


Grab is Southeast Asia's leading superapp. From getting your favourite meals delivered to helping you manage your finances and getting around town hassle-free, we've got your back with everything. In Grab, purpose gives us joy and habits build excellence, while harnessing the power of Technology and AI to deliver the mission of driving Southeast Asia forward by economically empowering everyone, with heart, hunger, honour, and humility.


Get to know our Team


At GrabFin, we empower the people of Southeast Asia by ensuring financial inclusion for the underserved. The Insurance Operations PST in Malaysia supports Insurance products and owns Accounting, Reports, Internal Tools, and Third-Party Integration domains for insurance products.

You will report to the Engineering Manager, Insurance Operations, based in Malaysia and develop backend systems powering accounting, reporting, and third-party integrations for insurance products. You will work on BNM regulatory reporting capabilities and local partnership integrations. We're looking for candidates that embody ownership, display a hunger for learning and improvement, and excel in autonomy.


This role is onsite based in our Petaling Jaya, Malaysia office.


The Critical Tasks You Will Perform



  • You will develop high-quality and scalable backend applications for accounting, reporting, and integration services

  • You will build and maintain third-party integrations (ISM, APAD, JPJ) for regulatory compliance

  • You will write clean, efficient, and maintainable code to solve challenging problems

  • You will collaborate with diverse teams to design and ship new features

  • You will participate in code reviews to maintain code quality and share knowledge

  • You will troubleshoot, debug complex issues, and provide quick resolutions

  • You will contribute to architectural decisions and technical direction

What Essential Skills You will Need



  • You have 4+ years of relevant experience in software development

  • You have proficiency in Java (preferred) and/or Golang

  • You have experience with relational databases (MySQL, PostgreSQL) and Git

  • You have computer Science fundamentals in algorithms and data structures

  • You have hands-on experience with cloud platforms (AWS)

  • You have experience with financial/regulatory systems is a plus


Life at Grab


We care about your well-being at Grab, here are some of the global benefits we offer:

  • With GrabFlex, create a benefits package that suits your needs and aspirations.

  • Celebrate moments that matter in life with loved ones through Parental and Birthday leave, and give back to your communities through Love-all-Serve-all (LASA) volunteering leave

What We Stand For At Grab


We are committed to building an inclusive and equitable workplace that provides equal opportunity for Grabbers to grow and perform at their best. We consider all candidates fairly and equally regardless of nationality, ethnicity, race, religion, age, gender, family commitments, physical and mental impairments or disabilities, and other attributes that make them unique.

title: Lageroperatør til varemodtagelsen (daghold)
description:
Har du solid erfaring med truckkørsel, og vil du være en del af et stærkt team på en stabil arbejdsplads med ambitiøse planer for fremtiden? Så er du måske vores nye kollega i varemodtagelsen hos ABENA Produktion.

Du bliver en del af et engageret daghold bestående af 10 lageroperatører. Vi arbejder selvstændigt, tager ansvar for vores opgaver og hjælper hinanden, når der er brug for det. Du bliver en vigtig del af et team, hvor tillid, samarbejde og ordentlighed er centrale værdier.

Vi oplever høj aktivitet og udvider derfor teamet med en ny kollega. Samtidig investerer vi markant i fremtidens produktion og øger kapaciteten i de kommende år. Du bliver dermed en del af en virksomhed med langsigtede ambitioner og høj stabilitet.

Som lageroperatør i varemodtagelsen er din vigtigste opgave at sikre, at råvarer og emballage modtages, kontrolleres og indlagres korrekt, så produktionen kan køre effektivt.

Dine opgaver omfatter blandt andet:

  • udføre modtagekontrol og indgangskontrol

  • modtage og ankomstmelde interne og eksterne biler

  • læsse og tømme biler med råvarer og emballage

  • føre palleregnskab

  • gennemføre optællinger

  • håndtere afvigelser

  • sikre orden og struktur i lagerområdet

  • løse ad hoc-opgaver i afdelingen

Du ansættes på fast daghold. Der kan dog i perioder forekomme arbejde på skiftehold.

Arbejdstiderne er: mandag til onsdag: kl. 06.00-14.35, torsdag: kl. 06.00-14.20, fredag: kl. 06.00-13.00.

Vi forestiller os, at du

  • har erfaring fra et lignende job og flere års erfaring med truckkørsel

  • er fortrolig med at bruge PC som arbejdsredskab

  • behersker dansk i skrift og tale

  • arbejder struktureret og tager ansvar for dine opgaver

  • bidrager positivt til samarbejdet i teamet

  • Kendskab til ERP-systemet SAP er en fordel, men ikke et krav.

Din kommende leder fortæller

"Som lagermedarbejder værdsætter jeg frihed under ansvar. Det er afgørende, at vi tager ejerskab for vores arbejdsdag, både i udvikling og i vedligeholdelse af rutiner. Når man arbejder med mennesker, er tillid, retfærdighed og samarbejde fundamentet for et godt arbejdsmiljø. Kommunikationen er central, og vi taler til hinanden med respekt og ligeværd." - Bo Hansen, Afdelingsleder Lager

Derfor skal du vælge ABENA

Hos ABENA bliver du en del af en arbejdsplads, hvor vi investerer i fremtiden, udvikler vores produktion og skaber rammerne for langsigtet vækst. Samtidig får du hverdagen i et stærkt team, hvor der er plads til både ansvar, faglighed og godt humør. Vi tilbyder blandt andet:

  • frihed under ansvar

  • engagerede og hjælpsomme kolleger

  • mulighed for faglig og personlig udvikling

  • kantineordning

  • motionsrum

  • sundhedsordning

  • en række attraktive personalegoder

Hos os skal det være sjovt at gå på arbejde. Samtidig sætter vi en ære i at være ordentlige over for hinanden, vores leverandører og naturen.

Ansøgning

Er du klar til at blive en del af holdet? Send din ansøgning og dit CV ved at klikke på "Ansøg".

Har du spørgsmål til stillingen, er du velkommen til at kontakte Bo Hansen, Afdelingsleder Lager, på telefon 28939917.

Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig.

title: Studentermedhjælper – Junior Data & AI Analyst
description:
Byg dataplatforme og AI-løsninger, der styrker analyser af global skibsfart

Vil du arbejde praktisk med data og AI – og være med til at opbygge den digitale platform, der skal understøtte vores arbejde med bæredygtighed og markedsanalyse? I Danmarks Skibskredit søger vi en studentermedhjælper til Sustainability & Research, som har lyst til at udvikle dataløsninger, automatiserede arbejdsgange og AI-baserede værktøjer. Rollen er for dig, der trives med at bygge, teste og forbedre løsninger og gerne vil se dit arbejde blive brugt i praksis.

Om Sustainability & Research

Sustainability & Research arbejder i krydsfeltet mellem skibsfart, data, teknologi og bæredygtighed. Afdelingen leverer analyser, data og digitale værktøjer, som anvendes i bankens beslutningsprocesser og i dialogen med kunder og investorer.

Vi er i gang med at opbygge en ny digital infrastruktur, hvor bæredygtigheds- og markedsdata samles, struktureres og gøres tilgængelige gennem blandt andet Microsoft Fabric og Power BI.

Samtidig arbejder vi på næste skridt i vores brug af AI. Ambitionen er at bevæge os fra primært at bruge AI til tekst, kode og enkeltstående analyser til at integrere AI direkte i vores data- og analysearbejde. Det omfatter blandt andet AI-agenter og automatiserede arbejdsgange, som kan arbejde med data fra vores platform og understøtte analytikerne i mere komplekse processer.

Hvad du kommer til at arbejde med

Du får en praktisk og teknisk rolle og vil blandt andet arbejde med

  • strukturering og kvalitetssikring af sustainability- og markedsdata
  • datamodeller, dataflows og datalag
  • Python og SQL til databehandling og analyse
  • rapportering og visualisering i Power BI
  • udvikling og test af AI-agenter og automatiserede arbejdsgange
  • integration mellem AI, data og analyseprocesser.

En vigtig del af rollen bliver at afprøve, hvor AI kan forbedre vores arbejdsgange og analyser, og hvordan teknologien kan anvendes på en struktureret og kontrolleret måde.

Vi forestiller os

Du er i gang med en relevant videregående uddannelse, eksempelvis inden for matematik, computer science, ingeniørvidenskab, økonomi eller et beslægtet område.

Du interesserer dig for data og teknologi, arbejder struktureret og har lyst til at omsætte teori til løsninger, der fungerer i praksis.

Det er en fordel, hvis du har erfaring med SQL, Python, Power BI, Microsoft Fabric eller andre cloud-platforme. Det vigtigste er dog, at du er nysgerrig, lærer hurtigt og har lyst til at tage ansvar for dine opgaver.

Eksempler på, hvad du vil bygge det første halve år

Et af de centrale udviklingsspor er opbygningen af en ny dataplatform oven på bankens eksisterende SQL-baserede datagrundlag. Du vil blandt andet blive involveret i at strukturere de underliggende data, opbygge datamodeller og udvikle dataflows, visualiseringer og AI-baserede funktioner. Datagrundlaget skal blandt andet understøtte etableringen af en intern sprogmodel.

Målet er at skabe en mere effektiv og konsistent analyseproces og samtidig opbygge et bedre grundlag for AI-understøttede analyser på tværs af bankens portefølje.

Vi tilbyder

Vi tilbyder et fagligt ambitiøst studiejob, hvor du får mulighed for at arbejde med konkrete data- og teknologiprojekter med direkte anvendelse i forretningen. Du bliver en del af et miljø med høj faglighed, åben videndeling og tæt sparring med erfarne analytikere. Samtidig får du mulighed for selv at tage ansvar og være med til at forme løsninger, som fortsat er under opbygning.

Yderligere oplysninger

Arbejdstiden forventes at være ca. 15–20 timer om ugen med fleksibilitet i forhold til studie og eksamen. Sustainability & Research består af seks fuldtidsmedarbejdere og fire studentermedhjælpere. Hvis du har spørgsmål til stillingen, er du velkommen til at kontakte Head of Sustainability & Research, Christopher Rex, på telefon 22 19 99 34.

Ansøgning

Vi læser ansøgninger løbende, så send gerne din ansøgning, dit CV, din karakterudskrift og øvrige relevante oplysninger allerede i dag og senest søndag den 4. oktober. Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig.

Om Danmarks Skibskredit

Danmarks Skibskredit har siden 1961 ydet lån til den maritime sektor. Vi er højt specialiserede inden for skibsfinansiering og finansierer i dag over 500 skibe for vores kunder globalt. Vi arbejder for at understøtte den globale shippingindustris grønne omstilling og bidrager årligt med 15 % af vores overskud til Den Danske Maritime Fond. Du bliver en del af en virksomhedskultur, der lægger vægt på langsigtede beslutninger, troværdighed, ordentlighed og et højt fagligt niveau.

Læs mere om os som arbejdsplads på vores hjemmeside.

title: Utility Operator - 1st Shift

title: Specialister til Netværksoperations til Forsvarets nye Digitale Backbone
description:
Motiveres du af teamwork og udfordrende IT-projekter i miljøer med høj grad af isolation og høje krav til compliance, sikkerhed og dokumentation? Så har du chancen for at få en central rolle i et greenfield IT-miljø, der er unikt i størrelse, opgave og karakteristika!

Om os
Forsvaret står overfor en omfattende digital og operativ transformation for at kunne imødegå fremtidens udfordringer. Programmet for Digital og Operativ Transformation bygger derfor fremtidens digitale og datacentriske forsvar i samarbejde med de operative enheder.

Du bliver en del af Digital Backbone-afdelingen, der står for den konkrete etablering af Forsvarets nye IT-platform, herunder eget netværk. Det er et IT-miljø, der er unikt i størrelse, opgave og karakteristika.

Om stillingerne
Vi søger en række profiler, og en kombination af profiler med mange års erfaring og helt nyuddannet, til forskellige fagområder i sektionen Network Operations & Management, hvor du bliver en del af opbygningen af Forsvarets kommende digitale infrastruktur.

Du kommer til at arbejde med etablering, implementering og initial drift af moderne netværks infrastruktur og managementplatforme i et mission-kritisk miljø med høje krav til sikkerhed, robusthed og tilgængelighed.

Du bliver en del af et greenfield-miljø, hvor vi bygger ny digital infrastruktur fra bunden, og hvor du får mulighed for at præge både tekniske løsninger, arbejdsgange og den fremtidige operationelle drift.

Du vil samarbejde tæt med arkitekter, projektledere, specialister, operative miljøer og eksterne leverandører på tværs af Digital Backbone-programmet.

Vi søger kompetencer inden for følgende områder:
Du forventes ikke at mestre alle områder, men at have stærke kompetencer inden for ét eller flere fagfelter, samt lyst til at samarbejde bredt på tværs af specialer og platforme.
- Datacenter netværk, switching, routing, software defined network, policy-driven network, orkestrering, m.v.
- Service provider netværk, wan-infrastruktur, MPLS, DWDM, fiber planlægning, m.v.
- Core services og management-netværk, m.v.
- Netværkssikkerhed, firewalls, kryptografi, cross domain solutions/gateways, compliance, m.v.
- Netværksovervågning og monitering, m.v.
- Automation og operationel robusthed, m.v.

Dine hovedopgaver:
- Deltage i design, etablering, implementering, initial drift og vedligehold af netværk og tilhørende managementplatforme.
- Deltage i design, udvikling og forvaltning af infrastruktur og managementlag på tværs af klassifikationsniveauer.
- Deltage i design og videreudviklingen af den samlede digitale infrastruktur i regi af Digital Backbone.
- Deltage i design og implementering af automatiserede og proaktive driftsprocesser, der sikrer høj tilgængelighed og robust drift.
- Deltage i udarbejdelse af teknisk dokumentation samt faglig assistance ved interne og eksterne projekt- og udviklingsarbejder.
- Deltage i udvikling af automatiserede og datadrevne driftsprocesser, herunder anvendelse af AI-baserede værktøjer, hvor det skaber operationel værdi.

Dine andre opgaver er blandt andet:
- Deltage i tilrettelæggelse af egen vedligeholdende uddannelse indenfor funktionsområdet for at opretholde egne kvalifikationer.
- Deltage i tværgående teams og bidrage til arkitektur, sikkerhed, CI/CD og operationel excellence på tværs af platforme og projekter.
- Deltage på Site Surveys til vores andre lokationer, til samarbejdspartnere og til leverandører.
- Deltage i teknisk beredskab i forbindelse med initial drift af den skalerbare netværksstruktur.
- Deltage i kvalitetskontrol, herunder udarbejdelse af dokumentation og processer.
- Deltage i ad hoc-opgaver, der understøtter og videreudvikler DOT’s operationelle kapabiliteter.

Vi garanterer en varieret hverdag i et miljø med start-up ånd, hvor et stort ansvar går hånd i hånd med stor indflydelse. Du får mulighed for fleksible arbejdstider, personlig og faglig kompetenceudvikling, arbejdsgiverbetalt pensionsordning og betalt frokostpause.

Om dig
Din baggrund kan være mangeartet, men vi forventer, at du har solid viden om og interesse for netværk og deres kontekst. Du kan have såvel en faglært erhvervsuddannelse som en kort-, mellemlang- eller lang videregående uddannelse. I alle tilfælde har du en klar teknisk IT-profil i både uddannelse og erfaring. Alternativt kan du dokumentere kompetencer og resultater indenfor tilsvarende områder og kontekst.

Uanset baggrund forventer vi, at tunge profiler har flere års erfaring, herunder relevant og aktuel efter- og videreuddannelse indenfor sit felt. Vi forestiller os, at du har erfaring fra komplekse infrastrukturelle miljøer med høje krav til isolation, compliance, governance, dokumentation og kontrol.

Er du nyuddannet med den helt rette profil, tilbyder vi den nødvendige oplæring og uddannelse, så du kan løse opgaverne og bidrage til udviklingen.

Vi vægter faglighed højt, men er især interesseret i dine personlige kompetencer som kollega, og som repræsentant for afdelingen og programmet. Du bidrager til fællesskabet, og er med til at skabe tillidsfulde rammer for godt samarbejde i alle relationer.

Du behersker teknisk engelsk og har kørekort til almindelig bil (kategori B).

Ansættelsesvilkår
Er du akademiker ansættes du i henhold til den til enhver tid gældende overenskomst mellem Finansministeriet og en række akademikerorganisationer for akademikere i staten (Akademikeroverenskomsten).

Har du en IT-faglig uddannelse eller en anden relevant uddannelse ansættes du i henhold til den til enhver tid gældende Fællesoverenskomst mellem Finansministeriet og Offentligt Ansattes Organisationer – Det Statslige Område (OAO-S-fællesoverenskomsten) og organisationsaftale for kontorfunktionærer, laboranter og it-medarbejdere.

Afhængigt af dine kvalifikationer og kompetencer, tilpasser vi funktionen. Der er der mulighed for forhandling af tillæg. Der er til stillingen knyttet en arbejdsgiverfinansieret pensionsordning.

Dit daglige arbejdssted er i Karup eller Aalborg. Du skal forvente jævnlig rejseaktivitet til alle vores lokationer.

Som ansat under Forsvarsministeriets område er du omfattet af nogle særlige vilkår. Du skal bl.a. kunne sikkerhedsgodkendes og opretholde sikkerhedsgodkendelsen under hele ansættelsesforholdet.

Du har som ansat pligt til at forrette tjeneste uden for landets grænser, herunder ved enheder i internationale operationer med henblik på deltagelse i konfliktforebyggende, fredsbevarende, fredsskabende, humanitære og andre lignende operationer.

Kontakt og ansøgning
Hvis du vil vide mere om stillingen, er du meget velkommen til at kontakte sektionschefen Michael (Michael) på telefon 5240 6556.

Har du spørgsmål til løn- og ansættelsesvilkår, er du velkommen til at kontakte Personelkommandoen, HR-konsulent
Madeleine Elisabeth Moltke Kæmsgaard 4031 1094.

Ansøgningsfristen er d. 19. oktober 2026. Samtaler og ansættelse sker løbende. Stillingerne er til besættelse d. 1. december 2026 eller snarest muligt.

Du søger stillingen via linket og vi beder dig vedhæfte ansøgning, cv og kopi af uddannelsesbevis. Vær opmærksom på at bilag skal tilføjes i PDF-format.

I Forsvarsministeriets organisation tror vi på, at mangfoldighed optimerer opgaveløsningen. Derfor opfordrer vi alle interesserede uanset baggrund til at søge stillingen.

Om Forsvarsministeriets Materiel- og Indkøbsstyrelse
Forsvarsministeriets Materiel- og Indkøbsstyrelse (FMI) er en styrelse under Forsvarsministeriet.

FMI har ansvaret for det samlede forsvars og beredskabs materiel, IT og cybersikkerhed. Det er os, der anskaffer, driver og bortskaffer materiel og IT for såvel Hæren, Søværnet, Flyvevåbnet, Arktisk Kommando, Specialoperationskommandoen, Hjemmeværnet, Beredskabsstyrelsen og resten af Forsvarsministeriets koncern. Desuden bistår vores IT-medarbejdere dagligt i at modstå de cyberangreb, Forsvarsministeriets koncern udsættes for.

Vi er ca. 2500 medarbejdere (3/4 civile - 1/4 militære) fordelt ud over hele Kongeriget, med hovedkontorer i henholdsvis Ballerup, Brabrand og Hvidovre.

description:

title: Process Expert, Strategic Sourcing & Category Management

description:
About the role

In this role, you will lead the process design and documentation for direct sourcing, category management, and supplier management. You will work closely with geographically dispersed teams and act as a critical bridge between business stakeholders and technical SAP templates. Your assertiveness and expertise will drive the alignment towards SAP standard solutions.

Work tasks

This role involves leading the documentation, design, and harmonization of sourcing and category management processes to prepare for a major SAP S/4HANA ERP transformation.

 
- Lead the documentation and design of Core Category Management, Supplier Management, and Sourcing processes
- Conduct gap analyses between current processes and SAP standard processes
- Facilitate alignment to achieve an end-state as close to SAP standard as possible
- Lead data harmonization and preparation efforts for the upcoming ERP transformation
- Define tool requirements to support the transition and change of sourcing systems
- Define training and change management needs, acting as a Subject Matter Expert
- Support current Global Process Owner (GPO) resources throughout the project

We are looking for

- Advanced knowledge of SAP S/4HANA standard processes in Source-to-Pay (STP)
- Good experience in STP process transformation and process documentation
- Ability to bridge technical requirements with business needs
- Strong communication skills in English, with the assertiveness to challenge stakeholders

Other information:

Start: In October

Employment period: Six months, possibility to extension

Location: Mostly remote work, occasional visits to Helsinki

Our recruitment process

This recruitment process is handled by Academic Work and it is our clients wish that all questions regarding the position is directed to Academic Work.

Our selection process is continuous and the advert may close before the recruitment process is completed if we have moved forward to the next phase. The process includes two tests: one personality test and one cognitive test. The tests are tools to find the right talent for the right position, to enable equality, diversity, and a fair process.

title: Er du klar til næste kapitel i dit arbejdsliv?
description:
Syrenparken søger uddannede pædagoger til i alt 8 barselsvikariater.

Vil du være med til at skabe håb, trivsel og udvikling for mennesker med psykiske sårbarheder? Så søger vi pædagoger, der kan bidrage med faglighed, engagement og lysten til at gøre en forskel.

"Jeg er altid glad for at stå op og gå på arbejde. Jeg har gode kollegaer, og det er en skøn borgergruppe, jeg møder ind til. Personligt oplever jeg det som et meningsfuldt arbejde."
– Medarbejder på Syrenparken

Kan du nikke genkendende til dette?

  • Du motiverer og samarbejder med borgerne om at skabe trivsel, udvikling og håb.
  • Du trives i arbejdet med mennesker med komplekse psykiske udfordringer.
  • Du tænker kreativt og ser muligheder frem for begrænsninger.
  • Du ønsker at bringe dine faglige kompetencer i spil i et tværprofessionelt samarbejde.
  • Du er fagligt nysgerrig, reflekterende og værdsætter samarbejde med engagerede kollegaer.
Hvem er du?
Du motiveres af at arbejde rehabiliterende og recovery-orienteret sammen med borgerne. Du ser værdien i at være en del af et team, hvor forskellige fagligheder bringes i spil, og hvor vi sammen skaber de bedste løsninger.

Vi forestiller os, at du:

  • Er uddannet pædagog.
  • Har interesse for socialpsykiatri eller erfaring fra området.
  • Kan arbejde selvstændigt og samtidig indgå aktivt i et tværfagligt team.
  • Møder mennesker med respekt, nysgerrighed og anerkendelse.
  • Har kørekort til personbil.
Hvem er vi?
Socialcenter Lillebælt – Syrenparken i Børkop er et højt specialiseret regionalt botilbud for 46 borgere med psykiske sårbarheder.

Vi arbejder tværprofessionelt med sygeplejersker, social- og sundhedsassistenter, ergoterapeuter, pædagoger, socialrådgivere og andre relevante faggrupper fordelt på tre enheder med hver deres faglige profil.

Enhed 1:
Rehabilitering med fokus på udvikling og aktiv deltagelse i samfundslivet.
Dialektisk adfærdsterapi (DAT) og traumebevidst tilgang.

Enhed 2:
Rehabiliterende og stabiliserende indsats med særligt fokus på arousalregulering, konflikthåndtering og kognitiv behandling.

Enhed 3:
Rehabilitering med fokus på struktur, systematik og neuropædagogiske tilgange.

Vi ser mennesket:
"Vi lykkes, når borgeren føler sig værdifuld i en meningsfuld hverdag gennem håb, mestring og omsorg."

Det er ikke bare vores vision – det er fundamentet for den måde, vi arbejder på hver eneste dag.

Vores faglige fundament:
Vi arbejder rehabiliterende med afsæt i:

  • LA2
  • Kognitiv tilgang
  • Recovery-orienteret rehabilitering
  • Tværprofessionelt samarbejde.
Vi tilbyder:
En grundig introduktion

  • Individuelt tilrettelagt introduktionsforløb
  • Mentorordning
  • God oplæring i specialområdet.
Faglig udvikling

  • LA2-uddannelse
  • Kognitivt grundkursus
  • Løbende kompetenceudvikling
  • Teamudvikling
  • Individuel kompetenceudviklingsplan.
Et stærkt arbejdsfællesskab
Hos os bliver du en del af et engageret kollegafællesskab, hvor vi prioriterer høj faglighed, refleksion og trivsel.

Du kan se frem til:

  • regelmæssig supervision
  • team- og enhedsmøder
  • daglig faglig sparring
  • dialogmøder mellem ledelse og medarbejdere
  • et botilbud i fortsat udvikling
  • et arbejdsmiljø præget af engagement, humor og fælles ansvar.
Vi søger kollegaer, som

  • er fagligt nysgerrige og reflekterende.
  • ønsker at bidrage til udvikling og kvalitet.
  • har gode samarbejdsevner.
  • kommunikerer anerkendende og respektfuldt.
  • kan bevare ro og overblik i komplekse situationer.
Er du nysgerrig?
Se mere på vores hjemmeside Syrenparken og vores film om at arbejde på Syrenparken Er du vores nye kollega?

Vi viser meget gerne rundt og fortæller om Syrenparken, hvis du har lyst til at høre mere om stillingerne.

title: Sygeplejerske til Søvang Plejehjem
description:
Søvang Plejehjem i Glumsø består af 33 boliger, beliggende med en flot udsigt over søen. Vi arbejder med udgangspunkt i den enkelte borgers behov, med respekt for dennes livshistorie, personlige værdier og ønsker til den gode hverdag og især stjernestunder for vores borgere.

Søvang Plejehjem er tidligere blevet understøttet at sygeplejersker fra hjemmeplejen men nu søger vi vores egen sygeplejerske.
Du skal kunne se dig selv i et tæt samarbejde med resten af personalet og være engageret i at være tæt på borgerne og yde omsorg direkte i deres hverdag. Vi søger en sygeplejerske som skal have det sygeplejefaglige ansvar for borgerne, understøtte personalet i vores komplekse borgerforløb og stå i spidsen for det kontinuerlige arbejde med patientsikkerheden og kompetenceudviklingen af personalet. Du vil skulle medvirke til at sikre den faglige udvikling, arbejde med kvalitets-og evidensbaseret sygepleje og bistå til et højt tværfagligt samarbejde.

Du tilbydes fleksibilitet hvor du har indflydelse på egen vagtplan i tæt samspil med vores borgeres behov. Nogle gange kan det give mening at deltage i forskellige vagtlag i de komplekse borgerforløb. Arbejdstiden er primært i dagvagt, men med vagt på enkelte helligdage og arbejde hver 3. weekend.

Derudover vil du være tæt samarbejdspartner med vores kliniksygeplejerske der sidder i Fuglebjerg. Ved ferieafvikling vil du være ansvarlig for at varetage sygeplejeklinikken i Fuglebjerg.

Vi tilbyder

  • tæt samarbejde- og sparringsmuligheder med både de udekørende sygeplejersker og de andre teams af sygeplejersker der er i klyngen
  • arbejde i et tværfagligt team, der løser opgaverne i tæt samarbejde
  • en dynamisk arbejdsplads med fokus på borgeren og den høje faglighed
  • kontinuerlig fokus på arbejdsglæde og sammenhæng mellem arbejds- og privatliv.

title: Staff Backend Engineer - Grafana Second Horizon | Sweden | Remote
description:
Grafana Labs is the company behind Grafana Cloud, the fully managed observability platform trusted by more than 10,000 organizations to ensure reliability, resolve incidents faster, and optimize telemetry at scale. Built on open source and open standards and designed for interoperability across any stack, Grafana Cloud brings AI to observability and observability to AI, giving teams (and their agents) unified visibility so they can see, understand, and act on all their disparate data, wherever it lives, and move at the speed of their ambitions. Customers, including Anthropic, Bloomberg, NVIDIA, Microsoft, and Salesforce, rely on Grafana Labs. We are a 100% remote company with team members across 40+ countries, backed by leading investors including Lightspeed Venture Partners, Sequoia Capital, GIC, Coatue, J.P. Morgan, CapitalG, and Lead Edge Capital. Learn more at and follow us on LinkedIn and X.

We’re scaling fast and staying true to what makes us different: an open-source legacy, a global collaborative culture, and a passion for meaningful work. Our team thrives in an innovation-driven environment where transparency, autonomy, and trust fuel everything we do.

You may not meet every requirement, and that’s okay. If this role excites you, we’d love you to raise your hand for what could be a truly career-defining opportunity.

This is a remote opportunity, and we would be interested in applicants located in Spain, Sweden, UK, Ireland or Germany.

The Opportunity:

At Grafana Labs, we build observability tools that help users understand, respond to, and improve their systems – regardless of scale, complexity, or tech stack. We recently started a skunkworks initiative with a mission to bring observability to the rest of the business. Our goal is to make Grafana the single best place where humans and AI agents understand and act on real-time data from across the enterprise. As part of this initiative, we are building an AI-native data intelligence system that gives agents reliable, governed access to enterprise context. This system helps agents retrieve the right data, metadata, definitions, lineage, quality signals, and institutional knowledge without every agent builder having to maintain their own brittle context files. The principle is simple: the context system retrieves, agents decide, and data teams maintain the intelligence.

The new team is a mix of seasoned Grafanistas and new hires. We operate with a high degree of autonomy and ownership, both as individuals and as a team. Engineers are empowered to make decisions, move quickly, and validate ideas early – while being supported by a deeply collaborative culture that values curiosity, feedback, and cross-functional partnership.

We’re looking for a Staff-level Backend Engineer to help build the first production services for this context layer management system. You will design and ship the core backend architecture that powers ingestion, context storage, retrieval APIs, and agent-facing integrations. This is an early-stage role on a high-autonomy team, so you should be comfortable working through ambiguity, making pragmatic architectural decisions, and building systems that can evolve from internal dogfooding to production-grade SaaS. As the team matures, there’s a broad opportunity to expand or redefine this role based on impact and initiative.

What You'll Be Doing:

  • Build the core backend services: Design, implement, test, and operate the first services for context ingestion, context indexing, retrieval orchestration, API access, source configuration, and system administration.
  • Create a scalable SaaS foundation: Help define and build the architecture for a multi-tenant service, including tenant isolation, usage tracking, quotas, audit logs, background jobs, and reliable service boundaries.
  • Power agent-facing retrieval workflows: Build APIs and service interfaces that allow AI agents, MCP tools, CLIs, and internal applications to retrieve relevant context, provenance, confidence signals, and warnings.
  • Work across product and infrastructure: Partner with the team to make practical tradeoffs between fast experimentation and long-term reliability, especially as the project moves from prototype to production.
  • Operate what you build: Instrument services with metrics, logs, traces, alerts, and dashboards. Use observability tools to understand system behavior and improve reliability.
  • Contribute to technical direction: Help shape the architecture, service boundaries, storage choices, API contracts, deployment patterns, and engineering practices for a new product area.
  • Effective communication: You’ll be working in a highly dynamic and collaborative environment, so we need someone who can communicate effectively and contribute across teams.
  • Ownership and impact: Take full ownership of the AI solutions you develop, ensuring they are not only innovative but also scalable, maintainable, and aligned with real user workflows.

What Makes You a Great Fit:

  • Strong engineering skills: Solid experience building production-grade, user-facing software systems. You’re a self-starter, capable of tackling complex engineering problems and making UI design decisions with minimal supervision.
  • AI experience with a practical mindset: You’re familiar with AI technologies and frameworks, and you focus on delivering high-quality solutions that work in the real world, not just in theory.
  • Quick iteration and experimentation: You’re comfortable releasing prototypes, collecting feedback, and iterating with a pragmatic mindset.
  • Proven initiative: You take ownership and drive projects forward, pushing boundaries to find the most impactful solutions. You can deal with ambiguity and are able to define scope where things are loosely defined.
  • Collaborative attitude: You communicate effectively with your peers. You’re open to feedback, and you bring a solutions-oriented mindset to the table.
  • Experience with LLMs, prompt engineering, and building applications powered by GenAI.
  • Proven track record of delivering software that made it into production and is actively used by users.
  • Exposure to working in cloud-native environments (e.g., AWS, GCP, Azure).
  • Experience using observability tools to understand and troubleshoot system behavior.

Bonus Points for:

  • Experience building or working with agent frameworks or multi‑agent workflows.
  • Experience as a data analyst or work with data platforms (e.g., Looker, Tableau, PowerBI, Snowflake, DataBricks)
  • Experience building tools for data engineering.

How we work:

We are a remote-first team that meets regularly over video and does most of our work asynchronously, in writing. We value creativity, diverse perspectives, and clear communication. Tempo is relied upon by prominent global organizations to monitor critical applications and infrastructure, and we expect everyone on the team, including our Staff engineers, to contribute ideas that make it a more reliable, more useful, and more loved product.

Compensation & Rewards:

In Sweden, the Base compensation range for this role is SEK 878,578 - SEK 1,054,294. Actual compensation may vary based on level, experience, and skillset as assessed in the interview process. Benefits include equity, bonus (if applicable) and other benefits listed here.

*Compensation ranges are country specific. If you are applying for this role from a different location than listed above, your recruiter will discuss your specific market’s defined pay range & benefits at the beginning of the process

*Compensation ranges are country specific. If you are applying for this role from a different location than listed above, your recruiter will discuss your specific market’s defined pay range & benefits at the beginning of the process.

Why You’ll Thrive at Grafana Labs:

  • 100% Remote, Global Culture - As a remote-only company, we bring together talent from around the world, united by a culture of collaboration and shared purpose.
  • Scaling Organization – Tackle meaningful work in a high-growth, ever-evolving environment.
  • Transparent Communication – Expect open decision-making and regular company-wide updates.
  • Innovation-Driven – Autonomy and support to ship great work and try new things.
  • Open Source Roots – Built on community-driven values that shape how we work.
  • Empowered Teams – High trust, low ego culture that values outcomes over optics.
  • Career Growth Pathways – Defined opportunities to grow and develop your career.
  • Approachable Leadership – Transparent execs who are involved, visible, and human.
  • Passionate People – Join a team of smart, supportive folks who care deeply about what they do.
  • In-Person onboarding - We want you to thrive from day 1 with your fellow new ‘Grafanistas’ to learn all about what we do and how we do it.
  • Balance is Key - We operate a global annual leave policy of 30 days per annum. 3 days of your annual leave entitlement are reserved for Grafana Shutdown Days to allow the team to really disconnect. *We will comply with local legislation where applicable.

Equal Opportunity Employer: Grafana Labs is an equal opportunities employer. We welcome applications from everyone regardless of race, colour, nationality, origin, caste, sex, gender reassignment identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, religion or belief, disability, veteran status, genetic information, pregnancy, maternity, marital, family or carer status, or any other characteristic which is protected by local law. We believe that equality and diversity build a strong organisation, and we work hard to ensure that is the foundation of our organisation as we grow.

title: Vi söker säljare till Albrekts Guld i Nova Lund
description:

title: Logistics Operations Developer
description:
In Purchasing Development, we enable purchasing of sustainable and affordable IKEA products by developing a strong global supplier network. We work close to suppliers, partners, Range and Supply Chain Operations to secure quality, availability, sustainability and the lowest possible cost for the many people.


Within Purchasing Development, Category Area Food is part of the Food total value chain transformation. We are shaping a simpler, more connected and more industry-relevant way of working for IKEA Food, with clearer accountability, faster decisions and stronger supplier performance. Food has its own conditions, with limited shelf life, food safety requirements, freshness needs and changing market expectations. This calls for practical, fact-based and close supplier collaboration.


We are now looking for a Logistics Operations Developer who wants to help strengthen supplier logistics performance and capability across an assigned geography. In this role, you will work close to suppliers and business teams to make sure supplier routines, data quality, logistics compliance and execution readiness support reliable, compliant and cost-conscious supply.

This is a role for someone who enjoys turning operational signals into clear improvement actions. You will help suppliers and office teams understand what needs to be improved, follow up progress and make sure repeated issues are solved in a structured way within agreed ways of working.


About the role

As Logistics Operations Developer, you will own and develop supplier logistics performance for assigned suppliers and geographies. You will follow up delivery performance, data quality, logistics compliance and launch or change readiness. You will also support supplier capability development through analysis, training, implementation follow-up and corrective actions.


You will work closely with Business Developers, Business Development Managers, Product Sourcing Leaders, Inventory Planners, suppliers and other internal stakeholders. Your input will help bring supplier-side logistics reality into business decisions, so we can improve availability, reduce recurring issues and support growth at lower cost.


In this role, you will:

  • Own supplier logistics performance follow-up for assigned suppliers and geographies.
  • Follow up delivery performance, data quality, logistics compliance and execution readiness.
  • Translate Category Business Plan, supplier priorities and improvement needs into practical logistics actions.
  • Drive supplier improvement plans and corrective actions that strengthen delivery performance, supplier routines and logistics set-ups.
  • Provide supplier-side logistics feasibility, risk and readiness input for sourcing, launch, range change and deviation decisions.
  • Train and support suppliers and office teams in agreed logistics requirements and routines.
  • Identify process, data or digital improvement needs from supplier operations and secure the right escalation.

We are looking for someone who:

  • Has experience from supplier operations, logistics, supply planning, supplier development or operational performance improvement.
  • Understands supplier delivery performance, data quality, capacity and readiness, logistics set-up and compliance drivers.
  • Can analyse performance data, spot recurring deviations and recommend clear corrective actions.
  • Is comfortable guiding suppliers and office teams through requirements, routines and practical improvement work.
  • Communicates clearly across cultures, roles and locations, with a simple and fact-based way of working.
  • Enjoys solving problems structurally and helping others build capability for long-term performance.


At IKEA, low cost has a meaning. It helps us create better products at lower prices and make them available to more people. In this role, your everyday work with supplier logistics helps turn that idea into action.


You will be part of strengthening the Food value chain by making supplier operations more reliable, more compliant and easier to work with. Together, we keep the customer in the centre, act with business acumen and build a Food setup that can grow with speed, care and cost-consciousness.

We look forward to receiving your application by the 28th of September, 2026.

We always recruit based on values, competence, potential and diversity. Once competence

requirements are met, we will first consider impacted co-workers at Inter IKEA Group.

title: Junior Quantitative Researcher
description:
Flow Traders is looking for a Junior Quantitative Researcher to join the quantitative trading team at our Hong Kong office. This is a unique opportunity to join a leading proprietary trading firm, working alongside some of the brightest minds in the industry. As a firm, we are committed to leveraging advances in computer science, statistics, and machine learning to generate value in the financial markets.

A successful Quantitative Researcher is an expert in mathematics and statistics, passionate about translating challenging quantitative problems into equations and models, and skilled at optimizing them using cutting-edge computational techniques. If you're at the top of your quantitative, modeling, and coding game, and excited to test these skills in competitive live markets, this opportunity is for you.

What you will do

  • Design, build, optimize, and deploy state-of-the-art models and algorithms for systematic trading.
  • Analyze large datasets to identify patterns and signals that can be translated into trading strategies.
  • Collaborate with traders and technologists to bring models from research into live production.
  • Monitor and refine existing models based on live market performance.

What you need to succeed

  • A PhD degree in Mathematics, Physics, Computer Science or a related quantitative field.
  • Strong statistical and linear algebra knowledge.
  • Proficiency in implementing models and algorithms in programming languages such as Python or C++.
  • Experience in Deep Learning is a plus.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to work independently on open-ended, ambiguous problems.
  • Ownership and entrepreneurship.

What We Offer


We like to think that talent grows at Flow and stays at Flow. To ensure this, we provide our employees with an extensive onboarding program, access to Flow Academy, the best working environment, the latest technology and continuous support. We go out of our way to retain the small business feeling with which we started and stimulate innovation and collaboration through teamwork and our non-hierarchical approach. We offer competitive salary, annual discretionary bonus and other fantastic perks and benefits, such as:

  • Flow Academy for continuous learning and opportunities to attend domain-related conferences
  • Comprehensive health insurance coverage
  • In-house lounge with a bar, pool table and console games
  • Daily catered breakfast and lunch with healthy snacks and drinks available throughout the day
  • In-house hairdresser and massage therapist
  • Personal trainers, weekly boot camps and a subsidized gym membership
  • Annual company trip and a variety of events throughout the year
  • Global rotations between our offices worldwide
    and more!

Flow Traders does not accept unsolicited resumes from any professional staffing or search firms. All resumes, and any other information identifying potential candidates, submitted to any employee at Flow Traders via-email, the Internet or directly without a valid and signed search agreement will be deemed free to contact by Flow Traders without any restrictions and no placement fee of any kind will be paid in the event the candidate is hired by Flow Traders.

title: Robotics Systems Engineer
description:
Location: Uppsala, Sweden (Hybrid)

Team: Tech / Robotics

Type: Full-time

About Deep Forestry

At Deep Forestry, we are rewriting the rules of forestry management. We build autonomous, deep-tech drone systems capable of navigating dense, complex forest environments to acquire, process, and deliver high-fidelity spatial data. From heavy-duty hardware prototyping and edge-computed SLAM to commercial cloud portals, we own our entire stack.

To date, Deep Forestry's drones have completed over 1000 autonomous flights beneath the canopy in forests across multiple continents. The system measures stem diameter with a mean absolute error of 1.6 cm against harvester measurements along the full length of the stem, independently verified by a third-party government forestry authority.

The Role

As a Robotics Systems Engineer, you will help integrate, calibrate, optimize, and deploy the onboard software stack that powers our autonomous drones. You'll work across perception, navigation, autonomy, and hardware to ensure the entire system works together reliably on embedded computing platforms.

A key part of the role is bringing together multiple sensors into a well-integrated system. This includes developing and maintaining sensor calibration workflows, ensuring accurate spatial alignment and synchronization, and helping build a robust platform that performs reliably in demanding real-world environments.

You'll work closely with perception, autonomy, and hardware engineers to turn advanced robotics algorithms into production-ready systems that fly every day.

Responsibilities

  • Integrate new software components into our onboard robotics platform.

  • Develop and improve sensor calibration workflows, including extrinsic calibration between cameras, LiDARs, IMUs, GNSS, and other sensors.

  • Help ensure sensors remain well-calibrated and synchronized throughout development and deployment.

  • Deploy and maintain software on NVIDIA Jetson and other embedded Linux platforms.

  • Improve onboard performance by optimizing CPU, GPU, memory usage, and communication between software components.

  • Design and maintain ROS2-based system architectures and deployment pipelines.

  • Package and release software for production deployments.

  • Diagnose and resolve system integration, performance, and reliability issues.

  • Collaborate across perception, autonomy, hardware, and field teams to continuously improve the platform.

What we're looking for:

We're looking for someone with experience in robotics software and a passion for building reliable autonomous systems. You don't need to tick every box below - we value curiosity, practical problem solving, and a willingness to learn.

Ideally, you have experience with several of the following:

  • C++ and/or Python development.

  • ROS2 (or solid ROS1 experience with an interest in ROS2).

  • Robotics software running on Linux.

  • Multi-sensor systems and sensor calibration.

  • Embedded computing platforms such as NVIDIA Jetson.

  • Performance optimization and debugging.

  • Multi-threaded or distributed software systems.

  • Deploying software onto real robotic systems.

Nice to have

It's great if you've also worked with some of these:

  • Precise sensor synchronization (PTP, PPS, hardware timestamps, trigger signals, etc.).

  • Docker, CI/CD, or automated deployment workflows.

  • NVIDIA Jetson optimization.

  • Autonomous drones or mobile robots.

  • Calibration tools or automated calibration pipelines.

  • DDS, networking, shared memory, or real-time communication.

  • ROS1 → ROS2 migration.

  • Integrating sensors such as cameras, LiDARs, IMUs, GNSS, or flight controllers.

If you're excited about this role but don't meet every qualification, we'd still love to hear from you. We know great engineers come from a wide range of backgrounds.

Why Deep Forestry?

  • Real Deep-Tech: Work on a real, physical product combining advanced robotics, custom hardware, and cutting-edge cloud infrastructure.

  • High Autonomy: Join a flat, agile team of top-tier experts where your voice directly shapes the product and architecture.

  • Impact: Help transform an analog industry into a data-driven, sustainable future.
