title: Senior Database Administrator
description:
About the Role

We are seeking a high-ownership, autonomous Senior Database Administrator to serve as the single point of accountability for database architecture, reliability, and data safety across our entire organization. Evolving from a traditional DBA background into a cloud-native, automation-first operator, you will manage our production MySQL environment on AWS with a view toward potential PostgreSQL migration.

About the Client

Our client is a fin-tech company with a focus on innovation and customer-centric digital banking solutions provider.

What You Will Do

  • Lead Database Architecture: Serve as the senior technical authority on database architecture, performance, reliability, and data integrity across the organization.
  • Manage Fleet Operations: Own end-to-end administration of production MySQL (and potential PostgreSQL) fleets, including replication topologies, backup/recovery systems, capacity planning, and performance tuning.
  • Design Resilient AWS Infrastructure: Build and evolve highly available database architectures (RDS/Aurora Multi-AZ, cross-region replicas, automated failover strategies) focused on resilience and simplicity.
  • Drive Disaster Recovery & Backups: Own the backup and DR strategy end-to-end—designing automated workflows, performing regular restore tests, documenting RTO/RPO, and ensuring total data recoverability.
  • Execute Zero-Downtime Migrations: Lead complex database migrations, including major version upgrades, engine changes, cloud migrations, and large schema changes with minimal to zero downtime.
  • Establish Observability: Define database observability strategy using Datadog and Coralogix, establishing custom dashboards, metrics, alerting, and meaningful SLOs/SLIs.
  • Lead Root-Cause Analysis: Conduct thorough postmortems for production incidents, transforming root-cause findings into durable fixes, automated checks, and runbooks.
  • Optimize Performance: Perform advanced query and index optimization, execution plan analysis, and proactive tuning at scale.
  • Enforce Governance & Standards: Establish and enforce standards for schema design, data access patterns, and query reviews as a senior reviewer and gatekeeper.
  • Automate Workflows: Drive end-to-end automation of DBA tasks (provisioning, patching, failover drills, backup validation) using Terraform, Python, and Bash.
  • Strengthen Database Security: Manage database security posture, ensuring robust encryption, IAM/least-privilege access, credential rotation, audit logging, and compliance support (SOC 2, GDPR).
  • Mentor & Shape On-Call: Guide engineering teams on database best practices, act as the escalation point for complex database issues, and participate in shaping the on-call rotation.

What You Bring

  • Deep DBA Experience: 7+ years of hands-on DBA experience demonstrating deep mastery of database internals.
  • MySQL Mastery: Expert-level administration skills in MySQL, including replication (async/semi-sync/group replication), InnoDB internals, backup/recovery mechanics, and complex troubleshooting.
  • AWS Cloud Expertise: Extensive experience running production databases on AWS (RDS/Aurora Multi-AZ, read replicas, failover mechanics) and evaluating cost/performance trade-offs.
  • Disaster Recovery Ownership: Proven track record designing, automating, and validating real-world backup and DR testing frameworks.
  • Migration Leadership: Demonstrated success leading major database version upgrades, engine switches, and cloud migrations with minimal disruption and rollback planning.
  • Observability Skills: Hands-on experience with monitoring tools (Datadog, Coralogix, CloudWatch) to build effective metrics and alerting systems.
  • Advanced Query Tuning: Expert SQL capabilities, including execution plan analysis, indexing strategy, and query optimization at scale.
  • Automation & IaC: Proficiency in scripting (Python, Bash) and Infrastructure as Code using Terraform.
  • Security & Compliance Knowledge: Solid grasp of networking, security groups, IAM, encryption, and compliance standards (SOC 2, GDPR).
  • Incident Response & Communication: Ability to manage incidents end-to-end and clearly articulate technical risks, trade-offs, and solutions to both engineers and executive leadership.

What's in it for you

  • Generous Leave: 24 annual vacation days to support work-life balance.
  • Flexible Sick Days: 6 sick days per year without requiring a medical certificate.
  • Comprehensive Healthcare: Premium Health Insurance coverage up to €5,000 annually.
  • Relocation Support: Complete relocation package provided for international candidates.

title: Middle/Senior Full-Stack Python Engineer (Django)
description:
We are looking for a Middle/Senior Full-Stack Developer with strong Python/Django and SQL expertise to help develop and maintain a web application for migrating reporting functionality from Oracle APEX.

Our client is a leading Ukrainian bank undergoing significant digital transformation. The team is working on modernizing reporting solutions and migrating existing reporting functionality from Oracle APEX to a Python/Django-based web application. The role combines backend and frontend development with database analysis, reporting, dashboard development, and performance optimization.

Responsibilities:

  • Analyze existing Oracle APEX reports, dashboards, SQL queries, and business logic.
  • Develop and maintain backend functionality using Python and Django.
  • Develop web interfaces using Django Templates, HTML, CSS, and JavaScript.
  • Build interactive dashboards, tables, charts, and calculated metrics.
  • Implement data filtering, search, sorting, grouping, and pagination.
  • Develop report generation and export functionality in XLSX, CSV, and PDF formats.
  • Migrate and implement user roles, authentication, authorization, and access control for reports and data.
  • Analyze and optimize SQL queries and overall application performance.
  • Connect Django applications to Oracle Database and work with Oracle SQL and PL/SQL.
  • Validate migrated functionality and ensure data consistency between Oracle APEX and the Django application.
  • Develop and integrate REST APIs, preferably using Django REST Framework.
  • Document implemented functionality and support further development of the solution.

Requirements:

  • Strong Python skills and hands-on experience developing web applications with Django.
  • Commercial experience with Django backend and frontend development.
  • Strong knowledge of Django ORM and experience optimizing database queries.
  • Solid SQL skills and practical experience with Oracle Database.
  • Good understanding of PL/SQL.
  • Experience analyzing Oracle APEX applications, reports, dashboards, SQL queries, and business logic.
  • Experience integrating Django with Oracle Database, preferably using python-oracledb.
  • Experience developing interactive dashboards, tables, charts, filters, and calculated metrics.
  • Strong HTML5, CSS3, and JavaScript skills.
  • Experience implementing search, sorting, filtering, grouping, and pagination.
  • Experience with data visualization libraries such as Chart.js, Apache ECharts, or similar.
  • Experience generating and exporting reports in XLSX, CSV, and PDF formats.
  • Understanding of authentication, authorization, role-based access control, and data access restrictions.
  • Experience developing and integrating REST APIs.
  • Experience optimizing web application performance and SQL queries for large datasets.
  • Experience with Git.

Nice to have:

  • Experience with Django REST Framework.
  • Experience with PostgreSQL.
  • Experience with Oracle APEX migration or modernization projects.
  • Experience working with enterprise reporting or business intelligence applications.

We offer*:

  • Flexible working format - remote, office-based or flexible
  • A competitive salary and good compensation package
  • Personalized career growth
  • Professional development tools (mentorship program, tech talks and trainings, centers of excellence, and more)
  • Active tech communities with regular knowledge sharing
  • Education reimbursement
  • Memorable anniversary presents
  • Corporate events and team buildings
  • Other location-specific benefits

*not applicable for freelancers

title: ABA/AVA-projektleder
description:
Hareskov Elektric A/S søger en teknisk stærk ABA/AVA-projektleder, der vil være med til at drive og udvikle vores aktiviteter inden for brandtekniske installationer.

Vi søger en erfaren elektriker med interesse og flair for ABA- og AVA-anlæg, som kan tage ansvar for vores projekter hele vejen – fra projektering og tilbud til udførelse, kvalitetssikring, myndighedskrav, godkendelse og aflevering.

Stillingen er ikke kun en traditionel projektlederstilling. Vi leder efter en person, der trives med at være den tekniske nøgleperson på projekterne og samtidig kan samarbejde tæt med vores elektrikere, kunder, rådgivere og øvrige samarbejdspartnere.

Dine primære opgaver

Du får en central rolle i vores ABA/AVA-projekter og kommer blandt andet til at arbejde med:

  • Projektering, tilbudsgivning og planlægning af ABA- og AVA-installationer

  • Teknisk gennemgang af projekter, tegninger og beskrivelser

  • Tilsyn med udførelsen på byggepladser og eksisterende installationer

  • Kvalitetssikring og dokumentation

  • Sikring af, at installationerne udføres i henhold til gældende regler, forskrifter og projektmateriale

  • Forberedelse og håndtering af DBI-inspektion og godkendelse

  • Teknisk sparring med og instruktion af vores elektrikere

  • Fejlfinding på ABA/AVA-anlæg samt anvisning af løsninger

  • I mindre omfang programmering, konfiguration og idriftsættelse af ABA/AVA-centraler

  • Deltagelse ved test, idriftsættelse og aflevering

  • Dialog med kunder, rådgivere, inspektionsorganer og øvrige aktører på projekterne

En vigtig del af rollen er at kunne analysere tekniske problemstillinger, finde den rigtige løsning og instruere vores elektrikere i, hvordan fejl og mangler skal udbedres.

Du skal samtidig være indstillet på i begrænset omfang selv at deltage i det praktiske tekniske arbejde, eksempelvis ved programmering, idriftsættelse og fejlfinding på centraler.

Din baggrund

Vi forestiller os, at du:

  • Er uddannet elektriker

  • Har erfaring med ABA-anlæg og gerne også AVA

  • Har en stærk teknisk forståelse og interesse for brandtekniske installationer

  • Kan læse og forstå tegninger, beskrivelser og teknisk dokumentation

  • Arbejder struktureret med kvalitetssikring og dokumentation

  • Kan arbejde selvstændigt og tage ansvar for et projekt

  • Har praktisk forståelse og kan formidle tekniske løsninger klart til elektrikere på pladsen

  • Har erfaring med fejlfinding og idriftsættelse

Har du en videregående teknisk uddannelse som elinstallatør eller maskinmester, er det en fordel, men ikke et krav.

DBI-certificering

Det er en fordel, hvis du allerede har relevante DBI-uddannelser og den nødvendige erfaring til at varetage en certificeret rolle inden for ABA.

Det er dog ikke et krav, at du er certificeret i dag.

Har du den rigtige tekniske baggrund og motivation, vil en del af din udvikling hos Hareskov Elektric være, at du gennem uddannelse og praktisk erfaring opnår de nødvendige kompetencer og certificeringer.

Målet er, at du på sigt kan få et selvstændigt fagligt ansvar for vores ABA/AVA-projekter og deres godkendelse.

Hvem er du?

Du er først og fremmest elektriker.

Du interesserer dig for, hvorfor et anlæg virker – og hvorfor det ikke virker. Når der opstår en fejl, har du lyst til at finde årsagen og løsningen frem for blot at konstatere problemet.

Du har samtidig lyst til at tage mere ansvar og bevæge dig ud over den traditionelle elektrikerrolle. Du kan bevare overblikket over et projekt og sikre, at projektering, installation, dokumentation, kvalitetssikring og aflevering hænger sammen.

Du behøver ikke være den klassiske projektledertype. Det vigtigste for os er din tekniske forståelse, ansvarlighed og lyst til at udvikle dig inden for ABA og AVA.

Vi tilbyder

Hos Hareskov Elektric får du mulighed for at få en central rolle i et område, som vi ønsker at udvikle yderligere.

Du bliver en del af en virksomhed, hvor der er kort vej fra beslutning til handling, og hvor tekniske kompetencer og praktisk erfaring vægtes højt.

Vi tilbyder blandt andet:

  • En selvstændig stilling med stor teknisk indflydelse

  • Mulighed for at præge og udvikle vores ABA/AVA-aktiviteter

  • Relevant efteruddannelse og mulighed for DBI-certificering

  • En varieret hverdag med projektering, byggeplads, fejlfinding og teknisk sparring

  • Tæt samarbejde med elektrikere og afdelingsledere

  • Gode muligheder for faglig og personlig udvikling

Om Hareskov Elektric

Hareskov Elektric A/S udfører el- og teknikentrepriser for professionelle kunder inden for blandt andet erhverv, offentlige byggerier og større byggeprojekter.

Vores størrelse betyder, at vi har organisationen og kompetencerne til at håndtere større og komplekse projekter, samtidig med at vi er små nok til at være agile, træffe hurtige beslutninger og tilpasse os den enkelte opgave.

Er du elektriker med stærk teknisk forståelse og lyst til at tage næste skridt og blive en af vores nøglepersoner inden for ABA og AVA, vil vi meget gerne høre fra dig.

title: Tietoasiantuntijan toistaiseksi voimassa oleva tehtävä
description:
Tehtävä sijoittuu yliopiston kirjaston Julkaisemisen edellytykset -yksikköön, joka vastaa muun muassa opetus- ja kulttuuriministeriölle vuosittain tehtävästä julkaisutiedonkeruusta ja julkaisujen metadatan laadusta. Yksikkö osallistuu myös tutkimustietojärjestelmän kehittämiseen yhdessä muiden yliopistopalveluiden kanssa.

Tehtävänäsi on olla mukana toteuttamassa ja kehittämässä tutkimustuotosten julkaisemisen palveluja sekä niissä hyödynnettäviä teknisiä ratkaisuja tutkijalähtöisesti. Tulet osallistumaan tutkimustietojärjestelmän (CRIS) uudistusprojektiin. Lisäksi tehtäväkenttäsi sisältää avoimen tieteen edistämisen ja julkaisemisen tuen tehtäviä, kuten koulutusten pitämistä ja tutkijoiden neuvomista, kansallista ja kansainvälistä tutkimusarkkitehtuuriyhteistyötä sekä muita julkaisutiedonkeruun tehtäviä.

Työsi on luonteeltaan yhteistyötä ja verkostoitumista kirjastossa, yliopistossa sekä kansallisissa ja kansainvälisissä verkostoissa. Työn tarkempi sisältö täsmentyy valittavan asiantuntijan vahvuuksien mukaan.

Etsimämme henkilö

Etsimämme henkilö tuntee yliopistojen tietojärjestelmäkokonaisuuksia (esim. DSpace-julkaisuarkistot ja CRIS-järjestelmät) sekä tieteellisiä tietokantoja (esim. Web of Science, Scopus ja PubMed) ja omaa näkemystä julkaisutiedonkeruun prosessien tutkijalähtöiseen kehittämiseen. Sinulla on valmiuksia olla mukana kehittämässä tekoälyn hyödyntämistä tieteellisen kirjaston prosesseissa ja yliopistoyhteisön palveluissa. Hallitset sujuvan suomen ja englannin kielen sekä pystyt toimimaan asiantuntijana sekä yksin että moniammatillisissa ryhmissä.

Edellytämme sinulta soveltuvaa ylempää korkeakoulututkintoa. Lisäksi olet hankkinut valmiuksia informaatioalan, tutkimuspalveluiden tai tietojärjestelmätyön tehtäviin joko opinnoista tai työkokemuksesta.

Katsomme eduksi kokemuksen tutkimustietojärjestelmien ylläpidosta, hankintaprosessista ja/tai käyttöönotosta, työskentelyn yliopiston kirjastossa, tutkimuspalveluissa tai IT-palveluissa sekä näkemyksen siitä, miten tutkijoita voidaan osallistaa julkaisemisen palvelujen kehittämiseen.

Arvostamme yhteisöllisyyttä ja edistämme tasa-arvoa, monimuotoisuutta ja inklusiivisuutta. Kannustammekin erilaisen taustan omaavia päteviä hakijoita hakemaan avoimia tehtäviämme.

Tarjoamme

Tarjoamme mielenkiintoisen ja monipuolisen tehtävän, jossa pääset kehittämään keskeisiä palveluja ja uusia toiminnan ja yhteistyön tapoja. Yliopistomme on hyvinvointiin panostava työyhteisö, jossa henkilöstöllä on monipuoliset mahdollisuudet kouluttautua ja kehittää osaamistaan.

- Mahdollisuus kehittää itseäsi – Kannustamme henkilöstöämme kehittämään osaamistaan tarjoamalla monipuolisia koulutus- ja osaamisen kehittämismahdollisuuksia. Myös avoimen yliopistomme kurssit kuuluvat ilmaiseen koulutustarjontaan.

- Hyvinvoinnistasi pidetään huolta – Työntekijöidemme hyvinvointi on meille tärkeää! Kattavan työterveyshuollon lisäksi omat hyvinvointipalvelumme seuraa, tukee ja kehittää henkilöstömme hyvinvointia. Fyysistä jaksamista edistämme CampusSportin liikuntapalveluilla henkilöstöhintaan.

- Työ ja vapaa-aikasi ovat tasapainossa – Joustava työaika ja osittainen etätyömahdollisuus auttavat työn ja vapaa-ajan yhteensovittamisessa.

- Mukava ja toisiaan tukeva työyhteisö – Kannustamme toisiamme ja arvostamme yhdessä tekemistä!

title: NK Care / BPA Service søger handicaphjælper til kvinde med sclerose i Frederikshavn
description:
Vil du have et meningsfuldt arbejde, hvor nærvær, humor og en god portion fleksibilitet er en vigtig del af hverdagen?

NK Care / BPA Service søger nye medlemmer til et velfungerende hjælperteam hos en kvinde med sclerose, som bor i eget hjem i Frederikshavn sammen med sin mand og familiens søde og rolige hund.

Vi søger både en fast handicaphjælper til en stilling på ca. 150 timer om måneden samt afløsere, som kan træde til ved sygdom, ferie og andet fravær.

Fast stilling – ca. 150 timer pr. måned

Opstart hurtigst muligt.

Vagterne er primært:

Ulige uger:
• Onsdag og torsdag kl. 08.00–18.00

Lige uger:
• Mandag, tirsdag, fredag, lørdag og søndag kl. 08.00–18.00

Der er mulighed for mindre ændringer i vagtplanen, og vi lægger vægt på, at du er fleksibel og indstillet på at bytte vagter med dine kolleger, når behovet opstår.

Afløsere søges også

Vi søger desuden afløsere, som kan hjælpe ved sygdom og ferie.

Der kan være tale om både dag-, aften- og nattevagter, så det er en fordel, hvis du har mulighed for at være fleksibel.

Om jobbet

Som handicaphjælper bliver du en vigtig del af hverdagen og hjælper med de ting, som kvinden har brug for støtte til.

Opgaverne består blandt andet af:

• Personlig pleje
• Forflytninger
• Praktisk hjælp i hjemmet
• Rengøring
• Madlavning
• Ledsagelse og ture ud af huset
• Hjælp i forbindelse med træning
• Kørsel i handicapbus
• Hjælp til forskellige praktiske og fysiske opgaver i hverdagen – eksempelvis at skrive, når det er nødvendigt

Det er derfor en alsidig stilling, hvor dagene kan være forskellige, og hvor du både kommer til at arbejde selvstændigt og som en del af et team.

Hvem er du?

Vi forestiller os, at du:

• Er moden og ansvarsbevidst
• Er positiv, frisk og imødekommende
• Har humor og gerne bidrager til en god stemning
• Er fleksibel og hjælpsom over for dine kolleger
• Kan arbejde selvstændigt og tage ansvar
• Har lyst til at gøre en forskel i et andet menneskes hverdag
• Har kørekort – da der indgår kørsel i handicapbus
• Er ikke-ryger

title: SPUC mangler dig – pædagog eller SSA til en stilling på 25 timer om ugen
description:
Fem formiddage om ugen – med tid til nærvær og faglighed

SPUC mangler dig, der er en tydelig, kompetent og motiveret pædagog eller social- og sundhedsassistent til en stilling på 25 timer om ugen.

Stillingen er mandag til fredag kl. 07.00-12.00, og din opgave bliver bl.a. at være med til at skabe en god, tryg og rolig start på dagen for vores beboere. Du skal hjælpe og støtte i forbindelse med morgenrutinerne, herunder personlig pleje, samt under morgenmaden. Derudover bliver igangsætning af pædagogiske aktiviteter en fast del af din hverdag.

I de kommende år implementerer vi LA2U som en fælles metode. Derfor forventer vi, at du er nysgerrig på LA2U og interesserer dig for beboernes indefra-perspektiv – og at du har lyst til at være med til at udvikle vores fælles faglige praksis.

Vi leder efter dig, som kan sige JA til:
  • At du er uddannet pædagog eller social- og sundhedsassistent.
  • At du har et solidt fagligt fundament og et stærkt værdigrundlag.
  • At du betragter samarbejde som en professionel kernekompetence.
  • At du har interesse for – eller erfaring med – voksne med udviklingshæmning.
  • At du er optaget af at forstå den enkelte beboers oplevelse, ønsker og behov og lade dette være udgangspunkt for din støtte.
  • At du kan bidrage til en rolig, tryg og forudsigelig start på dagen for den enkelte beboer.
  • At du er tryg ved og kan støtte beboerne i personlig pleje som en naturlig del af morgenrutinen.
  • At du kan støtte og vejlede beboerne i deres morgenrutiner med blik for den enkeltes ressourcer, behov og selvbestemmelse.
  • At du har lyst til at tage initiativ til og igangsætte pædagogiske aktiviteter, der tager udgangspunkt i beboernes ønsker, interesser, ressourcer og behov.
  • At du er stabil og pålidelig i dit fremmøde og ser kontinuitet som en vigtig forudsætning for beboernes tryghed og for det kollegiale samarbejde.
  • At du deler viden, erfaringer og faglige refleksioner med dine kolleger.
  • At du trives med en fast arbejdstid mandag til fredag kl. 07.00-12.00.
Vi tilbyder dig:
  • En fast stilling på 25 timer om ugen med arbejdstid mandag til fredag kl. 07.00-12.00.
  • En arbejdsplads med et tydeligt fælles værdigrundlag.
  • Et miljø, hvor respekt og ligeværd præger relationerne mellem både beboere og medarbejdere.
  • Et fagligt fokus på beboernes ressourcer, perspektiver og indefra-perspektiv, som styrer vores indsatser.
  • En hverdag, hvor du får en vigtig rolle i at skabe gode og trygge morgener for vores beboere.
  • Et stærkt kollegialt fællesskab, hvor vi løfter i flok og deler viden, ansvar og faglige refleksioner.
  • Løbende supervision og mulighed for kompetenceudvikling.
Du bliver en vigtig del af beboernes hverdag. Du møder ind kl. 07.00 og er med til at skabe struktur, ro og nærvær omkring dagens begyndelse. Opgaverne består blandt andet i at støtte beboerne i deres individuelle morgenrutiner, herunder personlig pleje, og være til stede under morgenmaden. Støtten tager altid udgangspunkt i den enkelte beboers behov, ønsker, ressourcer og perspektiv med fokus på størst mulig selvstændighed og livskvalitet.
Vil du vide mere om stillingen, er du velkommen til at kontakte afdelingsleder Anya Isherwood på mail: isher@helsingor.dk.
Vi modtager kun ansøgninger via portalen. Send en motiveret ansøgning og CV – vi glæder os til at høre fra dig.
Samtaler finder sted den 6. oktober i dagtimerne.

SPUC er en organisation, der yder socialpædagogisk vejledning og støtte i henhold til Serviceloven § 83 & § 85 til voksne mennesker med udviklingshæmning, i bofællesskaber og botilbud. Endvidere driver SPUC værestedet Liv, der er et fritidstilbud i henhold til Servicelovens § 79.

I Helsingør Kommune vægter vi, at medarbejdere og ledere udvikler deres faglighed. Derfor har vi fokus på at skabe sammenhæng mellem den ambitiøse udvikling af hele organisationen Helsingør Kommune og videreuddannelse af både medarbejdere og ledere – fagligt og personligt.

9 ud af 10 indbyggere bor mindre end 2 km fra vandet. Her mødes Hamlet og Kronborg med verdenskendt arkitektur og en hyggelig middelalderby på ét og samme sted. Tjek #OplevHelsingor og se selv.

title: Social- og sundhedsassistent til Åsumgruppen
description:
Er du social- og sundhedsassistent med ambitioner og hjertet på rette sted? Brænder du for at arbejde i en udekørende gruppe, hvor vi tværfagligt og fremtidsrettet samarbejder om og med borgeren, skaber den bedste arbejdsplads for hinanden og tør udfordre det vi plejer for at skabe forandring? Så er denne stilling som social- og sundhedsassistent lige noget for dig.

Om os
Åsumgruppen er en udekørende hjemmeplejegruppe organiseret i forløb erhvervet hjerneskade og består af 50 kompetente kollegaer, fordelt på sygeplejersker, social- og sundhedsassistenter, -hjælpere, ergo- og fysioterapeuter samt elever. Vi arbejder i faste tværfaglige teams i gruppen.

Vi kommer ved ca. 250 borgere. Vores borgergruppe er primært borgere som er udfordret af sindslidelse, erhvervet eller medfødt hjerneskade samt andre fysiske eller sociale udfordringer.

Som social- og sundhedsassistent i Åsumgruppen tilbyder vi dig en hverdag, med rehabiliterende tankegang, hvor dagene aldrig er ens og kompleksiteten i opgaverne spænder vidt. Med borgeren i centrum for din opgaveløsning er du optaget af relationsarbejdet både til borgerne og de pårørende.

Det tilbyder vi:

  • Velfærdsteknologi i hverdagen
    Vi er med helt fremme, når det gælder nye løsninger. Hos os er velfærdsteknologi ikke bare et buzzword – det er noget vi arbejder aktivt med for at integreret det som en del af vores kerneopgave og som en hjælp til både borgere og personale.
  • Godt arbejdsmiljø
    Vi har fokus på trivsel, medindflydelse og en kultur, hvor man hjælper hinanden og griner sammen. Her er der plads til både faglighed og fællesskab – og du bliver aldrig overladt til dig selv.
  • Høj faglighed
    Vi går ikke på kompromis med fagligheden. Her får du mulighed for at bruge dine kompetencer og udvikle dem – hver dag. Du bliver en vigtig del af vores arbejde med komplekse forløb, rehabilitering og helhedsorienteret pleje.
  • Mulighed for faglig udvikling
    Vi prioriterer din udvikling! Du får adgang til kurser, temadage og supervision, og vi understøtter, hvad enten du ønsker mere viden, ansvar eller fordybelse.
  • Faste tværfaglige teams
    Du bliver en del af et trygt og velfungerende team, hvor samarbejdet mellem sygeplejersker, terapeuter, assistenter og hjælpere er tæt, tillidsfuldt og struktureret. Vi tror på, at kontinuitet skaber kvalitet – både for borgeren og medarbejderen.
Om dig
Du skal bidrage til:

  • at give borgerne de bedste forudsætninger, når du med din faglighed og rehabiliterende tilgang kommer i deres hjem
Et tværfagligt miljø, som både kendetegner vores gruppe, men også de andre faglige enheder vi samarbejder med.

  • at opbygge betydningsfulde relationer- både til borgerne, men også de pårørende, som er vigtige samarbejdspartnere i borgerens forløb.
Faglige kvalifikationer:

  • Er uddannet social- og sundhedsassistent og er sikker i egne kompetencer og faglighed
  • Kan arbejde ud fra en rehabiliterende tankegang, og har fokus på hvilke faglige tiltag, der kan understøtte borgeren til at mestre eget liv
  • Evner at arbejde selvstændigt og samtidig indgå i et ligeværdigt og udviklende samarbejde med øvrige kollegaer, samt tager ansvar for fælles trivsel
  • Du er fagligt nysgerrig på hvordan vi løser kerneopgaven og vil medvirke til at udvikle Åsumgruppen.
  • Du ser dokumentation som en naturlig del af din hverdag
Løn- og ansættelsesvilkår
Stillingen aflønnes efter gældende overenskomst afhængig af erfaring og kvalifikationer. Det forventede lønniveau oplyses inden en eventuel samtale.
Tiltrædelse snarest muligt.

Vil du vide mere?
Er du blevet nysgerrig kan du kontakte rehabiliteringsleder Charlotte Luth på 65 51 34 31 eller assisterende rehabiliteringsleder Mette Borstrøm Kjærstad. 65 51 34 31.

Det praktiske
Ansøgningsfrist er den 4. oktober 2026. Ansættelsessamtaler afholdes løbende.

title: Student assistant in the administration of VOLT Research Center
description:
Would you like to help communicate to the general public and scientists alike about the research we do at VOLT Center (Center for Volatile Interactions), Copenhagen University? Could it be interesting to work with web communication and editing, as well as social media? We are looking for a student to create educational visual communication, as well as assist with basic administrative tasks. In our team, collaboration and high ambitions are important keywords, and we are ready with training, guidance, sparring and good humor.

What will your tasks be?

  • Assist with editing and creating new texts about our research for our website
  • Prepare draft materials for news, events, info screens and banners about Center events
  • Solve communication tasks in close collaboration with your direct manager (Center coordinator) and colleague scientists and then post on social media
  • Assist in basic admin tasks such as printing documents, updating office door signs, making cards for the staff board
  • Assist in working with graphic material for our communication, e.g. in Canva or Photoshop
You will be an important part of our team, and you will be encouraged to use your perspective as a student/ non-specialist in the tasks we perform. As you get to know the tasks, you will have the opportunity to take on more responsibility and work independently with your tasks.

Who are you?

  • You are studying at a University in Copenhagen (or somewhere that allows you to come to your workplace in person) and are interested in communication
  • You are interested in target group-oriented communication
  • You are structured and systematic in your work style and good at completing tasks
  • You are solution-oriented and can understand the user's problems and needs
  • It's a bonus if you have the courage to do image editing and lighter graphic work
  • You are willing to be trained in video editing, statistics tools, etc.
  • You ask for help when in doubt.
  • You like to have a large contact surface and collaborate with many people
We do not expect you to know everything in advance, but that you have the courage to learn, dare to ask for help and tell us about students' needs. We are committed to communicating clearly and welcomingly to our audiences, and we look forward to your help.

About us
Center for Volatile Interactions (VOLT) is a Center of Excellence established in 2023 with funding from the Danish National Research Foundation. The center is based at Department of Biology, Faculty of Science, University of Copenhagen. VOLT research concerns climate change and ecosystem processes, and aims to characterize and quantify the production and consumption of volatiles by understudied organisms and environments, such as mosses, lichens, soils as well as fresh and marine waters.

VOLT endorses diversity, as is demonstrated by the gender-balanced and multinational team of PIs and collaborators. The inclusive, open, and collaborative research environment is built to allow different approaches and personalities to contribute to a unique, creative space for science, which will translate into innovation and high productivity.

Would you like to know more about the position?
We are happy to answer questions about the job posting. You can contact Center coordinator Ana Verissimo at ana.verissimo@bio.ku.dk.

Application
Send your application via the job page (click on "Apply for the position" at the bottom of the posting) together with your CV, a current enrolment confirmation and a current transcript.

We must receive your application by 20 October 2026 at the latest. We expect to hold interviews the week immediately after the deadline.

Salary and employment terms
You will be employed and paid according to the applicable collective agreement between the Ministry of Finance and the Public Employees' Organisations - The State Sector (OAO-S collective agreement) and according to the Organisational Agreement for office clerks, laboratory technicians and IT employees (HK). You will be placed as a student according to seniority. The minimum hourly wage is DKK 145.73 as of 1 August 2026. You can read more about salary levels in the state at .

The starting date for the position is 1 December 2026 or as soon as possible thereafter. The working hours are 15 hours per week. Remuneration is based solely on the actual number of hours worked, and you are not guaranteed a fixed number of hours.

To be employed, it is a prerequisite that you are enrolled and active student at a higher education institution (medium or long-term education).

We want to reflect the surrounding community and therefore encourage everyone, regardless of personal background, to apply for the position.

The University of Copenhagen has established a new joint administrative organization, which is still being implemented. This involves ongoing changes and development of, among other things, workflows and collaboration surfaces.



The University of Copenhagen gives its nearly 10,000 employees opportunities to fully utilize their talent in an ambitious, informal environment. We ensure a traditional and modern framework for education and independent research at a high international level. We seek answers and solutions to common problems and make new knowledge accessible and useful to others.

title: Redovisningskonsult till Checkat Stockholm – mer än bara redovisning
description:

Checkat växer och nu är det Stockholms tur!

Vi etablerar Checkat Stockholm och söker en erfaren redovisningskonsult som vill få en viktig roll i vår satsning. Vi letar efter dig som gillar redovisning och rådgivning, men som också får energi av människor, nya relationer och möjligheten att påverka.

Om rollen

Hos oss arbetar du nära våra kunder med redovisning, bokslut, årsredovisningar, deklarationer och rådgivning. Men rollen i Stockholm är större än så.

Vi vill bygga en stark lokal närvaro och söker dig som tycker att det är roligt att skapa kontakter, nätverka och se möjligheter till nya affärer. Du får vara med och påverka hur Checkat Stockholm utvecklas och växer, med hela Checkat och ett riktigt vasst team bakom dig.

Vem är du?

Du har flera års erfarenhet från redovisningsbyrå och är trygg i din roll. Du gillar människor lika mycket som siffror och vill vara mer än den som ser till att bokföringen blir rätt.

Kanske lockas du av tanken på att få kombinera rollen som redovisningskonsult med att vara med och utveckla ett kontor och bygga team. Då tror vi att du kommer trivas riktigt bra hos oss.

Rollen kan växa tillsammans med Checkat Stockholm och för rätt person finns möjlighet till både kontorsansvar och delägarskap.

Hos oss får du frihet under ansvar, flexibla arbetssätt, stora möjligheter att påverka och framför allt ett gäng kollegor som gärna tänker nytt tillsammans med dig.

Nyfiken? Vi ser fram emot att höra från dig!

title: Clinical Lab Scientist
description:
SUMMARY: Day position

Performs specialized clinical laboratory testing in all clinical laboratory disciplines. Performs and reports results, proof tests and assumes responsibility for accuracy.

ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS:

  1. Utilizes laboratory computer systems to document all actions taken concerning patient and quality control testing.
  2. Performs laboratory testing following laboratory policies and procedures.
  3. Performs and documents instrument calibrations following manufacturers’ guidelines.
  4. Performs routine preventative maintenance following laboratory policies and procedures and manufacturers’ guidelines.
  5. Performs quality control testing as required in laboratory policies and procedures. All remedial actions taken for out of control results will be documented.
  6. Performs STAT testing in a timely manner and has the ability to organize testing priorities during heavy workload situations to expedite patient testing results.
  7. Relays Panic Values to ordering service and documents all actions taken.
  8. Follows laboratory safety policies and procedures including Standard Precautions.

OTHER RESPONSIBILITIES:

1. Performs venous and arterial puncture to obtain specimens for laboratory testing.

  1. Maintains clean work area and adequate supplies and reagents.
  2. Assists in researching and implementing new testing procedures.
  3. Assists in training and supervision of Laboratory Assistants.
  4. Supervises lab assistants and phlebotomists on weekends and after office hours.
  5. Other duties as assigned from time to time.

SUPERVISORY RESPONSIBILITIES: None


EDUCATION, EXPERIENCE, AND SKILLS REQUIRED:

  1. Ability to work independently with little or no supervision.
  2. Good manual dexterity and ability to follow instructions.


LICENSES AND CERTIFICATION:

  1. Four-year college degree with a valid Clinical Laboratory License issued by the State of California Department of Health Services required.

AGE OF POPULATION SERVED:

Newborn ⁯ Infant/Pediatric ⁯ Adolescent ⁯ Adult ⁯ Geriatric All X ⁯ No Patient Care

title: Kravhanterare till Teknik & Trafiktjänster
description:
Kravhanterare till Teknik & Trafiktjänster

Region Stockholm söker en erfaren kravhanterare till Trafikförvaltningens IT-avdelning, sektion Teknik & Trafiktjänster. Uppdraget omfattar arbete i stora och komplexa verksamhets- och IT-initiativ inom kollektivtrafiken.

Du kommer att arbeta som konsult i en central roll med ansvar för kravinsamling, analys, kravnedbrytning och kravhantering i projekt och förvaltningsinitiativ med många intressenter, system och integrationer.

Placering är Stockholm med möjlighet till både distansarbete och arbete på kontor på Kungsholmen enligt verksamhetens behov. Uppdraget startar 2026-11-10 och omfattar heltid.

Om företaget

Region Stockholm har det övergripande ansvaret för att invånare och besökare ska ha tillgång till en väl utbyggd, tillgänglig och pålitlig kollektivtrafik. Trafikförvaltningen ansvarar för utveckling, styrning och uppföljning av kollektivtrafiken samt förvaltning av infrastrukturen. IT-avdelningen ansvarar för design, utveckling och förvaltning av Trafikförvaltningens digitala tjänster för att bidra till en attraktiv och hållbar kollektivtrafik.

Om rollen

Rollen verkar inom IT-avdelningen och sektionen Teknik & Trafiktjänster. Du kommer att arbeta inom flera större initiativ, bland annat upphandling av nytt system för hantering av anläggningar och fastigheter samt införande av anropsstyrd trafik.

Du arbetar nära verksamhet, projektledare, initiativledare, produktägare och utvecklingsteam för att säkerställa att krav är tydliga, testbara och skapar verksamhetsnytta. Arbetet bedrivs i komplexa IT-miljöer med många integrationer och beroenden mellan verksamheter och system.

Roll och ansvar

• Genomföra kravinsamling, kravanalys och kravhantering i projekt och förvaltningsinitiativ.• Samla in, bearbeta och analysera verksamhetens behov.• Översätta verksamhetsbehov till tydliga och konkreta krav.• Bryta ned högnivåkrav till testbar och uppföljningsbar nivå.• Säkerställa att krav dokumenteras strukturerat och enligt etablerade processer.• Facilitera workshops och kravdialoger med verksamhet och utvecklingsteam.• Arbeta genom initiativens samtliga faser från analys och förstudie till införande.• Säkerställa kravuppföljning och mätning av kravuppfyllnad.• Arbeta i Trafikförvaltningens verktyg och processer, exempelvis Confluence och Jira.• Samverka med flera verksamhetssektioner och intressenter.

Kompetenskrav

1. Minst fem (5) års erfarenhet av att arbeta strukturerat med krav; kravinsamling, analys, nedbrytning och strukturering

2. Minst fem (5) års erfarenhet av kravarbete i form av kravanalytiker i större verksamhetskritiska IT-miljöer med flera samverkande system, omfattande integrationsflöden och många verksamhetsintressenter

3. Minst fem (5) års erfarenhet av att dokumentera, förankra och kommunicera krav mellan verksamhet, förvaltning och utvecklingsteam

4. Minst fem (5) års erfarenhet att självständigt driva kravarbete samt facilitera workshops och kravdialoger med verksamhet, projekt, förvaltning och utvecklingsteam

5. Minst tre (3) års erfarenhet av att ha jobbat inom offentlig verksamhet

6. Minst tre (3) års erfarenhet av att arbeta i enligt PM3 eller motsvarande förvaltningsmodell

Mervärdeskrav

1. Dokumenterad erfarenhet av etablerad kravhanteringsmetod från minst två uppdrag eller certifiering inom kravhantering (exempelvis IREB, REQB, IIBA eller likvärdig).

2. Erfarenhet från minst två (2) uppdrag inom stora organisationer med fler än 500 anställda och många intressenter.

3. Erfarenhet från minst två (2) tidigare uppdrag som omfattat arbete med nyttoanalyser

4. Erfarenhet från minst två (2) tidigare uppdrag som omfattat framtagande av acceptanskriterier / acceptansscenarion

5. Minst tre (3) års erfarenhet av arbete i både agila utvecklingsteam och i projektorganisationer

Uppdragsinformation

• Uppdragsperiod: 2026-11-10 – 2028-11-09• Omfattning: 40 timmar per vecka• Option: 1+1 år• Placeringsort: Stockholm (Kungsholmen) med möjlighet till distansarbete enligt verksamhetens behov

Om Kraftsam

Kraftsam Rekrytering & Bemanning hjälper företag och offentliga verksamheter att hitta rätt kompetens för både specialist- och ledande roller. Genom personligt engagemang, hög kvalitet och nära samarbete skapar vi långsiktiga matchningar mellan arbetsgivare och kandidater. Vi arbetar med rekrytering, bemanning och konsultlösningar över hela Sverige.

Ansökan

Skicka gärna in din ansökan så snart som möjligt då tjänsten kan komma att tillsättas innan sista ansökningsdag.

Har du frågor om tjänsten, vänligen kontakta ansvarig rekryterare på anbud@kraftsam.se.

Välkommen med din ansökan!

title: Dental Associate

title: Healthcare Assistant

title: Entrepriseleder / Projektleder søges til SærByg Entreprise ApS
description:
Vi søger en erfaren entrepriseleder/projektleder, der kan tage ansvar for egne projekter – og som trives lige så godt med mennesker som med økonomi, tidsplaner og byggeteknik.

Om SærByg Entreprise

SærByg Entreprise ApS arbejder primært med renovering og transformation af eksisterende ejendomme.

Vores hovedopgaver ligger inden for klimaskærm, ombygning og renovering, herunder renovering af offentlige bygninger. Vi løser mellemstore entrepriser på Sjælland og i Storkøbenhavn og lægger stor vægt på kvalitet, ordentlighed og et godt samarbejde gennem hele byggeprocessen.

Vi tror på, at de bedste projekter skabes gennem god dialog og stærke relationer. Derfor betyder samarbejdet med både bygherrer, rådgivere, underentreprenører, leverandører og vores egne medarbejdere meget for os.

Din rolle

Som entrepriseleder/projektleder får du ansvaret for dine egne projekter i tæt samarbejde med dine kollegaer på kontoret og folkene ude på pladserne.

Du kommer typisk til at drive et eller flere projekter ad gangen og følger dem fra opstart til aflevering.

Du får blandt andet ansvar for at:

• styre projekterne med fokus på økonomi, kvalitet og tid
• udarbejde og følge op på tidsplaner og sikre den nødvendige fremdrift
• styre egenproduktion, leverandører og underentreprenører
• afholde byggemøder og sikre en god og konstruktiv dialog mellem projektets parter
• følge sagsøkonomien og sikre en fornuftig anvendelse af materialer, arbejdskraft og øvrige ressourcer
• håndtere dokumentation, aftaler og projektopfølgning
• være den primære kontakt til bygherre, rådgivere, myndigheder og samarbejdspartnere
• bidrage med din erfaring allerede i tilbuds- og planlægningsfasen.

Kort sagt får du ansvar og mulighed for selv at præge den måde, dine projekter bliver gennemført på.

Hvem er du?

Din uddannelsesmæssige baggrund kan være bygningskonstruktør eller tilsvarende. En håndværksmæssig baggrund – gerne som tømrer – er en klar fordel, men din praktiske erfaring og måde at drive projekter på betyder mindst lige så meget for os.

Vi forestiller os, at du:

• har solid erfaring fra entreprenørbranchen, gerne minimum 5 år
• har erfaring med hovedentrepriser og renoveringsprojekter
• har styr på byggeteknik, logistik og planlægning
• kan arbejde sikkert med tidsplaner og projektøkonomi
• har kendskab til relevante aftalevilkår som eksempelvis AB18
• bevarer overblikket og finder løsninger, når et projekt ikke går helt som planlagt
• tager ejerskab og følger dine opgaver helt til dørs
• har forretningsforståelse og kan se projektet fra både kundens og entreprenørens side
• er en holdspiller, som kommunikerer ordentligt og respektfuldt med forskellige mennesker.

Kendskab til E-Komplet og Inspectly er en fordel, men ikke et krav. Det skal vi nok hjælpe dig med.

Hvad tilbyder vi?

Hos SærByg får du en arbejdsplads med korte beslutningsveje, flad struktur og højt til loftet.

Vi er en organisation, hvor man bliver hørt, og hvor der er kort vej fra idé til handling. Du får stor frihed under ansvar og mulighed for både at præge dine egne projekter og være med til at udvikle virksomheden.

Derudover tilbyder vi:

• et stærkt kollegaskab og et godt arbejdsmiljø
• spændende renoverings- og transformationsprojekter
• stor indflydelse på dit eget arbejde
• gode muligheder for faglig udvikling
• attraktive løn- og ansættelsesvilkår efter kvalifikationer
• pension og sundhedsforsikring.

📍 Arbejdssted: Vores kontor i Kirke Såby (mellem Roskilde og Holbæk) samt byggepladser på Sjælland og i Storkøbenhavn.

Skal du være vores nye kollega?

Vil du høre mere om stillingen, er du meget velkommen til at kontakte administrerende direktør Asbjørn Bluhme på 40 92 90 47 eller sab@saerbyg.dk.

Ansøgning sendes til Susanne Klinke på sus@saerbyg.dk.

Vi holder samtaler løbende og ansætter, når vi har fundet den rette.

title: Skoleleder til Grønnemose Skole
description:
Skoleleder til Grønnemose Skole

Med knap 800 elever, fem nyetablerede spor, SFO, klub, NEST-miljøer og kommunens største gruppeordning rummer skolen både volumen, kompleksitet og et særligt potentiale: at udvikle stærke børnefællesskaber, hvor almen- og specialområdet samtænkes som én skole. Nu søger Gladsaxe Kommune en skoleleder, der kan træde tydeligt ind i dét rum.

Som skoleleder får du en central rolle i at samle skolens mange perspektiver og skabe retning for det næste kapitel. Vi skaber gode faglige resultater og lykkes med at løfte de mange elever på forskellige områder. Du skal bygge videre på det, der allerede fungerer, styrke sammenhængskraften på tværs af skolen og bringe elevernes stemmer, medarbejdernes faglighed, forældrenes engagement og kommunens ambitioner endnu tættere sammen i skolens hverdag og udvikling. Børns og unges perspektiver en del af skolens udviklingskraft – og som skoleleder får du en vigtig opgave i at omsætte det til tydelig retning, fælles praksis og stærke deltagelsesmuligheder for alle.

Du får fem ledere og en souschef i direkte reference og bliver samtidigt en del af et tæt, strategisk skolelederfællesskab i en kommune, hvor skoleudvikling prioriteres højt, og hvor der er tydelige ambitioner for børn, trivsel, læring.

Vi søger en leder med skolefaglig tyngde, organisatorisk overblik og lysten til at stå i spidsen for en skole, hvor der er meget på spil – og meget at lykkes med. En leder, der kan kombinere nærvær med retning. Og en leder, der kan samle mennesker, skabe følgeskab og holde fast, også når mange hensyn skal balanceres.

Nysgerrig? Så læs mere i job- og personprofilen (pdf) og søg stillingen via ansøg-linket. Har du spørgsmål om jobbet, er du meget velkommen til at kontakte skolechefen Anne Sofie Borup Stevnhoved på mail: ansost@gladsaxe.dk eller associeret partner i Genitor Stine Rasmussen på mail: SR@genitor.dk eller på tlf. 3141 9808.

Ansøgningsfristen er den 18. oktober 2026.

title: Associate Talent Coordination Specialist
description:
At GWI we’re always looking for extraordinary people who thrive on making an extraordinary impact. Right now we’re looking for an Associate Talent Coordination Specialist to play a key role in our People Operations team in London. If that’s you, and making a difference gets you out of bed in the morning, keep reading. It could be the start of something, well, extraordinary.

If successful at application stage, you'll receive an invitation to submit a one-way video interview so we can get to know you a bit better - keep an eye on spam just in case!

Sounds great, what will I be doing? 🤔

As our Associate Talent Coordination Specialist you’ll:

Sit at the centre of our hiring process, coordinating candidates and interviews end-to-end while keeping every stakeholder in the loop - whatever their role or seniority. Reporting into our Senior People Workflow Specialist, you'll be a trusted point of contact across the business, and someone who's always asking: is there a better way to do this? This isn't a role for someone who just wants to run the process as-is. We'll want your ideas on where AI or automation could help - if there's a smarter, faster way to do something, we want to hear about it and support the activation!

A few things you’ll be responsible for:

👉 Coordinating recruitment activities across the process - using AI and automation to keep things moving at pace without sacrificing accuracy
👉 Ownership of your day to day tasks, from managing diaries across multiple timezones and guiding both candidates and senior stakeholders through the process, to posting job adverts and maybe even creating job offers.
👉 Owning internal and external comms across the hiring process - keeping your candidates and stakeholders clearly and consistently in the loop
👉 Building genuine relationships with Hiring Managers across every level of the business, coordinating their hiring efforts while keeping them clearly informed and supported at each step
👉 Delivering a next-level candidate experience that's fast, clear and memorable for every applicant - successful or not

It's also fun; shaking things up is what working for GWI is all about. You'll need to be flexible, comfortable with continuous change, and working in a high-tempo environment - able to turn on a dime as priorities shift.

What do I need to bring with me? 🧳

This role suits someone early in their career who's already coordinated fast-moving, detail-heavy work - but you don't need TA experience specifically. Strong backgrounds in PA, EA, office management or general coordination are just as welcome as recruitment coordination. Here's what the team will be looking for in you:

👉 Proven coordination or administrative experience - hands-on ATS experience such as Greenhouse is a plus. You will be abel to hit the ground running with minimal ramp-up time
👉 Detail attentive while driven by urgency - accuracy-obsessed, steady under pressure, fast to react, and quick to reprioritise no matter the pace. Time management is your superpower.
👉 Strong and adaptable communication skills to keep candidates, Hiring Managers and the wider team clearly and consistently in the loop
👉 Fluency in and a genuine curiosity about AI tools and automation - you’re already using this in your day to day - constantly looking for ways in which AI can help you work more efficiently and effectively
👉 Natural problem solver - you notice when something's not quite working and aren't afraid to flag it and offer a solution
👉 You keep a pulse on the talent market - who's hiring, what candidates expect, and where the competition is moving - so every conversation with candidates and Hiring Managers is grounded in what's actually happening out there, not guesswork
👉 A passion for delivering a positive, memorable candidate experience - every touchpoint matters, and you're a brand ambassador for GWI throughout

Equally important is attitude. We want people who think big (to make an impact), ask why (to find a better way), and show respect (to everyone, at every level, all the time). Those are our values, and they’re a big part of what we’re looking for in you.

Why Join Us

👉 A front-row seat in a fast-growing, global data tech company
👉 Real ownership from day one - this is a company built on trust, not micromanagement
👉 A supportive, forward-thinking People & Culture team that values curiosity over ticking boxes
👉 Hybrid working in our London office… also epic snacks!

What We Offer 🧘

At GWI, you’ll find meaningful work, visible impact, and a culture that empowers you to do your best. Our package includes:

  • Time to recharge – 25 days’ annual leave, plus office closures over the holidays.
  • Health & wellbeing – Health cash plan, enhanced family benefits, carer days, and mental health support.
  • Financial benefits – Competitive salary, 4% pension matching, and recognition programs that celebrate success.
  • Flexibility & balance – Flexitime, early Friday finishes, hybrid and remote options, plus a “work from home” budget.
  • Career growth – Accredited learning, leadership development, and global career mobility.
  • Community & impact – DE&I initiatives, volunteering opportunities, donation matching, and payroll giving.

Put all that together and GWI is the friendliest, most fulfilling place any of us has ever worked.

Diversity, Equity & Inclusion 🫶

Diversity is fundamental to who we are—as a data company and as a workplace. Our data reflects global realities, and so must our teams. We strive to build a workforce as diverse and inclusive as the insights we deliver.

As a Disability Confident employer, we welcome applications from disabled candidates and are committed to making adjustments throughout the hiring process—whether that's extra time, materials in advance or a different format, breaks, an adjusted interview format, assistive tools, or flexible scheduling. We're happy to discuss whatever would work best for you.

We actively encourage applications from underrepresented and marginalised communities.

At GWI, you'll find a place to contribute meaningfully, grow professionally, and belong fully.

title: Postdoctoral Position in Animal Welfare Risks of Feeding Red Seaweed to Dairy Cows
description:
The Department of Animal and Veterinary Sciences, Aarhus University, calls for applications for a full-time postdoctoral position. The two-year position is available from 1 February 2027, or soon thereafter. The position will be in the research unit Behaviour, stress and welfare (BSW).

Dairy cattle contribute substantially to agricultural greenhouse gas emissions, primarily through enteric methane production, making the identification of effective nutritional mitigation strategies an important area of research. While the feed additive Bovaer has received considerable attention for its methane-reducing effects, concerns regarding animal health and welfare have led to increasing interest in alternative solutions, including seaweed-based feed additives. The seaweed Asparagopsis spp. has shown significant methane-mitigating potential; however, its use has also raised animal welfare concerns. Consequently, there is a need to evaluate the animal welfare effects of seaweed-based feed additives.

Research tasks

  • Evaluating the effects of seaweed-based feed additives on the behaviour and welfare of dairy cattle.
  • Investigating behavioural indicators of discomfort and pain associated with feed management.
  • Validating welfare assessment measures through experimental approaches, including pharmacological interventions.
  • Contributing to scientific publications and dissemination of research results.
  • Participating in knowledge exchange activities with public authorities and industry stakeholders.
  • Contributing to teaching and supervision of students at the bachelor's, master's, and PhD levels.

Qualifications

We are seeking a candidate who has:

  • A PhD degree or equivalent in biology, animal science, veterinary science, or a related field, and research experience in animal behaviour and welfare.
  • A strong interest in strategies aimed at reducing the climate impact of dairy production through feeding management.
  • At least a basic understanding of feeding management.
  • Strong interpersonal and communication skills, with a demonstrated ability to communicate scientific research results effectively.
  • The ability to work independently as well as collaboratively in a research environment.
  • For non-Scandinavian candidates, a commitment to learning Danish, including reading, writing, and speaking, is expected during the employment period.

Contact

Further information on the position may be obtained from Professor Margit Bak Jensen, phone: +4522365482, email: margitbak.jensen@anivet.au.dk

What we offer

  • A well-developed research infrastructure, laboratories and access to shared equipment and animal experimental facilities
  • An informal and multicultural research environment with high professionalism and close collaboration and networking activities
  • A workplace characterized by equality and a good work-life balance, and an open discussion across different fields of research.

The candidate will have the opportunity to be trained and gain experience in:

  • Teaching and supervision of students at the BSc and MSc level through active involvement in teaching in animal science and in the veterinary science programme.
  • Research-based consultancy to authorities, where it is relevant.

Who we are

Department of Animal and Veterinary Sciences is well-known for its skilled and very innovative interdisciplinary research environments with high international impact. We perform world-class research, which contributes with solutions to solve essential societal challenges within the green transition: food production and veterinary medicine – nationally and globally.

The department generates novel research at the highest international level within sustainable food production, environment, climate, health and welfare for animals and humans. The activities form the basis for the research-based public sector consultancy and degree programs covering bachelor’s, master’s and PhD degree programs within animal science and veterinary medicine. We offer a lively, engaged and innovative learning and study environment, which is closely integrated in the research environment.

Our department has unique and advanced animal experimental research facilities and technologies, situated in close connection to the research environment, and a comprehensive national and international research network and good industrial and professional collaboration.

Please refer to Department of Animal and Veterinary Sciences (au.dk) for further information about the department:

Place of work and area of employment

The place of work is the Department of Animal and Veterinary Sciences, AU Viborg,
Blichers Allé 20, DK-8830 Tjele, and the area of employment is Aarhus University (AU) with related departments.

Living in Denmark

Please visit the international staff website: for information about arriving to and living in Denmark for both the applicants and their potential families.

Application procedure

Shortlisting is used. This means that after the deadline for applications – and with the assistance from the assessment committee chairman, and the appointment committee if necessary, – the head of department selects the candidates to be evaluated. All applicants will be notified whether or not their applications have been sent to an expert assessment committee for evaluation. The selected applicants will be informed about the composition of the committee, and each applicant is given the opportunity to comment on the part of the assessment that concerns him/her self.

Formalities and salary range

Technical Sciences refers to the Ministerial Order on the Appointment of Academic Staff at Danish Universities under the Danish Ministry of Science, Technology and Innovation.

The application must be in English and include a curriculum vitae, degree certificate, a complete list of publications, a statement of future research plans and information about research activities, teaching portfolio and verified information on previous teaching experience (if any). Guidelines for applicants can be found here.

Appointment shall be in accordance with the collective labour agreement between the Danish Ministry of Taxation and the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations. Further information on qualification requirements and job content may be found in the Memorandum on Job Structure for Academic Staff at Danish Universities.

Salary and terms as agreed between the Danish Ministry of Taxation and the Confederation of Professional Unions at basic salary steps 4-8.

Aarhus University’s ambition is to be an attractive and inspiring workplace for all and to foster a culture in which each individual has opportunities to thrive, achieve and develop. We view equality and diversity as assets, and we welcome all applicants.

Research activities will be evaluated in relation to actual research time. Thus, we encourage applicants to specify periods of leave without research activities, in order to be able to subtract these periods from the span of the scientific career during the evaluation of scientific productivity.

Aarhus University offers a broad variety of services for international researchers and accompanying families, including relocation service and career counselling to expat partners. Read more here. Please find more information about entering and working in Denmark here.

Aarhus University also offers a Junior Researcher Development Programme targeted at career development for postdocs at AU. You can read more about it here.

The application must be submitted via Aarhus University’s recruitment system, which can be accessed under the job advertisement on Aarhus University's website.

title: Eligibility Counselor/Quality Assurance
company: Early Learning Coalition of Hillsborough County
description:
POSITION SUMMARY


Under the direct supervision of the Manager, Eligibility, the Eligibility Counselor will educate families on quality childcare opportunities through childcare listings, provide referrals to community resources, and communicate with clients to determine eligibility for the Voluntary Prekindergarten Program (VPK) and the School Readiness (SR) Programs.


ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES


  • Respond to requests for information regarding Childcare Resources and Referral (CCR&R) on rules, policies and procedures and community resources for the SR and VPK programs.
  • Provide clients with resources such as provider listing if requested.
  • Resolve issues and concerns by providing solutions to customers.
  • Identify and escalate priority issues to appropriate leader.
  • Process determinations for the Wait List; initial eligibility for placement and redetermination based on federal, state, and local program requirements, rules, and responsibilities.
  • Collect required documentation to verify client’s eligibility such as partner agency referrals; the purpose of care; residency; child’s age and citizenship; and any other required eligibility documentation.
  • Process requests via the Division of Early Learning Coalition Portal to change providers, transfer in/out of county; suspension of care; classroom transfer; parent/household income changes, purpose of care; enrollment and re-enrollment of children; and termination of services.
  • Deliver exceptional internal and external customer service.
  • Review and verify information in the Division of Early Learning Coalition Portal to ensure accuracy.
  • Record and communicate updates with both clients and childcare providers in the Division of Early Learning Coalition Portal and the WebAuthor Portal
  • Record contact with clients and case processing to reinforce transparency of the agency and keep a history to assist other caseworkers who are contacted by the client.
  • Conduct Internal audits of client files; provide feedback to Eligibility Counselors; collaborate with staff to correct file errors.
  • Develop and Lead Eligibility and Intake Staff training in response to internal audit findings and feedback.
  • Safeguard all client information to ensure compliance with confidentiality policies.
  • Immediately report claims of child abuse and/or neglect to the appropriate leader
  • Assist walk-ins with the online registration process
  • As a state mandated reporter, immediately report any suspected abuse, fraud, or misrepresentation along with supporting documentation to the appropriate leader.
  • Communicate with partner agencies of any changes in policies and procedures.
  • Follow up with clients and childcare providers regarding child absences.
  • Assist across departments with any childcare enrollment and eligibility issues.
  • Attend meetings, trainings and/or conferences pertaining to SR, CCR&R and VPK as essential
  • Attend community outreach and sponsored events representing the ELCHC as needed.
  • Support the Intake team as needed.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

title: Operator Surveillance

title: Licensed Clinical Staff (LCSW, LMFT or LPC)
description:
Benchmark's Mobile Crisis Response Team- our clinicians are dispatched into the community to respond to crisis calls in region 5 of GA, Zone B.


Since 1960, Benchmark has been connecting people and potential. We are committed to empowering those we serve to live as independently as possible, be included in their communities, and reach their full potential. This mission extends to our employees, who bring our mission to life each day. We actively strive to be a workplace that honors the unique experiences, perspectives, and strengths of our employees. We believe we are stronger, better, and more effective in our pursuits when we create space for everyone to be their authentic selves.


Benchmark Human Services has grown to become one of the most respected leaders in the country in the areas of intellectual and developmental disabilities (IDD) and behavioral health. We work with people of all ages at home, at work, and in the community through residential programs, employment services, crisis response, early intervention, and more. View our 65 Years of Stories campaign to learn more about the impact Benchmark employees have made across the country.


Benchmark is seeking a Licensed Clinical Social Worker (LCSW), a Licensed Professional Counselor (LPC) or a Licensed Marriage and Family Therapist (LMFT) to join our Blended Mobile Crisis team in providing crisis support services to individuals in our community who are experiencing a behavioral health crisis. We provide thorough training, great challenges, and even greater fulfillment as you help individuals reach their maximum potential.


Schedule:

7 days on following 7 days off

DAYS 6:30am-6:30pm

NIGHTS 6:30pm-6:30am


Benefits:

  • Competitive wages based on experience
  • Salaried position with no billable hours.
  • Potential 5K annual bonus on top of salary.
  • Health dental, vision insurance
  • 401k plan with company match
  • Mileage Reimbursement
  • Tuition reimbursement
  • Paid Time Off and Sick Time Pay
  • Flexible Spending Accounts (FSA)
  • Various shifts and locations
  • Advancement opportunities

General responsibilities:

  • Act as the onsite crisis team leader.
  • Respond immediately when dispatched on crisis responses and be present to provide supervision to staff.
  • Follow up with individual’s IDT to ensure that they adhere to the crisis-service-recommended support/services.
  • Assist in providing information to the mobile crisis team.
  • Facilitate referrals quickly to prevent escalation of crisis.
  • Establish and maintain record keeping functions; integration with CIS system.
  • Complete necessary documentation to facilitate reimbursement through primary funding sources.

title: Small Business Programmes Business Executive
description:
Join a programme that is helping manufacturers embrace digital innovation and drive meaningful economic impact. As a Made Smarter Business Executive, you will play a vital role in supporting the successful delivery of the Made Smarter programme, ensuring businesses receive an outstanding experience from initial enquiry through to programme participation.

Working within a fast-paced and collaborative team, you will provide essential operational, administrative and customer service support across programme delivery, governance, reporting and stakeholder engagement. From managing data and producing insights to coordinating events, supporting marketing activities and engaging with SMEs, you will help keep the programme running smoothly while contributing to its growth and success.

This is an exciting opportunity to develop valuable expertise in programme management, governance, compliance, data analysis and digital technologies while making a tangible difference to businesses and communities. If you are highly organised, customer-focused and eager to build your skills in a role with real social and economic impact, this is an excellent opportunity to grow your career.
Programme Monitoring, Reporting & Governance

· Monitor programme performance against delivery, financial, output and outcome targets, ensuring delivery and quality concerns are raised and tacked promptly.

· Understand and track risks, issues and mitigation actions, escalating concerns where appropriate.

· Coordinate, create, cleanse and maintain programme CRM, documentation, reports and governance records on a regular basis to meet compliance obligations.

· Produce reports and performance insights for funders and internal stakeholders to support performance monitoring, decision-making and service improvement.

Grant Administration & Compliance

· Support end-to-end grant administration, including applications, assessments, awards and claims processes.

· Coordinate assessor documentation, grant panel meetings and minute taking.

· Support eligibility and compliance checks; liaising with applicants, the finance team and Programme Manager.

· Track and maintain grant records, CRM data and supporting documentation to ensure end-to-end processes are completed and compliance is met.

· Process purchase orders, invoices and financial claims in line with funding and organisational requirements.

Programme Operations, Events & Logistics

· Coordinate meetings, workshops, webinars and events with internal and external stakeholders.

· Manage event logistics, including venue booking, attendee registration and event delivery support.

· Prepare agendas, presentations, minutes, action logs and project documentation.

· Support the delivery of alumni engagement activities such as; webinars, workshops, networking events and the end of year event.

Data, Insights & Continuous Improvement

· Collect, analyse and report on SME feedback and programme engagement data; working with the delivery team and external stakeholders.

· Coordinate impact surveys and monitor programme outcomes.

· Produce insights and recommendations to improve programme delivery and customer experience.

· Support the development of reporting and operational processes.

Stakeholder & Customer Support

· Act as a key point of contact for SME enquiries, ensuring a professional and responsive service.

· Manage programme inboxes and handle day-to-day communications.

· Build and maintain effective relationships with SMEs, delivery partners, universities and stakeholders.

· Support stakeholder engagement activities and respond to queries on behalf of the team where appropriate.

Digital Internship Programme Coordination

· Lead the administration and monitoring of the Digital Internship programme.

· Liaise with universities and delivery partners to promote internship opportunities.

· Coordinate internship applications, placements and reviews.

· Monitor compliance, performance and outcomes of internship placements.

Marketing, Outreach & SME Engagement

· Support Made Smarter’s Marketing Executive and Social Media Executive with marketing, outreach campaigns to raise awareness of the Made Smarter programme and generate SME engagement.

· Coordinate promotional activities with internal marketing teams and external partners.

· Support the marketing team with creation, distribution and tracking of marketing communications, including newsletters, events and digital campaigns.

· Manage and monitor and review event registrations and campaign leads and follow-up activities, to convert leads into programme participants.

· Monitor outreach performance and engagement metrics, providing insights and recommendations to improve campaign effectiveness.

· Gather and share SME success stories, testimonials to support the development of case studies and impact reporting.

Additional Responsibilities

· Undertake other reasonable administrative and operational duties to support the Small Business Directorate.
· Knowledge of project management, including data analysis, project planning and evaluation
· Well-developed IT skills, experience of using financial and content management systems and processes and excellent report writing skills

· In-depth knowledge of Excel and other MS Office tools including PowerPoint and Word

· In-depth knowledge of database systems (e.g. Salesforce) including data entry and cleansing and experience using CRM systems, e.g. Salesforce, is desirable

· Knowledge of data collection software (e.g. google forms, smart survey) desirable
· Excellent written and verbal communication skills
· Strong interpersonal and customer service skills
· Ability to effectively develop and implement work plans
· Organise all tasks to be delivered to the required standards.
· Ability to achieve deadlines and targets
· Excellent attention to detail with high professional standards
· Proficiency in administrative procedures; and an ability to work effectively within a target-driven, KPI process-driven environment
· Experience coordinating events
In addition, you will be able to demonstrate attention to detail, willingness to be flexible based on the requirements of the team, ability to multi-task and willingness to collaborate with other team members as well as work on your own initiative when required to do so

· Service-driven, with a passion for delivering exceptional stakeholder value
· Proactive team player, contributing creative and innovative solutions to projects and objectives.

· Helps foster collaboration, constructive dialogue and builds trust with peers.

title: SDE Intern - Frontend
description:
WHO ARE WE?

We are a bunch of super enthusiastic, passionate, and highly driven people, working to achieve a common goal! We believe that work and the workplace should be joyful and always buzzing with energy!

CloudSEK, one of India’s most trusted Cyber security product companies, is on a mission to build the world’s fastest and most reliable AI technology that identifies and resolves digital threats in real-time. The central proposition is leveraging Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning to create a quick and reliable analysis and alert system that provides rapid detection across multiple internet sources, precise threat analysis, and prompt resolution with minimal human intervention.

Founded in 2015, headquartered at Singapore, we are proud to say that we’ve grown at a frenetic pace and have been able to achieve some accolades along the way, including:

CloudSEK’s Product Suite:

  • CloudSEK XVigil constantly maps a customer’s digital assets, identifies threats and enriches them with cyber intelligence, and then provides workflows to manage and remediate all identified threats including takedown support.
  • A powerful Attack Surface Monitoring tool that gives visibility and intelligence on customers’ attack surfaces. CloudSEK's BeVigil uses a combination of Mobile, Web, Network and Encryption Scanners to map and protect known and unknown assets.
  • CloudSEK’s Contextual AI SVigil identifies software supply chain risks by monitoring Software, Cloud Services, and third-party dependencies.
  • CloudSEK’s AIVigil is an AI-native Attack Surface Monitoring platform that continuously discovers, monitors, and secures exposed AI infrastructure, MCP servers, leaked AI credentials, vector databases, agentic workflows, and shadow AI across the internet.

Key Milestones:

  • 2016: Launched our first product.
  • 2018: Secured Pre-series A funding.
  • 2019: Expanded operations to India, Southeast Asia, and the Americas.
  • 2020: Won the NASSCOM-DSCI Excellence Award for Security Product Company of the Year.
  • 2021: Raised $7M in Series A funding led by MassMutual Ventures.
  • Awards & Recognition: Won NetApp Excellerator's "Best Growth Strategy Award," CloudSEK XVigil joined NVIDIA Inception Program, and won the NASSCOM Emerge 50 Cybersecurity Award.
  • 2025: Secured $19 million in funding led by Tenacity Ventures, Commvault.
ABOUT THE ROLE
We are looking for frontend engineers who are obsessed with technology, have a creative eye to solve problems and love to make an impact!

What are we looking for?
  • Great programming skills with expertise in Frontend.
  • JavaScript- Hands-on experience working with Object Oriented JavaScript (OOJS), JavaScript libraries and their practical uses in building complex interactive experiences.
  • Experience working in ReactJS.
  • Understanding of stateful (container) vs stateless (presentational) components and how to break down the application into components
  • Understanding of different CSS architectures that go hand-in- hand with ReactJS application development.

What’s in it for you?
  • Work with the best company in the external predictive threat intelligence space
  • Assured professional and personal growth by working with proficient, experienced, and approachable teams.

Please Note :

  • We are currently looking for candidates who can work from Bangalore office at-least 4 days in a week (we have 5 days working, Mon-Fri.)

Benefits of Joining CloudSEK

We provide an environment where you can develop and enhance your skills while delivering meaningful work that matters. You’ll be rewarded a competitive salary as well as a full spectrum of generous perks and incentives which include:

  • Flexible working hours.

And, the finest part is yet to come! Every now and then we ensure to unwind and have a good time together, which involves games, fun, and soulful music. Feel free to show off your artistic side here!

title: Lead DevOps Engineer
description:
Why Join EML?

Flexibility That Supports Your Life

giving you more control over your time and work life balance.

EML’s investment in AI-powered technology is designed to reduce admin, giving you more time to focus on making a real difference in people’s lives.

Make a real difference in people's lives with EML


As we expand, our Technology team is growing rapidly, driving innovation in AI for Workers Compensation. We're transforming the industry with cutting-edge solutions that enhance claims management, improve outcomes, and streamline processes.

We’re now welcoming applications for DevOps Lead to join our supportive, purpose‑driven team in Sydney on a Permanent, full-time basis. This is deeply meaningful work where your empathy, problem‑solving and commitment have a profound impact every single day.

As our DevOps Lead, you’ll combine hands-on technical expertise with people leadership to drive automation, strengthen our cloud infrastructure and make software delivery faster, more reliable and secure. You’ll develop your team and partner with AI, infrastructure and security specialists to turn ideas into meaningful improvements

What You’ll Be Doing

  • Build and improve CI/CD pipelines and automation to support fast, reliable and secure software releases across cloud and on-premise environments.

  • Design and manage infrastructure using Terraform and Ansible, improving scalability, resilience and cost efficiency across AWS, Azure and VMware.

It’s ok if you haven’t done this before, what matters most is your commitment to helping others that can make you a great fit for the role. Do you have…
